	function createLiveGameLibrary(readLibrary = () => globalThis.lib) {
		const current = () => {
			const value = readLibrary();
			return value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};
		};
		return new Proxy({}, {
			get: (_target, key) => {
				const library = current();
				const value = Reflect.get(library, key);
				return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(library) : value;
			},
			has: (_target, key) => Reflect.has(current(), key),
			ownKeys: () => Reflect.ownKeys(current()),
			getOwnPropertyDescriptor: (_target, key) => {
				const descriptor = Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(current(), key);
				return descriptor ? {
					...descriptor,
					configurable: true
				} : void 0;
			}
		});

	/**
	* Глубокое клонирование: structuredClone с JSON.stringify fallback для старых браузеров.
	*/
	function cloneData(value) {
		if (globalThis.structuredClone) try {
			return globalThis.structuredClone(value);
		} catch {}
		if (value == null) return value;
		return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
	}
	/**
	* Проверяет, является ли значение простым объектом (не null, не массив).
	*/
	function isPlainObject(value) {
		return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
	}
	/**
	* Приводит значение к простому объекту, для остального возвращает пустую запись.
	* Заменяет самодельные `getPlainRecord`/`toRecord`, которые каждый скрипт писал сам.
	*/
	function asPlainRecord(value) {
		return isPlainObject(value) ? value : {};
	}
	/**
	* Вариант для грязного runtime игры, где массив тоже используется как запись:
	* проверяется только `typeof === "object"`.
	*/
	function asObjectRecord(value) {
		return value !== null && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};
	}
	/**
	* Nullable-вариант: часть runtime-кода отличает «не запись» от «пустая запись».

	function asRecordOrNull(value) {

	function siftDown(heap, index) {
		while (true) {
			const left = index * 2 + 1;
			const right = left + 1;
			let smallest = index;
			if (left < heap.length && isLowerRank(heap[left], heap[smallest])) smallest = left;
			if (right < heap.length && isLowerRank(heap[right], heap[smallest])) smallest = right;
			if (smallest === index) return;
			[heap[index], heap[smallest]] = [heap[smallest], heap[index]];
			index = smallest;
		}
	}
	function siftUp(heap, index) {
		while (index > 0) {
			const parent = Math.floor((index - 1) / 2);
			if (!isLowerRank(heap[index], heap[parent])) return;
			[heap[index], heap[parent]] = [heap[parent], heap[index]];
			index = parent;
		}
	}
	function topK(items, requestedCount, getter) {
		const count = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(requestedCount));
		if (count === 0 || items.length === 0) return [];
		if (items.length <= count) return items.map((value, index) => ({
			value,
			score: finiteNumber$2(getter(value), Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY),
			index
		})).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.index - right.index).map(({ value }) => value);
		const heap = [];
		for (let index = 0; index < items.length; index += 1) {
			const value = items[index];
			const score = finiteNumber$2(getter(value), Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
			if (heap.length < count) {
				heap.push({
					value,
					score,
					index
				});
				siftUp(heap, heap.length - 1);
				continue;
			}
			const lowest = heap[0];
			if (score > lowest.score || score === lowest.score && index < lowest.index) {
				heap[0] = {
					value,
					score,
					index
				};
				siftDown(heap, 0);
			}
		}
		return heap.sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.index - right.index).map(({ value }) => value);
	}

	function resolveBattleTimelineIndex(timeline, time) {

	}

	/** Подставляет исполненные индексы в переносимый снимок, не меняя исходную команду. */
	function resolveTimeOnlyBattleInput(input, indices) {
		const result = [...input];
		for (let offset = 0, cursor = 0; offset < result.length; cursor++) {
			const type = result[offset];
			const width = type === "auto" ? 3 : type === "custom" ? 5 : type === "cast" || type === "teamCustom" ? 4 : 0;
			if (!width || offset + width > result.length) throw new Error("Неизвестная или неполная команда боя при разрешении времени.");
			const index = indices[cursor];
			if (index !== void 0) {
				if (!Number.isSafeInteger(index) || index < 0) throw new Error("Некорректный фактический индекс команды боя.");
				result[offset + 1] = index;
			}
			offset += width;
		}
		return result;
	}

	//#region src/shared/game/smart-battle-engine/runtime-input-replay.ts
	/**
	* Индексы из probe действуют лишь до первого изменения событий боя. Сохраняем
	* нативный порядок достижимых команд, а устаревший индекс привязываем к фактическому
	* состоянию в заданное время. Защиту игры от циклов и расчёт событий не отключаем.
	* Перехват действует только внутри сериализованного Calc и снимается его владельцем.
	*/
	function installRuntimeInputReplay(registry, options = {}) {
		const Engine = registry["battle.BattleEngine"];
		const Timeline = registry["battle.timeline.Timeline"];
		const Holder = registry["battle.InputEventHolder"];
		if (!Engine || !Timeline || !Holder) return null;
		let contract = contracts.get(Engine);
		if (contract === void 0) {
			contract = readContract(Engine, Timeline, Holder);
			contracts.set(Engine, contract);
		}
		if (!contract) return null;
		const c = contract;
		const prototype = Engine.prototype;
		const descriptors = c.keys.map((key) => [key, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(prototype, key)]);
		if (descriptors.some(([, descriptor]) => !descriptor.writable)) return null;
		const original = prototype[c.keys[0]];
		const wrapped = function() {
			const input = this.input;
			if (!input) return Reflect.apply(original, this, []);
			const timeline = this[c.timeline];
			const advance = timeline[c.advance];
			const guard = this[c.guard];
			const readTime = input[c.timeGetter];
			const readIndex = input[c.indexGetter];
			const next = input.next;
			let time = readTime.call(input);
			let index = readIndex.call(input);
			let previousTime = -1;
			while (time < c.end) {
				if (options.resolveInputByTime) {
					if (time === 0 && Number(timeline[c.index]) === 0) advance.call(timeline, 0, 0);
					else if (time !== previousTime) advance.call(timeline, time);
					guard.call(this);
					if (timeline.time === c.end) break;
					const cursor = Number(input[c.cursor]);
					const actualIndex = Number(timeline[c.index]);
					input[c.events][cursor][c.eventIndex] = actualIndex;
					options.onResolvedIndex?.(cursor, actualIndex);
					previousTime = time;
					time = next.call(input);
					index = readIndex.call(input);
					guard.call(this);
					continue;
				}
				advance.call(timeline, time, index);
				guard.call(this);
				if (timeline.time === c.end) break;
				if (timeline[c.index] !== index) {
					advance.call(timeline, time);
					guard.call(this);
					if (timeline.time === c.end) break;
					const events = input[c.events];
					events[Number(input[c.cursor])][c.eventIndex] = timeline[c.index];
				}
				time = next.call(input);
				index = readIndex.call(input);
				guard.call(this);
			}
			advance.call(timeline, c.end);
		};
		for (const [key] of descriptors) prototype[key] = wrapped;
		return () => {
			for (const [key, descriptor] of descriptors) if (prototype[key] === wrapped) Object.defineProperty(prototype, key, descriptor);
		};
	}
	/** Контракт выводится из фактических методов клиента, а не номеров полей сборки. */
	function readContract(Engine, Timeline, Holder) {
		const methods = Object.entries(Engine.prototype).filter(([, value]) => typeof value === "function");
		const candidate = methods.find(([, value]) => {
			const source = String(value);
			return source.includes("this.input.next()") && /[\w$]+=this\.input\.[\w$]+\(\),[\w$]+=this\.input\.[\w$]+\(\)/.test(source);
		});
		if (!candidate) return null;
		const source = String(candidate[1]);
		const getters = source.match(/([\w$]+)=this\.input\.([\w$]+)\(\),([\w$]+)=this\.input\.([\w$]+)\(\)/);
		const advance = source.match(/this\.([\w$]+)\.([\w$]+)\(([\w$]+),([\w$]+)\);this\.([\w$]+)\(\)/);
		const index = source.match(/==this\.([\w$]+)\.([\w$]+)/);
		const end = source.match(/\.time!=[\w$]+\.([\w$]+)/);
		if (!getters || !advance || !index || !end) return null;
		if (getters[1] !== advance[3] || getters[3] !== advance[4] || advance[1] !== index[1]) return null;
		const event = String(Holder.prototype[getters[4]]).match(/this\.([\w$]+)\[this\.([\w$]+)\]\.([\w$]+)/);
		const endTime = Timeline[end[1]];
		if (!event || typeof endTime !== "number" || !(endTime > 0)) return null;
		if (!String(Engine.prototype[advance[5]]).includes("possible infinite replay loop")) return null;
		return {
			keys: methods.filter(([, value]) => value === candidate[1]).map(([key]) => key),
			timeline: advance[1],
			advance: advance[2],
			guard: advance[5],
			index: index[2],
			timeGetter: getters[2],
			indexGetter: getters[4],
			events: event[1],
			cursor: event[2],
			eventIndex: event[3],
			end: endTime
		};
	}

	//#region src/shared/game/smart-battle-engine/game-runtime-calculator.ts
	/**
	* Полный журнал нужен длительности боя, поиску окон ульт и истории, но не
	* оценке урона. Декодируем при первом обращении, а для одной длительности
	* не держим тысячи событий в каждом сохранённом прогоне.
	*/
	function createGameRuntimeBattleCalculation(raw, { decodeLogs, timerDivisor }) {
		const { encodedLogs, battleTimeLimit: timeLimit } = raw;
		let decodedLogs = null;
		let durations = null;
		const decode = () => {
			const probe = getBattlePerformanceProbe();
			const startedAt = probe ? readPerformanceTime() : 0;
			const logs = decodeLogs(encodedLogs);
			if (probe) {
				probe.add("calc.decodeLogs", readPerformanceTime() - startedAt);
				probe.count("calc.decodedLogs");
			}
			return logs;
		};
		const readDurations = () => {
			if (durations) return durations;
			if (decodedLogs) {
				durations = decodedLogs.map((events) => getBattleDuration(events, timeLimit));
				return durations;
			}
			durations = decode().map((events) => getBattleDuration(events, timeLimit));
			return durations;
		};
		const calculation = {
			battleLogs: void 0,
			battleTime: void 0,
			battleTimeLimit: timeLimit,
			battleTimer: void 0,
			battleData: raw.battleData,
			progress: raw.progress,
			result: raw.result,
			timeline: raw.timeline
		};
		defineLazyCalculationValue(calculation, "battleLogs", () => {
			decodedLogs ?? (decodedLogs = decode());
			return decodedLogs;
		});
		defineLazyCalculationValue(calculation, "battleTime", () => readDurations().reduce((total, duration) => total + duration, 0));
		defineLazyCalculationValue(calculation, "battleTimer", () => readDurations().reduce((total, duration) => total + toDisplayTimer(duration, timerDivisor), 0));
		return calculation;
	}
	function toDisplayTimer(duration, divisor) {
		return Math.max(Math.ceil(duration / divisor + 1.5), 4);
	}
	/**
	* Геттер вычисляет значение один раз и кэширует его. Запись заменяет геттер
	* обычным полем, чтобы потребители могли переопределить значение как раньше.
	* structuredClone, JSON и IndexedDB читают такие поля через [[Get]].
	*/
	function defineLazyCalculationValue(target, key, compute) {
		let resolved = false;
		let value;
		Object.defineProperty(target, key, {
			configurable: true,
			enumerable: true,
			get: () => {
				if (!resolved) {
					value = compute();
					resolved = true;
				}
				return value;
			},
			set: (next) => {
				Object.defineProperty(target, key, {
					configurable: true,
					enumerable: true,
					writable: true,
					value: next
				});
			}
		});
	}

	}

	function findCompletionSignal(instant, BattleInstantPlay) {

		let baseKeys = instantPlayFieldNames.get(BattleInstantPlay);
		if (!baseKeys) {
			baseKeys = new Set(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(BattleInstantPlay.prototype));
			instantPlayFieldNames.set(BattleInstantPlay, baseKeys);
		}
		const fieldNames = baseKeys;
		const entries = Object.entries(instant);
		const inheritedCandidates = entries.filter(([key, value]) => fieldNames.has(key) && isRuntimeSignal(value));
		const allCandidates = inheritedCandidates.length === 1 ? inheritedCandidates : entries.filter(([, value]) => isRuntimeSignal(value));
		if (allCandidates.length === 1) {
			const [key, signal] = allCandidates[0];
			if (prototype) completionSignalKeys.set(prototype, key);
			return signal;
		}
		throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не удалось однозначно найти completion-сигнал BattleInstantPlay. Игровой контракт изменился.");
	}
	function findEncodedBattleLogs(result, progress) {
		const candidates = Object.values(result).filter((value) => value !== progress && Array.isArray(value) && value.every((entry) => typeof entry === "string"));
		if (candidates.length === 0) return [];
		return candidates.reduce((best, current) => current.length > best.length ? current : best);
	}
	function decodeBattleLog(encoded, BattleLogReader, BattleLogEncoder) {
		const read = BattleLogEncoder.read;
		if (typeof read !== "function") throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("У BattleLogEncoder пропал статический метод read. Игровой контракт изменился.");
		const decoded = Reflect.apply(read, BattleLogEncoder, [new BattleLogReader(encoded)]);
		if (!Array.isArray(decoded)) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("BattleLogEncoder.read вернул не массив событий. Игровой контракт изменился.");
		return decoded.filter((event) => asRecordOrNull(event) !== null);
	}
	function getBattleDuration(events, timeLimit) {
		let duration = 0;
		for (const event of events) {
			const time = event.time;
			if (typeof time === "number" && Number.isFinite(time) && time >= 0 && time < timeLimit && time !== BATTLE_END_SENTINEL_TIME) duration = Math.max(duration, time);
		}
		return duration;
	}
	function isRuntimeSignal(value) {
		const record = asRecordOrNull(value);
		return record !== null && typeof record.add === "function";
	}
	function normalizePositiveNumber(value, fallback) {
		return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
	}

	var DEFAULT_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 12e4;

	/** Пул не может посчитать бой сейчас: расчёт нужно выполнить в основном потоке. */
	var CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError = class extends Error {
		constructor(message) {
			super(message);
			this.name = "CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError";
		}
	};
	/** Воркер получил ошибку игры на конкретном бою; страница решает, общая ли она. */

	var GameCalcWorkerPool = class {
		constructor(options) {
			_defineProperty(this, "options", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "generation", 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "slots", []);
			_defineProperty(this, "startingSlots", []);
			_defineProperty(this, "queue", []);
			_defineProperty(this, "stateValue", "idle");
			_defineProperty(this, "starting", null);
			_defineProperty(this, "sourceKey", null);
			_defineProperty(this, "nextRequestId", 1);
			_defineProperty(this, "idleTimer", null);
			_defineProperty(this, "disabledReason", "");
			_defineProperty(this, "lifecycle", 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "replacing", false);
			this.options = options;
		}
		get state() {
			return this.stateValue;
		}
		get size() {
			return this.stateValue === "ready" ? this.slots.length : 0;
		}
		/** Число занятых Calc-воркеров; это занятость пула, а не процент CPU ОС. */
		get busyWorkers() {
			return this.slots.filter((slot) => slot.busy).length;
		}
		get disabledMessage() {
			return this.disabledReason;
		}
		start() {
			if (this.stateValue === "disabled") return Promise.resolve(false);
			if (this.starting) return this.starting;
			let key;
			try {
				key = this.options.readSourceKey();
			} catch (error) {
				this.disable(`Calc-воркерам не хватает данных страницы: ${errorMessage$2(error)}`);
				return Promise.resolve(false);
			}
			if (this.stateValue === "ready") {
				if (key === this.sourceKey) return Promise.resolve(true);
				this.stop("Данные игры сменились, воркеры перезапускаются.");
			}
			if (!key) return Promise.resolve(false);
			this.starting = this.launch(key).finally(() => {
				this.starting = null;
			});
			return this.starting;
		}
		calculateRaw(battle, mode, options) {
			if (this.stateValue !== "ready" || this.slots.length === 0 && this.startingSlots.length === 0) return Promise.reject(new CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError("Calc-воркеры ещё не готовы."));
			this.cancelIdleStop();
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				this.queue.push({
					battle,
					mode,
					options,
					resolve,
					reject
				});
				this.pump();
			});
		}
		stop(message = "Calc-воркеры остановлены.") {
			this.lifecycle += 1;
			this.cancelIdleStop();
			const slots = [...this.slots, ...this.startingSlots];
			this.slots = [];
			this.startingSlots = [];
			for (const slot of slots) this.terminateSlot(slot, message);
			for (const job of this.queue.splice(0)) job.reject(new CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError(message));
			if (this.stateValue !== "disabled") this.stateValue = "idle";
			this.sourceKey = null;
			if (slots.length > 0) this.options.onEvent?.({
				type: "stopped",
				message
			});
		}
		disable(reason) {
			if (this.stateValue === "disabled") return;
			this.disabledReason = reason;
			this.stateValue = "disabled";
			this.stop(reason);
			this.options.onEvent?.({
				type: "disabled",
				message: reason
			});
		}
		async launch(key) {
			const lifecycle = this.lifecycle;
			let payload;
			const slots = [];
			try {
				const source = this.options.readInitPayload();
				payload = source instanceof Promise ? await source : source;
				if (lifecycle !== this.lifecycle) return false;
				if (!payload) return false;
				const size = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.options.size));
				for (let index = 0; index < size; index += 1) slots.push(this.createSlot());
			} catch (error) {
				for (const slot of slots) this.terminateSlot(slot, "Запуск отменён.");
				if (lifecycle !== this.lifecycle) return false;
				this.disable(`Calc-воркеры не запустились: ${errorMessage$2(error)}`);
				return false;
			}
			this.stateValue = "starting";
			this.startingSlots = slots;
			const generation = this.generation + 1;
			const responses = Array.from({ length: slots.length });
			let nextSlot = 0;
			const initNext = async () => {
				while (nextSlot < slots.length && this.stateValue === "starting") {
					const index = nextSlot++;
					responses[index] = await this.send(slots[index], {
						kind: "init",
						...payload
					}, this.options.initTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
				}
			};
			await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(slots.length, MAX_PARALLEL_INITS) }, () => initNext()));
			if (this.startingSlots === slots) this.startingSlots = [];
			if (this.stateValue !== "starting") return false;
			const ready = [];
			const timings = [];
			const warnings = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			let contractFailure = null;
			let lastFailure = "";
			responses.forEach((response, index) => {
				if (!response) return;
				if (response.kind === "ready") {
					ready.push(slots[index]);
					timings.push(response.timings);
					for (const warning of response.warnings) warnings.add(warning);
					return;
				}
				lastFailure = response.kind === "failure" || response.kind === "lost" ? response.message : "";
				if (response.kind === "failure" && response.unavailable) contractFailure = response.message;
				this.terminateSlot(slots[index], lastFailure);
			});
			if (ready.length === 0) {
				this.stateValue = "idle";
				this.options.onEvent?.({
					type: "start-failed",
					message: lastFailure
				});
				if (contractFailure) this.disable(contractFailure);
				return false;
			}
			this.slots = ready;
			this.sourceKey = key;
			this.generation = generation;
			this.stateValue = "ready";
			this.options.onEvent?.({
				type: "ready",
				workers: ready.length,
				timings,
				warnings: [...warnings]
			});
			this.scheduleIdleStop();
			this.pump();
			return true;
		}
		createSlot() {
			const slot = {
				worker: this.options.createWorker(),
				busy: false,
				pending: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),
				onMessage: () => void 0,
				onError: () => void 0,
				jobCount: 0
			};
			slot.onMessage = (event) => {
				const resolve = slot.pending.get(event.data.id);
				if (!resolve) return;
				slot.pending.delete(event.data.id);
				resolve(event.data);
			};
			slot.onError = (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
				this.loseSlot(slot, event.message || "Calc-воркер завершился с ошибкой.");
			};
			slot.worker.addEventListener("message", slot.onMessage);
			slot.worker.addEventListener("error", slot.onError);
			return slot;
		}
		send(slot, message, timeoutMs) {
			const id = this.nextRequestId++;
			return new Promise((resolve) => {
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					this.loseSlot(slot, `Calc-воркер не ответил за ${timeoutMs} мс.`);
				}, timeoutMs);
				slot.pending.set(id, (response) => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					resolve(response);
				});
				try {
					slot.worker.postMessage({
						...message,
						id
					});
				} catch (error) {
					this.loseSlot(slot, errorMessage$2(error));
				}
			});
		}
		pump() {
			if (this.stateValue !== "ready") return;
			for (const slot of this.slots) {
				if (this.queue.length === 0) return;
				if (slot.busy) continue;
				const job = this.queue.shift();
				slot.busy = true;
				slot.jobCount += 1;
				this.send(slot, {
					kind: "calculate",
					battle: job.battle,
					mode: job.mode,
					...job.options ? { options: job.options } : {}
				}, this.options.calculationTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_CALCULATION_TIMEOUT_MS).then((response) => {
					slot.busy = false;
					this.settle(job, response);
					if (slot.jobCount >= (this.options.maxJobsPerWorker ?? MAX_SLOT_JOB_COUNT) && !this.replacing) this.replaceSlot(slot);
					else this.pump();
					this.scheduleIdleStop();
				});
			}
		}
		async replaceSlot(slot) {
			const index = this.slots.indexOf(slot);
			if (index === -1 || this.stateValue !== "ready") return;
			this.replacing = true;
			const lifecycle = this.lifecycle;
			this.slots.splice(index, 1);
			this.terminateSlot(slot, "Плановый перезапуск воркера для очистки памяти.");
			let newSlot;
			let failure = "";
			try {
				newSlot = this.createSlot();
				this.startingSlots.push(newSlot);
				const source = this.options.readInitPayload();
				const payload = source instanceof Promise ? await source : source;
				if (lifecycle !== this.lifecycle || this.stateValue !== "ready") return;
				if (!payload) throw new Error("Данные игры для замены воркера недоступны.");
				const response = await this.send(newSlot, {
					kind: "init",
					...payload
				}, this.options.initTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
				const startingIndex = this.startingSlots.indexOf(newSlot);
				if (startingIndex !== -1) this.startingSlots.splice(startingIndex, 1);
				if (response.kind === "ready" && this.stateValue === "ready" && lifecycle === this.lifecycle) {
					this.slots.push(newSlot);
					this.pump();
				} else {
					failure = response.kind === "failure" || response.kind === "lost" ? response.message : "Запуск воркера отменён.";
					this.terminateSlot(newSlot, failure);
				}
			} catch (error) {
				failure = errorMessage$2(error);
				if (newSlot) this.terminateSlot(newSlot, failure);
			} finally {
				this.replacing = false;
				if (newSlot) {
					const startingIndex = this.startingSlots.indexOf(newSlot);
					if (startingIndex !== -1) this.startingSlots.splice(startingIndex, 1);
				}
				if (lifecycle === this.lifecycle && this.stateValue === "ready") {
					if (failure) this.options.onEvent?.({
						type: "worker-lost",
						message: failure,
						workers: this.slots.length
					});
					if (this.slots.length === 0 && this.startingSlots.length === 0) this.stop(failure);
					else this.pump();
					this.scheduleIdleStop();
				}
			}
		}
		settle(job, response) {
			if (response.kind === "calculation") {
				job.resolve(response.calculation);
				return;
			}
			if (response.kind === "failure" && !response.unavailable) {
				job.reject(new CalcWorkerCalculationError(response.message));
				return;
			}
			const message = response.kind === "ready" ? "Неожиданный ответ Calc-воркера." : response.message;
			if (response.kind === "failure") this.disable(message);
			job.reject(new CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError(message));
		}
		loseSlot(slot, message) {
			const index = this.slots.indexOf(slot);
			if (index !== -1) this.slots.splice(index, 1);
			this.terminateSlot(slot, message);
			if (index === -1) return;
			this.options.onEvent?.({
				type: "worker-lost",
				message,
				workers: this.slots.length
			});
			if (this.slots.length === 0 && this.startingSlots.length === 0 && this.stateValue === "ready") this.stop(message);
			else this.pump();
		}
		terminateSlot(slot, message) {
			slot.worker.removeEventListener("message", slot.onMessage);
			slot.worker.removeEventListener("error", slot.onError);
			slot.worker.terminate();
			const pending = [...slot.pending.entries()];
			slot.pending.clear();
			for (const [id, resolve] of pending) resolve({
				id,
				kind: "lost",
				message
			});
		}
		scheduleIdleStop() {
			if (this.stateValue !== "ready" || this.startingSlots.length > 0 || this.queue.length > 0 || this.slots.some((slot) => slot.busy)) return;
			this.cancelIdleStop();
			this.idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
				this.idleTimer = null;
				this.stop("Calc-воркеры простаивали и освободили память.");
			}, this.options.idleTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
		}
		cancelIdleStop() {
			if (this.idleTimer === null) return;
			clearTimeout(this.idleTimer);
			this.idleTimer = null;
		}
	};
	function errorMessage$2(error) {
		return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
	}

	/**
	* Отправляет Calc в пул воркеров и держит основной поток запасным путём.
	* Первый расчёт каждого запуска пула считается дважды: пока воркер не совпал
	* со страницей байт в байт, его результатам не доверяем.
	*/
	var GameRuntimeCalcDispatcher = class {
		constructor(options) {
			_defineProperty(this, "supportsTimeResolvedInput", true);
			_defineProperty(this, "pool", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "mainThread", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "onDiagnostic", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "verifiedGeneration", -1);
			_defineProperty(this, "verifyPromise", null);
			_defineProperty(this, "allowMainThreadFallback", void 0);
			this.pool = options.pool;
			this.mainThread = options.mainThread ?? new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
			this.onDiagnostic = options.onDiagnostic;
			this.allowMainThreadFallback = options.allowMainThreadFallback ?? true;
		}
		get concurrency() {
			const pool = this.pool;
			return pool?.state === "ready" && this.verifiedGeneration === pool.generation ? Math.max(1, pool.size) : 1;
		}
		/** Снимок текущей занятости пула без хранения истории расчётов. */
		get resourceUsage() {
			return {
				busyWorkers: this.pool?.busyWorkers ?? 0,
				workers: this.pool?.size ?? 0
			};
		}
		/** Раннер тоже обязан соблюдать запрет фонового поиска на странице. */
		get allowLegacyFallback() {
			return this.allowMainThreadFallback;
		}
		/** Запускает воркеры заранее, чтобы первый поиск не ждал их подготовки. */
		warmUp() {
			return this.pool?.start() ?? Promise.resolve(false);
		}
		async calculate(battle, mode, options) {
			const pool = this.pool;
			if (!this.allowMainThreadFallback && (!pool || pool.state === "disabled")) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError(pool?.disabledMessage || "Calc-воркеры недоступны. Проверь настройки расчётов.");
			if (!pool || pool.state === "disabled") return this.mainThread.calculate(battle, mode, options);
			if (pool.state !== "ready") {
				if (!this.allowMainThreadFallback) {
					if (!await pool.start()) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError(pool.disabledMessage || "Не удалось запустить Calc-воркеры.");
					return this.calculate(battle, mode, options);
				}
				pool.start();
				return this.mainThread.calculate(battle, mode, options);
			}
			if (this.verifiedGeneration !== pool.generation) {
				if (!this.verifyPromise) {
					this.verifyPromise = this.verifyAndCalculate(pool, battle, mode, options).finally(() => {
						this.verifyPromise = null;
					});
					return this.verifyPromise;
				}
				await this.verifyPromise;
				return this.calculate(battle, mode, options);
			}
			try {
				return this.mainThread.toCalculation(await pool.calculateRaw(battle, mode, options));
			} catch (error) {
				if (!this.allowMainThreadFallback && error instanceof CalcWorkerCalculationError) throw error;
				if (!this.allowMainThreadFallback && error instanceof CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError(`Расчёт в воркере остановлен: ${error.message}`);
				if (error instanceof CalcWorkerCalculationError) {
					const calculation = await this.mainThread.calculate(battle, mode, options);
					pool.disable(`Calc-воркер упал на бою, который считает страница: ${error.message}`);
					return calculation;
				}
				if (!(error instanceof CalcWorkerPoolUnavailableError)) throw error;
				return this.mainThread.calculate(battle, mode, options);
			}
		}
		toBattleCalc() {
			return (battle, _candidate, mode) => this.calculate(battle, mode);
		}
		/** Останавливает воркеры для освобождения памяти, но позволяет перезапустить их. */
		cleanup() {
			this.pool?.stop("Calc-воркеры остановлены для очистки памяти.");
		}
		/** Освобождает воркеры; дальнейшие расчёты идут в основном потоке. */
		dispose() {
			this.pool?.disable("Calc-воркеры заменены новой конфигурацией.");
		}
		async verifyAndCalculate(pool, battle, mode, options) {
			const generation = pool.generation;
			const [worker, page] = await Promise.allSettled([pool.calculateRaw(battle, mode, options), this.mainThread.calculateRaw(battle, mode, options)]);
			if (page.status === "rejected") throw page.reason;
			if (worker.status === "fulfilled") if (sameCalculation(worker.value, page.value)) {
				if (pool.generation === generation) this.verifiedGeneration = generation;
			} else pool.disable("Calc-воркер разошёлся со страницей на контрольном бою.");
			else if (worker.reason instanceof CalcWorkerCalculationError) pool.disable(`Calc-воркер упал на контрольном бою: ${worker.reason.message}`);
			else this.onDiagnostic?.(`Контрольный расчёт в воркере не выполнен: ${errorMessage$1(worker.reason)}`);
			if (!this.allowMainThreadFallback && this.verifiedGeneration !== generation) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError(pool.disabledMessage || "Контрольный расчёт Calc-воркера не прошёл проверку.");
			return this.mainThread.toCalculation(page.value);
		}
	};
	function sameCalculation(left, right) {
		try {
			return left.battleTimeLimit === right.battleTimeLimit && JSON.stringify(left.battleData) === JSON.stringify(right.battleData) && JSON.stringify(left.progress) === JSON.stringify(right.progress) && JSON.stringify(left.result) === JSON.stringify(right.result) && JSON.stringify(left.encodedLogs) === JSON.stringify(right.encodedLogs) && JSON.stringify(left.timeline) === JSON.stringify(right.timeline);
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	}
	function errorMessage$1(error) {
		return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
	}

	/** Имена базовых кодовых ассетов боя зашиты в BattleAssetStorage строковыми литералами. */
	function listRequiredCodeAssets(BattleAssetStorage) {
		const names = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const name of Object.getOwnPropertyNames(BattleAssetStorage.prototype)) {
			const method = BattleAssetStorage.prototype[name];
			if (typeof method !== "function") continue;
			for (const match of sourceOf(method).matchAll(/"([^"]+\.sc)"/g)) names.add(match[1]);
		}
		if (names.size === 0) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не найдены кодовые ассеты боя.");
		return [...names];
	}

	}

	}

		const assetStorage = findOwnInstance(classes.assetStorage, classes.assetStorage, "AssetStorage.instance");

	function callRuntimeMethod(target, methodName, args = []) {

	}

	function ownDataValues(owner) {
		const values = [];

			if (descriptor && "value" in descriptor) values.push(descriptor.value);
		}

	}

	function resolvePropertyMethodFromPrototype(initialPrototype, semanticName) {
		let prototype = initialPrototype;
		while (prototype) {
			const properties = Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(prototype, "__properties__")?.value;
			if (isObject(properties)) {
				for (const [methodName, propertyName] of Object.entries(properties)) if (propertyName === semanticName) return methodName;
			}
			prototype = Reflect.getPrototypeOf(prototype);
		}
		return null;
	}

	}

	function resolveRuntimeNames(classes, assetLoader, overrides) {

	function resolveAssetLoaderLoad(Type, instance) {

	}
	function resolveAssetLoaderCancel(Type, instance) {
		const methods = prototypeMethods(Type).filter(({ method }) => {
			const source = methodSource(method);
			return method.length === 1 && source.includes(".splice(") && source.includes("break");
		});
		if (methods.length === 1) return methods[0].name;
		const fallback = DEFAULT_GAME_ASSET_RUNTIME_NAMES.assetLoaderCancel;
		return typeof Reflect.get(instance, fallback) === "function" ? fallback : "";
	}
	function resolveUsageMethods(classes) {
		const names = Reflect.ownKeys(classes.usageCounter.prototype).filter((key) => typeof key === "string" && key !== "__class__" && key !== "constructor" && key !== resolveHaxePropertyMethod(classes.requestableAsset, "get_completed"));
		const retain = names.find((name) => {
			const method = Reflect.get(classes.imageIconAsset.prototype, name);
			return typeof method === "function" && methodSource(method).includes("++");
		});
		const release = names.find((name) => {
			const method = Reflect.get(classes.imageIconAsset.prototype, name);
			return typeof method === "function" && methodSource(method).includes("--");
		});
		if (retain && release) return {
			retain,
			release
		};
		if (names.length === 2) return {
			retain: names[0],
			release: names[1]
		};
		throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Не удалось определить контракт retain/release.");
	}
	function prototypeMethods(Type) {
		const methods = [];
		for (const key of Reflect.ownKeys(Type.prototype)) {
			if (typeof key !== "string" || key === "constructor") continue;
			const value = Reflect.get(Type.prototype, key);
			if (typeof value === "function") methods.push({
				name: key,
				method: value
			});
		}
		return methods;
	}

	}

		try {

		}
	}
	function requireClass(registry, path) {
		const value = findRegistryClass(registry, path);
		if (typeof value !== "function") throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Класс ${path} не найден в реестре Hero Wars. Нужен полный cheats.getSelfGame().`);

	function discoverGameClassRegistry(runtimeRoot) {
		const roots = collectRuntimeRoots(runtimeRoot);
		for (const root of roots) for (const candidate of collectRegistryCandidates(root)) {
			const registry = asRegistry(candidate);
			if (registry) return registry;
		}
		throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Не найден реестр классов Hero Wars. Передайте classes из cheats.getSelfGame().");
	}
	function collectRuntimeRoots(runtimeRoot) {
		const roots = [];
		const queue = [runtimeRoot, globalThis];
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		while (queue.length > 0) {
			const candidate = queue.shift();
			if (!isObject(candidate) || seen.has(candidate)) continue;
			seen.add(candidate);
			roots.push(candidate);
			for (const key of [
				"unsafeWindow",
				"window",
				"self"
			]) queue.push(readRuntimeRootProperty(candidate, key));
		}
		return roots;
	}
	function asRegistry(value) {
		if (!isObject(value)) return null;
		const registry = value;
		const assetStorage = readRegistryValue(registry, GAME_ASSET_CLASS_PATHS.assetStorage);
		const loader = readRegistryValue(registry, GAME_ASSET_CLASS_PATHS.assetLoader);
		return typeof assetStorage === "function" && typeof loader === "function" ? registry : null;
	}
	function collectRegistryCandidates(root) {
		const candidates = [root, readRuntimeRootProperty(root, "HWHClasses")];
		const cheats = readRuntimeRootProperty(root, "cheats");
		if (isObject(cheats)) {
			const getSelfGame = readRuntimeRootProperty(cheats, "getSelfGame");
			if (typeof getSelfGame === "function") try {
				candidates.push(Reflect.apply(getSelfGame, cheats, []));
			} catch {}
		}
		try {
			for (const descriptor of Object.values(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(root))) if ("value" in descriptor) candidates.push(descriptor.value);
		} catch {}
		return candidates;
	}
	function findRegistryClass(registry, path) {
		const exact = readRegistryValue(registry, path);
		if (typeof exact === "function") return exact;
		for (const candidate of ownDataValues(registry)) {
			if (typeof candidate !== "function") continue;
			try {
				if (Reflect.get(candidate, "j") === path) return candidate;
			} catch {}
		}
	}
	function readRegistryValue(registry, path) {
		try {
			return Reflect.get(registry, path);
		} catch {
			return;
		}
	}
	function findOwnInstance(owner, Type, label) {
		const instance = findOwnInstances(owner, Type)[0];
		if (!instance) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Не найден ${label} в игровом runtime.`);
		return instance;
	}
	function readRuntimeRootProperty(owner, key) {
		try {
			const descriptor = Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(owner, key);
			if (!descriptor) return void 0;
			return "value" in descriptor ? descriptor.value : Reflect.get(owner, key);
		} catch {
			return;
		}
	}
	function isObject(value) {
		return typeof value === "object" && value !== null || typeof value === "function";
	}

	var GAME_BUNDLE_PATTERN = /\/client\/heroes\.[0-9a-f]+\.js(?:[?#]|$)/;
	/** Загружает байткод навыков штатным загрузчиком, даже если игрок ещё не открывал бой. */
	async function loadGameCodeAssets(registry) {
		if (!registry) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не найден реестр классов игры для загрузки навыков.");
		const BattleAssets = readRegistryClass(registry, "game.assets.storage.BattleAssetStorage");
		if (!BattleAssets) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не найдено хранилище навыков боя.");
		const runtime = resolveGameAssetRuntime({ classes: registry });
		const Storage = readRegistryClass(registry, "game.assets.storage.AssetStorage");
		const storage = Storage && Object.values(Storage).find((value) => value instanceof BattleAssets);
		if (!storage) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не создано хранилище навыков боя.");
		const getters = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(BattleAssets.prototype).filter((name) => {
			const method = BattleAssets.prototype[name];
			return name !== "__class__" && typeof method === "function" && method.length === 0 && /"[^"]+\.sc"/.test(String(method));
		});
		if (getters.length !== 1) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Не найден загрузчик базовых навыков боя.");
		const assets = storage[getters[0]].call(storage);
		if (!Array.isArray(assets) || assets.length === 0) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Игра вернула пустой список навыков боя.");
		await Promise.all(assets.map((asset) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const cancel = () => {
				const fn = Reflect.get(runtime.assetLoader, runtime.names.assetLoaderCancel);
				if (typeof fn === "function") fn.call(runtime.assetLoader, complete);
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				try {
					cancel();
				} catch (error) {
					reject(error);
					return;
				}
				reject(new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Навыки боя не загрузились за 30 секунд. Повтори запуск."));
			}, 3e4);
			const complete = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				resolve();
			};
			try {
				Reflect.get(runtime.assetLoader, runtime.names.assetLoaderLoad).call(runtime.assetLoader, asset, complete, 0);
			} catch (error) {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				cancel();
				reject(error);
			}
		})));
		const code = readGameCodeAssets(registry);
		if (!code) throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Навыки загружены, но байткод недоступен Calc-воркерам.");
		return code;
	}
	/**
	* В воркер уходят только поля, от которых зависит инициализация данных игры.
	* Идентификаторы игрока, ключи авторизации, IP и адреса API остаются на странице.

	var WORKER_FLASH_VARS = [

	/**
	* Игра сама кладёт адрес клиентского бандла в `NXFlashVars.preloader_js`.
	* Перебор `<script>` и resource timing остаётся запасным путём для старых страниц.
	*/
	function findGameBundleUrl(root = globalThis) {
		const page = root;
		const preloader = page.NXFlashVars?.preloader_js;
		if (typeof preloader === "string" && GAME_BUNDLE_PATTERN.test(preloader)) return preloader;
		return [...Array.from(page.document?.scripts ?? [], (script) => script.src ?? ""), ...Array.from(page.performance?.getEntriesByType?.("resource") ?? [], (entry) => String(entry.name))].find((url) => GAME_BUNDLE_PATTERN.test(url)) ?? null;
	}
	/**
	* Скрипты навыков игра качает при первом бое. Пока их нет, воркеру нечем
	* считать: возвращаем null, и расчёт идёт в основном потоке.
	*/
	function readGameCodeAssets(registry) {
		if (!registry) return readFallbackCodeAssets();
		const AssetStorage = readRegistryClass(registry, "game.assets.storage.AssetStorage");
		const BattleAssetStorage = readRegistryClass(registry, "game.assets.storage.BattleAssetStorage");
		const ByteArrayData = readRegistryClass(registry, "openfl.utils.ByteArrayData");
		if (!AssetStorage || !BattleAssetStorage || !ByteArrayData) return readFallbackCodeAssets();
		const battleAssets = Object.values(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(AssetStorage)).find((descriptor) => "value" in descriptor && descriptor.value instanceof BattleAssetStorage)?.value;
		if (!battleAssets?.code) return readFallbackCodeAssets();
		let entries;
		try {
			entries = findStringMapEntries(battleAssets.code);
		} catch (error) {
			if (error instanceof GameRuntimeUnavailableError) return readFallbackCodeAssets();
			throw error;
		}
		const assets = [];
		for (const name of listRequiredCodeAssets(BattleAssetStorage)) {
			const asset = entries[name];
			const view = (asset !== null && typeof asset === "object" ? Object.values(asset).find((value) => value instanceof ByteArrayData) : void 0)?.b;
			if (!(view instanceof Uint8Array) || view.byteLength === 0) return readFallbackCodeAssets();
			assets.push({
				name,
				buffer: view.buffer.slice(0)
			});
		}
		if (assets.length > 0) {
			const root = globalThis;
			root.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__ = {
				...root.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__ ?? {},
				codeAssets: assets
			};
		}
		return assets;
	}
	if (typeof indexedDB !== "undefined") try {
		const req = indexedDB.open("hwh-calc-storage", 1);
		req.onsuccess = (e) => {
			const db = e.target.result;
			if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("assets")) return;
			const getAllReq = db.transaction("assets", "readonly").objectStore("assets").getAll();
			getAllReq.onsuccess = () => {
				const stored = getAllReq.result;
				if (Array.isArray(stored) && stored.length > 0) {
					const root = globalThis;
					if (!root.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__?.codeAssets) root.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__ = {
						...root.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__ ?? {},
						codeAssets: stored
					};
				}
			};
		};
	} catch {}
	function readFallbackCodeAssets() {
		const dump = globalThis.__HWH_CALC_DUMP__;
		if (!dump?.codeAssets || dump.codeAssets.length === 0) return null;
		const assets = [];
		for (const item of dump.codeAssets) if (item.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) assets.push({
			name: item.name,
			buffer: item.buffer
		});
		else if (typeof item.base64 === "string") {
			const binary = atob(item.base64);
			const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
			for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
			assets.push({
				name: item.name,
				buffer: bytes.buffer
			});
		}
		return assets.length > 0 ? assets : null;
	}
	function readCalcWorkerFlashVars(root = globalThis) {
		const source = root.NXFlashVars ?? {};
		return Object.fromEntries(WORKER_FLASH_VARS.filter((key) => key in source).map((key) => [key, source[key]]));
	}
	function readCalcWorkerPageInfo(root = globalThis) {
		const { location, navigator } = root;
		return {
			location: {
				href: location?.href?.split(/[?#]/, 1)[0] ?? "",
				origin: location?.origin ?? "",
				protocol: location?.protocol ?? "",
				host: location?.host ?? "",
				hostname: location?.hostname ?? "",
				port: location?.port ?? "",
				pathname: location?.pathname ?? "",
				search: "",
				hash: ""
			},
			navigator: {
				userAgent: navigator?.userAgent ?? "",
				platform: navigator?.platform ?? "",
				language: navigator?.language ?? "",
				languages: [...navigator?.languages ?? []],
				vendor: navigator?.vendor ?? "",
				hardwareConcurrency: navigator?.hardwareConcurrency ?? 1
			}
		};
	}
	function readRegistryClass(registry, name) {
		for (const key of [name, `${name}_`]) {
			const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(registry, key);
			if (descriptor && "value" in descriptor && typeof descriptor.value === "function") return descriptor.value;
		}
		return null;
	}

	function createPageCalcDispatcher(options) {
		const root = options.root ?? globalThis;
		const libraryIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
		let nextLibraryId = 1;
		const identifyLibrary = (library) => {
			let id = libraryIds.get(library);
			if (id === void 0) {
				id = nextLibraryId++;
				libraryIds.set(library, id);
			}
			return id;
		};
		const workers = Math.max(0, Math.floor(options.workers));
		return new GameRuntimeCalcDispatcher({
			pool: workers > 0 && typeof root.Worker === "function" ? new GameCalcWorkerPool({
				size: workers,
				createWorker: options.createWorker,
				idleTimeoutMs: options.idleTimeoutMs,
				onEvent: options.onEvent,
				readSourceKey: () => {
					const bundleUrl = findGameBundleUrl(root);
					const library = options.readLibrary();
					return bundleUrl && library ? `${bundleUrl}#${identifyLibrary(library)}` : null;
				},
				readInitPayload: () => {
					const bundleUrl = findGameBundleUrl(root);
					const library = options.readLibrary();
					if (!bundleUrl || !library) return null;
					const registry = findHeroWarsClassRegistry(root);
					const libraryJson = JSON.stringify(library);
					const makePayload = (codeAssets) => ({
						bundleUrl,
						libraryJson,
						flashVars: readCalcWorkerFlashVars(root),
						codeAssets,
						page: readCalcWorkerPageInfo(root)
					});
					const codeAssets = readGameCodeAssets(registry);
					return codeAssets ? makePayload(codeAssets) : loadGameCodeAssets(registry).then(makePayload);
				}
			}) : null,
			allowMainThreadFallback: options.allowMainThreadFallback
		});
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/core/calc-library.ts
	init_normalize();
	var asgardLibraries = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
	var CLIENT_ONLY_SECTIONS = [
		"quest",
		"battlePass",
		"specialQuestEvent",
		"minigame",
		"expedition",
		"seasonAdventure",
		"powerTournament",
		"playerAvatar",
		"specialOffer",
		"tiledMap",
		"lineGacha",
		"unitPhrases",
		"bundle",
		"tutorial",
		"coopBundle",
		"eventPicker"
	];
	var INVASION_CLIENT_SECTIONS = [
		"boss",
		"phase",
		"list",
		"chapter",
		"abyssReward"
	];
	/**
	* Для Calc Асгарда оставляет боевые данные целиком, но не строит в каждом
	* воркере хранилища квестов, карт и клиентских событий. Пустые разделы сохраняют
	* контракт DataStorage; метаданные магазинов и lootBox нужны его перекрёстным ссылкам.
	* Ассортимент магазинов в Calc не используется и не копируется в каждый воркер.
	* Во Вторжении убираются только описания этапов и наград; талисманы,
	* улучшения бойцов и неизвестные новые разделы сохраняются.
	* В снимках Battle Lab характеристики уже рассчитаны до отправки в Calc:
	* уровни прокачки скинов там не нужны. Их метаданные нужны DataStorage.
	* Другие режимы должны получать исходную библиотеку до отдельной проверки.
	*/
	function asgardCalcLibrary(library) {
		const cached = asgardLibraries.get(library);
		if (cached) return cached;
		const compact = { ...library };
		for (const section of CLIENT_ONLY_SECTIONS) if (section in compact) compact[section] = Array.isArray(compact[section]) ? [] : {};
		const shops = asRecordOrNull(library.shop);
		if (shops && !Array.isArray(shops)) compact.shop = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(shops).map(([id, raw]) => {
			const shop = asRecordOrNull(raw);
			if (!shop || !asRecordOrNull(shop.slots)) return [id, raw];
			return [id, {
				...shop,
				slots: Array.isArray(shop.slots) ? [] : {}
			}];
		}));
		const invasion = library.invasion;
		if (invasion && typeof invasion === "object" && !Array.isArray(invasion)) {
			const compactInvasion = { ...invasion };
			for (const section of INVASION_CLIENT_SECTIONS) if (section in compactInvasion) compactInvasion[section] = Array.isArray(compactInvasion[section]) ? [] : {};
			compact.invasion = compactInvasion;
		}
		const skins = asRecordOrNull(library.skin);
		if (skins) compact.skin = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(skins).map(([id, raw]) => {
			const skin = asRecordOrNull(raw);
			const statData = asRecordOrNull(skin?.statData);
			if (!skin || !statData || !asRecordOrNull(statData.levels)) return [id, raw];
			return [id, {
				...skin,
				statData: {
					...statData,
					levels: Array.isArray(statData.levels) ? [] : {}
				}
			}];
		}));
		asgardLibraries.set(library, compact);
		return compact;
	}

	/** Простой пула между запусками; закрытие окна освобождает воркеры сразу. */
	var CALC_WORKER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15 * 6e4;
	/** Держит один пул Calc-воркеров и пересоздаёт его только при смене их числа. */
	function createBattleLabCalcWorkers(readModeId) {
		let dispatcher = null;
		let configuredWorkers = -1;
		return {
			get dispatcher() {
				return dispatcher;
			},
			configure(settings) {
				const workers = settings.calcInWorkers ? resolveBattleLabCalcWorkers(settings.plannerWorkers) : 0;
				if (workers === configuredWorkers) return;
				configuredWorkers = workers;
				dispatcher?.dispose();
				dispatcher = workers > 0 ? createPageCalcDispatcher({
					workers,
					allowMainThreadFallback: false,
					createWorker: createGameCalcWorker,
					idleTimeoutMs: CALC_WORKER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS,
					readLibrary: () => readBattleLabCalcLibrary(readModeId()),
					onEvent: logBattleLabCalcWorkerEvent
				}) : null;
				setBattleLabCalcExecutor(dispatcher);
			}
		};
	}
	/** Выбирает проверенную библиотеку Calc для текущего режима. */
	function readBattleLabCalcLibrary(modeId) {
		const data = globalThis.lib?.data;
		if (data === null || typeof data !== "object" || Object.keys(data).length === 0) return null;
		const library = data;
		return modeId === "asgard" ? asgardCalcLibrary(library) : library;
	}
	function logBattleLabCalcWorkerEvent(event) {
		const prefix = "[Battle Lab:calc-workers]";
		if (event.type === "ready") {
			console.info(prefix, `Calc-воркеров готово: ${event.workers}`, {
				timings: event.timings,
				warnings: event.warnings
			});
			return;
		}
		if (event.type === "stopped") {
			console.info(prefix, event.message);
			return;
		}
		console.warn(prefix, event.message);
	}

	* Нормализует placement действия меню: только main или other.

		return value === "other" || value === "main" ? value : fallbackValue;

	/**
	* Синхронизирует placement действия меню: перемещает кнопку между main и other.
	*/
	function syncScriptMenuActionPlacement({ HWHData, mainMenuButtons, othersPopupButtons, placement, mainKey, actionKey, createMainButton, createOtherButton, mainPlacementValue = MENU_ACTION_PLACEMENT_MAIN, otherPlacementValue = MENU_ACTION_PLACEMENT_OTHER }) {
		const menuData = HWHData ?? {};
		const mainButtons = mainMenuButtons ?? ensureMainMenuButtons(menuData);
		const otherButtons = othersPopupButtons ?? ensureOtherPopupButtons(menuData);
		const existingOtherIndex = otherButtons.findIndex((button) => button?.actionKey === actionKey);
		if (existingOtherIndex >= 0) otherButtons.splice(existingOtherIndex, 1);
		if (mainKey) delete mainButtons[mainKey];
		if (placement === otherPlacementValue && typeof createOtherButton === "function") otherButtons.push(createOtherButton());
		else if (mainKey && placement === mainPlacementValue && typeof createMainButton === "function") mainButtons[mainKey] = createMainButton();
		menuData.buttons = mainButtons;
		return {
			mainMenuButtons: mainButtons,
			othersPopupButtons: otherButtons
		};
	}

	function normalizeUiTheme(value, fallback = UI_THEME_DARK) {
		const normalizedValue = normalizeThemeToken(value);
		if (UI_THEME_VALUE_SET.has(normalizedValue)) return normalizedValue;
		if (LEGACY_DARK_THEME_TOKENS.has(normalizedValue)) return UI_THEME_DARK;
		const normalizedFallback = normalizeThemeToken(fallback);
		return UI_THEME_VALUE_SET.has(normalizedFallback) ? normalizedFallback : UI_THEME_DARK;
	}
	function normalizeThemeToken(value) {
		return String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, "");
	}

		const settings = value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};

			trainingRuns: normalizeInteger(settings.trainingRuns, DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.trainingRuns, 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),
			asgardTeamCount: normalizeInteger(settings.asgardTeamCount, DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.asgardTeamCount, 1, 10),
			autoTrainAfterSearch: typeof settings.autoTrainAfterSearch === "boolean" ? settings.autoTrainAfterSearch : DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.autoTrainAfterSearch,
			historyLimit: normalizeInteger(settings.historyLimit, DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.historyLimit, 50, 5e4),
			ultraTimingEnabled: typeof settings.ultraTimingEnabled === "boolean" ? settings.ultraTimingEnabled : DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.ultraTimingEnabled,
			ultraMinTime,
			ultraMaxTime,

	function getCompactNumberFormatter(locale, compact) {
		const cacheKey = `${locale}:${compact ? "compact" : "standard"}`;
		let formatter = compactNumberFormatters.get(cacheKey);
		if (!formatter) {
			formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
				notation: compact ? "compact" : "standard",
				maximumFractionDigits: 1
			});
			compactNumberFormatters.set(cacheKey, formatter);
		}
		return formatter;
	}

	function finiteNumber$1(value, fallback = 0) {

		return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : fallback;

	function formatCompactNumber(value, locale = "ru-RU") {
		const number = Number(value);
		if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return "—";
		return getCompactNumberFormatter(locale, Math.abs(number) >= 1e4).format(number);
	}

	function toBattleUnitRecord(units) {
		const ids = units.map((unit) => String(unit.id));

	function detectBattleLabPlatform(input = {}) {
		for (const value of [
			input.platformId,
			input.platform,
			input.network
		]) {
			const alias = PLATFORM_ALIASES[String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()];
			if (alias) return alias;
		}
		const hostname = String(input.hostname ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
		if (hostname.includes("vk.com")) return "vk";
		if (hostname.includes("ok.ru") || hostname.includes("odnoklassniki")) return "ok";
		if (hostname.includes("fbsbx.com") || hostname.includes("facebook")) return "facebook";
		if (hostname.includes("my.games") || hostname.includes("mygames")) return "mygames";
		if (hostname.includes("mail.ru")) return "mailru";
		if (hostname.includes("hero-wars.com") || hostname.includes("hero-wars")) return "web";
		return "unknown";
	}

		});
	}

		}
	}

	function normalizeBattleLabTournamentState(response, maxLevel = null) {
		const source = asRecord$1(unwrapResponse$1(response));
		const rivals = indexedValues(source.rivals);
		const scores = rivals.map(({ value }) => finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(value).attackScore, 0));
		const completedOpponents = scores.filter((score) => score >= 250).length;
		const remainingOpponents = rivals.length - completedOpponents;
		const status = String(source.status ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
		const statusBlocksDefense = [
			"completed_tier",
			"completed",
			"disabled",
			"peace_time"
		].includes(status);
		return {
			level: positiveInteger(source.tier ?? source.level ?? source.currentTier),
			maxLevel: positiveInteger(maxLevel),
			status,
			totalOpponents: rivals.length,
			completedOpponents,
			remainingOpponents,
			canSetDefense: rivals.length > 0 && !statusBlocksDefense && (typeof source.canUpdateDefenders === "boolean" ? source.canUpdateDefenders : scores.every((score) => score <= 0))
		};
	}

	function getOpponentSources(mode, response) {

			return titanArenaRivalMode(value, key) === mode.id && (!Number.isFinite(attackScore) || attackScore < 250);
		}), root);

	}

	function getAdventureSources(root) {
		const adventure = asRecord$1(root);
		const currentNodeId = positiveInteger(resolveAdventurePlayer(adventure).currentNode);
		const paths = asAdventurePaths(adventure.paths);
		return withBattleLabRoot(indexedValues(adventure.nodes).filter(({ value }) => {
			const node = asRecord$1(value);
			const nodeId = positiveInteger(node.id);
			if (!String(node.type ?? "").includes("COMBAT") || node.state === "empty") return false;
			return !currentNodeId || !nodeId || paths.length === 0 || nodeId === currentNodeId || paths.some(({ from, to }) => from === currentNodeId && to === nodeId || to === currentNodeId && from === nodeId);
		}), root);
	}

	function normalizeOpponent(mode, key, value, index, translateGame) {

	function distributeKnownPower(teams, totalPower) {
		const missingCount = teams.filter((team) => team.power <= 0).length;
		if (totalPower <= 0 || missingCount === 0) return [...teams];
		const knownPower = teams.reduce((total, team) => total + Math.max(0, team.power), 0);
		const remainingPower = Math.max(0, totalPower - knownPower);
		if (remainingPower <= 0) return [...teams];
		const estimatedPower = remainingPower / missingCount;
		return teams.map((team) => team.power > 0 ? team : {
			...team,
			power: estimatedPower
		});
	}

	function findBattleLabServerError(response) {
		const queue = [response];
		const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (let index = 0; index < queue.length; index += 1) {
			const value = queue[index];
			if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || visited.has(value)) continue;
			visited.add(value);
			if (Array.isArray(value)) {
				queue.push(...value);
				continue;
			}
			const record = asRecord$1(value);
			const message = errorMessage(record.error);
			if (message) return message;
			queue.push(record.result, record.response);
			if (record.results && typeof record.results === "object") queue.push(...Object.values(record.results));
		}
		return null;
	}
	function parseBattleLabServerResponse(response) {
		const error = findBattleLabServerError(response);
		const payload = unwrapResponse(response);
		const battle = asRecord$1(payload.battle);
		const candidates = [
			payload,
			payload.result,
			battle,
			battle.result
		];
		let result = "unknown";
		let stars = null;
		if (!error) {
			for (const candidate of candidates) {
				const win = asRecord$1(candidate).win ?? candidate;
				if (win === true || win === 1) {
					result = "win";
					break;
				}
				if (win === false || win === 0) {
					result = "loss";
					break;
				}
			}
			for (const candidate of candidates) {
				const value = asRecord$1(candidate).stars;
				if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0) {
					stars = value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		return {
			payload,
			error,
			result,
			stars
		};
	}
	function unwrapResponse(response) {
		let current = response;
		const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		while (current && typeof current === "object" && !visited.has(current)) {
			visited.add(current);
			if (Array.isArray(current)) {
				current = current[0];
				continue;
			}
			const record = asRecord$1(current);
			if (Array.isArray(record.results)) current = record.results[0];
			else if (asRecord$1(record.result).response !== void 0) current = asRecord$1(record.result).response;
			else if (record.response !== void 0) current = record.response;
			else return record;
		}
		return {};
	}
	function errorMessage(value) {
		if (!value) return null;
		if (typeof value === "string") return value.trim() || null;
		if (typeof value !== "object") return "ServerError";
		const error = asRecord$1(value);
		if (Object.keys(error).length === 0) return null;
		const name = String(error.name ?? error.error ?? "ServerError");
		const description = String(error.description ?? error.message ?? "").trim();
		return description ? `${name}: ${description}` : name;
	}

	/**
	* Карта события называет точку и ключ босса по-разному: `675` и

	function canonicalBattleLabInvasionBossId(value) {

	}

	/**
	* Во время автопрохождения опираться нужно на id уже выбранной серверной точки.

	/**
	* Превращает сырой `invasion_getInfo` в минимальное состояние, нужное для
	* планировщика. Список разрешённых бойцов берётся только из главы/события, а

	function normalizeBattleLabInvasionEvent(infoValue, libraryValue) {
		const info = asRecord$1(infoValue);
		const invasion = asRecord$1(libraryValue.invasion);
		const lists = asRecord$1(invasion.list);
		const invasionId = resolveInvasionId(info, lists);
		if (!invasionId) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул идентификатор вторжения.");
		const event = asRecord$1(lists[invasionId]);
		const activeChapterId = resolveActiveChapterId(info);
		const completed = new Set(toIds(info.farmedChapters ?? info.completedChapters ?? info.chapters));
		const chapters = Object.values(asRecord$1(invasion.chapter)).map(asRecord$1).filter((chapter) => String(chapter.invasionId) === invasionId).sort((left, right) => finiteNumber$1(left.id) - finiteNumber$1(right.id)).map((chapter, index) => {
			const id = String(chapter.id);
			return {
				id,
				number: index + 1,
				completed: completed.has(id),
				active: id === activeChapterId,
				availableUnits: readAvailableUnits(chapter.attackUnitsPool ?? event.attackUnitsPool)
			};
		});
		const active = chapters.find((chapter) => chapter.active);
		const fallback = chapters.find((chapter) => !chapter.completed) ?? chapters.at(-1);
		const availableUnits = active?.availableUnits ?? fallback?.availableUnits ?? [];
		const actions = readActions(info.actions ?? asRecord$1(info.invasion).actions, asRecord$1(invasion.phase), activeChapterId);
		return {
			invasionId,
			activeChapterId,
			lives: nullableNonNegative(info.lives ?? asRecord$1(info.invasion).lives),
			unitType: resolveUnitType(event, availableUnits),
			chapters,
			availableUnits,
			actions,
			talismanRollBosses: toUnitIds(asRecord$1(event.settings).talismanRollBosses),
			fragments: readFragments(info.fragments ?? asRecord$1(info.invasion).fragments)
		};
	}
	function readActions(value, phases, chapterId) {
		const actions = (Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value))).map(asRecord$1).map((action, index) => {
			const payload = asRecord$1(action.payload ?? action);
			const id = String(payload.id ?? action.id ?? "").trim();
			const sequence = positiveInteger(payload.number ?? action.number ?? payload.position ?? action.position ?? payload.order ?? action.order);
			return {
				id,
				wins: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(payload.wins)),
				sequence,
				fallbackIndex: index
			};
		}).filter((action) => action.id).sort((left, right) => (left.sequence ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (right.sequence ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) || left.fallbackIndex - right.fallbackIndex);
		const bossIds = new Set(Object.values(phases).map(asRecord$1).filter((phase) => String(phase.chapterId) === chapterId).flatMap((phase) => Object.entries(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(phase.phaseData).boss)).filter(([, phaseBoss]) => isArchdemonPhase(phaseBoss)).flatMap(([id]) => battleLabInvasionBossAliases(id))));
		return actions.map(({ sequence, fallbackIndex: _fallbackIndex, ...action }, index) => ({
			...action,
			number: sequence ?? index + 1,
			completed: action.wins > 0,
			boss: battleLabInvasionBossAliases(action.id).some((id) => bossIds.has(id)) || bossIds.size === 0 && index === actions.length - 1
		}));
	}
	function battleLabInvasionBossAliases(value) {

	}
	function isArchdemonPhase(value) {
		const type = String(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(value).eventConfig).type).toLowerCase();
		return type === "bossrating" || type === "bossgrouprating";
	}
	function resolveInvasionId(info, lists) {
		const candidates = [
			info.invasionId,
			info.eventId,
			info.id,
			asRecord$1(info.invasion).id,
			asRecord$1(info.invasion).invasionId
		];
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const id = String(candidate ?? "");
			if (id && Object.hasOwn(lists, id)) return id;
		}
		const ids = Object.keys(lists);
		return ids.length === 1 ? ids[0] : null;
	}
	function resolveActiveChapterId(info) {
		const candidate = info.activeChapterId ?? info.chapterId ?? asRecord$1(info.activeChapter).id ?? asRecord$1(info.invasion).activeChapterId;
		return String(candidate ?? "").trim() || null;
	}
	function readAvailableUnits(value) {
		const pool = asRecord$1(value);
		return [...new Set(toUnitIds(pool.availableUnits ?? pool.units))];
	}
	/** Фрагменты приходят из текущего состояния события, а не из локального журнала боёв. */
	function readFragments(value) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(value)).flatMap(([id, count]) => {
			const amount = finiteNumber$1(count, NaN);
			return Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0 ? [[id, Math.floor(amount)]] : [];
		}));
	}
	function toIds(value) {
		return toUnitIds(value).map(String);
	}
	function toUnitIds(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value))).map((item) => positiveInteger(asRecord$1(item).id ?? item)).filter((id) => id !== null);
	}
	function nullableNonNegative(value) {
		const number = finiteNumber$1(value, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(number)) : null;
	}
	function resolveUnitType(event, availableUnits) {
		const declared = String(event.unitType ?? asRecord$1(event.settings).unitType ?? "").toLowerCase();
		if (declared.includes("titan")) return "titan";
		if (declared.includes("hero")) return "hero";
		if (availableUnits.length > 0 && availableUnits.every((id) => id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3)) return "titan";
		if (availableUnits.some((id) => id < 1e3)) return "hero";
		return "unknown";
	}

	function campaignResultVariants(result) {
		return [{
			...result,
			variations: []
		}, ...(result.variations ?? []).filter((v) => v.succeeded > 0 && v.winRate === 1 && v.confidenceLow !== null && v.confidenceLow >= result.confidence).slice(0, 12).map((v) => ({

			id: result.id + ":" + v.id,
			teams: v.teams,
			timings: v.actions,
			statistics: {
				...result.statistics,
				...v
			},
			score: v.scoreMean,
			wins: v.wins,
			confidence: v.confidenceLow ?? result.confidence,
			variations: [],
			battleSnapshot: null,
			details: null,
			scenarioResults: [],
			teamResults: void 0,
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: false
		}))];
	}
	function assignBattleLabCampaign(snapshot, candidates, width = 192) {
		let beam = [[]];
		const unavailable = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...snapshot.usedHeroes, ...snapshot.usedTitans]);
		for (const target of snapshot.targets) {
			const choices = candidates.get(target.opponent.id) ?? [];
			if (!choices.length) continue;
			const next = [...beam];
			for (const plan of beam) {
				const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...unavailable, ...snapshot.modeId === "asgard-minions" ? [] : plan.flatMap((a) => a.result.teams.flatMap((t) => t.unitIds))]);
				if (plan.length >= snapshot.attempts.total || plan.filter((a) => a.target.unitType === target.unitType).length >= snapshot.attempts[target.unitType]) continue;
				for (const result of choices) {
					const ids = result.teams.flatMap((team) => team.unitIds);
					const chance = result.statistics?.winRate;
					if (!ids.length || new Set(ids).size !== ids.length || ids.some((id) => used.has(id))) continue;
					if (chance !== 1 || result.strategy !== "simulation" || !result.searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory) continue;
					next.push([...plan, {
						target,
						result,
						expectedPoints: target.points * chance
					}]);
				}
			}
			const unique = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			for (const plan of next.sort(comparePlans)) {
				const key = plan.map((a) => a.target.opponent.id + ":" + a.result.teams.flatMap((t) => t.unitIds).sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")).join("|");
				if (!unique.has(key)) unique.set(key, plan);
				if (unique.size >= width) break;
			}
			beam = [...unique.values()];
		}
		return (beam.sort(comparePlans)[0] ?? []).sort((a, b) => Number(b.target.assigned) - Number(a.target.assigned) || b.expectedPoints - a.expectedPoints);
	}
	function comparePlans(a, b) {
		return b.filter((item) => item.target.assigned).length - a.filter((item) => item.target.assigned).length || expectedPlanPoints(b) - expectedPlanPoints(a) || b.length - a.length;
	}
	function expectedPlanPoints(plan) {
		let total = plan.reduce((sum, attack) => sum + attack.expectedPoints, 0);
		const grouped = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const attack of plan) {
			const id = attack.target.fortificationId;
			grouped.set(id, [...grouped.get(id) ?? [], attack]);
		}
		for (const attacks of grouped.values()) {
			const target = attacks[0].target;
			if (target.fortificationRemainingSlots.every((id) => attacks.some((a) => a.target.opponent.externalId === id))) total += target.fortificationReward * attacks.reduce((chance, a) => chance * (a.result.statistics?.winRate ?? 0), 1);
		}
		return total;
	}
	/** Атака требует и живой цели, и соответствующей попытки; оборона этим не ограничена. */
	function canPlanBattleLabCampaignAttack(snapshot) {
		return snapshot.attempts.total > 0 && snapshot.targets.length > 0;
	}
	function assertCampaignAttackCurrent(snapshot, attack, revision) {
		if (snapshot.revision !== revision) throw new Error("Война или неделя сменилась. Пересчитай план.");
		const fresh = snapshot.targets.find((target) => target.opponent.id === attack.target.opponent.id);
		if (!fresh || fresh.fingerprint !== attack.target.fingerprint) throw new Error("Цель, назначение или усиления изменились. Обнови план перед атакой.");
		if (snapshot.attempts.total <= 0 || snapshot.attempts[fresh.unitType] <= 0) throw new Error("Попытки атаки закончились.");
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...snapshot.usedHeroes, ...snapshot.usedTitans]);
		if (attack.result.teams.some((team) => team.unitIds.some((id) => used.has(id)))) throw new Error("Бойцы из этого плана уже использованы. Пересчитай оставшиеся атаки.");
		return fresh;
	}

	function normalizeBattleLabWarMap(modeId, info, map, userId, library, now = Date.now()) {
		const cross = modeId === "clash-of-worlds";
		const war = cross ? asRecord$1(info.war) : info;
		const rules = asRecord$1(library[cross ? "crossClanWar" : "clanWar"]);
		const slots = asCollection(map.enemySlots);
		const slotRules = asRecord$1(rules.fortificationSlot);
		const forts = asRecord$1(rules.fortification);
		const snapshot = warSnapshot(modeId, info, map, userId);
		if (Object.keys(slots).length && !Object.keys(slotRules).length) throw new Error("Игровые данные укреплений ещё не загружены. Повтори обновление карты.");
		const tiers = warOpenTiers(slots, slotRules, forts);
		const settings = asRecord$1(info.settings);
		for (const [slotId, raw] of Object.entries(slots)) {
			const slot = asRecord$1(raw);
			const definition = asRecord$1(slotRules[slotId]);
			const fortId = String(definition.fortificationId ?? "");
			const fort = asRecord$1(forts[fortId]);
			const order = asRecord$1(readCollectionEntry(map.targets, slotId));
			const assignedTo = String(cross ? order.userId || "" : slot.targetMarkingUserId || "").replace(/^0$/, "");
			const assigned = assignedTo === userId;
			const blocked = warAttackBlockedReason(snapshot, slot, tiers.has(count(fort.tier)), assignedTo, settings, now);
			const type = definition.type;
			if (type !== "hero" && type !== "titan") continue;
			const team = extractBattleLabWarSlotTeam(slot);
			if (!team) continue;
			const effects = warDefenseEffects(asRecord$1(map.enemyBuffs)[fortId], library);
			const points = Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(slot.pointsTotal ?? slot.totalPoints) - finiteNumber$1(slot.pointsFarmed));
			const source = {
				...slot,
				id: slotId,
				userId: void 0,
				typeId: slotId,
				slotId,
				name: String(asRecord$1(slot.user).name ?? "Укрепление") + " · точка " + slotId,
				team,
				defenders: team,
				__battleLabUsedHeroes: snapshot.usedHeroes,
				__battleLabUsedTitans: snapshot.usedTitans,
				__battleLabUnitType: type,
				type: (type === "titan" ? "titan_" : "") + (cross ? "clan_global_pvp" : "clan_pvp"),
				effects: {
					attackers: {},
					defenders: effects
				},
				__battleLabWarRevision: snapshot.revision,
				__battleLabAttackBlockedReason: blocked || (snapshot.attempts[type] <= 0 ? "Попытки атаки закончились" : "")
			};
			const [opponent] = normalizeBattleLabOpponents(BATTLE_LAB_MODE_BY_ID[modeId], { [slotId]: source });
			if (!opponent) continue;
			const reason = String(source.__battleLabAttackBlockedReason);
			const visibleOpponent = {
				...opponent,
				detail: (assigned ? "Назначено тебе · " : "") + (type === "titan" ? "Титаны" : "Герои") + " · " + points + " очков" + (reason ? " · " + reason : "")
			};
			snapshot.opponents.push(visibleOpponent);
			if (reason) continue;
			const remaining = Object.entries(slots).filter(([id, value]) => String(asRecord$1(slotRules[id]).fortificationId) === fortId && asRecord$1(value).status !== "defeated").map(([id]) => id);
			snapshot.targets.push({
				opponent: visibleOpponent,
				unitType: type,
				assigned,
				points,
				fortificationId: fortId,
				fortificationReward: finiteNumber$1(fort.pointReward),
				fortificationRemainingSlots: remaining,
				fingerprint: JSON.stringify({
					slot,
					order,
					effects
				})
			});
		}
		snapshot.targets.sort((a, b) => Number(b.assigned) - Number(a.assigned) || b.points - a.points || a.opponent.id.localeCompare(b.opponent.id));
		snapshot.mapStatus = snapshot.opponents.length ? "На карте: " + snapshot.opponents.length + ". Доступно для атаки: " + snapshot.targets.length + "." + (snapshot.attempts.total <= 0 ? " Попытки закончились; подбор обороны доступен." : "") : "Сервер не вернул составы противников. " + (Object.keys(war).length ? "Проверь фазу войны и доступ к карте." : "Сейчас нет активной войны.");
		return snapshot;
	}
	function warSnapshot(modeId, info, map, userId) {
		const cross = modeId === "clash-of-worlds";
		const war = cross ? asRecord$1(info.war) : info;
		const clanTries = asRecord$1(map.clanTries ?? war.clanTries);
		const mine = cross ? {
			...asRecord$1(war.myTries),
			...asRecord$1(clanTries[userId])
		} : war;
		const total = cross ? count(mine.heroes) + count(mine.titans) : Math.min(count(war.myTries), count(clanTries.clan, count(war.myTries)));
		return {
			modeId,
			revision: [
				modeId,
				userId,
				info.season,
				war.day ?? war.id,
				war.endTime
			].join(":"),
			userId,
			expiresAt: finiteNumber$1(war.endTime) * 1e3,
			attempts: {
				total,
				hero: cross ? count(mine.heroes) : total,
				titan: cross ? count(mine.titans) : total
			},
			usedHeroes: unitIds(mine.usedHeroes),
			usedTitans: unitIds(mine.usedTitans),
			targets: [],
			opponents: []
		};
	}
	function warOpenTiers(slots, slotRules, forts) {
		const tiers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([1]);
		for (const [fortId, raw] of Object.entries(forts)) {
			const members = Object.entries(slots).filter(([id]) => String(asRecord$1(slotRules[id]).fortificationId) === fortId);
			if (members.length && members.every(([, slot]) => asRecord$1(slot).status === "defeated")) {
				const next = count(asRecord$1(raw).tierUnlock);
				if (next) tiers.add(next);
			}
		}
		return tiers;
	}
	function warAttackBlockedReason(snapshot, slot, tierAvailable, assignedTo, settings, now) {
		if (snapshot.expiresAt <= now) return "Период атаки закончился или сервер не вернул время его окончания";
		if (slot.status !== "ready") return slot.status === "defeated" ? "Точка уже побеждена" : "Точка занята";
		if (!tierAvailable) return "Проход к укреплению закрыт";
		if (snapshot.modeId === "clash-of-worlds" && (settings.restrictAttackWithoutOrder && !assignedTo || settings.restrictAttackForeignOrder && assignedTo && assignedTo !== snapshot.userId)) return "Атака ограничена приказом гильдии";
		return "";
	}
	/**
	* Читает состав из слота ВГ/СМ независимо от промежуточных серверных обёрток.
	* Используется и при выборе карты, и при нормализации, чтобы слот не считался
	* сначала «боевым», а потом внезапно не исчезал из списка противников.
	*/
	function extractBattleLabWarSlotTeam(slot) {
		const battle = asRecord$1(slot.battle);
		const sources = [
			slot.team,
			slot.defenders,
			slot.defense,
			slot.defence,
			slot.defenseTeam,
			slot.defenceTeam,
			slot.enemyTeam,
			slot.heroTeam,
			slot.titanTeam,
			slot.units,
			slot.heroes,
			slot.titans,
			battle.team,
			battle.defenders,
			battle.defense,
			battle.defence,
			battle.defenseTeam,
			battle.defenceTeam,
			battle.enemyTeam,
			battle.heroTeam,
			battle.titanTeam,
			battle.units,
			battle.heroes,
			battle.titans
		];
		for (const source of [...sources, slot]) {
			const team = unwrapWarSlotTeam(source);
			if (team) return team;
		}
		return null;
	}
	/**
	* В старой карте команда лежит прямо в `team`, а новая оборачивает её в
	* `defense.heroes`/`defenders.titans`. Возвращаем именно коллекцию бойцов,
	* иначе слот проходит проверку карты, но исчезает уже в нормализаторе.
	*/
	function unwrapWarSlotTeam(value, visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set()) {
		if (value && typeof value === "object") {
			if (visited.has(value)) return null;
			visited.add(value);
		}
		if (Array.isArray(value)) {
			if (isDirectBattleLabTeam(value)) return value;
			for (const nested of value) {
				const team = unwrapWarSlotTeam(nested, visited);
				if (team) return team;
			}
			return null;
		}
		const record = asRecord$1(value);
		if (!Object.keys(record).length) return null;
		if (isBattleLabUnitRecord(record) || isDirectBattleLabTeamRecord(record)) return record;
		for (const key of [
			"0",
			"team",
			"heroes",
			"titans",
			"units",
			"members",
			"defense",
			"defence",
			"defenders",
			"defenseTeam",
			"defenceTeam",
			"enemyTeam",
			"heroTeam",
			"titanTeam",
			"battle"
		]) {
			const team = unwrapWarSlotTeam(record[key], visited);
			if (team) return team;
		}
		for (const [key, nested] of Object.entries(record)) {
			if ([
				"0",
				"team",
				"heroes",
				"titans",
				"units",
				"members",

	/** Отличает `[герой, ...]` от `[команда, ...]`, не отрезая четырёх бойцов. */
	function isDirectBattleLabTeam(value) {
		return value.some((unit) => isBattleLabUnitRecord(asRecord$1(unit)));
	}
	function isDirectBattleLabTeamRecord(value) {
