	}
	function isBattleLabUnitRecord(value) {
		return value.id != null && (value.type != null || value.level != null || value.skills != null || value.hp != null || value.power != null);
	}
	/** Сервер менял коллекции карты между объектом и массивом; id слота сохраняем ключом. */
	function asCollection(value) {
		if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.fromEntries(value.flatMap((item, index) => {
			const record = asRecord$1(item);
			const id = String(record.id ?? record.slotId ?? index).trim();
			return id ? [[id, item]] : [];
		}));
		return asRecord$1(value);
	}
	function readCollectionEntry(value, id) {
		const collection = asCollection(value);
		return collection[id] ?? collection[String(Number(id))];
	}
	function warDefenseEffects(value, library) {
		const buffs = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.adventure).buff);
		const effects = {};
		for (const [id, amount] of Object.entries(asRecord$1(value))) {
			const effect = String(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(buffs[id]).effect).effect ?? "");
			if (!effect) throw new Error("Неизвестное усиление укрепления " + id + ". Обнови игровые данные.");
			effects[effect] = amount;
		}
		return effects;
	}
	function normalizeBattleLabMinions(info, userId, now = Date.now()) {
		const targets = [];
		let expiresAt = 0;
		for (const [nodeId, raw] of Object.entries(asRecord$1(info.nodes))) {
			const node = asRecord$1(raw);
			const timestamps = asRecord$1(node.timestamps);
			const end = finiteNumber$1(timestamps.end) * 1e3;
			if (finiteNumber$1(timestamps.start) * 1e3 > now || end <= now) continue;
			const teams = Array.isArray(node.teams) ? node.teams : [];
			const battles = teams.flatMap((rawTeam, battleIndex) => {
				const team = asRecord$1(rawTeam);
				const states = Array.isArray(team.states) ? team.states : [];
				if (!states.length || states.every(waveDefeated)) return [];
				return [{
					defenders: states,
					type: "clan_raid",
					typeId: nodeId,
					battleIndex,
					__battleLabMultiwave: true
				}];
			});
			if (!battles.length) continue;
			const indices = battles.map((battle) => battle.battleIndex);
			const source = {
				id: nodeId,
				nodeId,
				name: "Прислужники · точка " + nodeId,
				teams: battles.length === 1 ? battles[0].defenders[0] : battles.map((battle) => battle.defenders[0]),
				battles,
				__battleLabMultiwave: true,
				__battleLabBattleIndices: indices,
				__battleLabRoot: info,
				type: "clan_raid",
				effects: {
					attackers: {},
					defenders: {}
				}
			};
			const [opponent] = normalizeBattleLabOpponents({
				...BATTLE_LAB_MODE_BY_ID["asgard-minions"],
				expectedTeamCount: battles.length
			}, { [nodeId]: source });
			if (!opponent) continue;
			const points = indices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(teams[i]).victoryPoints) - finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(teams[i]).points)), 0);
			targets.push({
				opponent: {
					...opponent,
					detail: battles.length + " боёв · до " + new Date(end).toLocaleTimeString()
				},
				unitType: "hero",
				assigned: false,
				points,
				fortificationId: nodeId,
				fortificationReward: 0,
				fortificationRemainingSlots: [nodeId],
				fingerprint: JSON.stringify({
					node,
					indices
				})
			});
			expiresAt = Math.max(expiresAt, end);
		}
		return {
			modeId: "asgard-minions",
			revision: [
				"asgard-minions",
				userId,
				asRecord$1(info.stats).weekStart
			].join(":"),
			userId,
			expiresAt,
			attempts: {
				total: count(info.attempts),
				hero: count(info.attempts),
				titan: 0
			},
			usedHeroes: [],
			usedTitans: [],
			targets
		};
	}
	function waveDefeated(value) {
		const units = (Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value))).filter((unit) => asRecord$1(unit).type !== "pet");
		return units.length > 0 && units.every((unit) => {
			const state = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(unit).state);
			return state.isDead === true || state.hp != null && finiteNumber$1(state.hp) <= 0;
		});
	}
	function unitIds(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value))).map((item) => Number(asRecord$1(item).id ?? item)).filter((id) => Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0);
	}
	function count(value, fallback = 0) {
		return Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(value, fallback)));
	}

	function readBattleLabWarUsedUnits(history, userId) {
		const replays = new Map(Object.entries(asRecord$1(history.replays)).map(([key, value]) => [String(asRecord$1(value).id ?? key), asRecord$1(value)]));
		if (Array.isArray(history.replays)) history.replays.forEach((value) => replays.set(String(asRecord$1(value).id), asRecord$1(value)));
		const entries = Array.isArray(history.attack) ? history.attack : Object.values(asRecord$1(history.attack));
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const value of entries) {
			const entry = asRecord$1(value);
			if (String(entry.attackerId) !== userId || entry.previousStatus === "empty") continue;
			const ids = unitIds(replays.get(String(entry.replayId))?.attackers);
			if (!ids.length) throw new Error("В журнале войны отсутствует состав твоей предыдущей атаки. Не могу исключить использованных бойцов.");
			ids.forEach((id) => used.add(id));
		}
		return {
			usedHeroes: [...used].filter((id) => id < 4e3),
			usedTitans: [...used].filter((id) => id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3)
		};
	}

	function isBattleLabCalculationBroken(error) {
		return error instanceof GameRuntimeUnavailableError || typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "name" in error && error.name === "TypeError";
	}

	function isBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error) {

	function isArchdemonBattle(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const battle = asRecord$1(source.battleData ?? source.battle ?? source);
		if (battle.type === "boss_rating_event") return true;
		if (!/^invasion_boss_\d+$/.test(String(battle.type))) return false;
		return (Array.isArray(battle.defenders) ? battle.defenders : [battle.defenders]).some((team) => Object.values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(team).heroes ?? team)).some((unit) => Number(asRecord$1(unit).id) === 2010));
	}
	function resolveArchdemonBossId(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const battle = asRecord$1(source.battleData ?? source.battle ?? source);
		const nativeId = /^invasion_boss_(\d+)$/.exec(String(battle.type))?.[1];
		const request = asRecord$1(source.__battleLabStartArgs);
		const alias = /^boss_(\d+)_\d+$/.exec(String(request.id ?? battle.typeId ?? ""));
		return nativeId ?? alias?.[1] ?? (battle.type === "boss_rating_event" && /^\d+$/.test(String(battle.typeId)) ? String(battle.typeId) : null);
	}
	function resolveArchdemonEvent(opponent, library) {
		const context = opponent.context;
		const request = asRecord$1(context.__battleLabStartArgs);
		const battle = asRecord$1(context.battleData ?? context.battle ?? context);
		const bossId = resolveArchdemonBossId(context);
		const invasion = asRecord$1(library.invasion);
		const alias = /^boss_(\d+)_(\d+)$/.exec(String(request.id ?? battle.typeId ?? ""));
		const chapterId = String(request.chapterId ?? context.chapterId ?? alias?.[2] ?? "");
		const chapters = asRecord$1(invasion.chapter);
		let chapter = asRecord$1(chapters[chapterId]);
		if (!chapter.id) {
			const matches = Object.values(asRecord$1(invasion.phase)).map(asRecord$1).filter((phase) => {
				const bosses = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(phase.phaseData).boss);
				return Object.entries(bosses).some(([id, raw]) => {
					return asRecord$1(asRecord$1(raw).eventConfig).type === "bossGroupRating" && bossId === id;
				});
			});
			const ids = new Set(matches.map((phase) => String(phase.chapterId)));
			if (ids.size === 1) chapter = asRecord$1(chapters[[...ids][0]]);
		}
		const event = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(invasion.list)[String(chapter.invasionId)]);
		const chapterPool = chapter.attackUnitsPool;
		const pool = asRecord$1(chapterPool == null || chapterPool === "" ? event.attackUnitsPool : chapterPool).availableUnits;
		if (!chapter.id || !event.id || !Array.isArray(pool)) throw new Error("В снимке Архидемона нет главы события. Нужен новый бой, записанный лабораторией: так подбор получит именно доступных в событии бойцов.");
		return {
			invasionId: String(event.id),
			chapterId: String(chapter.id),
			availableUnits: [...new Set(pool.map(Number))].filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 && id < 7e3)
		};
	}
	function readArchdemonTalismans(library, translate = (key) => key) {
		const buffs = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.adventure).buff);
		return Object.values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.invasion).talismans)).flatMap((raw) => {
			const talisman = asRecord$1(raw);
			const effectConfig = asRecord$1(talisman.effectConfig);
			const effect = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(buffs[String(effectConfig.buffId)]).effect).effect;
			const id = finiteNumber$1(talisman.id);
			if (!id || typeof effect !== "string" || !effect) return [];
			const key = `LIB_TALISMAN_NAME_${id}`;
			const label = translate(key);
			const descriptionKey = `LIB_TALISMAN_DESC_${id}`;
			const description = translate(descriptionKey);
			return [{
				id,
				label: label === key ? `#${id}` : label,
				description: description === descriptionKey ? "" : description,
				effect,
				enabled: finiteNumber$1(talisman.isBattle) > 0 && finiteNumber$1(talisman.weight) > 0,
				amount: Number.isFinite(Number(effectConfig.amount)) ? Number(effectConfig.amount) : null
			}];
		});
	}
	function withArchdemonTalisman(opponent, catalog, talismanId) {
		const context = structuredClone(opponent.context);
		const battle = asRecord$1(context.battleData ?? context.battle ?? context);
		if (!isArchdemonBattle(battle)) throw new Error("Нужен полный снимок боя с Архидемоном.");
		const effects = asRecord$1(context.effects ?? battle.effects);
		const attackers = { ...asRecord$1(effects.attackers) };
		const selected = catalog.find((item) => item.id === talismanId);
		if (talismanId !== 0 && !selected) throw new Error("Талисман отсутствует в игровом справочнике.");
		if (selected && !selected.enabled && !Object.hasOwn(attackers, selected.effect)) throw new Error("Этот талисман отключён в текущем событии.");
		const amount = selected?.amount ?? (selected ? finiteNumber$1(attackers[selected.effect], NaN) : 0);
		if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) throw new Error("Сила этого талисмана зависит от состояния события. Для сравнения нужен снимок боя с уже выбранным талисманом.");
		for (const talisman of catalog) delete attackers[talisman.effect];
		if (selected) attackers[selected.effect] = amount;
		context.effects = {
			...effects,
			attackers,
			battleConfig: "boss_event"
		};
		context.__battleLabTalismanId = talismanId;
		if (context.battle) context.battle = {
			...asRecord$1(context.battle),
			effects: context.effects
		};
		if (context.battleData) context.battleData = {
			...asRecord$1(context.battleData),
			effects: context.effects
		};
		return {
			...opponent,
			context,
			scenarios: void 0
		};
	}

	}

	async function fetchArchdemonAccount(caller, opponent, library) {
		const event = resolveArchdemonEvent(opponent, library);
		const units = {
			hero: event.availableUnits.filter((id) => id < 1e3),
			pet: event.availableUnits.filter((id) => id >= 6e3),
			titan: []
		};
		const { payload, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
			name: "team_getMaxUpgrade",
			args: { units }
		}));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		const source = asRecord$1(payload);
		const readUnits = (kind) => {
			const collection = asRecord$1(source[kind]);
			const allowed = new Set(units[kind]);
			return Object.fromEntries(Object.values(collection).map(asRecord$1).filter((unit) => allowed.has(Number(unit.id))).map((unit) => [String(unit.id), {
				...unit,
				id: Number(unit.id),
				type: kind
			}]));
		};
		const heroes = readUnits("hero");
		const pets = readUnits("pet");
		if (!Object.keys(heroes).length) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул максимальную прокачку героев события.");
		const missing = [...units.hero.filter((id) => !heroes[id]), ...units.pet.filter((id) => !pets[id])];
		if (missing.length) throw new Error(`Сервер вернул неполный пул события: нет максимальной прокачки бойцов ${missing.join(", ")}.`);
		return {
			userId: String(asRecord$1(opponent.context.battle).userId ?? opponent.context.userId ?? ""),
			heroes,
			pets,
			titans: {},
			titanSpirits: {},
			banners: {},
			arenaState: {},
			teamPresets: {},
			teamFavor: {},
			teamBanners: {},
			offers: {},
			roleAscension: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(library.roleAscension)).map(([id, raw]) => [id, {
				id: Number(id),
				level: Math.max(0, ...Object.values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(raw).levels)).map((entry) => finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(entry).level)))
			}]))
		};
	}

		return [...new Set(ids.map(finiteId).filter((id) => id > 0))].sort((left, right) => left - right);
	}

		return size > 0 ? 1 / Math.sqrt(size) : 1;

				}
				for (const event of data.energyWindows) for (const delta of [
					0,
					.2,
					.5,
					.85
				]) {
					const value = round(event.time + delta);
					if (value >= min && value <= max) times.add(value);
				}
				return [...times].sort((left, right) => left - right);
			}
		};
	}));

	//#region src/shared/game/smart-battle-engine/legacy-battle-calculator.ts
	function getLegacyBattleCalc(runtimeRoot = globalThis) {
		const explicitCalc = runtimeRoot.BattleCalc;
		if (typeof explicitCalc === "function") return (battle, mode) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			if (getBattleType(battle, mode) === "boss_event" || battle.type === "boss_rating_event") {
				reject(new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Для Архидемона нужен штатный движок с конфигом boss_event. Старый BattleCalc не поддерживает этот конфиг."));
				return;
			}
			const timeout = globalThis.setTimeout(() => reject(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error("Резервный игровой расчёт не завершился за 20 секунд.")), 2e4);
			const fail = (error) => {
				globalThis.clearTimeout(timeout);
				reject(error);
			};
			try {
				const completion = explicitCalc.call(runtimeRoot, battle, resolveBattleConfigGetter(getBattleType(battle, mode)), (result) => {
					globalThis.clearTimeout(timeout);
					resolve(result);
				});
				if (completion) Promise.resolve(completion).catch(fail);
			} catch (error) {
				fail(error);
			}
		});
		const genericCalc = runtimeRoot.Calc;
		return typeof genericCalc === "function" ? (battle, mode) => {
			const type = getBattleType(battle, mode);
			if (type === "boss_event" || battle.type === "boss_rating_event") throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Для Архидемона нужен штатный движок с конфигом boss_event.");
			if (type === "titan_arena" || type === "titan_arena_def") throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError("Для Турнира нужен игровой движок или BattleCalc с явным конфигом. Старый Calc несовместим с этим режимом.");
			return Reflect.apply(genericCalc, runtimeRoot, [battle]);
		} : void 0;
	}

		init_game_runtime_calculator();
		init_haxe_runtime();
	}));

	function serializeCalculationInput(battle) {
		try {
			return JSON.stringify(battle);
		} catch {
			return null;
		}
	}
	function inspectCalculationInput(before, after) {
		if (before === null || after === null) return "unserializable";
		return before === after ? "unchanged" : "mutated";
	}
	var BattleRunner, MainThreadBattleCalculation;
	var init_battle_runner = __esmMin((() => {

		BattleRunner = class {
			constructor(options = {}) {
				_defineProperty(this, "calc", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "buildBattleFn", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "sendFinalFn", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "budget", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "gameRuntimeCalculator", void 0);
				this.calc = options.calc;
				this.buildBattleFn = options.buildBattle;
				this.sendFinalFn = options.sendFinal;
				this.budget = options.budget ?? null;
				this.gameRuntimeCalculator = options.executor ?? new MainThreadBattleCalculation();
			}
			/** Сколько прогонов имеет смысл запускать параллельно этим раннером. */
			get concurrency() {
				return this.calc ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.gameRuntimeCalculator.concurrency));
			}
			/** Стороннему Calc нельзя передавать команды без уже разрешённых индексов. */
			get supportsTimeResolvedInput() {
				return !this.calc && this.gameRuntimeCalculator.supportsTimeResolvedInput === true;
			}
			async buildBattle(candidate, enemyContext, mode) {
				if (this.buildBattleFn) return await this.buildBattleFn(candidate, enemyContext, mode);
				if (enemyContext.battle && typeof enemyContext.battle === "object") return clone(enemyContext.battle);
				throw new Error("BattleRunner.buildBattle: передайте buildBattle(candidate, enemyContext, mode).");
			}
			async simulateBattle(battle, input, candidate, mode, calculationOptions) {
				if (calculationOptions?.resolveInputByTime && !this.supportsTimeResolvedInput) throw new Error("Исполнитель не поддерживает разрешение команд по времени.");
				if (this.budget) {
					if (!this.budget.canRunCalc()) throw new Error("Лимит поиска исчерпан.");
					this.budget.registerCalc();
				}
				const probe = getBattlePerformanceProbe();
				const cloneStartedAt = probe ? readPerformanceTime() : 0;
				const firstProgress = battle.progress?.[0] ?? {};
				const attackers = firstProgress.attackers ?? {};
				const battleCopy = {
					...battle,
					progress: [{
						...firstProgress,
						attackers: {
							...attackers,
							input: input ?? []
						}
					}, ...battle.progress?.slice(1) ?? []]
				};
				if (!probe) return await this.calculateCopy(battleCopy, candidate, mode, calculationOptions);
				probe.add("runner.clone", readPerformanceTime() - cloneStartedAt);
				const inputBefore = probe.shouldInspectCalculationInput?.() ? serializeCalculationInput(battleCopy) : void 0;
				const calculation = await this.calculateCopy(battleCopy, candidate, mode, calculationOptions);
				if (inputBefore !== void 0) probe.recordCalculationInput?.(inspectCalculationInput(inputBefore, serializeCalculationInput(battleCopy)));
				return calculation;
			}
			async calculateCopy(battleCopy, candidate, mode, calculationOptions) {
				if (this.calc) return await this.calc(battleCopy, candidate, mode);
				try {
					return await this.gameRuntimeCalculator.calculate(battleCopy, mode, calculationOptions);
				} catch (error) {
					if (calculationOptions?.resolveInputByTime || !(error instanceof GameRuntimeUnavailableError) || this.gameRuntimeCalculator.allowLegacyFallback === false) throw error;
					const legacyCalc = getLegacyBattleCalc();
					if (legacyCalc) return await legacyCalc(battleCopy, mode);
					throw new GameRuntimeUnavailableError(`BattleRunner.simulateBattle: игровой калькулятор недоступен. ${error.message}`);
				}
			}
			async sendFinal(payload) {
				if (this.sendFinalFn) return await this.sendFinalFn(payload);
				return {
					ok: true,
					skipped: true,
					payload
				};
			}
		};
		MainThreadBattleCalculation = class {
			constructor() {
				_defineProperty(this, "concurrency", 1);
				_defineProperty(this, "calculator", new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator());
			}
			/** Без реестра используется legacy Calc, который не умеет разрешать время. */
			get supportsTimeResolvedInput() {
				return findHeroWarsClassRegistry(globalThis) !== null;
			}
			calculate(battle, mode, options) {
				return this.calculator.calculate(battle, mode, options);
			}
		};
	}));

	var BattleResultScorer;
	var init_battle_scoring = __esmMin((() => {
		init_constants();
		init_helpers$1();
		init_battle_log();

		BattleResultScorer = class {
			constructor(mode, config = {}) {
				_defineProperty(this, "mode", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "config", void 0);
				this.mode = mode;
				this.config = {
					...DEFAULT_CONFIG,
					...config
				};
			}
			score(calculation, candidate = null) {
				if (this.mode.objective === "max_damage") return this.scoreBossDamage(calculation);
				if (this.mode.objective === "save_hp_energy") return this.scoreSaveHpEnergy(calculation) + this.scoreCandidatePrior(candidate);
				return this.scoreWinStars(calculation) + this.scoreCandidatePrior(candidate);
			}
			scoreWinStars(calculation) {
				const result = calculation.result ?? calculation.battle?.result ?? {};
				let score = result.win ? 1e6 : 0;
				score += finiteNumber$2(result.stars) * 12e4;
				score += this.scoreAttackersState(calculation) * 5;
				score -= this.scoreDefendersState(calculation) * 3;
				score -= finiteNumber$2(calculation.battleTime) * 8;
				if (!result.win) score += this.damageToDefendersPercent(calculation) * this.config.lostBattleDamageWeight;
				return score;
			}
			scoreBossDamage(calculation) {
				const counter = this.readBossDamageCounter(calculation);
				if (counter > 0) return counter;
				return this.damageToDefendersRaw(calculation);
			}
			/** Игра читает урон по боссу из `progress[0].defenders.heroes["1"].extra`. */
			readBossDamageCounter(calculation) {
				const defenders = this.getProgressUnits(calculation, "defenders");
				const bossDamage = this.readAccumulatedBossDamage(defenders["1"]);
				if (bossDamage !== null && bossDamage > 0) return bossDamage;
				let best = 0;
				for (const defender of objectValues(defenders)) {
					const damage = this.readAccumulatedBossDamage(defender);
					if (damage !== null) best = Math.max(best, damage);
				}
				return best;
			}
			readAccumulatedBossDamage(value) {
				const extra = asRecord$2(asRecord$2(value).extra);
				if (!Object.hasOwn(extra, "damageTaken") && !Object.hasOwn(extra, "damageTakenNextLevel")) return null;
				return finiteNumber$2(extra.damageTaken) + finiteNumber$2(extra.damageTakenNextLevel);
			}
			scoreSaveHpEnergy(calculation) {
				const attackers = objectValues(this.getProgressUnits(calculation, "attackers"));
				if (attackers.length > 0 && attackers.every((attacker) => attacker.isDead)) return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
				let score = (calculation.result ?? calculation.battle?.result)?.win ? 4e5 : 0;
				score += this.scoreAttackersState(calculation) * 8;
				score += sum$1(attackers, (attacker) => finiteNumber$2(attacker.energy) / 1e3) * 3e3;
				return score;
			}
			scoreGrand(results) {
				const scores = results.map((result) => this.scoreWinStars(result));
				const wins = results.filter((result) => (result.result ?? result.battle?.result ?? {}).win).length;
				const stars = sum$1(results, (result) => finiteNumber$2((result.result ?? result.battle?.result ?? {}).stars));
				let score = sum$1(scores, (value) => value);
				if (wins >= 2) score += 3e6;
				score += wins * 5e5 + stars * 8e4;
				return {
					score,
					wins,
					stars,
					scores
				};
			}
			getProgress(calculation) {
				return calculation.progress?.[0] ?? calculation.battle?.progress?.[0] ?? null;
			}
			getInitialAttackers(calculation) {
				return this.toUnitStateRecord(calculation.battleData?.attackers ?? calculation.battle?.attackers ?? calculation.attackers);
			}
			getInitialDefenders(calculation) {
				const defenders = calculation.battleData?.defenders ?? calculation.battle?.defenders ?? calculation.defenders;
				if (Array.isArray(defenders) && !this.looksLikeUnit(defenders[0])) return this.toUnitStateRecord(defenders[0]);
				return this.toUnitStateRecord(defenders);
			}
			getProgressUnits(calculation, side) {
				const progressSide = this.getProgress(calculation)?.[side];
				return [
					asRecord$2(progressSide?.heroes),
					asRecord$2(progressSide?.titans),
					asRecord$2(progressSide?.units)
				].find((candidate) => Object.keys(candidate).length > 0) ?? {};
			}
			scoreAttackersState(calculation) {
				return this.scoreSideState(this.getProgressUnits(calculation, "attackers"), this.getInitialAttackers(calculation), true);
			}
			scoreDefendersState(calculation) {
				return this.scoreSideState(this.getProgressUnits(calculation, "defenders"), this.getInitialDefenders(calculation), false);
			}
			scoreSideState(after, before, penalizeDeath) {
				let score = 0;
				for (const [unitId, rawState] of objectEntries(after)) {
					const state = rawState;
					if (state.isDead) {
						if (penalizeDeath) score -= 25e3;
						continue;
					}
					const initial = asRecord$2(before[unitId]);
					const maxHp = finiteNumber$2(asRecord$2(initial.state).maxHp, finiteNumber$2(initial.hp, finiteNumber$2(state.maxHp, state.hp)));
					if (maxHp > 0) score += clamp(finiteNumber$2(state.hp) / maxHp, 0, 2) * 2e4;
					score += clamp(finiteNumber$2(state.energy) / 1e3, 0, 1.5) * 2500;
				}
				return score;
			}
			damageToDefendersPercent(calculation) {
				const { total, damage } = this.defenderDamage(calculation);
				return total > 0 ? damage / total : 0;
			}
			damageToDefendersRaw(calculation) {
				return this.defenderDamage(calculation).damage;
			}
			defenderDamage(calculation) {
				const after = this.getProgressUnits(calculation, "defenders");
				const before = this.getInitialDefenders(calculation);
				let total = 0;
				let damage = 0;
				let matchedStates = 0;
				for (const [unitId, rawInitial] of objectEntries(before)) {
					const current = asRecord$2(after[unitId]);
					if (Object.keys(current).length === 0) continue;
					matchedStates += 1;

					const maxHp = finiteNumber$2(asRecord$2(initial.state).maxHp, initial.hp);
					if (maxHp <= 0) continue;
					total += maxHp;
					damage += clamp(maxHp - finiteNumber$2(current.hp), 0, maxHp);
				}
				if (matchedStates > 0 && total > 0) return {
					total,
					damage
				};
				total = sum$1(objectValues(before), (rawInitial) => {
					const initial = asRecord$2(rawInitial);
					return Math.max(0, finiteNumber$2(asRecord$2(initial.state).maxHp, finiteNumber$2(initial.hp)));
				});
				const loggedDamage = new BattleLogParser().parse(calculation).reduce((amount, event) => event.isDamage && finiteNumber$2(event.target) < 0 ? amount + Math.max(0, event.damage) : amount, 0);
				return {
					total,
					damage: total > 0 ? clamp(loggedDamage, 0, total) : 0
				};
			}
			scoreCandidatePrior(candidate) {
				if (!candidate) return 0;

			}
			toUnitStateRecord(value) {
				if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
					const record = asRecord$2(value);
					return [
						asRecord$2(record.heroes),
						asRecord$2(record.titans),

				}
				return result;
			}
			looksLikeUnit(value) {
				return asRecord$2(value).id != null;
			}

	//#region src/shared/game/smart-battle-engine/hero-skill-mechanics.ts
	/**
	* Часть игровых навыков описана не текстом, а именем Haxe-класса и набором
	* параметров. Числовой id навыка здесь намеренно не используется: при появлении
	* нового героя движок читает его сигнатуру из актуальной lib, а не из списка
	* вручную внесённых любимчиков.
	*/
	function resolveHeroSkillMechanics(skill) {
		const behavior = asRecord$2(skill.behavior);
		const name = String(behavior.behavior ?? "");
		const effect = String(behavior.effect ?? "").toLowerCase();

			tags: ["stat_buff"]
		};

	function applyHeroSkillMechanics(profile, before, tags, mechanics) {
		if (!mechanics) return;
		for (const [metric, value] of Object.entries(mechanics.metrics)) {
			const key = metric;

			tags.add(key === "teamBuff" ? "team_buff" : key === "energyGain" ? "energy_gain" : key);
		}
		mechanics.tags.forEach((tag) => tags.add(tag));
	}

			buildAssignments(heroes, options = {}) {

				const limit = Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 10);

				const perHero = heroes.map((hero) => ({
					hero,
					options: this.getTopFavorOptions(hero, topPerHero, forbiddenPets)
				})).sort((left, right) => left.options.length - right.options.length);
				const slotBonus = options.preferFilledSlots ? 1 + perHero.reduce((total, item) => total + Math.max(0, ...item.options.map((option) => option.score)), 0) : 0;
				if (slotBonus > 0) {
					for (const item of perHero) for (const option of item.options) if (option.id) option.score += slotBonus;
				}
				const optimisticSuffix = Array.from({ length: perHero.length + 1 }, () => 0);
				for (let index = perHero.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) optimisticSuffix[index] = optimisticSuffix[index + 1] + (perHero[index].options[0]?.score ?? 0);
				let results = [];
				const visit = (index, used, favor, score) => {
					if (results.length >= limit) {
						const worstScore = results[results.length - 1].score;
						if (score + optimisticSuffix[index] <= worstScore) return;
					}
					if (index >= perHero.length) {
						results = topK([...results, {
							favor: { ...favor },
							score
						}], limit, (assignment) => assignment.score);
						return;
					}
					const item = perHero[index];
					for (const option of item.options) {
						if (option.id && used.has(option.id)) continue;
						if (option.id) {
							used.add(option.id);
							favor[String(item.hero.id)] = option.id;
						}
						visit(index + 1, used, favor, score + option.score);
						if (option.id) {
							used.delete(option.id);
							delete favor[String(item.hero.id)];
						}
					}
				};
				visit(0, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), {}, 0);
				if (slotBonus > 0) {
					const filled = Math.max(0, ...results.map((assignment) => Object.keys(assignment.favor).length));
					results = results.filter((assignment) => Object.keys(assignment.favor).length === filled).map((assignment) => ({
						...assignment,
						score: assignment.score - filled * slotBonus
					}));
				}
				return results;
			}
		};

	function emptyModifier() {
		return {
			burst: 0,
			control: 0,
			heal: 0,
			shield: 0,
			energyBurn: 0,
			physicalDamage: 0,

			interrupt: 0,

	function applySkillProfile(modifier, profile, factor) {
		modifier.physicalDamage += profile.physicalDamage * factor;
		modifier.magicDamage += profile.magicDamage * factor;
		modifier.pureDamage += profile.pureDamage * factor;
		modifier.burst += (profile.burst + profile.damage * .22) * factor;
		modifier.control += profile.control * factor;
		modifier.interrupt += profile.interrupt * factor;
		modifier.heal += profile.heal * factor;
		modifier.shield += profile.shield * factor;
		modifier.energyBurn += profile.energyBurn * factor;
		modifier.teamBuff += (profile.teamBuff + profile.energyGain * .7) * factor;
		modifier.revive += profile.revive * factor;
		modifier.cleanse += profile.cleanse * factor;
	}
	function applyModifier(base, modifier) {
		const result = { ...base };
		for (const key of MODIFIER_KEYS) result[key] = finiteNumber$2(base[key]) + modifier[key];
		return result;
	}
	function quantile(sortedValues, fraction) {
		if (sortedValues.length === 0) return 0;
		return sortedValues[Math.min(sortedValues.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sortedValues.length * fraction) - 1))];
	}
	function average(values) {
		return values.length > 0 ? values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length : 0;
	}

				const result = { ...fallback };
				for (const key of MODIFIER_KEYS) result[key] = quantile(scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.summary[key]).sort((left, right) => left - right), .78);
				return result;
			}
			aggregateScores(scores) {
				const finiteScores = scores.filter(Number.isFinite).sort((left, right) => left - right);
				if (finiteScores.length === 0) return {
					score: 0,
					mean: 0,
					worst: 0,
					cvar: 0,
					spread: 0
				};
				const mean = average(finiteScores);
				const worst = finiteScores[0];
				const tailSize = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(finiteScores.length * .35));
				const cvar = average(finiteScores.slice(0, tailSize));
				return {
					score: round(mean * .25 + cvar * .5 + worst * .25),
					mean: round(mean),
					worst: round(worst),
					cvar: round(cvar),
					spread: round(Math.max(0, mean - worst))
				};
			}
			resolveTeamPetOptions(enemyContext, enemyUnits, assessment) {
				const visible = this.findNamedValue(enemyContext, TEAM_PET_KEYS);
				const explicit = visible.found ? this.normalizePetOptions(visible.value, enemyUnits) : [];
				if (explicit.length > 0) return explicit;
				const embedded = this.findEmbeddedTeamPets(enemyContext, enemyUnits);
				if (embedded.length > 0) return embedded;
				if (assessment.teamPet === "known") return [{
					id: 0,
					unit: null
				}];
				const options = this.playablePetIds().map((id) => ({
					id,
					unit: this.syntheticPet(id, enemyUnits)
				}));
				return options.length > 0 ? options : [{
					id: 0,
					unit: null
				}];
			}
			resolveFavorPlans(enemyContext, enemyUnits, assessment) {
				const explicit = this.findNamedValue(enemyContext, FAVOR_KEYS);
				const fixedFavor = {
					...this.favorFromUnits(enemyUnits),
					...explicit.found ? this.normalizeFavor(explicit.value) : {}
				};
				if (assessment.patronage === "known") return [{
					archetype: "known",
					favor: fixedFavor,
					score: 0
				}];
				const inferred = [
					"burst",
					"sustain",
					"tempo"
				].map((archetype) => this.findBestFavorPlan(enemyUnits, archetype, fixedFavor));
				return inferred.some((plan) => Object.keys(plan.favor).length > 0) ? inferred : [{
					archetype: "known",
					favor: fixedFavor,
					score: 0
				}];
			}
			findBestFavorPlan(enemyUnits, archetype, fixedFavor) {
				const petIds = this.playablePetIds();
				const used = new Set(Object.values(fixedFavor).map(finiteId).filter((petId) => petId > 0));
				const pendingHeroes = enemyUnits.filter((hero) => finiteId(fixedFavor[String(hero.id)]) === 0).map((hero) => ({
					hero,
					options: [{
						id: 0,
						score: 0
					}, ...topK(petIds.filter((petId) => this.canFavor(hero.id, petId)).map((petId) => ({
						id: petId,
						score: this.scoreFavorFit(hero, petId, archetype)
					})), 5, (option) => option.score)]
				})).sort((left, right) => left.options.length - right.options.length);
				let bestFavor = { ...fixedFavor };
				let bestScore = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
				const visit = (index, score, favor) => {
					if (index >= pendingHeroes.length) {
						if (score > bestScore) {
							bestScore = score;
							bestFavor = { ...favor };
						}
						return;
					}
					const { hero, options } = pendingHeroes[index];
					for (const option of options) {
						if (option.id > 0 && used.has(option.id)) continue;
						if (option.id > 0) {
							used.add(option.id);
							favor[String(hero.id)] = option.id;
						}
						visit(index + 1, score + option.score, favor);
						if (option.id > 0) {
							used.delete(option.id);
							delete favor[String(hero.id)];
						}
					}
				};
				visit(0, 0, { ...fixedFavor });
				return {
					archetype,
					favor: bestFavor,
					score: Number.isFinite(bestScore) ? bestScore : 0
				};
			}
			scoreFavorFit(hero, petId, archetype) {
				const heroProfile = this.skillAnalyzer.analyzeUnit(hero);
				const pet = this.index.getPetLib(petId) ?? {};
				const favorProfile = this.getFavorProfile(petId);
				let burst = favorProfile.damage + favorProfile.burst * 1.25;
				let sustain = favorProfile.heal + favorProfile.shield + favorProfile.cleanse * 1.15;
				const tempo = favorProfile.control + favorProfile.energyBurn + favorProfile.energyGain + favorProfile.teamBuff * .65;
				for (const rawRule of objectValues(pet.favorStats)) {
					const rule = asRecord$2(rawRule);
					const stat = String(rule.stat ?? "");
					const multiplier = Math.abs(finiteNumber$2(rule.multiplier, 1));
					if (stat === "physicalAttack" || stat === "armorPenetration") burst += multiplier * (heroProfile.isPhysical ? 24 : 7);
					else if (stat === "magicPower" || stat === "magicPenetration") burst += multiplier * (heroProfile.isMagic ? 24 : 7);
					else if (stat === "hp") sustain += multiplier * (heroProfile.isTank ? 8 : 4);
					else if (stat === "armor" || stat === "magicResist") sustain += multiplier * (heroProfile.isTank ? 18 : 9);
					else if (stat === "dodge" || stat.includes("Crit")) {
						burst += multiplier * 12;
						sustain += multiplier * 6;
					}
				}
				if (archetype === "burst") return burst + tempo * .25;
				if (archetype === "sustain") return sustain + tempo * .2;
				return tempo + burst * .25 + sustain * .15;
			}
			applyTeamPet(modifier, pet) {
				applySkillProfile(modifier, this.getActivePetProfile(pet.id), .9);
			}
			applyFavor(modifier, enemyUnits, favor) {
				const units = new Map(enemyUnits.map((unit) => [finiteId(unit.id), unit]));
				for (const [heroIdValue, petIdValue] of Object.entries(favor)) {
					const hero = units.get(finiteId(heroIdValue));
					const petId = finiteId(petIdValue);
					if (!hero || petId <= 0) continue;
					if (!(finiteId(hero.favorPetId ?? hero.petId) === petId)) this.applyFavorStats(modifier, hero, petId);
					applySkillProfile(modifier, this.getFavorProfile(petId), .72);
				}
			}
			applyFavorStats(modifier, hero, petId) {
				const profile = this.skillAnalyzer.analyzeUnit(hero);
				const pet = this.index.getPetLib(petId) ?? {};
				for (const rawRule of objectValues(pet.favorStats)) {
					const rule = asRecord$2(rawRule);
					const stat = String(rule.stat ?? "");
					const multiplier = Math.abs(finiteNumber$2(rule.multiplier, 1));
					if (stat === "physicalAttack" || stat === "armorPenetration") {
						modifier.physicalDamage += multiplier * (profile.isPhysical ? 18 : 5);
						modifier.burst += multiplier * (profile.isPhysical ? 9 : 2);
					} else if (stat === "magicPower" || stat === "magicPenetration") {
						modifier.magicDamage += multiplier * (profile.isMagic ? 18 : 5);
						modifier.burst += multiplier * (profile.isMagic ? 9 : 2);
					} else if (stat === "hp") {
						modifier.hp += profile.hp * clamp(multiplier / 100, .01, .16);
						modifier.shield += multiplier * (profile.isTank ? 3.5 : 1.7);
					} else if (stat === "armor") {
						modifier.armor += profile.armor * clamp(multiplier / 20, .015, .12);
						modifier.shield += multiplier * 4;
					} else if (stat === "magicResist") {
						modifier.magicResist += profile.magicResist * clamp(multiplier / 20, .015, .12);
						modifier.shield += multiplier * 4;
					} else if (stat === "dodge") modifier.shield += multiplier * 10;
					else if (stat.includes("Crit")) modifier.burst += multiplier * 10;
				}
			}
			applyBanner(modifier, rawBanner, baseSummary, assessment, archetype) {
				const bannerId = finiteId(asRecord$2(rawBanner).id ?? rawBanner);
				const baseValue = objectValues((bannerId > 0 ? this.index.getBanner(bannerId) : null)?.buffs).reduce((total, value) => total + Math.abs(finiteNumber$2(value)), 0);
				const risk = assessment.bannerRisk;
				if (baseValue <= 0 && risk <= 0) return;
				const strength = clamp(baseValue / 10 + risk, .4, 2.5);
				if (archetype === "sustain") {
					modifier.armor += baseSummary.armor * .045 * strength;
					modifier.magicResist += baseSummary.magicResist * .045 * strength;
					modifier.hp += baseSummary.hp * .025 * strength;
					modifier.shield += 18 * strength;
					return;
				}
				if (archetype === "tempo") {
					modifier.control += 12 * strength;
					modifier.energyBurn += 9 * strength;
					modifier.teamBuff += 13 * strength;
					return;
				}
				const physicalShare = baseSummary.physicalDamage >= baseSummary.magicDamage ? .7 : .35;
				modifier.physicalDamage += 22 * strength * physicalShare;
				modifier.magicDamage += 22 * strength * (1 - physicalShare);
				modifier.burst += 15 * strength;
			}
			applyFallbackUncertainty(modifier, assessment, pet, favorPlan) {
				if (pet.id === 0 && assessment.petRisk > 0) {
					modifier.burst += 34 * assessment.petRisk;
					modifier.control += 28 * assessment.petRisk;

					modifier.shield += 20 * assessment.petRisk;
				}
				if (Object.keys(favorPlan.favor).length === 0 && assessment.patronageRisk > 0) {
					modifier.burst += 18 * assessment.patronageRisk;
					modifier.shield += 20 * assessment.patronageRisk;
					modifier.control += 12 * assessment.patronageRisk;
				}
			}
			getActivePetProfile(petId) {

			normalizePetOptions(value, enemyUnits) {

					}

					const current = strongestByPet.get(scenario.teamPetId);
					if (!current || scenario.severity > current.severity) strongestByPet.set(scenario.teamPetId, scenario);
				}
				for (const scenario of strongestByPet.values()) selected.set(scenario.key, scenario);
				for (const scenario of topK(scenarios, 15, (item) => item.severity)) {
					selected.set(scenario.key, scenario);
					if (selected.size >= 15) break;
				}
				return [...selected.values()];

	function getBrowserLocalStorage() {
		try {
			return globalThis.localStorage ?? null;
		} catch {
			return null;
		}
	}
	function warnBrowserStorageError(message, error) {
		console.warn(message, error);
	}
	function createBrowserStorageNamespace(prefix, storage = getBrowserLocalStorage()) {
		return {
			clear() {
				try {
					if (!storage) return;
					for (let index = storage.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
						const key = storage.key(index);
						if (key?.startsWith(prefix)) storage.removeItem(key);
					}
				} catch {}
			},
			getItem(key) {
				try {
					return storage?.getItem(`${prefix}${key}`) ?? null;
				} catch {
					return null;
				}
			},
			keys() {
				const keys = [];
				try {
					if (!storage) return keys;
					for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index++) {
						const key = storage.key(index);
						if (key?.startsWith(prefix)) keys.push(key.slice(prefix.length));
					}
				} catch {
					return keys;
				}
				return keys;
			},
			removeItem(key) {
				try {
					storage?.removeItem(`${prefix}${key}`);
				} catch {}
			},
			setItem(key, value) {
				try {
					if (!storage) return false;
					storage.setItem(`${prefix}${key}`, value);
					return true;
				} catch {
					return false;
				}
			}
		};
	}

	function openDatabase(factory, databaseName, storeName, version) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let settled = false;
			const request = version === void 0 ? factory.open(databaseName) : factory.open(databaseName, version);
			request.addEventListener("upgradeneeded", () => {
				if (!request.result.objectStoreNames.contains(storeName)) request.result.createObjectStore(storeName);
			});
			request.addEventListener("error", () => {
				settled = true;
				reject(request.error ?? createStorageError("IndexedDB open failed"));
			});
			request.addEventListener("blocked", () => {
				settled = true;
				reject(createStorageError("IndexedDB open blocked"));
			});
			request.addEventListener("success", () => {
				if (settled) {
					request.result.close();
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				resolve(request.result);
			});
		});
	}
	function requestResult(request) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

			request.addEventListener("success", () => resolve(request.result));
		});
	}
	function transactionComplete(transaction) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			transaction.addEventListener("abort", () => reject(transaction.error ?? createStorageError("IndexedDB transaction aborted")));
			transaction.addEventListener("error", () => reject(transaction.error ?? createStorageError("IndexedDB transaction failed")));
			transaction.addEventListener("complete", () => resolve());
		});
	}
	function readCursorKeys(store) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const keys = [];
			const request = store.openKeyCursor();
			request.addEventListener("error", () => reject(request.error ?? createStorageError("IndexedDB cursor failed")));
			request.addEventListener("success", () => {
				const cursor = request.result;
				if (!cursor) {
					resolve(keys);
					return;
				}
				keys.push(String(cursor.key));
				cursor.continue();
			});
		});
	}

	function heroLineupKey(heroes) {

	}
	function heroCandidateKey(candidate) {

	function buildHeroExplorationTeams(pool, size, score) {
		const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const add = (units) => {
			const key = heroLineupKey(units.map((unit) => Number(unit.id)));

			add([...pool]);
			return [...result.values()];
		}
		if (combinationCountAtMost(pool.length, teamSize, 2e3)) {
			addHeroCombinations(pool, teamSize, add);
			return [...result.values()];
		}

			const partners = selectExplorationPartners(pool, anchor, partnerLimit, score);
			addExplorationLatticeTeams(result, anchor, partners, size);
			let beam = [{
				units: [anchor],
				score: score([anchor])
			}];

						const candidate = {
							units,
							score: score(units)
						};

					}

			}

		}
		return [...result.values()];
	}
	function combinationCountAtMost(n, k, limit) {
		const selected = Math.min(k, n - k);
		let count = 1;
		for (let index = 1; index <= selected; index += 1) {
			count = count * (n - selected + index) / index;
			if (count > limit) return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
	function addHeroCombinations(pool, size, add) {
		const current = [];
		const visit = (start) => {
			if (current.length === size) {
				add([...current]);
				return;
			}
			const remaining = size - current.length;
			for (let index = start; index <= pool.length - remaining; index += 1) {
				current.push(pool[index]);
				visit(index + 1);
				current.pop();
			}
		};
		visit(0);
	}
	function addExplorationLatticeTeams(target, anchor, partners, size) {
		const teamSize = Math.min(size, partners.length + 1);
		if (teamSize < 2) return;
		const routeCount = Math.min(8, Math.max(3, teamSize + 1));
		for (let route = 0; route < routeCount; route += 1) {
			const units = [anchor];
			for (let position = 0; position < teamSize - 1; position += 1) {
				const partner = partners[route + position * routeCount];
				if (!partner) break;
				units.push(partner);
			}
			if (units.length !== teamSize) continue;
			const key = heroLineupKey(units.map((unit) => Number(unit.id)));
			if (!target.has(key)) target.set(key, { units });
		}
	}
	function selectExplorationPartners(pool, anchor, partnerLimit, score) {
		const ranked = pool.filter((unit) => unit.id !== anchor.id).map((unit, index) => ({
			unit,
			score: score([anchor, unit]),
			index
		})).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.index - right.index);
		const primary = ranked.slice(0, partnerLimit);
		const selected = new Map(primary.map((item) => [Number(item.unit.id), item.unit]));
		const tail = ranked.slice(partnerLimit);
		const explorationCount = Math.min(tail.length, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(partnerLimit * .25)));
		for (let index = 0; index < explorationCount; index += 1) {
			const candidate = tail[Math.floor((index + .5) * tail.length / explorationCount)]?.unit;
			if (candidate) selected.set(Number(candidate.id), candidate);
		}
		return [...selected.values()];
	}

				let variants = byTarget.get(target);
				if (!variants) {
					variants = [void 0, void 0];
					byTarget.set(target, variants);
				}
				const cached = variants[buffWeight];
				if (cached) return cached;
				const edges = [];
				const buckets = [];
				this.connectPair(source, target, edges, buckets, buffWeight);
				const pair = {
					edges,
					buckets
				};
				variants[buffWeight] = pair;
				return pair;
			}
			connectPair(source, target, edges, buckets, buffWeight) {
				const sourceProfile = source.profile;
				const targetProfile = target.profile;
				const offense = signal(targetProfile.damage + targetProfile.burst * 1.2 + targetProfile.control * .35);
				const ultimateValue = signal(targetProfile.activeTimelineValue * 4 + targetProfile.burst + Number(targetProfile.ultimate !== null) * 18);
				const frontlineNeed = .8 + Number(target.isTank) * .75 + clamp(35e4 / Math.max(1, target.hp), 0, 1);
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "team_buff", signal(sourceProfile.teamBuff) * (.7 + offense * .16) * buffWeight, "damage");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "energy_chain", signal(sourceProfile.tags.includes("self_energy") ? 0 : sourceProfile.energyGain) * (.65 + ultimateValue * .2), "tempo");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "frontline_protection", signal(sourceProfile.shield) * frontlineNeed, "survival");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "healing_loop", signal(sourceProfile.heal) * (.8 + Number(target.isTank) * .45), "survival");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "cleanse_cover", signal(sourceProfile.cleanse) * (.65 + Number(target.isBurst || target.isControl) * .5), "survival");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "revive_cover", signal(sourceProfile.revive) * (.55 + Number(target.isTank || target.isBurst) * .55), "survival");
				this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "control_burst", signal(sourceProfile.control + sourceProfile.debuff * .7) * (.55 + signal(targetProfile.burst + targetProfile.aoe) * .17), "disruption");
				const sameDamagePlan = source.isPhysical && target.isPhysical || source.isMagic && target.isMagic;
				const focusEnabler = sourceProfile.teamBuff * buffWeight + sourceProfile.debuff + sourceProfile.control * .35;
				if (sameDamagePlan && focusEnabler > 0) this.addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, "damage_focus", signal(focusEnabler) * (.5 + offense * .12), "damage");
			}
			addEdge(edges, buckets, source, target, kind, rawWeight, bucket) {
				const weight = round(clamp(rawWeight, 0, 90));
				if (weight < .35) return;
				edges.push(Object.freeze({
					sourceId: source.id,
					targetId: target.id,
					kind,
					weight
				}));
				buckets.push(bucket);
			}
			scoreCoverage(profiles) {
				if (profiles.length === 0) return 0;
				const hasTank = profiles.some((profile) => profile.isTank);
				const hasSustain = profiles.some((profile) => profile.isHealer || profile.profile.shield > 10);
				const hasControl = profiles.some((profile) => profile.isControl);
				const hasCleanse = profiles.some((profile) => profile.profile.cleanse > 0);
				const hasPhysical = profiles.some((profile) => profile.isPhysical);
				const hasMagic = profiles.some((profile) => profile.isMagic);
				const fullTeam = profiles.length >= 5;
				return Number(hasTank) * 18 + Number(hasSustain) * 16 + Number(hasControl) * 14 + Number(hasCleanse) * 10 + Number(hasPhysical && hasMagic) * 8 + Number(fullTeam) * 8;
			}
		};
	}));

	function resolveUnitProgression(unit) {
		const power = readFirstFiniteNumber(unit, ["power"]);
		const level = readFirstFiniteNumber(unit, ["level"]);
		const evolution = readFirstFiniteNumber(unit, [
			"star",
			"stars",
			"evolution"
		]);
		const rank = readFirstFiniteNumber(unit, ["color", "rank"]);
		return {
			power,
			level,
			evolution,
			rank,
			score: power / 100 + level * 3.5 + evolution * 18 + rank * 6
		};
	}
	function sumUnitPower(units) {
		return units.reduce((total, unit) => total + resolveUnitProgression(unit).power, 0);
	}
	function readFirstFiniteNumber(unit, keys) {
		for (const key of keys) {
			const value = Number(unit[key]);
			if (Number.isFinite(value)) return Math.max(0, value);
		}
		return 0;
	}

					slot: 1
				};
			}

				const skills = [];

					skills.push({
						skillId: finiteId(skillId),
						level,
						tierScale: finiteNumber$2(levelScale[level - 1])
					});
				}
				return skills;
			}
		};

				else if (enemy.magicResist > enemy.armor * 1.2) score += ally.physicalDamage * 1.35 + ally.magicDamage * .75;
				else score += ally.physicalDamage + ally.magicDamage;

				if (enemy.control > 25) score += ally.cleanse * 1.6 + ally.shield * .8;

				if (enemy.interactions.survivalAmplification > 25) score += ally.burst * .45 + ally.control * .35;
				if (enemy.physicalDamage > enemy.magicDamage * 1.2) score += Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, ally.armor)) * 2.5;
				else if (enemy.magicDamage > enemy.physicalDamage * 1.2) score += Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, ally.magicResist)) * 2.5;
				return score;
			}
			scoreTeamShape(ally, enemy) {
				let score = 0;
				if (ally.tankCount >= 1) score += 25;
				if (ally.healerCount >= 1) score += enemy.burst > 30 ? 25 : 15;
				if (ally.controlCount >= 1) score += enemy.heal > 20 || enemy.burst > 30 ? 30 : 15;
				if (ally.physicalCount >= 2 && ally.magicCount >= 2) score += 15;
				if (ally.count === 5) score += 20;
				if (ally.count < 3) score -= 30;
				return score;
			}

						score: baseScore + this.scoreHeroTeamAcrossScenarios(units, enemyUnits, supportScenarios).score * tacticalWeight
					};
					shells.push(shell);

					const alreadyIncluded = shells.some((shell) => stableSortedIds(shell.units.map((unit) => finiteId(unit.id))).join(",") === preferredKey);
					if (preferredUnits.length < this.mode.minUnits || alreadyIncluded) continue;

						lastPoolIndex: -1,
						baseScore,
						score: baseScore + this.scoreHeroTeamAcrossScenarios(preferredUnits, enemyUnits, supportScenarios).score * tacticalWeight
					});
				}

					if (candidateMap.size <= Math.min(this.config.maxTeamCandidates * 2, 4096)) return;

				};

						banner: supportAssessment.banner,

						scenarioSpread: scenarioScore.spread

							type: "hero",
							heroes: heroIds,
							teamPet: teamPet.id,
							favor: favor.favor,
							banner: banner?.id ?? 0,
							approxScore: shell.score + favor.score + teamPet.score + (banner?.score ?? 0) + robustnessScore * supportAssessment.uncertainty * this.config.unknownEnemySupportApproxWeight,

						const previous = candidateMap.get(key);
						if (!previous || candidate.approxScore > previous.approxScore || candidate.approxScore > previous.approxScore) candidateMap.set(key, candidate);
					}
					compactCandidates();
				}
				return this.selectHeroCandidates([...candidateMap.values()], this.config.maxTeamCandidates);
			}
			generateTitanTeams(enemyUnits, restrictions = {}) {
				const forbiddenTitans = new Set((restrictions.forbiddenTitans ?? []).map(finiteId));
				const pool = topK(this.index.listAccountTitans().filter((titan) => !forbiddenTitans.has(finiteId(titan.id))).map((titan) => ({
					unit: titan,
					score: this.scoreTitanAlone(titan, enemyUnits)
				})), this.config.titanPoolSize, (item) => item.score);
				return topK(this.buildShells(pool, (units) => this.counterPicker.scoreTitanTeam(units, enemyUnits)).map((shell) => {
					const titans = shell.units.map((titan) => finiteId(titan.id));
					const totems = this.totemResolver.resolve(titans);
					return {
						type: "titan",
						titans,
						totems,
						approxScore: shell.score + this.totemResolver.score(totems),
						teamPower: sumUnitPower(shell.units),
						progressionScore: shell.units.reduce((total, unit) => total + resolveUnitProgression(unit).score, 0)
					};
				}), this.config.maxTeamCandidates, (candidate) => candidate.approxScore);
			}
			scoreHeroAlone(hero, enemy, enemyKnowledge) {
				const profile = this.skillAnalyzer.analyzeUnit(hero);
				const progression = resolveUnitProgression(hero);
				if (this.mode.objective === "max_damage") {
					const powerBonus = progression.power / 100;
					let score = progression.score + powerBonus + profile.profile.damage * 2 + profile.profile.physicalDamage * .75 + profile.profile.magicDamage * .75 + profile.profile.pureDamage * 1.35 + profile.profile.burst * .7 + profile.profile.teamBuff * 1.6 + profile.profile.debuff * 1.45 + profile.profile.energyGain * 1.3 + profile.profile.activeTimelineValue * 3 + profile.profile.heal * .5 + profile.profile.shield * .35 + profile.profile.revive * 1.25;
					const metaBonus = BOSS_META_HERO_BONUSES.get(finiteId(hero.id));
					if (metaBonus) score += metaBonus;
					return score;
				}
				const tacticalWeight = .12 + enemyKnowledge * .88;
				let tacticalScore = profile.profile.damage * 1.4 + profile.profile.burst * 1.2 + profile.profile.control * 1.7 + profile.profile.heal * .9 + profile.profile.shield * .8 + profile.profile.revive * 1.5;
				if (enemy.heal > 25 && profile.isControl) tacticalScore += 20;
				if (enemy.burst > 35 && (profile.isTank || profile.isSupport || profile.isHealer)) tacticalScore += 25;
				if (enemy.magicDamage > enemy.physicalDamage && profile.magicResist > 2e4) tacticalScore += 10;
				if (enemy.physicalDamage >= enemy.magicDamage && profile.armor > 2e4) tacticalScore += 10;
				return progression.score + tacticalScore * tacticalWeight;
			}
			scoreHeroTeamAcrossScenarios(teamUnits, enemyUnits, scenarios) {
				if (scenarios.length === 0) return this.enemySupportScenarioPlanner.aggregateScores([]);
				const ally = this.counterPicker.summarize(teamUnits);
				const scores = scenarios.map((scenario) => this.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? this.counterPicker.scoreBossDamageTeam(teamUnits, enemyUnits, scenario.summary, ally) : this.counterPicker.scoreHeroTeam(teamUnits, scenario.summary));
				return this.enemySupportScenarioPlanner.aggregateScores(scores);
			}
			scoreTitanAlone(titan, enemyUnits) {
				return resolveUnitProgression(titan).score + this.titanAnalyzer.scoreTeamVsEnemy([titan], enemyUnits) * .4;
			}
			resolveEnemyKnowledge(enemyUnits) {
				if (enemyUnits.length === 0) return 0;
				const signal = enemyUnits.reduce((total, unit) => {
					if (finiteNumber$2(unit.power) > 0) return total + 1;
					if (finiteNumber$2(unit.hp) > 0 || finiteNumber$2(unit.level) > 0 || finiteNumber$2(unit.armor) > 0 || finiteNumber$2(unit.magicResist) > 0 || Object.keys(asRecord$2(unit.skills)).length > 0) return total + .55;
					return total + .08;
				}, 0);
				return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, signal / enemyUnits.length));
			}
			buildShells(pool, synergyScore) {
				let beams = [{
					units: [],
					lastPoolIndex: -1,
					baseScore: 0,
					score: 0
				}];
				const completed = [];
				for (let size = 1; size <= this.mode.maxUnits; size += 1) {
					const next = [];
					for (const beam of beams) for (let poolIndex = beam.lastPoolIndex + 1; poolIndex < pool.length; poolIndex += 1) {
						const units = [...beam.units, pool[poolIndex].unit];
						const baseScore = beam.baseScore + pool[poolIndex].score;
						next.push({
							units,
							lastPoolIndex: poolIndex,
							baseScore,
							score: baseScore + synergyScore(units)
						});
					}
					beams = topK(next, this.config.teamBeamWidth, (shell) => shell.score);
					if (size >= this.mode.minUnits) completed.push(...beams);
					if (beams.length === 0) break;
				}
				return topK(completed, this.config.teamBeamWidth, (shell) => shell.score);
			}
			bannerContext(enemy) {
				return {
					physicalWeight: enemy.magicResist > enemy.armor ? 1.25 : 1,
					magicWeight: enemy.armor > enemy.magicResist ? 1.25 : 1,
					armorWeight: enemy.physicalDamage > enemy.magicDamage ? 1.25 : .8,
					magicResistWeight: enemy.magicDamage >= enemy.physicalDamage ? 1.25 : .8
				};
			}
			candidateKey(candidate) {
				const cached = this.candidateKeyCache.get(candidate);
				if (cached) return cached;
				const favor = Object.entries(candidate.favor).sort(([left], [right]) => finiteNumber$2(left) - finiteNumber$2(right));
				const key = `${stableSortedIds(candidate.heroes).join(",")}|${candidate.teamPet}|${favor.map(([heroId, petId]) => `${heroId}:${petId}`).join(",")}|${candidate.banner}`;
				this.candidateKeyCache.set(candidate, key);
				return key;
			}
			selectHeroCandidates(candidates, limit) {
				return selectHeroLineups(candidates, limit);
			}
			preferredHeroTeams() {
				const arenaState = asRecord$2(this.index.account.arenaState);
				const source = this.mode.isGrandArena ? arenaState.grandHeroes : this.mode.ident === "hero_arena_auto" ? arenaState.arenaHeroes : null;
				if (!source) return [];

			}
			toUnitArray(value) {
				return objectValues(value).filter((unit) => this.looksLikeUnit(unit) && unit.type !== "pet" && Number.isFinite(finiteNumber$2(unit.id, NaN)));
			}
			looksLikeUnit(value) {
				const unit = asRecord$2(value);
				return unit.id != null && typeof unit.type === "string";
			}
		};

	/** Есть ли у записи бойца готовые боевые характеристики. */
	function hasRawBattleStats(unit) {
		const record = asRecord$2(unit);
		const hasHealth = finiteNumber$2(record.hp) > 0;
		const hasAttack = finiteNumber$2(record.physicalAttack) > 0 || finiteNumber$2(record.magicPower) > 0;
		return hasHealth && hasAttack;
	}
	/** Возвращает только те характеристики, которые в записи бойца уже есть. */
	function pickBattleStats(unit) {
		const record = asRecord$2(unit);
		const stats = {};
		for (const key of BATTLE_STAT_KEYS) {
			const value = record[key];
			if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) stats[key] = value;
		}
		return stats;
	}
	function collectTitanEffectStats(root, descriptor, level) {
		const stats = {};
		for (const effectId of objectValues(descriptor.battleEffect)) {
			const effect = asRecord$2(recordValue(root.battleEffect, finiteId(effectId)));
			const stat = String(effect.effect ?? "").trim();
			if (!stat) continue;
			const value = Array.isArray(effect.levels) ? effect.levels[level] : recordValue(effect.levels, level);
			stats[stat] = finiteNumber$2(stats[stat]) + finiteNumber$2(value);
		}
		return stats;
	}
	function resolveRuneLevel(levels, enchantPoints) {
		if (levels.length === 0 || enchantPoints <= 0) return 0;
		for (let index = 0; index < levels.length; index += 1) if (finiteNumber$2(levels[index].enchantValue) > enchantPoints) return Math.max(0, index - 1);
		return levels.length - 1;
	}
	function addStats(target, source, factor = 1) {
		if (factor === 0) return;
		for (const [key, value] of objectEntries(source)) {
			if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
			target[key] = finiteNumber$2(target[key]) + value * factor;
		}
	}
	function roundStats(stats) {
		for (const key of Object.keys(stats)) stats[key] = Math.round(stats[key] * 100) / 100;
	}
	function stableJson(value) {
		if (value === null || value === void 0) return "";
		if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => stableJson(item)).join(",");
		if (typeof value === "object") return Object.entries(value).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right)).map(([key, item]) => key + ":" + stableJson(item)).join(";");
		return String(value);
	}

			prepare(unit) {

	/**
	* `team_getMaxUpgrade` намеренно выдаёт вершину события. Для уже купленного
	* ростера накладываем ступень из `invasion.unitUpgrades`, иначе один фрагмент
	* превратится в фальшивого бойца 130 уровня.
	*/
	function projectBattleLabInvasionUnitUpgrade(unit, library, fragments) {
		if (finiteNumber$1(fragments) >= 7) return unit;
		const reward = resolveBattleLabInvasionUpgradeReward(library, unit.type, fragments);
		if (!reward) return unit;
		const projected = { ...unit };
		assignNumber(projected, reward, "level");
		assignNumber(projected, reward, "star");
		assignNumber(projected, reward, "color");
		assignNumber(projected, reward, "titanGiftLevel");
		if (Array.isArray(reward.artifact)) projected.artifacts = reward.artifact;
		if (Array.isArray(reward.runeLevels)) projected.runes = reward.runeLevels;
		projectSkillLevels(projected, asRecord$1(reward.skills), library, unit);
		projectSkinLevels(projected, finiteNumber$1(reward.skinLevel));
		for (const key of [...BATTLE_STAT_KEYS, "power"]) delete projected[key];
		return projected;
	}
	function resolveBattleLabInvasionUpgradeReward(library, unitType, fragments) {
		const amount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(fragments)));
		const upgrade = Object.values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.invasion).unitUpgrades)).map(asRecord$1).filter((item) => String(item.type) === unitType).filter((item) => finiteNumber$1(item.fragmentCount) <= amount).sort((left, right) => finiteNumber$1(right.fragmentCount) - finiteNumber$1(left.fragmentCount))[0];
		if (!upgrade) return null;
		const direct = asRecord$1(upgrade.upgradeReward);
		const bundleId = positiveInteger(direct.bundleHeroReward);
		if (!bundleId) return Object.keys(direct).length ? direct : null;
		const reward = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.bundleHeroReward)[bundleId]).reward);
		return Object.keys(reward).length ? reward : null;
	}
	function assignNumber(target, source, key) {
		const value = finiteNumber$1(source[key], NaN);
		if (Number.isFinite(value)) target[key] = value;
	}
	function projectSkillLevels(target, reward, library, unit) {
		const current = asRecord$1(target.skills);
		const levels = Object.values(reward).map((value) => finiteNumber$1(value));
		if (Object.keys(current).length === 0 || levels.length === 0) return;
		const ids = resolveUnitSkillIds(library, unit, current);
		target.skills = {
			...current,
			...Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id, index) => [id, levels[index] ?? current[id]]))
		};
	}
	function resolveUnitSkillIds(library, unit, current) {
		const source = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library[unit.type === "titan" ? "titan" : "hero"])[unit.id]);
		const configured = Object.values(asRecord$1(source.skill)).map(positiveInteger).filter((id) => id !== null).map(String).filter((id) => Object.hasOwn(current, id));
		if (configured.length > 0) return configured;
		return Object.keys(current).sort((left, right) => Number(left) - Number(right));
	}
	function projectSkinLevels(target, level) {
		if (level <= 0) return;
		const skins = asRecord$1(target.skins);
		if (Object.keys(skins).length === 0) return;
		target.skins = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(skins).map((id) => [id, level]));
	}

		]);

	}

	function resolveAsgardAttackEffects(context, gameLibrary) {
		const root = asRecord$1(context.__battleLabRoot);

	}
	function explicitAttackEffectSources(context, root) {

		];
	}
	function normalizeAsgardBuffCollection(value) {
		if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap((entry, index) => normalizeBuffEntry(entry, String(index)));
		const record = asRecord$1(value);

	}
	function normalizeBuffEntry(value, fallbackId) {

		return buffValue === void 0 ? [] : [{
			id,
			value: buffValue
		}];
	}

	/**
	* Строки, которые видит игрок: ручные ячейки плюс пачки последнего результата.
	* Остановленный подбор не пишет промежуточный план в сетап, но тренировать и
	* атаковать показанные пачки всё равно можно.
	*/
	function projectPlanningSetupResult(setup, result) {
		const normalized = normalizePlanningSetup(setup);
		return result?.teams.length ? fillPlanningSetupSlots(normalized, result.teams) : normalized;
	}
	/** Сохраняет показанный план остановленного подбора Асгарда в строки редактора. */
	function keepStoppedAsgardPlan(setups, key, result) {
		if (result?.modeId !== "asgard" || !result.teams.length) return { ...setups };
		return {
			...setups,
			[key]: projectPlanningSetupResult(setups?.[key], result)
		};
	}
	/** Записывает найденные свободные места, сохраняя порядок и ручные назначения ячеек. */
	function fillPlanningSetupSlots(setup, results) {
		const next = normalizePlanningSetup(setup);
		const assigned = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const result of results) {
			let row = next.teams.findIndex((fixed, index) => !assigned.has(index) && fixed.every((id) => result.unitIds.includes(id)) && (fixed.length < 5 || fixed.length === result.unitIds.length));
			if (row === -1) {
				if (next.teams.length >= Math.min(5, results.length)) continue;
				row = next.teams.length;
				next.teams.push([]);
				next.teamPetSelections.push("auto");
				next.bannerSelections.push("auto");
				next.favorSelections.push({});
			}
			assigned.add(row);
			const fixed = next.teams[row];
			next.teams[row] = [...fixed, ...result.unitIds.filter((id) => !fixed.includes(id))];
			if (typeof next.teamPetSelections[row] !== "number") next.teamPetSelections[row] = result.teamPetId ?? "auto";
			const favor = next.favorSelections[row] ?? {};
			next.favorSelections[row] = {
				...result.favor,
				...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(favor).filter(([, pet]) => typeof pet === "number"))
			};
		}
		return next;
	}
	function normalizePlanningSetup(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const teams = Array.isArray(source.teams) ? Array.from(source.teams.slice(0, 5)).map((team) => Array.isArray(team) ? [...new Set(team.map(Number).filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0))].slice(0, 5) : []) : [];
		return {
			asgardTestBossId: positivePlanningId(source.asgardTestBossId),
			asgardTestLevel: positivePlanningId(source.asgardTestLevel),
			archdemonTalisman: source.archdemonTalisman === "current" ? "current" : typeof source.archdemonTalisman === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(source.archdemonTalisman) && source.archdemonTalisman >= 0 ? source.archdemonTalisman : "auto",
			teams,
			teamPetSelections: normalizeSupportSelections(source.teamPetSelections, teams.length),
			bannerSelections: normalizeSupportSelections(source.bannerSelections, teams.length),
			favorSelections: teams.map((team, index) => {
				const selections = asRecord$1(Array.isArray(source.favorSelections) ? source.favorSelections[index] : void 0);
				return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(selections).filter(([heroId]) => team.includes(Number(heroId))).map(([heroId, selection]) => [heroId, selection === null ? null : positivePlanningId(selection) ?? "auto"]));
			}),
			asgardBuffMode: source.asgardBuffMode === "manual" || source.asgardBuffMode === "auto" ? source.asgardBuffMode : "current",
			asgardBuffCounts: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(source.asgardBuffCounts)).map(([id, count]) => [id, Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(count)))])),
			coinBudget: Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(source.coinBudget))),
			goldBudget: Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(source.goldBudget)))
		};
	}
	/** Возвращает ограничения поддержки, выровненные по индексам ручных пачек. */
	function planningFixedTeamSupports(setup, options = {}) {
		return setup.teams.map((_, index) => ({
			teamPet: setup.teamPetSelections?.[index] === void 0 || setup.teamPetSelections?.[index] === null || setup.teamPetSelections?.[index] === "auto" ? "auto" : setup.teamPetSelections[index],
			banner: setup.bannerSelections?.[index] === void 0 || options.fillEmptySlots && setup.bannerSelections?.[index] === null ? "auto" : setup.bannerSelections[index],
			...setup.favorSelections?.[index] && Object.keys(setup.favorSelections[index]).length > 0 ? { favor: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(setup.favorSelections[index]).map(([hero, pet]) => [hero, options.fillEmptySlots && pet === null ? "auto" : pet])) } : {},

	/**
	* Проверяет только полноту ручного плана для запуска локальной тренировки.
	* Доступность конкретных бойцов и поддержки повторно проверяет движок по аккаунту.
	*/
	function isPlanningSetupTrainable(setup, opponent, asgardTeamLimit) {
		if (setup.teams.length === 0) return false;
		const expectedTeamCount = opponent.modeId === "grand-arena" ? 3 : opponent.modeId === "asgard-minions" ? opponent.teams.length : opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? null : 1;
		if (expectedTeamCount !== null && setup.teams.length !== expectedTeamCount) return false;
		if (opponent.modeId === "asgard" && (setup.teams.length > Math.max(1, Math.floor(asgardTeamLimit)) || setup.teams.some((team) => team.length !== 5))) return false;
		if (setup.teams.some((team) => team.length < 1 || team.length > 5)) return false;
		const selected = setup.teams.flat();
		return new Set(selected).size === selected.length;
	}
	function positivePlanningId(value) {
		const id = Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(value, NaN));
		return Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
	}
	function normalizeSupportSelections(value, teamCount) {
		const source = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
		return Array.from({ length: teamCount }, (_, index) => {
			const selection = source[index];
			if (selection === null) return null;
			const id = Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(selection, NaN));
			return Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : "auto";
		});
	}

	function validateFixedTeams(teams, available, expectedCount) {
		if (!teams.length) return;
		if (expectedCount !== void 0 && teams.length !== expectedCount) throw new Error(`Нужно задать составы всех ${expectedCount} команд.`);
		const allowed = new Set(available);
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const team of teams) {
			if (!team.length || team.length > 5) throw new Error("В ручной пачке должно быть от 1 до 5 бойцов.");
			for (const id of team) {
				if (!allowed.has(id)) throw new Error(`Боец #${id} недоступен для этого нападения.`);
				if (used.has(id)) throw new Error(`Боец #${id} указан в нескольких командах.`);
				used.add(id);
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	* Влияние каждого слота плана на каждую пачку по парным расчётам «план» и
	* «план без одного уровня слота» на одинаковых seed.
	*/
	function analyzeAsgardBuffEffects(teams, planCounts, withPlan, withoutSlot) {
		return teams.map((unitIds, index) => {
			const base = withPlan[index] ?? 0;
			const helps = [];
			const hurts = [];
			for (const slotId of Object.keys(planCounts)) {
				const without = withoutSlot[slotId]?.[index];
				if (without === void 0 || !Number.isFinite(without)) continue;
				const delta = base - without;
				if (Math.abs(delta) <= Math.abs(base) * BUFF_EFFECT_THRESHOLD) continue;
				(delta > 0 ? helps : hurts).push(slotId);
			}
			return {
				unitIds: [...unitIds],
				helps,
				hurts
			};
		});
	}
	/**
	* Баффы недели не снимаются, но покупать их можно между атаками. Пачки,
	* которым слот мешает, бьют до его покупки; остальное покупается сразу.
	* Сначала идут пачки, которым мешает больше всего слотов.
	*/
	function planAsgardBuffSchedule(planCounts, effects) {
		const pending = new Map(Object.entries(planCounts).filter(([, count]) => count > 0));
		const hurtBy = (slotId) => effects.filter((effect) => effect.hurts.includes(slotId));
		const steps = [];
		const attacked = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const buyReady = () => {
			const counts = {};
			for (const [slotId, count] of pending) if (hurtBy(slotId).every((effect) => attacked.has(effect))) counts[slotId] = count;
			for (const slotId of Object.keys(counts)) pending.delete(slotId);
			if (Object.keys(counts).length) steps.push({
				kind: "buy",
				counts
			});
		};
		buyReady();
		const order = [...effects].sort((a, b) => b.hurts.length - a.hurts.length);
		let batch = [];
		for (const effect of order) {
			if (!effect.hurts.some((slotId) => pending.has(slotId)) && pending.size) continue;
			batch.push(effect.unitIds);
			attacked.add(effect);
			const before = pending.size;
			buyReady();
			if (pending.size !== before) {
				steps.splice(steps.length - 1, 0, {
					kind: "attack",
					teams: batch
				});
				batch = [];
			}
		}
		if (batch.length) steps.push({
			kind: "attack",
			teams: batch
		});
		buyReady();
		const rest = effects.filter((effect) => !attacked.has(effect)).map((effect) => effect.unitIds);
		if (rest.length) steps.push({
			kind: "attack",
			teams: rest
		});
		return steps;
	}
	/** Лимит рекомендаций не превышает подтверждённый остаток очков магазина. */
	function readAsgardBuffCoinBudget(opponent, requested) {
		const balance = Number(asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot).coins);
		if (!Number.isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) {
			if (requested > 0) throw new Error("Неизвестен остаток очков Асгарда. Обнови противника.");
			return 0;
		}
		return Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(requested)), Math.floor(balance));
	}
