	function priceAsgardBuffPlan(catalog, counts) {
		const selected = {};
		let coins = 0;
		let gold = 0;
		for (const [slotId, count] of Object.entries(counts)) {
			if (!count) continue;
			const buff = catalog.find((item) => item.slotId === slotId);
			if (!buff || !Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > buff.remaining) throw new Error("Магазин Асгарда изменился: обнови выбранные усиления.");
			selected[slotId] = count;
			coins += buff.coinCost * count;
			gold += buff.goldCost * count;
		}
		return {
			counts: selected,
			coins,
			gold,
			tested: 0
		};
	}
	function withAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, library, catalog, counts) {
		const plan = priceAsgardBuffPlan(catalog, counts);
		const baseEffects = opponent.context.__battleLabBaseAsgardEffects ? asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabBaseAsgardEffects) : resolveAsgardAttackEffects({
			...opponent.context,
			__battleLabPlannedAsgardEffects: void 0
		}, library);
		const effects = { ...baseEffects };
		for (const buff of catalog) {
			const count = plan.counts[buff.slotId] ?? 0;
			if (count) effects[buff.effect] = finiteNumber$1(effects[buff.effect]) + buff.value * count;
		}
		return {
			...opponent,
			context: {
				...opponent.context,
				__battleLabBaseAsgardEffects: { ...baseEffects },
				__battleLabPlannedAsgardEffects: effects
			}
		};
	}
	async function searchAsgardBuffPlans(options) {
		assertAsgardBuffSearchBudget(options);
		const limit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.maxTrials));
		const plans = enumerateAsgardBuffPlans(options.catalog, options.coinBudget, options.goldBudget, limit + 1);
		const exhaustive = plans.length <= limit;
		if (!exhaustive && !options.bounded) throw new Error(`Для точного подбора усилений нужно проверить ${plans.length} наборов, а бюджет допускает ${limit}. Увеличь бюджет расчётов.`);
		let best;
		let tested = 0;
		const queue = exhaustive ? plans : [priceAsgardBuffPlan(options.catalog, {})];
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const key = (plan) => JSON.stringify(Object.entries(plan.counts).sort());
		const enqueue = (counts) => {
			if (queue.length >= limit * 4) return;
			const plan = priceAsgardBuffPlan(options.catalog, counts);
			if (plan.coins > options.coinBudget || plan.gold > options.goldBudget || seen.has(key(plan))) return;
			seen.add(key(plan));
			queue.push(plan);
		};
		if (!exhaustive) {
			seen.add(key(queue[0]));
			for (const counts of seedAsgardBuffCounts(options)) enqueue(counts);
		}
		for (let index = 0; index < queue.length && tested < limit; index++) {
			const plan = queue[index];
			if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new Error("Подбор усилений остановлен.");
			const result = await options.evaluate(plan);
			if (!Number.isFinite(result.score)) throw new Error("Не удалось рассчитать урон с усилениями.");
			const entry = {
				plan,
				...result
			};
			const improved = !best || entry.score > best.score || entry.score === best.score && entry.plan.coins + entry.plan.gold < best.plan.coins + best.plan.gold;
			if (improved) best = entry;
			tested++;
			if (!exhaustive && improved) for (const counts of neighbourAsgardBuffCounts(options.catalog, plan.counts)) {
				if (queue.length >= limit * 4) break;
				enqueue(counts);
			}
			options.onProgress?.(tested, exhaustive ? plans.length : limit);
		}
		if (!best) throw new Error("Нет рассчитанного набора усилений.");
		return {
			plan: {
				...best.plan,
				tested,
				exhaustive
			},
			value: best.value
		};
	}
	function assertAsgardBuffSearchBudget(options) {
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.maxTrials) || options.maxTrials < 1 || !Number.isFinite(options.coinBudget) || options.coinBudget < 0 || !Number.isFinite(options.goldBudget) || options.goldBudget < 0) throw new Error("Укажи конечный неотрицательный бюджет и положительное целое число проверок усилений.");
	}
	/** Стартовые точки локального поиска: одна покупка и максимум по бюджету. */
	function seedAsgardBuffCounts(options) {
		const seeds = [];
		for (const buff of options.catalog) {
			if (buff.remaining < 1) continue;
			seeds.push({ [buff.slotId]: 1 });
			const count = Math.min(buff.remaining, buff.coinCost ? Math.floor(options.coinBudget / buff.coinCost) : buff.remaining, buff.goldCost ? Math.floor(options.goldBudget / buff.goldCost) : buff.remaining);
			if (count > 1) seeds.push({ [buff.slotId]: count });
		}
		return seeds;
	}
	/** Соседи набора: докупка одного усиления или обмен уровня одного на другое. */
	function neighbourAsgardBuffCounts(catalog, counts) {
		const neighbours = [];
		for (const buff of catalog) {
			const count = counts[buff.slotId] ?? 0;
			if (count >= buff.remaining) continue;
			neighbours.push({
				...counts,
				[buff.slotId]: count + 1
			});
			for (const [slot, selected] of Object.entries(counts)) if (selected > 0 && slot !== buff.slotId) neighbours.push({
				...counts,
				[slot]: selected - 1,
				[buff.slotId]: count + 1
			});
		}
		return neighbours;
	}
	function enumerateAsgardBuffPlans(catalog, coinBudget, goldBudget, limit) {
		const plans = [];
		const counts = {};
		const visit = (index, coins, gold) => {
			if (plans.length >= limit) return;
			if (index === catalog.length) {
				plans.push({
					counts: { ...counts },
					coins,
					gold,
					tested: 0
				});
				return;
			}
			const buff = catalog[index];
			for (let count = 0; count <= buff.remaining; count++) {
				if (plans.length >= limit) break;
				const nextCoins = coins + buff.coinCost * count;
				const nextGold = gold + buff.goldCost * count;
				if (nextCoins > coinBudget || nextGold > goldBudget) break;
				if (count) counts[buff.slotId] = count;
				else delete counts[buff.slotId];
				visit(index + 1, nextCoins, nextGold);
			}
			delete counts[buff.slotId];
		};
		visit(0, 0, 0);
		return plans;
	}

	function _unwrapValue(value) {
		let currentValue = value;
		for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
			if (!currentValue || typeof currentValue !== "object" || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(currentValue, "value")) break;
			currentValue = currentValue.value;
		}
		return currentValue;
	}
	function _migrate(rawValue) {
		let currentVersion = Number(rawValue?.schemaVersion) || 1;
		let currentValue = _assertClassBrand(_VersionedStorage_brand, this, _unwrapValue).call(this, rawValue);
		while (currentVersion < this.schemaVersion) {
			const migration = this.migrations[currentVersion];
			if (typeof migration !== "function") break;
			currentValue = _assertClassBrand(_VersionedStorage_brand, this, _unwrapValue).call(this, migration(currentValue));
			currentVersion += 1;
		}
		return _assertClassBrand(_VersionedStorage_brand, this, _unwrapValue).call(this, currentValue);
	}
	var _VersionedStorage_brand, VersionedStorage;
	var init_versioned_storage = __esmMin((() => {
		init_browser_storage();
		init_classPrivateMethodInitSpec();
		init_defineProperty();
		init_assertClassBrand();
		_VersionedStorage_brand = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakSet();
		VersionedStorage = class {
			constructor({ keyPrefix, schemaVersion, migrations = {}, storage = getBrowserLocalStorage(), warn = warnBrowserStorageError }) {
				_classPrivateMethodInitSpec(this, _VersionedStorage_brand);
				_defineProperty(this, "keyPrefix", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "schemaVersion", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "migrations", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "storage", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "warn", void 0);
				this.keyPrefix = keyPrefix;
				this.schemaVersion = schemaVersion;
				this.migrations = migrations;
				this.storage = storage;
				this.warn = warn;
			}
			key(userId) {
				return `${this.keyPrefix}${userId}`;
			}
			read(userId, fallbackValue) {
				let rawValue;
				try {
					rawValue = this.storage?.getItem(this.key(userId)) ?? null;
				} catch (error) {
					this.warn("[hwh] versioned storage read failed", error);
					return fallbackValue;
				}
				if (!rawValue) return fallbackValue;
				let parsedValue;
				try {
					parsedValue = JSON.parse(rawValue);
				} catch {
					return fallbackValue;
				}
				return _assertClassBrand(_VersionedStorage_brand, this, _migrate).call(this, parsedValue);
			}
			write(userId, value) {
				const envelope = {
					schemaVersion: this.schemaVersion,
					value
				};
				try {
					this.storage?.setItem(this.key(userId), JSON.stringify(envelope));
				} catch (error) {
					this.warn("[hwh] versioned storage write failed", error);
				}
			}
			remove(userId) {
				try {
					this.storage?.removeItem(this.key(userId));
				} catch (error) {
					this.warn("[hwh] versioned storage remove failed", error);
				}
			}
		};

	/**
	* Территория присылает карту кусками: движение содержит позицию и видимые
	* клетки, а защита приходит отдельным push-сообщением. Склеиваем только
	* фактические данные одного события, не додумывая закрытые клетки и команды.

	function buildBattleLabTerritorySnapshot(captures) {
		const messages = captures.flatMap((capture) => capture.calls.map((call, index) => ({
			name: call.name,
			args: call.args ?? {},
			body: extractPushBody(extractCallResponse(capture.response, index)),

		const relevant = eventId ? messages.filter((message) => {
			const messageEventId = String(asRecord$1(message.body).eventId ?? "");
			return !messageEventId || messageEventId === eventId;
		}) : messages;
		const ownerId = resolveKnownOwnerId(relevant) ?? resolveOwnerId(relevant);
		const state = {
			eventId,
			mapVersion: null,
			userId: ownerId,
			guildId: null,
			position: null,
			actionPoints: null,
			visiblePositions: [],
			userPositions: {},
			towns: {},
			users: {},
			enemyTeams: {},
			defense: null,
			defenseState: null,
			healed: null
		};
		for (const message of relevant) {
			const body = asRecord$1(message.body);
			const users = asRecord$1(body.users ?? body.players ?? body.members);
			if (Object.keys(users).length) state.users = {
				...state.users,

			};
			const guildId = readGuildId$1(body);
			if (guildId) state.guildId = guildId;
			if (!state.guildId && message.ownerGuildId) state.guildId = message.ownerGuildId;
			const version = finiteNumber$1(body.mapVersion, NaN);
			if (Number.isFinite(version)) state.mapVersion = version;
			const actionPoints = readActionPoints(body, asRecord$1(body.refillable));
			if (actionPoints !== null) state.actionPoints = actionPoints;
			const visible = readVisiblePositions(body);
			if (visible !== null && (visible.length > 0 || Number.isFinite(finiteNumber$1(body.mapVersion, NaN)))) state.visiblePositions = visible;
			const positions = readUserPositions(body);
			if (Object.keys(positions).length) state.userPositions = {
				...state.userPositions,
				...positions
			};
			const position = readCurrentPosition(body, ownerId, state.userPositions);
			if (position !== null) state.position = position;
			if (Object.hasOwn(body, "townPositions")) {

				state.towns = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(towns).map(([id, town]) => [id, structuredClone(asRecord$1(town))]));
			}
			if (message.name === "clanDomination_getEnemyTeams") {
				const enemyPosition = finiteNumber$1(message.args.levelId, NaN);
				if (Number.isInteger(enemyPosition)) state.enemyTeams[String(enemyPosition)] = structuredClone(body);
			}
			const defense = asRecord$1(body.defense ?? body.defence);
			const defenseState = asRecord$1(body.defenseState ?? body.defenceState);
			if (Object.keys(defense).length && (message.name === "clanDomination_getInfo" || String(body.userId ?? "") === ownerId)) {

				state.defenseState = structuredClone(defenseState);
				state.healed = typeof body.healed === "boolean" ? body.healed : null;
			}

		state.position = readCurrentPosition({}, ownerId, state.userPositions) ?? state.position;

	}
	function resolveKnownOwnerId(messages) {
		for (const message of [...messages].reverse()) {
			const ownerId = String(message.ownerId ?? "").trim();
			if (ownerId) return ownerId;
		}
		return null;
	}
	function readActionPoints(body, refillable) {
		for (const value of [
			refillable.amount,
			body.actionPoints,
			body.actionsLeft,
			body.moves,
			body.tries

	function extractPushBody(value) {

	function trimTerritoryCapture(value, depth = 0) {
		if (typeof value === "string") return value.length <= MAX_CAPTURE_TEXT_LENGTH ? value : `${value.slice(0, MAX_CAPTURE_TEXT_LENGTH)}…`;
		if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return value;

		if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice(0, MAX_CAPTURE_ITEMS).map((item) => trimTerritoryCapture(item, depth + 1));
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).slice(0, MAX_CAPTURE_ITEMS).map(([key, item]) => [key, trimTerritoryCapture(item, depth + 1)]));
	}

	function processBattleResponse(calls, response) {
		saveBattleLabTerritoryCapture(calls, response);
		const responseByIdent = getResponsesByIdent(response);
		calls.forEach((call, index) => {
			const callEnvelope = responseByIdent.get(call.ident) ?? responseByIdent.get(String(index)) ?? response;
			const envelope = {
				error: asRecord$1(response).error,
				response: callEnvelope
			};
			const { payload: callResponse, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(envelope);
			cacheOpponentMetadata(call, callResponse);
			const declaredMode = START_CALL_MODES[call.name] ?? END_CALL_MODES[call.name];
			const archdemonStart = pendingByMode.get("archdemon")?.enemyContext.__battleLabStartArgs;
			const endsArchdemon = Boolean(END_CALL_MODES[call.name] && archdemonStart && String(asRecord$1(archdemonStart).id) === String(call.args.id));
			const modeId = declaredMode === "tournament-of-elements" ? resolveObservedTitanArenaMode(call, callResponse) : declaredMode === "invasion" && (findBattleRecords(callResponse).some(isArchdemonBattle) || endsArchdemon) ? "archdemon" : declaredMode;
			if (!modeId) return;
			if (error) {
				emitObservedBattle(modeId, pendingByMode.get(modeId) ?? buildPendingBattle(call.args, callResponse, modeId), call.args, envelope);
				pendingByMode.delete(modeId);
				return;
			}
			if (START_CALL_MODES[call.name]) {
				const pending = buildPendingBattle(call.args, callResponse, modeId);
				pendingByMode.set(modeId, pending);
				if (IMMEDIATE_CALLS.has(call.name)) {
					emitObservedBattle(modeId, pending, call.args, callResponse);
					pendingByMode.delete(modeId);
				}
				return;
			}
			emitObservedBattle(modeId, pendingByMode.get(modeId) ?? buildPendingBattle(call.args, callResponse, modeId), call.args, callResponse);
			pendingByMode.delete(modeId);
		});
	}

	function collectBattleLogMetrics(record) {
		const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const events = new BattleLogParser().parse(record);
		const metric = (side, unitId) => {
			const key = `${side}:${unitId}`;
			const current = result.get(key) ?? {
				damageDealt: 0,
				damageTaken: 0,
				healing: 0
			};
			result.set(key, current);
			return current;
		};
		for (const event of events) {
			const source = finiteNumber$1(event.source, NaN);
			const target = finiteNumber$1(event.target, NaN);
			const sourceSide = source < 0 ? "defenders" : "attackers";
			const targetSide = target < 0 ? "defenders" : "attackers";
			if (event.isDamage) {
				if (Number.isFinite(source) && source !== 0) metric(sourceSide, Math.abs(source)).damageDealt += event.damage;
				if (Number.isFinite(target) && target !== 0) metric(targetSide, Math.abs(target)).damageTaken += event.damage;
			}
			if (event.isHeal && Number.isFinite(source) && source !== 0) metric(sourceSide, Math.abs(source)).healing += event.heal;
		}
		return result;
	}
	function mergeBattleDetails(primary, secondary) {
		if (!primary) return secondary;
		if (!secondary) return primary;
		const keyed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const unit of [...primary.units, ...secondary.units]) {
			const key = `${unit.side}:${unit.teamIndex}:${unit.unitId}`;
			const previous = keyed.get(key);
			keyed.set(key, previous ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({
				...previous,
				...unit
			}).map(([field, current]) => [field, current ?? previous[field]])) : unit);
		}
		return {
			duration: maxNullable(primary.duration, secondary.duration),
			battleCount: Math.max(primary.battleCount, secondary.battleCount),
			units: [...keyed.values()]
		};
	}
	function nullableNumber$1(value) {
		const number = finiteNumber$1(value, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(0, number) : null;
	}
	function firstNullableNumber(...values) {
		for (const value of values) {
			const number = nullableNumber$1(value);
			if (number !== null) return number;
		}
		return null;
	}
	function maxNullable(left, right) {
		if (left === null) return right;
		if (right === null) return left;
		return Math.max(left, right);
	}
	function extractObservedEnemySnapshot(response, modeId) {
		const collectedTeams = [];
		const battleContexts = [];
		const teamResults = [];
		for (const battleRecord of findBattleRecords(response)) {
			const rawBattleData = asRecord$1(battleRecord.battleData ?? battleRecord);
			const battleData = {
				...rawBattleData,
				result: rawBattleData.result ?? battleRecord.result
			};
			const teams = normalizeObservedDefenders(battleData.defenders, modeId);
			if (teams.length === 0) continue;
			collectedTeams.push(...teams);
			battleContexts.push(battleData);
			teamResults.push(resolveSnapshotResult(battleData.result));
			if (modeId !== "grand-arena" || collectedTeams.length >= 3) break;
		}
		if (collectedTeams.length === 0) return null;
		const teams = collectedTeams.slice(0, modeId === "grand-arena" ? 3 : 1);
		const primary = battleContexts[0] ?? {};
		const defenderBanners = battleContexts.flatMap((context) => {
			const effects = asRecord$1(context.effects);
			if (!Object.hasOwn(effects, "defendersBanner")) return [];
			const banner = effects.defendersBanner;
			return Array.isArray(banner) ? banner : [banner];
		});
		return {
			teams,
			teamResults: teamResults.slice(0, teams.length),
			context: {
				...primary,
				defenders: modeId === "grand-arena" ? teams.map(toBattleUnitRecord) : toBattleUnitRecord(teams[0] ?? []),
				battle: primary,
				battles: battleContexts,
				...defenderBanners.length === 0 ? {} : modeId === "grand-arena" ? { banners: defenderBanners } : { banner: defenderBanners[0] }
			}
		};
	}
	function resolveSnapshotResult(value) {
		const candidate = asRecord$1(value).win ?? value;
		if (candidate === true || candidate === 1) return "win";
		if (candidate === false || candidate === 0) return "loss";
		return "unknown";
	}
	function findBattleRecords(value) {
		const result = [];
		const queue = [{
			value,
			depth: 0
		}];
		const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		while (queue.length > 0) {
			const current = queue.shift();
			if (!current || current.depth > 4) continue;
			const item = current.value;
			if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || visited.has(item)) continue;
			visited.add(item);
			if (Array.isArray(item)) {
				queue.push(...item.map((nested) => ({
					value: nested,
					depth: current.depth + 1
				})));
				continue;
			}
			const record = asRecord$1(item);
			const battleData = asRecord$1(record.battleData);
			if (Object.keys(battleData).length > 0 && battleData.attackers != null && battleData.defenders != null) {
				result.push(record);
				continue;

	/**

	function selectDiverseParetoCandidates(candidates, requestedLimit, maxDamage = false) {
		const limit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(requestedLimit));
		if (maxDamage) return selectMaxDamageCandidates(candidates, limit);
		if (candidates.length > 0 && candidates.every((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero")) {
			const vectors = normalizeVectors(candidates.map(toCandidateVector));
			const priorities = new Map(vectors.map((vector) => [vector.candidate, vector.objectives.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)]));
			return selectHeroLineups(candidates, limit, (candidate) => priorities.get(candidate) ?? 0);
		}
		if (candidates.length <= limit) return deduplicateCandidates(candidates);
		const fronts = buildParetoFronts(normalizeVectors(buildParetoPool(candidates, limit).map(toCandidateVector)));
		const selected = [];
		for (const front of fronts) {
			const remaining = limit - selected.length;
			if (remaining <= 0) break;
			if (front.length <= remaining) {
				selected.push(...front);
				continue;
			}
			selected.push(...chooseDiverse(front, selected, remaining));
		}
		if (selected.length < limit) {
			const selectedKeys = new Set(selected.map((item) => item.key));
			const fallback = normalizeVectors(candidates.map(toCandidateVector)).filter((item) => !selectedKeys.has(item.key));
			selected.push(...chooseDiverse(fallback, selected, limit - selected.length));
		}
		return selected.slice(0, limit).map((item) => item.candidate);
	}
	/**
	* Для бессмертных боссов «устойчивая» пачка не обязана быть пачкой с максимумом
	* урона. Часть места оставляем для равномерной выборки связок из хвоста, чтобы
	* Calc увидел нетипичный дамаговый союз, который эвристика пока не умеет ценить.
	*/
	function selectMaxDamageCandidates(candidates, limit) {
		const unique = deduplicateCandidates(candidates);
		if (unique.length <= limit) return unique;
		const explorationCount = Math.min(limit - 1, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(limit * .3)));
		const primary = selectByDamagePriority(unique, Math.max(1, limit - explorationCount));
		const selected = new Map(primary.map((candidate) => [battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate]));
		const remaining = unique.filter((candidate) => !selected.has(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate)));
		for (const candidate of sampleBattleLabCandidateExploration(remaining, explorationCount)) selected.set(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate);
		if (selected.size < limit) for (const candidate of selectByDamagePriority(remaining, limit - selected.size)) selected.set(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate);
		return [...selected.values()].slice(0, limit);
	}
	function selectByDamagePriority(candidates, limit) {
		if (candidates.every((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero")) return selectHeroLineups(candidates, limit, maxDamagePriority);
		return [...candidates].sort((left, right) => maxDamagePriority(right) - maxDamagePriority(left) || battleLabCandidateKey(left).localeCompare(battleLabCandidateKey(right))).slice(0, limit);
	}
	function maxDamagePriority(candidate) {
		const interaction = candidate.type === "hero" ? finiteNumber$1(candidate.interactionScore) : 0;
		return finiteNumber$1(candidate.approxScore) + interaction * .35;
	}
	/** Равномерный резерв составов для Calc, не зависящий от эвристической силы. */
	function sampleBattleLabCandidateExploration(candidates, limit) {
		const byLineup = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of [...candidates].sort(compareCandidateHash)) {
			const lineup = candidate.type === "hero" ? `h:${[...candidate.heroes].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}` : `t:${[...candidate.titans].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}`;
			if (!byLineup.has(lineup)) byLineup.set(lineup, candidate);
		}
		const lineups = [...byLineup.values()];
		const count = Math.min(limit, lineups.length);
		return Array.from({ length: count }, (_unused, index) => {
			const position = Math.min(lineups.length - 1, Math.floor((index + .5) * lineups.length / count));
			return lineups[position];
		});
	}
	function compareCandidateHash(left, right) {
		return stableCandidateHash(battleLabCandidateKey(left)) - stableCandidateHash(battleLabCandidateKey(right)) || battleLabCandidateKey(left).localeCompare(battleLabCandidateKey(right));
	}
	function stableCandidateHash(value) {
		let hash = 2166136261;
		for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ value.charCodeAt(index), 16777619);
		return hash >>> 0;
	}
	function buildParetoPool(candidates, limit) {
		const target = Math.min(candidates.length, MAX_PARETO_POOL, Math.max(256, limit * 2));
		const selected = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const add = (candidate) => {
			if (selected.size < target) selected.set(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate);
		};
		const quota = Math.max(16, Math.ceil(target / 8));
		for (let objective = 0; objective < OBJECTIVE_COUNT; objective += 1) [...candidates].sort((left, right) => battleLabCandidateObjectives(right)[objective] - battleLabCandidateObjectives(left)[objective]).slice(0, quota).forEach(add);
		candidates.slice(0, quota).forEach(add);
		for (let index = 0; selected.size < target && index < target; index += 1) add(candidates[Math.round(index * (candidates.length - 1) / Math.max(1, target - 1))]);
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			if (selected.size >= target) break;
			add(candidate);
		}
		return [...selected.values()];
	}
	function buildParetoFronts(vectors) {
		const dominates = vectors.map(() => []);
		const dominatedByCount = vectors.map(() => 0);
		for (let left = 0; left < vectors.length; left += 1) for (let right = left + 1; right < vectors.length; right += 1) {
			const comparison = compareDominance(vectors[left].objectives, vectors[right].objectives);
			if (comparison > 0) {
				dominates[left].push(right);
				dominatedByCount[right] += 1;
			} else if (comparison < 0) {
				dominates[right].push(left);
				dominatedByCount[left] += 1;
			}
		}
		const fronts = [];
		let current = dominatedByCount.map((count, index) => count === 0 ? index : -1).filter((index) => index >= 0);
		while (current.length > 0) {
			fronts.push(current.map((index) => vectors[index]));
			const next = [];
			for (const index of current) for (const dominated of dominates[index]) {
				dominatedByCount[dominated] -= 1;
				if (dominatedByCount[dominated] === 0) next.push(dominated);
			}
			current = next;
		}
		return fronts;
	}
	function chooseDiverse(candidates, alreadySelected, count) {
		const remaining = [...candidates];
		const result = [];
		while (remaining.length > 0 && result.length < count) {
			const references = [...alreadySelected, ...result];
			let bestIndex = 0;
			let bestUtility = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
			for (let index = 0; index < remaining.length; index += 1) {
				const candidate = remaining[index];
				const diversity = references.length === 0 ? 1 : Math.min(...references.map((reference) => jaccardDistance(candidate.tokens, reference.tokens)));
				const objectiveUtility = candidate.objectives.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / candidate.objectives.length;
				const utility = diversity * .7 + objectiveUtility * .3;
				if (utility > bestUtility || utility === bestUtility && candidate.key < remaining[bestIndex].key) {
					bestUtility = utility;
					bestIndex = index;
				}
			}
			result.push(remaining.splice(bestIndex, 1)[0]);
		}
		return result;
	}
	function compareDominance(left, right) {
		let leftBetter = false;
		let rightBetter = false;
		for (let index = 0; index < Math.max(left.length, right.length); index += 1) {
			const leftValue = left[index] ?? 0;
			const rightValue = right[index] ?? 0;
			if (leftValue > rightValue) leftBetter = true;
			if (rightValue > leftValue) rightBetter = true;
		}
		if (leftBetter === rightBetter) return 0;
		return leftBetter ? 1 : -1;
	}
	function normalizeVectors(vectors) {
		const bounds = Array.from({ length: OBJECTIVE_COUNT }, (_, objective) => {
			const values = vectors.map((vector) => vector.objectives[objective]);
			return {
				minimum: Math.min(...values),
				maximum: Math.max(...values)
			};
		});
		return vectors.map((vector) => ({
			...vector,
			objectives: vector.objectives.map((value, objective) => {
				const { minimum, maximum } = bounds[objective];
				return maximum > minimum ? (value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum) : .5;
			})
		}));
	}
	function toCandidateVector(candidate) {
		return {
			candidate,

			objectives: battleLabCandidateObjectives(candidate),
			tokens: candidateTokens(candidate)
		};
	}
	function battleLabCandidateObjectives(candidate) {
		const learning = candidate.adaptiveLearning;
		return [
			finiteNumber$1(candidate.approxScore),
			candidate.type === "hero" ? finiteNumber$1(candidate.robustnessScore) : 0,
			finiteNumber$1(candidate.progressionScore),
			finiteNumber$1(candidate.teamPower),
			learning ? finiteNumber$1(learning.probability) * Math.max(.05, finiteNumber$1(learning.confidence)) + finiteNumber$1(learning.exploration) * .1 : 0,
			candidate.type === "hero" ? finiteNumber$1(candidate.interactionScore) : 0
		];
	}
	function candidateTokens(candidate) {
		if (candidate.type === "titan") return new Set(candidate.titans.map((id) => `unit:${id}`));
		return /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
			...candidate.heroes.map((id) => `unit:${id}`),
			...candidate.teamPet > 0 ? [`pet:${candidate.teamPet}`] : [],
			...candidate.banner > 0 ? [`banner:${candidate.banner}`] : [],
			...Object.entries(candidate.favor).map(([heroId, petId]) => `favor:${heroId}:${petId}`)
		]);
	}
	function battleLabCandidateKey(candidate) {
		if (candidate.type === "titan") {
			const totems = (candidate.totems ?? []).map((totem) => totem.id).sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",");
			return `t:${[...candidate.titans].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}|${totems}`;
		}
		const favor = Object.entries(candidate.favor).sort(([left], [right]) => Number(left) - Number(right)).map(([heroId, petId]) => `${heroId}:${petId}`).join(",");
		return `h:${[...candidate.heroes].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}|${candidate.teamPet}|${candidate.banner}|${favor}`;
	}
	function deduplicateCandidates(candidates) {
		return [...new Map(candidates.map((candidate) => [battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate])).values()];
	}
	function jaccardDistance(left, right) {
		let intersection = 0;
		for (const value of left) if (right.has(value)) intersection += 1;
		const union = left.size + right.size - intersection;
		return union > 0 ? 1 - intersection / union : 0;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/engine/perfect-victory.ts
	/**
	* Отделяет идеальную наблюдаемую серию от статистически пригодного допуска к
	* реальной атаке. Например, 25/25 дают только около 87 % нижней границы.
	*/
	function isBattleLabAttackStatisticallyReliable(statistics) {
		return Boolean(statistics && statistics.attempted >= 12 && statistics.succeeded === statistics.attempted && statistics.failed === 0 && (statistics.losses ?? 0) === 0 && (statistics.unknown ?? 0) === 0 && statistics.winRate === 1 && statistics.confidenceLow !== null && statistics.confidenceLow >= .95);
	}
	function canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(evidence) {
		if (evidence.observation) return evidence.failed === 0 && evidence.observation.count > 0 && evidence.observation.wins === evidence.observation.count && evidence.observation.losses === 0 && evidence.observation.unknown === 0;
		return evidence.failed === 0 && evidence.samples.length > 0 && evidence.samples.every((sample) => sample.win === true);
	}
	function isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(evidence, scenarioIds, minimumAttempts = 12) {
		const requiredAttempts = Math.max(12, Math.floor(minimumAttempts), new Set(scenarioIds).size);
		const succeeded = evidence.observation?.count ?? evidence.samples.length;
		if (!canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(evidence) || succeeded < requiredAttempts) return false;
		if (scenarioIds.length === 0) return true;
		const coveredScenarios = evidence.observation ? new Set(Object.keys(evidence.observation.scenarios)) : new Set(evidence.samples.map((sample) => sample.scenarioId).filter((scenarioId) => Boolean(scenarioId)));
		return scenarioIds.every((scenarioId) => coveredScenarios.has(scenarioId));
	}

	function createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(samples = []) {
		const accumulator = {
			...emptyAccumulator("default", null),
			scenarios: {}
		};
		for (const sample of samples) appendBattleLabSample(accumulator, sample);
		return accumulator;
	}
	function appendBattleLabSample(accumulator, sample) {
		appendSampleValues(accumulator, sample);
		const scenarioId = sample.scenarioId ?? "default";
		const scenario = accumulator.scenarios[scenarioId] ?? (accumulator.scenarios[scenarioId] = emptyAccumulator(sample.scenarioLabel ?? scenarioId, sample.scenarioBuff ?? null));
		appendSampleValues(scenario, sample);
		if (sample.scenarioLabel) scenario.label = sample.scenarioLabel;
		if (sample.scenarioBuff !== void 0) scenario.buff = sample.scenarioBuff;
	}
	function mergeBattleLabSampleAccumulators(target, source) {
		mergeAccumulatorValues(target, source);
		for (const [scenarioId, sourceScenario] of Object.entries(source.scenarios)) {
			const targetScenario = target.scenarios[scenarioId] ?? (target.scenarios[scenarioId] = emptyAccumulator(sourceScenario.label, sourceScenario.buff));
			mergeAccumulatorValues(targetScenario, sourceScenario);
			targetScenario.label = sourceScenario.label;
			targetScenario.buff = sourceScenario.buff;
		}
	}
	function summarizeBattleLabSamples(samples, failed, binaryOutcome) {
		return summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(samples), failed, binaryOutcome);
	}
	function summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(accumulator, failed, binaryOutcome) {
		const scoreMean = accumulator.scoreCount > 0 ? accumulator.scoreMean : 0;
		const scoreDeviation = accumulatorDeviation(accumulator);
		const attempted = accumulator.count + Math.max(0, failed);
		const wins = binaryOutcome ? accumulator.wins : 0;
		const losses = binaryOutcome ? accumulator.losses : 0;
		const unknown = binaryOutcome ? accumulator.unknown : accumulator.count;
		const binarySampleCount = wins + losses;
		const interval = binarySampleCount > 0 ? wilsonInterval(wins, binarySampleCount) : null;
		const winRate = binarySampleCount > 0 ? wins / binarySampleCount : null;
		const repeatability = resolveRepeatability(scoreMean, scoreDeviation);
		const evidence = 1 - Math.exp(-accumulator.count / 8);
		const reliability = attempted > 0 ? accumulator.count / attempted : 0;
		return {
			confidence: clamp01(interval ? interval.low * reliability : repeatability * evidence * reliability),
			statistics: {
				attempted,
				succeeded: accumulator.count,
				failed: Math.max(0, failed),
				wins,
				losses,
				unknown,
				winRate,
				scoreMean,
				scoreMax: accumulator.scoreCount > 0 ? accumulator.scoreMax : 0,
				scoreDeviation,
				confidenceLow: interval?.low ?? null,
				confidenceHigh: interval?.high ?? null
			}
		};
	}
	function accumulatorDeviation(accumulator) {
		return accumulator.scoreCount < 2 ? 0 : Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, accumulator.scoreM2 / (accumulator.scoreCount - 1)));
	}
	function wilsonInterval(wins, total, z = 1.96) {
		if (total <= 0) return {
			low: 0,
			high: 1
		};
		const rate = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, wins / total));
		const zSquared = z * z;
		const denominator = 1 + zSquared / total;
		const center = (rate + zSquared / (2 * total)) / denominator;
		const margin = z / denominator * Math.sqrt((rate * (1 - rate) + zSquared / (4 * total)) / total);
		return {
			low: clamp01(center - margin),
			high: clamp01(center + margin)
		};
	}
	function emptyAccumulator(label, buff) {
		return {
			count: 0,
			scoreCount: 0,
			scoreMean: 0,
			scoreM2: 0,
			scoreMin: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
			scoreMax: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
			wins: 0,
			losses: 0,
			unknown: 0,
			label,
			buff
		};
	}
	function appendSampleValues(accumulator, sample) {
		accumulator.count += 1;
		if (sample.win === true) accumulator.wins += 1;
		else if (sample.win === false) accumulator.losses += 1;
		else accumulator.unknown += 1;
		if (!Number.isFinite(sample.score)) return;
		accumulator.scoreCount += 1;
		const delta = sample.score - accumulator.scoreMean;
		accumulator.scoreMean += delta / accumulator.scoreCount;
		accumulator.scoreM2 += delta * (sample.score - accumulator.scoreMean);
		accumulator.scoreMin = Math.min(accumulator.scoreMin, sample.score);
		accumulator.scoreMax = Math.max(accumulator.scoreMax, sample.score);
	}
	function mergeAccumulatorValues(target, source) {
		const targetScoreCount = target.scoreCount;
		const combinedScoreCount = targetScoreCount + source.scoreCount;
		if (source.scoreCount > 0) {
			if (targetScoreCount === 0) {
				target.scoreMean = source.scoreMean;
				target.scoreM2 = source.scoreM2;
				target.scoreMin = source.scoreMin;
				target.scoreMax = source.scoreMax;
			} else {
				const delta = source.scoreMean - target.scoreMean;
				target.scoreMean += delta * source.scoreCount / combinedScoreCount;
				target.scoreM2 += source.scoreM2 + delta * delta * targetScoreCount * source.scoreCount / combinedScoreCount;
				target.scoreMin = Math.min(target.scoreMin, source.scoreMin);
				target.scoreMax = Math.max(target.scoreMax, source.scoreMax);
			}
			target.scoreCount = combinedScoreCount;
		}
		target.count += source.count;
		target.wins += source.wins;
		target.losses += source.losses;
		target.unknown += source.unknown;
	}
	function resolveRepeatability(average, standardDeviation) {
		if (standardDeviation === 0) return 1;
		return clamp01(1 - standardDeviation / Math.max(1, Math.abs(average)));
	}
	function clamp01(value) {
		return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0));
	}

	/** Подтверждает тайминг на одинаковых seed; пики берутся из полной парной серии. */
	function isPairedTimingBetter(timed, automatic, objective, peaks) {
		if (objective === "max_damage") {
			const scores = pairedMaxima(timed, automatic, peaks);
			return scores !== null && scores[0] > scores[1];
		}
		const count = Math.min(timed.length, automatic.length);
		if (count === 0) return false;
		let improved = 0;
		let regressed = 0;
		let scoreDelta = 0;
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
			if (isBetterSample$1(timed[index], automatic[index])) improved += 1;
			else if (isBetterSample$1(automatic[index], timed[index])) regressed += 1;
			scoreDelta += timed[index].score - automatic[index].score;
		}
		const decisive = improved + regressed;
		if (decisive === 0) return scoreDelta > 0;
		const preferenceInterval = wilsonInterval(improved, decisive, 1.645);
		return scoreDelta > 0 && (preferenceInterval.low > .5 || improved >= 2 && regressed === 0);
	}
	/** Прирост использует ту же метрику и те же парные прогоны, что и отбор. */
	function resolvePairedTimingImprovement(timed, automatic, objective, peaks) {
		if (objective === "max_damage") {
			const scores = pairedMaxima(timed, automatic, peaks);
			return scores === null || scores[1] === 0 ? null : (scores[0] - scores[1]) / Math.abs(scores[1]);
		}
		const count = Math.min(timed.length, automatic.length);
		if (count === 0) return null;
		const timedScores = timed.slice(0, count).map((sample) => sample.score);
		const automaticScores = automatic.slice(0, count).map((sample) => sample.score);
		const timedScore = timedScores.reduce((total, score) => total + score, 0) / count;
		const automaticScore = automaticScores.reduce((total, score) => total + score, 0) / count;
		if (!Number.isFinite(automaticScore) || automaticScore === 0) return null;
		return (timedScore - automaticScore) / Math.abs(automaticScore);
	}
	/** Полная статистика пар сохраняет ранний рекорд без хранения тяжёлых Calc-снимков. */
	function pairedMaxima(timed, automatic, peaks) {
		if (peaks) return peaks.timed.count > 0 && peaks.timed.count === peaks.automatic.count && Number.isFinite(peaks.timed.scoreMax) && Number.isFinite(peaks.automatic.scoreMax) ? [peaks.timed.scoreMax, peaks.automatic.scoreMax] : null;
		const count = Math.min(timed.length, automatic.length);
		if (count === 0) return null;
		let timedMax = -Infinity;
		let automaticMax = -Infinity;
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
			timedMax = Math.max(timedMax, timed[index].score);
			automaticMax = Math.max(automaticMax, automatic[index].score);
		}
		return Number.isFinite(timedMax) && Number.isFinite(automaticMax) ? [timedMax, automaticMax] : null;
	}
	function isBetterSample$1(left, right) {
		if (left.win === true && right.win !== true) return true;
		if (left.win !== true && right.win === true) return false;
		return left.score > right.score;
	}

	function rankBattleRaceEntries(entries, binaryOutcome) {
		return entries.map((entry) => ({
			...entry,
			metrics: summarizeRaceEntry(entry.samples, entry.failed, binaryOutcome, entry.observation)
		})).sort((left, right) => {
			if (!binaryOutcome && left.metrics.scoreMax !== right.metrics.scoreMax) return right.metrics.scoreMax - left.metrics.scoreMax;
			return compareRaceMetrics(right.metrics, left.metrics);
		});
	}
	function selectSuccessiveHalvingSurvivors(entries, binaryOutcome, minimumSurvivors = 3) {
		const keep = Math.min(entries.length, Math.max(minimumSurvivors, Math.ceil(entries.length / 2)));
		return rankBattleRaceEntries(entries, binaryOutcome).slice(0, keep).map((entry) => entry.candidate);
	}
	function summarizeRaceEntry(samples, failed, binaryOutcome, observation) {
		const scores = samples.map((sample) => sample.score).filter(Number.isFinite);
		const scoreMean = observation ? observation.scoreCount > 0 ? observation.scoreMean : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : mean$1(scores);
		const scoreLowerBound = empiricalBernsteinBound(scores, scoreMean, observation, -1);
		const scoreUpperBound = empiricalBernsteinBound(scores, scoreMean, observation, 1);
		const scoreCvar = lowerTailMean(scores, .25);
		const binarySamples = observation ? observation.wins + observation.losses : samples.filter((sample) => sample.win !== null).length;
		const wins = observation ? observation.wins : samples.filter((sample) => sample.win === true).length;
		const interval = binaryOutcome && binarySamples > 0 ? wilsonInterval(wins, binarySamples) : null;
		const succeeded = observation?.count ?? samples.length;
		const attempted = succeeded + Math.max(0, failed);
		const scenarios = observation ? Object.values(observation.scenarios) : [...groupByScenario(samples).values()];
		const scenarioMetrics = scenarios.map((scenario) => summarizeScenarioMetric(scenario, binaryOutcome));
		const reliabilityInterval = wilsonInterval(succeeded, attempted);
		return {
			attempted,
			succeeded,
			reliability: attempted > 0 ? succeeded / attempted : 0,
			scoreMean,
			scoreMax: observation?.scoreMax ?? (scores.length ? Math.max(...scores) : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY),
			scoreLowerBound,
			scoreUpperBound,
			scoreCvar,
			worstScenarioScoreLowerBound: minimumFinite(scenarioMetrics.map((metric) => metric.scoreLowerBound), scoreLowerBound),
			winRate: binarySamples > 0 ? wins / binarySamples : null,
			winLowerBound: interval?.low ?? null,
			winUpperBound: interval?.high ?? null,
			worstScenarioWinLowerBound: minimumNullable(scenarioMetrics.map((metric) => metric.winLowerBound)),
			reliabilityLowerBound: reliabilityInterval.low,
			reliabilityUpperBound: reliabilityInterval.high,
			scenarioCount: scenarios.length
		};
	}
	function selectRaceEntryForSampling(entries, binaryOutcome, round) {
		const ranked = rankBattleRaceEntries(entries, binaryOutcome);
		const incumbent = ranked[0];
		if (!incumbent) return null;
		const challengers = ranked.slice(1).sort((left, right) => {
			const leftPotential = racePotential(left.metrics, binaryOutcome);
			return racePotential(right.metrics, binaryOutcome) - leftPotential || left.metrics.attempted - right.metrics.attempted;
		});
		if (challengers.length === 0 || Math.abs(Math.floor(round)) % 2 === 0) return entries.find((entry) => entry.candidate === incumbent.candidate) ?? null;
		const challenger = challengers[0];
		return entries.find((entry) => entry.candidate === challenger.candidate) ?? null;
	}
	function pruneDominatedRaceEntries(entries, binaryOutcome, minimumSurvivors = 2, minimumAttempts = 4) {
		if (entries.length <= minimumSurvivors) return [...entries];
		const ranked = rankBattleRaceEntries(entries, binaryOutcome);
		const incumbent = ranked[0];
		if (!incumbent) return [];
		const threshold = binaryOutcome ? (incumbent.metrics.winLowerBound ?? 0) * incumbent.metrics.reliabilityLowerBound : incumbent.metrics.scoreLowerBound;
		const retained = ranked.filter((entry, index) => {
			if (!binaryOutcome && entry.metrics.scoreMax >= incumbent.metrics.scoreMax) return true;
			if (index < minimumSurvivors || entry.metrics.attempted < minimumAttempts) return true;
			return (binaryOutcome ? (entry.metrics.winUpperBound ?? 1) * entry.metrics.reliabilityUpperBound : entry.metrics.scoreUpperBound) >= threshold;
		});
		const retainedCandidates = new Set(retained.map((entry) => entry.candidate));
		return entries.filter((entry) => retainedCandidates.has(entry.candidate));
	}
	function compareRaceMetrics(left, right) {
		const worstScenarioWin = compareNullable(left.worstScenarioWinLowerBound, right.worstScenarioWinLowerBound);
		if (worstScenarioWin !== 0) return worstScenarioWin;
		const winLower = compareNullable(left.winLowerBound, right.winLowerBound);
		if (winLower !== 0) return winLower;
		const winRate = compareNullable(left.winRate, right.winRate);
		if (winRate !== 0) return winRate;
		if (left.worstScenarioScoreLowerBound !== right.worstScenarioScoreLowerBound) return left.worstScenarioScoreLowerBound - right.worstScenarioScoreLowerBound;
		if (left.scoreCvar !== right.scoreCvar) return left.scoreCvar - right.scoreCvar;
		if (left.scoreLowerBound !== right.scoreLowerBound) return left.scoreLowerBound - right.scoreLowerBound;
		if (left.scoreMean !== right.scoreMean) return left.scoreMean - right.scoreMean;
		if (left.reliabilityLowerBound !== right.reliabilityLowerBound) return left.reliabilityLowerBound - right.reliabilityLowerBound;
		return left.reliability - right.reliability;
	}
	function compareNullable(left, right) {
		if (left === null && right === null) return 0;
		if (left === null) return -1;
		if (right === null) return 1;
		return left - right;
	}
	function mean$1(values) {
		return values.length > 0 ? values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
	}
	function deviation(values, average) {
		if (values.length < 2 || !Number.isFinite(average)) return 0;
		const variance = values.reduce((total, value) => total + (value - average) ** 2, 0) / (values.length - 1);
		return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, variance));
	}
	function empiricalBernsteinBound(values, average, observation, direction, delta = .05) {
		const count = observation?.scoreCount ?? values.length;
		if (count === 0 || !Number.isFinite(average)) return direction < 0 ? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
		if (count === 1) return average;
		const minimum = observation?.scoreMin ?? Math.min(...values);
		const range = (observation?.scoreMax ?? Math.max(...values)) - minimum;
		if (range <= 0) return average;
		const variance = observation ? accumulatorDeviation(observation) ** 2 : deviation(values, average) ** 2;
		const logarithm = Math.log(3 / Math.max(Number.EPSILON, delta));
		return average + direction * (Math.sqrt(2 * variance * logarithm / count) + 3 * range * logarithm / count);
	}
	function summarizeScenarioMetric(scenario, binaryOutcome) {
		if (!isScenarioAccumulator(scenario)) {
			const scores = scenario.map((sample) => sample.score).filter(Number.isFinite);
			const average = mean$1(scores);
			const binary = scenario.filter((sample) => sample.win !== null);
			const wins = binary.filter((sample) => sample.win === true).length;
			return {
				scoreLowerBound: empiricalBernsteinBound(scores, average, void 0, -1),
				winLowerBound: binaryOutcome && binary.length > 0 ? wilsonInterval(wins, binary.length).low : null
			};
		}
		const binary = scenario.wins + scenario.losses;
		return {
			scoreLowerBound: empiricalBernsteinBound([], scenario.scoreCount > 0 ? scenario.scoreMean : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, scenario, -1),
			winLowerBound: binaryOutcome && binary > 0 ? wilsonInterval(scenario.wins, binary).low : null
		};
	}
	function isScenarioAccumulator(value) {
		return !Array.isArray(value);
	}
	function racePotential(metrics, binaryOutcome) {
		return binaryOutcome ? (metrics.winUpperBound ?? 1) * metrics.reliabilityUpperBound : metrics.scoreUpperBound;
	}
	function lowerTailMean(values, fraction) {
		if (values.length === 0) return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
		const sorted = [...values].sort((left, right) => left - right);
		const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sorted.length * fraction));
		return mean$1(sorted.slice(0, count));
	}
	function groupByScenario(samples) {
		const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const sample of samples) {
			const id = sample.scenarioId ?? "default";
			const values = groups.get(id) ?? [];
			values.push(sample);
			groups.set(id, values);
		}
		return groups;
	}
	function minimumNullable(values) {
		const finite = values.filter((value) => value !== null);
		return finite.length > 0 ? Math.min(...finite) : null;
	}
	function minimumFinite(values, fallback) {
		const finite = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
		return finite.length > 0 ? Math.min(...finite) : fallback;
	}

	function resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated, options = {}) {

		if (divisor !== void 0 && Number.isFinite(divisor) && divisor > 0) {
			const seconds = finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTime, NaN);
			if (Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0) return toDisplayBattleDurationMs(seconds, divisor);
		}
		const countdownSeconds = finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTimer, NaN);
		if (Number.isFinite(countdownSeconds) && countdownSeconds > 0) return Math.ceil(countdownSeconds * 1e3);
		const battleSeconds = finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTime, NaN);
		if (Number.isFinite(battleSeconds) && battleSeconds > 0) return toDisplayBattleDurationMs(battleSeconds);
		if (Number.isFinite(battleSeconds) && !options.useTimeLimitFallback) return Math.ceil(battleSeconds * 1e3);
		const timeLimitSeconds = finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTimeLimit, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(timeLimitSeconds) && timeLimitSeconds > 0 ? toDisplayBattleDurationMs(timeLimitSeconds) : 0;
	}
	function resolveSnapshotSubmitAt(calculated, battleStartedAt, serverDeadlineAt, submissionReserveMs, timerDivisor) {
		const latestSafeSubmitAt = serverDeadlineAt - Math.max(2e3, Math.floor(submissionReserveMs));
		const durationMs = resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated, {
			useTimeLimitFallback: true,
			timerDivisor
		});
		const battleFinishedAt = durationMs > 0 ? battleStartedAt + durationMs + SNAPSHOT_RENDER_MARGIN_MS : latestSafeSubmitAt;
		return Math.min(battleFinishedAt, latestSafeSubmitAt);
	}
	function toDisplayBattleDurationMs(battleSeconds, divisor = DEFAULT_BATTLE_TIMER_DIVISOR) {
		return Math.max(MIN_BATTLE_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS, Math.ceil(battleSeconds / (divisor > 0 ? divisor : DEFAULT_BATTLE_TIMER_DIVISOR) + 1.5)) * 1e3;
	}
	var DEFAULT_BATTLE_TIMER_DIVISOR, MIN_BATTLE_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS, SNAPSHOT_RENDER_MARGIN_MS;
	var init_battle_duration = __esmMin((() => {
		init_helpers();
		DEFAULT_BATTLE_TIMER_DIVISOR = 1.5;
		MIN_BATTLE_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 4;
		SNAPSHOT_RENDER_MARGIN_MS = 500;
	}));

	function resolveServerBattleDeadline(start) {
		const timestamp = finiteNumber$1(start.endTime);
		return timestamp > 0 ? timestamp * 1e3 : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
	}

				_defineProperty(this, "serverDeadlineAt", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "reserveMs", void 0);

			}

			}

					this.deadlineAt = this.measuredLimit ? Math.min(this.deadlineAt, deadline) : deadline;
					this.measuredLimit = true;
				}
			}
			select(calculation) {
				this.submitAt = resolveSnapshotSubmitAt(calculation, this.startedAt, this.deadlineAt, this.reserveMs, this.timerDivisor);
			}
		};
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/engine/manual-window.ts
	/**
	* План боя: ручные касты (в том числе повторные после перезарядки), затем
	* не больше одного включения «Авто». Включённый автобой сам кастует ульты при
	* полной энергии, поэтому всё после него — лишнее: и касты, и попытки выключить.
	* Первый `auto` в 0 с — служебное начальное состояние replay, а не включение.
	*/
	function enforceManualCastWindow(actions) {
		const sorted = [...actions].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
		const result = [];
		for (const [index, action] of sorted.entries()) {
			result.push(action);
			if (action.type === "auto" && !(index === 0 && action.time === 0)) break;
		}
		return result;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/engine/priority-queue.ts
	var BattleLabPriorityQueue;
	var init_priority_queue = __esmMin((() => {
		init_defineProperty();
		BattleLabPriorityQueue = class {
			constructor() {
				_defineProperty(this, "items", []);
				_defineProperty(this, "sequence", 0);
			}
			get length() {
				return this.items.length;
			}
			/** При равном приоритете сохраняет порядок добавления. */
			push(value) {
				const entry = {
					value,
					sequence: this.sequence++
				};
				this.items.push(entry);
				let index = this.items.length - 1;
				while (index > 0) {
					const parent = index - 1 >>> 1;
					if (!this.before(entry, this.items[parent])) break;
					this.items[index] = this.items[parent];
					index = parent;
				}
				this.items[index] = entry;
			}
			/** Удаляет лидера за O(log n). */
			pop() {
				const first = this.items[0];
				const last = this.items.pop();
				if (!first || !last || this.items.length === 0) return first?.value;
				let index = 0;
				while (index * 2 + 1 < this.items.length) {
					let child = index * 2 + 1;
					if (child + 1 < this.items.length && this.before(this.items[child + 1], this.items[child])) child += 1;
					if (!this.before(this.items[child], last)) break;
					this.items[index] = this.items[child];
					index = child;
				}
				this.items[index] = last;
				return first.value;
			}
			/** Ограничение памяти применяется пачкой; отсечённые ключи можно убрать из dedup-набора. */
			trim(limit) {
				if (this.length <= limit) return [];
				this.items.sort((a, b) => a.value.priority === b.value.priority ? a.sequence - b.sequence : b.value.priority - a.value.priority);
				return this.items.splice(limit).map((entry) => entry.value);
			}
			before(a, b) {
				return a.value.priority > b.value.priority || a.value.priority === b.value.priority && a.sequence < b.sequence;
			}
		};
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/ultimate-plan-search.ts
	/**
	* «Залп»: ульты копятся, пока энергия не наберётся у последнего героя, затем
	* все касты подряд и автобой (эталон Оша 160: 10.4 → 11.07 с). Два порядка:
	* по готовности и обратный — кто открывает залп, заметно меняет урон.
	*/
	function buildSalvoPlans(actionCandidates, maxActions) {
		const ready = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const { action } of actionCandidates) {
			if (action.type !== "cast") continue;
			ready.set(action.unitId, Math.min(ready.get(action.unitId) ?? Infinity, action.time));
		}
		if (ready.size < 2) return [];
		const start = Math.max(...ready.values()) + .05;
		const order = [...ready.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]).map(([unitId]) => unitId);
		return [order, [...order].reverse()].map((sequence, index) => ({
			manualActions: sequence.slice(0, maxActions).map((unitId, position) => ({
				type: "cast",
				unitId,
				time: Math.round((start + position * SALVO_STEP_SECONDS) * BATTLE_TIME_SCALE) / BATTLE_TIME_SCALE
			})),
			priority: 400 - index
		}));
	}
	/** По одному лучшему действию каждого героя и питомца. */
	function buildOwnerCoveragePlans(actionCandidates) {
		const owners = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const coverage = [];
		for (const candidate of actionCandidates) {
			const owner = actionOwnerKey(candidate.action);
			if (owners.has(owner)) continue;
			owners.add(owner);
			coverage.push({
				manualActions: [candidate.action],
				priority: candidate.heuristic
			});
		}
		return coverage;
	}
	/** Потолок проб и длины плана: без явного лимита план не длиннее отряда плюс два. */
	function resolveUltimatePlanLimits(candidateCount, maxTrials, requestedMaxActions, unitCount) {
		return {
			trialLimit: Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(maxTrials)), Math.max(candidateCount * 64, 8192)),
			maxActions: Math.max(2, Math.floor(requestedMaxActions ?? Math.min(8, unitCount + 2)))
		};
	}
	/** Проверяет владельцев действий и продолжает ветки по результату Calc в пределах общего бюджета. */
	async function searchUltimatePlans({ baseline, seedActions = baseline.actions, timeline: requestedTimeline, timingCalculation = baseline.calculation, unitIds, allowTeamCustom, teamCustomValues, sameUnitCooldowns = {}, sameTeamCustomCooldowns = {}, minTime, maxTime, maxTrials, maxActions: requestedMaxActions, retainObservations = true, signal, evaluate, compare, onObservation, concurrency }) {
		const timeline = resolveBattleCalculationTimeline({
			...timingCalculation,
			timeline: requestedTimeline ?? timingCalculation.timeline
		});
		if (timeline.length === 0) return emptyResult$1(baseline, "Игровой движок не отдал точную шкалу боя.");
		const actionCandidates = buildUltimateActionCandidates({
			...timingCalculation,
			timeline
		}, unitIds, allowTeamCustom, minTime, maxTime, teamCustomValues);
		if (actionCandidates.length === 0) return emptyResult$1(baseline, "В журнале боя не найдено ни одного доступного окна для ульты.");
		const { trialLimit, maxActions } = resolveUltimatePlanLimits(actionCandidates.length, maxTrials, requestedMaxActions, unitIds.length);
		if (trialLimit === 0) return {
			...emptyResult$1(baseline, "На подбор тайминга не осталось расчётов."),
			candidateCount: actionCandidates.length
		};
		const seeds = buildSeedPlans(actionCandidates, unitIds.length, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns, seedActions);
		const astralSchedule = buildAstralSwitchSchedule(sameTeamCustomCooldowns[3], timeline, minTime, maxTime, maxActions);
		if (allowTeamCustom && teamCustomValues?.includes(3) && astralSchedule.length > 1 && isValidPlan(astralSchedule, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) seeds.push({
			manualActions: astralSchedule,
			priority: 200
		});
		const queue = new BattleLabPriorityQueue();
		for (const plan of seeds) queue.push(plan);
		const coverage = [...buildSalvoPlans(actionCandidates, maxActions).filter((plan) => isValidPlan(plan.manualActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)), ...buildOwnerCoveragePlans(actionCandidates)];
		let coverageIndex = 0;
		const queued = new Set(seeds.map((plan) => planKey(plan.manualActions)));
		const tested = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const observations = [];
		const queueLimit = Math.min(4096, Math.max(256, trialLimit * 2));
		let best = baseline;
		let bestActions = baseline.actions;
		let failed = 0;
		const getConcurrency = () => Math.max(1, Math.floor(concurrency?.() ?? 1));
		const running = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let globalFailure = null;
		while ((queue.length > 0 || running.size > 0) && (tested.size < trialLimit || running.size > 0)) {
			while (queue.length > 0 && running.size < getConcurrency() && tested.size < trialLimit) {
				if (globalFailure) break;
				if (signal?.aborted) {
					globalFailure = { error: signal.reason ?? new DOMException("Остановлено", "AbortError") };
					break;
				}
				const plan = coverageIndex < coverage.length ? coverage[coverageIndex++] : queue.pop();
				if (!plan) break;
				const key = planKey(plan.manualActions);
				if (tested.has(key)) continue;
				tested.add(key);
				const actions = materializePlan(plan.manualActions);
				const p = evaluate(actions).then((sample) => {
					if (globalFailure) return;
					const observation = {
						actions,
						sample
					};
					if (retainObservations) observations.push(observation);
					onObservation?.(observation);
					const becameBest = compare(sample, best) > 0;
					const gain = (sample.score - baseline.score) / Math.max(1, Math.abs(baseline.score));
					const quality = Math.max(-600, Math.min(2e3, gain * 1e3)) + (becameBest ? 600 : 0);
					if (becameBest) {
						best = sample;
						bestActions = actions;
						enqueueLocalRefinements(queue, queued, plan, actionCandidates, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns, quality);
					}
					enqueuePlanExpansions(queue, queued, plan, actionCandidates, maxActions, quality, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns);
					trimPlanQueue(queue, queued, queueLimit);
				}).catch((error) => {
					try {
						throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
						throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(signal);
						failed += 1;
					} catch (fatalError) {
						globalFailure ?? (globalFailure = { error: fatalError });
					}
				}).finally(() => {
					running.delete(p);
				});
				running.add(p);
			}
			if (running.size === 0 || globalFailure) break;
			await Promise.race(running);
		}
		if (running.size > 0) await Promise.all(running);
		if (globalFailure) throw globalFailure.error;
		return {
			actions: [...bestActions],
			sample: best,
			observations,
			tested: tested.size,
			failed,
			candidateCount: actionCandidates.length,
			unavailableReason: null
		};
	}
	function trimPlanQueue(queue, queued, limit) {
		if (queue.length <= limit + Math.min(256, Math.ceil(limit / 4))) return;
		for (const removed of queue.trim(limit)) queued.delete(planKey(removed.manualActions));
	}
	/** Моменты, когда энергия бойца впервые доходит до ульты. */
	function collectUltimateReadiness(events, allowedUnits) {
		const readinessByUnit = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const event of events) {
			const unitId = positiveUnitId(event.source);
			const oldValue = Number(event.oldValue);
			const delta = Number(event.delta);
			if (event.side !== "ally" || !event.isEnergy || !allowedUnits.has(unitId) || !Number.isFinite(oldValue) || !Number.isFinite(delta) || oldValue >= 1e3 || oldValue + delta < 1e3) continue;
			const times = readinessByUnit.get(unitId) ?? [];
			times.push(event.time);
			readinessByUnit.set(unitId, times);
		}
		return readinessByUnit;
	}
	/** Командные действия (ульта питомца, смена мира) ставятся на угрозы и сетку боя. */
	function addTeamCustomCandidates(candidates, timeline, customTimes, values, minTime, maxTime) {
		for (const value of new Set(values.filter(Number.isFinite))) {
			const astral = value === 3;
			const times = astral ? [...customTimes.slice(0, 16), ...buildTimelineGrid(timeline, minTime, maxTime, 16)] : customTimes.slice(0, 12);
			for (const [index, time] of times.entries()) {
				const snapped = snapToTimeline(timeline, time, minTime, maxTime);
				if (snapped === null) continue;
				candidates.push({
					action: {
						type: "teamCustom",
						value,
						time: snapped
					},
					heuristic: astral ? 110 - index : 42 - index
				});
			}
		}
	}
	function buildUltimateActionCandidates(calculation, unitIds, allowTeamCustom, requestedMinTime, requestedMaxTime, requestedTeamCustomValues) {
		const timeline = resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(calculation);
		if (timeline.length === 0) return [];
		const minTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(requestedMinTime, requestedMaxTime));
		const maxTime = Math.min(Math.max(minTime, Math.max(requestedMinTime, requestedMaxTime)), timeline.at(-1)?.time ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
		const allowedUnits = new Set(unitIds.filter((unitId) => Number.isSafeInteger(unitId) && unitId > 0));
		const battleSignals = threatExtractor$1.extract(calculation);
		const candidates = [];
		const readinessByUnit = collectUltimateReadiness(battleSignals.events, allowedUnits);
		const loggedTimes = threatExtractor$1.buildManualTimes(calculation, {
			manualTimeMin: minTime,
			manualTimeMax: maxTime,
			manualTimeStep: Math.max(.5, (maxTime - minTime) / 24)
		}).slice(0, 32);
		const fallbackTimes = loggedTimes.length > 0 ? loggedTimes : buildTimelineGrid(timeline, minTime, maxTime, 24);
		for (const unitId of allowedUnits) {
			const readinessTimes = readinessByUnit.get(unitId) ?? [];
			if (readinessTimes.length === 0) {
				for (const [index, time] of fallbackTimes.slice(0, 8).entries()) addCastCandidate(candidates, timeline, unitId, time, 30 - index);
				continue;
			}
			for (const readinessTime of readinessTimes.slice(0, 8)) {
				for (const [index, offset] of [
					0,
					.08,
					.2,
					.45,
					.9,
					1.4
				].entries()) addCastCandidate(candidates, timeline, unitId, readinessTime + offset, 120 - index * 6);
				const reactiveWindows = [...battleSignals.threats.map((threat) => ({
					time: threat.time,
					score: threat.score
				})), ...battleSignals.events.filter((event) => event.isCastLike || event.isDeathLike).map((event) => ({
					time: event.time,
					score: event.isDeathLike ? 90 : 55
				}))].filter((window) => window.time >= readinessTime && window.time <= readinessTime + 8 && window.time >= minTime && window.time <= maxTime).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score).slice(0, 6);
				for (const window of reactiveWindows) for (const offset of [
					-.45,
					-.18,
					-.05,
					.08
				]) addCastCandidate(candidates, timeline, unitId, Math.max(readinessTime, window.time + offset), 70 + window.score - Math.abs(offset) * 10);
			}
		}
		if (allowTeamCustom) addTeamCustomCandidates(candidates, timeline, [...battleSignals.threats.map((threat) => threat.time), ...fallbackTimes], requestedTeamCustomValues ?? [1], minTime, maxTime);
		const unique = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const key = actionKey(candidate.action);
			const previous = unique.get(key);
			if (!previous || candidate.heuristic > previous.heuristic) unique.set(key, candidate);
		}
		const ranked = [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => right.heuristic - left.heuristic);
		if (ranked.length <= 192) return ranked;
		const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of ranked) {
			const owner = actionOwnerKey(candidate.action);
			const group = groups.get(owner) ?? [];
			group.push(candidate);
			groups.set(owner, group);
		}
		const retained = [];
		for (let index = 0; retained.length < 192; index++) for (const group of groups.values()) {
			if (group[index]) retained.push(group[index]);
			if (retained.length === 192) break;
		}
		return retained.sort((left, right) => right.heuristic - left.heuristic);
	}
	function buildTimelineGrid(timeline, minTime, maxTime, count) {
		const times = timeline.map((point) => point.time).filter((time) => Number.isFinite(time) && time >= minTime && time <= maxTime);
		if (times.length === 0 || count <= 0) return [];
		if (times.length <= count) return [...new Set(times)];
		const step = (times.length - 1) / (count - 1);
		const grid = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) grid.add(times[Math.round(index * step)]);
		return [...grid];
	}
	function buildSeedPlans(candidates, unitCount, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns, seedActions) {
		const result = candidates.slice(0, 36).map((candidate) => ({
			manualActions: [candidate.action],
			priority: candidate.heuristic
		}));
		appendSeedPlanNeighborhood(result, candidates, seedActions, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns);
		const bestPerUnit = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const key = actionOwnerKey(candidate.action);
			if (!bestPerUnit.has(key)) bestPerUnit.set(key, candidate);
		}
		const coordinated = [...bestPerUnit.values()].slice(0, Math.min(6, Math.max(1, unitCount + 1))).map((candidate) => candidate.action).sort(compareActions);
		if (coordinated.length > 1 && isValidPlan(coordinated, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) result.push({
			manualActions: coordinated,
			priority: [...bestPerUnit.values()].slice(0, coordinated.length).reduce((total, candidate) => total + candidate.heuristic, 0)
		});
		const rotation = buildRotationSeed(candidates, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns);
		if (rotation.length > 1) for (const length of [
			2,
			4,
			8,
			12,
			maxActions
		]) {
			const actions = rotation.slice(0, Math.min(rotation.length, length));
			if (actions.length < 2) continue;
			result.push({
				manualActions: actions,
				priority: 1200 + actions.length * 12
			});
		}
		return result;
	}
	function appendSeedPlanNeighborhood(target, candidates, seedActions, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns) {
		const allowedOwners = new Set(candidates.map((candidate) => actionOwnerKey(candidate.action)));
		const manualActions = seedActions.filter((action) => action.type !== "auto").filter((action) => allowedOwners.has(actionOwnerKey(action))).slice(0, maxActions).sort(compareActions);
		if (manualActions.length === 0 || !isValidPlan(manualActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) return;
		target.push({
			manualActions,
			priority: 5e3 + manualActions.length * 25
		});
		for (let index = 0; index < manualActions.length; index += 1) {
			const current = manualActions[index];
			const alternatives = candidates.filter((candidate) => actionOwnerKey(candidate.action) === actionOwnerKey(current) && candidate.action.time !== current.time).sort((left, right) => Math.abs(left.action.time - current.time) - Math.abs(right.action.time - current.time) || right.heuristic - left.heuristic).slice(0, 8);
			for (const alternative of alternatives) {
				const actions = manualActions.map((action, actionIndex) => actionIndex === index ? alternative.action : action).sort(compareActions);
				if (!isValidPlan(actions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) continue;
				target.push({
					manualActions: actions,
					priority: 4700 + alternative.heuristic - index
				});
			}
		}
	}
	function buildRotationSeed(candidates, maxActions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns) {
		const chronological = [...candidates].sort((left, right) => left.action.time - right.action.time || right.heuristic - left.heuristic);
		const result = [];
		for (const candidate of chronological) {
			if (result.length >= maxActions) break;
			const actions = [...result, candidate.action].sort(compareActions);
			if (!isValidPlan(actions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) continue;
			result.splice(0, result.length, ...actions);
		}
		return result;
	}
	function enqueuePlanExpansions(queue, queued, source, candidates, maxActions, qualityBoost, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns) {
		if (source.manualActions.length >= maxActions) return;
		let added = 0;
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const actions = [...source.manualActions, candidate.action].sort(compareActions);
			if (!isValidPlan(actions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) continue;
			const key = planKey(actions);
			if (queued.has(key)) continue;
			queued.add(key);
			queue.push({
				manualActions: actions,
				priority: candidate.heuristic + qualityBoost - actions.length * 4
			});
			added += 1;
			if (added >= 18) break;
		}
	}
	function enqueueLocalRefinements(queue, queued, source, candidates, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns, qualityBoost) {
		for (let actionIndex = 0; actionIndex < source.manualActions.length; actionIndex += 1) {
			const current = source.manualActions[actionIndex];
			const alternatives = candidates.filter((candidate) => actionOwnerKey(candidate.action) === actionOwnerKey(current) && candidate.action.time !== current.time).sort((left, right) => Math.abs(left.action.time - current.time) - Math.abs(right.action.time - current.time) || right.heuristic - left.heuristic).slice(0, 8);
			for (const alternative of alternatives) {
				const actions = source.manualActions.map((action, index) => index === actionIndex ? alternative.action : action).sort(compareActions);
				if (!isValidPlan(actions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns)) continue;
				const key = planKey(actions);
				if (queued.has(key)) continue;
				queued.add(key);
				queue.push({
					manualActions: actions,
					priority: qualityBoost + alternative.heuristic + 720
				});
			}
		}
	}
	function materializePlan(manualActions) {
		const actions = [...manualActions].sort(compareActions);
		const lastTime = actions.at(-1)?.time ?? 0;
		return [...actions, {
			type: "auto",
			time: Math.round((lastTime + .02) * BATTLE_TIME_SCALE) / BATTLE_TIME_SCALE
		}];
	}
	/**
	* Стартовый план Маэстро: менять мир сразу после перезарядки, пока барьер не
	* набрал силу. Поиск дальше сдвигает отдельные переключения.
	*/
	function buildAstralSwitchSchedule(cooldown, timeline, minTime, maxTime, maxActions) {
		if (!cooldown || !Number.isFinite(cooldown) || cooldown <= 0) return [];
		const actions = [];
		const step = cooldown + .05;
		for (let time = Math.max(minTime, step); time <= maxTime && actions.length < maxActions; time += step) {
			const snapped = snapToTimeline(timeline, time, minTime, maxTime);
			if (snapped !== null && snapped > (actions.at(-1)?.time ?? -Infinity)) actions.push({
				type: "teamCustom",
				value: 3,
				time: snapped
			});
		}
		return actions;
	}
	function isValidPlan(actions, sameUnitCooldowns, sameTeamCustomCooldowns) {
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (let index = 0; index < actions.length; index += 1) {
			const action = actions[index];
			const key = actionKey(action);
			if (seen.has(key)) return false;
			seen.add(key);
			for (let previousIndex = 0; previousIndex < index; previousIndex += 1) {
				const previous = actions[previousIndex];
				const distance = Math.abs(previous.time - action.time);
				if (distance < .04) return false;
				if (previous.type === "cast" && action.type === "cast" && previous.unitId === action.unitId && distance < Math.max(.04, sameUnitCooldowns[action.unitId] ?? 3)) return false;
				if (previous.type === "teamCustom" && action.type === "teamCustom" && previous.value === action.value && distance < Math.max(.04, sameTeamCustomCooldowns[action.value] ?? 2)) return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
	function addCastCandidate(target, timeline, unitId, time, heuristic) {
		const snapped = snapToTimeline(timeline, time, timeline[0]?.time ?? 0, timeline.at(-1)?.time ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
		if (snapped === null) return;
		target.push({
			action: {
				type: "cast",
				unitId,
				time: snapped
			},
			heuristic
		});
	}
	function snapToTimeline(timeline, time, minTime, maxTime) {
		if (!Number.isFinite(time) || time < minTime || time > maxTime) return null;
		let left = 0;
		let right = timeline.length - 1;
		while (left < right) {
			const middle = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
			if (timeline[middle].time < time) left = middle + 1;
			else right = middle;
		}
		const current = timeline[left];
		const previous = left > 0 ? timeline[left - 1] : null;
		const selected = previous && Math.abs(previous.time - time) <= Math.abs(current.time - time) ? previous : current;
		return selected && selected.time >= minTime && selected.time <= maxTime ? selected.time : null;
	}
	function compareActions(left, right) {
		if (left.time !== right.time) return left.time - right.time;
		if (left.type === right.type) {
			if (left.type === "cast" && right.type === "cast") return left.unitId - right.unitId;
			return 0;
		}
		return left.type === "teamCustom" ? -1 : 1;
	}
	function planKey(actions) {
		return actions.map(actionKey).join("|");
	}
	function actionKey(action) {
		return action.type === "cast" ? `cast:${action.unitId}:${action.time}` : `teamCustom:${action.value}:${action.time}`;
	}
	function actionOwnerKey(action) {
		return action.type === "cast" ? `cast:${action.unitId}` : `teamCustom:${action.value}`;
	}
	function positiveUnitId(value) {
		const parsed = Math.abs(Number(value));
		return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0;
	}
