	function buildLocalUltraTimingMap(timeline, minTime, maxTime, refinementAnchors) {
		const min = Math.max(0, Math.min(minTime, maxTime));
		const max = Math.max(min, Math.max(minTime, maxTime));
		const normalizedTimeline = normalizeBattleTimeline(timeline);
		const byTime = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const point of normalizedTimeline) if (point.time >= min && point.time <= max) byTime.set(point.time, point.index + 1);
		for (const anchor of refinementAnchors ?? []) {
			if (!Number.isFinite(anchor.time)) continue;
			for (const offset of [0, ...MICRO_REFINEMENT_STEPS.flatMap((step) => [-step, step])]) {
				const time = roundTiming(anchor.time + offset);
				if (time < min || time > max || normalizedTimeline.length === 0) continue;
				byTime.set(time, resolveBattleTimelineIndex(normalizedTimeline, time));
			}
		}
		return [...byTime.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left - right).map(([time, inputIndex], position) => ({
			position,
			time,
			inputIndex
		}));
	}
	/**
	* Исследует интервалы по точным метрикам всех попыток. Для уточнения достаточно
	* шести лучших полных результатов; необязательная история не влияет на поиск.
	*/
	async function searchAdaptiveUltraTiming({ timeline, minTime, maxTime, maxTrials, baseline, signals = [], evaluate, compare, getScore, getOutcome, assertActive, onError, onObservation, concurrency, retainObservations = true }) {
		const normalizedTimeline = normalizeBattleTimeline(timeline);
		const candidates = buildLocalUltraTimingMap(normalizedTimeline, minTime, maxTime, signals.length > 0 ? signals : fallbackRefinementAnchors(normalizedTimeline, minTime, maxTime));
		const trialLimit = Math.min(candidates.length, Math.max(0, Math.floor(maxTrials)));
		if (trialLimit === 0) return emptyResult(baseline, candidates.length);
		const state = {
			candidates,
			attempted: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(),
			observations: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),
			leaders: [],
			signalWeights: mapSignalsToCandidates(candidates, signals),
			bestPosition: null
		};
		const errors = [];
		let best = baseline;
		let failed = 0;
		const retainedObservations = [];
		const testPosition = async (position) => {
			assertActive?.();
			if (state.attempted.has(position) || state.attempted.size >= trialLimit) return;
			const candidate = candidates[position];
			if (!candidate) return;
			state.attempted.add(position);
			try {
				const sample = await evaluate(candidate);
				const observation = {
					candidate,
					sample
				};
				state.observations.set(position, {
					candidate,
					score: getScore(sample),
					outcome: getOutcome(sample)
				});
				state.leaders.push(observation);
				state.leaders.sort((left, right) => compare(right.sample, left.sample));
				state.leaders.length = Math.min(6, state.leaders.length);
				if (retainObservations) retainedObservations.push(observation);
				onObservation?.(observation);
				if (compare(sample, best) > 0) {
					best = sample;
					state.bestPosition = position;
				}
			} catch (error) {
				onError?.(error);
				assertActive?.();
				failed += 1;
				if (errors.length < 5) errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
			}
		};
		const getConcurrency = () => Math.max(1, Math.floor(concurrency?.() ?? 1));
		const runParallel = async (limit, getPos) => {
			const running = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			let failure = null;
			while (state.attempted.size < limit) {
				while (running.size < getConcurrency() && state.attempted.size < limit) {
					if (failure) break;
					const position = getPos();
					if (position === null) break;
					const p = testPosition(position).catch((e) => {
						failure ?? (failure = { error: e });
					}).finally(() => {
						running.delete(p);
					});
					running.add(p);
				}
				if (running.size === 0 || failure) break;
				await Promise.race(running);
			}
			if (running.size > 0) await Promise.all(running);
			if (failure) throw failure.error;
		};
		const initialPositions = buildInitialPositions(state, trialLimit);
		let initialIndex = 0;
		await runParallel(initialPositions.length, () => initialIndex < initialPositions.length ? initialPositions[initialIndex++] : null);
		await runParallel(Math.max(state.attempted.size, Math.floor(trialLimit * .72)), () => selectAdaptivePosition(state));
		await runParallel(trialLimit, () => selectRefinementPosition(state, trialLimit) ?? selectAdaptivePosition(state));
		const bestObservation = state.bestPosition === null ? null : state.observations.get(state.bestPosition) ?? null;
		return {
			best,
			bestCandidate: bestObservation?.candidate ?? null,
			observations: retainedObservations.sort((left, right) => left.candidate.position - right.candidate.position),
			tested: state.attempted.size,
			failed,
			errors,
			candidateCount: candidates.length
		};
	}
	function emptyResult(baseline, candidateCount) {
		return {
			best: baseline,
			bestCandidate: null,
			observations: [],
			tested: 0,
			failed: 0,
			errors: [],

		};
	}
	function buildInitialPositions(state, trialLimit) {
		const refinementReserve = trialLimit >= 4 ? Math.min(6, Math.floor(trialLimit / 3)) : 0;
		const count = Math.min(Math.max(1, trialLimit - refinementReserve), Math.max(5, Math.min(24, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(trialLimit)) * 2)));
		const positions = [];
		const selected = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const add = (position) => {
			if (positions.length < count && position >= 0 && position < state.candidates.length && !selected.has(position)) {
				selected.add(position);
				positions.push(position);
			}
		};
		for (const [position] of [...state.signalWeights.entries()].sort((left, right) => right[1] - left[1])) add(position);
		for (const position of spreadPositions(state.candidates.length, Math.ceil(count * .6))) add(position);
		for (const position of spreadPositions(state.candidates.length, count)) add(position);
		return positions;
	}
	function selectAdaptivePosition(state) {
		const tested = [...state.attempted].sort((left, right) => left - right);
		const scoreRange = getScoreRange(state);
		let bestInterval = null;
		for (let index = 1; index < tested.length; index += 1) {
			const left = tested[index - 1];
			const right = tested[index];
			if (right - left <= 1) continue;
			const candidatePosition = chooseIntervalCandidate(state, left, right);
			if (candidatePosition === null) continue;
			const interval = {
				left,
				right,
				candidatePosition,
				priority: intervalPriority(state, left, right, scoreRange)
			};
			if (!bestInterval || interval.priority > bestInterval.priority || interval.priority === bestInterval.priority && right - left > bestInterval.right - bestInterval.left) bestInterval = interval;
		}
		return bestInterval?.candidatePosition ?? null;
	}
	function selectRefinementPosition(state, trialLimit) {
		const ranked = state.leaders;
		if (ranked.length === 0) return null;
		const radius = Math.max(12, Math.ceil(state.candidates.length / Math.max(1, trialLimit)) * 4);
		for (let distance = 1; distance <= radius; distance += 1) for (const observation of ranked) for (const position of [observation.candidate.position - distance, observation.candidate.position + distance]) if (position >= 0 && position < state.candidates.length && !state.attempted.has(position)) return position;
		return null;
	}
	function intervalPriority(state, left, right, scoreRange) {
		const leftObservation = state.observations.get(left);
		const rightObservation = state.observations.get(right);
		const leftQuality = normalizedQuality(leftObservation, scoreRange);
		const rightQuality = normalizedQuality(rightObservation, scoreRange);
		const width = right - left - 1;
		const widthScore = Math.log2(width + 1) / Math.log2(Math.max(2, state.candidates.length));
		const outcomeBoundary = hasOutcomeBoundary(leftObservation, rightObservation);
		const bestEdge = state.bestPosition === left || state.bestPosition === right ? 1 : 0;
		const signal = maxSignalWeight(state.signalWeights, left, right);
		const missingEdge = !leftObservation || !rightObservation ? 1 : 0;
		return widthScore * 1.25 + (leftQuality + rightQuality) / 2 * .65 + Math.abs(leftQuality - rightQuality) * .85 + outcomeBoundary * 1.4 + bestEdge * .6 + signal * .75 + missingEdge * .1;
	}
	function chooseIntervalCandidate(state, left, right) {
		const signal = [...state.signalWeights.entries()].filter(([position]) => position > left && position < right && !state.attempted.has(position)).sort((leftEntry, rightEntry) => rightEntry[1] - leftEntry[1])[0];
		if (signal && signal[1] >= .35) return signal[0];
		return nearestUntestedPosition(Math.floor((left + right) / 2), left + 1, right - 1, state.attempted);
	}
	function normalizedQuality(sample, range) {
		if (!sample) return 0;
		const score = sample.score;
		if (!Number.isFinite(score)) return 0;
		if (range.max <= range.min) return .5;
		return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (score - range.min) / (range.max - range.min)));
	}
	function getScoreRange(state) {
		const scores = [...state.observations.values()].map((observation) => observation.score).filter(Number.isFinite);
		return {
			min: scores.length > 0 ? Math.min(...scores) : 0,
			max: scores.length > 0 ? Math.max(...scores) : 0
		};
	}
	function hasOutcomeBoundary(left, right) {
		if (!left || !right) return 0;
		return left.outcome !== right.outcome ? 1 : 0;
	}
	function maxSignalWeight(signalWeights, left, right) {
		let max = 0;
		for (const [position, weight] of signalWeights) if (position > left && position < right) max = Math.max(max, weight);
		return max;
	}
	function mapSignalsToCandidates(candidates, signals) {
		const raw = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		let maxWeight = 0;
		for (const signal of signals) {
			if (!Number.isFinite(signal.time) || !Number.isFinite(signal.weight)) continue;
			const position = nearestCandidatePosition(candidates, signal.time);
			if (position === null) continue;
			const weight = Math.max(0, signal.weight);
			raw.set(position, Math.max(raw.get(position) ?? 0, weight));
			maxWeight = Math.max(maxWeight, weight);
		}
		if (maxWeight <= 0) return /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		return new Map([...raw.entries()].map(([position, weight]) => [position, weight / maxWeight]));
	}
	function nearestCandidatePosition(candidates, target) {
		if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
		let left = 0;
		let right = candidates.length - 1;
		while (left < right) {
			const middle = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
			if (candidates[middle].time < target) left = middle + 1;
			else right = middle;
		}
		if (left === 0) return 0;
		const previous = candidates[left - 1];
		const current = candidates[left];
		return Math.abs(previous.time - target) <= Math.abs(current.time - target) ? left - 1 : left;
	}
	function spreadPositions(length, count) {
		if (length <= 0 || count <= 0) return [];
		if (count === 1) return [Math.floor((length - 1) / 2)];
		const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) result.add(Math.round(index * (length - 1) / (count - 1)));
		return [...result];
	}
	function nearestUntestedPosition(target, min, max, attempted) {
		for (let offset = 0; target - offset >= min || target + offset <= max; offset += 1) {
			const left = target - offset;
			if (left >= min && !attempted.has(left)) return left;
			const right = target + offset;
			if (right <= max && !attempted.has(right)) return right;
		}
		return null;
	}

		}));
	}

		if (maxTime >= DELAYED_AUTO_MIN_BATTLE) for (let time = DELAYED_AUTO_BAND[0]; time <= DELAYED_AUTO_BAND[1]; time += .5) addSignalWindow(signals, time, 66, [0]);

			timeline,
			minTime,
			maxTime,
			signals: compressSignals(signals, minTime, maxTime)
		};
	}
	function isUltimateReadinessEvent(event) {
		if (event.side !== "ally" || !event.isEnergy) return false;
		const oldValue = Number(event.oldValue);
		const delta = Number(event.delta);
		return Number.isFinite(oldValue) && Number.isFinite(delta) && oldValue < 1e3 && oldValue + delta >= 1e3;
	}
	function addSignalWindow(target, time, weight, offsets) {
		if (!Number.isFinite(time) || time < 0) return;
		for (const offset of offsets) target.push({
			time: Math.max(0, time + offset),
			weight: Math.max(0, weight - Math.abs(offset) * 12)
		});
	}
	function compressSignals(signals, minTime, maxTime) {
		const byTime = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const signal of signals) {
			if (signal.time < minTime || signal.time > maxTime) continue;
			const time = Math.round(signal.time * 1e6) / 1e6;
			byTime.set(time, Math.max(byTime.get(time) ?? 0, signal.weight));
		}
		return [...byTime.entries()].map(([time, weight]) => ({
			time,
			weight
		})).sort((left, right) => right.weight - left.weight).slice(0, 96);
	}
	function compareSamples$2(left, right, isBetter) {
		if (isBetter(left, right)) return 1;
		if (isBetter(right, left)) return -1;
		return 0;
	}

		* команды после фактического конца боя вырезаются и перепроверяются.

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/asgard-seed-potential.ts
	/**
	* Потенциал пачки Асгарда так, как его реализует живой бой: на каждом seed
	* тайминги подбираются заново (тот же поиск, что перед отправкой на сервер),
	* а оценка — лучший бой; среднее по seed идёт в надёжность. Один общий тайминг на все seed у
	* Асгарда проигрывает автобою: выигрышный залп зависит от хода конкретного боя.
	*/
	async function trainAsgardSeedPotential(options, candidate, startActions, seedFor) {
		const total = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.maxCalculations));
		const seeds = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_SEEDS, Math.floor(total / MIN_CALCULATIONS_PER_SEED)));
		const perSeed = Math.max(1, Math.floor(total / seeds));
		const runner = new BattleRunner({ executor: getBattleLabCalcExecutor() });
		const spent = [];
		const bests = [];
		let reserved = 0;
		const reserve = () => {
			const share = Math.min(perSeed, total - reserved);
			if (share < Math.min(MIN_TAIL_CALCULATIONS, perSeed)) return 0;
			reserved += share;
			return share;
		};
		const report = () => {
			const done = bests.filter((best) => best !== null);
			const completed = spent.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
			options.onProgress?.(completed);
			if (!done.length) return;
			const leader = done.reduce((left, right) => right.damage > left.damage ? right : left);
			options.onProcess?.({
				phase: "training",
				completed,
				total,
				leaders: [{
					teams: [candidate],
					actions: leader.actions,
					statistics: summarize(done.map((best) => best.damage), bests.length),
					score: Math.max(...done.map((best) => best.damage))
				}]
			});
		};
		const runSeed = async (round, budget) => {
			if (options.signal?.aborted) return;
			spent[round] = 0;
			bests[round] = null;
			const seed = seedFor(round);
			const battle = options.buildBattle(candidate, options.opponent.context, options.mode, seed, options.direction, 0);
			const custom = resolveHeroTeamCustomActions(battle, options.gameLibrary, candidate.teamPet);
			const result = await optimizeStartedBattleTiming({
				battle,
				savedActions: startActions,
				unitIds: candidate.heroes,
				hasTeamPet: candidate.teamPet > 0,
				teamCustomValues: custom.values,
				teamCustomCooldowns: custom.cooldowns,
				minTime: options.ultraMinTime,
				maxTime: options.ultraMaxTime,
				maxCalculations: budget,
				battleStartedAt: 0,
				now: () => 0,
				mode: options.mode,
				signal: options.signal,
				resolveInputByTime: runner.supportsTimeResolvedInput,
				calculate: (prepared, calculationOptions) => runner.simulateBattle(prepared, prepared.progress?.[0]?.attackers?.input ?? [], candidate, options.mode, calculationOptions),
				onProgress: (progress) => {
					spent[round] = progress.completed;
					options.onProgress?.(spent.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0));
				}
			});
			spent[round] = result.calculationCount;
			reserved -= Math.max(0, budget - result.calculationCount);
			bests[round] = {
				damage: result.damage,
				automatic: result.automaticDamage,
				actions: result.actions,
				calculation: result.calculation
			};
			report();
		};
		const parallel = getBattleLabCalcExecutor() ? seeds : 1;
		let next = 0;
		await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(parallel, seeds) }, async () => {
			while (next < MAX_ROUNDS && !options.signal?.aborted) {
				const budget = reserve();
				if (!budget) break;
				await runSeed(next++, budget);
			}
		}));
		const done = bests.filter((best) => best !== null);
		if (!done.length) throw new Error("Тренировка остановлена до первого результата.");
		const leader = done.reduce((left, right) => right.damage > left.damage ? right : left);
		const statistics = summarize(done.map((best) => best.damage), bests.length);
		const score = statistics.scoreMax;
		const reliability = score > 0 ? statistics.scoreMean / score : null;
		const timingImprovement = leader.automatic > 0 ? (leader.damage - leader.automatic) / leader.automatic : null;
		return {
			teams: [candidate],
			score,
			wins: null,
			stars: null,
			actions: leader.actions,
			teamActions: [leader.actions],
			teamTimingImprovements: [timingImprovement],
			teamScores: [score],
			teamReliability: [reliability],
			timingImprovement,
			calculations: [leader.calculation],
			teamResults: ["unknown"],
			confidence: 0,
			statistics,
			calculationCount: spent.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0),
			direction: options.direction,
			scenarioResults: [],
			timingSearch: {
				status: "found",
				tested: spent.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0),
				candidateCount: done.length,
				reason: "Тайминги подобраны отдельно под каждый seed, как перед отправкой боя."
			},
			alternatives: []
		};
	}
	function mean(values) {
		return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / Math.max(1, values.length);
	}
	function summarize(values, attempted) {
		const average = mean(values);
		const deviation = Math.sqrt(values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - average) ** 2, 0) / Math.max(1, values.length));
		return {
			attempted,
			succeeded: values.length,
			failed: 0,
			wins: 0,
			losses: 0,
			unknown: values.length,
			winRate: null,
			scoreMean: average,
			scoreMax: Math.max(...values),
			scoreDeviation: deviation,
			confidenceLow: null,
			confidenceHigh: null
		};
	}
	var MIN_CALCULATIONS_PER_SEED, MAX_SEEDS, MIN_TAIL_CALCULATIONS, MAX_ROUNDS;
	var init_asgard_seed_potential = __esmMin((() => {

		init_team_custom_actions();
		init_started_battle_timing();
		init_calc_executor();

		MAX_SEEDS = 8;
		MIN_TAIL_CALCULATIONS = 3;
		MAX_ROUNDS = 32;
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/scenario-planning.ts
	function planBattleLabScenarios(opponent, direction, settings, history = [], translateGame) {
		if (opponent.modeId === "dominion-rift") return buildDominionRiftScenarios(opponent, settings);
		if (isTitanArenaMode(opponent.modeId) && direction === "defense") {
			const defenseScenarios = buildTournamentDefenseScenarios(opponent, history, translateGame);
			if (defenseScenarios.length > 0) {
				if (defenseScenarios.some((scenario) => scenario.id.includes(":defense:rival:"))) return defenseScenarios;
				return selectEvenly(defenseScenarios, settings.tournamentDefenseScenarios);
			}
		}
		if (opponent.scenarios && opponent.scenarios.length > 0) return opponent.scenarios.map(cloneScenario);
		return [{
			id: `${opponent.id}:default`,
			label: opponent.name,
			context: structuredClone(opponent.context),
			weight: 1,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			buff: null
		}];
	}
	function buildDominionRiftScenarios(opponent, settings) {
		const minimum = Math.min(settings.dominionRiftMinBuff, settings.dominionRiftMaxBuff);
		const maximum = Math.max(settings.dominionRiftMinBuff, settings.dominionRiftMaxBuff);
		const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(settings.dominionRiftBuffStep));
		const buffs = [];
		for (let buff = minimum; buff <= maximum; buff += step) buffs.push(buff);
		if (buffs.at(-1) !== maximum) buffs.push(maximum);
		return buffs.map((buff) => ({
			id: `${opponent.id}:buff:${buff}`,
			label: String(buff),
			context: withInvasionBuff(opponent.context, buff),
			weight: 1,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			buff
		}));
	}
	function buildTournamentDefenseScenarios(opponent, history = [], translateGame) {
		const root = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot);
		const rivals = asRecord$1(root.rivals ?? opponent.context.rivals);
		const sources = [];
		Object.entries(rivals).forEach(([key, value], index) => {
			const rival = asRecord$1(value);
			const team = rival.titans ?? rival.team ?? rival.rivalTeam ?? rival.attackers ?? rival.defenders ?? rival.defenceTeam ?? rival.defenseTeam;
			if (Object.keys(asRecord$1(team)).length === 0 && !Array.isArray(team)) return;
			const id = titanArenaRivalId(rival, key) ?? key;
			sources.push({
				id: `rival:${id}`,
				label: titanArenaRivalName(rival, id, translateGame),
				team,
				seed: finiteNumber$1(rival.seed, index + 1),
				context: rival
			});
		});
		if (sources.length > 0) return toTournamentDefenseScenarios(opponent, sources);
		const explicitAttackers = opponent.context.defenseAttackers ?? root.defenseAttackers ?? root.attackers;
		for (const [index, team] of toTeamSources(explicitAttackers).entries()) sources.push({
			id: `server:${index}`,
			label: `Серверная атака ${index + 1}`,
			team,
			seed: index + 10001
		});
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (!isTitanArenaMode(entry.modeId) || (entry.direction ?? "attack") !== "attack" || !entry.battleSnapshot) continue;
			extractHistoryBattles(entry.battleSnapshot).forEach((battle, index) => {
				if (battle.attackers == null) return;
				sources.push({
					id: `history:${entry.id}:${index}`,
					label: `${entry.opponentName} · ${entry.platformId}`,
					team: battle.attackers,
					seed: finiteNumber$1(battle.seed, entry.seed ?? entry.createdAt + index)
				});
			});
		}
		return toTournamentDefenseScenarios(opponent, sources);
	}
	function toTournamentDefenseScenarios(opponent, sources) {
		const unique = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const source of sources) {
			const signature = unitSignature(source.team);
			if (!signature) continue;
			const key = source.id.startsWith("rival:") ? source.id : signature;
			unique.set(key, source);
		}

			id: `${opponent.id}:defense:${source.id}`,
			label: source.label,
			context: {
				...opponent.context,
				...source.context,
				defenders: source.team,
				rivalId: source.id,
				typeId: source.id,
				seed: source.seed
			},
			weight: 1,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			buff: null
		}));
	}
	function withInvasionBuff(context, buff) {
		const normalizedBuff = Math.max(0, Math.min(300, Math.floor(buff)));
		const effects = asRecord$1(context.effects);
		const attackers = { ...asRecord$1(effects.attackers) };
		if (normalizedBuff > 0) attackers[INVASION_BUFF_EFFECT] = normalizedBuff;
		else delete attackers[INVASION_BUFF_EFFECT];
		return {
			...structuredClone(context),
			effects: {
				...effects,
				attackers
			},
			__battleLabBuff: normalizedBuff
		};
	}
	function selectEvenly(values, limit) {
		const count = Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit));
		if (values.length <= count) return [...values];
		if (count === 1) return [values[Math.floor((values.length - 1) / 2)]];
		const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) result.add(values[Math.round(index * (values.length - 1) / (count - 1))]);
		return [...result];
	}
	function selectScenarioByRound(scenarios, round) {
		if (scenarios.length === 0) return null;
		if (scenarios.length === 1) return scenarios[0];
		const normalizedRound = Math.max(0, Math.floor(round));
		const fraction = normalizedRound === 0 ? 0 : normalizedRound === 1 ? 1 - Number.EPSILON : radicalInverseBase2(normalizedRound - 1);
		const weights = scenarios.map((scenario) => Math.max(0, scenario.weight));
		const totalWeight = weights.reduce((total, weight) => total + weight, 0);
		if (totalWeight <= 0) return scenarios[Math.min(scenarios.length - 1, Math.floor(fraction * scenarios.length))];
		const target = fraction * totalWeight;
		let cumulative = 0;
		for (let index = 0; index < scenarios.length; index += 1) {
			cumulative += weights[index];
			if (target < cumulative || index === scenarios.length - 1) return scenarios[index];
		}
		return scenarios.at(-1) ?? null;
	}
	function radicalInverseBase2(value) {
		let source = Math.max(0, Math.floor(value));
		let result = 0;
		let denominator = 2;
		while (source > 0) {
			result += source % 2 / denominator;
			source = Math.floor(source / 2);
			denominator *= 2;
		}
		return result;
	}
	function cloneScenario(scenario) {
		return {
			...scenario,
			context: structuredClone(scenario.context)
		};
	}
	function toTeamSources(value) {
		if (value == null) return [];
		if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [value];
		if (value.length === 0) return [];
		return value.every((item) => Number.isSafeInteger(Number(asRecord$1(item).id))) ? [value] : value;
	}
	function extractHistoryBattles(value) {
		const snapshot = asRecord$1(value);
		return (Array.isArray(snapshot.battles) ? snapshot.battles : [snapshot]).map((source) => {
			const record = asRecord$1(source);
			return asRecord$1(record.battleData ?? record.battle ?? record);
		}).filter((battle) => battle.attackers != null && battle.defenders != null);
	}
	function unitSignature(value) {
		const ids = [];
		const queue = [value];
		const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		while (queue.length > 0) {
			const current = queue.shift();
			if (!current || typeof current !== "object" || visited.has(current)) continue;
			visited.add(current);
			if (Array.isArray(current)) {
				queue.push(...current);
				continue;
			}
			const record = asRecord$1(current);
			const id = Number(record.id);
			if (Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0) ids.push(id);
			else queue.push(...Object.values(record));
		}
		return [...new Set(ids)].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",");
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/budget.ts
	function isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error) {
		return error instanceof BattleLabBudgetExhaustedError;
	}
	function now() {
		return globalThis.performance?.now?.() ?? Date.now();
	}
	async function yieldToBrowser() {
		const scheduler = globalThis.scheduler;
		if (typeof scheduler?.yield === "function") {
			await scheduler.yield();
			return;
		}
		if (canYieldWithMessageChannel()) {
			await yieldWithMessageChannel();
			return;
		}
		await new Promise((resolve) => globalThis.setTimeout(resolve, 0));
	}
	/**
	* Цепочка setTimeout(0) после пятой вложенности зажимается до 4 мс, а в фоновой
	* вкладке до секунды и больше. Сообщение порта таких ограничений не имеет.
	* Только в браузере: в Bun/Node открытый порт держал бы процесс живым.
	*/
	function canYieldWithMessageChannel() {
		return typeof globalThis.MessageChannel === "function" && typeof globalThis.document !== "undefined";
	}
	function yieldWithMessageChannel() {
		if (!yieldChannel) {
			yieldChannel = new MessageChannel();
			yieldChannel.port1.addEventListener("message", () => pendingYields.shift()?.());
			yieldChannel.port1.start();
		}
		const channel = yieldChannel;
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			pendingYields.push(resolve);
			channel.port2.postMessage(null);
		});
	}

		init_profiler();

		BattleLabBudgetExhaustedError = class extends Error {
			constructor() {
				super("Лимит штатных симуляций исчерпан.");
				this.name = "BattleLabBudgetExhaustedError";
			}
		};
		CalculationBudget = class {
			constructor(max, onProgress, signal) {
				_defineProperty(this, "max", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "onProgress", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "signal", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "count", 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "calculationsSinceYield", 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "lastYieldAt", now());
				this.max = max;
				this.onProgress = onProgress;
				this.signal = signal;
			}
			canRun(amount = 1) {
				return !this.signal?.aborted && this.count + Math.max(1, Math.floor(amount)) <= this.max;
			}
			register() {
				throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(this.signal);
				if (!this.canRun()) throw new BattleLabBudgetExhaustedError();
				this.count += 1;
				this.calculationsSinceYield += 1;
				this.onProgress?.(this.count);
			}
			async acquire() {
				throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(this.signal);
				this.register();
				const currentTime = now();
				if (this.calculationsSinceYield < 4 && currentTime - this.lastYieldAt < 8) return;
				this.calculationsSinceYield = 0;
				this.lastYieldAt = currentTime;
				if (!isBattleLabProfileActive()) {
					await yieldToBrowser();
					return;
				}
				const yieldStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
				await yieldToBrowser();
				readPerformanceTime() - yieldStartedAt;
			}
		};
		yieldChannel = null;
		pendingYields = [];
	}));

	/**
	* Нельзя отдавать в Haxe Calc нового титана в старом заполненном titan-lib.
	* Для героев и питомцев библиотека может загружаться отдельным контуром, а
	* таблица skills — лениво; их отсутствие только диагностируем. У титана
	* отсутствующий навык в заполненной таблице — фатальная дыра: Haxe Calc
	* падает на первом срабатывании пассивки с `null.w`.
	*/
	function filterBattleLabCandidatesByLibrary(candidates, index) {
		const gaps = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const libraryState = resolveLibraryState(index);
		const unitGaps = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const describeCachedUnitGap = (unit) => {
			if (!unitGaps.has(unit)) unitGaps.set(unit, describeUnitGap(unit, index, libraryState));
			return unitGaps.get(unit) ?? null;
		};
		return {
			candidates: candidates.filter((candidate) => {
				const candidateGaps = candidateUnits(candidate, index).map(describeCachedUnitGap).filter((gap) => gap !== null);
				candidateGaps.forEach((gap) => gaps.set(`${gap.type}:${gap.id}`, gap));
				return candidateGaps.every((gap) => !gap.missingUnitDefinition && !(gap.type === "titan" && gap.missingSkillIds.length > 0));
			}),
			gaps: [...gaps.values()]
		};
	}
	/** Раньше Object.keys всей таблицы навыков строился заново на каждый навык. */
	function resolveLibraryState(index) {
		return {
			hasTitanLibrary: hasOwnEntries$1(index.titanLib),
			hasSkillLibrary: hasOwnEntries$1(index.skillLib)
		};
	}
	function hasOwnEntries$1(record) {
		for (const key in record) if (Object.hasOwn(record, key)) return true;
		return false;
	}
	function candidateUnits(candidate, index) {
		if (candidate.type === "titan") return candidate.titans.flatMap((id) => resolveAccountUnit(index.accountTitans, id));
		const ids = new Set(candidate.heroes);
		if (candidate.teamPet > 0) ids.add(candidate.teamPet);
		Object.values(candidate.favor).forEach((petId) => {
			if (petId > 0) ids.add(petId);
		});
		return [...ids].flatMap((id) => id >= 6e3 ? resolveAccountUnit(index.accountPets, id) : resolveAccountUnit(index.accountHeroes, id));
	}
	function resolveAccountUnit(units, id) {
		const unit = units[String(id)];
		return unit && typeof unit === "object" ? [unit] : [];
	}
	function describeUnitGap(unit, index, libraryState) {
		const missingUnitDefinition = unit.type === "titan" && libraryState.hasTitanLibrary && index.getTitanLib(unit.id) === null;
		const missingSkillIds = libraryState.hasSkillLibrary ? index.getUnitSkillIds(unit).filter((skillId) => index.getSkill(skillId) === null) : [];
		return missingUnitDefinition || missingSkillIds.length > 0 ? {
			id: unit.id,
			type: unit.type,
			missingUnitDefinition,
			missingSkillIds
		} : null;
	}

	function findMaxDisjointLineups(lineups, targetCount) {
		let bestSet = [];
		let bestScore = -1;
		function search(startIndex, currentSet, currentScore, usedMask) {
			if (currentSet.length > bestSet.length || currentSet.length === bestSet.length && currentScore > bestScore) {
				bestSet = [...currentSet];
				bestScore = currentScore;
			}
			if (bestSet.length >= targetCount) return;
			for (let i = startIndex; i < lineups.length; i++) {
				if (currentSet.length + (lineups.length - i) < bestSet.length) return;
				const item = lineups[i];
				let overlaps = false;
				for (const id of item.ids) if (usedMask.has(id)) {
					overlaps = true;
					break;
				}
				if (overlaps) continue;
				for (const id of item.ids) usedMask.add(id);
				currentSet.push(item);
				search(i + 1, currentSet, currentScore + item.score, usedMask);
				currentSet.pop();
				for (const id of item.ids) usedMask.delete(id);
				if (bestSet.length >= targetCount) return;
			}
		}
		search(0, [], 0, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set());
		return bestSet;
	}
	/**
	* Подбирает лучшие мета-пачки на текущего босса Асгарда, полностью опираясь на доступных
	* и прокачанных героев на аккаунте игрока.
	* Возвращает упорядоченный список пятерок героев (по 5 ID в каждой).
	*/
	function selectAsgardArchetypeLineups(accountHeroes, maxLineups = 24, bossUnitId = null) {
		const archetypes = listAsgardArchetypes(bossUnitId);
		const isAvailable = (id) => {
			const hero = accountHeroes[String(id)];
			if (!hero) return false;
			if (hero.isDead === true) return false;
			return true;
		};
		const getHeroPower = (id) => {
			const hero = accountHeroes[String(id)];
			return finiteNumber$1(hero?.power, 0);
		};
		const getHeroLevel = (id) => {
			const hero = accountHeroes[String(id)];
			return positiveInteger(hero?.level) ?? 1;
		};
		const scoredMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const archetypeBuckets = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const archetype of archetypes) {
			const bucket = [];
			const addLineup = (lineup, tierWeight) => {
				if (lineup.length !== 5) return;
				if (!lineup.every(isAvailable)) return;
				const key = [...lineup].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
				const existing = scoredMap.get(key);
				if (existing) {
					bucket.push(existing);
					return;
				}
				const powers = lineup.map(getHeroPower);
				const levels = lineup.map(getHeroLevel);
				const totalPower = powers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0);
				const minLevel = Math.min(...levels);
				const avgLevel = levels.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l, 0) / 5;
				const levelPenalty = minLevel < 30 ? .35 : minLevel < 70 ? .75 : 1;
				const score = tierWeight * (totalPower + avgLevel * 500) * levelPenalty;
				const entry = {
					ids: [...lineup],
					score
				};
				scoredMap.set(key, entry);
				bucket.push(entry);
			};
			for (const lineup of archetype.lineups) addLineup(lineup, archetype.tierWeight);
			if (archetype.core && archetype.flex && archetype.core.every(isAvailable)) {
				const availableFlex = archetype.flex.filter((id) => isAvailable(id) && !archetype.core.includes(id));
				const needed = 5 - archetype.core.length;
				if (needed > 0 && availableFlex.length >= needed) {
					const sortedFlex = [...availableFlex].sort((a, b) => getHeroPower(b) - getHeroPower(a));
					for (let i = 0; i <= sortedFlex.length - needed && i < 3; i++) addLineup([...archetype.core, ...sortedFlex.slice(i, i + needed)], archetype.tierWeight * .95);
				}
			}
			archetypeBuckets.set(archetype.id, bucket.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score));
		}
		const allScored = [...scoredMap.values()].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
		const selectedKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const diverseLineups = [];
		for (const ids of ASGARD_CONTROL_LINEUPS) {
			if (!ids.every(isAvailable)) continue;
			selectedKeys.add([...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(","));
			diverseLineups.push([...ids]);
		}
		const disjointTop = findMaxDisjointLineups(allScored, 5);
		for (const entry of disjointTop) {
			const key = [...entry.ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			if (selectedKeys.has(key)) continue;
			selectedKeys.add(key);
			diverseLineups.push(entry.ids);
		}
		const maxPerArchetype = Math.max(2, Math.floor(maxLineups / Math.max(1, archetypes.length)) + 1);
		for (let rank = 0; rank < maxPerArchetype; rank++) for (const bucket of archetypeBuckets.values()) {
			const entry = bucket[rank];
			if (entry) {
				const key = [...entry.ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
				if (!selectedKeys.has(key)) {
					selectedKeys.add(key);
					diverseLineups.push(entry.ids);
				}
			}
		}
		for (const entry of allScored) {
			if (diverseLineups.length >= maxLineups) break;
			const key = [...entry.ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			if (!selectedKeys.has(key)) {
				selectedKeys.add(key);
				diverseLineups.push(entry.ids);
			}
		}
		return diverseLineups.slice(0, maxLineups);
	}

	/**

	function resolveAsgardBossUnitId(context) {

	/**
	* Рекомендованная поддержка для состава: из архетипа, чей шаблон совпадает с
	* составом или чьё ядро в нём целиком. Покровители — только для героев состава.
	*/
	function findAsgardArchetypeSupport(lineup, bossUnitId) {
		const heroes = new Set(lineup);
		const key = [...lineup].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
		const archetype = listAsgardArchetypes(bossUnitId).find((item) => (item.teamPets?.length || item.favor) && (item.lineups.some((ids) => [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",") === key) || item.core?.length && item.core.every((id) => heroes.has(id))));
		if (!archetype) return null;
		return {
			teamPets: [...archetype.teamPets ?? []],
			favor: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(archetype.favor ?? {}).filter(([hero]) => heroes.has(Number(hero))))
		};

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/fixed-team-candidates.ts
	/** Дополняет ручную часть до пяти героев, затем перебирает поддержку полного состава. */
	function generateAsgardSlotCandidates(options, required, context, support, preferredLineups = []) {
		if (required.length === 5) return generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [[...required]], context, options.mode, [support]);
		const remaining = 5 - required.length;
		const manual = new Set(required);
		const freeAccount = {
			...options.account,
			heroes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(options.account.heroes)).filter(([id]) => !manual.has(Number(id)))),
			teamPresets: {}
		};
		const generator = new TeamCandidateGenerator(new GameDataIndex({
			libs: options.gameLibrary,
			account: freeAccount
		}), {
			...options.mode,
			minUnits: remaining,
			maxUnits: remaining,
			allowTeamPet: false,
			allowFavorPets: false,
			allowBanner: false
		}, {
			heroPoolSize: Math.max(30, Object.keys(freeAccount.heroes).length),
			maxTeamCandidates: 192,
			teamBeamWidth: 512
		});
		const lineups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const allHeroes = new GameDataIndex({
			libs: options.gameLibrary,
			account: options.account
		}).listAccountHeroes();
		const available = new Set(allHeroes.map((hero) => hero.id));
		for (const lineup of preferredLineups) if (lineup.length === 5 && new Set(lineup).size === 5 && lineup.every((id) => available.has(id)) && required.every((id) => lineup.includes(id))) lineups.set([...lineup].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(","), [...lineup]);
		for (const heroes of selectAsgardArchetypeLineups(Object.fromEntries(allHeroes.map((hero) => [hero.id, hero])), 40, resolveAsgardBossUnitId(context))) if (required.every((id) => heroes.includes(id))) lineups.set([...heroes].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(","), heroes);
		for (const candidate of generator.generate(context)) {
			if (candidate.type !== "hero" || candidate.heroes.length !== remaining) continue;
			const heroes = [...required, ...candidate.heroes];
			const key = [...heroes].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			lineups.set(key, heroes);
		}
		const generated = generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [...lineups.values()], context, options.mode, [...lineups.values()].map(() => support));
		return [...archetypeSupportCandidates(options, [...lineups.values()], context, support), ...generated].filter(uniqueCandidate());
	}
	/**
	* Поддержка из рекордных боёв архетипа (питомец пачки и покровители) идёт
	* первой: при узком бюджете скрининг иначе не доходит до неё по эвристике силы.
	* Ручной выбор строки важнее рекомендации.
	*/
	function archetypeSupportCandidates(options, lineups, context, support) {
		if (support?.teamPet !== void 0 && support.teamPet !== "auto") return [];
		const owned = asRecord$1(options.account.pets);
		const bossUnitId = resolveAsgardBossUnitId(context);
		return lineups.flatMap((lineup) => {
			const preferred = findAsgardArchetypeSupport(lineup, bossUnitId);
			if (!preferred) return [];
			const favor = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(preferred.favor).filter(([hero, pet]) => owned[String(pet)] && support?.favor?.[hero] === void 0).map(([hero, pet]) => [hero, pet]));
			return preferred.teamPets.filter((pet) => owned[String(pet)]).flatMap((teamPet) => {
				try {
					return generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [lineup], context, options.mode, [{
						...support,
						teamPet,
						banner: support?.banner ?? "auto",
						favor: {
							...support?.favor,
							...favor
						}
					}]).slice(0, 2);
				} catch {
					return [];
				}
			});
		});
	}
	function uniqueCandidate() {
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		return (candidate) => {
			const key = candidate.type === "hero" ? JSON.stringify([
				[...candidate.heroes].sort((a, b) => a - b),
				candidate.teamPet,
				Object.entries(candidate.favor).sort()
			]) : JSON.stringify([...candidate.titans].sort((a, b) => a - b));
			if (seen.has(key)) return false;
			seen.add(key);
			return true;
		};
	}
	function generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, teams, context, mode = options.mode, supports = []) {
		return teams.flatMap((ids, teamIndex) => {
			const allowed = new Set(ids);
			const rosterKey = mode.unitType === "titan" ? "titans" : "heroes";
			const account = {
				...options.account,
				[rosterKey]: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(options.account[rosterKey])).filter(([id]) => allowed.has(Number(id)))),
				teamPresets: {}
			};
			const generator = new TeamCandidateGenerator(new GameDataIndex({
				libs: options.gameLibrary,
				account
			}), {
				...mode,
				minUnits: ids.length,
				maxUnits: ids.length
			}, {
				maxTeamCandidates: 192,
				topFavorAssignmentsPerTeam: 12,
				topTeamPets: Math.max(1, Object.keys(asRecord$1(options.account.pets)).length + 1),
				topBanners: Math.max(1, Object.keys(asRecord$1(options.account.banners)).length)
			});
			const support = supports[teamIndex];
			const favorAssignments = buildFixedFavorAssignments(generator, ids, support?.favor, support?.fillEmptySlots);
			const petIds = Object.keys(asRecord$1(options.account.pets)).map(Number);
			const bannerIds = Object.keys(asRecord$1(options.account.banners)).map(Number);
			let matching = generator.generate(context, {
				forbiddenTeamPets: forbiddenSupportIds(petIds, support?.teamPet),
				forbiddenBanners: forbiddenSupportIds(bannerIds, support?.banner),
				...favorAssignments ? { forbiddenFavorPets: petIds } : {}
			}).filter((candidate) => {
				const units = candidate.type === "titan" ? candidate.titans : candidate.heroes;
				return units.length === ids.length && units.every((id) => allowed.has(id)) && (candidate.type === "titan" || matchesSupport(candidate.teamPet, support?.teamPet, mode.allowTeamPet) && matchesSupport(candidate.banner, support?.banner, mode.allowBanner));
			});
			if (support?.fillEmptySlots && matching.some((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero" && candidate.teamPet > 0)) matching = matching.filter((candidate) => candidate.type !== "hero" || candidate.teamPet > 0);
			if (!favorAssignments) return matching;
			return matching.flatMap((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero" ? favorAssignments.map((assignment) => ({
				...candidate,
				favor: assignment.favor,
				approxScore: candidate.approxScore + assignment.score
			})) : [candidate]);
		});
	}
	/** Закрепляет ручных покровителей до top-K, оставляя автоподбор свободным героям. */
	function buildFixedFavorAssignments(generator, ids, selections, fillEmptySlots = false) {
		if (!generator.mode.allowFavorPets || !selections && !fillEmptySlots) return null;
		selections ?? (selections = {});
		const manual = ids.filter((id) => selections[id] !== void 0 && selections[id] !== "auto");
		if (manual.length === 0 && !fillEmptySlots) return null;
		const heroes = generator.index.listAccountHeroes();
		const pets = generator.index.listAccountPets();
		const favor = {};
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let score = 0;
		for (const heroId of manual) {
			const petId = selections[heroId];
			if (petId === null) continue;
			const hero = heroes.find((unit) => unit.id === heroId);
			const pet = pets.find((unit) => unit.id === petId);
			if (!hero || !pet || !generator.petOptimizer.canFavor(heroId, petId)) throw new Error(`Покровитель #${petId} недоступен для героя #${heroId}.`);
			if (used.has(pet.id)) throw new Error(`Покровитель #${pet.id} указан у нескольких героев пачки.`);
			used.add(pet.id);
			favor[heroId] = pet.id;
			score += generator.petOptimizer.scoreFavor(hero, pet);
		}
		const freeHeroes = heroes.filter((hero) => ids.includes(hero.id) && !manual.includes(hero.id));
		return generator.petOptimizer.buildAssignments(freeHeroes, {
			topPerHero: fillEmptySlots ? pets.length + 1 : generator.config.topFavorPetsPerHero,
			limit: generator.config.topFavorAssignmentsPerTeam,
			forbiddenPets: [...used],
			preferFilledSlots: fillEmptySlots
		}).map((assignment) => ({
			favor: {
				...assignment.favor,
				...favor
			},
			score: assignment.score + score
		}));
	}
	function forbiddenSupportIds(available, selection) {
		if (selection === void 0 || selection === "auto") return [];
		if (selection === null) return [...available];
		return available.filter((id) => id !== selection);
	}
	function matchesSupport(actual, selection, allowed) {
		if (!allowed || selection === void 0 || selection === "auto") return true;
		return actual === (selection ?? 0);
	}

	function createBattleSnapshotVector(score, win, damage = 0, stars = 0, battleTime = 0, hpRemaining = 0, damageTaken = 0, seed = 0) {
		const vec = /* @__PURE__ */ new Float64Array(8);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.SCORE] = finiteNumber$1(score);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.WIN] = win === true ? 1 : win === false ? 0 : -1;
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.DAMAGE] = finiteNumber$1(damage);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.STARS] = finiteNumber$1(stars);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.BATTLE_TIME] = finiteNumber$1(battleTime);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.HP_REMAINING] = finiteNumber$1(hpRemaining);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.DAMAGE_TAKEN] = finiteNumber$1(damageTaken);
		vec[BATTLE_VECTOR.SEED] = finiteNumber$1(seed);
		return vec;
	}
	/**
	* Читает урон боссу из блока defenders.extra (если Calc вел счетчик).
	*/
	function readBossDamageFromCalculation(calculation) {
		const first = asRecord$1((Array.isArray(calculation.progress) ? calculation.progress : [])[0]);
		const defenders = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(first.defenders).heroes ?? asRecord$1(first.defenders).units);
		let best = 0;
		for (const def of Object.values(defenders)) {
			const extra = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(def).extra);
			const dmg = finiteNumber$1(extra.damageTaken) + finiteNumber$1(extra.damageTakenNextLevel);
			if (dmg > best) best = dmg;
		}
		return best;
	}
	/**
	* Читает оставшееся здоровье и полученный урон атакующих из последнего кадра.
	*/
	function extractAttackerHealth(calculation) {
		const last = asRecord$1((Array.isArray(calculation.progress) ? calculation.progress : []).at(-1));
		const attackers = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(last.attackers).heroes ?? asRecord$1(last.attackers).units ?? asRecord$1(last.attackers).titans);
		let hpRemaining = 0;
		let damageTaken = 0;
		for (const att of Object.values(attackers)) {
			const s = asRecord$1(att);
			hpRemaining += finiteNumber$1(s.hp);
			const extra = asRecord$1(s.extra);
			damageTaken += finiteNumber$1(extra.damageTaken) + finiteNumber$1(extra.damageTakenNextLevel);
		}
		return {
			hpRemaining,
			damageTaken
		};
	}
	/**
	* Сжимает тяжелый снимок боя Calc в компактный вектор чисел Float64Array.
	*/
	function extractBattleSnapshotVector(calculation, score, win, seed) {
		const outcome = asRecord$1(calculation.result ?? calculation.battle?.result);
		const stars = finiteNumber$1(outcome.stars);
		const battleTime = finiteNumber$1(calculation.battleTime ?? calculation.battleTimer);
		let damage = finiteNumber$1(outcome.damage);
		if (damage <= 0) damage = readBossDamageFromCalculation(calculation);
		if (damage <= 0 && score > 0) damage = score;
		const { hpRemaining, damageTaken } = extractAttackerHealth(calculation);
		return createBattleSnapshotVector(score, win, damage, stars, battleTime, hpRemaining, damageTaken, seed);
	}
	/**
	* Очищает Calc-снимок от многомегабайтного battleLogs и промежуточного progress,
	* сохраняя только необходимые поля для реплея/таймингов (battleData, result, timeline).
	*/
	function compactBattleCalculation(calculation, retainTiming = true) {
		const summary = {
			battleData: calculation.battleData ?? calculation.battle,
			result: calculation.result ?? calculation.battle?.result,
			battleTime: calculation.battleTime,
			battleTimer: calculation.battleTimer
		};
		if (!retainTiming) return summary;
		const signals = new ThreatWindowExtractor().extract(calculation);
		const threats = new Set(signals.threats.map((threat) => threat.event));
		const timingEvents = signals.events.filter((event) => event.isEnergy || event.isCastLike || event.isDeathLike || threats.has(event)).map((event) => ({
			...event,
			raw: {}
		}));
		return {
			...summary,
			timeline: calculation.timeline?.length ? calculation.timeline : resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(calculation),
			timingEvents
		};
	}
	function createBattleLabRetainedSeries(initial = [], maxRetained = 16) {
		const series = {
			samples: [],
			observation: createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(),
			bestSample: null
		};
		for (const sample of initial) appendBattleLabRetainedSample(series, sample, maxRetained);
		return series;
	}
	function appendBattleLabRetainedSample(series, sample, maxRetained = 16) {
		appendBattleLabSample(series.observation, sample);
		const sampleVector = sample.vector ?? createBattleSnapshotVector(sample.score, sample.win);
		series.vector = sampleVector;
		if (!series.bestSample || sample.score > series.bestSample.score) {
			series.bestSample = sample;
			series.bestValues = {
				score: sample.score,
				win: sample.win,
				damage: sampleVector[BATTLE_VECTOR.DAMAGE],
				stars: sampleVector[BATTLE_VECTOR.STARS],
				actions: sample.actions ?? [],
				seed: sampleVector[BATTLE_VECTOR.SEED],
				vector: sampleVector
			};
		}
		series.samples.push(sample);
		if (series.samples.length > maxRetained) series.samples.splice(0, series.samples.length - maxRetained);
	}
	function createBattleLabCandidateResult(candidate, initial = []) {
		const series = createBattleLabRetainedSeries(initial, 1);
		return {
			candidate,
			vector: series.vector,
			bestValues: series.bestValues,
			samples: series.bestSample ? [series.bestSample] : [],
			observation: series.observation,
			bestSample: series.bestSample,
			failed: 0
		};
	}
	function appendBattleLabCandidateSample(result, sample) {
		appendBattleLabSample(ensureBattleLabCandidateObservation(result), sample);
		const sampleVector = sample.vector ?? createBattleSnapshotVector(sample.score, sample.win, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, sample.seed);
		result.vector = sampleVector;
		if (!result.bestSample || sample.score > result.bestSample.score) {
			result.bestSample = sample;
			result.bestValues = {
				score: sample.score,
				win: sample.win,
				damage: sampleVector[BATTLE_VECTOR.DAMAGE],
				stars: sampleVector[BATTLE_VECTOR.STARS],
				actions: sample.actions ?? [],
				seed: sample.seed,
				vector: sampleVector
			};
		}
		result.samples = [result.bestSample ?? sample];
	}
	function ensureBattleLabCandidateObservation(result) {
		if (!result.observation) result.observation = createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(result.samples);
		return result.observation;
	}
	function battleLabCandidateAttempts(result) {
		return ensureBattleLabCandidateObservation(result).count + result.failed;
	}
	function summarizeBattleLabCandidate(result, binaryOutcome) {
		return summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(ensureBattleLabCandidateObservation(result), result.failed, binaryOutcome);
	}
	function selectBattleLabCandidateBestSample(result) {
		if (result.bestSample) return result.bestSample;
		const best = result.samples.reduce((current, sample) => !current || sample.score > current.score ? sample : current, null);
		result.bestSample = best;
		return best;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/task-pool.ts
	/**
	* Запускает прогоны по мере освобождения Calc-воркеров. Порядок старта
	* сохраняется, порядок завершения нет: задача сама пишет итог в свой агрегат.
	* Первая ошибка останавливает выдачу задач, но уже запущенные доживают до конца.
	*/
	async function runBattleLabTaskPool({ concurrency, next, run }) {
		const running = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let failure = null;
		for (;;) {
			while (running.size < Math.max(1, Math.floor(concurrency()))) {
				if (failure) break;
				try {
					const task = next(running.size);
					if (task === null) break;
					const execution = run(task).then(() => {
						running.delete(execution);
					}, (error) => {
						running.delete(execution);
						failure ?? (failure = { error });
					});
					running.add(execution);
				} catch (error) {
					failure ?? (failure = { error });
					break;
				}
			}
			if (running.size === 0) break;
			await Promise.race(running);
		}
		if (failure) throw failure.error;
	}
	/**
	* Запущенная задача могла ещё не списать свои Calc из бюджета, поэтому
	* резервируем их заранее: параллельный хвост фазы не выходит за лимит.
	*/
	function hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, calculationsPerTask = 1, reserve = 0) {
		return budget.canRun(Math.max(1, Math.floor(calculationsPerTask)) + Math.max(0, Math.floor(reserve)));
	}

	function selectReplacementSupportVariants(variants, evaluated, limit = REPLACEMENT_SUPPORT_VARIANTS) {
		return variants.filter((variant) => !evaluated.has(battleLabCandidateKey(variant))).slice(0, Math.max(1, limit));
	}
	/** Уточняет поддержки и замены ограниченным пулом Calc; новые родители выбираются между этапами. */
	async function refineDamageTeams({ options, budget, results, generated, rank, simulate, onUpdate, concurrency = () => 1 }) {
		if (options.mode.objective !== "max_damage" || options.mode.unitType !== "hero" || options.fixedTeams?.length) return;
		const allowance = Math.floor(budget.max * .12);
		const end = Math.min(budget.max, budget.count + allowance);
		if (allowance < 4) return;
		const roster = Object.values(asRecord$1(options.account.heroes)).map((unit) => Number(asRecord$1(unit).id)).filter((id) => id > 0);
		const leaders = () => {
			const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			return rank([...results.values()]).filter((entry) => {
				if (entry.candidate.type !== "hero") return false;
				const key = heroLineupKey(entry.candidate.heroes);
				if (seen.has(key)) return false;
				seen.add(key);
				return true;
			}).slice(0, 4);
		};
		/** Родители следующей фазы выбираются после всех ответов текущей, как в последовательном поиске. */
		const evaluate = async (candidates, phaseEnd) => {
			const iterator = candidates[Symbol.iterator]();
			try {
				await runBattleLabTaskPool({
					concurrency,
					next: () => {
						while (budget.count < phaseEnd && budget.canRun()) {
							throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(options.signal);
							const next = iterator.next();
							if (next.done) return null;
							const key = battleLabCandidateKey(next.value);
							if (results.has(key)) continue;
							const aggregate = createBattleLabCandidateResult(next.value);
							results.set(key, aggregate);
							return aggregate;
						}
						return null;
					},
					run: async (aggregate) => {
						await simulate(aggregate);
						onUpdate();
					}
				});
				throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(options.signal);
			} finally {
				iterator.return?.();
			}
		};
		const supportEnd = Math.min(end, budget.count + Math.floor(allowance / 3));
		const supportGroups = leaders().map((entry) => generated.filter((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero" && entry.candidate.type === "hero" && heroLineupKey(candidate.heroes) === heroLineupKey(entry.candidate.heroes)));
		function* supportCandidates() {
			for (let variant = 0; supportGroups.some((group) => group.length > variant); variant += 1) for (const group of supportGroups) if (group[variant]) yield group[variant];
		}
		await evaluate(supportCandidates(), supportEnd);
		const generatedLineups = new Set([...results.values()].flatMap((entry) => entry.candidate.type === "hero" ? [heroLineupKey(entry.candidate.heroes)] : []));
		const pairEnd = Math.min(end, budget.count + Math.max(2, Math.floor((end - budget.count) * PAIR_REPLACEMENT_BUDGET_RATIO)));
		const pairProposals = leaders().map((entry) => entry.candidate.type === "hero" ? iterateHeroReplacementPairs(entry.candidate.heroes, roster) : iterateHeroReplacementPairs([], []));
		function* pairCandidates() {
			let pairsRemaining = true;
			while (pairsRemaining) {
				pairsRemaining = false;
				for (const group of pairProposals) {
					throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(options.signal);
					const next = group.next();
					if (next.done) continue;
					pairsRemaining = true;
					const ids = next.value;
					if (options.compositionRequiredHeroes?.some((id) => !ids.includes(id))) continue;
					const key = heroLineupKey(ids);
					if (generatedLineups.has(key)) continue;
					generatedLineups.add(key);
					yield* selectReplacementSupportVariants(generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [ids], options.opponent.context, options.mode, [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[0]]), results);
				}
			}
		}
		await evaluate(pairCandidates(), pairEnd);
		for (let generation = 0; generation < 2 && budget.count < end && budget.canRun(); generation += 1) {
			const generationEnd = generation === 0 ? budget.count + Math.ceil((end - budget.count) / 2) : end;
			const proposals = leaders().map((entry) => entry.candidate.type === "hero" ? buildHeroReplacements(entry.candidate.heroes, roster, generation) : []);
			function* replacementCandidates() {
				for (let position = 0; proposals.some((group) => group.length > position); position += 1) for (const group of proposals) {
					throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(options.signal);
					const ids = group[position];
					if (!ids) continue;
					if (options.compositionRequiredHeroes?.some((id) => !ids.includes(id))) continue;
					const key = heroLineupKey(ids);
					if (generatedLineups.has(key)) continue;
					generatedLineups.add(key);
					yield* selectReplacementSupportVariants(generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [ids], options.opponent.context, options.mode, [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[0]]), results);
				}
			}
			await evaluate(replacementCandidates(), generationEnd);
		}
	}
	function buildHeroReplacements(heroes, roster, offset = 0) {
		const available = [...new Set(roster)].filter((id) => !heroes.includes(id));
		const result = [];
		for (let rotation = 0; rotation < heroes.length; rotation += 1) available.forEach((id, index) => {
			const slot = (index + rotation + offset) % heroes.length;
			result.push(heroes.map((hero, position) => position === slot ? id : hero));
		});
		return result;
	}
	/** Чередует пары позиций и свободных героев, не создавая весь перебор в памяти. */
	function* iterateHeroReplacementPairs(heroes, roster) {
		const available = [...new Set(roster)].filter((id) => !heroes.includes(id));
		for (let distance = 1; distance <= Math.floor(available.length / 2); distance++) {
			const count = distance * 2 === available.length ? available.length / 2 : available.length;
			for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
				const other = (index + distance) % available.length;
				const first = Math.min(index, other);
				const second = Math.max(index, other);
				for (let firstSlot = 0; firstSlot < heroes.length; firstSlot += 1) for (let secondSlot = firstSlot + 1; secondSlot < heroes.length; secondSlot += 1) yield heroes.map((hero, position) => {
					if (position === firstSlot) return available[first];
					if (position === secondSlot) return available[second];
					return hero;
				});
			}
		}
	}

	function saveBattleLabFailure(phase, battle, error, request, gameLibrary) {
		new VersionedStorage({
			keyPrefix: "hwh-battle-lab:diagnostic:",
			schemaVersion: 1
		}).write(phase, {
			version: "0.2.363",
			createdAt: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(),
			phase,
			error: getErrorMessage(error),
			stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : void 0,
			units: describeBattleLabFailureUnits(battle),
			libraryGaps: gameLibrary ? describeBattleLabLibraryGaps(battle, gameLibrary) : void 0,
			battle,
			request
		});
	}
	/**
	* Нативный Calc сообщает только имя поля из VM. Сохраняем не весь повторный
	* слепок прокачки, а минимальную карту метаданных, по которой видно, какой
	* боец и какая часть его конфигурации дошли до аварийного навыка.
	*/
	function describeBattleLabFailureUnits(battle) {
		return [...collectBattleLabFailureUnits("attackers", battle.attackers), ...collectBattleLabFailureUnits("defenders", battle.defenders)];
	}
	/**
	* На рассинхроне игрового lib Haxe обычно падает глубоко в resolver-е навыка
	* и оставляет только бесполезное `reading 'w'`. Здесь оставляем точную дырку:
	* запись бойца, отсутствующий навык или оба сразу.
	*/
	function describeBattleLabLibraryGaps(battle, gameLibrary) {
		const index = new GameDataIndex({ libs: gameLibrary });
		const gaps = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const unit of describeBattleLabFailureUnits(battle)) {
			const missingUnitDefinition = unit.type === "titan" ? index.getTitanLib(unit.id) === null : unit.type === "pet" ? index.getPetLib(unit.id) === null : unit.type === "hero" ? index.getHeroLib(unit.id) === null : false;
			const missingSkillIds = unit.skillIds.filter((skillId) => index.getSkill(skillId) === null);
			if (!missingUnitDefinition && missingSkillIds.length === 0) continue;
			const key = `${unit.side}:${unit.type}:${unit.id}`;
			gaps.set(key, {
				side: unit.side,
				id: unit.id,
				type: unit.type,
				missingUnitDefinition,
				missingSkillIds
			});
		}
		return [...gaps.values()];
	}
	function collectBattleLabFailureUnits(side, source) {
		if (Array.isArray(source)) return source.flatMap((entry) => collectBattleLabFailureUnits(side, entry));
		const record = asRecord(source);
		const direct = describeBattleLabFailureUnit(side, record);
		if (direct) return [direct];
		const fromGroups = [
			record.heroes,
			record.titans,
			record.units
		].filter((group) => group !== void 0 && group !== null).flatMap((group) => collectBattleLabFailureUnits(side, group));
		if (fromGroups.length > 0) return fromGroups;
		return Object.values(record).flatMap((entry) => {
			const unit = describeBattleLabFailureUnit(side, asRecord(entry));
			return unit ? [unit] : [];
		});
	}
	function describeBattleLabFailureUnit(side, unit) {
		const id = finiteNumber(unit.id);
		const type = typeof unit.type === "string" ? unit.type : "";
		if (id <= 0 || !type) return null;
		const skills = asRecord(unit.skills);
		const spiritSkillCount = Array.isArray(unit.elementSpiritSkills) ? unit.elementSpiritSkills.length : Object.keys(asRecord(unit.elementSpiritSkills)).length;
		const elementSpiritLevel = finiteNumber(unit.elementSpiritLevel);
		const elementSpiritStar = finiteNumber(unit.elementSpiritStar);
		const titanSpiritId = finiteNumber(unit.titanSpiritId);
		return {
			side,
			id,
			type,
			element: typeof unit.element === "string" ? unit.element : void 0,
			skillIds: Object.keys(skills).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite),
			hasRawStats: [
				"hp",
				"physicalAttack",
				"magicPower",
				"strength",
				"agility",
				"intelligence"
			].some((key) => finiteNumber(unit[key]) > 0),
			...type === "titan" && (titanSpiritId > 0 || elementSpiritLevel > 0 || elementSpiritStar > 0) ? { titanSpirit: {
				...titanSpiritId > 0 ? { id: titanSpiritId } : {},
				level: elementSpiritLevel || void 0,
				star: elementSpiritStar || void 0,
				skillCount: spiritSkillCount
			} } : {}
		};
	}
	function asRecord(value) {

	function isNativeNullResolverError(error) {
		if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) return false;
		return /(?:null|undefined).*['"](?:w|resolve)['"]|(?:w|resolve).*null/i.test(error.message);
	}
	var MIN_REPEATED_FAILURES, BattleLabCandidateFailureQuarantine;
	var init_candidate_failure_quarantine = __esmMin((() => {
		init_defineProperty();
		MIN_REPEATED_FAILURES = 3;
		BattleLabCandidateFailureQuarantine = class {
			constructor() {
				_defineProperty(this, "failedTitanTeams", /* @__PURE__ */ new Map());
				_defineProperty(this, "blockedTitanIds", /* @__PURE__ */ new Set());
			}
			blocks(candidate) {
				return candidate.type === "titan" && candidate.titans.some((id) => this.blockedTitanIds.has(id));
			}
			record(candidate, error) {
				if (candidate.type !== "titan" || !isNativeNullResolverError(error)) return [];
				const titans = [...new Set(candidate.titans)].sort((left, right) => left - right);
				if (titans.length === 0) return [];
				this.failedTitanTeams.set(titans.join(","), titans);
				if (this.failedTitanTeams.size < MIN_REPEATED_FAILURES) return [];
				const teams = [...this.failedTitanTeams.values()];
				const added = teams.slice(1).reduce((shared, team) => shared.filter((id) => team.includes(id)), [...teams[0]]).filter((id) => !this.blockedTitanIds.has(id));
				added.forEach((id) => this.blockedTitanIds.add(id));
				return added;
			}
		};
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/candidate-racing.ts
	async function raceBattleLabCandidates({ finalists, budget, validationEnd, mode, minimumStageAttempts = 2, minimumSurvivors = 3, pruneDuringAllocation = true, concurrency = () => 1, simulate, onError, onUpdate }) {
		let survivors = [...finalists];
		let targetAttempts = Math.max(2, Math.floor(minimumStageAttempts));
		const binaryOutcome = mode.objective !== "max_damage";
		const survivorFloor = Math.max(1, Math.floor(minimumSurvivors));
		while (survivors.length > survivorFloor && canContinue(budget, validationEnd)) {
			if (!await runRacingStage({
				survivors,
				targetAttempts,
				budget,
				validationEnd,
				concurrency,
				simulate,
				onError,
				onUpdate: () => onUpdate?.(survivors)
			})) break;
			const selected = new Set(selectSuccessiveHalvingSurvivors(survivors, binaryOutcome, survivorFloor));
			survivors = survivors.filter((entry) => selected.has(entry.candidate));
			survivors = retainCandidateResults(survivors, pruneDominatedRaceEntries(survivors, binaryOutcome, survivorFloor, targetAttempts));
			targetAttempts *= 2;
		}
		let allocationRound = 0;
		const pendingRounds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency,
			next: (running) => {
				if (!canContinue(budget, validationEnd, running)) return null;
				const targetCandidate = selectRaceEntryForSampling(survivors, binaryOutcome, allocationRound);
				const target = survivors.find((entry) => entry.candidate === targetCandidate?.candidate);
				if (!target) return null;
				const pending = pendingRounds.get(target) ?? 0;
				pendingRounds.set(target, pending + 1);
				allocationRound += 1;
				if (pruneDuringAllocation && allocationRound % Math.max(2, survivors.length) === 0) survivors = retainCandidateResults(survivors, pruneDominatedRaceEntries(survivors, binaryOutcome, survivorFloor, 4));
				return {
					target,
					round: attempts(target) + pending
				};
			},
			run: async ({ target, round }) => {
				try {
					await runCandidate(target, round, budget, simulate, onError);
				} finally {
					pendingRounds.set(target, (pendingRounds.get(target) ?? 1) - 1);
				}
				onUpdate?.(survivors);
			}
		});
		return rankBattleRaceEntries(survivors, binaryOutcome).map((entry) => entry.candidate).map((candidate) => survivors.find((entry) => entry.candidate === candidate)).filter((entry) => Boolean(entry));
	}
	async function runRacingStage({ survivors, targetAttempts, budget, validationEnd, concurrency, simulate, onError, onUpdate }) {
		const plan = survivors.flatMap((aggregate) => Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, targetAttempts - attempts(aggregate)) }, (_, offset) => ({
			aggregate,
			round: attempts(aggregate) + offset
		})));
		let nextStep = 0;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency,
			next: (running) => nextStep < plan.length && canContinue(budget, validationEnd, running) ? plan[nextStep++] : null,
			run: async ({ aggregate, round }) => {
				await runCandidate(aggregate, round, budget, simulate, onError);
				onUpdate?.();
			}
		});
		return survivors.every((aggregate) => attempts(aggregate) >= targetAttempts);
	}
	async function runCandidate(aggregate, round, budget, simulate, onError) {
		const budgetBefore = budget.count;
		try {
			appendBattleLabCandidateSample(aggregate, await simulate(aggregate, round));
		} catch (error) {
			if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
			throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
			aggregate.failed += 1;
			onError(error);
		} finally {
			if (budget.count === budgetBefore && budget.canRun()) await budget.acquire();
		}
	}
	function attempts(aggregate) {
		return battleLabCandidateAttempts(aggregate);
	}
	function canContinue(budget, validationEnd, running = 0) {
		return budget.canRun(running + 1) && budget.count + running < validationEnd;
	}
	function retainCandidateResults(source, retained) {
		const candidates = new Set(retained.map((entry) => entry.candidate));
		return source.filter((entry) => candidates.has(entry.candidate));
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/history-learning.ts
	function attachBattleLabHistoryLearning({ candidates, history, index, generator, mode, modeId, direction, enemyContext, teamIndex = 0 }) {
		const relevant = history.filter((entry) => entry.modeId === modeId && (entry.direction ?? "attack") === direction && (mode.objective !== "max_damage" || sameDamageTarget(entry, enemyContext))).slice(0, MAX_HISTORY_OBSERVATIONS);
		if (relevant.length === 0) return [...candidates];
		const learner = new AdaptiveTeamLearner(index);
		const maximumDamage = Math.max(0, ...relevant.map((entry) => finiteHistoryMetric(recordedDamage(entry))));
		let observations = 0;
		for (const entry of [...relevant].reverse()) {
			const candidate = historyCandidate(entry, mode, teamIndex);
			const reward = historyReward(entry, mode, modeId, teamIndex, maximumDamage);
			if (!candidate || reward === null) continue;
			learner.learn(candidate, historyContext(entry, generator, mode, teamIndex), reward);
			observations += 1;
		}
		if (observations === 0) return [...candidates];
		const currentContext = {
			modeIdent: mode.ident,
			enemyUnits: generator.extractEnemyUnits(enemyContext),
			support: generator.enemySupportAnalyzer.analyze(enemyContext, mode)
		};
		return candidates.map((candidate) => ({
			...candidate,
			adaptiveLearning: learner.predict(candidate, currentContext)
		}));
	}
	function historyCandidate(entry, mode, teamIndex) {
		const stored = entry.teams?.[teamIndex];
		const ids = (stored?.unitIds ?? entry.teamIds[teamIndex] ?? []).filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0);
		if (mode.unitType === "titan") {
			const titans = ids.filter((id) => id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3);
			if (titans.length === 0) return null;
			return {
				type: "titan",
				titans,
				totems: stored?.totems?.map((totem) => ({ ...totem })) ?? [],
				approxScore: 0,
				teamPower: stored?.power
			};
		}
		const heroes = ids.filter((id) => id < 4e3);
		if (heroes.length === 0) return null;
		return {
			type: "hero",
			heroes,
			teamPet: stored?.teamPetId ?? ids.find((id) => id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3) ?? 0,
			favor: { ...stored?.favor ?? {} },
			banner: stored?.bannerId ?? 0,
			approxScore: 0,
			teamPower: stored?.power
		};
	}
	function historyContext(entry, generator, mode, teamIndex) {
		const snapshot = asRecord$1(entry.battleSnapshot);
		const snapshotUnits = generator.extractEnemyUnits(snapshot);
		const enemyUnits = snapshotUnits.length > 0 ? snapshotUnits : (entry.enemyTeamIds[teamIndex] ?? []).map((id) => ({
			id,
			type: mode.unitType
		}));
		const context = snapshotUnits.length > 0 ? snapshot : { defenders: Object.fromEntries(enemyUnits.map((unit) => [String(unit.id), unit])) };
		return {
			modeIdent: mode.ident,
			enemyUnits,
			support: generator.enemySupportAnalyzer.analyze(context, mode)
		};
	}
	function historyReward(entry, mode, modeId, teamIndex, maximumDamage) {
		if (mode.objective === "max_damage") {
			const rawDamage = recordedDamage(entry);
			if (rawDamage == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(rawDamage)) || maximumDamage <= 0) return null;
			if (entry.damage == null && entry.result === "unknown" && Number(rawDamage) <= 0) return null;
			return Math.min(1, finiteHistoryMetric(rawDamage) / maximumDamage);
		}
		const teamResult = entry.teamResults[teamIndex];
		if (teamResult === "win") return 1;
		if (teamResult === "loss") return 0;
		if (modeId === "grand-arena") return null;
		if (entry.result === "win") return 1;
		if (entry.result === "loss") return 0;
		return null;
	}
	function sameDamageTarget(entry, context) {
		const battle = asRecord$1(context.battle ?? context);
		const stored = asRecord$1(entry.battleSnapshot);
		if (battle.type && entry.battleType && String(battle.type) !== entry.battleType) return false;
		return battle.typeId == null || stored.typeId == null || String(battle.typeId) === String(stored.typeId);
	}
	function recordedDamage(entry) {
		return entry.damage ?? (entry.source === "battle-lab" ? entry.score : null);
	}
	function finiteHistoryMetric(value) {
		const metric = Number(value);
		return Number.isFinite(metric) ? Math.max(0, metric) : 0;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/engine/planning-workers.ts
	async function preselectCandidatesWithWorkers(candidates, requestedLimit, workerCount, signal, breadthMultiplier = 1.5, reserveExploration = false) {
		const unique = [...new Map(candidates.map((candidate) => [battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate])).values()];
		const target = Math.min(unique.length, MAX_PLANNER_POOL, Math.max(512, Math.ceil(requestedLimit * Math.max(1, breadthMultiplier))));
		if (unique.length <= target) return unique;
		const normalizedObjectives = normalizeObjectives(unique.map(battleLabCandidateObjectives));
		const explorationCount = reserveExploration ? Math.min(target - 1, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(target * .3))) : 0;
		const primaryTarget = Math.max(1, target - explorationCount);
		const indexes = await shortlistBattleLabPlannerItems(unique.map((candidate, index) => ({
			index,
			key: battleLabCandidateKey(candidate),
			objectives: normalizedObjectives[index]
		})), primaryTarget, workerCount, signal);
		if (unique.every((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero")) {
			const workerSelected = new Set(indexes);
			const priorities = new Map(unique.map((candidate, index) => [candidate, Number(workerSelected.has(index)) + normalizedObjectives[index].reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)]));
			return appendExplorationCandidates(selectHeroLineups(unique, primaryTarget, (candidate) => priorities.get(candidate) ?? 0), unique, explorationCount);
		}
		return appendExplorationCandidates(indexes.map((index) => unique[index]), unique, explorationCount);
	}
	function appendExplorationCandidates(primary, source, explorationCount) {
		if (explorationCount <= 0) return [...primary];
		const selected = new Set(primary.map(battleLabCandidateKey));
		return [...primary, ...sampleBattleLabCandidateExploration(source.filter((candidate) => !selected.has(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate))), explorationCount)];
	}
	async function shortlistBattleLabPlannerItems(items, requestedLimit, requestedWorkers, signal) {
		throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(signal);
		const limit = Math.min(items.length, Math.max(1, Math.floor(requestedLimit)));
		const workerCount = Math.min(items.length, limit, Math.max(1, Math.floor(requestedWorkers)));
		if (items.length <= limit || workerCount <= 1 || !canUseWorkers()) return shortlistOnMainThread(items, limit);
		const chunks = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, () => []);
		items.forEach((item, index) => chunks[index % workerCount].push(item));
		const workers = [];
		let workerUrl = "";
		try {
			workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([PLANNER_WORKER_SOURCE], { type: "text/javascript" }));
			const quotas = distributeLimit(limit, chunks.map((chunk) => chunk.length));
			const results = await Promise.all(chunks.map((chunk, index) => {
				const worker = new Worker(workerUrl, { name: `hwh-battle-lab-planner-${index + 1}` });
				workers.push(worker);
				return runWorker(worker, chunk, quotas[index], signal);
			}));
			throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(signal);
			return results.flat().slice(0, limit);
		} catch (error) {
			if (signal?.aborted || error instanceof BattleLabRunCancelledError) throw error;
			return shortlistOnMainThread(items, limit);
		} finally {
			workers.forEach((worker) => worker.terminate());
			if (workerUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
		}
	}
	function canUseWorkers() {
		return typeof globalThis.Worker === "function" && typeof globalThis.Blob === "function" && typeof globalThis.URL?.createObjectURL === "function";
	}
	function runWorker(worker, items, limit, signal) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const abort = () => {
				cleanup();
				worker.terminate();
				reject(new BattleLabRunCancelledError());
			};
			const handleMessage = (event) => {
				cleanup();
				resolve(event.data.indexes);
			};
			const handleError = (event) => {
				cleanup();
				reject(new Error(event.message || "Web Worker планировщика завершился с ошибкой."));
			};
			const cleanup = () => {
				signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
				worker.removeEventListener("message", handleMessage);
				worker.removeEventListener("error", handleError);
			};
			signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
			worker.addEventListener("message", handleMessage, { once: true });
			worker.addEventListener("error", handleError, { once: true });
			if (signal?.aborted) {
				abort();
				return;
			}
			worker.postMessage({
				items,
				limit
			}, []);
		});
	}
	function shortlistOnMainThread(items, limit) {
		const weights = [
			.26,
			.14,
			.1,
			.08,
			.2,
			.22
		];
		return [...items].sort((left, right) => {
			const score = (item) => item.objectives.reduce((total, value, index) => total + value * (weights[index] ?? 0), 0);
			return score(right) - score(left) || left.key.localeCompare(right.key);
		}).slice(0, limit).map((item) => item.index);
	}
	function distributeLimit(limit, sizes) {
		const quotas = sizes.map(() => 0);
		let remaining = limit;
		while (remaining > 0) {
			let allocated = false;
			for (let index = 0; index < sizes.length && remaining > 0; index += 1) {
				if (quotas[index] >= sizes[index]) continue;
				quotas[index] += 1;
				remaining -= 1;
				allocated = true;
			}
			if (!allocated) break;
		}
		return quotas;
	}
	function normalizeObjectives(values) {
		const objectiveCount = Math.max(0, ...values.map((entry) => entry.length));
		const bounds = Array.from({ length: objectiveCount }, (_, objective) => {
			const column = values.map((entry) => entry[objective] ?? 0);
			return {
				minimum: Math.min(...column),
				maximum: Math.max(...column)
			};
		});
		return values.map((entry) => entry.map((value, objective) => {
			const { minimum, maximum } = bounds[objective];
			return maximum > minimum ? (value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum) : .5;
		}));
	}

    );
    selected.push(remaining.splice(position, 1)[0]);
  }

	async function runBattleLabEngine(options) {
		const budget = new CalculationBudget(Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.maxCalculations)), options.onProgress, options.signal);
		const runner = new BattleRunner({ executor: getBattleLabCalcExecutor() });

			libs: options.gameLibrary,
