	}
	async function trainBattleLabEngine(options, teams, actions) {
		const expectedTeams = options.mode.isGrandArena ? Math.max(1, options.mode.grandTeams ?? 3) : 1;
		if (teams.length < expectedTeams) throw new Error("Для тренировки не хватает сохранённых пачек.");
		const budget = new CalculationBudget(Math.max(expectedTeams, Math.floor(options.maxCalculations)), options.onProgress, options.signal);
		const runner = new BattleRunner({ executor: getBattleLabCalcExecutor() });
		const scorer = new BattleResultScorer(options.mode);
		if (options.mode.isGrandArena) return trainGrandArena(options, budget, runner, scorer, teams);
		const candidate = teams[0];
		if (options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" && options.ultraTimingEnabled && options.mode.manualAllowed && candidate.type === "hero") return trainAsgardSeedPotential(options, candidate, actions.length > 0 ? actions : AUTO_ACTIONS$1, (round) => resolveSimulationSeed(options, `${options.opponent.id}:default`, round, 0));
		const timedSeries = createBattleLabRetainedSeries();
		const pairedAutomaticSeries = createBattleLabRetainedSeries();
		const normalizedActions = actions.length > 0 ? [...actions] : AUTO_ACTIONS$1;
		await startProfilingExperiments(options, runner, candidate, 0);
		const preparedTiming = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.trainingTiming", () => prepareTrainingTiming({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			candidate,
			normalizedActions
		}));
		const automaticSeries = createBattleLabRetainedSeries(preparedTiming.automaticSamples);
		let { failed, round, selectedActions, timingSearch } = preparedTiming;
		const errors = [];
		const trainingStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
		const trainingActions = selectedActions;
		const calculationsPerRound = hasManualActions$1(trainingActions) ? timingPairCalculationCount(runner) : 1;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, calculationsPerRound) ? round++ : null,
			run: async (trainingRound) => {
				try {
					if (hasManualActions$1(trainingActions)) {
						const pair = await simulateCandidatePairWithExactTimeline({
							options,
							budget,
							runner,
							scorer,
							candidate,
							teamIndex: 0,
							round: trainingRound,
							actions: trainingActions
						});
						appendBattleLabRetainedSample(automaticSeries, pair.automatic);
						appendBattleLabRetainedSample(pairedAutomaticSeries, pair.automatic);
						appendBattleLabRetainedSample(timedSeries, pair.timed);
					} else appendBattleLabRetainedSample(automaticSeries, await simulateCandidate({
						options,
						budget,
						runner,
						scorer,
						candidate,
						teamIndex: 0,
						round: trainingRound,
						actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1
					}));
				} catch (error) {
					if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
					throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
					failed += 1;
					errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
				}
				emitTrainingValidationProgress(options, budget, candidate, trainingActions, timedSeries.observation.count > 0 ? timedSeries : automaticSeries, failed, pairedAutomaticSeries);
			}
		});
		while (calculationsPerRound > 1 && budget.canRun()) {
			try {
				appendBattleLabRetainedSample(automaticSeries, await simulateCandidate({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					candidate,
					teamIndex: 0,
					round: round++,
					actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1
				}));
			} catch (error) {
				if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) break;
				throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
				failed += 1;
				errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
			}
			emitTrainingValidationProgress(options, budget, candidate, trainingActions, timedSeries.observation.count > 0 ? timedSeries : automaticSeries, failed, pairedAutomaticSeries);
		}
		readPerformanceTime() - trainingStartedAt;
		let selectedSeries = timedSeries.observation.count > 0 ? timedSeries : automaticSeries;
		let timingImprovement = null;
		if (timedSeries.observation.count > 0) if (isPairedTimingBetter(timedSeries.samples, pairedAutomaticSeries.samples, options.mode.objective, {
			timed: timedSeries.observation,
			automatic: pairedAutomaticSeries.observation
		})) {
			timingSearch = {
				...timingSearch,
				status: "found",
				reason: null
			};
			timingImprovement = resolvePairedTimingImprovement(timedSeries.samples, pairedAutomaticSeries.samples, options.mode.objective, {
				timed: timedSeries.observation,
				automatic: pairedAutomaticSeries.observation
			});
		} else {
			selectedActions = AUTO_ACTIONS$1;
			selectedSeries = automaticSeries;
			timingSearch = {
				...timingSearch,
				status: "rejected",
				reason: "Подобранный автотайминг не подтвердил преимущество над автобоем на одинаковых seed."
			};
		}
		if (selectedSeries.observation.count === 0) throw noSimulationError([...errors, ...timingSearch.reason ? [timingSearch.reason] : []]);
		const summary = summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(selectedSeries.observation, failed, options.mode.objective !== "max_damage");
		const representative = selectedSeries.bestSample;
		if (!representative) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const result = calculationResult(representative.calculation);
		const score = options.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? selectedSeries.observation.scoreMax : selectedSeries.observation.scoreMean;
		return {
			teams: [candidate],
			score,
			wins: representative.win === null ? null : representative.win ? 1 : 0,
			stars: nullableNumber(result.stars),
			actions: selectedActions,
			teamActions: [[...selectedActions]],
			teamTimingImprovements: [timingImprovement],
			teamScores: [score],
			timingImprovement,
			calculations: [representative.calculation],
			teamResults: [representative.win === null ? "unknown" : representative.win ? "win" : "loss"],
			confidence: summary.confidence,
			statistics: summary.statistics,
			calculationCount: budget.count,
			direction: options.direction,
			scenarioResults: summarizeScenarioResults(selectedSeries.samples, selectedSeries.observation),
			timingSearch,
			alternatives: [],
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: options.mode.objective !== "max_damage" && isPerfectVictoryConfirmed({
				samples: selectedSeries.samples,
				observation: selectedSeries.observation,
				failed
			}, options.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.id))
		};
	}
	async function prepareTrainingTiming({ options, budget, runner, scorer, candidate, normalizedActions }) {
		const preparation = {
			automaticSamples: [],
			failed: 0,
			round: 0,
			selectedActions: normalizedActions,
			timingSearch: initialTimingSearchDiagnostics(options)
		};
		if (!options.ultraTimingEnabled || !options.mode.manualAllowed || !budget.canRun(9)) return preparation;
		try {
			const baseline = await simulateCandidate({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				candidate,
				teamIndex: 0,
				round: preparation.round,
				actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1
			});
			preparation.automaticSamples.push(baseline);
			const battle = cloneCalculationBattle(baseline.calculation);
			const memo = new BattleLabSimulationMemo();
			const timelineProbe = await simulatePreparedBattle({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				battle,
				candidate,
				input: [...TIMELINE_PROBE_INPUT$1],
				actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
				seed: baseline.seed,
				scenarioId: baseline.scenarioId,
				scenarioLabel: baseline.scenarioLabel,
				scenarioBuff: baseline.scenarioBuff,
				memo
			});
			if (!hasUsableBattleTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation)) throw new Error("Игровой движок не отдал шкалу или журнал боя для автотайминга.");
			const timeline = resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation);
			let reference = baseline;
			if (hasManualActions$1(normalizedActions) && budget.canRun()) {
				const savedTiming = await simulatePreparedBattle({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					battle,
					candidate,
					input: encodeBattleActions(normalizedActions, timeline),
					actions: normalizedActions,
					seed: baseline.seed,
					scenarioId: baseline.scenarioId,
					scenarioLabel: baseline.scenarioLabel,
					scenarioBuff: baseline.scenarioBuff,
					memo
				});
				if (isBetterSample(savedTiming, reference)) reference = savedTiming;
				else preparation.selectedActions = AUTO_ACTIONS$1;
			}
			preparation.round += 1;
			const remainingBeforeValidation = Math.max(0, budget.max - budget.count);
			const validationReserve = Math.max(6, Math.floor(remainingBeforeValidation * .3));
			const searchTrials = Math.max(0, remainingBeforeValidation - validationReserve);
			const planTrials = searchTrials >= 8 ? Math.max(4, Math.floor(searchTrials * .55)) : 0;
			const observations = [];
			const timingResult = await searchUltraTiming({
				baseline: reference,
				timelineCalculation: timelineProbe.calculation,
				minTime: options.ultraMinTime,
				maxTime: options.ultraMaxTime,
				maxTrials: Math.max(0, searchTrials - planTrials),
				signal: options.signal,
				concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
				isBetter: isBetterSample,
				simulate: async (encodedInput, candidateActions) => simulatePreparedBattle({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					battle,
					candidate,
					input: encodedInput,
					actions: candidateActions,
					seed: baseline.seed,
					scenarioId: baseline.scenarioId,
					scenarioLabel: baseline.scenarioLabel,
					scenarioBuff: baseline.scenarioBuff,
					memo
				}),
				onObservation: (observation) => {
					appendProgressObservation(observations, observation);
					emitTrainingSearchProgress(options, budget, candidate, observations);
				}
			});
			if (isBetterSample(timingResult.sample, reference)) {
				reference = timingResult.sample;
				preparation.selectedActions = timingResult.actions;
			}
			const planOutcome = await searchTimingPlanChoice({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				maxTrials: planTrials,
				context: {
					aggregate: createBattleLabCandidateResult(candidate, [baseline]),
					baseline,
					reference,
					battle,
					timeline,
					timingCalculation: timelineProbe.calculation,
					memo
				},
				onObservation: (observation) => {
					appendProgressObservation(observations, observation);
					emitTrainingSearchProgress(options, budget, candidate, observations);
				}
			});
			if (planOutcome.choice && isBetterSample(planOutcome.choice.sample, reference)) preparation.selectedActions = planOutcome.choice.actions;
			preparation.timingSearch = {
				status: hasManualActions$1(preparation.selectedActions) ? "searching" : "not-improved",
				tested: timingResult.tested + planOutcome.tested,
				candidateCount: timingResult.candidateCount + planOutcome.candidateCount,
				teamCount: 1,
				testedTeamCount: 1,
				reason: hasManualActions$1(preparation.selectedActions) ? null : "Проверенные тайминги не превзошли сохранённый план и чистый автобой."
			};
		} catch (error) {
			throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
			throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(options.signal);
			preparation.timingSearch = {
				status: "unavailable",
				tested: preparation.timingSearch.tested,
				candidateCount: preparation.timingSearch.candidateCount,
				reason: getErrorMessage(error)
			};
			preparation.failed += 1;
		}
		return preparation;
	}
	async function trainGrandArena(options, budget, runner, scorer, teams) {
		const teamCount = Math.max(1, options.mode.grandTeams ?? 3);
		const singleMode = {
			...options.mode,
			isGrandArena: false,
			grandTeams: void 0,
			objective: "win_stars"
		};
		const rounds = createBattleLabRetainedSeries();
		let failed = 0;
		const errors = [];
		let round = 0;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, teamCount) ? round++ : null,
			run: async (trainingRound) => {
				try {
					const samples = [];
					for (let teamIndex = 0; teamIndex < teamCount; teamIndex += 1) samples.push(await simulateCandidate({
						options: {
							...options,
							mode: singleMode
						},
						budget,
						runner,
						scorer,
						candidate: teams[teamIndex],
						teamIndex,
						round: trainingRound,
						actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
						enemyContext: pickGrandEnemyContext(options.opponent.context, teamIndex)
					}));
					const wins = samples.filter((sample) => sample.win === true).length;
					appendBattleLabRetainedSample(rounds, {
						score: samples.reduce((total, sample) => total + sample.score, 0) + (wins >= (options.mode.requiredTeamWins ?? 2) ? 3e6 : 0),
						win: wins >= (options.mode.requiredTeamWins ?? 2),
						calculations: samples.map((sample) => sample.calculation),
						teamResults: samples.map((sample) => sample.win === true ? "win" : "loss"),
						stars: samples.reduce((total, sample) => total + finiteNumber$1(calculationResult(sample.calculation).stars), 0)
					});
				} catch (error) {
					if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
					throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
					failed += 1;
					errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
				}
			}
		});
		if (rounds.observation.count === 0) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const summary = summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(rounds.observation, failed, true);
		const representative = rounds.bestSample;
		if (!representative) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		return {
			teams: [...teams.slice(0, teamCount)],
			score: rounds.observation.scoreMean,
			wins: representative.teamResults.filter((result) => result === "win").length,
			stars: representative.stars,
			actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			calculations: representative.calculations,
			teamResults: representative.teamResults,
			confidence: summary.confidence,
			statistics: summary.statistics,
			calculationCount: budget.count,
			direction: options.direction,
			scenarioResults: [],
			timingSearch: {
				status: "disabled",
				tested: 0,
				candidateCount: 0,
				reason: "В Гранд-арене ручное применение ульт недоступно."
			},
			alternatives: []
		};
	}
	async function screenSingleBattleCandidates({ options, budget, runner, scorer, candidates, wideAsgardTiming, errors }) {
		const results = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const screeningRounds = wideAsgardTiming ? ASGARD_SCREENING_ROUNDS : 1;
		const quarantine = new BattleLabCandidateFailureQuarantine();
		let perfectVictoryCandidate = null;
		let experimentsStarted = false;
		let nextCandidate = 0;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => {
				while (nextCandidate < candidates.length && hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, screeningRounds)) {
					if (perfectVictoryCandidate) break;
					const candidate = candidates[nextCandidate];
					nextCandidate += 1;
					if (!quarantine.blocks(candidate)) return getCandidateResult(results, candidate);
				}
				return null;
			},
			run: async (aggregate) => {
				for (let round = 0; round < screeningRounds && budget.canRun(); round += 1) await appendCandidateSample({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					aggregate,
					round,
					errors,
					quarantine
				});
				if (!experimentsStarted && aggregate.samples.length > 0) {
					experimentsStarted = true;
					await startProfilingExperiments(options, runner, aggregate.candidate, 0);
				}
				emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, "screening", results.values());
				if (!perfectVictoryCandidate && options.mode.objective !== "max_damage" && await confirmPerfectVictoryCandidate({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					aggregate,
					firstRound: screeningRounds,
					errors,
					quarantine,
					progressEntries: results
				})) perfectVictoryCandidate ?? (perfectVictoryCandidate = aggregate);
			}
		});
		return {
			results,
			perfectVictoryCandidate
		};
	}
	async function confirmPerfectVictoryCandidate({ options, budget, runner, scorer, aggregate, firstRound, errors, quarantine, progressEntries }) {
		if (!canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(aggregate)) return false;
		const scenarioIds = options.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.id);
		let round = firstRound;
		while (budget.canRun() && canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(aggregate) && !isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(aggregate, scenarioIds)) {
			const coveredScenarioIds = aggregate.observation ? new Set(Object.keys(aggregate.observation.scenarios)) : new Set(aggregate.samples.map((sample) => sample.scenarioId).filter((scenarioId) => Boolean(scenarioId)));
			await appendCandidateSample({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				aggregate,
				round,
				errors,
				scenario: options.scenarios.find((scenario) => !coveredScenarioIds.has(scenario.id)),
				quarantine
			});
			round += 1;
			emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, "screening", progressEntries.values());
		}
		return isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(aggregate, scenarioIds);
	}
	async function appendCandidateSample({ options, budget, runner, scorer, aggregate, round, errors, scenario, quarantine }) {
		try {
			appendBattleLabCandidateSample(aggregate, await simulateCandidate({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				candidate: aggregate.candidate,
				teamIndex: 0,
				round,
				actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
				scenario
			}));
		} catch (error) {
			if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
			throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
			aggregate.failed += 1;
			errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
			const blocked = quarantine?.record(aggregate.candidate, error) ?? [];
			if (blocked.length > 0) errors.push(`Нативный Calc повторно упал; исключены титаны ${blocked.join(", ")} на этот подбор.`);
		}
	}
	function automaticTimingOutcome(options, best) {
		return {
			best,
			finalActions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			finalRound: battleLabCandidateAttempts(best),
			timingSearch: initialTimingSearchDiagnostics(options),
			timedChoices: []
		};
	}
	async function searchSingleBattleTiming(input) {
		const best = input.ranked[0];
		const fallback = automaticTimingOutcome(input.options, best);
		if (!input.options.ultraTimingEnabled || !input.options.mode.manualAllowed || !input.budget.canRun()) return fallback;
		try {
			const outcome = await findAdaptiveTimingChoice(input);
			return {
				best: outcome.choice?.aggregate ?? best,
				finalActions: outcome.choice?.actions ?? AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
				finalRound: battleLabCandidateAttempts(outcome.choice?.aggregate ?? best),
				timingSearch: outcome.diagnostics,
				timedChoices: outcome.choices
			};
		} catch (error) {
			throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
			throwIfBattleLabRunCancelled(input.options.signal);
			return {
				...fallback,
				timingSearch: {
					status: "unavailable",
					tested: 0,
					candidateCount: 0,
					reason: getErrorMessage(error)
				}
			};
		}
	}
	async function validatePrimaryTimingChoice(input) {
		if (!hasManualActions$1(input.finalActions)) {
			await validateAutomaticCandidate(input);
			return {
				best: input.best,
				finalActions: input.finalActions,
				timingSearch: input.timingSearch
			};
		}
		const timedCandidate = input.best.candidate;
		const validation = await collectPairedTimingValidation(input);
		if (validation.timed.observation.count > 0 && isPairedTimingBetter(validation.timed.samples, validation.automatic.samples, input.options.mode.objective, {
			timed: validation.timed.observation,
			automatic: validation.automatic.observation
		})) {
			const validated = createBattleLabCandidateResult(input.best.candidate, validation.timed.samples);
			validated.observation = validation.timed.observation;
			validated.bestSample = validation.timed.bestSample;
			validated.failed = validation.failures;
			return {
				best: validated,
				finalActions: input.finalActions,
				timingSearch: {
					...input.timingSearch,
					status: "found",
					reason: null
				}
			};
		}
		const automaticBest = input.automaticBest;
		if (validation.automatic.observation.count > 0 && automaticBest.candidate === timedCandidate) {
			mergeBattleLabSampleAccumulators(automaticBest.observation ?? (automaticBest.observation = createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(automaticBest.samples)), validation.automatic.observation);
			for (const sample of validation.automatic.samples) automaticBest.samples.push(sample);
			automaticBest.samples.splice(0, Math.max(0, automaticBest.samples.length - 1));
			if (validation.automatic.bestSample && (!automaticBest.bestSample || validation.automatic.bestSample.score > automaticBest.bestSample.score)) automaticBest.bestSample = validation.automatic.bestSample;
		}
		return {
			best: automaticBest,
			finalActions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			timingSearch: {
				...input.timingSearch,
				status: "rejected",
				reason: validation.timed.observation.count === 0 ? "Не осталось парных прогонов для независимой проверки тайминга." : "Подобранный автотайминг не подтвердил преимущество над автобоем на одинаковых seed."
			}
		};
	}
	async function validateAutomaticCandidate(input) {
		let round = input.finalRound;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => input.runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(input.budget, running, 1, input.secondaryTimingValidationReserve) ? round++ : null,
			run: async (validationRound) => {
				await appendCandidateSample({
					options: input.options,
					budget: input.budget,
					runner: input.runner,
					scorer: input.scorer,
					aggregate: input.best,
					round: validationRound,
					errors: input.errors
				});
				emitCandidateProgress(input.options, input.budget, "validation", [input.best], input.finalActions);
			}
		});
	}
	async function collectPairedTimingValidation(input) {
		const automatic = createBattleLabRetainedSeries();
		const timed = createBattleLabRetainedSeries();
		let failures = 0;
		let round = input.finalRound;
		let confirmed = false;
		const scenarioIds = input.options.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.id);
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => input.runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => !confirmed && hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(input.budget, running, timingPairCalculationCount(input.runner), input.secondaryTimingValidationReserve) ? round++ : null,
			run: async (validationRound) => {
				try {
					const pair = await simulateCandidatePairWithExactTimeline({
						options: input.options,
						budget: input.budget,
						runner: input.runner,
						scorer: input.scorer,
						candidate: input.best.candidate,
						teamIndex: 0,
						round: validationRound,
						actions: input.finalActions
					});
					appendBattleLabRetainedSample(automatic, pair.automatic);
					appendBattleLabRetainedSample(timed, pair.timed);
				} catch (error) {
					if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
					throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
					failures += 1;
					input.errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
				}
				emitTimingValidationProgress(input.options, input.budget, input.best.candidate, input.finalActions, timed.samples, failures);
				if (input.options.opponent.modeId !== "asgard" && isPerfectVictoryConfirmed({
					samples: timed.samples,
					observation: timed.observation,
					failed: failures
				}, scenarioIds) && isPairedTimingBetter(timed.samples, automatic.samples, input.options.mode.objective)) confirmed = true;
			}
		});
		return {
			automatic,
			timed,
			failures
		};
	}
	async function runSingleBattle(options, budget, runner, scorer, index) {
		const exhaustiveTitanSearch = options.opponent.modeId === "lord";
		const generator = createGenerator(index, options.mode, budget.max, exhaustiveTitanSearch);
		const wideAsgardTiming = isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options);
		const requestedCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.requestedTeamCount ?? 1));
		const hasFixedCandidates = Boolean(options.fixedCandidates?.length);
		const hasFixedTeams = Boolean(options.fixedTeams?.length);
		const candidateLimit = Math.min(MAX_SCREENING_CANDIDATES, Math.max(hasFixedTeams ? (options.fixedTeams?.length ?? 1) * 8 : requestedCount > 1 ? requestedCount * 8 : 1, exhaustiveTitanSearch ? Math.floor(budget.max * .55) : options.compositionSearch ? Math.floor(budget.max * COMPOSITION_SCREENING_SHARE) : wideAsgardTiming && requestedCount === 1 && !hasFixedTeams ? Math.floor(budget.max * .88 / ASGARD_TIMING_CALCULATIONS_PER_TEAM) : Math.floor(budget.max * (options.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? .3 : .4))));
		const learnedCandidates = hasFixedCandidates ? [...options.fixedCandidates ?? []] : hasFixedTeams ? generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, options.fixedTeams ?? [], options.opponent.context, options.mode, options.fixedTeamSupports) : learnGeneratedCandidates({
			options,
			index,
			generator,
			mode: options.mode,
			enemyContext: options.opponent.context
		});
		const libraryCovered = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.libraryCoverage", () => filterBattleLabCandidatesByLibrary(learnedCandidates, index));
		if (libraryCovered.candidates.length === 0) throw noLibraryCoverageError(libraryCovered.gaps);
		const preselectedCandidates = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("engine.preselect", () => preselectCandidatesWithWorkers(libraryCovered.candidates, candidateLimit, options.plannerWorkers ?? 1, options.signal, options.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? MAX_DAMAGE_PLANNER_BREADTH : 1.5, options.mode.objective === "max_damage"));
		const generatedCandidates = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.pareto", () => selectDiverseParetoCandidates(preselectedCandidates, candidateLimit, options.mode.objective === "max_damage"));
		const candidates = filterBattleLabCandidatesByLibrary(mergeSeedCandidates(options.compositionSearch && hasFixedCandidates ? selectCompositionSeeds(libraryCovered.candidates, 64) : hasFixedCandidates || hasFixedTeams ? [] : options.seedCandidates, generatedCandidates, options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? candidateLimit : void 0), index).candidates;
		if (candidates.length === 0) throw new Error("Ростер пуст: движку нечего перебирать.");
		const errors = [];
		const screening = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.screening", () => screenSingleBattleCandidates({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			candidates,
			wideAsgardTiming,
			errors
		}));
		const { perfectVictoryCandidate } = screening;
		const refineStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
		await refineDamageTeams({
			options,
			budget,
			results: screening.results,
			generated: libraryCovered.candidates,
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			rank: (entries) => rankCandidates(entries, false),
			simulate: (aggregate) => appendCandidateSample({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				aggregate,
				round: 0,
				errors
			}),
			onUpdate: () => emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, "screening", screening.results.values())
		});
		readPerformanceTime() - refineStartedAt;
		let ranked = perfectVictoryCandidate ? [perfectVictoryCandidate] : rankCandidates([...screening.results.values()], options.mode.objective !== "max_damage");
		if (options.compositionSearch && !perfectVictoryCandidate && ranked.length > 1) ranked = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.compositionConfirm", () => confirmCompositionLeaders({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			ranked,
			errors
		}));
		if (ranked.length === 0) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		screening.results.clear();
		if (!options.compositionSearch && !wideAsgardTiming && !perfectVictoryCandidate) {
			const validationEnd = Math.max(budget.count, Math.floor(budget.max * (options.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? .58 : .66)));
			const finalists = ranked.slice(0, Math.min(24, ranked.length));
			for (let rankIndex = finalists.length; rankIndex < ranked.length; rankIndex += 1) {
				const entry = ranked[rankIndex];
				if (entry.bestSample?.calculation) delete entry.bestSample.calculation.battleData;
			}
			ranked = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.racing", () => raceBattleLabCandidates({
				finalists,
				budget,
				validationEnd,
				mode: options.mode,
				minimumSurvivors: 3,
				pruneDuringAllocation: true,
				minimumStageAttempts: Math.min(8, Math.max(2, options.scenarios.length)),
				concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
				simulate: (aggregate, round) => simulateCandidate({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					candidate: aggregate.candidate,
					teamIndex: 0,
					round,
					actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1
				}),
				onError: (error) => errors.push(getErrorMessage(error)),
				onUpdate: (entries) => emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, "racing", entries)
			}));
		}
		const timingOutcome = perfectVictoryCandidate || options.compositionSearch ? automaticTimingOutcome(options, perfectVictoryCandidate ?? ranked[0]) : await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.timing", () => searchSingleBattleTiming({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			ranked
		}));
		const automaticBest = ranked[0];
		const { finalRound, timedChoices } = timingOutcome;
		let { best, finalActions, timingSearch } = timingOutcome;
		const requestedTeamCount = options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.requestedTeamCount ?? 1)) : 1;
		const secondaryTimingValidationReserve = wideAsgardTiming ? Math.max(0, requestedTeamCount - 1) * 3 : 0;
		if (!perfectVictoryCandidate && !options.compositionSearch) ({best, finalActions, timingSearch} = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.validation", () => validatePrimaryTimingChoice({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			best,
			automaticBest,
			finalActions,
			finalRound,
			timingSearch,
			secondaryTimingValidationReserve,
			errors
		})));
		if (best.samples.length === 0) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const binaryOutcome = options.mode.objective !== "max_damage";
		const summary = summarizeBattleLabCandidate(best, binaryOutcome);
		const representative = selectBattleLabCandidateBestSample(best);
		if (!representative) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const result = calculationResult(representative.calculation);
		const win = representative.win;
		const timedChoiceByCandidate = new Map(timedChoices.map((choice) => [battleLabCandidateKey(choice.aggregate.candidate), choice]));
		let selectedChoices = selectDisjointTimingChoices({
			aggregate: best,
			actions: finalActions,
			sample: representative,
			baseline: timedChoiceByCandidate.get(battleLabCandidateKey(best.candidate))?.baseline ?? representative,
			utility: 0
		}, ranked.filter((aggregate) => aggregate.candidate !== best.candidate).map((aggregate) => resolveCandidateTimingChoice(aggregate, timedChoiceByCandidate.get(battleLabCandidateKey(aggregate.candidate)))), requestedTeamCount);
		if (wideAsgardTiming && selectedChoices.length > 1) {
			const choices = selectedChoices;
			selectedChoices = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("phase.secondaryValidation", () => validateSecondaryAsgardTimingChoices({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				choices,
				errors
			}));
		}
		const selectedCandidateKeys = new Set(selectedChoices.map((choice) => battleLabCandidateKey(choice.aggregate.candidate)));
		const alternatives = (options.compositionSearch ? selectCompositionResults(ranked, 128, selectCompositionSeeds(libraryCovered.candidates, 64)) : ranked).filter((aggregate) => !selectedCandidateKeys.has(battleLabCandidateKey(aggregate.candidate))).map((aggregate) => {
			const timed = timedChoiceByCandidate.get(battleLabCandidateKey(aggregate.candidate));
			return {
				...progressEntry([aggregate.candidate], timed?.actions ?? AUTO_ACTIONS$1, timed ? [timed.sample] : aggregate.samples, aggregate.failed, binaryOutcome, timed ? void 0 : aggregate.observation),
				timingImprovement: timed ? resolveTimingImprovement(timed) : null
			};
		}).sort(compareProgressEntries).slice(0, options.compositionSearch ? 128 : wideAsgardTiming ? 9 : 4);
		return {
			teams: selectedChoices.map((choice) => choice.aggregate.candidate),
			score: binaryOutcome ? meanScore(best) : maxScore(best),
			wins: win === null ? null : win ? 1 : 0,
			stars: nullableNumber(result.stars),
			actions: finalActions,
			teamActions: selectedChoices.map((choice) => [...choice.actions]),
			teamTimingImprovements: selectedChoices.map(resolveTimingImprovement),
			teamScores: selectedChoices.map((choice) => choice.sample.score),
			calculations: selectedChoices.map((choice) => choice.sample.calculation),
			teamResults: selectedChoices.map(({ sample }) => sample.win === null ? "unknown" : sample.win ? "win" : "loss"),
			confidence: summary.confidence,
			statistics: summary.statistics,
			calculationCount: budget.count,
			direction: options.direction,
			scenarioResults: summarizeScenarioResults(best.samples, best.observation),
			timingSearch,
			alternatives,
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: options.opponent.modeId !== "asgard" && isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(best, options.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.id)),
			timingImprovement: hasManualActions$1(finalActions) ? resolveTimingImprovement(timedChoiceByCandidate.get(battleLabCandidateKey(best.candidate)) ?? null) : null
		};
	}
	/**
	* Один бой на кандидата выбирает везучий seed, а не сильную пачку. Лидерам
	* скрининга добавляются бои на других seed, и они ранжируются по среднему.
	* Неподтверждённые кандидаты остаются ниже: их одиночный пик не сравним со средним.
	*/
	async function confirmCompositionLeaders(input) {
		const { options, budget, runner, scorer, ranked, errors } = input;
		const finalists = ranked.slice(0, Math.min(COMPOSITION_CONFIRM_FINALISTS, ranked.length));
		const tasks = finalists.flatMap((aggregate) => Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, COMPOSITION_CONFIRM_SAMPLES - aggregate.samples.length) }, (_, index) => ({
			aggregate,
			round: aggregate.samples.length + index
		})));
		let next = 0;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => next < tasks.length && hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, 1) ? tasks[next++] : null,
			run: async ({ aggregate, round }) => {
				try {
					await appendCandidateSample({
						options,
						budget,
						runner,
						scorer,
						aggregate,
						round,
						errors
					});
				} catch (error) {
					if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
					throw error;
				}
				emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, "validation", ranked);
			}
		});
		const confirmed = finalists.filter((aggregate) => aggregate.samples.length > 1).sort((left, right) => meanScore(right) - meanScore(left));
		const confirmedKeys = new Set(confirmed);
		return [...confirmed, ...ranked.filter((aggregate) => !confirmedKeys.has(aggregate))];
	}
	async function findAdaptiveTimingChoice(input) {
		const { options, budget, runner, scorer, ranked } = input;
		const timingFinalists = ranked.slice(0, resolveTimingTeamLimit(options, budget.max, ranked.length));
		const wideAsgardTiming = isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options);
		const minimumValidationReserve = wideAsgardTiming ? Math.max(9, Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.requestedTeamCount ?? 1)) * 3) : 9;
		const validationReserve = Math.max(minimumValidationReserve, Math.floor(budget.max * (wideAsgardTiming ? .12 : .2)));
		const searchEnd = Math.max(budget.count, Math.min(budget.max, budget.max - validationReserve));
		let choice = null;
		const choices = [];
		let tested = 0;
		let candidateCount = 0;
		let testedTeamCount = 0;
		let unavailableReason = null;
		const timingObservations = [];
		if (timingFinalists.length === 0) return {
			choice: null,
			choices: [],
			diagnostics: {
				status: "unavailable",
				tested: 0,
				candidateCount: 0,
				teamCount: 0,
				testedTeamCount: 0,
				reason: "Для автотайминга не осталось пачек-кандидатов."
			}
		};
		emitTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, timingFinalists, timingObservations);
		/** Каждая пачка получает квоту до запуска: соседние задачи не съедают резерв валидации. */
		async function searchTeam(rank, aggregate, teamBudget, concurrency) {
			const samples = [...aggregate.samples].sort((left, right) => left.score - right.score);
			const baseline = samples[Math.floor(samples.length / 2)];
			if (!baseline) return null;
			const battle = cloneCalculationBattle(baseline.calculation);
			const memo = new BattleLabSimulationMemo();
			const timelineProbe = await simulatePreparedBattle({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				battle,
				candidate: aggregate.candidate,
				input: [...TIMELINE_PROBE_INPUT$1],
				actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
				seed: baseline.seed,
				scenarioId: baseline.scenarioId,
				scenarioLabel: baseline.scenarioLabel,
				scenarioBuff: baseline.scenarioBuff,
				memo
			});
			testedTeamCount += 1;
			if (!hasUsableBattleTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation)) {
				unavailableReason = "Штатный расчёт не вернул шкалу или журнал боя для лучших пачек.";
				return null;
			}
			const timeline = resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation);
			const availableTrials = Math.max(0, Math.min(teamBudget - 1, searchEnd - budget.count));
			const shiftTrials = Math.min(Math.max(0, availableTrials - (wideAsgardTiming && availableTrials >= 8 ? 4 : 0)), Math.max(availableTrials > 0 ? 1 : 0, wideAsgardTiming ? 4 : Math.floor(availableTrials * .55)));
			const planTrials = Math.max(0, availableTrials - shiftTrials);
			const timingResult = await searchUltraTiming({
				baseline,
				timelineCalculation: timelineProbe.calculation,
				minTime: options.ultraMinTime,
				maxTime: options.ultraMaxTime,
				maxTrials: shiftTrials,
				signal: options.signal,
				concurrency,
				isBetter: isBetterSample,
				simulate: async (encodedInput, actions) => simulatePreparedBattle({
					options,
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					battle,
					candidate: aggregate.candidate,
					input: encodedInput,
					actions,
					seed: baseline.seed,
					scenarioId: baseline.scenarioId,
					scenarioLabel: baseline.scenarioLabel,
					scenarioBuff: baseline.scenarioBuff,
					memo
				}),
				onObservation: (observation) => {
					appendProgressObservation(timingObservations, {
						aggregate,
						observation
					});
					emitTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, timingFinalists, timingObservations);
				}
			});
			tested += timingResult.tested;
			candidateCount += timingResult.candidateCount;
			const reference = isBetterSample(timingResult.sample, baseline) ? timingResult.sample : baseline;
			let teamChoice = isBetterSample(timingResult.sample, baseline) ? {
				aggregate,
				actions: timingResult.actions,
				sample: timingResult.sample,
				baseline,
				utility: timingImprovementUtility(timingResult.sample, baseline) - rank * .025
			} : null;
			const planContext = {
				aggregate,
				baseline,
				reference,
				battle,
				timeline,
				timingCalculation: timelineProbe.calculation,
				memo
			};
			const planOutcome = await searchTimingPlanChoice({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				maxTrials: Math.min(planTrials, Math.max(0, searchEnd - budget.count)),
				context: planContext,
				concurrency,
				onObservation: (observation) => {
					appendProgressObservation(timingObservations, {
						aggregate,
						observation
					});
					emitTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, timingFinalists, timingObservations);
				}
			});
			tested += planOutcome.tested;
			candidateCount += planOutcome.candidateCount;
			if (planOutcome.choice && (!teamChoice || isPreferredTimingChoice(planOutcome.choice, teamChoice, options.mode))) teamChoice = planOutcome.choice;
			return teamChoice;
		}
		let nextRank = 0;
		while (nextRank < timingFinalists.length && budget.canRun(2)) {
			const batch = [];
			const batchSize = wideAsgardTiming ? runner.concurrency : 1;
			let unallocated = Math.max(0, searchEnd - budget.count);
			while (batch.length < batchSize && nextRank < timingFinalists.length) {
				const teamBudget = resolveBattleLabTimingTeamBudget(unallocated, timingFinalists.length - nextRank, wideAsgardTiming);
				if (teamBudget < 2) break;
				batch.push({
					rank: nextRank,
					aggregate: timingFinalists[nextRank],
					teamBudget
				});
				unallocated -= teamBudget;
				nextRank++;
			}
			if (batch.length === 0) break;
			const concurrency = () => Math.max(1, Math.floor(runner.concurrency / batch.length));
			const results = await Promise.allSettled(batch.map(({ rank, aggregate, teamBudget }) => searchTeam(rank, aggregate, teamBudget, concurrency)));
			for (const result of results) {
				if (result.status === "rejected") throw result.reason;
				const teamChoice = result.value;
				if (!teamChoice) continue;
				choices.push(teamChoice);
				if (!choice || isPreferredTimingChoice(teamChoice, choice, options.mode)) choice = teamChoice;
			}
		}
		return {
			choice,
			choices,
			diagnostics: {
				status: choice ? "searching" : tested > 0 ? "not-improved" : "unavailable",
				tested,
				candidateCount,
				teamCount: timingFinalists.length,
				testedTeamCount,
				reason: choice ? null : tested > 0 ? "Проверенные моменты включения ульт не превзошли чистый автобой." : unavailableReason ?? "Автотайминг не смог построить кандидатов."
			}
		};
	}
	/**
	* Второй слой автотайминга: перебирает отдельные `cast` героев или титанов и
	* `teamCustom` питомца и тотемов. В Асгарде запускается отдельно на каждой
	* пачке широкого пула, а не только на победителе автобоя.
	*/
	async function searchTimingPlanChoice(input) {
		const { options, budget, runner, scorer, context, onObservation } = input;
		const empty = {
			choice: null,
			tested: 0,
			candidateCount: 0
		};
		if (!context || context.timeline.length === 0 || !budget.canRun(4)) return empty;
		const plan = resolveUltimatePlanInputs(options, context.aggregate.candidate, context.battle);
		if (plan.unitIds.length === 0 && !plan.allowTeamCustom) return empty;
		const maxTrials = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.maxTrials)), Math.max(0, budget.max - budget.count - 3));
		if (maxTrials <= 0) return empty;
		const result = await searchUltimatePlans({
			baseline: context.reference,
			seedActions: context.reference.actions,
			timeline: context.timeline,
			timingCalculation: context.timingCalculation,
			unitIds: plan.unitIds,
			allowTeamCustom: plan.allowTeamCustom,
			teamCustomValues: plan.teamCustomValues,
			sameUnitCooldowns: plan.sameUnitCooldowns,
			sameTeamCustomCooldowns: plan.sameTeamCustomCooldowns,
			minTime: options.ultraMinTime,
			maxTime: options.ultraMaxTime,
			maxTrials,
			maxActions: isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options) ? 18 : void 0,
			retainObservations: false,
			signal: options.signal,
			concurrency: input.concurrency ?? (() => runner.concurrency),
			compare: (left, right) => isBetterSample(left, right) ? 1 : -1,
			onObservation: ({ actions, sample }) => onObservation({
				actions,
				sample
			}),
			evaluate: async (actions) => simulatePreparedBattle({
				options,
				budget,
				runner,
				scorer,
				battle: context.battle,
				candidate: context.aggregate.candidate,
				input: encodeBattleActions(actions, context.timeline),
				actions,
				seed: context.baseline.seed,
				scenarioId: context.baseline.scenarioId,
				scenarioLabel: context.baseline.scenarioLabel,
				scenarioBuff: context.baseline.scenarioBuff,
				memo: context.memo
			})
		});
		if (!isBetterSample(result.sample, context.reference)) return {
			choice: null,
			tested: result.tested,
			candidateCount: result.candidateCount
		};
		return {
			choice: {
				aggregate: context.aggregate,
				actions: result.actions,
				sample: result.sample,
				baseline: context.baseline,
				utility: timingImprovementUtility(result.sample, context.baseline) + .05
			},
			tested: result.tested,
			candidateCount: result.candidateCount
		};
	}
	function resolveUltimatePlanInputs(options, candidate, battle) {
		const castCooldown = resolveDefaultCastCooldown(options);
		if (candidate.type === "titan") {
			const teamCustomValues = (candidate.totems ?? []).map((totem, index) => Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(totem.slot, index + 1))));
			return {
				unitIds: [...candidate.titans],
				allowTeamCustom: teamCustomValues.length > 0,
				teamCustomValues,
				sameUnitCooldowns: buildCooldownMap(candidate.titans, castCooldown),
				sameTeamCustomCooldowns: buildCooldownMap(teamCustomValues, castCooldown)
			};
		}
		const teamPet = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(candidate.teamPet)));
		const custom = resolveHeroTeamCustomActions(battle, options.gameLibrary, teamPet);
		return {
			unitIds: [...candidate.heroes],
			allowTeamCustom: custom.values.length > 0,
			teamCustomValues: custom.values,
			sameUnitCooldowns: buildCooldownMap(candidate.heroes, castCooldown),
			sameTeamCustomCooldowns: custom.cooldowns
		};
	}
	function resolveDefaultCastCooldown(options) {
		const cooldown = finiteNumber$1(new GameDataIndex({
			libs: options.gameLibrary,
			account: options.account
		}).getModeBattleConfig(options.mode).defaultCastCooldown, DEFAULT_TEAM_CUSTOM_COOLDOWN_SECONDS);
		return cooldown > 0 ? cooldown : DEFAULT_TEAM_CUSTOM_COOLDOWN_SECONDS;
	}
	function buildCooldownMap(keys, cooldown) {
		return Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, cooldown]));
	}
	async function runGrandArena(options, budget, runner, scorer, index) {
		const singleMode = {
			...options.mode,
			ident: `${options.mode.ident}_team`,
			isGrandArena: false,
			grandTeams: void 0,
			objective: "win_stars"
		};
		const pools = [];
		const errors = [];
		const teamCount = Math.max(1, options.mode.grandTeams ?? 3);
		const screeningEnd = Math.floor(budget.max * .58);
		for (let teamIndex = 0; teamIndex < teamCount; teamIndex += 1) {
			const context = pickGrandEnemyContext(options.opponent.context, teamIndex);
			const generator = createGenerator(index, singleMode, budget.max);
			const remainingTeams = teamCount - teamIndex;
			const allowance = Math.min(MAX_SCREENING_CANDIDATES, Math.max(1, Math.floor((screeningEnd - budget.count) / remainingTeams)));
			const fixedTeam = options.fixedTeams?.[teamIndex];
			const learnedCandidates = fixedTeam ? generateFixedTeamCandidates(options, [fixedTeam], context, singleMode, [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[teamIndex]]) : learnGeneratedCandidates({
				options,
				index,
				generator,
				mode: singleMode,
				enemyContext: context,
				teamIndex
			});
			const libraryCovered = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.libraryCoverage", () => filterBattleLabCandidatesByLibrary(learnedCandidates, index));
			if (libraryCovered.candidates.length === 0) throw noLibraryCoverageError(libraryCovered.gaps, teamIndex + 1);
			const preselectedCandidates = await measureBattleLabPhaseAsync("engine.preselect", () => preselectCandidatesWithWorkers(libraryCovered.candidates, allowance, options.plannerWorkers ?? 1, options.signal));
			const generatedCandidates = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.pareto", () => selectDiverseParetoCandidates(preselectedCandidates, allowance));
			const candidates = filterBattleLabCandidatesByLibrary(mergeSeedCandidates(!fixedTeam && options.seedCandidates?.[teamIndex] ? [options.seedCandidates[teamIndex]] : [], generatedCandidates), index).candidates;
			if (candidates.length === 0) throw noLibraryCoverageError(libraryCovered.gaps, teamIndex + 1);
			const screened = [];
			const screeningStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
			let nextCandidate = 0;
			await runBattleLabTaskPool({
				concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
				next: (running) => {
					if (nextCandidate >= candidates.length || !hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running) || budget.count + running >= screeningEnd) return null;
					nextCandidate += 1;
					return nextCandidate - 1;
				},
				run: async (candidateIndex) => {
					const aggregate = createBattleLabCandidateResult(candidates[candidateIndex]);
					try {
						appendBattleLabCandidateSample(aggregate, await simulateCandidate({
							options: {
								...options,
								mode: singleMode
							},
							budget,
							runner,
							scorer,
							candidate: aggregate.candidate,
							teamIndex,
							round: 0,
							actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
							enemyContext: context
						}));
					} catch (error) {
						if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
						throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
						aggregate.failed += 1;
						errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
					}
					if (aggregate.samples.length > 0) screened[candidateIndex] = aggregate;
				}
			});
			const results = screened.filter((entry) => entry !== void 0);
			readPerformanceTime() - screeningStartedAt;
			const ranked = rankCandidates(results, true).slice(0, 64);
			if (ranked.length === 0) throw noSimulationError(errors, teamIndex + 1);
			pools.push(ranked);
		}
		const assignments = buildGrandAssignments(pools, 320).slice(0, 20);
		if (assignments.length === 0) throw new Error("Не нашлось непересекающихся пачек для всех боёв. Нужны разные герои в каждом составе.");
		const validation = assignments.map((assignment) => ({
			assignment,
			...createBattleLabRetainedSeries(),
			failed: 0
		}));
		let round = 1;
		let perfectVictoryAssignment = null;
		const simulateAssignment = async (target, simulationRound) => {
			try {
				const samples = [];
				for (let teamIndex = 0; teamIndex < teamCount; teamIndex += 1) samples.push(await simulateCandidate({
					options: {
						...options,
						mode: singleMode
					},
					budget,
					runner,
					scorer,
					candidate: target.assignment.teams[teamIndex].candidate,
					teamIndex,
					round: simulationRound,
					actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
					enemyContext: pickGrandEnemyContext(options.opponent.context, teamIndex)
				}));
				const wins = samples.filter((sample) => sample.win === true).length;
				appendBattleLabRetainedSample(target, {
					score: samples.reduce((total, sample) => total + sample.score, 0) + (wins >= (options.mode.requiredTeamWins ?? 2) ? 3e6 : 0),
					win: wins >= (options.mode.requiredTeamWins ?? 2),
					calculations: samples.map((sample) => sample.calculation),
					teamResults: samples.map((sample) => sample.win === true ? "win" : "loss"),
					stars: samples.reduce((total, sample) => total + finiteNumber$1(calculationResult(sample.calculation).stars), 0)
				});
			} catch (error) {
				if (isBattleLabBudgetExhausted(error)) return;
				throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
				target.failed += 1;
				errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
			}
		};
		const validationStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
		let focus = null;
		await runBattleLabTaskPool({
			concurrency: () => runner.concurrency,
			next: (running) => {
				if (perfectVictoryAssignment || !hasBattleLabBudgetForTask(budget, running, teamCount)) return null;
				if (focus && (!canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(focus) || isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(focus, []))) focus = null;
				const target = focus ?? validation[(round - 1) % validation.length];
				round += 1;
				return {
					target,
					simulationRound: round - 1
				};
			},
			run: async ({ target, simulationRound }) => {
				await simulateAssignment(target, simulationRound);
				if (perfectVictoryAssignment) return;
				if (isPerfectVictoryConfirmed(target, [])) perfectVictoryAssignment = target;
				else if (!focus && canStillConfirmPerfectVictory(target)) focus = target;
			}
		});
		readPerformanceTime() - validationStartedAt;
		const normallyRankedValidation = validation.filter((entry) => entry.samples.length > 0).sort((left, right) => grandMeanScore(right) - grandMeanScore(left));
		const rankedValidation = perfectVictoryAssignment ? [perfectVictoryAssignment, ...normallyRankedValidation.filter((entry) => entry !== perfectVictoryAssignment)] : normallyRankedValidation;
		if (rankedValidation.length === 0) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const best = rankedValidation[0];
		const summary = summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(best.observation, best.failed, true);
		const representative = best.bestSample;
		if (!representative) throw noSimulationError(errors);
		const alternatives = rankedValidation.slice(1, 5).map((entry) => {
			const alternativeSummary = summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(entry.observation, entry.failed, true);
			return {
				teams: entry.assignment.teams.map((team) => team.candidate),
				actions: [...AUTO_ACTIONS$1],
				statistics: alternativeSummary.statistics,
				score: grandMeanScore(entry)
			};
		});
		return {
			teams: best.assignment.teams.map((team) => team.candidate),
			score: grandMeanScore(best),
			wins: representative.teamResults.filter((result) => result === "win").length,
			stars: representative.stars,
			actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			calculations: representative.calculations,
			teamResults: representative.teamResults,
			confidence: summary.confidence,
			statistics: summary.statistics,
			calculationCount: budget.count,
			direction: options.direction,
			scenarioResults: [],
			timingSearch: {
				status: "disabled",
				tested: 0,
				candidateCount: 0,
				reason: "В Гранд-арене ручное применение ульт недоступно."
			},
			alternatives,
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: perfectVictoryAssignment !== null
		};
	}

	function encodeBattleActions(requested, timeline, byTime = false) {
		const actions = enforceManualCastWindow(requested);
		if (actions.length === 1 && actions[0].type === "auto" && actions[0].time === 0) return [
			"auto",
			0,
			0,
			"auto",
			0,
			0
		];
		const builder = BattleInputBuilder.fromActions(actions, { includeAutoAtStart: !(actions[0]?.type === "auto" && actions[0].time === 0) });
		return byTime ? builder.encodeByTime() : timeline === void 0 ? builder.encode() : builder.encodeWithTimeline(timeline);
	}
	async function simulateCandidate({ options, budget, runner, scorer, candidate, teamIndex, round, actions, enemyContext, scenario: scenarioOverride }) {
		await budget.acquire();
		const scenario = enemyContext === void 0 ? scenarioOverride ?? selectScenario(options, round) : null;
		const resolvedContext = enemyContext ?? scenario?.context ?? options.opponent.context;
		const seed = resolveSimulationSeed(options, `${options.opponent.id}:${scenario?.id ?? "default"}`, round, teamIndex);
		return simulatePreparedBattle({
			options,
			budget,
			runner,
			scorer,
			battle: measureBattleLabPhase("engine.buildBattle", () => options.buildBattle(candidate, resolvedContext, options.mode, seed, options.direction, teamIndex)),
			candidate,
			input: encodeBattleActions(actions),
			actions,
			seed,
			scenarioId: scenario?.id,
			scenarioLabel: scenario?.label,
			scenarioBuff: scenario?.buff ?? null,
			budgetAlreadyAcquired: true
		});
	}

	async function simulateCandidatePairWithExactTimeline(input) {
		await input.budget.acquire();
		const scenario = input.enemyContext === void 0 ? selectScenario(input.options, input.round) : null;
		const resolvedContext = input.enemyContext ?? scenario?.context ?? input.options.opponent.context;
		const seed = resolveSimulationSeed(input.options, `${input.options.opponent.id}:${scenario?.id ?? "default"}`, input.round, input.teamIndex);
		const battle = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.buildBattle", () => input.options.buildBattle(input.candidate, resolvedContext, input.options.mode, seed, input.options.direction, input.teamIndex));
		const baseline = await simulatePreparedBattle({
			...input,
			battle,
			input: encodeBattleActions(AUTO_ACTIONS$1),
			actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			seed,
			scenarioId: scenario?.id,
			scenarioLabel: scenario?.label,
			scenarioBuff: scenario?.buff ?? null,
			budgetAlreadyAcquired: true
		});
		if (input.runner.supportsTimeResolvedInput) return {
			automatic: baseline,
			timed: await simulatePreparedBattle({
				...input,
				battle,
				input: encodeBattleActions(input.actions, void 0, true),
				calculationOptions: { resolveInputByTime: true },
				seed,
				scenarioId: scenario?.id,
				scenarioLabel: scenario?.label,
				scenarioBuff: scenario?.buff ?? null
			})
		};
		const timelineProbe = await simulatePreparedBattle({
			...input,
			battle,
			input: [...TIMELINE_PROBE_INPUT$1],
			actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
			seed,
			scenarioId: scenario?.id,
			scenarioLabel: scenario?.label,
			scenarioBuff: scenario?.buff ?? null
		});
		if (!hasUsableBattleTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation)) throw new Error("Игровой движок не отдал шкалу или журнал боя для автотайминга.");
		const encoded = encodeBattleActions(input.actions, resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation));
		return {
			automatic: baseline,
			timed: await simulatePreparedBattle({
				...input,
				battle,
				input: encoded,
				seed,
				scenarioId: scenario?.id,
				scenarioLabel: scenario?.label,
				scenarioBuff: scenario?.buff ?? null
			})
		};
	}
	async function simulatePreparedBattle({ options, budget, runner, scorer, battle, candidate, input, actions, seed, scenarioId, scenarioLabel, scenarioBuff, budgetAlreadyAcquired = false, calculationOptions, memo }) {
		if (!calculationOptions && runner.supportsTimeResolvedInput && hasManualActions$1(actions)) {
			input = encodeBattleActions(actions, void 0, true);
			calculationOptions = { resolveInputByTime: true };
		}
		if (!budgetAlreadyAcquired) {
			const cached = memo?.read(input, actions);
			if (cached) return cached;
			await budget.acquire();
		}
		let calculation;
		try {
			calculation = await runner.simulateBattle(battle, input, candidate, options.mode, calculationOptions);
		} catch (error) {
			if (shouldCaptureBattleLabSimulationFailure(error)) saveBattleLabFailure("simulation", battle, error, {
				input,
				mode: options.mode.ident
			}, options.gameLibrary);
			throw error;
		}
		const outcome = calculationResult(calculation);
		const attackerWin = typeof outcome.win === "boolean" ? outcome.win : null;
		const win = attackerWin === null || ["asgard", "archdemon"].includes(options.opponent.modeId) && options.mode.objective === "max_damage" ? null : options.direction === "defense" ? !attackerWin : attackerWin;
		const rawScore = measureBattleLabPhase("engine.score", () => scorer.score(calculation, candidate));
		const score = options.direction === "defense" ? (attackerWin === false ? 2e6 : 0) - rawScore : rawScore;
		if (!Number.isFinite(score)) throw new Error("Игровой калькулятор вернул нечисловой результат.");
		const sample = {
			score,
			win,
			vector: extractBattleSnapshotVector(calculation, score, win, seed),
			calculation: compactBattleCalculation(calculation, input.length === 3 && input[0] === "auto" && input[1] === 0 && input[2] === 0),
			actions,
			seed,
			scenarioId,
			scenarioLabel,
			scenarioBuff
		};
		if (!budgetAlreadyAcquired) memo?.remember(input, sample);
		return sample;
	}
	function selectScenario(options, round) {
		return selectScenarioByRound(options.scenarios, round);
	}
	function summarizeScenarioResults(samples, observation) {
		if (observation) return Object.entries(observation.scenarios).map(([scenarioId, scenario]) => {
			const binaryCount = scenario.wins + scenario.losses;
			return {
				scenarioId,
				label: scenario.label,
				attempted: scenario.count,
				wins: scenario.wins,
				scoreMean: scenario.scoreCount > 0 ? scenario.scoreMean : 0,
				scoreDeviation: accumulatorDeviation(scenario),
				confidenceLow: binaryCount > 0 ? wilsonInterval(scenario.wins, binaryCount).low : null,
				buff: scenario.buff
			};
		});
		const grouped = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const sample of samples) {
			const id = sample.scenarioId ?? "default";
			const values = grouped.get(id) ?? [];
			values.push(sample);
			grouped.set(id, values);
		}
		return [...grouped.entries()].map(([scenarioId, values]) => {
			const summary = summarizeBattleLabSamples(values.map((sample) => ({
				score: sample.score,
				win: sample.win
			})), 0, values.some((sample) => sample.win !== null));
			return {
				scenarioId,
				label: values[0]?.scenarioLabel ?? scenarioId,
				attempted: values.length,
				wins: values.filter((sample) => sample.win === true).length,
				scoreMean: summary.statistics.scoreMean,
				scoreDeviation: summary.statistics.scoreDeviation,
				confidenceLow: summary.statistics.confidenceLow,
				buff: values[0]?.scenarioBuff ?? null
			};
		});
	}
	function emitCandidateProgress(options, budget, phase, candidates, actions = AUTO_ACTIONS$1) {
		if (!shouldEmitEngineProgress(options, budget, phase)) return;

			const binaryOutcome = options.mode.objective !== "max_damage";
			emitEngineProgress(options, budget, phase, rankCandidates(list, binaryOutcome).slice(0, 5).map((candidate) => progressEntry([candidate.candidate], actions, candidate.samples, candidate.failed, binaryOutcome, candidate.observation)));
		});
	}
	function emitTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, finalists, observations) {
		if (!shouldEmitEngineProgress(options, budget, "timing")) return;
		measureBattleLabPhase("engine.progress", () => publishTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, finalists, observations));
	}
	function publishTimingSearchProgress(options, budget, finalists, observations) {
		const grouped = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const aggregate of finalists) {
			const bestSample = [...aggregate.samples].sort((left, right) => isBetterSample(left, right) ? -1 : isBetterSample(right, left) ? 1 : 0)[0];
			if (!bestSample) continue;
			grouped.set(battleLabCandidateKey(aggregate.candidate), {
				aggregate,
				actions: AUTO_ACTIONS$1,
				samples: aggregate.samples,
				bestSample
			});
		}
		for (const item of observations) {
			const key = battleLabCandidateKey(item.aggregate.candidate);
			const group = grouped.get(key) ?? {
				aggregate: item.aggregate,
				actions: item.observation.actions,
				samples: [item.observation.sample],
				bestSample: item.observation.sample
			};
			if (isBetterSample(item.observation.sample, group.bestSample)) {
				group.actions = item.observation.actions;
				group.samples = [item.observation.sample];
				group.bestSample = item.observation.sample;
			}
			grouped.set(key, group);
		}
		emitEngineProgress(options, budget, "timing", [...grouped.values()].map((group) => progressEntry([group.aggregate.candidate], group.actions, group.samples, 0, options.mode.objective !== "max_damage")).sort(compareProgressEntries).slice(0, isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options) ? 10 : 5));
	}
	function emitTimingValidationProgress(options, budget, candidate, actions, samples, failed) {
		if (!shouldEmitEngineProgress(options, budget, "validation")) return;
		measureBattleLabPhase("engine.progress", () => emitEngineProgress(options, budget, "validation", [progressEntry([candidate], actions, samples, failed, options.mode.objective !== "max_damage")]));
	}
	function emitTrainingSearchProgress(options, budget, candidate, observations) {
		if (!shouldEmitEngineProgress(options, budget, "timing")) return;

		});
	}
	function emitTrainingValidationProgress(options, budget, candidate, actions, series, failed, automaticSeries) {

			}) : null;

		});
	}
	/**
	* Лидеров считаем только когда публикация реально дойдёт до интерфейса:
	* адаптер всё равно отбрасывает обновления чаще 100 мс, а ранжирование всего
	* пула после каждой пачки превращало отбор в квадратичную работу. Смена фазы
	* и последний расчёт бюджета проходят без ожидания.
	*/
	function shouldEmitEngineProgress(options, budget, phase) {
		const publish = options.onProcess;
		if (!publish) return false;
		const now = readPerformanceTime();
		const gate = engineProgressGates.get(publish);
		if (gate && gate.phase === phase && budget.count < budget.max && now - gate.publishedAt < ENGINE_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS$1) return false;
		engineProgressGates.set(publish, {
			publishedAt: now,
			phase
		});
		return true;
	}
	function progressEntry(teams, actions, samples, failed, binaryOutcome, observation) {
		const summary = observation ? summarizeBattleLabAccumulator(observation, failed, binaryOutcome) : summarizeBattleLabSamples(samples, failed, binaryOutcome);
		return {
			teams,
			actions: [...actions],
			statistics: summary.statistics,
			score: binaryOutcome ? summary.statistics.scoreMean : summary.statistics.scoreMax ?? summary.statistics.scoreMean
		};
	}
	function compareProgressEntries(left, right) {
		return (right.statistics.confidenceLow ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) - (left.statistics.confidenceLow ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) || (right.statistics.winRate ?? -1) - (left.statistics.winRate ?? -1) || right.score - left.score;
	}
	function emitEngineProgress(options, budget, phase, leaders) {
		options.onProcess?.({
			phase,
			completed: budget.count,
			total: budget.max,
			leaders: [...leaders]
		});
	}

	function resolveBattleLabTimingTeamPoolSize(maxCalculations, candidateCount, wideAsgardTiming) {
		const availableCandidates = Math.max(0, Math.floor(candidateCount));
		if (availableCandidates === 0) return 0;
		if (!wideAsgardTiming) return Math.min(3, availableCandidates);
		return availableCandidates;
	}
	/**
	* В Асгарде одинаковая порция на весь широкий пул делала поиск поверхностным:
	* каждая пачка получала пару проб, а сильнейшая не успевала раскрыть ульты.
	* Две попытки остаются у каждой, остаток уходит верхним составам по Calc.
	*/
	function resolveBattleLabTimingTeamBudget(remainingBudget, remainingTeams, wideAsgardTiming) {
		const budget = Math.max(0, Math.floor(remainingBudget));
		const teams = Math.max(1, Math.floor(remainingTeams));
		if (!wideAsgardTiming) return Math.floor(budget / teams);
		const minimumPerTeam = 2;
		const guaranteed = minimumPerTeam * teams;
		if (budget <= guaranteed) return Math.floor(budget / teams);
		const surplus = budget - guaranteed;
		const totalRankWeight = teams * (teams + 1) / 2;
		const priorityShare = Math.floor(surplus * teams / totalRankWeight);
		return Math.min(budget - minimumPerTeam * (teams - 1), minimumPerTeam + priorityShare);
	}
	function resolveTimingTeamLimit(options, maxCalculations, candidateCount) {
		return resolveBattleLabTimingTeamPoolSize(maxCalculations, candidateCount, isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options));
	}
	function isWideAsgardTimingSearch(options) {
		return options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" && options.mode.objective === "max_damage" && options.mode.manualAllowed && !options.compositionSearch && options.ultraTimingEnabled;
	}
	function isPreferredTimingChoice(candidate, current, mode) {
		return mode.objective === "max_damage" ? isBetterSample(candidate.sample, current.sample) : candidate.utility > current.utility;
	}
	function getCandidateResult(results, candidate) {
		const key = battleLabCandidateKey(candidate);
		let result = results.get(key);
		if (!result) {
			result = createBattleLabCandidateResult(candidate);
			results.set(key, result);

	}
	function rankCandidates(values, binaryOutcome) {
		const candidates = values.filter((value) => value.samples.length > 0);
		const byCandidate = new Map(candidates.map((entry) => [entry.candidate, entry]));
		return rankBattleRaceEntries(candidates, binaryOutcome).map((entry) => byCandidate.get(entry.candidate)).filter((entry) => entry !== void 0);
	}
	function buildGrandAssignments(pools, beamWidth) {
		let beam = [{
			teams: [],
			score: 0
		}];
		for (const pool of pools) {
			const next = [];
			for (const assignment of beam) {
				const usedUnits = new Set(assignment.teams.flatMap((team) => candidateUnitIds(team.candidate)));
				const usedPets = new Set(assignment.teams.flatMap((team) => candidatePetIds(team.candidate)));
				const usedBanners = new Set(assignment.teams.flatMap((team) => candidateBannerIds(team.candidate)));
				for (const candidate of pool) {
					const ids = candidateUnitIds(candidate.candidate);
					const pets = candidatePetIds(candidate.candidate);
					const banners = candidateBannerIds(candidate.candidate);
					if (ids.some((id) => usedUnits.has(id)) || pets.some((id) => usedPets.has(id)) || banners.some((id) => usedBanners.has(id))) continue;
					next.push({
						teams: [...assignment.teams, candidate],
						score: assignment.score + meanScore(candidate)
					});
				}
			}
			beam = next.sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score).slice(0, beamWidth);
			if (beam.length === 0) break;
		}
		return beam;
	}
	function pickGrandEnemyContext(context, teamIndex) {
		const defenders = Array.isArray(context.defenders) ? context.defenders : [context.defenders];
		const battle = asObjectRecord((Array.isArray(context.battles) ? context.battles : [])[teamIndex]);
		const banners = Array.isArray(context.banners) ? context.banners : [];
		return {
			...context,
			...battle,
			battle,
			defenders: battle.defenders ?? defenders[teamIndex] ?? {},
			grandBattleIndex: teamIndex,
			...banners[teamIndex] === void 0 ? {} : { banner: banners[teamIndex] }
		};
	}
	/** Сохраняет по одной поддержке каждого стартового состава до эвристического отсечения. */
	function selectCompositionSeeds(candidates, limit) {
		const lineups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const key = candidateUnitIds(candidate).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			if (!lineups.has(key)) lineups.set(key, candidate);
			if (lineups.size >= limit) break;
		}
		return [...lineups.values()];
	}
	/** Для распределения героев сохраняет разные составы, а не варианты петов одного лидера. */
	function selectCompositionResults(ranked, limit, protectedCandidates) {
		const protectedLineups = new Set(protectedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidateUnitIds(candidate).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",")));
		const ordered = [...ranked.filter((entry) => protectedLineups.has(candidateUnitIds(entry.candidate).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(","))), ...ranked];
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		return ordered.filter((entry) => {
			const key = candidateUnitIds(entry.candidate).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			if (seen.has(key) || seen.size >= limit) return false;
			seen.add(key);
			return true;
		});
	}
	/** Делит ограниченный скрининг между стартовыми составами и общим поиском. */
	function mergeSeedCandidates(seeds, generated, maxCandidates = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {
		const limit = Math.max(0, Math.floor(maxCandidates));
		const seedQuota = Math.ceil(limit / 2);
		const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of seeds ?? []) {
			if (result.size >= seedQuota) break;
			result.set(battleLabCandidateKey(candidate), candidate);
		}
		for (const candidate of generated) {
			if (result.size >= limit) break;
			const key = battleLabCandidateKey(candidate);
			if (!result.has(key)) result.set(key, candidate);
		}
		for (const candidate of seeds ?? []) {
			if (result.size >= limit) break;
			const key = battleLabCandidateKey(candidate);
			if (!result.has(key)) result.set(key, candidate);
		}
		return [...result.values()];
	}
	function candidateUnitIds(candidate) {

	function isBetterSample(left, right) {
		if (left.win === true && right.win !== true) return true;
		if (left.win !== true && right.win === true) return false;
		return left.score > right.score;
	}
	function timingImprovementUtility(timed, automatic) {
		const outcomeGain = timed.win === true && automatic.win !== true ? 2 : timed.win !== true && automatic.win === true ? -2 : 0;
		const scoreScale = Math.max(1, Math.abs(automatic.score));
		return outcomeGain + (timed.score - automatic.score) / scoreScale;
	}
	function resolveTimingImprovement(choice) {
		if (!choice || !hasManualActions$1(choice.actions)) return null;
		const baseline = choice.baseline.score;
		if (!Number.isFinite(baseline) || baseline === 0) return null;
		return (choice.sample.score - baseline) / Math.abs(baseline);
	}

	async function validateSecondaryAsgardTimingChoices(input) {
		const validated = [input.choices[0]];
		let round = Math.max(ASGARD_SCREENING_ROUNDS, ...input.choices.map((choice) => battleLabCandidateAttempts(choice.aggregate)));
		for (const choice of input.choices.slice(1)) {
			if (!hasManualActions$1(choice.actions)) {
				validated.push(choice);
				continue;
			}
			if (!input.budget.canRun(timingPairCalculationCount(input.runner))) {
				validated.push(resolveCandidateTimingChoice(choice.aggregate, void 0));
				continue;
			}
			try {
				const pair = await simulateCandidatePairWithExactTimeline({
					options: input.options,
					budget: input.budget,
					runner: input.runner,
					scorer: input.scorer,
					candidate: choice.aggregate.candidate,
					teamIndex: 0,
					round,
					actions: choice.actions
				});
				emitTimingValidationProgress(input.options, input.budget, choice.aggregate.candidate, choice.actions, [pair.timed], 0);
				if (isPairedTimingBetter([pair.timed], [pair.automatic], input.options.mode.objective)) {
					const timedSamples = [choice.sample, pair.timed];
					const automaticSamples = [choice.baseline, pair.automatic];
					const timedAggregate = createBattleLabCandidateResult(choice.aggregate.candidate, timedSamples);
					validated.push({
						...choice,
						aggregate: timedAggregate,
						sample: selectBestSample(timedSamples),
						baseline: selectBestSample(automaticSamples)
					});
				} else {
					const automaticAggregate = createBattleLabCandidateResult(choice.aggregate.candidate, choice.aggregate.samples);
					automaticAggregate.failed = choice.aggregate.failed;
					automaticAggregate.observation = structuredClone(choice.aggregate.observation ?? createBattleLabSampleAccumulator(choice.aggregate.samples));
					automaticAggregate.bestSample = choice.aggregate.bestSample ?? null;
					appendBattleLabCandidateSample(automaticAggregate, pair.automatic);
					validated.push(resolveCandidateTimingChoice(automaticAggregate, void 0));
				}
			} catch (error) {
				throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
				input.errors.push(getErrorMessage(error));
				validated.push(resolveCandidateTimingChoice(choice.aggregate, void 0));
			}
			round += 1;
		}
		return validated;
	}
	function selectBestSample(samples) {
		const sample = [...samples].sort((left, right) => isBetterSample(left, right) ? -1 : isBetterSample(right, left) ? 1 : 0)[0];
		if (!sample) throw new Error("У пачки нет успешного контрольного прогона.");
		return sample;
	}
	function selectDisjointTimingChoices(primary, candidates, requestedCount, beamWidth = 512) {
		const target = Math.max(1, Math.floor(requestedCount));
		if (target === 1) return [primary];
		const primaryUnits = new Set(candidateUnitIds(primary.aggregate.candidate));
		const pool = candidates.filter((choice) => candidateUnitIds(choice.aggregate.candidate).every((unitId) => !primaryUnits.has(unitId))).sort((left, right) => right.sample.score - left.sample.score);
		let beam = [{
			choices: [],
			usedUnits: new Set(primaryUnits),
			score: 0
		}];
		for (const choice of pool) {
			const ids = candidateUnitIds(choice.aggregate.candidate);
			const next = [...beam];
			for (const assignment of beam) {
				if (assignment.choices.length >= target - 1 || ids.some((unitId) => assignment.usedUnits.has(unitId))) continue;
				next.push({
					choices: [...assignment.choices, choice],
					usedUnits: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...assignment.usedUnits, ...ids]),
					score: assignment.score + choice.sample.score
				});
			}
			beam = next.sort((left, right) => right.choices.length - left.choices.length || right.score - left.score).slice(0, Math.max(8, Math.floor(beamWidth)));
		}
		return [primary, ...beam.sort((left, right) => right.choices.length - left.choices.length || right.score - left.score)[0]?.choices ?? []];
	}
	function resolveSimulationSeed(options, opponentId, round, teamIndex) {

	}
	function createBattleLabSimulationSeed(opponentId, round, teamIndex) {
		let hash = 2166136261;
		for (const character of opponentId) {
			hash ^= character.charCodeAt(0);
			hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619) >>> 0;
		}
		hash ^= Math.imul(Math.max(0, Math.floor(round)) + 1, 2654435761);
		hash ^= Math.imul(Math.max(0, Math.floor(teamIndex)) + 1, 2246822519);
		return mixUint32(hash) || 1;
	}
	function mixUint32(value) {
		let mixed = value >>> 0;
		mixed ^= mixed >>> 16;
		mixed = Math.imul(mixed, 2146121005) >>> 0;
		mixed ^= mixed >>> 15;
		mixed = Math.imul(mixed, 2221713035) >>> 0;
		mixed ^= mixed >>> 16;
		return mixed >>> 0;
	}

	async function compressBattleSnapshot(data) {
		const json = JSON.stringify(data);
		const stream = new Blob([json]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream("deflate"));
		const buffer = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();
		return "deflate:" + btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(buffer)));
	}
	async function decompressBattleSnapshot(encoded) {
		if (typeof encoded !== "string" || !encoded.startsWith("deflate:")) return encoded;
		const b64 = encoded.slice(8);
		const binString = atob(b64);
		const uint8 = new Uint8Array(binString.length);
		for (let i = 0; i < binString.length; i++) uint8[i] = binString.charCodeAt(i);
		const stream = new Blob([uint8]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate"));
		const json = await new Response(stream).text();
		return JSON.parse(json);
	}

	/**
	* Ограниченный beam search по уже рассчитанным альтернативам строк.
	* Не симулирует бой и не складывает пересекающихся героев. Жадный исходный
	* план всегда остаётся запасным: отсечение луча не может ухудшить его оценку.
	*/
	function selectAsgardPlan(rows, baseline, beamWidth = 64) {
		const heroBits = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const masks = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const row of rows) for (const choice of row) {
			let mask = 0n;
			for (const id of choice.team.unitIds) {
				if (!heroBits.has(id)) heroBits.set(id, 1n << BigInt(heroBits.size));
				mask |= heroBits.get(id);
			}
			masks.set(choice, mask);
		}
		let beam = [{
			choices: [],
			used: 0n,
			score: 0
		}];
		for (const row of rows) {
			const next = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			for (const prefix of beam) for (const choice of row) {
				const mask = masks.get(choice);
				if (!Number.isFinite(choice.score) || (mask & prefix.used) !== 0n) continue;
				const used = prefix.used | mask;
				const score = prefix.score + choice.score;
				if (score > (next.get(used)?.score ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)) next.set(used, {
					prefix,
					choice,
					used,
					score
				});
			}
			beam = [...next.values()].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.floor(beamWidth))).map((entry) => ({
				choices: [...entry.prefix.choices, entry.choice],
				used: entry.used,
				score: entry.score
			}));
			if (!beam.length) return [...baseline];
		}
		const originalScore = baseline.reduce((sum, choice) => sum + choice.score, 0);
		return beam[0] && beam[0].score > originalScore ? beam[0].choices : [...baseline];
	}
