	/** В записях истории рядом с героями лежит id питомца пачки (6000+). */
	function heroIdsOnly(ids) {
		return ids.filter((id) => id > 0 && id < 6e3);
	}
	/** Порядок героев не меняет состав; ключ общий для банка, архетипов и истории. */
	function asgardLineupKey(ids) {
		return [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
	}
	/**
	* Делит бюджет оценки потенциала на пробы. Меньше минимальной пробы не режем:
	* лучше проверить меньше составов, но с раскрытыми таймингами.
	*/
	function resolveAsgardPotentialBudget(budget, candidateCount) {
		const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(budget));
		const probes = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(candidateCount)), ASGARD_POTENTIAL_MAX_PROBES, Math.floor(total / 16), Math.max(1, Math.round(total / ASGARD_POTENTIAL_TARGET_PROBE)));
		return probes > 0 ? {
			probes,
			perProbe: Math.floor(total / probes)
		} : {
			probes: 0,
			perProbe: 0
		};
	}
	/**
	* У Асгарда один id противника на Оша и Маэстро, поэтому история фильтруется
	* по юниту босса в `enemyTeamIds`; без юнита берутся все записи цели.
	*/
	function isSameAsgardBoss(entry, opponentId, bossUnitId) {
		if (entry.modeId !== "asgard" || entry.opponentId !== opponentId) return false;
		return bossUnitId === null || entry.enemyTeamIds.flat().includes(bossUnitId);
	}
	/** Реальные бои по составам из подтверждённых сервером атак на этого босса. */
	function readAsgardObservations(history, opponentId, bossUnitId = null) {
		const observed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (entry.source !== "game" || !isSameAsgardBoss(entry, opponentId, bossUnitId)) continue;
			const damage = entry.damage ?? entry.score;
			if (damage === null || !Number.isFinite(damage) || entry.teamIds.length !== 1) continue;
			const key = asgardLineupKey(heroIdsOnly(entry.teamIds[0]));
			if (damage > (observed.get(key)?.damage ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)) observed.set(key, {
				damage,
				timings: [...entry.timings ?? []]
			});
		}
		return observed;
	}
	/**
	* Обратная связь от сервера: отношение реального урона к прогнозу Battle Lab
	* для того же состава. Составы без пары получают медиану известных отношений.
	* Ограничение [0.5; 2] не даёт одному странному бою перевернуть план.
	*/
	function readAsgardDamageCalibration(history, opponentId, bossUnitId = null) {
		const predicted = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (entry.source !== "battle-lab" || !isSameAsgardBoss(entry, opponentId, bossUnitId)) continue;
			const teams = entry.teams?.length ? entry.teams.map((team) => ({
				ids: team.unitIds,
				damage: team.damage
			})) : entry.teamIds.length === 1 ? [{
				ids: entry.teamIds[0],
				damage: entry.damage ?? entry.score
			}] : [];
			for (const team of teams) {
				if (!team.damage || !Number.isFinite(team.damage) || team.damage <= 0) continue;
				const key = asgardLineupKey(team.ids);
				predicted.set(key, Math.max(predicted.get(key) ?? 0, team.damage));
			}
		}
		const byLineup = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const [key, real] of readAsgardObservations(history, opponentId, bossUnitId)) {
			const forecast = predicted.get(key);
			if (!forecast || real.damage <= 0) continue;
			byLineup.set(key, Math.min(CALIBRATION_LIMITS[1], Math.max(CALIBRATION_LIMITS[0], real.damage / forecast)));
		}
		const ratios = [...byLineup.values()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
		return {
			byLineup,
			fallback: ratios.length ? ratios[Math.floor(ratios.length / 2)] : 1
		};
	}
	/**
	* Применяет калибровку только к оценке плана; урон симуляции в пачке не меняется.
	* Возвращает новые объекты и ту же раскладку базового плана по ним.
	*/
	function calibrateAsgardChoices(bank, baseline, calibration) {
		if (!calibration.byLineup.size) return {
			bank: [...bank],
			baseline: [...baseline]
		};
		const mapped = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const convert = (choice) => {
			const cached = mapped.get(choice);
			if (cached) return cached;
			const ratio = calibration.byLineup.get(asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds)) ?? calibration.fallback;
			const next = {
				...choice,
				score: choice.score * ratio
			};
			mapped.set(choice, next);
			return next;
		};
		return {
			bank: bank.map(convert),
			baseline: baseline.map(convert)
		};
	}
	/**
	* Автобой занижает пачки, которые раскрываются только ручными ультами
	* (Корнелиус, Джу): на авто они дают в разы меньше. Поэтому пробы берутся
	* не только сверху автобойного рейтинга, но и из архетипов и реальной истории.
	* Очереди чередуются, повторный состав не тратит второй бюджет.
	*/
	function selectAsgardPotentialProbes(bank, priors, limit) {
		const bestByLineup = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const choice of bank) {
			if (choice.team.unitIds.length !== 5 || !Number.isFinite(choice.score)) continue;
			const key = asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds);
			const current = bestByLineup.get(key);
			if (!current || choice.score > current.score) bestByLineup.set(key, choice);
		}
		const entries = [...bestByLineup.entries()];
		const byScore = [...entries].sort((a, b) => b[1].score - a[1].score);
		const archetypes = byScore.filter(([key]) => priors.archetypeKeys.has(key));
		const queues = [
			byScore,
			entries.filter(([key]) => priors.observedDamage.has(key)).sort((a, b) => (priors.observedDamage.get(b[0]) ?? 0) - (priors.observedDamage.get(a[0]) ?? 0)),
			archetypes,
			byScore
		];
		const cursors = queues.map(() => 0);
		const selected = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const target = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(limit)), bestByLineup.size);
		while (selected.size < target) {
			let advanced = false;
			for (const [index, queue] of queues.entries()) {
				while (cursors[index] < queue.length) {
					const [key, choice] = queue[cursors[index]++];
					if (selected.has(key)) continue;
					selected.set(key, choice);
					advanced = true;
					break;
				}
				if (selected.size >= target) break;
			}
			if (!advanced) break;
		}
		return [...selected.values()];
	}
	/** Есть ли в действиях что-то кроме служебного автобоя с нуля. */
	function hasTimedActions(team) {
		return (team.timings ?? []).some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0);
	}
	/**
	* Объяснение выбора пачки: откуда состав, сколько он дал на автобое и
	* сколько после проб таймингов. Сравнивается только тот же состав из банка.
	*/
	function explainAsgardChoice(choice, bank, context) {
		const key = asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds);
		const same = bank.filter((item) => asgardLineupKey(item.team.unitIds) === key);
		const best = (items) => items.length ? Math.max(...items.map((item) => item.team.damage ?? item.score)) : null;
		const auto = best(same.filter((item) => !hasTimedActions(item.team)));
		const timed = best(same.filter((item) => hasTimedActions(item.team)));
		const observed = context.observations.get(key)?.damage ?? null;
		const sources = [];
		if (context.archetypeKeys.has(key)) sources.push("archetype");
		if (observed !== null) sources.push("history");
		if (!sources.length) sources.push("screening");
		return {
			sources,
			autoDamage: auto,
			timedDamage: timed !== null && (auto === null || timed > auto) ? timed : null,
			observedDamage: observed,
			calibration: context.calibration.byLineup.get(key) ?? (context.calibration.byLineup.size ? context.calibration.fallback : 1)
		};
	}
	/**
	* Лучшие найденные тайминги каждого состава этого босса: реальные атаки и
	* рассчитанные пачки. Служебный автобой с нуля шаблоном не считается.
	*/
	function readAsgardTimingTemplates(history, opponentId, bossUnitId = null) {
		const best = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const consider = (ids, timings, damage) => {
			const heroes = heroIdsOnly(ids);
			if (!damage || damage <= 0 || heroes.length !== 5 || !timings.some(isManualAction)) return;
			const key = asgardLineupKey(heroes);
			if (damage > (best.get(key)?.damage ?? 0)) best.set(key, {
				ids: heroes,
				timings: timings.map((action) => ({ ...action })),
				damage
			});
		};
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (!isSameAsgardBoss(entry, opponentId, bossUnitId)) continue;
			if (entry.teams?.length) for (const team of entry.teams) consider(team.unitIds, team.timings ?? [], team.damage);
			else if (entry.teamIds.length === 1) consider(entry.teamIds[0], entry.timings ?? [], entry.damage ?? entry.score);
		}
		return [...best.values()].sort((a, b) => b.damage - a.damage);
	}
	function isManualAction(action, index = 1) {
		return action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0;
	}
	/**
	* Шаблон для состава: свой — как есть, иначе самый похожий по общим героям
	* (при равенстве — с большим уроном). Касты отсутствующих героев выпадают,
	* отложенный автобой и командные действия переносятся без изменений.
	*/
	function pickAsgardTimingTemplate(ids, templates) {
		const own = new Set(ids);
		let chosen = null;
		for (const template of templates) {
			const overlap = template.ids.filter((id) => own.has(id)).length;
			if (overlap < TEMPLATE_MIN_OVERLAP) continue;
			if (!chosen || overlap > chosen.overlap) chosen = {
				template,
				overlap
			};
		}
		if (!chosen) return null;
		const adapted = chosen.template.timings.filter((action) => action.type !== "cast" || own.has(action.unitId));
		return adapted.some((action, index) => isManualAction(action, index)) ? adapted : null;
	}
	/** Всё, что нужно объяснению выбора, читается из истории один раз на подбор. */
	function buildAsgardInsightContext(history, opponentId, bossUnitId) {
		return {
			archetypeKeys: listAsgardArchetypeLineupKeys(bossUnitId),
			observations: readAsgardObservations(history, opponentId, bossUnitId),
			calibration: readAsgardDamageCalibration(history, opponentId, bossUnitId)
		};
	}
	/** Пачки плана с объяснением выбора — и для превью, и для итога. */
	function withAsgardInsights(choices, bank, context) {
		return choices.map((choice) => ({
			...choice.team,
			insight: explainAsgardChoice(choice, bank, context)
		}));
	}
	var ASGARD_POTENTIAL_TARGET_PROBE, ASGARD_POTENTIAL_MAX_PROBES, CALIBRATION_LIMITS, TEMPLATE_MIN_OVERLAP;
	var init_asgard_potential = __esmMin((() => {
		init_asgard_archetypes();
		ASGARD_POTENTIAL_TARGET_PROBE = 24;
		ASGARD_POTENTIAL_MAX_PROBES = 24;
		CALIBRATION_LIMITS = [.5, 2];
		TEMPLATE_MIN_OVERLAP = 3;
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/engine/asgard-lineup-model.ts
	/** Пачки этого босса из истории: реальные атаки и рассчитанные Battle Lab строки. */
	function readAsgardLineupSamples(history, opponentId, bossUnitId) {
		const samples = [];
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (entry.modeId !== "asgard" || entry.opponentId !== opponentId) continue;
			if (bossUnitId !== null && !entry.enemyTeamIds.flat().includes(bossUnitId)) continue;
			if (entry.teams?.length) {
				for (const team of entry.teams) if (team.damage && team.damage > 0) samples.push({
					ids: team.unitIds,
					damage: team.damage
				});
				continue;
			}
			const damage = entry.damage ?? entry.score;
			if (entry.teamIds.length === 1 && damage && damage > 0) samples.push({
				ids: heroIdsOnly(entry.teamIds[0]),
				damage
			});
		}
		return samples;
	}
	/**
	* Стабильно переупорядочивает кандидатов по прогнозу. Обязательные составы
	* (`pinned`) остаются впереди в исходном порядке: их проверка не обсуждается.
	*/
	function orderByLineupModel(items, idsOf, model, pinned = () => false) {
		if (!model.ready) return [...items];
		const head = items.filter(pinned);
		const tail = items.filter((item) => !pinned(item)).map((item, index) => ({
			item,
			index,
			score: model.predict(idsOf(item))
		})).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.index - b.index).map((entry) => entry.item);
		return [...head, ...tail];
	}
	var RIDGE_LAMBDA, FIT_ITERATIONS, AsgardLineupModel;
	var init_asgard_lineup_model = __esmMin((() => {
		init_asgard_potential();
		init_defineProperty();
		RIDGE_LAMBDA = 1.5;
		FIT_ITERATIONS = 40;
		AsgardLineupModel = class AsgardLineupModel {
			constructor(intercept, weights, size) {
				_defineProperty(this, "intercept", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "weights", void 0);
				_defineProperty(this, "size", void 0);
				this.intercept = intercept;
				this.weights = weights;
				this.size = size;
			}
			static fit(samples) {
				const rows = samples.filter((sample) => sample.damage > 0 && sample.ids.length > 0).map((sample) => ({
					ids: [...new Set(sample.ids)],
					y: Math.log1p(sample.damage)
				}));
				if (!rows.length) return new AsgardLineupModel(0, /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), 0);
				const intercept = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.y, 0) / rows.length;
				const weights = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
				const rowsByHero = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
				rows.forEach((row, index) => {
					for (const id of row.ids) {
						weights.set(id, 0);
						rowsByHero.set(id, [...rowsByHero.get(id) ?? [], index]);
					}
				});
				const residuals = rows.map((row) => row.y - intercept);
				for (let iteration = 0; iteration < FIT_ITERATIONS; iteration += 1) for (const [id, indices] of rowsByHero) {
					const current = weights.get(id) ?? 0;
					let numerator = 0;
					for (const index of indices) numerator += residuals[index] + current;
					const next = numerator / (indices.length + RIDGE_LAMBDA);
					const delta = next - current;
					if (delta === 0) continue;
					for (const index of indices) residuals[index] -= delta;
					weights.set(id, next);
				}
				return new AsgardLineupModel(intercept, weights, rows.length);
			}
			get ready() {
				return this.size >= 12;
			}
			/** Прогноз log1p(урона); сравнивать имеет смысл только прогнозы одной модели. */
			predict(ids) {
				let value = this.intercept;
				for (const id of new Set(ids)) value += this.weights.get(id) ?? 0;
				return value;
			}
		};
	}));

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/asgard-potential-probe.ts
	/**
	* Короткая тренировка лучших строк банка: подбор ультов на одном seed и
	* парная проверка, затем те же тайминги на двух лучших вариантах питомца и
	* покровителей. Оценка пачки заменяется только если проба её подняла.
	*/
	async function probeAsgardTimingPotential(input) {
		const bossUnitId = resolveAsgardBossUnitId(input.opponent.context);
		const observations = readAsgardObservations(input.history, input.opponent.id, bossUnitId);
		const templates = readAsgardTimingTemplates(input.history, input.opponent.id, bossUnitId);
		const candidates = input.bank.filter((choice) => !input.probed?.has(asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds)));
		const unique = new Set(candidates.map((choice) => asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds)));
		const { probes, perProbe } = resolveAsgardPotentialBudget(input.budget, unique.size);
		const selected = selectAsgardPotentialProbes(candidates, {
			archetypeKeys: listAsgardArchetypeLineupKeys(bossUnitId),
			observedDamage: new Map([...observations].map(([key, observation]) => [key, observation.damage]))
		}, probes);
		if (!selected.length) return input.completed;
		for (const choice of selected) input.probed?.add(asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds));
		const spent = selected.map(() => 0);
		const total = () => input.completed + spent.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
		let next = 0;
		const executor = getBattleLabCalcExecutor();
		const parallel = executor ? Math.min(selected.length, Math.max(2, Math.floor(executor.concurrency))) : 1;
		const worker = async () => {
			while (next < selected.length && !input.signal?.aborted) {
				const index = next++;
				const report = (count) => {
					spent[index] = count;
					input.onProgress?.(total());
				};
				try {
					const improved = await probeChoice(input, selected[index], {
						budget: perProbe,
						timings: resolveProbeTimings(selected[index], observations, templates),
						report
					});
					if (improved) acceptImprovedChoice(input, selected[index], improved);
				} catch (error) {
					if (input.signal?.aborted) return;
					throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
					console.warn("[Battle Lab] Проба потенциала Асгарда не удалась", error);
				}
				if (input.publishPreview !== false) publishPotentialPreview(input, total());
			}
		};
		await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: parallel }, () => worker()));
		return total();
	}
	/** Тайминги реального рекордного боя этого состава — лучший старт поиска. */
	function resolveProbeTimings(choice, observations, templates) {
		const observed = observations.get(asgardLineupKey(choice.team.unitIds))?.timings;
		if (observed?.length) return observed;
		const own = choice.team.timings ?? [];
		if (own.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0)) return own;
		return pickAsgardTimingTemplate(choice.team.unitIds, templates) ?? [{
			type: "auto",
			time: 0
		}];
	}
	async function probeChoice(input, choice, probe) {
		const variants = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_SUPPORT_VARIANTS, Math.floor((probe.budget - 22) / SUPPORT_VARIANT_RUNS)));
		const mainBudget = probe.budget - variants * SUPPORT_VARIANT_RUNS;
		let used = 0;
		const run = async (team, timings, maxCalculations, ultraTimingEnabled) => {
			const base = used;
			const trained = await input.train({
				bestResult: {
					...input.template,
					teams: [team],
					timings,
					variations: void 0,
					asgardBuffPlan: void 0
				},
				maxCalculations,
				ultraTimingEnabled,
				onProgress: (count) => probe.report(base + count)
			});
			used = base + trained.calculationCount;
			probe.report(used);
			const trainedTeam = trained.teams[0];
			if (!trainedTeam) return null;
			const score = robustTrainingScore(trained);
			return {
				team: {
					...team,
					...trainedTeam,
					damage: score
				},
				score
			};
		};
		let best = await run(choice.team, probe.timings, mainBudget, true);
		const timings = best?.team.timings ?? probe.timings;
		for (const variant of listSupportVariants(input, choice.team, variants)) {
			if (input.signal?.aborted) break;
			const tried = await run(variant, timings, SUPPORT_VARIANT_RUNS, false);
			if (tried && (!best || tried.score > best.score)) best = tried;
		}
		return best && best.score > choice.score ? best : null;
	}
	/** В Асгарде важен пик: оценка пробы — лучший бой пачки с подбором под seed. */
	function robustTrainingScore(result) {
		return result.score;
	}
	/** Лучшие по эвристике варианты питомца и покровителей, отличные от текущего. */
	function listSupportVariants(input, team, limit) {
		if (limit < 1) return [];
		const row = input.manual.findIndex((ids) => ids.every((id) => team.unitIds.includes(id)));
		const ranked = generateFixedTeamCandidates({
			account: input.account,
			gameLibrary: input.gameLibrary,
			mode: input.mode
		}, [team.unitIds], input.opponent.context, input.mode, [row === -1 ? void 0 : input.supports?.[row]]).filter((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero" && !sameSupport(candidate, team)).sort((a, b) => b.approxScore - a.approxScore);
		const differentPet = (candidate) => (candidate.teamPet || 0) !== (team.teamPetId ?? 0);
		const heuristicPet = ranked.find(differentPet);
		const picked = [heuristicPet, ranked.filter((candidate) => differentPet(candidate) && candidate.teamPet !== heuristicPet?.teamPet).sort((a, b) => petPower(input, b.teamPet) - petPower(input, a.teamPet))[0]].filter((candidate) => candidate !== void 0);
		return [...picked, ...ranked.filter((item) => !picked.includes(item))].slice(0, limit).map((candidate) => ({
			...team,
			teamPetId: candidate.teamPet || null,
			bannerId: candidate.banner || null,
			favor: { ...candidate.favor },
			teamPet: candidate.teamPet ? input.account.pets[candidate.teamPet] ?? null : null
		}));
	}
	function petPower(input, petId) {
		const pet = input.account.pets[petId];
		return Number(pet?.power) || 0;
	}
	function sameSupport(candidate, team) {
		if ((candidate.teamPet || 0) !== (team.teamPetId ?? 0)) return false;
		return [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...Object.keys(candidate.favor), ...Object.keys(team.favor)])].every((key) => (candidate.favor[key] || 0) === (team.favor[key] || 0));
	}
	function acceptImprovedChoice(input, original, improved) {
		input.bank.push(improved);
		const row = input.baseline.indexOf(original);
		if (row !== -1 && sameSupportTeams(original.team, improved.team)) input.baseline[row] = improved;
	}
	function sameSupportTeams(left, right) {
		return (left.teamPetId ?? 0) === (right.teamPetId ?? 0) && JSON.stringify(Object.entries(left.favor).sort()) === JSON.stringify(Object.entries(right.favor).sort());
	}
	function publishPotentialPreview(input, completed) {
		const plan = selectAsgardPlan(buildAsgardPlanRows(input.bank, input.baseline, input.manual, input.supports), input.baseline, 256);
		const score = plan.reduce((sum, choice) => sum + choice.score, 0);
		input.onProcess?.({
			kind: "search",
			phase: "timing",
			completed,
			total: input.maxCalculations,
			variations: [{
				id: `${input.opponent.id}:asgard-potential`,
				rank: 1,
				teams: input.insightContext ? withAsgardInsights(plan, input.bank, input.insightContext) : plan.map((choice) => choice.team),
				actions: plan[0]?.team.timings ?? [{
					type: "auto",
					time: 0
				}],
				attempted: completed,
				succeeded: completed,
				failed: 0,
				wins: 0,
				losses: 0,
				unknown: completed,
				winRate: null,
				confidenceLow: null,
				confidenceHigh: null,
				scoreMean: score,
				scoreMax: score,
				scoreDeviation: 0
			}]
		});
	}

	/** Нажато «Взять лучшее», а не «Стоп». */
	function isSoftFinish(options) {
		return Boolean(options.finishSignal?.aborted) && !options.signal?.aborted;
	}
	/** Сигнал, который срабатывает при жёсткой остановке или при «Взять лучшее». */
	function combineAbortSignals(...signals) {
		const present = signals.filter((signal) => Boolean(signal));
		if (present.length < 2) return present[0];
		const controller = new AbortController();
		for (const signal of present) {
			if (signal.aborted) {
				controller.abort(signal.reason);
				break;
			}
			signal.addEventListener("abort", () => controller.abort(signal.reason), { once: true });
		}
		return controller.signal;
	}

				for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) for (const list of perLineup) if (list[i]) interleavedArchetypeCandidates.push(list[i]);
				seedCandidates = [...userSeeds, ...interleavedArchetypeCandidates];
			}
		}
		const normalized = normalizeEngineResult(await runBattleLabEngine({
			account,
			gameLibrary,
			opponent: engineOpponent,
			mode,
			maxCalculations,
			compositionSearch: options.compositionSearch,
			compositionRequiredHeroes: options.compositionRequiredHeroes,
			requestedTeamCount: opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? fixedTeams?.length || asgardTeamCount : 1,
			fixedTeams,
			fixedTeamSupports,
			fixedCandidates,
			plannerWorkers,
			direction,
			ultraTimingEnabled,
			ultraMinTime,
			ultraMaxTime,
			scenarios: resolveEngineScenarios(engineOpponent, scenarios),
			history,
			serverSeeds: resolveObservedServerSeeds(history, opponent.modeId),
			signal,
			seedCandidates,
			onProgress: publishCount,
			onProcess: publishProgress,
			buildBattle: (candidate, enemyContext, battleMode, seed, battleDirection, teamIndex) => buildBattle(candidate, enemyContext, battleMode, account, engineOpponent, seed, battleDirection, teamIndex, supportResolvers)
		}), engineOpponent, Date.now() - startedAt, account, supportResolvers);
		if (fixedTeams?.length) {
			const teamKey = (ids) => [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
			const expected = fixedTeams.map(teamKey).sort();
			const actual = normalized.teams.map((team) => teamKey(team.unitIds)).sort();
			if (expected.length !== actual.length || expected.some((key, index) => key !== actual[index])) throw new Error("Не удалось проверить все заданные составы. Увеличь бюджет расчётов.");
		}
		return normalized;
	}
	/**
	* Автобой не показывает потолок пачек, которые живут ручными ультами: часть
	* бюджета уходит на короткий подбор таймингов. Остаток делят построчный и общий
	* скрининг полного ростера.
	*/
	function splitAsgardSlotBudget(maxCalculations, teamCount, hasFreeSlots, timingAllowed) {
		const potentialBudget = timingAllowed && hasFreeSlots && maxCalculations >= teamCount * 40 ? Math.floor(maxCalculations * ASGARD_POTENTIAL_BUDGET_SHARE) : 0;
		const searchBudget = maxCalculations - potentialBudget;
		const globalBudget = teamCount > 1 && hasFreeSlots && searchBudget >= teamCount * 20 ? Math.floor(searchBudget * .5) : 0;
		return {
			potentialBudget,
			searchBudget,
			globalBudget,
			baselineBudget: searchBudget - globalBudget
		};
	}
	/**
	* Ранний скрининг берёт первые составы списка, поэтому порядок решает, кто
	* получит Calc. Модель «состав → урон» учится на истории этого босса и уже
	* посчитанных строках запуска; заданные и мета-составы остаются впереди.
	*/
	function orderAsgardSlotCandidates(candidates, options, preferredLineups, computed) {
		const bossUnitId = resolveAsgardBossUnitId(options.opponent.context);
		const model = AsgardLineupModel.fit([...readAsgardLineupSamples(options.history ?? [], options.opponent.id, bossUnitId), ...computed.map((choice) => ({
			ids: choice.team.unitIds,
			damage: choice.score
		}))]);
		const pinned = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...preferredLineups.map((ids) => asgardLineupKey(ids)), ...listAsgardArchetypeLineupKeys(bossUnitId)]);
		const idsOf = (candidate) => candidate.type === "hero" ? candidate.heroes : candidate.titans;
		return orderByLineupModel(candidates, idsOf, model, (candidate) => pinned.has(asgardLineupKey(idsOf(candidate))));
	}
	/** Выравнивает ручные строки по числу пачек и проверяет, что план вообще собирается. */
	function prepareAsgardSlotRows(options) {
		const teamCount = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.asgardTeamCount ?? options.fixedTeams?.length ?? 5)));
		if ((options.fixedTeams?.length ?? 0) > teamCount) throw new Error("Число ручных пачек превышает число строк плана.");
		const manual = Array.from({ length: teamCount }, (_, index) => options.fixedTeams?.[index] ?? []);
		validateFixedTeams(manual.filter((team) => team.length > 0), Object.keys(options.accountSnapshot.heroes).map(Number));
		if (Object.keys(options.accountSnapshot.heroes).length < teamCount * 5) throw new Error(`Для ${teamCount} пачек нужно ${teamCount * 5} доступных героев.`);
		if (options.maxCalculations < teamCount) throw new Error(`Для проверки ${teamCount} пачек нужен бюджет хотя бы ${teamCount} расчётов.`);
		return {
			teamCount,
			manual
		};
	}
	/** Сохраняет допустимый план и улучшает его общим банком рассчитанных составов. */
	async function optimizeAsgardSlots(sourceOptions, mode) {
		const finishSignal = sourceOptions.finishSignal;
		const options = {
			...sourceOptions,
			signal: combineAbortSignals(sourceOptions.signal, finishSignal)
		};
		const { teamCount, manual } = prepareAsgardSlotRows(options);
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		const results = [];
		const alternatives = [];
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const { potentialBudget, searchBudget, globalBudget, baselineBudget } = splitAsgardSlotBudget(options.maxCalculations, teamCount, manual.some((ids) => ids.length < 5), options.ultraTimingEnabled !== false && mode.manualAllowed);
		const preferredLineups = [...(options.seedTeams ?? []).map((team) => team.unitIds), ...(options.history ?? []).filter((entry) => entry.modeId === "asgard").sort((a, b) => (b.damage ?? b.score ?? 0) - (a.damage ?? a.score ?? 0)).slice(0, 16).flatMap((entry) => entry.teamIds).slice(0, 32)];
		let completed = 0;
		const insightContext = buildAsgardInsightContext(options.history ?? [], options.opponent.id, resolveAsgardBossUnitId(options.opponent.context));
		let probeSpent = 0;
		const probed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const probe = (input) => probeAsgardTimingPotential({
			...input,
			probed,
			insightContext,
			opponent: options.opponent,
			history: options.history ?? [],
			account: options.accountSnapshot,
			gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
			mode,
			maxCalculations: options.maxCalculations,
			signal: options.signal,
			onProgress: options.onProgress,
			onProcess: options.onProcess,
			train: (request) => trainBattleLabResult({
				accountSnapshot: options.accountSnapshot,
				caller: options.caller,
				gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
				opponent: options.opponent,
				plannerWorkers: options.plannerWorkers,
				scenarios: options.scenarios,
				history: options.history,
				signal: options.signal,
				ultraMinTime: options.ultraMinTime,
				ultraMaxTime: options.ultraMaxTime,
				...request
			})
		});
		for (let slot = 0; slot < teamCount; slot += 1) {
			if (options.signal?.aborted && results.length) break;
			options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
			const reserved = new Set(manual.flatMap((ids, index) => index === slot ? [] : ids));
			const account = {
				...options.accountSnapshot,
				heroes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(options.accountSnapshot.heroes).filter(([id]) => !reserved.has(Number(id)) && !used.has(Number(id)))),
				teamPresets: {}
			};
			const candidates = orderAsgardSlotCandidates(generateAsgardSlotCandidates({
				account,
				gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
				mode
			}, manual[slot], options.opponent.context, options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot], preferredLineups), options, preferredLineups, alternatives.flat());
			if (!candidates.length) throw new Error(`Не удалось дополнить пачку ${slot + 1} доступными героями.`);
			const priorTeams = results.flatMap((result) => result.teams);
			const priorScore = results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.score, 0);
			const rowSearch = optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
				...options,
				accountSnapshot: account,
				asgardTeamCount: 1,
				fixedTeams: void 0,
				fixedTeamSupports: [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot] ?? {
					teamPet: "auto",
					banner: "auto"
				}],
				fixedCandidates: candidates,
				compositionSearch: true,
				compositionRequiredHeroes: manual[slot],
				seedTeams: [],
				maxCalculations: Math.max(1, Math.floor((baselineBudget - (completed - probeSpent)) / (teamCount - slot))),
				onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(completed + count),
				onProcess: (progress) => options.onProcess?.({
					...progress,
					completed: completed + progress.completed,
					total: options.maxCalculations,
					variations: progress.variations.map((variation) => ({
						...variation,
						teams: [...priorTeams, ...variation.teams],
						scoreMean: priorScore + variation.scoreMean,
						scoreMax: priorScore + (variation.scoreMax ?? variation.scoreMean)
					}))
				})
			});
			let result;
			try {
				result = await rowSearch;
			} catch (error) {
				if (isSoftFinish(sourceOptions) && results.length > 0) break;
				throw error;
			}
			const selected = result.teams[0];
			if (!selected || selected.unitIds.length !== 5 || manual[slot].some((id) => !selected.unitIds.includes(id))) throw new Error(`Пачка ${slot + 1}: движок не сохранил заданных героев.`);
			selected.unitIds.forEach((id) => used.add(id));
			results.push(result);
			alternatives.push([{
				team: {
					...selected,
					damage: selected.damage ?? result.score
				},
				score: robustAsgardResultScore(selected, result)
			}, ...(result.variations ?? []).slice(1, 129).flatMap((variation) => {
				const team = variation.teams[0];
				if (!team || team.unitIds.length !== 5 || manual[slot].some((id) => !team.unitIds.includes(id))) return [];
				const score = robustAsgardScore(team, variation);
				return [{
					team: {
						...team,
						damage: score,
						timings: variation.actions
					},
					score
				}];
			})]);
			completed += result.calculationCount;
			options.onProgress?.(completed);
			const rowProbeBudget = Math.floor(potentialBudget * EARLY_POTENTIAL_SHARE / teamCount);
			if (rowProbeBudget >= 16 && !options.signal?.aborted) {
				const row = alternatives[slot];
				const rowBaseline = [row[0]];
				const before = completed;
				completed = await probe({
					manual: [manual[slot]],
					supports: [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot] ?? {
						teamPet: "auto",
						banner: "auto"
					}],
					baseline: rowBaseline,
					bank: row,
					template: result,
					completed,
					budget: rowProbeBudget,
					publishPreview: false
				});
				probeSpent += completed - before;
				alternatives[slot] = [rowBaseline[0], ...row.filter((choice) => choice !== rowBaseline[0])];
				publishAsgardRowsPreview(options, alternatives, completed, insightContext);
			}
		}
		const baseline = alternatives.map((row) => row[0]);
		const bank = alternatives.flat();
		const exploration = await exploreAsgardCompositionBank({
			options,
			mode,
			manual,
			baseline,
			bank,
			preferredLineups,
			completed,
			budgetEnd: searchBudget,
			enabled: Boolean(globalBudget)
		});
		completed = exploration.completed;
		const globalResults = exploration.results;
		if (potentialBudget > 0 && !options.signal?.aborted && results[0]) completed = await probe({
			manual,
			supports: options.fixedTeamSupports,
			baseline,
			bank,
			template: results[0],
			completed,
			budget: options.maxCalculations - completed
		});
		const calibrated = calibrateAsgardChoices(bank, baseline, insightContext.calibration);
		const plan = selectAsgardPlan(buildAsgardPlanRows(calibrated.bank, calibrated.baseline, manual, options.fixedTeamSupports), calibrated.baseline, 256);
		return {
			...combineAsgardPlanResults({
				results,
				globalResults,
				baseline: calibrated.baseline,
				plan,
				completed,
				startedAt
			}),
			teams: withAsgardInsights(plan, bank, insightContext)
		};
	}
	/** Подтверждённая несколькими seed пачка оценивается средним, одиночная — своим боем. */
	function robustAsgardScore(team, variation) {
		return variation.succeeded > 1 ? variation.scoreMean : team.damage ?? variation.scoreMax ?? variation.scoreMean;
	}
	function robustAsgardResultScore(team, result) {
		const statistics = result.statistics;
		return statistics && statistics.succeeded > 1 ? statistics.scoreMean : team.damage ?? result.score;
	}
	/** Превью плана из уже готовых строк: первые варианты каждой строки. */
	function publishAsgardRowsPreview(options, rows, completed, insightContext) {
		const teams = withAsgardInsights(rows.map((row) => row[0]), rows.flat(), insightContext);
		const score = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row[0].score, 0);
		options.onProcess?.({
			kind: "search",
			phase: "timing",
			completed,
			total: options.maxCalculations,
			variations: [{
				id: `${options.opponent.id}:asgard-rows`,
				rank: 1,
				teams,
				actions: teams[0]?.timings ?? [{
					type: "auto",
					time: 0
				}],
				attempted: completed,
				succeeded: completed,
				failed: 0,
				wins: 0,
				losses: 0,
				unknown: completed,
				winRate: null,
				confidenceLow: null,
				confidenceHigh: null,
				scoreMean: score,
				scoreMax: score,
				scoreDeviation: 0
			}]
		});
	}
	/** Собирает результат общего плана без выдачи первого снапшота за повтор пяти боёв. */
	function combineAsgardPlanResults({ results, globalResults, baseline, plan, completed, startedAt }) {
		const changedPlan = plan.some((choice, index) => choice !== baseline[index]);
		const teams = plan.map((choice) => choice.team);
		const score = plan.reduce((sum, choice) => sum + choice.score, 0);
		return {
			...results[0],
			teams,
			score,
			damage: score,
			wins: !changedPlan && results.every((result) => result.wins !== null) ? results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + (result.wins ?? 0), 0) : null,
			stars: !changedPlan && results.every((result) => result.stars !== null) ? results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + (result.stars ?? 0), 0) : null,
			timingSource: teams.some((team) => team.timings?.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0)) ? "calculated" : "automatic",
			elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
			calculationCount: completed,
			simulatedTeamCount: [...results, ...globalResults].reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.simulatedTeamCount, 0),
			estimatedTeamCount: [...results, ...globalResults].reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.estimatedTeamCount, 0),
			confidence: changedPlan ? 0 : Math.min(...results.map((result) => result.confidence)),
			timings: teams[0]?.timings ?? [{
				type: "auto",
				time: 0
			}],
			timingImprovement: teams[0]?.timingImprovement ?? null,
			teamResults: changedPlan ? teams.map(() => "unknown") : results.flatMap((result) => result.teamResults ?? ["unknown"]),
			battleSnapshot: null,
			details: null,
			statistics: void 0,
			scenarioResults: [],
			variations: [],
			timingSearch: {
				status: "disabled",
				tested: 0,
				candidateCount: 0,
				reason: "Составы выбраны по общему урону рассчитанных пачек; тренировка уточняет индивидуальные тайминги."
			}
		};
	}
	/** Проверяет полный ростер и публикует только допустимые общие планы, включая остановку. */
	async function exploreAsgardCompositionBank({ options, mode, manual, baseline, bank, preferredLineups, completed, budgetEnd, enabled }) {
		const globalResults = [];
		const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		if (enabled && baseline.length === manual.length) manual.forEach((ids, slot) => {
			if (ids.length === 5) return;
			const support = options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot];
			const key = JSON.stringify([
				ids.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b),
				support?.teamPet === void 0 ? "auto" : support.teamPet,
				support?.banner === void 0 ? "auto" : support.banner,
				Object.entries(support?.favor ?? {}).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)),
				support?.fillEmptySlots ?? false
			]);
			if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, slot);
		});
		const slots = [...groups.values()];
		for (const [groupIndex, slot] of slots.entries()) {
			if (options.signal?.aborted) break;
			const reserved = new Set(manual.flatMap((ids, index) => index === slot ? [] : ids));
			const account = {
				...options.accountSnapshot,
				heroes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(options.accountSnapshot.heroes).filter(([id]) => !reserved.has(Number(id)))),
				teamPresets: {}
			};
			const candidates = orderAsgardSlotCandidates(generateAsgardSlotCandidates({
				account,
				gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
				mode
			}, manual[slot], options.opponent.context, options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot], [...preferredLineups, ...baseline.map((choice) => choice.team.unitIds)]), options, preferredLineups, bank);
			if (!candidates.length) continue;
			const partial = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			let globalCount = 0;
			let result;
			try {
				result = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
					...options,
					accountSnapshot: account,
					asgardTeamCount: 1,
					fixedTeams: void 0,
					fixedTeamSupports: [options.fixedTeamSupports?.[slot] ?? {
						teamPet: "auto",
						banner: "auto"
					}],
					fixedCandidates: candidates,
					compositionSearch: true,
					compositionRequiredHeroes: manual[slot],
					seedTeams: [],
					maxCalculations: Math.max(1, Math.floor((budgetEnd - completed) / (slots.length - groupIndex))),
					onProgress: (count) => {
						globalCount = count;
						options.onProgress?.(completed + count);
					},
					onProcess: (progress) => {
						globalCount = progress.completed;
						for (const variation of progress.variations) {
							const team = variation.teams[0];
							if (!team || team.unitIds.length !== 5) continue;
							const key = team.unitIds.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
							const score = robustAsgardScore(team, variation);
							if (score > (partial.get(key)?.score ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)) partial.set(key, {
								team: {
									...team,
									damage: score,
									timings: variation.actions
								},
								score
							});
						}
						if (partial.size > 128) {
							const retained = [...partial.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1].score - a[1].score).slice(0, 128);
							partial.clear();
							retained.forEach(([key, choice]) => partial.set(key, choice));
						}
						const preview = selectAsgardPlan(buildAsgardPlanRows([...bank, ...partial.values()], baseline, manual, options.fixedTeamSupports), baseline, 256);
						const score = preview.reduce((sum, choice) => sum + choice.score, 0);
						options.onProcess?.({
							...progress,
							completed: completed + progress.completed,
							total: options.maxCalculations,
							variations: progress.variations.length ? [{
								...progress.variations[0],
								teams: preview.map((choice) => choice.team),
								scoreMean: score,
								scoreMax: score
							}] : []
						});
					}
				});
			} catch (error) {
				if (!options.signal?.aborted) throw error;
				bank.push(...partial.values());
				completed += globalCount;
				break;
			}
			globalResults.push(result);
			bank.push(...result.teams.map((team) => ({
				team,
				score: robustAsgardResultScore(team, result)
			})), ...(result.variations ?? []).flatMap((variation) => variation.teams.map((team) => ({
				team: {
					...team,
					timings: variation.actions
				},
				score: robustAsgardScore(team, variation)
			}))));
			completed += result.calculationCount;
			options.onProgress?.(completed);
		}
		return {
			results: globalResults,
			completed
		};
	}
	async function runBattleLabResultTraining({ accountSnapshot, caller, gameLibrary, opponent, bestResult, maxCalculations, plannerWorkers = 4, scenarios = opponent.scenarios, history = [], signal, onProgress, onProcess, ultraTimingEnabled = true, ultraMinTime = 1, ultraMaxTime = 120 }) {
		const account = accountSnapshot ?? (opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? await fetchArchdemonAccount(caller, opponent, gameLibrary) : opponent.modeId === "invasion" ? await fetchBattleLabInvasionAccount(caller, opponent, gameLibrary) : await fetchAccountSnapshot(caller));
		if (opponent.modeId === "archdemon" && bestResult.archdemonTalismanPlan) {
			opponent = withArchdemonTalisman(opponent, readArchdemonTalismans(gameLibrary), bestResult.archdemonTalismanPlan.talismanId);
			scenarios = void 0;
		}
		if (opponent.modeId === "asgard" && bestResult.asgardBuffPlan) opponent = withAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, gameLibrary, readAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, gameLibrary, (key) => key), bestResult.asgardBuffPlan.counts);
		const direction = bestResult.direction ?? "attack";
		assertAsgardBossRoster(opponent, account);
		const mode = resolveBattleMode(opponent, account, direction);
		const supportResolvers = createSupportResolvers(gameLibrary, account);
		const publishProgress = createEngineProgressPublisher(onProcess, account, supportResolvers, "training");
		const publishCount = createCalculationProgressPublisher(onProgress, maxCalculations);
		const engineOpponent = enrichOpponentForEngine(opponent, gameLibrary);
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		const result = await trainBattleLabEngine({
			account,
			gameLibrary,
			opponent: engineOpponent,
			mode,
			maxCalculations,
			plannerWorkers,
			direction,
			ultraTimingEnabled,
			ultraMinTime,
			ultraMaxTime,
			scenarios: resolveEngineScenarios(engineOpponent, scenarios),
			history,
			serverSeeds: resolveObservedServerSeeds(history, opponent.modeId),
			signal,
			onProgress: publishCount,
			onProcess: publishProgress,
			buildBattle: (candidate, enemyContext, battleMode, seed, battleDirection, teamIndex) => buildBattle(candidate, enemyContext, battleMode, account, engineOpponent, seed, battleDirection, teamIndex, supportResolvers)
		}, bestResult.teams.map((team) => bestTeamToCandidate(team, opponent.modeId)), bestResult.timings);
		return {
			...normalizeEngineResult(result, engineOpponent, Date.now() - startedAt, account, supportResolvers),
			asgardBuffPlan: bestResult.asgardBuffPlan,
			archdemonTalismanPlan: bestResult.archdemonTalismanPlan ? {
				...bestResult.archdemonTalismanPlan,
				damageMean: result.statistics.scoreMean
			} : void 0
		};
	}
	function bestTeamToCandidate(team, modeId) {
		if (isTitanArenaMode(modeId) || team.units?.some((unit) => unit.type === "titan")) return {
			type: "titan",
			titans: [...team.unitIds],
			totems: team.totems?.map((totem) => ({ ...totem })) ?? [],
			approxScore: 0
		};
		return {
			type: "hero",
			heroes: [...team.unitIds],
			teamPet: team.teamPetId ?? 0,
			favor: { ...team.favor },
			banner: team.bannerId ?? 0,
			approxScore: 0
		};
	}
	async function fetchAccountSnapshot(caller) {
		if (canUseCallerInstance(caller)) try {
			const instance = new caller(ACCOUNT_CALLS.map((name) => ({
				name,
				args: {},
				ident: name
			})));
			await instance.send();
			const resultsMap = {};
			for (const name of ACCOUNT_CALLS) resultsMap[name] = instance.result(name);
			return normalizeAccountSnapshot(resultsMap);
		} catch {}
		return normalizeAccountSnapshot(await caller.send(ACCOUNT_CALLS));
	}
	function canUseCallerInstance(caller) {

	}

	function isPetCollection(value) {
		if (!value) return false;
		const unwrapped = unwrapCallResponse(value);
		if (Array.isArray(unwrapped)) return unwrapped.some((u) => {
			const rec = asRecord$1(u);
			const id = positiveInteger(rec.id ?? rec.petId);
			return id !== null && id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3;
		});
		const record = asRecord$1(unwrapped);
		if (Array.isArray(record.pets) && record.pets.length > 0) return true;
		if (asRecord$1(record.pets) && Object.keys(asRecord$1(record.pets)).length > 0) return true;
		return Object.keys(record).some((key) => {
			const id = Number(key);
			return id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3;
		});
	}
	function getFallbackAccountPets() {
		const root = globalThis;
		const cheatsObj = root?.cheats;
		const candidates = [root?.HWHData && asRecord$1(root.HWHData).pets, cheatsObj && typeof cheatsObj.getSelfGame === "function" ? cheatsObj.getSelfGame()?.pets : void 0];
		for (const candidate of candidates) if (candidate) {
			const normalized = normalizeOwnedCollection(candidate, "pet");
			if (Object.keys(normalized).length > 0) return normalized;
		}
		return {};
	}
	function unwrapCallResponse(value) {
		const envelope = asRecord$1(value);
		return asRecord$1(envelope.result).response ?? envelope.response ?? value;
	}
	function normalizeOwnedCollection(value, type) {
		const unwrapped = unwrapCallResponse(value);
		if (Array.isArray(unwrapped)) return normalizeOwnedUnits(unwrapped, type);
		const record = asRecord$1(unwrapped);
		return normalizeOwnedUnits((type === "hero" ? ["heroes", "hero"] : type === "pet" ? ["pets", "pet"] : ["titans", "titan"]).map((alias) => record[alias]).find((candidate) => Array.isArray(candidate) ? candidate.length > 0 : Object.keys(asRecord$1(candidate)).length > 0) ?? unwrapped, type);
	}
	/** Применяет серверные ограничения режима к ростеру до UI и расчёта. */
	function restrictAccountForOpponent(account, opponent) {
		if (opponent.modeId === "invasion") account = restrictBattleLabInvasionAccount(account, opponent.context);
		if (opponent.modeId === "territory") account = applyBattleLabTerritoryDefenseState(account, opponent.context);
		const excluded = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
			...opponent.context.__battleLabUsedHeroes ?? [],
			...opponent.context.__battleLabUsedTitans ?? [],
			...opponent.context.__battleLabExcludedUnits ?? [],
			...opponent.usedHeroes ?? []
		]);
		if (opponent.modeId === "asgard") {
			const asgardUsed = [
				...opponent.usedHeroes ?? [],
				...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(opponent),
				...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(opponent.context),
				...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot)
			];
			for (const id of asgardUsed) excluded.add(id);
			const roots = [opponent.context, asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot)];
			for (const root of roots) collectUsedIds(root, excluded);
		}
		if (excluded.size) account = {
			...account,
			heroes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(account.heroes).filter(([id]) => !excluded.has(Number(id)))),
			titans: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(account.titans).filter(([id]) => !excluded.has(Number(id))))
		};
		return account;
	}
	/**
	* В Территории здоровье и энергия выбранной команды не обновляются между
	* боями. Берём только серверное состояние своей защиты; чужие ключи и пустые
	* поля не меняют ростер, чтобы из частичного push не получить «мёртвую» пачку.
	*/
	function applyBattleLabTerritoryDefenseState(account, context) {
		const states = asRecord$1(context.__battleLabTerritoryDefenseState);
		if (Object.keys(states).length === 0) return account;
		const heroes = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(account.heroes).map(([id, hero]) => {
			const state = asRecord$1(states[id]);
			const hp = finiteNumber$1(state.hp, NaN);
			const energy = finiteNumber$1(state.energy, NaN);
			if (!Number.isFinite(hp) && !Number.isFinite(energy) && state.isDead !== true) return [id, hero];
			return [id, {
				...hero,
				...Number.isFinite(hp) ? { hp } : {},
				...Number.isFinite(energy) ? { energy } : {},
				...state.isDead === true ? { isDead: true } : {}
			}];
		}));
		return {
			...account,
			heroes
		};
	}
	/**
	* Во Вторжении обычный `heroGetAll` возвращает весь аккаунт. Состав события
	* задают текущая глава и выданные сервером фрагменты. Ненулевой счётчик уже
	* открывает бойца, а отметка `1/3` в лавке означает промежуточный ранг, не
	* доступность. Иначе оптимизатор подберёт запрещённого героя или пропустит
	* уже полученного бойца.
	*/
	function restrictBattleLabInvasionAccount(account, context) {
		const allowed = new Set(Array.isArray(context.__battleLabInvasionAllowedUnits) ? context.__battleLabInvasionAllowedUnits.map(Number) : []);
		const fragments = new Set(Object.entries(asRecord$1(context.__battleLabInvasionFragments)).filter(([, count]) => finiteNumber$1(count) > 0).map(([id]) => Number(id)).filter(Number.isSafeInteger));
		const available = context.__battleLabInvasionFullRoster === true && allowed.size > 0 ? allowed : allowed.size > 0 && fragments.size > 0 ? new Set([...allowed].filter((id) => fragments.has(id))) : allowed.size > 0 ? allowed : fragments;
		if (available.size === 0) return account;
		const filter = (units) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(units).filter(([id]) => available.has(Number(id))));
		return {
			...account,
			heroes: filter(account.heroes),
			titans: filter(account.titans),
			pets: filter(account.pets)
		};
	}
	function collectUsedIds(value, target) {
		for (const key of [
			"usedHeroes",
			"bossUsedHeroes",
			"heroesUsed",
			"__battleLabUsedHeroes"
		]) {
			const source = value[key];
			const values = Array.isArray(source) ? source : Object.values(asRecord$1(source));
			for (const item of values) {
				const id = positiveInteger(asRecord$1(item).id ?? item);
				if (id) target.add(id);
			}
		}
		const userStats = asRecord$1(value.userStats);
		if (Object.keys(userStats).length > 0 && userStats !== value) collectUsedIds(userStats, target);
		const root = asRecord$1(value.__battleLabRoot);
		if (Object.keys(root).length > 0 && root !== value) collectUsedIds(root, target);
		const progress = asRecord$1(value.progress);
		if (Object.keys(progress).length > 0 && progress !== value) collectUsedIds(progress, target);
	}
	function normalizeAccountBanners(...sources) {
		const banners = {};
		const visit = (value) => {
			const directId = positiveInteger(asRecord$1(value).id ?? value);
			if (directId) {
				const source = asRecord$1(value);
				banners[String(directId)] = Object.keys(source).length > 0 ? {
					...source,
					id: directId
				} : { id: directId };
				return;
			}
			if (Array.isArray(value)) {
				value.forEach(visit);
				return;
			}
			Object.values(asRecord$1(value)).forEach(visit);
		};
		sources.forEach(visit);
		return banners;
	}
	function resolveBattleMode(opponent, account, direction = "attack") {
		const modeId = opponent.modeId;
		let mode;
		switch (modeId) {
			case "guild-war":
			case "clash-of-worlds":
				mode = opponent.context.__battleLabUnitType === "titan" ? {
					...direction === "defense" ? BattleModes.TITAN_ARENA_AUTO : BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "titan_clan_pvp"
				} : {
					...direction === "defense" ? BattleModes.HERO_ARENA_AUTO : BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "clan_pvp"
				};
				break;
			case "territory":
				mode = opponent.context.__battleLabUnitType === "titan" ? {
					...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "clan_domination"
				} : {
					...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "clan_domination"
				};
				break;
			case "asgard-minions":
				mode = {
					...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "clan_pvp",
					allowBanner: false,
					isGrandArena: true,
					grandTeams: opponent.teams.length,
					requiredTeamWins: opponent.teams.length
				};
				break;
			case "arena":
				mode = BattleModes.HERO_ARENA_AUTO;
				break;
			case "grand-arena":
				mode = BattleModes.GRAND_ARENA_AUTO;
				break;
			case "asgard":
				mode = {
					...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
					battleConfigIdent: "clan_pvp",
					minUnits: 5,
					maxUnits: 5
				};
				break;
			case "adventure":
				mode = {
					...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "adventure"
				};
				break;
			case "epic-brawl":
				mode = isTitanEpicBrawl(opponent.context) ? {
					...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl_titan"
				} : {
					...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl"
				};
				break;
			case "invasion":
			case "dominion-rift":
				mode = {
					...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
					battleConfigIdent: "invasion_boss"
				};
				break;
			case "archdemon":
				mode = {
					...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
					battleConfigIdent: "boss_event",
					manualAllowed: false,
					allowBanner: false
				};
				break;
			case "lord":
			case "tournament-of-elements":
				mode = {
					...direction === "defense" ? BattleModes.TITAN_ARENA_AUTO : BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
					battleConfigIdent: "titan_arena"
				};
				break;
		}
		const rosterSize = mode.unitType === "titan" ? Object.keys(account.titans).length : Object.keys(account.heroes).length;
		const availablePerTeam = mode.isGrandArena ? Math.floor(rosterSize / Math.max(1, mode.grandTeams ?? 3)) : rosterSize;
		const teamSize = direction === "defense" && (modeId === "guild-war" || modeId === "clash-of-worlds") ? Math.min(availablePerTeam, positiveInteger(opponent.context.__battleLabMaxTeamUnits) ?? availablePerTeam) : availablePerTeam;
		return {
			...mode,
			maxUnits: Math.max(1, Math.min(mode.maxUnits, teamSize)),
			minUnits: Math.max(1, Math.min(mode.minUnits, teamSize))
		};
	}
	/** Обычный бой босса Асгарда сервер принимает только полной пятёркой. */
	function assertAsgardBossRoster(opponent, account) {
		if (opponent.modeId !== "asgard") return;
		const available = Object.keys(account.heroes).length;
		if (available < 5) throw new Error(`Для боя с боссом Асгарда нужны 5 доступных героев, сейчас ${available}.`);
	}
	function isTitanEpicBrawl(context) {
		const root = asRecord$1(context.__battleLabRoot);
		return String(context.battleUnitType ?? root.battleUnitType ?? context.type ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("titan");
	}
	function resolveEngineScenarios(opponent, scenarios) {
		if (scenarios && scenarios.length > 0) return scenarios.map((scenario) => ({
			...scenario,
			context: mergeEngineContext(opponent.context, scenario.context)
		}));
		return [{
			id: `${opponent.id}:default`,
			label: opponent.name,
			context: opponent.context,
			weight: 1,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			buff: null
		}];
	}
	function mergeEngineContext(engineContext, scenarioContext) {

		const scenarioEffects = asRecord$1(scenarioContext.effects);
		return {
			...engineContext,

			effects: {
				...engineEffects,
				...scenarioEffects,
				attackers: {
					...asRecord$1(engineEffects.attackers),
					...asRecord$1(scenarioEffects.attackers),
					...asRecord$1(engineContext.__battleLabPlannedAsgardEffects)
				},
				defenders: {
					...asRecord$1(engineEffects.defenders),
					...asRecord$1(scenarioEffects.defenders)
				}
			}
		};
	}
	function enrichOpponentForEngine(opponent, gameLibrary) {
		if (opponent.modeId !== "asgard") return opponent;
		const attackers = resolveAsgardAttackEffects(opponent.context, gameLibrary);
		const enrichBoss = (unit) => {
			if (unit.type === "pet" || unit.id >= 6e3 && unit.id < 7e3) return unit;
			if (hasRawBattleStats(unit)) return unit;
			const level = positiveInteger(unit.level) ?? 160;
			const attackStat = Math.max(1e4, Math.round(level * 500));
			return {
				...unit,
				physicalAttack: finiteNumber$1(unit.physicalAttack, attackStat),
				magicPower: finiteNumber$1(unit.magicPower, attackStat)
			};
		};
		const enrichTeamUnits = (team) => {
			const rec = asRecord$1(team);
			if (Array.isArray(rec.units)) return {
				...rec,
				units: rec.units.map((u) => enrichBoss(u))
			};
			return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(rec).map(([key, u]) => [key, enrichBoss(u)]));
		};
		const defenders = Array.isArray(opponent.context.defenders) ? opponent.context.defenders.map(enrichTeamUnits) : opponent.context.defenders;
		const teams = Array.isArray(opponent.context.teams) ? opponent.context.teams.map(enrichTeamUnits) : opponent.context.teams;
		const normalizedTeams = opponent.teams.map((t) => ({
			...t,
			units: t.units.map(enrichBoss)
		}));
		return {
			...opponent,
			teams: normalizedTeams,
			context: {
				...opponent.context,
				type: "clan_raid",
				defenders,
				teams,
				effects: {
					...asRecord$1(opponent.context.effects),
					battleConfig: "clan_pvp",
					attackers
				}
			}
		};
	}
	function buildBattle(candidate, enemyContext, mode, account, opponent, seed, direction, teamIndex, resolvers) {
		const baseBattle = resolveBaseBattle(enemyContext);
		const preparedDefenders = prepareDefenders(opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? baseBattle.defenders : enemyContext.defenders ?? enemyContext.teams);
		if (!preparedDefenders.simulationReady) throw new Error("Снимок защиты неполный: штатный движок не может честно воспроизвести бой.");
		const freshTitanArena = isTitanArenaMode(opponent.modeId) && !baseBattle.attackers;
		let effects = {
			...asRecord$1(baseBattle.effects),
			...asRecord$1(enemyContext.effects),
			battleConfig: mode.battleConfigIdent
		};
		if (direction === "defense") effects = {
			...effects,
			attackers: effects.defenders ?? {},
			defenders: effects.attackers ?? {},
			attackersBanner: effects.defendersBanner,
			defendersBanner: effects.attackersBanner
		};
		const defenderBanner = findEnemyBanner(enemyContext);
		if (defenderBanner.found) effects[direction === "defense" ? "attackersBanner" : "defendersBanner"] = defenderBanner.value;
		if (candidate.type === "hero" && candidate.banner) {
			const attackerBanner = asRecord$1(account.banners[String(candidate.banner)]);
			if (Object.keys(attackerBanner).length > 0) effects[direction === "defense" ? "defendersBanner" : "attackersBanner"] = attackerBanner;
		}
		const candidateUnits = buildAttackerUnits(candidate, account, resolvers);
		const enemyTeam = withBattleStats(preparedDefenders.teams[Math.min(teamIndex, preparedDefenders.teams.length - 1)] ?? preparedDefenders.teams[0], resolvers, freshTitanArena);
		assertKnownTitanDefinitions(candidateUnits, resolvers.index, "Атакующая пачка");
		assertKnownTitanDefinitions(enemyTeam, resolvers.index, "Защита противника");
		assertSimulationReadyUnits(candidateUnits, "Атакующая пачка");
		assertSimulationReadyUnits(enemyTeam, "Защита противника");
		const waves = enemyContext.__battleLabMultiwave || opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? preparedDefenders.teams.map((team) => withBattleStats(team, resolvers, freshTitanArena)) : [enemyTeam];
		waves.forEach((wave) => assertKnownTitanDefinitions(wave, resolvers.index, "Волна защиты противника"));
		waves.forEach((wave) => assertSimulationReadyUnits(wave, "Волна защиты противника"));
		return {
			...baseBattle,
			attackers: direction === "defense" ? enemyTeam : candidateUnits,
			defenders: direction === "defense" ? [candidateUnits] : opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? baseBattle.defenders : waves,
			seed,
			type: String(baseBattle.type ?? enemyContext.type ?? mode.battleConfigIdent),
			typeId: baseBattle.typeId ?? resolveEnemyBattleTypeId(enemyContext, opponent),
			userId: baseBattle.userId ?? account.userId,
			effects,
			progress: normalizeInitialProgress(baseBattle.progress)
		};
	}
	function resolveEnemyBattleTypeId(enemyContext, opponent) {
		const root = asRecord$1(enemyContext.__battleLabRoot);
		const boss = asRecord$1(root.boss ?? enemyContext.boss);
		return enemyContext.typeId ?? enemyContext.battleTypeId ?? boss.typeId ?? boss.battleTypeId ?? root.typeId ?? root.battleTypeId ?? opponent.externalId;
	}
	function resolveObservedServerSeeds(history, modeId, limit = 64) {
		if (modeId !== "asgard") return [];
		const unique = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		return [...history].filter((entry) => entry.modeId === modeId && entry.source === "game").sort((left, right) => right.createdAt - left.createdAt).flatMap((entry) => {
			if (typeof entry.seed !== "number") return [];
			const seed = entry.seed;
			if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 4294967295 || unique.has(seed)) return [];
			unique.add(seed);
			return [seed];
		}).slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.floor(limit)));
	}
	/**
	* Снимок врага отдаём без копии: сборка боя только читает его, а BattleRunner
	* всё равно копирует готовый бой перед Calc. Прежний structuredClone на каждом
	* прогоне стоил лишней глубокой копии и ломал кэш подготовленной защиты
	* Архидемона, у которого каждый раз появлялся новый объект.
	*/
	function resolveBaseBattle(enemyContext) {
		const direct = asRecord$1(enemyContext.battleData ?? enemyContext.battle);
		if (direct.attackers != null && direct.defenders != null) return direct;
		return {};
	}
	function normalizeInitialProgress(value) {
		const progress = Array.isArray(value) ? [...value] : [{}];
		const first = asRecord$1(progress[0]);
		progress[0] = {
			...first,
			attackers: {
				...asRecord$1(first.attackers),
				input: []
			}
		};
		return progress;
	}
	function prepareDefenders(value) {
		const cacheKey = value !== null && typeof value === "object" ? value : null;
		const cached = cacheKey ? preparedDefendersCache.get(cacheKey) : void 0;
		if (cached) return cached;
		const teams = normalizeDefenders(value);
		const prepared = {
			teams,
			simulationReady: hasAuthoritativeBattleLabDefenders(teams)
		};
		if (cacheKey) preparedDefendersCache.set(cacheKey, prepared);
		return prepared;
	}
	/**
	* Для собственной пачки Lab умеет восстановить статы из `heroGetAll`. Для
	* противника это делать нельзя: у него другие роль-ветви, экипировка и
	* скрытые модификаторы. Принимаем только снимок с серверными HP и атакой,
	* иначе результат Calc был бы предположением, замаскированным под победу.
	*/
	function hasAuthoritativeBattleLabDefenders(defenders) {
		return defenders.length > 0 && defenders.every((team) => {
			const combatUnits = Object.values(team).filter((unit) => unit.type !== "pet");
			return combatUnits.length > 0 && combatUnits.every(hasRawBattleStats);
		});
	}
	/**
	* Возвращает ту же сторону защиты, которую позднее получил бы `buildBattle`.
	* Это нужно до запуска Calc: скрытая Гранд-арена не имеет команды вовсе, а
	* частичный ответ не должен превращать бой в расчёт с выдуманным соперником.
	*/
	function resolveOpponentDefenderTeams(opponent) {
		const context = opponent.context;
		const battle = resolveBaseBattle(context);
		return normalizeDefenders(opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? battle.defenders : context.defenders ?? context.teams);
	}
	/**
	* План B для скрытых и частичных пачек. Мы не симулируем вымышленного врага:
	* генератор перебирает реальные сочетания собственных героев, питомцев, флага
	* и привязок, а затем оставляет самые сильные непересекающиеся составы.

	async function estimateBattleLabOpponent({ account, gameLibrary, opponent, mode, resolvers, requestedTeamCount, direction, startedAt, fixedCandidates, fixedTeams, fixedTeamSupports, history }) {
		const generator = new TeamCandidateGenerator(resolvers.index, mode, {
			heroPoolSize: Math.max(30, Object.keys(account.heroes).length),
			titanPoolSize: Math.max(22, Object.keys(account.titans).length),
			teamBeamWidth: 1500,
			maxTeamCandidates: 12e3,
			topFavorAssignmentsPerTeam: 12,
			topTeamPets: 8,
			topBanners: 8
		});

			account,

			candidates: generator.generate(opponent.context),

				...entry,
				battleSnapshot: typeof entry.battleSnapshot === "string" ? await decompressBattleSnapshot(entry.battleSnapshot) : entry.battleSnapshot
			}))),
			index: resolvers.index,
			generator,
			mode,
			modeId: opponent.modeId,
			direction,
			enemyContext: opponent.context
		})).sort((left, right) => estimateCandidateScore(right, account) - estimateCandidateScore(left, account));
		const selected = [];
		const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const unitIds = candidate.type === "titan" ? candidate.titans : candidate.heroes;
			if (unitIds.some((id) => used.has(id))) continue;
			selected.push(candidate);
			unitIds.forEach((id) => used.add(id));
			if (selected.length >= Math.max(1, requestedTeamCount)) break;
		}
		if (selected.length === 0) throw new Error("В доступном ростере не нашлось полной пачки для приблизительного плана.");
		const teams = selected.map((candidate) => candidateToBestTeam(candidate, account, resolvers));
		const score = teams.reduce((total, team) => total + finiteNumber$1(team.power), 0);
		return {
			id: `${opponent.id}:${Date.now()}`,
			modeId: opponent.modeId,
			opponentId: opponent.id,
			opponentName: opponent.name,
			titanArenaPlanContext: titanArenaPlanContext(opponent, direction),
			createdAt: Date.now(),
			calculationCount: 0,
			elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
			score,
			wins: null,
			stars: null,
			teams,
			dataQuality: opponent.dataQuality,
			strategy: "estimate",
			confidence: 0,
			timings: [{
				type: "auto",
				time: 0
			}],
			timingSource: "automatic",
			simulatedTeamCount: 0,
			estimatedTeamCount: candidates.length,
			direction,
			teamResults: teams.map(() => "unknown"),
			battleSnapshot: null,
			details: null,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			scenarioResults: [],
			timingSearch: {
				status: "disabled",
				tested: 0,
				candidateCount: candidates.length,
				reason: "Защита скрыта или неполна: выбран сильнейший состав из реального ростера."
			},
			variations: [],
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: false
		};
	}
	/**
	* При скрытом сопернике база — сила фактического ростера. История лишь слегка
	* сдвигает порядок среди близких вариантов и не может вытащить слабую пачку наверх.
	*/
	function estimateCandidateScore(candidate, account) {
		const rosterPower = estimateCandidatePower(candidate, account);
		const learned = candidate.adaptiveLearning;
		if (!learned || learned.effectiveEvidence <= 0) return rosterPower;
		const confidence = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, learned.confidence));
		return rosterPower * (.9 + .1 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, learned.probability)) * confidence);
	}
	function estimateCandidatePower(candidate, account) {
		const ids = candidate.type === "titan" ? candidate.titans : candidate.heroes;
		const units = candidate.type === "titan" ? account.titans : account.heroes;
		const petPower = candidate.type === "hero" ? finiteNumber$1(account.pets[String(candidate.teamPet)]?.power) : 0;
		const rosterPower = ids.reduce((total, id) => total + finiteNumber$1(units[String(id)]?.power), petPower);
		return Math.max(rosterPower, finiteNumber$1(candidate.teamPower), finiteNumber$1(candidate.approxScore));
	}
	function normalizeEngineResult(result, opponent, elapsedMs, account, resolvers) {
		const createdAt = Date.now();
		const calculations = result.calculations.map((calculation) => ({
			battleData: calculation.battleData ?? calculation.battle,
			progress: calculation.progress,
			result: calculation.result,
			battleLogs: calculation.battleLogs,
			battleTime: calculation.battleTime,
			battleTimer: calculation.battleTimer,
			timeline: calculation.timeline
		}));
		const battleSnapshot = calculations.length === 1 ? calculations[0] : { battles: calculations };
		const variations = [{
			teams: result.teams,
			actions: result.actions,
			statistics: result.statistics,
			score: result.score,
			timingImprovement: result.timingImprovement ?? null
		}, ...result.alternatives].map((entry, index) => {
			const normalized = normalizeProgressEntry(entry, account, resolvers, index);
			if (index === 0) normalized.teams = normalized.teams.map((team, tIdx) => ({
				...team,
				damage: result.teamScores?.[tIdx] ?? (result.teams.length === 1 ? result.score : null),
				timings: result.teamActions?.[tIdx] ?? team.timings,
				timingImprovement: result.teamTimingImprovements?.[tIdx] ?? team.timingImprovement,
				reliability: result.teamReliability?.[tIdx] ?? team.reliability
			}));
			else if (normalized.teams.length === 1) normalized.teams[0].damage = entry.statistics?.scoreMax ?? entry.statistics?.scoreMean ?? entry.score;
			return normalized;
		});
		return {
			id: `${opponent.id}:${createdAt}`,
			modeId: opponent.modeId,
			opponentId: opponent.id,
			opponentName: opponent.name,
			titanArenaPlanContext: titanArenaPlanContext(opponent, result.direction),
			createdAt,
			calculationCount: result.calculationCount,
			elapsedMs,
			score: result.score,
			wins: result.wins,
			stars: result.stars,
			teams: result.teams.map((candidate, index) => ({
				...candidateToBestTeam(candidate, account, resolvers),
				timings: [...result.teamActions?.[index] ?? (index === 0 ? result.actions : [{
					type: "auto",
					time: 0
				}])],
				timingImprovement: result.teamTimingImprovements?.[index] ?? null,
				damage: result.teamScores?.[index] ?? null
			})),
			dataQuality: opponent.dataQuality,
			strategy: "simulation",
			confidence: result.confidence,
			timings: result.actions,
			timingSource: result.actions.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0) ? "calculated" : "automatic",
			timingImprovement: result.timingImprovement ?? null,
			simulatedTeamCount: result.teams.length,
			estimatedTeamCount: 0,
			direction: result.direction,
			statistics: result.statistics,
			teamResults: result.teamResults,
			damage: opponent.modeId === "asgard" || opponent.modeId === "invasion" || opponent.modeId === "archdemon" || opponent.modeId === "dominion-rift" ? result.score : null,
			battleSnapshot,
			details: extractBattleDetails(battleSnapshot),
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			scenarioResults: result.scenarioResults,
			replayKind: resolveBattleLabReplayKind(opponent.modeId),
			timingSearch: result.timingSearch,
			variations,
			searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory: result.searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory ?? false
		};
	}
	function normalizeEngineProgress(progress, account, resolvers, kind) {
		return {
			kind,
			phase: progress.phase,
			completed: progress.completed,
			total: progress.total,
			variations: progress.leaders.map((leader, index) => normalizeProgressEntry(leader, account, resolvers, index))
		};
	}
	function createEngineProgressPublisher(publish, account, resolvers, kind) {
		let lastPublishedAt = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
		let lastPhase = null;
		return (progress) => {
			if (!publish) return;
			const now = Date.now();
			if (!(progress.phase !== lastPhase) && !(progress.completed >= progress.total) && now - lastPublishedAt < ENGINE_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS) return;
			lastPhase = progress.phase;
			lastPublishedAt = now;
			publish(normalizeEngineProgress(progress, account, resolvers, kind));
		};
	}
	function createCalculationProgressPublisher(publish, total) {
		let lastPublishedAt = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
		return (count) => {
			if (!publish) return;
			const now = Date.now();
			if (count < total && now - lastPublishedAt < ENGINE_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS) return;
			lastPublishedAt = now;
			publish(count);
		};
	}
	function normalizeProgressEntry(entry, account, resolvers, index) {
		return {
			id: `${entry.teams.map(candidateSignature).join("+")}:${JSON.stringify(entry.actions)}`,
			rank: index + 1,
			teams: entry.teams.map((candidate) => candidateToBestTeam(candidate, account, resolvers)),
			actions: [...entry.actions],
			timingImprovement: entry.timingImprovement ?? null,
			attempted: entry.statistics.attempted,
			succeeded: entry.statistics.succeeded,
			failed: entry.statistics.failed,
			wins: entry.statistics.wins,
			losses: entry.statistics.losses,
			unknown: entry.statistics.unknown,
			winRate: entry.statistics.winRate,
			confidenceLow: entry.statistics.confidenceLow,
			confidenceHigh: entry.statistics.confidenceHigh,
			scoreMean: entry.statistics.scoreMean,
			scoreMax: entry.statistics.scoreMax ?? entry.statistics.scoreMean,
			scoreDeviation: entry.statistics.scoreDeviation
		};
	}
	function candidateSignature(candidate) {
		if (candidate.type === "titan") return `t:${candidate.titans.join(",")}:${(candidate.totems ?? []).map((totem) => `${totem.id}:${totem.slot}`).join(",")}`;
		const favor = Object.entries(candidate.favor).sort(([left], [right]) => Number(left) - Number(right)).map(([heroId, petId]) => `${heroId}:${petId}`).join(",");
		return `h:${candidate.heroes.join(",")}:${candidate.teamPet}:${candidate.banner}:${favor}`;
	}
	function candidateToBestTeam(candidate, account, resolvers) {
		const unitIds = candidate.type === "titan" ? candidate.titans : candidate.heroes;
		const teamPetId = candidate.type === "hero" ? positiveInteger(candidate.teamPet) : null;
		const bannerId = candidate.type === "hero" ? positiveInteger(candidate.banner) : null;
		const preparedUnits = buildAttackerUnits(candidate, account, resolvers);
		return {
			unitIds,
			teamPetId,
			bannerId,
			totemIds: candidate.type === "titan" ? (candidate.totems ?? []).map((totem) => totem.id) : [],
			totems: candidate.type === "titan" ? (candidate.totems ?? []).map((totem) => ({ ...totem })) : [],
			favor: candidate.type === "hero" ? candidate.favor : {},
			power: resolveOwnedTeamPower(unitIds, teamPetId, account),
			units: unitIds.map((unitId) => preparedUnits[String(unitId)]).filter((unit) => Boolean(unit)).map((unit) => structuredClone(unit)),
			teamPet: teamPetId ? structuredClone(preparedUnits[String(teamPetId)] ?? null) : null,
			banner: resolveOwnedBanner(bannerId, account)
		};
	}
	function createSupportResolvers(gameLibrary, account) {

			freshTitanArenaUnits: /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap()
