	}
	function findEnemyBanner(enemyContext) {
		const teamIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(enemyContext.grandBattleIndex)));
		const roots = [
			enemyContext,
			asRecord$1(enemyContext.effects),
			asRecord$1(enemyContext.battle),
			asRecord$1(asRecord$1(enemyContext.battle).effects)
		];
		for (const root of roots) for (const key of [
			"banners",
			"banner",
			"battleFlags",
			"battleFlag",
			"flags",
			"flag",
			"defenderBanners",
			"defenderBanner",
			"defendersBanner"
		]) {
			if (!Object.hasOwn(root, key)) continue;
			const value = root[key];
			if (Array.isArray(value)) return {
				found: teamIndex < value.length,
				value: value[teamIndex]
			};
			const record = asRecord$1(value);
			if (Object.hasOwn(record, teamIndex)) return {
				found: true,
				value: record[String(teamIndex)]
			};
			return {
				found: true,
				value
			};
		}
		return { found: false };
	}
	function buildAttackerUnits(candidate, account, resolvers) {
		const cached = resolvers.attackerUnits.get(candidate);
		if (cached) return cached;
		if (candidate.type === "titan") {
			const units = Object.fromEntries(candidate.titans.map((id) => [String(id), resolvers.stats.prepare(resolvers.totem.enrichTitan(getRequiredUnit(account.titans, id)))]));
			resolvers.attackerUnits.set(candidate, units);
			return units;
		}
		const units = candidate.heroes.map((id) => {
			const unit = resolvers.stats.prepare(getRequiredUnit(account.heroes, id));
			const favorPetId = positiveInteger(candidate.favor[String(id)]);
			const favorPet = favorPetId ? resolvers.stats.prepare(getRequiredUnit(account.pets, favorPetId)) : null;
			return [String(id), resolvers.patronage.enrichHero(unit, favorPet)];
		});
		if (candidate.teamPet) units.push([String(candidate.teamPet), resolvers.stats.prepare(getRequiredUnit(account.pets, candidate.teamPet))]);
		const prepared = Object.fromEntries(units);
		resolvers.attackerUnits.set(candidate, prepared);
		return prepared;
	}
	/**
	* Игровой `battle.BattleStats.fromRawData` читает характеристики прямо из записи
	* бойца. Снимок `heroGetAll` их не содержит, поэтому без этого шага в симуляцию
	* уходит пачка с нулевым здоровьем — и любой бой честно проигрывается.
	*/
	function withBattleStats(units, resolvers, freshTitanArena = false) {
		const cache = freshTitanArena ? resolvers.freshTitanArenaUnits : resolvers.defenderUnits;
		const cached = cache.get(units);
		if (cached) return cached;
		const prepared = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(units).map(([key, unit]) => [key, resolvers.stats.prepare(freshTitanArena ? withoutTitanArenaResultState(unit) : withObservedBattleState(unit))]));
		cache.set(units, prepared);
		return prepared;
	}
	/**
	* В картах ВГ/СМ базовые статы часто лежат на бойце, а оставшиеся HP и энергия
	* — в `state`. Calc читает плоские поля: без этого объединения он восстанавливал
	* полное HP и превращал добивание в бой с нераненой защитой.
	*/
	function withObservedBattleState(unit) {
		const state = asRecord$1(unit.state);
		if (Object.keys(state).length === 0) return unit;
		const observed = {};
		for (const key of [
			"hp",
			"energy",
			"isDead"
		]) if (Object.hasOwn(state, key)) observed[key] = state[key];
		return Object.keys(observed).length > 0 ? {
			...unit,
			...observed
		} : unit;
	}
	function assertSimulationReadyUnits(units, side) {
		const broken = Object.values(units).filter((unit) => unit.type !== "pet" && !(unit.id >= 6e3 && unit.id < 7e3) && !hasRawBattleStats(unit));
		if (broken.length === 0) return;
		throw new Error(side + ": не удалось собрать боевые характеристики бойцов " + broken.map((unit) => unit.id).join(", ") + ". Игровой конфиг неполный, честный расчёт невозможен.");
	}
	/**
	* Старый заполненный titan-lib не знает новых титанов и их навыков. Haxe Calc
	* падает на этом не сразу, а при первом срабатывании пассивки (`null.w`).
	* Останавливаем расчёт до первого прогона и называем сломанный снимок.
	*/
	function assertKnownTitanDefinitions(units, index, side) {
		if (Object.keys(index.titanLib).length === 0) return;
		const titans = Object.values(units).filter((unit) => unit.type === "titan");
		const missing = titans.filter((unit) => index.getTitanLib(unit.id) === null).map((unit) => unit.id);
		if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error(`${side}: текущий lib не знает титанов ${missing.join(", ")}. Обновите игровой снимок перед расчётом.`);
		if (Object.keys(index.skillLib).length === 0) return;
		const unknownSkills = titans.map((unit) => ({
			id: unit.id,
			skillIds: index.getUnitSkillIds(unit).filter((skillId) => index.getSkill(skillId) === null)
		})).filter(({ skillIds }) => skillIds.length > 0);
		if (unknownSkills.length === 0) return;
		const detail = unknownSkills.map(({ id, skillIds }) => `${id} (${skillIds.join(", ")})`).join("; ");
		throw new Error(`${side}: текущий lib не знает навыков титанов ${detail}. Обновите игровой снимок перед расчётом.`);
	}
	function getRequiredUnit(units, id) {
		const unit = units[String(id)];
		if (!unit) throw new Error(`Юнит ${id} отсутствует в снимке аккаунта.`);
		return unit;
	}
	function normalizeDefenders(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]).map((team) => {
			const entries = Object.entries(asRecord$1(team)).map(([key, unit]) => [key, normalizeUnit$2(unit, void 0, key)]).filter((entry) => entry[1] !== null);
			return Object.fromEntries(entries);
		}).filter((team) => Object.keys(team).length > 0);
	}
	function normalizeOwnedUnits(value, type) {
		const rawList = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map((unit) => [void 0, unit]) : Object.entries(asRecord$1(value)).map(([key, unit]) => [key, unit]);
		return Object.fromEntries(rawList.map(([key, unit]) => normalizeUnit$2(unit, type, key)).filter((unit) => unit !== null).map((unit) => [String(unit.id), unit]));
	}
	function normalizeUnit$2(value, defaultType, fallbackId) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const id = positiveInteger(source.id ?? source.petId ?? source.heroId ?? source.titanId ?? fallbackId);
		if (!id) return null;
		const rawType = source.type;
		const type = rawType === "hero" || rawType === "pet" || rawType === "titan" ? rawType : defaultType ?? (id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3 ? "pet" : "hero");
		return {
			...source,
			id,
			type
		};
	}
	function resolveOwnedBanner(bannerId, account) {
		const banner = bannerId ? asRecord$1(account.banners[String(bannerId)]) : {};
		return Object.keys(banner).length > 0 ? structuredClone(banner) : null;
	}
	function resolveOwnedTeamPower(unitIds, teamPetId, account) {
		return unitIds.reduce((total, unitId) => total + finiteNumber$1(account.heroes[String(unitId)]?.power ?? account.titans[String(unitId)]?.power), 0) + finiteNumber$1(account.pets[String(teamPetId ?? 0)]?.power);
	}

	/**
	* Войны отдают карту отдельным RPC и уже несколько раз меняли вложенность
	* слотов. Не тащим в localStorage весь ответ с сотнями статов: для фикса
	* достаточно формы карты и первых точек, иначе диагностика сама выбьет квоту.
	*/
	function saveBattleLabCampaignDiagnostic(options) {
		new VersionedStorage({
			keyPrefix: "hwh-battle-lab:diagnostic:",
			schemaVersion: 1
		}).write(`campaign:${options.mode}`, {
			version: "0.2.363",
			createdAt: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(),
			mode: options.mode,
			phase: options.phase,
			error: options.error ? getErrorMessage(options.error) : void 0,
			info: describeCampaignValue(options.info),
			map: options.mapResponse ? describeCampaignValue(options.mapResponse) : void 0
		});
	}
	/** Короткая форма последней живой карты для разбора изменений контракта. */
	function readBattleLabCampaignDiagnostic(mode) {
		return new VersionedStorage({
			keyPrefix: "hwh-battle-lab:diagnostic:",
			schemaVersion: 1
		}).read(`campaign:${mode}`) ?? null;
	}
	function describeCampaignValue(value, depth = 0) {
		if (value === null || value === void 0) return value;
		if (typeof value === "string") return value.slice(0, 180);
		if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") return value;
		if (depth >= 4) return "[свёрнуто]";
		if (Array.isArray(value)) return {
			kind: "array",
			length: value.length,
			items: value.slice(0, 4).map((item) => describeCampaignValue(item, depth + 1))
		};
		if (typeof value !== "object") return String(value);
		const entries = Object.entries(value);
		return {
			kind: "object",
			keys: entries.map(([key]) => key).slice(0, 40),
			values: Object.fromEntries(entries.slice(0, 12).map(([key, nested]) => [key, describeCampaignValue(nested, depth + 1)]))
		};
	}

	async function campaignCall(caller, call) {
		const result = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send(call));
		if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error);
		return result.payload;
	}
	async function loadBattleLabCampaign(caller, mode, library) {
		const user = await campaignCall(caller, "userGetInfo");
		const userId = String(user.id ?? user.userId ?? "");
		if (!userId) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул идентификатор игрока.");
		if (mode === "asgard-minions") return normalizeBattleLabMinions(await campaignCall(caller, "clanRaid_getInfo"), userId);
		const info = await campaignCall(caller, mode === "guild-war" ? "clanWarGetInfo" : "crossClanWar_getInfo");
		if (mode === "guild-war" && finiteNumber$1(info.myTries) > 0 && finiteNumber$1(info.endTime) * 1e3 > Date.now()) {
			if (info.season == null || info.day == null) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул день войны для проверки использованных бойцов.");
			const history = await campaignCall(caller, {
				name: "clanWarGetDayHistory",
				args: {
					season: Number(info.season),
					day: Number(info.day)
				},
				ident: "hwhBattleLabWarHistory"
			});
			Object.assign(info, readBattleLabWarUsedUnits(history, userId));
		}
		const embeddedMap = findCampaignMap(info);
		const attackMapResponse = mode === "guild-war" ? info : await campaignCall(caller, "crossClanWar_getAttackMap");
		const map = mode === "guild-war" ? embeddedMap : (embeddedMap && hasCampaignAttackSlots(embeddedMap) ? embeddedMap : null) ?? findCampaignMap(attackMapResponse);
		if (!map) {
			const error = /* @__PURE__ */ new Error("Сервер не вернул читаемую карту противников для текущей войны.");
			saveBattleLabCampaignDiagnostic({
				mode,
				phase: "map-missing",
				error,
				info,
				mapResponse: attackMapResponse
			});
			throw error;
		}
		const snapshot = normalizeBattleLabWarMap(mode, info, map, userId, library);
		if (snapshot.opponents?.length === 0) {
			saveBattleLabCampaignDiagnostic({
				mode,
				phase: "opponents-missing",
				info,
				mapResponse: attackMapResponse
			});
			snapshot.mapStatus = "Карта получена, но сервер не передал читаемые составы. Диагностика сохранена: hwh-battle-lab:diagnostic:campaign:" + mode + ".";
		}
		return snapshot;
	}
	/**
	* Ответы войны меняли обёртку несколько раз. Обходим дерево целиком и ищем
	* именно коллекцию слотов с составом, чтобы сводка getInfo без защитников не
	* подменяла подробную карту и не превращала активную войну в пустой экран.
	*/
	function findCampaignMap(value) {
		const queue = [value];
		const visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let emptyMap = null;
		while (queue.length) {
			const current = queue.shift();
			if (!current || typeof current !== "object" || visited.has(current)) continue;
			visited.add(current);
			const record = asRecord$1(current);
			for (const map of campaignMapShapes(record)) {
				if (hasCampaignAttackSlots(map)) return map;
				emptyMap ?? (emptyMap = map);
			}
			queue.push(...Object.values(record));
		}
		return emptyMap;
	}
	/**
	* У ВГ и СМ менялись не только внешние `payload.data`, но и имя коллекции
	* точек. Остальные поля оставляем от того же узла ответа: там лежат баффы,
	* попытки и приказы, нужные нормализатору.
	*/
	function campaignMapShapes(record) {
		return [
			"enemySlots",
			"attackSlots",
			"slots",
			"fortificationSlots",
			"defenseSlots",
			"defenceSlots",
			"battlegroundSlots"
		].flatMap((key) => {
			const slots = record[key];
			if (!slots || typeof slots !== "object") return [];
			return key === "enemySlots" ? [record] : [{
				...record,
				enemySlots: slots
			}];
		});
	}
	function hasCampaignAttackSlots(map) {
		const slots = map.enemySlots;
		return (Array.isArray(slots) ? slots : Object.values(asRecord$1(slots))).some((value) => extractBattleLabWarSlotTeam(asRecord$1(value)) !== null);
	}
	async function planBattleLabCampaign(snapshot, options, onProgressLabel) {
		return await runWithBattleLabProfile(`campaign:${snapshot.modeId}`, () => runBattleLabCampaignPlanning(snapshot, options, onProgressLabel), {
			modeId: snapshot.modeId,
			targets: snapshot.targets.length,
			maxCalculations: options.maxCalculations
		});
	}
	async function runBattleLabCampaignPlanning(snapshot, options, onProgressLabel) {
		onProgressLabel?.("Загрузка профиля игрока...");
		const accountSnapshot = await fetchAccountSnapshot(options.caller);
		const candidates = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const warnings = [];
		let usedBudget = 0;
		const screeningBudget = Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * .75);
		const targets = snapshot.targets;
		for (let index = 0; index < targets.length; index++) {
			if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new Error("Подбор остановлен.");
			const target = targets[index];
			onProgressLabel?.(`Оценка ${index + 1}/${targets.length} · ${target.opponent.name}`);
			const allowance = Math.max(1, Math.floor((screeningBudget - usedBudget) / (targets.length - index)));
			if (usedBudget >= screeningBudget) break;
			await calculateTarget(target.opponent, allowance);
		}
		onProgressLabel?.("Распределение пачек по узлам...");
		let plan = assignBattleLabCampaign(snapshot, candidates);
		const excluded = snapshot.modeId === "asgard-minions" ? [] : plan.flatMap((a) => a.result.teams.flatMap((t) => t.unitIds));
		for (let index = 0; index < targets.length; index++) {
			const target = targets[index];
			if (plan.length >= snapshot.attempts.total || usedBudget >= options.maxCalculations || options.signal?.aborted) break;
			if (plan.some((a) => a.target.opponent.id === target.opponent.id)) continue;
			if (plan.filter((a) => a.target.unitType === target.unitType).length >= snapshot.attempts[target.unitType]) continue;
			const remaining = options.maxCalculations - usedBudget;
			if (remaining < 3) break;
			onProgressLabel?.(`Дополнительный подбор ${index + 1}/${targets.length} · ${target.opponent.name}`);
			await calculateTarget({
				...target.opponent,
				context: {
					...target.opponent.context,
					__battleLabExcludedUnits: excluded
				}
			}, Math.min(remaining, Math.max(3, Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * .1))));
			plan = assignBattleLabCampaign(snapshot, candidates);
			if (snapshot.modeId !== "asgard-minions") excluded.splice(0, excluded.length, ...plan.flatMap((a) => a.result.teams.flatMap((t) => t.unitIds)));
		}
		onProgressLabel?.("Завершение подбора...");
		return {
			plan,
			calculationCount: usedBudget,
			warnings
		};
		async function calculateTarget(opponent, allowance) {
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
			try {
				const result = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
					...options,
					accountSnapshot,
					opponent,
					fixedTeams: options.fixedTeamsByOpponent?.[opponent.id],
					maxCalculations: allowance,
					ultraTimingEnabled: false,
					onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(usedBudget + count)
				});
				usedBudget += result.calculationCount;
				candidates.set(opponent.id, [...candidates.get(opponent.id) ?? [], ...campaignResultVariants(result)]);
			} catch (error) {
				throwIfBattleLabSimulationUnavailable(error);
				if (options.signal?.aborted) throw error;
				usedBudget += allowance;
				warnings.push(opponent.name + ": " + getErrorMessage$1(error));
			}
		}
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/helper-attack-transport.ts
	/**
	* Caller/Send сохраняют подпись и обработку ответа, но один запрос проходит без
	* клиентских перехватчиков Helper. Его send создаёт и отправляет XHR синхронно,
	* до возврата Promise: методы восстанавливаются до первого await, поэтому
	* обычный ручной бой и следующие запросы используют прежние обработчики.
	*/
	async function sendBattleLabOwnedRequest(send, createTransport = createNativeTransport) {
		const transport = createTransport();
		if (!transport) return send();
		const prototype = XMLHttpRequest.prototype;
		const original = {
			open: prototype.open,
			setRequestHeader: prototype.setRequestHeader,
			send: prototype.send
		};
		try {
			let request;
			try {
				prototype.open = transport.methods.open;
				prototype.setRequestHeader = transport.methods.setRequestHeader;
				prototype.send = transport.methods.send;
				request = send();
			} finally {
				prototype.open = original.open;
				prototype.setRequestHeader = original.setRequestHeader;
				prototype.send = original.send;
			}
			return await request;
		} finally {
			transport.dispose();
		}
	}
	/** Чистые методы берём из временного same-origin realm; новых сетевых ресурсов нет. */
	function createNativeTransport() {
		if (typeof document === "undefined" || typeof XMLHttpRequest === "undefined") return null;
		const frame = document.createElement("iframe");
		frame.hidden = true;
		frame.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
		document.body.appendChild(frame);
		const native = frame.contentWindow?.XMLHttpRequest;
		if (!native) {
			frame.remove();
			throw new Error("Не удалось создать отдельный транспорт Battle Lab. Атака не отправлена.");
		}
		return {
			methods: native.prototype,
			dispose: () => frame.remove()
		};
	}

	function resolveTournamentPoints(calculation, battle) {
		if (calculation.result?.win === true) return 250;
		const defenders = readDefenders(battle.defenders);
		const side = asRecord$1(calculation.progress?.[0]?.defenders);
		const states = asRecord$1(side.heroes ?? side.titans ?? side.units);
		if (defenders.size === 0 || Object.keys(states).length === 0) return null;
		let points = 250;
		for (const [id, defender] of defenders) {
			const state = asRecord$1(states[id]);
			if (Object.keys(state).length === 0 || state.isDead === true) continue;
			const hp = readHealth(state.hp);
			if (hp === null) return null;
			if (hp === 0) continue;
			const maxHp = readHealth(asRecord$1(defender.state).maxHp) ?? readHealth(defender.hp) ?? readHealth(state.maxHp);
			if (maxHp === null || maxHp === 0) return null;
			points -= Math.ceil(Math.min(hp, maxHp) * 50 / maxHp);
		}
		return points < 250 ? Math.max(0, points) : null;
	}
	function readDefenders(value) {
		const source = Array.isArray(value) && !positiveInteger(asRecord$1(value[0]).id) ? value[0] : value;
		const record = asRecord$1(source);
		const collection = record.heroes ?? record.titans ?? record.units ?? source;
		const entries = Array.isArray(collection) ? collection.map((unit) => [String(asRecord$1(unit).id), unit]) : Object.entries(asRecord$1(collection));
		const defenders = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const [key, rawUnit] of entries) {
			const unit = asRecord$1(rawUnit);
			const id = positiveInteger(key) ?? positiveInteger(unit.id);
			if (id && Object.keys(unit).length > 0) defenders.set(String(id), unit);
		}
		return defenders;
	}
	function readHealth(value) {
		return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
	}

	var AUTO_ACTIONS = [{
		type: "auto",
		time: 0
	}];
	var AUTO_INPUT = [
		"auto",
		0,
		0,
		"auto",
		0,
		0
	];
	var TIMELINE_PROBE_INPUT = [
		"auto",
		0,
		0
	];
	var DEFAULT_BATTLE_WINDOW_MS = 12e4;
	var DEFAULT_SUBMISSION_RESERVE_MS = 1e4;
	/**
	* После `titanArenaStartBattle` seed уже расходует реальную попытку, поэтому
	* подбор обязан закончиться раньше серверного окна и оставить запас на RPC со
	* снимком. Победу ищем на этом же battle, а не доверяем вчерашнему seed.
	*/
	async function optimizeStartedTournamentBattle(options) {
		return await runWithBattleLabProfile("live:tournament", () => runStartedTournamentBattle(options), {
			maxCalculations: options.maxCalculations,
			searchEnabled: options.searchEnabled
		});
	}
	async function runStartedTournamentBattle({ battle, savedActions, unitIds, teamCustomValues, searchEnabled, minTime, maxTime, maxCalculations, battleStartedAt, serverDeadlineAt = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, submissionReserveMs = DEFAULT_SUBMISSION_RESERVE_MS, now = Date.now, calculate, onProgress }) {
		const limit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxCalculations));
		const reserveMs = Math.max(2e3, Math.floor(submissionReserveMs));
		const controller = new AbortController();
		let calculationCount = 0;
		let deadlineAt = Math.min(battleStartedAt + DEFAULT_BATTLE_WINDOW_MS, serverDeadlineAt);
		let longestCalculationMs = 0;
		let snapshotSubmitAt = deadlineAt - reserveMs;
		let hasServerTimeLimit = false;
		let stoppedByDeadline = false;
		let stopReason = null;
		let best = null;
		let bestActions = AUTO_ACTIONS;
		let phase = "baseline";
		const stop = (reason) => {
			stopReason ?? (stopReason = reason);
			if (reason === "deadline") stoppedByDeadline = true;
			if (!controller.signal.aborted) controller.abort();
		};
		const assertAvailable = () => {
			if (calculationCount >= limit) {
				stop("limit");
				throw new TournamentLiveTimingStoppedError();
			}
			if (now() + Math.max(250, longestCalculationMs * 1.5) >= snapshotSubmitAt) {
				stop("deadline");
				throw new TournamentLiveTimingStoppedError();
			}
		};
		const emit = () => {
			if (!onProgress) return;
			measureBattleLabPhase("live.progress", () => onProgress({
				phase,
				completed: calculationCount,
				total: limit,
				bestPoints: best && best.score >= 0 ? best.score : null,
				win: best?.win ?? null,
				deadlineAt,
				snapshotSubmitAt,
				remainingMs: Math.max(0, snapshotSubmitAt - now())
			}));
		};
		const memo = new BattleLabSimulationMemo();
		const evaluate = async (input, actions) => {
			const cached = memo.read(input, actions);
			if (cached) return cached;
			assertAvailable();
			calculationCount += 1;
			const calculationStartedAt = now();
			const prepared = measureBattleLabPhase("live.prepareInput", () => withBattleInput$1(battle, input));
			const calculateStartedAt = readPerformanceTime();
			const calculation = await calculate(prepared);
			readPerformanceTime() - calculateStartedAt;
			longestCalculationMs = Math.max(longestCalculationMs, now() - calculationStartedAt);
			const timeLimit = finiteNumber$1(calculation.battleTimeLimit, NaN);
			if (Number.isFinite(timeLimit) && timeLimit > 0) {
				const calculatedDeadline = Math.min(battleStartedAt + timeLimit * 1e3, serverDeadlineAt);
				deadlineAt = hasServerTimeLimit ? Math.min(deadlineAt, calculatedDeadline) : calculatedDeadline;
				hasServerTimeLimit = true;
			}
			const sample = {
				score: measureBattleLabPhase("live.score", () => resolveTournamentPoints(calculation, battle)) ?? -1,
				win: typeof calculation.result?.win === "boolean" ? calculation.result.win : null,
				calculation,
				actions: [...actions],
				seed: normalizeSeed(battle.seed)
			};
			memo.remember(input, sample);
			if (!best || compareSamples(sample, best) > 0) {
				best = sample;
				bestActions = [...actions];
			}
			snapshotSubmitAt = resolveSnapshotSubmitAt((best ?? sample).calculation, battleStartedAt, deadlineAt, reserveMs);
			emit();
			if (sample.win === true) stop("winner");
			else if (now() >= snapshotSubmitAt) stop("deadline");
			return sample;
		};
		emit();
		const automatic = await evaluate(AUTO_INPUT, AUTO_ACTIONS);
		if (shouldFinishAfterBaseline(automatic, calculationCount, limit)) return buildResult$1(best ?? automatic, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, false);
		phase = "timing";
		let timelineProbe;
		try {
			timelineProbe = await evaluate(TIMELINE_PROBE_INPUT, AUTO_ACTIONS);
		} catch (error) {
			throwIfBattleLabCalculationBroken(error);
			if (!(error instanceof TournamentLiveTimingStoppedError)) console.warn("[HWH Battle Lab] Timeline-проба Турнира сорвалась, отправляю уже готовый безопасный snapshot.", error);
			return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
		}
		if (timelineProbe.win === true || controller.signal.aborted) return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
		const timeline = normalizeBattleTimeline(timelineProbe.calculation.timeline);
		if (timeline.length === 0) return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
		if (hasManualActions(savedActions) && calculationCount < limit) {
			phase = "saved";
			try {
				if ((await evaluate(encodeActions(savedActions, timeline), savedActions)).win === true || controller.signal.aborted) return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
			} catch (error) {
				throwIfBattleLabCalculationBroken(error);
				if (stopReason === "deadline" || stopReason === "limit") return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
				console.warn("[HWH Battle Lab] Сохранённый тайминг Турнира не воспроизвёлся на свежем seed.", error);
			}
		}
		if (!searchEnabled || calculationCount >= limit) return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
		phase = "timing";
		const shiftTrials = Math.min(192, Math.floor((limit - calculationCount) * .45));
		if (shiftTrials > 0) try {
			await searchUltraTiming({
				baseline: best ?? automatic,
				timelineCalculation: timelineProbe.calculation,
				minTime,
				maxTime,
				maxTrials: shiftTrials,
				signal: controller.signal,
				concurrency: () => 8,
				simulate: (input, actions) => evaluate(input, actions),
				isBetter: (left, right) => compareSamples(left, right) > 0
			});
		} catch (error) {
			throwIfBattleLabCalculationBroken(error);
			if (!controller.signal.aborted) console.warn("[HWH Battle Lab] Перебор автотайминга Турнира сорвался, сохраняю лучший готовый snapshot.", error);
		}
		if (hasTerminalStopReason(stopReason)) return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
		const planTrials = Math.max(0, limit - calculationCount);
		if (planTrials > 0) try {
			await searchUltimatePlans({
				baseline: best ?? automatic,
				seedActions: bestActions,
				timeline,
				unitIds,
				allowTeamCustom: teamCustomValues.length > 0,
				teamCustomValues,
				minTime,
				maxTime,
				maxTrials: planTrials,
				maxActions: 12,
				retainObservations: false,
				signal: controller.signal,
				concurrency: () => 8,
				evaluate: (actions) => evaluate(encodeActions(actions, timeline), actions),
				compare: compareSamples
			});
		} catch (error) {
			throwIfBattleLabCalculationBroken(error);
			if (!controller.signal.aborted) console.warn("[HWH Battle Lab] Перебор ульт Турнира сорвался, сохраняю лучший готовый snapshot.", error);
		}
		return requireResult(best, bestActions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
	}
	function shouldFinishAfterBaseline(sample, calculationCount, limit) {
		return sample.win === true || calculationCount >= limit;
	}
	function hasTerminalStopReason(reason) {
		return reason !== null;
	}
	function requireResult(sample, actions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline) {
		if (!sample) throw new Error("Свежий бой Турнира не дал ни одного снимка для отправки.");
		return buildResult$1(sample, actions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline);
	}
	function buildResult$1(sample, actions, calculationCount, deadlineAt, snapshotSubmitAt, stoppedByDeadline) {
		return {
			calculation: sample.calculation,
			actions: [...actions],
			points: sample.score >= 0 ? sample.score : null,
			calculationCount,
			deadlineAt,
			snapshotSubmitAt,
			stoppedByDeadline
		};
	}
	function compareSamples(left, right) {
		const leftWin = left.win === true ? 1 : 0;
		const rightWin = right.win === true ? 1 : 0;
		if (leftWin !== rightWin) return leftWin > rightWin ? 1 : -1;
		if (left.score !== right.score) return left.score > right.score ? 1 : -1;
		const leftStars = finiteNumber$1(left.calculation.result?.stars, -1);
		const rightStars = finiteNumber$1(right.calculation.result?.stars, -1);
		if (leftStars !== rightStars) return leftStars > rightStars ? 1 : -1;
		const leftTime = finiteNumber$1(left.calculation.battleTime, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
		const rightTime = finiteNumber$1(right.calculation.battleTime, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
		if (leftTime === rightTime) return 0;
		return leftTime < rightTime ? 1 : -1;
	}
	function withBattleInput$1(battleValue, input) {
		const battle = structuredClone(battleValue);
		const progress = Array.isArray(battle.progress) ? [...battle.progress] : [{}];
		const first = progress[0] ?? {};
		progress[0] = {
			...first,
			attackers: {
				...first.attackers ?? {},
				input: [...input]
			}
		};
		battle.progress = progress;
		return battle;
	}
	function encodeActions(actions, timeline) {
		if (!hasManualActions(actions)) return [...AUTO_INPUT];
		return BattleInputBuilder.fromActions(actions, { includeAutoAtStart: !(actions[0]?.type === "auto" && actions[0].time === 0) }).encodeWithTimeline(timeline);
	}
	function hasManualActions(actions) {
		return actions.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0);
	}
	function normalizeSeed(value) {
		const seed = Number(value);
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(seed)) return 0;
		return seed < 0 ? seed + 4294967296 : seed;
	}

	var snapshots = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
	var CALC_LIBRARY_SECTIONS = [
		"hero",
		"titan",
		"pet",
		"skill",
		"titanArtifact",
		"artifact",
		"battleConfig",
		"rule"

	/** Стабильная ссылка сохраняет кеши графики; замена раздела инвалидирует снимок. */
	function readBattleLabGameLibrary(library) {
		const runtime = asRecord$1(library);
		const data = asRecord$1(runtime.data);
		const entries = Object.entries(data);
		const sections = CALC_LIBRARY_SECTIONS.map((section) => {
			const resolved = readCurrentSection(runtime, section);
			return hasOwnEntries(resolved) ? resolved : null;
		});
		const mergedEntries = sections.map((resolved, index) => resolved && resolved !== data[CALC_LIBRARY_SECTIONS[index]] ? [...Object.entries(asRecord$1(data[CALC_LIBRARY_SECTIONS[index]])), ...Object.entries(resolved)] : null);
		const cached = snapshots.get(runtime);
		if (cached?.data === data && sameEntries(cached.entries, entries) && sections.every((section, index) => section === cached.sections[index]) && mergedEntries.every((items, index) => sameEntries(items, cached.mergedEntries[index]))) return cached.value;
		const current = { ...data };
		for (const [index, section] of CALC_LIBRARY_SECTIONS.entries()) {
			const resolved = sections[index];
			if (!resolved) continue;
			const stored = asRecord$1(data[section]);
			current[section] = resolved === stored || !hasOwnEntries(stored) ? resolved : {
				...stored,
				...resolved
			};
		}
		snapshots.set(runtime, {
			data,
			entries,
			sections,
			mergedEntries,
			value: current
		});
		return current;
	}
	/** Сверяем только верхний уровень: вложенные записи сохраняют игровые ссылки. */
	function sameEntries(left, right) {
		return left === right || !!left && !!right && left.length === right.length && left.every(([key, value], index) => key === right[index][0] && value === right[index][1]);
	}
	function readCurrentSection(runtime, section) {
		try {
			const current = asRecord$1(runtime.getData?.(section));
			if (hasOwnEntries(current)) return current;
		} catch {}
		return asRecord$1(asRecord$1(runtime.data)[section]);
	}
	function hasOwnEntries(record) {
		for (const key in record) if (Object.hasOwn(record, key)) return true;
		return false;
	}

	async function executeBattleLabAttack({ caller, modeId, opponent, bestResult, asgardLiveTiming, tournamentLiveTiming, executor }) {
		assertCalculatedTeams(bestResult, modeId);
		assertAttackReliability(bestResult, modeId);
		if (opponent.context.__battleLabLocalProfile === true) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Локальный профиль предназначен только для тренировки и не может быть отправлен на сервер.");
		if ([
			"guild-war",
			"clash-of-worlds",
			"asgard-minions"
		].includes(modeId)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Для этого режима атака выполняется из актуального плана карты.");
		if ((bestResult.direction ?? "attack") === "defense") {
			if (!isTitanArenaMode(modeId)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Установка защиты поддерживается только в Турнире стихий.");
			return executeTitanArenaDefense(caller, bestResult);
		}
		if (modeId === "arena") return assertImmediateBattleResult(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "arenaAttack",
			args: buildArenaArgs(opponent, bestResult.teams[0]),
			ident: "body"
		}), "Арена");
		if (modeId === "grand-arena") return assertImmediateBattleResult(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "grandAttack",
			args: buildGrandArenaArgs(opponent, bestResult.teams),
			ident: "body"
		}), "Гранд-арена");
		if (modeId === "territory") return executeTerritoryAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult);
		if (modeId === "asgard") return executeAsgardAttackSeries(caller, opponent, bestResult, asgardLiveTiming, executor);
		if (modeId === "adventure") return executeAdventureAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult);
		if (modeId === "epic-brawl") return executeEpicBrawlAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult);
		if (modeId === "invasion" || modeId === "archdemon") return executeInvasionAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult);
		if (modeId === "dominion-rift") throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Буря — аналитический стенд усилений. Искусственное усиление атаки нельзя честно отправить игровому серверу.");
		if (isTitanArenaMode(modeId)) return executeTitanArenaAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult, tournamentLiveTiming, executor);
	}
	function assertAttackReliability(bestResult, modeId) {
		if (bestResult.direction === "defense" || ["asgard", "archdemon"].includes(modeId)) return;
		const statistics = bestResult.statistics;
		const scenariosConfirmed = (bestResult.scenarioResults ?? []).every((scenario) => scenario.attempted > 0 && scenario.wins === scenario.attempted);
		if (!isBattleLabAttackStatisticallyReliable(statistics) || !scenariosConfirmed) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError(`Пачка не подтверждена: нижняя оценка победы ${Math.round((statistics?.confidenceLow ?? 0) * 100)}%, требуется не меньше ${Math.round(RELIABLE_ATTACK_CONFIDENCE_LOW * 100)}% и ни одного поражения или сбоя.`);
	}
	async function executeTerritoryAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult) {
		const targetId = positiveInteger(opponent.context.targetId ?? opponent.externalId);
		if (!targetId) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Снимок ТЗ не содержит номер соседней точки.");
		const team = bestResult.teams[0];
		const desiredTeam = {
			units: team?.unitIds ?? [],
			pet: team?.teamPetId ?? null,
			favor: team?.favor ?? {},
			banner: team?.bannerId ?? null
		};
		if (!sameTerritoryTeam(desiredTeam, opponent.context.__battleLabTerritoryCurrentTeam)) {
			if (opponent.context.__battleLabTerritoryAtCastle !== true) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("В ТЗ выбранная пачка не установлена. Вернись в замок: менять состав вне него сервер запрещает.");
			await sendChecked(caller, {
				name: "clanDomination_setDefence",
				args: {
					units: desiredTeam.units,
					...desiredTeam.pet ? { pet: desiredTeam.pet } : {},
					favor: desiredTeam.favor,
					...desiredTeam.banner ? { banner: desiredTeam.banner } : {}
				},
				ident: "hwhBattleLabTerritoryDefense"
			});
		}
		return sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "clanDomination_startBattle",
			args: { targetId },
			ident: "hwhBattleLabTerritoryStart"
		});
	}
	async function executeEpicBrawlAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult) {

	async function executeInvasionAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult) {
		const root = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot);
		const team = bestResult.teams[0];
		assertInvasionTeamIsAvailable(opponent, team);
		const startArgs = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabStartArgs);
		const id = resolveInvasionBossId(startArgs.id ?? opponent.context.id ?? opponent.context.typeId ?? opponent.externalId);
		if (!id) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Снимок вторжения не содержит id босса.");
		const chapterId = positiveInteger(startArgs.chapterId ?? opponent.context.chapterId ?? root.chapterId ?? asRecord$1(root.chapter).id);
		const start = unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "invasion_bossStart",
			args: {
				...chapterId ? { chapterId } : {},
				id,
				pet: team.teamPetId ?? 0,
				heroes: team.unitIds,
				favor: team.favor
			},
			ident: "hwhBattleLabInvasionStart"
		}));
		const calculated = await calculateStartedBattle(start.battle ?? start, bestResult, opponent.modeId === "archdemon" ? "archdemon" : "invasion");
		const durationMs = resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated);

			name: "invasion_bossEnd",
			args: {
				id,
				...pickBattleResult(calculated)
			},
			ident: "hwhBattleLabInvasionEnd"
		});
	}
	function assertInvasionTeamIsAvailable(opponent, team) {
		if (opponent.modeId !== "invasion") return;
		if (!Object.hasOwn(opponent.context, "__battleLabInvasionFragments")) return;
		const fragments = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabInvasionFragments);
		const unavailable = (team?.unitIds ?? []).filter((id) => finiteNumber$1(fragments[String(id)]) <= 0);
		if (unavailable.length > 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError(`Лавка Вторжения ещё не собрала бойцов ${unavailable.join(", ")}. Атака не отправлена.`);
	}
	function resolveInvasionBossId(value) {
		if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value > 0) return value;
		if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
		const id = value.trim();
		return id ? id : null;
	}

	function assertImmediateBattleResult(response, _modeLabel) {
		return response;

	/**
	* Асгард допускает несколько попыток за окно. План уже сформирован без повторов,
	* поэтому отправляем каждую команду последовательно и перед каждой запрашиваем
	* актуальные попытки и список использованных героев у сервера.
	*/
	async function executeAsgardAttackSeries(caller, opponent, bestResult, liveTiming, executor) {
		const responses = [];
		let pipeline = Boolean(liveTiming?.pipeline) && !asgardPipelineRejected;
		let pending = null;
		const start = (team) => startAsgardAttack(caller, opponent, {
			...bestResult,
			teams: [team],
			timings: team.timings ?? bestResult.timings
		}, liveTiming, executor, liveTiming?.timerDivisor);
		const settle = async (team, work) => {
			try {
				responses.push(await work);
				return "ok";
			} catch (error) {
				reportAsgardTeamFailure(liveTiming, team, error);
				if (error instanceof AsgardTeamAlreadyUsedError) return "skip";
				if (error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError && responses.length > 0) return { stop: error.message };
				throw error;
			}
		};
		const drain = async () => {
			if (!pending) return "ok";
			const current = pending;
			pending = null;
			return settle(current.team, current.finish);
		};
		for (const team of bestResult.teams) {
			const buy = liveTiming?.purchaseBefore?.(team.unitIds);
			if (buy && liveTiming?.waitForPurchase) {
				const drained = await drain();
				if (typeof drained === "object") return {
					responses,
					stoppedReason: drained.stop
				};
				if (!await liveTiming.waitForPurchase(buy)) return {
					responses,
					stoppedReason: "Серия остановлена перед покупкой баффов."
				};
			}
			let finish;
			try {
				finish = await start(team);
			} catch (error) {
				if (pending && pipeline && error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError && !(error instanceof AsgardTeamAlreadyUsedError)) {
					asgardPipelineRejected = true;
					pipeline = false;
					const drained = await drain();
					if (typeof drained === "object") return {
						responses,
						stoppedReason: drained.stop
					};
					const retried = await settle(team, start(team).then((next) => next()));
					if (typeof retried === "object") return {
						responses,
						stoppedReason: retried.stop
					};
					continue;
				}
				const drained = await drain();
				if (typeof drained === "object") return {
					responses,
					stoppedReason: drained.stop
				};
				const outcome = await settle(team, Promise.reject(error));
				if (typeof outcome === "object") return {
					responses,
					stoppedReason: outcome.stop
				};
				continue;
			}
			const drained = await drain();
			if (typeof drained === "object") return {
				responses,
				stoppedReason: drained.stop
			};
			if (pipeline) {
				const work = finish();
				work.catch(() => void 0);
				pending = {
					team,
					finish: work
				};
				continue;
			}
			const outcome = await settle(team, finish());
			if (typeof outcome === "object") return {
				responses,
				stoppedReason: outcome.stop
			};
		}
		const drained = await drain();
		if (typeof drained === "object") return {
			responses,
			stoppedReason: drained.stop
		};
		if (responses.length === 0) return {
			responses,
			stoppedReason: "Выбранные герои уже использованы в Асгарде."
		};
		return bestResult.teams.length === 1 ? responses[0] : { responses };
	}
	/** Конвейер однажды отвергнут сервером: до перезагрузки атакуем строго очередью. */
	var asgardPipelineRejected = false;
	function reportAsgardTeamFailure(liveTiming, team, error) {
		liveTiming?.onTeamProgress?.({
			unitIds: [...team.unitIds],
			phase: error instanceof AsgardTeamAlreadyUsedError ? "skipped" : "error",
			usedHeroIds: error instanceof AsgardTeamAlreadyUsedError ? error.usedHeroIds : void 0,
			finishedAt: Date.now(),
			error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
		});
	}
	/**
	* Первая фаза атаки пачки: старт боя на сервере и улучшение снимка.
	* Возвращает вторую фазу — ожидание длительности боя и отправку итога.
	*/
	async function startAsgardAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult, liveTiming, executor, timerDivisor) {
		const team = bestResult.teams[0];
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		let phase;
		let phaseStartedAt = startedAt;
		const publish = (progress) => {
			if (phase !== progress.phase) phaseStartedAt = Date.now();
			phase = progress.phase;
			liveTiming?.onTeamProgress?.({
				unitIds: [...team.unitIds],
				startedAt,
				phaseStartedAt,
				finishedAt: phase === "done" ? Date.now() : void 0,
				...progress
			});
		};
		publish({ phase: "starting" });
		const info = unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, "clanRaid_getInfo"));
		const boss = asRecord$1(info.boss);
		if (Object.keys(boss).length === 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Босс Асгарда сейчас недоступен: сервер не вернул активный рейд.");
		assertEventWindow(boss);
		assertAsgardAttemptsAndHeroes(info, boss, team.unitIds);
		const battleStartedAt = Date.now();
		const start = unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "clanRaid_startBossBattle",
			args: {
				heroes: team.unitIds,
				pet: team.teamPetId ?? 0,
				favor: team.favor
			},
			ident: "hwhBattleLabAttack"
		}));
		let calculated;
		let submittedActions;
		let submittedDamage;
		publish({
			phase: "improving",
			completed: 0
		});
		{
			const battle = requireStartedBattle(start.battle);
			const calculator = executor ?? new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
			const mode = resolveExecutorBattleMode("asgard", battle);
			const teamCustom = resolveHeroTeamCustomActions(battle, readBattleLabGameLibrary(globalThis.lib), team.teamPetId ?? 0);
			const optimized = await optimizeStartedBattleTiming({
				battle,
				savedActions: team.timings ?? bestResult.timings,
				unitIds: team.unitIds,
				hasTeamPet: Boolean(team.teamPetId),
				teamCustomValues: teamCustom.values,
				teamCustomCooldowns: teamCustom.cooldowns,
				minTime: liveTiming?.minTime ?? 0,
				maxTime: liveTiming?.maxTime ?? 120,
				maxCalculations: resolveLiveTimingCalculationLimit(liveTiming, team.timings ?? bestResult.timings),
				battleStartedAt,
				serverDeadlineAt: resolveServerBattleDeadline(start),
				timerDivisor,
				signal: liveTiming?.readSkipSignal?.(),
				resolveInputByTime: "supportsTimeResolvedInput" in calculator && calculator.supportsTimeResolvedInput === true,
				calculate: (preparedBattle, calculationOptions) => calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, preparedBattle, mode, calculationOptions),
				onProgress: (progress) => {
					liveTiming?.onProgress?.(progress);
					publish({
						phase: "improving",
						completed: progress.completed,
						damage: progress.bestDamage,
						actions: progress.actions
					});
				}
			});
			calculated = asRecord$1(optimized.calculation);
			submittedActions = optimized.actions;
			submittedDamage = optimized.damage;
		}
		return async () => {
			const waitMs = Math.max(0, resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated, { timerDivisor }) + 4e3 - (Date.now() - battleStartedAt));
			if (Date.now() + waitMs >= resolveServerBattleDeadline(start)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Истёк срок начатого боя Асгарда.");
			if (waitMs > 0) {
				publish({
					phase: "waiting-submit",
					damage: submittedDamage,
					actions: submittedActions,
					submitAt: Date.now() + waitMs
				});
				await delay(waitMs);
			}
			publish({
				phase: "sending",
				damage: submittedDamage,
				actions: submittedActions
			});
			const response = await submitAsgardBattleEnd(caller, calculated, {
				battleStartedAt,
				timerDivisor,
				deadlineAt: resolveServerBattleDeadline(start),
				onWait: (submitAt) => publish({
					phase: "waiting-submit",
					damage: submittedDamage,
					actions: submittedActions,
					submitAt
				})
			});
			const serverResult = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(unwrap(response)).result);
			publish({
				phase: "done",
				damage: submittedDamage,
				actions: submittedActions,
				serverDamage: typeof serverResult.damage === "number" && Number.isFinite(serverResult.damage) ? serverResult.damage : void 0
			});
			return response;
		};
	}
	/** Сервер однажды отверг ускоренную отправку: до перезагрузки ждём обычное время. */
	var subscriptionSpeedRejected = false;
	/**
	* Отправляет итог Асгарда. Если ускоренная по подписке отправка отвергнута,
	* дожидается обычной длительности боя и повторяет тот же итог один раз:
	* начатый бой ещё открыт, а повтор той же отправки ничего не портит.
	*/
	async function submitAsgardBattleEnd(caller, calculated, timing) {
		const send = () => sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "clanRaid_endBossBattle",
			args: pickBattleResult(calculated),
			ident: "hwhBattleLabAttackEnd"
		}, true);
		try {
			return await send();
		} catch (error) {
			if (timing.timerDivisor === void 0 || !(error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError)) throw error;
			subscriptionSpeedRejected = true;
			console.warn("[Battle Lab] Сервер не принял ускоренную отправку, возвращаю обычное ожидание.", error);
			const waitMs = Math.max(0, resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated) + 4e3 - (Date.now() - timing.battleStartedAt));
			if (Date.now() + waitMs >= timing.deadlineAt) throw error;
			timing.onWait(Date.now() + waitMs);
			await delay(waitMs);
			return await send();
		}
	}
	/**
	* Как и HWH, ускоряем ожидание только при активной подписке: клиент тогда
	* проигрывает бой на x5. Ошибка запроса не мешает атаке, просто ждём как обычно.
	*/
	async function readAccountBattleTimerDivisor(caller) {
		if (subscriptionSpeedRejected) return void 0;
		try {
			return finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(unwrap(await caller.send("subscriptionGetInfo")).subscription).endTime) * 1e3 > Date.now() ? 5 : void 0;
		} catch {
			return;
		}
	}
	function resolveLiveTimingCalculationLimit(options, actions) {
		if (options?.enabled) return options.maxCalculations;
		return actions.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0) ? 3 : 1;
	}
	function requireStartedBattle(value) {
		const battle = structuredClone(asRecord$1(value));
		if (Object.keys(battle).length === 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Сервер не вернул снимок начатого боя, поэтому безопасно завершить его нельзя.");
		return battle;
	}
	async function executeAdventureAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult) {
		const root = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot);
		const userId = String(globalThis.userId ?? globalThis.NXFlashVars?.user_id ?? "");
		const player = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(root.users)[userId] ?? root.user);
		const turnsLeft = finiteNumber$1(player.turnsLeft, NaN);
		if (Number.isFinite(turnsLeft) && turnsLeft <= 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("В приключении закончились ходы.");
		const currentNode = positiveInteger(player.currentNode);
		const targetNode = positiveInteger(opponent.externalId);
		if (!targetNode) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Сервер не вернул номер боевого узла.");
		const path = currentNode && currentNode !== targetNode ? [currentNode, targetNode] : [targetNode];
		if (path.length > 1 && !isConnectedAdventurePath(root.paths, path[0], path[1])) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Выбранный узел не соседний с текущей позицией. Сначала дойдите до него по карте.");
		const team = bestResult.teams[0];
		const solo = opponent.context.__battleLabAdventureSolo === true;
		const calculated = await calculateStartedBattle(unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: solo ? "adventureSolo_turnStartBattle" : "adventure_turnStartBattle",
			args: {
				path,
				heroes: team.unitIds,
				pet: team.teamPetId ?? 0,
				favor: team.favor,
				broadcast: false
			},
			ident: "hwhBattleLabAttack"
		})).battle, bestResult, "adventure");
		return sendChecked(caller, {
			name: solo ? "adventureSolo_endBattle" : "adventure_endBattle",
			args: pickBattleResult(calculated),
			ident: "hwhBattleLabAttackEnd"
		});
	}
	async function executeTitanArenaAttack(caller, opponent, bestResult, liveTiming, executor) {
		const status = unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, "titanArenaGetStatus"));
		const rival = findTitanArenaRival(asRecord$1(status.rivals), opponent.externalId);
		if (!rival) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Соперник турнира уже сменился. Обновите список и пересчитайте пачку.");
		if (rival && finiteNumber$1(rival.attackScore, NaN) >= 250) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("На этом сопернике уже набрано 250/250 очков. Повторная атака недоступна.");
		const rivalId = titanArenaRivalId(rival, opponent.externalId);
		if (!rivalId) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Сервер не вернул идентификатор соперника турнира.");
		if (titanArenaRivalMode(rival, rivalId) !== opponent.modeId) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Тип соперника изменился. Обнови список и пересчитай пачку.");
		assertTitanArenaPlanContext(status, bestResult, opponent.id);
		const battleStartedAt = Date.now();
		const start = unwrap(await sendChecked(caller, {
			name: "titanArenaStartBattle",
			args: {
				rivalId,
				titans: bestResult.teams[0].unitIds
			},
			ident: "body"
		}));
		const startedBattleValue = start.battle;
		const startedBattle = requireStartedBattle(startedBattleValue);
		let deadlineAt = battleStartedAt + 12e4;
		const submissionReserveMs = Math.max(2e3, Math.floor(liveTiming?.submissionReserveMs ?? TOURNAMENT_SUBMISSION_RESERVE_MS));
		let snapshotSubmitAt = deadlineAt - submissionReserveMs;
		let countdownTargetAt = null;
		let latestProgress = {
			phase: "baseline",
			completed: 0,
			total: liveTiming?.maxCalculations ?? 1,
			bestPoints: null,
			win: null,
			deadlineAt,
			snapshotSubmitAt,
			remainingMs: Math.max(0, snapshotSubmitAt - Date.now())
		};
		const reportProgress = (progress) => {
			const nextDeadlineAt = progress.deadlineAt ?? latestProgress.deadlineAt;
			const nextSnapshotSubmitAt = countdownTargetAt ?? progress.snapshotSubmitAt ?? latestProgress.snapshotSubmitAt;
			latestProgress = {
				...latestProgress,
				...progress,
				deadlineAt: nextDeadlineAt,
				snapshotSubmitAt: nextSnapshotSubmitAt,
				remainingMs: Math.max(0, nextSnapshotSubmitAt - Date.now())
			};
			deadlineAt = latestProgress.deadlineAt;
			snapshotSubmitAt = latestProgress.snapshotSubmitAt;
			liveTiming?.onProgress?.(latestProgress);
		};
		const ticker = liveTiming?.onProgress ? globalThis.setInterval(() => reportProgress({}), 100) : null;
		let endArgs;
		try {
			let calculated;
			if (liveTiming) {
				const calculator = executor ?? new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
				const mode = resolveExecutorBattleMode("tournament-of-elements", startedBattle);
				const team = bestResult.teams[0];
				const teamCustomValues = team.totems && team.totems.length > 0 ? team.totems.map((totem, index) => Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(totem.slot, index + 1)))) : (team.totemIds ?? []).map((_, index) => index + 1);
				const optimized = await optimizeStartedTournamentBattle({
					battle: startedBattle,
					savedActions: team.timings ?? bestResult.timings,
					unitIds: team.unitIds,
					teamCustomValues,
					searchEnabled: liveTiming.enabled,
					minTime: liveTiming.minTime,
					maxTime: liveTiming.maxTime,
					maxCalculations: liveTiming.maxCalculations,
					battleStartedAt,
					submissionReserveMs: liveTiming.submissionReserveMs,
					serverDeadlineAt: resolveServerBattleDeadline(start),
					calculate: (battle) => calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, battle, mode),
					onProgress: reportProgress
				});
				calculated = optimized.calculation;
				deadlineAt = optimized.deadlineAt;
				snapshotSubmitAt = optimized.snapshotSubmitAt;
			} else {
				calculated = await calculateStartedBattle(startedBattle, bestResult, "tournament-of-elements");
				const timeLimit = finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTimeLimit, NaN);
				if (Number.isFinite(timeLimit) && timeLimit > 0) deadlineAt = Math.min(deadlineAt, battleStartedAt + timeLimit * 1e3);
				snapshotSubmitAt = resolveSnapshotSubmitAt(calculated, battleStartedAt, deadlineAt, submissionReserveMs);
			}
			endArgs = {
				...pickTitanArenaBattleResult(calculated, startedBattle),
				rivalId
			};
			const submitAt = Math.min(snapshotSubmitAt, resolveSnapshotSubmitAt(calculated, battleStartedAt, deadlineAt, submissionReserveMs));
			countdownTargetAt = submitAt;
			reportProgress({
				phase: "waiting",
				deadlineAt,
				snapshotSubmitAt: submitAt
			});
			const waitMs = Math.max(0, submitAt - Date.now());
			if (waitMs > 0) await delay(waitMs);
			countdownTargetAt = Date.now();
			reportProgress({
				phase: "submitting",
				deadlineAt,
				snapshotSubmitAt: countdownTargetAt
			});
			const response = await sendChecked(caller, {
				name: "titanArenaEndBattle",
				args: endArgs,
				ident: "body"
			});
			saveTournamentResultMismatch(startedBattle, calculated, endArgs, response);
			return response;
		} catch (error) {
			saveBattleLabFailure("tournament", startedBattle, error, endArgs);
			throw error;
		} finally {
			if (ticker !== null) globalThis.clearInterval(ticker);
		}
	}
	function saveTournamentResultMismatch(battle, calculated, request, response) {
		const calculatedWin = asRecord$1(calculated.result).win;
		const serverResult = parseBattleLabServerResponse(response).result;
		if (typeof calculatedWin !== "boolean" || serverResult === "unknown" || calculatedWin && serverResult === "win" || !calculatedWin && serverResult === "loss") return;
		saveBattleLabFailure("tournament-response", battle, /* @__PURE__ */ new Error(`Рассинхрон результата Турнира: Calc=${calculatedWin ? "win" : "loss"}, сервер=${serverResult}.`), {
			endBattle: request,
			response: asRecord$1(response),
			calculation: {
				result: asRecord$1(calculated.result),
				progress: Array.isArray(calculated.progress) ? calculated.progress : [],
				battleTime: finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTime),
				battleTimer: finiteNumber$1(calculated.battleTimer)
			}
		});
	}
	function assertTitanArenaPlanContext(status, bestResult, opponentId = bestResult.opponentId) {
		const opponent = readTitanArenaOpponents(status).opponents.find((item) => item.id === opponentId);
		if (!opponent || !matchesTitanArenaPlan(bestResult, opponent)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Расчёт устарел: этаж или состав соперников изменился. Обнови список и пересчитай пачку перед атакой или установкой защиты.");
	}
	function findTitanArenaRival(rivals, externalId) {
		if (Object.hasOwn(rivals, externalId)) {
			const directMatch = asRecord$1(rivals[externalId]);
			return Object.keys(directMatch).length > 0 ? directMatch : null;
		}
		for (const value of Object.values(rivals)) {
			const rival = asRecord$1(value);
			const rivalId = titanArenaRivalId(rival, asRecord$1(rival.user).id);
			if (rivalId != null && String(rivalId) === externalId) return rival;
		}
		return null;
	}
	async function calculateStartedBattle(battleValue, bestResult, modeId) {
		const battle = requireStartedBattle(battleValue);
		const mode = resolveExecutorBattleMode(modeId, battle);
		const calculator = new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
		const manualTiming = modeId !== "archdemon" && hasManualTiming$1(bestResult);
		const baselineBattle = withBattleInput(battle, manualTiming ? new BattleInputBuilder().encode() : [...AUTOMATIC_BATTLE_INPUT]);
		let baseline;
		try {
			baseline = await calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, baselineBattle, mode);
		} catch (error) {
			throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError(`Точная шкала боя для автотайминга недоступна: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
		}
		if (!manualTiming) return baseline;
		const timeline = modeId === "tournament-of-elements" ? normalizeBattleTimeline(baseline.timeline) : resolveBattleCalculationTimeline(baseline);
		if (timeline.length === 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Начатый бой не вернул фактическую шкалу или журнал. Отправка выдуманного тайминга заблокирована.");
		return calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, withBattleInput(battle, BattleInputBuilder.fromActions(bestResult.timings, { includeAutoAtStart: !bestResult.timings.some((action) => action.type === "auto" && action.time === 0) }).encodeWithTimeline(timeline)), mode);
	}
	async function calculateAutomaticStartedBattle(battleValue, modeId) {
		const battle = requireStartedBattle(battleValue);
		const mode = resolveExecutorBattleMode(modeId, battle);
		return calculateExecutorBattle(new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator(), withBattleInput(battle, [...AUTOMATIC_BATTLE_INPUT]), mode);
	}
	async function calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, battle, mode, options) {
		try {
			return asRecord$1(await calculator.calculate(battle, mode, options));
		} catch (runtimeError) {
			if (!(runtimeError instanceof GameRuntimeUnavailableError)) throw runtimeError;
			const legacyCalc = getLegacyBattleCalc();
			if (!legacyCalc) throw runtimeError;
			return asRecord$1(await legacyCalc(battle, mode));
		}
	}
	function withBattleInput(battleValue, input) {
		const battle = structuredClone(battleValue);
		const progress = Array.isArray(battle.progress) ? [...battle.progress] : [{}];
		const firstProgress = asRecord$1(progress[0]);
		progress[0] = {
			...firstProgress,
			attackers: {
				...asRecord$1(firstProgress.attackers),
				input
			}
		};
		battle.progress = progress;
		return battle;
	}
	function hasManualTiming$1(bestResult) {
		return bestResult.timings.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0);
	}
	function resolveExecutorBattleMode(modeId, battle) {
		if (modeId === "guild-war" || modeId === "clash-of-worlds" || modeId === "asgard-minions") return battleHasTitans(battle) ? {
			...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "titan_clan_pvp"
		} : {
			...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "clan_pvp"
		};
		if (modeId === "asgard") return BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE;
		if (modeId === "invasion") return {
			...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
			battleConfigIdent: "invasion_boss"
		};
		if (modeId === "archdemon") return {
			...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
			battleConfigIdent: "boss_event",
			manualAllowed: false
		};
		if (modeId === "epic-brawl") return String(battle?.type ?? "").includes("titan") ? {
			...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl_titan"
		} : {
			...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl"
		};
		if (modeId === "territory") return battleHasTitans(battle) ? {
			...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "clan_domination"
		} : {
			...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "clan_domination"
		};
		if (modeId === "adventure") return {
			...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "adventure"
		};
		return {
			...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
			battleConfigIdent: "titan_arena"
		};
	}
	function battleHasTitans(battle) {
		return Object.entries(asRecord$1(battle?.attackers)).some(([key, unit]) => {
			const source = asRecord$1(unit);
			const id = positiveInteger(source.id ?? key);
			return source.type === "titan" || id !== null && id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3;
		});
	}
	function pickBattleResult(calculated) {
		const result = asRecord$1(calculated.result);
		const progress = Array.isArray(calculated.progress) ? calculated.progress : [];
		if (Object.keys(result).length === 0 || progress.length === 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Калькулятор не вернул результат и прогресс боя. Отправку на сервер остановила.");
		return {
			result,
			progress
		};
	}
	function pickTitanArenaBattleResult(calculated, startedBattle) {
		const payload = pickBattleResult(calculated);
		const calculatedResult = asRecord$1(payload.result);
		if (typeof calculatedResult.win !== "boolean") throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Калькулятор Турнира не вернул точный исход боя. Отправку сомнительного snapshot остановила.");
		const progress = Array.isArray(payload.progress) ? payload.progress : [];
		const battle = asRecord$1(startedBattle);
		const sourceProgress = Array.isArray(battle.progress) ? battle.progress : [];
		const battleSeed = normalizeUint32Seed(battle.seed);
		return {
			result: calculatedResult,
			progress: progress.map((value, index) => {
				const entry = asRecord$1(value);
				const sourceSeed = normalizeUint32Seed(asRecord$1(sourceProgress[index]).seed);
				const calculatedSeed = normalizeUint32Seed(entry.seed);
				const expectedSeed = sourceSeed ?? battleSeed;
				if (calculatedSeed !== null && expectedSeed !== null && calculatedSeed !== expectedSeed) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Калькулятор вернул progress от другого seed. Отправку результата чужого боя остановила.");
				const seed = calculatedSeed ?? expectedSeed;
				const protocol = asRecord$1(sourceProgress[index]);
				const restored = Object.fromEntries(["v", "b"].flatMap((key) => entry[key] == null && protocol[key] != null ? [[key, protocol[key]]] : []));
				return Object.assign({}, entry, restored, seed === null ? {} : { seed });
			})
		};
	}
	function normalizeUint32Seed(value) {
		if (typeof value !== "number" && typeof value !== "string") return null;
		const text = typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
		if (typeof value === "string" && !/^-?\d+$/.test(text)) return null;
		const seed = typeof value === "string" ? Number(text) : Number(value);
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(seed) || seed < -2147483648 || seed > 4294967295) return null;
		return seed < 0 ? seed + 4294967296 : seed;
	}
	function sameTerritoryTeam(desired, current) {
		const source = asRecord$1(current);
		const currentUnits = (Array.isArray(source.unitIds) ? source.unitIds : []).map((id) => positiveInteger(id)).filter((id) => id !== null).sort((left, right) => left - right);
		const desiredUnits = [...desired.units].sort((left, right) => left - right);
		if (desiredUnits.length !== currentUnits.length) return false;
		if (!desiredUnits.every((id, index) => id === currentUnits[index])) return false;
		if (positiveInteger(source.petId) !== desired.pet) return false;
		if (positiveInteger(source.bannerId) !== desired.banner) return false;
		return stableFavorKey(asRecord$1(source.favor)) === stableFavorKey(desired.favor);
	}
	function stableFavorKey(value) {
		return Object.entries(value).filter(([, id]) => positiveInteger(id) !== null).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right)).map(([heroId, petId]) => `${heroId}:${String(petId)}`).join(",");
	}
	function assertCalculatedTeams(bestResult, modeId) {
		const expected = modeId === "grand-arena" ? 3 : 1;
		if (bestResult.teams.length < expected || bestResult.teams.slice(0, expected).some((team) => team.unitIds.length === 0)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Расчёт не содержит полный состав для этого режима.");
		if ((modeId === "arena" || modeId === "grand-arena") && bestResult.teams.slice(0, expected).some((team) => team.unitIds.length !== 5)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Арена принимает ровно пять героев в каждой рассчитанной команде.");
		if (isTitanArenaMode(modeId) && bestResult.teams[0].unitIds.some((id) => id < 4e3 || id >= 5e3)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Для этого боя нужна пачка титанов. Пересчитайте старый состав.");
		if (modeId === "grand-arena") {
			const unitIds = bestResult.teams.flatMap((team) => team.unitIds);
			if (new Set(unitIds).size !== unitIds.length) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("В трёх пачках Гранд-арены повторяются герои. Такой состав сервер не примет.");
			const usedPets = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			for (const team of bestResult.teams) {
				const teamPets = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...team.teamPetId ? [team.teamPetId] : [], ...Object.values(team.favor)]);
				if ([...teamPets].some((id) => usedPets.has(id))) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("В трёх пачках Гранд-арены повторяются питомцы или покровители.");
				teamPets.forEach((id) => usedPets.add(id));
			}
			const bannerIds = bestResult.teams.map((team) => team.bannerId).filter((id) => id !== null);
			if (new Set(bannerIds).size !== bannerIds.length) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("В трёх пачках Гранд-арены повторяются флаги.");
		}
	}
	function assertEventWindow(source) {
		const timestamps = asRecord$1(source.timestamps);
		const start = finiteNumber$1(timestamps.start ?? source.startTime);
		const end = finiteNumber$1(timestamps.end ?? source.endTime);
		const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3);
		if (start > now) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Босс Асгарда ещё не открылся.");
		if (end > 0 && end <= now) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Недельный бой с боссом уже завершён.");
	}
	function assertAsgardAttemptsAndHeroes(info, boss, heroIds) {
		const clanTries = asRecord$1(info.clanTries);
		const me = asRecord$1(clanTries.me);
		if (firstFiniteNumber(info.bossAttemptsLeft, info.bossAttempts, boss.attemptsLeft, boss.attempts, clanTries.bossAttemptsLeft, clanTries.attemptsLeft, me.bossAttemptsLeft, me.attemptsLeft, me.attempts) === 0) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("Попытки атаки босса Асгарда закончились.");
		const usedHeroes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(info), ...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(boss)]);
		const repeated = heroIds.filter((id) => usedHeroes.has(id));
		if (repeated.length > 0) throw new AsgardTeamAlreadyUsedError(repeated);
	}
	function firstFiniteNumber(...values) {
		for (const value of values) {
			const number = finiteNumber$1(value, NaN);
			if (Number.isFinite(number)) return number;
		}
		return null;
	}
	function isConnectedAdventurePath(value, from, to) {
		const paths = Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value));
		if (paths.length === 0) return true;
		return paths.some((path) => {
			const edge = asRecord$1(path);
			const edgeFrom = positiveInteger(edge.from_id ?? edge.fromId ?? edge.from);
			const edgeTo = positiveInteger(edge.to_id ?? edge.toId ?? edge.to);
			return edgeFrom === from && edgeTo === to || edgeFrom === to && edgeTo === from;
		});
	}
	function unwrap(value) {
		const record = asRecord$1(value);
		return asRecord$1(asRecord$1(record.result).response ?? record.response ?? value);
	}
	async function sendChecked(caller, call, ownedAsgardResult = false) {
		const response = ownedAsgardResult ? await sendBattleLabOwnedRequest(() => caller.send(call)) : await caller.send(call);
		if (ownedAsgardResult && typeof call === "object" && "name" in call) recordBattleLabOwnedResponse({
			name: call.name,
			args: asRecord$1(call.args),
			ident: call.ident ?? "body"
		}, response);
		const serverError = findBattleLabServerError(response);
		if (serverError !== null) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError(serverError);
		return response;
	}
	function delay(milliseconds) {
		return new Promise((resolve) => globalThis.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
	}

	async function executeBattleLabCampaignAttack(options) {
		const { caller, library, snapshot, attack, onBattle, onStatus } = options;
		const fresh = await loadBattleLabCampaign(caller, snapshot.modeId, library);
		if (options.signal?.aborted) return;
		assertCampaignAttackCurrent(fresh, attack, snapshot.revision);
		const teams = attack.result.teams;
		const ids = teams.flatMap((team) => team.unitIds);
		if (attack.result.strategy !== "simulation" || !ids.length || new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw new Error("План содержит пустые или повторяющиеся составы.");
		const minions = snapshot.modeId === "asgard-minions";
		const indices = minions ? attack.target.opponent.context.__battleLabBattleIndices : [0];
		if (!indices || teams.length !== indices.length) throw new Error("Число рассчитанных команд не совпало с числом боёв точки.");
		const team = teams[0];
		const slotId = Number(attack.target.opponent.externalId);
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(slotId) || slotId <= 0) throw new Error("Некорректный идентификатор точки.");
		const name = minions ? "clanRaid_startNodeBattles" : snapshot.modeId === "guild-war" ? "clanWarAttack" : "crossClanWar_startBattle";
		const args = minions ? {
			nodeId: String(slotId),
			teams: teams.map((item, i) => ({
				heroes: item.unitIds,
				...item.teamPetId ? { pet: item.teamPetId } : {},
				battleIndex: indices[i]
			})),
			favor: Object.assign({}, ...teams.map((item) => item.favor))
		} : snapshot.modeId === "guild-war" ? {
			slotId,
			heroes: team.unitIds,
			favor: team.favor,
			...team.teamPetId ? { pet: team.teamPetId } : {},
			...team.bannerId ? { banner: team.bannerId } : {}
		} : {
			slotId,
			team: {
				units: team.unitIds,
				...team.teamPetId ? { pet: team.teamPetId } : {}
			},
			favor: team.favor,
			...team.bannerId ? { banner: team.bannerId } : {}
		};
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		const start = await campaignCall(caller, {
			name,
			args,
			ident: "hwhBattleLabCampaignStart"
		});
		const rawBattles = minions ? start.battles : { 0: start.battle };
		const battles = asRecord$1(rawBattles);
		for (let index = 0; index < indices.length; index++) {
			const battleIndex = indices[index];
			const battle = asRecord$1(Array.isArray(rawBattles) ? rawBattles[battleIndex] : battles[String(battleIndex)]);
			if (!battle.attackers || !battle.defenders || battle.seed == null) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул полный снимок начатого боя.");
			onStatus?.("Расчёт начатого боя " + (index + 1) + "/" + indices.length);
			const mode = resolveExecutorBattleMode(snapshot.modeId, battle);
			const calculator = new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
			const optimized = options.liveTiming?.enabled && !options.signal?.aborted ? await optimizeStartedBattleTiming({
				battle,
				mode,
				stopOnWin: true,
				savedActions: teams[index].timings ?? attack.result.timings,
				unitIds: teams[index].unitIds,
				hasTeamPet: Boolean(teams[index].teamPetId),
				teamCustomValues: teams[index].totems?.map((totem) => totem.slot),
				minTime: options.liveTiming.minTime,
				maxTime: options.liveTiming.maxTime,
				maxCalculations: options.liveTiming.maxCalculations,
				battleStartedAt: minions ? Date.now() : startedAt,
				serverDeadlineAt: resolveServerBattleDeadline(start),
				fallbackDurationMs: minions ? 54e4 : 12e4,
				signal: options.signal,
				calculate: (prepared) => calculateExecutorBattle(calculator, prepared, mode)
			}) : null;
			const calculated = optimized?.calculation ?? await calculateAutomaticStartedBattle(battle, snapshot.modeId);
			const result = asRecord$1(calculated.result);
			const progress = Array.isArray(calculated.progress) ? calculated.progress : [];
			if (typeof result.win !== "boolean" || !progress.length) throw new Error("Движок не вернул результат начатого боя.");
			const expectedSeed = Number(battle.seed) >>> 0;
			for (const item of progress) {
				const seed = asRecord$1(item).seed;
				if (seed != null && Number(seed) >>> 0 !== expectedSeed) throw new Error("Калькулятор вернул снимок другого боя.");
			}
			const duration = resolveBattleDurationMs(calculated, { useTimeLimitFallback: true });
			if (duration <= 0) throw new Error("Движок не вернул длительность боя.");
			const wait = Math.max(0, startedAt + duration + 1e3 - Date.now());
			const deadline = finiteNumber$1(start.endTime) * 1e3;
			if (deadline && Date.now() + wait >= deadline) throw new Error("Расчёт не уложился в срок начатого боя.");
			onStatus?.("Ожидание конца боя · " + Math.ceil(wait / 1e3) + " сек.");
			if (wait) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, wait));
			const server = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
				name: minions ? "clanRaid_endNodeBattle" : snapshot.modeId === "guild-war" ? "clanWarEndBattle" : "crossClanWar_endBattle",
				ident: "hwhBattleLabCampaignEnd",
				args: {
					result,
					progress,
					...minions ? {
						nodeId: String(slotId),
						battleIndex
					} : {}
				}
			}));
			const attackers = Object.values(asRecord$1(battle.attackers));
			const defenders = (Array.isArray(battle.defenders) ? battle.defenders : [battle.defenders]).map((wave) => Object.values(asRecord$1(wave)));
			await onBattle?.({
				modeId: snapshot.modeId,
				opponentId: String(slotId),
				opponentName: attack.target.opponent.name,
				battleId: battle.id == null ? null : String(battle.id),
				createdAt: Date.now(),
				result: server.result,
				serverError: server.error,
				stars: server.stars,
				teamResults: [server.result],
				damage: null,
				teamIds: [attackers.map((unit) => unit.id)],
				teams: [attackers],
				enemyTeams: defenders,
				enemyContext: {
					...battle,
					battleData: battle,
					progress
				},
				timings: optimized?.actions ?? [{
					type: "auto",
					time: 0
				}],
				details: extractBattleDetails({
					...calculated,
					battleData: battle
				}),
				platformId: attack.target.opponent.platformId,
				replayKind: attack.target.unitType === "titan" ? "titan" : "arena",
				battleType: String(battle.type ?? ""),
				seed: Number(battle.seed)
			});
			if (server.error) throw new Error(server.error);
		}
	}

	function warDefenseTeamCounts(mode, library) {
		const rule = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.crossClanWar).rule);
		return mode === "clash-of-worlds" ? {
			hero: Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(rule.heroTeams, 3))),
			titan: Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(rule.titanTeams, 2)))
		} : {
			hero: 1,
			titan: 1
		};
	}
	function warDefenseOpponents(snapshot, unitType) {
		const unique = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const enemy of snapshot.opponents ?? snapshot.targets.map((target) => target.opponent)) {
			if (enemy.context.__battleLabUnitType !== unitType || !enemy.teams.some((team) => team.units.length)) continue;
			const teams = enemy.teams.map((team) => ({
				...team,
				units: team.units.map((unit) => {
					const fresh = { ...unit };
					delete fresh.state;
					return fresh;
				})
			}));
			const defenders = teams.map((team) => Object.fromEntries(team.units.map((unit) => [unit.id, unit])));
			const key = JSON.stringify({
				defenders,
				banner: enemy.context.banner
			});
			if (unique.has(key)) continue;
			unique.set(key, {
				...enemy,
				teams,
				context: {
					...enemy.context,
					defenders,
					teams: defenders,
					effects: {
						attackers: {},
						defenders: {}
					},
					__battleLabUsedHeroes: [],
					__battleLabUsedTitans: [],
					__battleLabExcludedUnits: []
				}
			});
		}
		return [...unique.values()];
	}
	function warDefenseSupportIds(teams) {
		return {
			units: teams.flatMap((team) => team.unitIds),
			pets: [...new Set(teams.flatMap((team) => [team.teamPetId, ...Object.values(team.favor)]).filter((id) => id != null && id > 0))],
			banners: teams.flatMap((team) => team.bannerId ? [team.bannerId] : [])
		};
	}
