	async function planBattleLabWarDefense(snapshot, options, onTeam, calculations = {
		search: optimizeBattleLabOpponent,
		train: trainBattleLabResult
	}) {
		return await runWithBattleLabProfile(`war-defense:${snapshot.modeId}`, () => runBattleLabWarDefensePlanning(snapshot, options, onTeam, calculations), {
			modeId: snapshot.modeId,
			maxCalculations: options.maxCalculations
		});
	}
	async function runBattleLabWarDefensePlanning(snapshot, options, onTeam, calculations) {
		if (snapshot.modeId === "asgard-minions") throw new Error("У прислужников нет расстановки обороны.");
		const account = options.accountSnapshot ?? await fetchAccountSnapshot(options.caller);
		const counts = warDefenseTeamCounts(snapshot.modeId, options.gameLibrary);
		const threats = {
			hero: warDefenseOpponents(snapshot, "hero"),
			titan: warDefenseOpponents(snapshot, "titan")
		};
		for (const type of ["hero", "titan"]) {
			if (!threats[type].length) throw new Error("На карте нет составов для проверки обороны: " + (type === "hero" ? "герои" : "титаны") + ". Обнови противников во время войны.");
			const requiredUnits = counts[type] * 5;
			if (Object.keys(type === "hero" ? account.heroes : account.titans).length < requiredUnits) throw new Error("Для обороны " + (type === "hero" ? "героями" : "титанами") + " нужно " + requiredUnits + " бойцов без повторов.");
		}
		const slots = ["hero", "titan"].flatMap((unitType) => Array.from({ length: counts[unitType] }, (_, index) => ({
			unitType,
			index
		})));
		if (options.maxCalculations < slots.length * 3) throw new Error("Для подбора всех команд нужно хотя бы " + slots.length * 3 + " расчётов.");
		const plan = [];
		let usedBudget = 0;
		const searchBudget = Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * .7);
		for (const slot of slots) {
			checkCancellation();
			const { unitType, index } = slot;
			onTeam?.(plan.length, slots.length, (unitType === "hero" ? "Герои" : "Титаны") + " · команда " + (index + 1));
			const used = warDefenseSupportIds(plan.flatMap((item) => item.result.teams));
			const remainingAccount = withoutUsedDefense(account, used);
			const opponent = defenseTarget(snapshot, threats[unitType], unitType, index);
			opponent.context = {
				...opponent.context,
				__battleLabMaxTeamUnits: 5
			};
			const allowance = Math.max(1, Math.floor((searchBudget - usedBudget) / (slots.length - plan.length)));
			const result = await calculations.search({
				...options,
				opponent,
				accountSnapshot: remainingAccount,
				direction: "defense",
				ultraTimingEnabled: false,
				fixedTeams: void 0,
				maxCalculations: allowance,
				scenarios: opponent.scenarios,
				onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(usedBudget + count)
			});
			checkCancellation();
			assertDefenseResult(result, unitType, used);
			usedBudget += result.calculationCount;
			plan.push({
				...slot,
				result,
				opponentCount: threats[unitType].length,
				testedOpponentCount: 0
			});
		}
		for (let index = 0; index < plan.length; index++) {
			checkCancellation();
			const entry = plan[index];
			const opponent = defenseTarget(snapshot, threats[entry.unitType], entry.unitType, entry.index);
			onTeam?.(index, plan.length, "Проверка обороны · " + (entry.unitType === "hero" ? "герои" : "титаны") + " " + (entry.index + 1));
			const allowance = Math.floor((options.maxCalculations - usedBudget) / (plan.length - index));
			const result = await calculations.train({
				...options,
				accountSnapshot: account,
				opponent,
				bestResult: entry.result,
				ultraTimingEnabled: false,
				maxCalculations: allowance,
				scenarios: opponent.scenarios,
				onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(usedBudget + count)
			});
			checkCancellation();
			usedBudget += result.calculationCount;
			entry.result = result;
			entry.testedOpponentCount = new Set(result.scenarioResults?.filter((scenario) => scenario.attempted > 0).map((scenario) => scenario.scenarioId)).size;
		}
		return {
			plan,
			calculationCount: usedBudget
		};
		function checkCancellation() {
			if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new Error("Подбор остановлен.");
		}
	}
	function defenseTarget(snapshot, enemies, unitType, index) {
		const id = snapshot.modeId + ":defense:" + unitType + ":" + index;
		return {
			...enemies[0],
			id,
			name: (unitType === "hero" ? "Оборона героев " : "Оборона титанов ") + (index + 1),
			scenarios: enemies.map((enemy) => ({
				id: enemy.id,
				label: enemy.name,
				context: enemy.context,
				weight: 1
			}))
		};
	}
	function withoutUsedDefense(account, used) {
		const omit = (collection, ids) => {
			const excluded = new Set(ids);
			return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(collection).filter(([id]) => !excluded.has(Number(id))));
		};
		return {
			...account,
			heroes: omit(account.heroes, used.units),
			titans: omit(account.titans, used.units),
			pets: omit(account.pets, used.pets),
			banners: omit(account.banners, used.banners),
			teamPresets: {},
			teamFavor: {}
		};
	}
	function assertDefenseResult(result, unitType, used) {
		const resources = warDefenseSupportIds(result.teams);
		if (result.direction !== "defense" || result.strategy !== "simulation" || result.teams.length !== 1 || resources.units.length !== 5 || resources.units.some((id) => unitType === "titan" ? id < 4e3 || id >= 5e3 : id >= 4e3)) throw new Error("Движок не вернул рассчитанный состав обороны.");
		if (resources.units.some((id) => used.units.includes(id)) || resources.pets.some((id) => used.pets.includes(id)) || resources.banners.some((id) => used.banners.includes(id))) throw new Error("Команды обороны пересекаются. Подбор остановлен.");
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/campaign-defense-executor.ts
	async function applyBattleLabCampaignDefense(options) {
		const { caller, snapshot } = options;
		if (snapshot.modeId === "asgard-minions") throw new Error("У прислужников нет расстановки обороны.");
		const byType = groupDefenseTeams(options.plan);
		for (const unitType of ["hero", "titan"]) {
			const teams = byType[unitType];
			if (!teams.length) continue;
			if (teams.some((team) => team.unitIds.length !== 5)) throw new Error("План обороны содержит неполную команду.");
			if (snapshot.modeId === "guild-war") {
				if (teams.length !== 1) throw new Error("ВГ принимает ровно одну команду каждого типа.");
				await campaignCall(caller, {
					name: "clanWarSetDefenceTeam",
					ident: "hwhBattleLabCampaignDefense",
					args: guildWarDefensePayload(unitType, teams[0])
				});
				continue;
			}
			await campaignCall(caller, {
				name: "crossClanWar_setDefenceTeam",
				ident: "hwhBattleLabCampaignDefense",
				args: clashDefensePayload(unitType, teams)
			});
		}
	}
	function groupDefenseTeams(plan) {
		return plan.reduce((groups, entry) => {
			groups[entry.unitType].push(...entry.result.teams);
			return groups;
		}, {
			hero: [],
			titan: []
		});
	}
	function guildWarDefensePayload(unitType, team) {
		return {
			heroes: team.unitIds,
			...team.teamPetId ? { pet: team.teamPetId } : {},
			favor: team.favor,
			...team.bannerId ? { banner: team.bannerId } : {},
			type: unitType === "titan" ? "clanDefence_titans" : "clanDefence_heroes"
		};
	}
	function clashDefensePayload(unitType, teams) {
		return {
			type: unitType === "titan" ? "crossClanDefence_titans" : "crossClanDefence_heroes",
			teams: teams.map((team) => ({
				units: team.unitIds,
				pet: team.teamPetId ?? null
			})),
			favor: Object.assign({}, ...teams.map((team) => team.favor)),
			banners: teams.map((team) => team.bannerId ?? null)
		};
	}

	function createBattleLabCampaignController(options) {
		const { model, caller, library, onBattle } = options;
		const getLibrary = () => asRecord$1(typeof library === "function" ? library() : library);
		let controller = null;
		const refresh = async (mode) => {
			const snapshot = await loadBattleLabCampaign(caller, mode, getLibrary());
			const prior = model.campaign;
			const plan = prior?.snapshot.revision === snapshot.revision ? prior.plan.filter((attack) => {
				try {
					assertCampaignAttackCurrent(snapshot, attack, prior.snapshot.revision);
					return true;
				} catch {
					return false;
				}
			}) : [];
			model.campaign = {
				snapshot,
				plan,
				running: prior?.running ?? false,
				calculating: prior?.calculating ?? false,
				status: snapshot.mapStatus ?? "",
				defense: prior?.snapshot.revision === snapshot.revision && JSON.stringify(prior.snapshot.opponents) === JSON.stringify(snapshot.opponents) ? prior.defense : [],
				direction: prior?.snapshot.modeId === mode ? prior.direction : "attack"
			};
			model.opponentsByMode = {
				...model.opponentsByMode,
				[mode]: snapshot.opponents ?? snapshot.targets.map((t) => t.opponent)
			};
			if (!model.opponentsByMode[mode].some((opponent) => opponent.id === model.selectedOpponentId)) model.selectedOpponentId = model.opponentsByMode[mode][0]?.id ?? "";
			return snapshot;
		};
		const run = async (operation, automatic = false) => {
			if (controller || model.tournamentAutoRunning || model.runState === "running" || model.attackState === "attacking") return;
			controller = new AbortController();
			const signal = controller.signal;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.errorText = "";
			model.runProgress = null;
			model.calculationCount = 0;
			model.statusText = "";
			try {
				if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					running: automatic,
					calculating: true,
					status: "Загружаю актуальную карту"
				};
				await operation(signal);
				model.runState = "done";
				model.statusText = signal.aborted ? "Остановлено" : model.statusText || "Готово";
			} catch (error) {
				model.runState = signal.aborted ? "done" : "error";
				model.errorText = signal.aborted ? "" : getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.statusText = signal.aborted ? "Остановлено" : model.errorText;
			} finally {
				controller = null;
				model.attackState = model.runState === "error" ? "error" : "idle";
				if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					running: false,
					calculating: false,
					status: model.statusText
				};
			}
		};
		const optimizationOptions = (signal) => ({
			caller,
			gameLibrary: getLibrary(),
			maxCalculations: model.maxCalculations,
			plannerWorkers: model.settings.plannerWorkers,
			history: model.history,
			signal,
			ultraTimingEnabled: false,
			fixedTeamsByOpponent: Object.fromEntries((model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId] ?? []).map((opponent) => [opponent.id, model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(opponent)]?.teams ?? []])),
			onProgress: (count) => {
				model.calculationCount = count;
			}
		});
		const plan = async () => {
			const mode = model.activeModeId;
			if (!isBattleLabCampaignMode(mode)) return;
			await run(async (signal) => {
				const snapshot = await refresh(mode);
				if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					direction: "attack"
				};
				if (!canPlanBattleLabCampaignAttack(snapshot)) throw new Error(snapshot.mapStatus ?? "Нет доступных целей или попыток.");
				const planned = await planBattleLabCampaign(snapshot, optimizationOptions(signal), (label) => {
					model.statusText = label;
					if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
						...model.campaign,
						status: label
					};
				});
				if (signal.aborted) return;
				model.calculationCount = planned.calculationCount;
				model.selectedVariationId = null;
				model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					snapshot,
					plan: planned.plan
				};
				model.bestResults = [...planned.plan.map((a) => a.result), ...model.bestResults.filter((r) => !snapshot.targets.some((t) => t.opponent.id === r.opponentId))].slice(0, 100);
				if (!planned.plan.length) throw new Error("В этом бюджете не найдены победные составы без повторов. Увеличь бюджет подбора.");
				model.statusText = "Подготовлено атак: " + planned.plan.length + "/" + snapshot.attempts.total + (planned.warnings.length ? ". Не удалось рассчитать: " + [...new Set(planned.warnings)].join("; ") : "");
			});
		};
		const planDefense = async () => {
			const mode = model.activeModeId;
			if (mode !== "guild-war" && mode !== "clash-of-worlds") return;
			await run(async (signal) => {
				const snapshot = await refresh(mode);
				model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					direction: "defense"
				};
				const planned = await planBattleLabWarDefense(snapshot, optimizationOptions(signal), (done, total, label) => {
					updateStatus(label + " · " + done + "/" + total);
				});
				if (signal.aborted) return;
				model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					defense: planned.plan
				};
				model.calculationCount = planned.calculationCount;
				model.statusText = "Подобрано команд обороны: " + planned.plan.length + ". Расчётов: " + planned.calculationCount + ".";
			});
		};
		const applyDefense = async () => {
			const mode = model.activeModeId;
			const view = model.campaign;
			if (mode !== "guild-war" && mode !== "clash-of-worlds" || !view?.defense?.length) return;
			if (model.settings.confirmAttack && typeof globalThis.confirm === "function" && !globalThis.confirm("Установить рассчитанные команды обороны на сервере?")) return;
			await run(async (signal) => {
				if (signal.aborted) return;
				await applyBattleLabCampaignDefense({
					caller,
					snapshot: view.snapshot,
					plan: view.defense ?? []
				});
				if (signal.aborted) return;
				await refresh(mode);
				model.campaign = {
					...model.campaign,
					direction: "defense",
					defense: view.defense,
					status: "Оборона сохранена сервером."
				};
				model.statusText = "Оборона сохранена сервером.";
			});
		};
		const attack = async (opponentId) => {
			const view = model.campaign;
			const selected = view?.plan.find((item) => item.target.opponent.id === opponentId);
			if (!view || !selected) return;
			if (model.settings.confirmAttack && typeof globalThis.confirm === "function" && !globalThis.confirm("Атаковать «" + selected.target.opponent.name + "» рассчитанным составом?")) return;
			await run(async (signal) => {
				if (signal.aborted) return;
				model.attackState = "attacking";
				try {
					await executeBattleLabCampaignAttack({
						caller,
						library: getLibrary(),
						snapshot: view.snapshot,
						attack: selected,
						signal,
						onBattle,
						liveTiming: {
							enabled: model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
							minTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
							maxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
							maxCalculations: model.maxCalculations
						},
						onStatus: updateStatus
					});
					model.statusText = "Ответ сервера обработан";
				} finally {
					await refresh(view.snapshot.modeId);
				}
			});
		};
		const autoMinions = async () => {
			if (model.settings.confirmAttack && typeof globalThis.confirm === "function" && !globalThis.confirm("Подобрать команды и пройти доступные точки прислужников Асгарда? Будут потрачены оставшиеся попытки.")) return;
			await run(async (signal) => {
				for (;;) {
					const snapshot = await refresh("asgard-minions");
					if (signal.aborted || snapshot.attempts.total <= 0 || !snapshot.targets.length) return;
					const target = snapshot.targets[0];
					const result = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
						...optimizationOptions(signal),
						opponent: target.opponent,
						fixedTeams: model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(target.opponent)]?.teams
					});
					if (signal.aborted) return;
					if (result.statistics?.winRate !== 1 || result.statistics.succeeded < 3) throw new Error("Победа во всех боях точки пока не подтверждена. Автопрохождение остановлено.");
					const attackPlan = {
						target,
						result,
						expectedPoints: target.points
					};
					model.campaign = {
						...model.campaign,
						plan: [attackPlan]
					};
					model.bestResults = [result, ...model.bestResults].slice(0, 100);
					model.attackState = "attacking";
					await executeBattleLabCampaignAttack({
						caller,
						library: getLibrary(),
						snapshot,
						attack: attackPlan,
						signal,
						onBattle,
						liveTiming: {
							enabled: model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
							minTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
							maxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
							maxCalculations: model.maxCalculations
						},
						onStatus: updateStatus
					});
					model.statusText = "Точка завершена";
					const after = await refresh("asgard-minions");
					if (signal.aborted) return;
					if (after.targets.some((item) => item.opponent.id === target.opponent.id)) throw new Error("Сервер не подтвердил завершение точки. Серия остановлена, оставшиеся попытки сохранены.");
					model.attackState = "idle";
				}
			}, true);
		};
		function updateStatus(text) {
			model.statusText = text;
			if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
				...model.campaign,
				status: text
			};
		}
		return {
			refresh,
			plan,
			planDefense,
			applyDefense,
			attack,
			autoMinions,
			stop: () => controller?.abort()
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/invasion-auto-runner.ts
	var MAX_STAGNANT_REFRESHES = 2;
	function shouldRollBattleLabInvasionTalismans(snapshot) {
		return snapshot.talismanRollBosses.some((number) => snapshot.actions.find((action) => action.number === number)?.completed === true);
	}
	/**
	* Проходит главу только по свежему `invasion_getInfo`. После каждого боя
	* состояние перечитывается, поэтому прошлый снимок не отправит повторную
	* атаку. Архидемон — последняя серверная точка — отдельно помечается в UI.
	*/
	async function runBattleLabInvasionAutomation({ signal, load, plan, attack, shouldSelectTalisman = shouldRollBattleLabInvasionTalismans, selectTalisman, selectChapter, maxBattles = null, onProgress }) {
		const limit = maxBattles === null ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBattles));
		let battles = 0;
		let stagnantRefreshes = 0;
		let talismanSelected = false;
		const selectedTalismanRollBosses = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let snapshot = await load();
		const emit = (phase, action = null) => onProgress?.({
			phase,
			battles,
			action,
			snapshot
		});
		emit("loading");
		while (!signal.aborted) {
			if (snapshot.lives !== null && snapshot.lives <= 0) {
				emit("done");
				return finish(snapshot, battles, false);
			}
			const action = snapshot.actions.find((item) => !item.completed);
			if (!action) {
				const nextChapter = findNextBattleLabInvasionChapter(snapshot);
				if (nextChapter && selectChapter) {
					emit("chapter");
					const nextSnapshot = await selectChapter(nextChapter, snapshot);
					if (nextSnapshot.activeChapterId === snapshot.activeChapterId) throw new Error("Сервер не переключил главу Вторжения. Автопрохождение остановлено до следующего боя.");
					snapshot = nextSnapshot;
					talismanSelected = false;
					selectedTalismanRollBosses.clear();
					stagnantRefreshes = 0;
					continue;
				}
				emit("done");
				return finish(snapshot, battles, false);
			}
			if (battles >= limit) throw new Error(`Автопрохождение Вторжения остановлено после ${limit} боёв: сработал заданный лимит.`);
			const nextTalismanRollBoss = nextBattleLabInvasionTalismanRoll(snapshot, selectedTalismanRollBosses);
			if (nextTalismanRollBoss !== null ? true : selectedTalismanRollBosses.size === 0 && !talismanSelected && shouldSelectTalisman?.(snapshot) === true) {
				if (!selectTalisman) throw new Error("Для этой главы нужен выбор талисмана, но обработчик не настроен.");
				emit("talismans", action);
				await selectTalisman(snapshot);
				talismanSelected = true;
				if (nextTalismanRollBoss !== null) selectedTalismanRollBosses.add(nextTalismanRollBoss);
				snapshot = await load();
				continue;
			}
			emit(action.boss ? "archdemon" : "planning", action);
			const result = await plan(action, snapshot);
			if (signal.aborted) break;
			emit("attacking", action);
			const before = fingerprint(snapshot);
			await attack(action, result, snapshot);
			battles += 1;
			snapshot = await load();
			stagnantRefreshes = fingerprint(snapshot) === before ? stagnantRefreshes + 1 : 0;
			if (stagnantRefreshes >= MAX_STAGNANT_REFRESHES) throw new Error("Два боя Вторжения подряд не изменили серверное состояние. Автопрохождение остановлено.");
		}
		emit("stopped");
		return finish(snapshot, battles, true);
	}
	function findNextBattleLabInvasionChapter(snapshot) {
		const activeIndex = snapshot.chapters.findIndex((chapter) => chapter.id === snapshot.activeChapterId);
		if (activeIndex < 0) return null;
		return snapshot.chapters.slice(activeIndex + 1).find((chapter) => !chapter.completed) ?? null;
	}
	function nextBattleLabInvasionTalismanRoll(snapshot, selected) {
		return [...snapshot.talismanRollBosses].sort((left, right) => left - right).find((number) => !selected.has(number) && snapshot.actions.some((action) => action.number === number && action.completed)) ?? null;
	}
	function fingerprint(snapshot) {
		return [
			snapshot.activeChapterId ?? "?",
			snapshot.lives ?? "?",
			...snapshot.actions.map((action) => `${action.id}:${action.wins}`)
		].join("|");
	}
	function finish(snapshot, battles, stopped) {
		return {
			battles,
			stopped,
			completed: snapshot.actions.length > 0 && snapshot.actions.every((action) => action.completed),
			snapshot
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/invasion-shop.ts
	init_helpers();
	/** Находит лавку активной главы, не смешивая hero- и titan-варианты события. */
	function resolveBattleLabInvasionShopId(snapshot, library) {
		const chapter = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.invasion).chapter)[snapshot.activeChapterId ?? ""];
		const direct = positiveInteger(asRecord$1(chapter).settings && asRecord$1(asRecord$1(chapter).settings).stallShopId);
		if (direct) return direct;
		return positiveInteger(Object.values(asRecord$1(library.shop)).map(asRecord$1).find((shop) => String(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(shop.requirements).invasion).id) === snapshot.invasionId)?.id) ?? null;
	}
	/** Сырые слоты остаются серверной истиной: неизвестная награда не становится покупкой. */
	function normalizeBattleLabInvasionShop(shopId, value) {
		const root = asRecord$1(value);
		return {
			shopId,
			slots: Object.values(asRecord$1(root.slots)).flatMap((raw) => {
				const slot = asRecord$1(raw);
				const id = String(slot.id ?? "").trim();
				if (!id) return [];
				const reward = asRecord$1(slot.reward);
				return [{
					id,
					bought: slot.bought === true,
					...slot.pinned === true ? { pinned: true } : {},
					cost: readCost(asRecord$1(slot.cost)),
					unitIds: readUnits(reward),
					unitFragments: readUnitFragments(reward),
					random: Object.keys(reward).some((key) => key.endsWith("Rand"))
				}];
			}),
			refreshCost: root.refreshCost === void 0 ? null : readCost(asRecord$1(root.refreshCost))
		};
	}
	function readCost(cost) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(cost.coin)).flatMap(([currency, amount]) => {
			const value = finiteNumber$1(amount, NaN);
			return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? [[currency, value]] : [];
		}));
	}
	function readUnits(reward) {
		return Object.keys(readUnitFragments(reward)).map(positiveInteger).filter((id) => id !== null);
	}
	function readUnitFragments(reward) {
		return [...Object.entries(reward).flatMap(([key, value]) => key.startsWith("invasionFragment") && !key.endsWith("Rand") ? Object.entries(asRecord$1(value)).flatMap(([id, count]) => {
			const amount = finiteNumber$1(count, NaN);
			return Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0 ? [[id, Math.floor(amount)]] : [];
		}) : [])].reduce((result, [id, count]) => {
			result[id] = (result[id] ?? 0) + count;
			return result;
		}, {});
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/invasion-shop-service.ts
	init_server_battle_response();
	init_helpers();
	/** Читает витрину главы без покупки, закрепления и обновления карточек. */
	async function fetchBattleLabInvasionShop(caller, event, library) {
		const shopId = resolveBattleLabInvasionShopId(event, library);
		if (!shopId) throw new Error("Для активной главы Вторжения сервер не указал лавку.");
		const { payload, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
			name: "shopGet",
			args: { shopId }
		}));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		return normalizeBattleLabInvasionShop(shopId, payload);
	}
	/**
	* Возвращает только валюты, которыми оплачиваются текущие слоты. Так лавка не
	* привязывается к старому id монеты и не получает лишние данные инвентаря.
	*/
	async function fetchBattleLabInvasionShopBalance(caller, shop) {
		const currencies = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...shop.slots.flatMap((slot) => Object.keys(slot.cost)), ...Object.keys(shop.refreshCost ?? {})]);
		if (currencies.size === 0) return {};
		const { payload, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send("inventoryGet"));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		const coin = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(payload).coin);
		return Object.fromEntries([...currencies].map((currency) => [currency, Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(coin[currency])))]));
	}
	/**
	* Покупает только слоты уже проверенного плана. Стоимость и награда намеренно
	* не отправляются повторно: сервер берёт их из актуальной витрины и не даёт
	* клиенту подменить цену устаревшим снимком.
	*/
	async function buyBattleLabInvasionShopPurchases(caller, shop, purchases) {
		for (const purchase of purchases) {
			const { error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
				name: "shopBuy",
				args: {
					shopId: shop.shopId,
					slot: purchase.slotId
				}
			}));
			if (error) throw new Error(error);
		}
	}
	/** Закрепляет только выбранный планировщиком серверный слот до следующего захода. */
	async function pinBattleLabInvasionShopSlot(caller, shopId, slotId) {
		const { error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
			name: "shop_pinSlot",
			args: {
				shopId,
				slotId
			}
		}));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
	}
	/**
	* Обновление ассортимента — отдельная платная операция. Вызывающий код делает
	* его только при включённом пользователем лимите, затем заново читает витрину.
	*/
	async function refreshBattleLabInvasionShop(caller, shop) {
		const { payload, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
			name: "shopRefresh",
			args: { shopId: shop.shopId }
		}));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		const refreshed = normalizeBattleLabInvasionShop(shop.shopId, payload);
		return refreshed.refreshCost === null && shop.refreshCost !== null ? {
			...refreshed,
			refreshCost: shop.refreshCost
		} : refreshed;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/invasion-talisman-service.ts
	init_helpers();
	init_server_battle_response();
	/** Возвращает только талисманы, которые сервер выдал именно в этой главе. */
	async function rollBattleLabInvasionTalismans(caller) {
		const response = await caller.send("invasion_rollTalismans");
		const { error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(response);
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		const raw = findRolledTalismanIds(response);
		return [...new Set(raw.map(positiveInteger).filter((id) => id !== null))];
	}
	/**
	* У `invasion_rollTalismans` бывают прямой массив и HTTP-конверт. Первый
	* попавшийся массив может оказаться `results`, поэтому принимаем только
	* коллекцию скалярных ID из уже разобранного ответа сервера.
	*/
	function findRolledTalismanIds(value) {
		if (isTalismanIdArray(value)) return value;
		const queue = [value];
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const preferredKeys = [
			"talismans",
			"talismanIds",
			"offers",
			"choices",
			"items",
			"list"
		];
		const envelopeKeys = [
			"result",
			"response",
			"payload",
			"data",
			"results"
		];
		while (queue.length) {
			const current = queue.shift();
			if (!current || typeof current !== "object" || seen.has(current)) continue;
			seen.add(current);
			if (Array.isArray(current)) {
				queue.push(...current);
				continue;
			}
			const record = asRecord$1(current);
			for (const key of preferredKeys) {
				const candidate = record[key];
				if (isTalismanIdArray(candidate)) return candidate;
				if (isTalismanIdRecord(candidate)) return Object.values(asRecord$1(candidate));
			}
			if (isTalismanIdRecord(record)) return Object.values(record);
			for (const key of envelopeKeys) {
				const nested = record[key];
				if (isTalismanIdArray(nested)) return nested;
				if (nested && typeof nested === "object") queue.push(nested);
			}
		}
		return [];
	}
	function isTalismanIdRecord(value) {
		const values = Object.values(asRecord$1(value));
		return values.length > 0 && values.every((item) => positiveInteger(item) !== null);
	}
	function isTalismanIdArray(value) {
		return Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && value.every((item) => positiveInteger(item) !== null);
	}
	async function selectBattleLabInvasionTalisman(caller, talismanId, offeredIds) {
		if (!offeredIds.includes(talismanId)) throw new Error("Сервер не выдавал выбранный талисман в текущем броске.");
		const { error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send({
			name: "invasion_selectTalisman",
			args: { talismanId }
		}));
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/invasion-progression.ts
	/**
	* Во Вторжении фрагменты не открывают новых бойцов после первого: один и тот
	* же боец усиливается на отметках 1, 3 и 7. Держим правило рядом с моделью
	* события, чтобы закупка и расчёт не расходились в собственной арифметике.
	*/
	var BATTLE_LAB_INVASION_FRAGMENT_MILESTONES = [
		1,
		3,
		7
	];
	function resolveBattleLabInvasionUnitProgression(value) {
		const fragments = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(value) || 0)));
		const stage = BATTLE_LAB_INVASION_FRAGMENT_MILESTONES.filter((milestone) => fragments >= milestone).length;
		return {
			fragments,
			stage,
			nextMilestone: BATTLE_LAB_INVASION_FRAGMENT_MILESTONES[stage] ?? null
		};
	}
	function buildBattleLabInvasionProgression(fragments, unitIds) {
		return Object.fromEntries([...new Set(unitIds)].map((id) => [String(id), resolveBattleLabInvasionUnitProgression(fragments[String(id)])]));
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/invasion-opponents.ts
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* Строит плановые цели прямо из `invasion_getInfo` и `lib`. Это даёт выбрать
	* главу и начать тренировку до первого живого боя; старый журнал тут не нужен.
	*/
	function buildBattleLabInvasionOpponents(snapshot, library, modeId) {
		const chapter = snapshot.chapters.find((item) => item.id === snapshot.activeChapterId);
		if (!chapter) return [];
		return snapshot.actions.flatMap((action) => {
			if (action.completed || action.boss !== (modeId === "archdemon")) return [];
			const config = resolveBattleLabInvasionBossConfig(library, action.id, chapter.id);
			if (!config) return [];
			const teams = normalizeBossTeams(config.team, config.bossLevel ?? config.unitLevel);
			if (teams.length === 0) return [];
			const name = action.boss ? "Архидемон" : `Бой Вторжения ${action.number}`;
			const detail = action.boss ? `Глава ${chapter.number} · множитель ${config.damageMultiplier}` : `Глава ${chapter.number} · попытки ${action.wins}`;
			const battle = {
				type: config.battleType,
				typeId: config.id,
				attackers: {},
				defenders: teams.map((team) => Object.fromEntries(team.units.map((unit) => [String(unit.id), unit]))),
				effects: {
					battleConfig: config.battleConfig ?? "invasion_boss",
					attackers: {},
					defenders: {}
				},
				progress: [{ attackers: { input: [] } }]
			};
			const context = {
				battle,
				type: config.battleType,
				typeId: config.id,
				defenders: battle.defenders,
				teams: battle.defenders,
				effects: battle.effects,
				chapterId: chapter.id,
				__battleLabInvasionAllowedUnits: [...snapshot.availableUnits],
				__battleLabInvasionFullRoster: true,
				__battleLabInvasionFragments: { ...snapshot.fragments },
				__battleLabInvasionUnitProgression: buildBattleLabInvasionProgression(snapshot.fragments, snapshot.availableUnits),
				__battleLabStartArgs: {
					id: config.id,
					chapterId: chapter.id
				},
				__battleLabInvasionActionId: action.id,
				__battleLabInvasionConfig: {
					bossLevel: config.bossLevel,
					unitLevel: config.unitLevel,
					buffs: [...config.buffs],
					forceWin: config.forceWin
				}
			};
			return [{
				id: `${modeId}:${snapshot.invasionId}:${chapter.id}:${action.id}`,
				externalId: action.id,
				modeId,
				name,
				detail,
				position: action.number,
				power: teams.reduce((total, team) => total + team.power, 0),
				teams,
				dataQuality: "partial",
				platformId: "web",
				context
			}];
		});
	}
	function normalizeBossTeams(source, level) {
		return (Array.isArray(source) ? source : Object.values(source)).flatMap((rawTeam, index) => {
			const units = (Array.isArray(rawTeam) ? rawTeam : Object.values(asRecord$1(rawTeam).heroes ?? rawTeam)).map((raw) => normalizeBossUnit(raw, level)).filter((unit) => unit !== null);
			if (units.length === 0) return [];
			return [{
				id: `boss-team:${index + 1}`,
				units,
				power: units.reduce((total, unit) => total + Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(unit.power)), 0),
				quality: resolveTeamQuality(units)
			}];
		});
	}
	function normalizeBossUnit(value, level) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const id = positiveInteger(source.id);
		if (!id) return null;
		const type = id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3 ? "titan" : "hero";
		return {
			...source,
			id,
			type,
			...finiteNumber$1(source.level) > 0 || level === null ? {} : { level }
		};
	}
	function resolveTeamQuality(units) {
		return units.every((unit) => finiteNumber$1(unit.hp) > 0 || finiteNumber$1(unit.power) > 0 || finiteNumber$1(unit.level) > 0 && Object.keys(asRecord$1(unit.skills)).length > 0) ? "complete" : "partial";
	}
	/** Строит дефицит для выбранной пачки: после семи фрагментов боец собран полностью. */
	function buildBattleLabInvasionShopNeed(unitIds, fragments) {
		return Object.fromEntries([...new Set(unitIds)].flatMap((id) => {
			const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(fragments[String(id)]) || 0));
			const missing = Math.max(0, 7 - current);
			return missing > 0 ? [[String(id), missing]] : [];
		}));
	}
	/** Решение об атаке берётся из нового снимка события, а не из обещания витрины. */
	function isBattleLabInvasionShopNeedComplete(unitIds, fragments) {
		return Object.keys(buildBattleLabInvasionShopNeed(unitIds, fragments)).length === 0;
	}
	/**
	* Выбирает только известные карточки, которые закрывают переданную потребность
	* в фрагментах. Вероятностные лоты в план не попадают: их ценность нельзя
	* честно выдать за гарантированную синергию.
	*/
	function planBattleLabInvasionShopPurchases(options) {
		const remainingBalance = normalizePositive(options.balance);
		const remainingNeed = normalizePositive(options.neededFragments);
		const candidates = options.shop.slots.filter((slot) => !slot.bought && !slot.random).map((slot) => ({
			slot,
			usefulFragments: usefulFragments(slot, remainingNeed)
		})).filter((candidate) => Object.keys(candidate.usefulFragments).length).sort(compareCandidates);
		const purchases = [];
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			if (!canAfford(candidate.slot.cost, remainingBalance)) continue;
			const useful = usefulFragments(candidate.slot, remainingNeed);
			if (!Object.keys(useful).length) continue;
			spend(candidate.slot.cost, remainingBalance);
			applyFragments(useful, remainingNeed);
			purchases.push({
				slotId: candidate.slot.id,
				cost: { ...candidate.slot.cost },
				usefulFragments: useful
			});
		}
		const unaffordableUsefulSlots = options.shop.slots.filter((slot) => !slot.bought && !slot.random && Object.keys(usefulFragments(slot, remainingNeed)).length > 0 && !canAfford(slot.cost, remainingBalance)).sort((left, right) => compareCandidates({
			slot: left,
			usefulFragments: usefulFragments(left, remainingNeed)
		}, {
			slot: right,
			usefulFragments: usefulFragments(right, remainingNeed)
		}));
		const hasUnaffordableUsefulSlot = unaffordableUsefulSlots.length > 0;
		return {
			purchases,
			remainingBalance,
			remainingNeed,
			skippedRandomSlots: options.shop.slots.filter((slot) => !slot.bought && slot.random).length,
			hasUnaffordableUsefulSlot,
			pinSlotId: unaffordableUsefulSlots.find((slot) => !slot.pinned)?.id ?? null,
			canRefresh: !hasUnaffordableUsefulSlot && options.shop.refreshCost !== null && canAfford(options.shop.refreshCost, remainingBalance)
		};
	}
	/**
	* Случайная карта не доказывает синергию и не участвует в улучшении готовой
	* пачки. Она годится только как последний способ собрать минимум бойцов,
	* после чего состав и расчёт всегда перечитываются с сервера.
	*/
	function planBattleLabInvasionShopBootstrap(options) {
		const remainingBalance = normalizePositive(options.balance);
		if (options.ownedUnitCount >= options.requiredUnitCount) return {
			purchase: null,
			remainingBalance
		};
		const slot = options.shop.slots.filter((item) => !item.bought && item.random).filter((item) => canAfford(item.cost, remainingBalance)).sort((left, right) => {
			return sum(left.cost) - sum(right.cost) || left.id.localeCompare(right.id);
		})[0];
		if (!slot) return {
			purchase: null,
			remainingBalance
		};
		spend(slot.cost, remainingBalance);
		return {
			purchase: {
				slotId: slot.id,
				cost: { ...slot.cost },
				usefulFragments: {}
			},
			remainingBalance
		};
	}
	function normalizePositive(value) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).flatMap(([id, count]) => {
			const amount = Math.floor(Number(count));
			return Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0 ? [[id, amount]] : [];
		}));
	}
	function usefulFragments(slot, need) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(slot.unitFragments).flatMap(([id, count]) => {
			const useful = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(count)), need[id] ?? 0);
			return useful > 0 ? [[id, useful]] : [];
		}));
	}
	function compareCandidates(left, right) {
		const usefulDifference = sum(right.usefulFragments) - sum(left.usefulFragments);
		if (usefulDifference) return usefulDifference;
		return sum(left.slot.cost) - sum(right.slot.cost) || left.slot.id.localeCompare(right.slot.id);
	}
	function sum(values) {
		return Object.values(values).reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0);
	}
	function canAfford(cost, balance) {
		return Object.entries(cost).every(([currency, amount]) => (balance[currency] ?? 0) >= amount);
	}
	function spend(cost, balance) {
		for (const [currency, amount] of Object.entries(cost)) {
			const remaining = balance[currency] - amount;
			if (remaining > 0) balance[currency] = remaining;
			else delete balance[currency];
		}
	}
	function applyFragments(fragments, need) {
		for (const [id, amount] of Object.entries(fragments)) {
			const remaining = Math.max(0, need[id] - amount);
			if (remaining > 0) need[id] = remaining;
			else delete need[id];
		}
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/archdemon-planning.ts
	init_archdemon();

	async function optimizeArchdemonPlan(options, setup, selectionOptions = {}) {
		const accountSnapshot = options.accountSnapshot ?? await fetchArchdemonAccount(options.caller, options.opponent, options.gameLibrary);
		const prepared = {
			...options,
			accountSnapshot,
			scenarios: [],
			fixedTeams: options.fixedTeams ?? (setup.teams.length ? setup.teams : void 0)
		};
		const selection = setup.archdemonTalisman ?? "auto";
		if (selection === "current") return optimizeBattleLabOpponent(prepared);
		const catalog = readArchdemonTalismans(options.gameLibrary);
		const offered = selectionOptions.offeredIds ? new Set(selectionOptions.offeredIds.filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0)) : null;
		const candidates = availableArchdemonTalismans(options.opponent, catalog).filter((item) => !offered || offered.has(item.id));
		const ids = selection === "auto" ? [...selectionOptions.includeNoTalisman === true ? [0] : [], ...candidates.map((item) => item.id)] : [selection];
		if (selection !== "auto" && offered && !offered.has(selection)) throw new Error("Сервер не выдавал выбранный талисман в текущем броске.");
		if (selection === "auto" && ids.length === 0) throw new Error("В игровом справочнике нет талисманов, доступных для сравнения.");
		const total = Math.floor(options.maxCalculations);
		const runs = Math.max(3, Math.min(20, Math.floor(total * .25 / ids.length)));
		const searchBudget = Math.floor(total / ids.length) - runs;
		if (searchBudget < 8) throw new Error("Увеличь бюджет расчётов для сравнения всех талисманов.");
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		let used = 0;
		let best;
		let bestId = 0;
		let bestDamage = -Infinity;
		const comparisons = [];
		for (const talismanId of ids) {
			options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
			const opponent = withArchdemonTalisman(options.opponent, catalog, talismanId);
			const callbacks = () => {
				const offset = used;
				return {
					onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(offset + count),
					onProcess: (progress) => options.onProcess?.({
						...progress,
						completed: offset + progress.completed,
						total
					})
				};
			};
			const searched = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
				...prepared,
				opponent,
				maxCalculations: searchBudget,
				...callbacks()
			});
			used += searched.calculationCount;
			const trained = await trainBattleLabResult({
				...prepared,
				opponent,
				bestResult: searched,
				maxCalculations: runs,
				ultraTimingEnabled: false,
				...callbacks()
			});
			used += trained.calculationCount;
			const damage = trained.statistics?.scoreMean ?? trained.score;
			comparisons.push({
				talismanId,
				damageMean: damage,
				runs: trained.statistics?.succeeded ?? 0
			});
			if (damage > bestDamage) {
				best = trained;
				bestId = talismanId;
				bestDamage = damage;
			}
		}
		if (!best) throw new Error("Не удалось завершить ни одну тренировку Архидемона.");
		return {
			...best,
			elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
			calculationCount: used,
			archdemonTalismanPlan: {
				talismanId: bestId,
				damageMean: bestDamage,
				tested: comparisons.length,
				comparisons: comparisons.sort((a, b) => b.damageMean - a.damageMean)
			}
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/planning-service.ts
	init_planning_setup();
	init_asgard_buff_planning();
	init_calc_executor();

	init_profiler();
	init_opponent_normalizer();
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* Пачка, чей герой уже бил босса сегодня, отработала: сервер её не примет,
	* а движок не должен считать её ручной строкой. Из частичных строк убираем
	* только потраченных героев. Поддержка переиндексируется вместе со строками.
	*/
	function withoutSpentAsgardRows(setup, usedHeroIds) {
		const used = new Set(usedHeroIds);
		if (!used.size) return setup;
		const rows = setup.teams.flatMap((ids, index) => ids.length === 5 && ids.some((id) => used.has(id)) ? [] : [{
			index,
			ids: ids.filter((id) => !used.has(id))
		}]);
		return {
			...setup,
			teams: rows.map((row) => row.ids),
			teamPetSelections: rows.map((row) => setup.teamPetSelections[row.index] ?? "auto"),
			bannerSelections: rows.map((row) => setup.bannerSelections[row.index] ?? "auto"),
			favorSelections: rows.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(setup.favorSelections?.[row.index] ?? {}).filter(([hero]) => !used.has(Number(hero)))))
		};
	}
	/** Оставшиеся попытки босса из `clanRaid_getInfo`; null, если сервер их не прислал. */
	function readAsgardAttemptsLeft(opponent) {
		const attempts = finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot).bossAttempts, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(attempts) && attempts >= 0 ? Math.floor(attempts) : null;
	}
	async function optimizeBattleLabPlan(options, setup, archdemonTalismans) {
		return await runWithBattleLabProfile(`plan:${options.opponent.modeId}`, () => runBattleLabPlan(options, setup, archdemonTalismans), {
			modeId: options.opponent.modeId,
			maxCalculations: options.maxCalculations,
			asgardBuffMode: setup.asgardBuffMode,
			fixedTeams: setup.teams.length
		});
	}
	async function runBattleLabPlan(options, sourceSetup, archdemonTalismans) {
		const asgard = options.opponent.modeId === "asgard";
		const setup = asgard ? withoutSpentAsgardRows(sourceSetup, extractAsgardUsedHeroes(options.opponent)) : sourceSetup;
		const attemptsLeft = asgard ? readAsgardAttemptsLeft(options.opponent) : null;
		const supportSetup = asgard ? {
			...setup,
			teams: Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(5, attemptsLeft ?? 5, options.asgardTeamCount ?? (setup.teams.length || 5))) }, (_, index) => setup.teams[index] ?? [])
		} : setup;
		const prepared = {
			...options,
			opponent: options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? {
				...options.opponent,
				usedHeroes: [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...options.opponent.usedHeroes ?? [], ...setup.teams.slice(supportSetup.teams.length).flat()])]
			} : options.opponent,
			fixedTeams: options.fixedTeams ?? (setup.teams.length ? supportSetup.teams : void 0),
			fixedTeamSupports: options.fixedTeamSupports ?? (supportSetup.teams.length ? planningFixedTeamSupports(supportSetup, { fillEmptySlots: options.opponent.modeId === "asgard" }) : void 0)
		};
		if (options.opponent.modeId === "archdemon") return optimizeArchdemonPlan(prepared, setup, archdemonTalismans);
		if (options.opponent.modeId !== "asgard" || setup.asgardBuffMode === "current") return optimizeBattleLabOpponent(prepared);
		const catalog = readAsgardPlanningBuffs(options.opponent, options.gameLibrary, (key) => key);
		if (setup.asgardBuffMode === "manual") {
			const plan = priceAsgardBuffPlan(catalog, setup.asgardBuffCounts);
			return {
				...await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
					...prepared,
					opponent: withAsgardPlanningBuffs(prepared.opponent, options.gameLibrary, catalog, plan.counts)
				}),
				asgardBuffPlan: plan
			};
		}
		if (!catalog.length) throw new Error("В снимке нет доступного магазина усилений Асгарда. Обнови противника.");
		return optimizeAsgardWithBuffSearch(options, prepared, setup, catalog);
	}
	/**
	* Пачки и усиления зависят друг от друга: ролевые баффы Оша меняют лучший
	* состав, а состав — лучший набор. Чередуем: пачки → баффы → пачки → проверка
	* баффов на итоговых пачках. Баффы сравниваются с найденными таймингами пачек.
	*/
	async function optimizeAsgardWithBuffSearch(options, prepared, setup, catalog) {
		const accountSnapshot = options.accountSnapshot ?? await fetchAccountSnapshot(options.caller);
		const base = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
			...prepared,
			accountSnapshot,
			maxCalculations: Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * .3))
		});
		let used = base.calculationCount;
		if (options.finishSignal?.aborted) return base;
		const searchBuffs = async (teams, share) => {
			return await searchAsgardBuffsForTeams({
				options,
				prepared,
				setup,
				catalog,
				accountSnapshot,
				template: base,
				teams,
				budget: Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * share),
				onSpent: (count) => {
					used += count;
					options.onProgress?.(used);
				}
			});
		};
		const first = await searchBuffs(base.teams, .3);
		if (!first) throw new Error("Увеличь бюджет расчётов для подбора усилений.");
		if (options.finishSignal?.aborted) return {
			...base,
			calculationCount: used,
			asgardBuffPlan: first.plan
		};
		const finalBudget = Math.max(1, options.maxCalculations - used - Math.floor(options.maxCalculations * .12));
		const result = await optimizeBattleLabOpponent({
			...prepared,
			accountSnapshot,
			opponent: first.opponent,
			seedTeams: base.teams,
			maxCalculations: finalBudget,
			onProgress: (count) => options.onProgress?.(used + count),
			onProcess: (progress) => options.onProcess?.({
				...progress,
				completed: used + progress.completed,
				total: options.maxCalculations
			})
		});
		used += result.calculationCount;
		let plan = first.plan;
		let evaluator = sameTeamSet(base.teams, result.teams) ? first : null;
		if (!evaluator && !options.finishSignal?.aborted) {
			const second = await searchBuffs(result.teams, .12);
			if (second && second.score > await second.scoreOf(first.plan)) plan = second.plan;
			evaluator = second;
		}
		if (evaluator && !options.finishSignal?.aborted) plan = await describeAsgardBuffPlan(plan, result.teams, evaluator, catalog, { remaining: options.maxCalculations - used });
		return {
			...result,
			calculationCount: used,
			asgardBuffPlan: plan
		};
	}
	async function searchAsgardBuffsForTeams(input) {
		const { options, prepared, catalog, teams } = input;
		const perTrial = teams.length * BUFF_TRIAL_RUNS;
		const maxTrials = Math.min(128, Math.floor(input.budget / Math.max(1, perTrial)));
		if (maxTrials < 1) return null;
		const scores = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const teamScores = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const planKey = (plan) => JSON.stringify(Object.entries(plan.counts).sort());
		const scoreTeam = async (opponent, team) => {
			const trained = await trainBattleLabResult({
				...options,
				accountSnapshot: input.accountSnapshot,
				opponent,
				bestResult: {
					...input.template,
					teams: [team],
					timings: team.timings ?? [{
						type: "auto",
						time: 0
					}]
				},
				scenarios: [],
				maxCalculations: BUFF_TRIAL_RUNS,
				ultraTimingEnabled: false,
				onProcess: void 0,
				onProgress: void 0
			});
			input.onSpent(trained.calculationCount);
			return trained.statistics?.scoreMean ?? trained.score;
		};
		const evaluate = async (plan) => {
			const opponent = withAsgardPlanningBuffs(prepared.opponent, options.gameLibrary, catalog, plan.counts);
			const perTeam = getBattleLabCalcExecutor() ? await Promise.all(teams.map((team) => scoreTeam(opponent, team))) : await teams.reduce(async (done, team) => [...await done, await scoreTeam(opponent, team)], Promise.resolve([]));
			const score = perTeam.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
			scores.set(planKey(plan), score);
			teamScores.set(planKey(plan), perTeam);
			return {
				score,
				value: opponent
			};
		};
		const searched = await searchAsgardBuffPlans({
			catalog,
			coinBudget: readAsgardBuffCoinBudget(options.opponent, input.setup.coinBudget),
			goldBudget: input.setup.goldBudget,
			maxTrials,
			bounded: true,
			signal: options.signal,
			evaluate
		});
		return {
			plan: searched.plan,
			opponent: searched.value,
			score: scores.get(planKey(searched.plan)) ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
			scoreOf: async (plan) => scores.get(planKey(plan)) ?? (await evaluate(plan)).score,
			teamScoresOf: async (plan) => {
				if (!teamScores.has(planKey(plan))) await evaluate(plan);
				return teamScores.get(planKey(plan)) ?? [];
			}
		};
	}
	var BUFF_TRIAL_RUNS = 4;
	/**
	* Матрица «бафф × пачка» и расписание покупок: итоговый набор сравнивается
	* с собой без одного уровня каждого слота. Без бюджета план остаётся как есть.
	*/
	async function describeAsgardBuffPlan(plan, teams, evaluator, catalog, budget) {
		const slots = Object.entries(plan.counts).filter(([, count]) => count > 0);
		if (!slots.length) return plan;
		if ((slots.length + 1) * teams.length * BUFF_TRIAL_RUNS > budget.remaining) return plan;
		const withPlan = await evaluator.teamScoresOf(plan);
		const withoutSlot = {};
		for (const [slotId, count] of slots) withoutSlot[slotId] = await evaluator.teamScoresOf(priceAsgardBuffPlan(catalog, {
			...plan.counts,
			[slotId]: count - 1
		}));
		const teamEffects = analyzeAsgardBuffEffects(teams.map((team) => team.unitIds), plan.counts, withPlan, withoutSlot);
		return {
			...plan,
			teamEffects,
			schedule: planAsgardBuffSchedule(plan.counts, teamEffects)
		};
	}
	function sameTeamSet(left, right) {
		const key = (teams) => teams.map((team) => [...team.unitIds].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",")).sort().join("|");
		return key(left) === key(right);
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/asgard-attack-selection.ts
	init_opponent_normalizer();
	/** Выбранные собранные строки одинаковы для обучения и атаки, включая недоступных героев. */
	function selectedAsgardTrainingRows(setup, selected, usedHeroIds) {
		const used = new Set(usedHeroIds);
		return (setup?.teams ?? []).flatMap((ids, row) => ids.length === 5 && selected.includes(row) && !ids.some((id) => used.has(id)) ? [row] : []);
	}
	/** Серверные использованные герои дополняются уже подтверждёнными атаками этой сессии. */
	function readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(opponent, progress) {
		return [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...extractAsgardUsedHeroes(opponent), ...progress?.opponentId === opponent.id ? progress.teams.flatMap((team) => team.phase === "done" ? team.unitIds : team.phase === "skipped" ? team.usedHeroIds ?? [] : []) : []])];
	}
	/** Галочки относятся к строкам редактора, даже если результат содержит только часть строк. */
	function selectAsgardAttackTeams(teams, setup, selectedIndices, usedHeroIds) {
		const selected = new Set(selectedIndices);
		const used = new Set(usedHeroIds);
		return teams.filter((team, index) => {
			const fixedRow = setup?.teams.findIndex((ids) => ids.length === team.unitIds.length && ids.every((id) => team.unitIds.includes(id))) ?? -1;
			return team.unitIds.length === 5 && selected.has(fixedRow >= 0 ? fixedRow : index) && !team.unitIds.some((id) => used.has(id));
		});
	}
	/**
	* Цель атаки: в Асгарде — отмеченные и ещё не отработавшие строки редактора,
	* в остальных многопачечных режимах — отмеченные пачки результата.
	*/
	function selectBattleLabAttackTarget(modeId, bestResult, setup, selectedIndices, usedHeroIds) {
		let teams = bestResult.teams;
		if (modeId === "asgard") teams = selectAsgardAttackTeams(bestResult.teams, setup, selectedIndices, usedHeroIds);
		else if (bestResult.teams.length > 1) {
			const selected = new Set(selectedIndices);
			teams = bestResult.teams.filter((_, index) => selected.has(index));
		}
		if (teams.length === 0) return { blocked: modeId === "asgard" ? "Нет выбранных доступных пачек для атаки." : "Не выбрано ни одной пачки для атаки." };
		return { result: teams === bestResult.teams ? bestResult : {
			...bestResult,
			teams
		} };
	}
	/** Галочка строки: без сохранённого выбора отмечены все пять строк. */
	function toggleAsgardTeamIndex(selected, index) {
		const current = new Set(selected ?? [
			0,
			1,
			2,
			3,
			4
		]);
		if (current.has(index)) current.delete(index);
		else current.add(index);
		return [...current].sort((a, b) => a - b);
	}
	var lineupKey = (ids) => [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
	/**
	* Порядок атаки по расписанию баффов. Покупки до первой атаки уже сделаны или
	* сделаются перед ней; покупка между атаками ставится паузой перед следующей
	* пачкой. Пачки вне расписания идут в конце в исходном порядке.
	*/
	function buildAsgardAttackSequence(teams, schedule) {
		const remaining = new Map(teams.map((team) => [lineupKey(team.unitIds), team]));
		const steps = [];
		let pendingBuy = null;
		for (const step of schedule ?? []) {
			if (step.kind === "buy") {
				pendingBuy = {
					...pendingBuy ?? {},
					...step.counts
				};
				continue;
			}
			for (const ids of step.teams) {
				const team = remaining.get(lineupKey(ids));
				if (!team) continue;
				remaining.delete(lineupKey(ids));
				steps.push({
					team,
					buyBefore: pendingBuy
				});
				pendingBuy = null;
			}
		}
		for (const team of remaining.values()) {
			steps.push({
				team,
				buyBefore: pendingBuy
			});
			pendingBuy = null;
		}
		return steps;
	}

	function escapeHtml(value) {
		return String(value ?? "").replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;").replaceAll(">", "&gt;").replaceAll("\"", "&quot;").replaceAll("'", "&#39;");
	}
	var SHARED_STYLE_CACHE_KEY = "injectedStyleCacheV1";
	var localInjectedStyleCache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
	function getInjectedStyleCache() {
		const sharedUi = globalThis.HWHSharedUI && typeof globalThis.HWHSharedUI === "object" ? globalThis.HWHSharedUI : globalThis.HWHSharedUI = {};
		const sharedCache = sharedUi[SHARED_STYLE_CACHE_KEY];
		if (sharedCache instanceof Map) return sharedCache;
		sharedUi[SHARED_STYLE_CACHE_KEY] = localInjectedStyleCache;
		return localInjectedStyleCache;
	}
	function injectStyle(styleId, cssText) {
		const existingStyleElement = document.getElementById(styleId);
		const injectedStyleCache = getInjectedStyleCache();
		const cachedStyle = injectedStyleCache.get(styleId);
		if (cachedStyle?.source === cssText && existingStyleElement === cachedStyle.element) return;
		if (existingStyleElement?.tagName === "STYLE") {
			if (existingStyleElement.textContent !== cssText) existingStyleElement.textContent = cssText;
			injectedStyleCache.set(styleId, {
				source: cssText,
				normalized: cssText,
				element: existingStyleElement
			});
			return;
		}
		const styleElement = document.createElement("style");
		styleElement.id = styleId;
		styleElement.textContent = cssText;
		(document.head ?? document.documentElement).appendChild(styleElement);
		injectedStyleCache.set(styleId, {
			source: cssText,
			normalized: cssText,
			element: styleElement
		});
	}

	function ensureSharedUiFeedbackStyles() {

	//#region src/shared/ui/toast-preferences.ts
	init_normalize();

	var TOAST_POSITIONS = [
		"top-right",
		"bottom-right",
		"top-left",
		"bottom-left"
	];
	var DEFAULT_TOAST_POSITION = "top-right";
	var DEFAULT_TOAST_TIMEOUT_MS = 1e4;
	var MAX_TOAST_TIMEOUT_MS = 12e4;
	var DEFAULT_TOAST_PREFERENCES = Object.freeze({
		position: DEFAULT_TOAST_POSITION,
		stackSize: 3,
		timeoutMs: DEFAULT_TOAST_TIMEOUT_MS
	});
	var toastPositionSet = new Set(TOAST_POSITIONS);
	function normalizeToastPosition(value) {
		const position = String(value ?? "");
		return toastPositionSet.has(position) ? position : DEFAULT_TOAST_POSITION;
	}
	function normalizeToastStackSize(value) {
		const stackSize = Math.trunc(Number(value));
		return Number.isFinite(stackSize) ? Math.min(6, Math.max(1, stackSize)) : 3;
	}
	function normalizeToastTimeoutMs(value) {
		const timeoutMs = Math.trunc(Number(value));
		return Number.isFinite(timeoutMs) ? Math.min(MAX_TOAST_TIMEOUT_MS, Math.max(0, timeoutMs)) : DEFAULT_TOAST_TIMEOUT_MS;
	}
	function normalizeToastPreferences(value) {
		const source = isPlainObject(value) ? value : {};
		return {
			position: normalizeToastPosition(source.position),
			stackSize: normalizeToastStackSize(source.stackSize),
			timeoutMs: normalizeToastTimeoutMs(source.timeoutMs)
		};
	}
	function readToastPreferences(storage = getBrowserLocalStorage()) {
		try {
			return normalizeToastPreferences(JSON.parse(storage?.getItem("hwhx_toast_preferences") ?? "null"));
		} catch (error) {
			console.warn("[hwhx] Не удалось прочитать настройки уведомлений:", error);
			return { ...DEFAULT_TOAST_PREFERENCES };
		}
	}

	function showNativeToast(options) {
		ensureSharedUiFeedbackStyles();
		const id = String(options.id ?? createToastId());
		dismissNativeToast(id, "overflow");
		const root = ensureStack();
		const element = buildToastElement(id, options);
		const timeoutMs = normalizeToastPreferences({ timeoutMs: options.timeoutMs ?? preferences.timeoutMs }).timeoutMs;
		const entry = {
			element,
			onClose: options.onClose,
			timeoutId: timeoutMs > 0 ? globalThis.setTimeout(() => dismissNativeToast(id, "timeout"), timeoutMs) : null
		};
		entries.set(id, entry);
		root.appendChild(element);
		trimOverflow();
		return id;
	}
	function dismissNativeToast(id, reason = "close") {
		const entry = entries.get(id);
		if (!entry) return;
		entries.delete(id);
		if (entry.timeoutId !== null) globalThis.clearTimeout(entry.timeoutId);
		entry.element.remove();
		entry.onClose?.(reason);
		if (entries.size === 0) {
			stack?.remove();
			stack = null;
		}
	}
	function ensureStack() {
		if (stack?.isConnected) return stack;
		stack = document.createElement("div");
		stack.className = "hwhx-toast-stack hwhx-build-lite";
		syncStackPosition();
		document.body.appendChild(stack);
		return stack;
	}
	function syncStackPosition() {
		if (!stack) return;
		stack.dataset.position = preferences.position;
		stack.style.inset = "auto";
		const bottom = preferences.position.startsWith("bottom");
		const left = preferences.position.endsWith("left");
		stack.style[bottom ? "bottom" : "top"] = "8px";
		stack.style[left ? "left" : "right"] = "8px";
		stack.style.flexDirection = bottom ? "column-reverse" : "column";
	}
	function buildToastElement(id, options) {
		const element = document.createElement("article");
		element.className = "hwhx-toast";
		element.dataset.tone = options.tone ?? "info";
		const content = document.createElement("div");
		content.className = "hwhx-toast__content";
		if (options.title) {
			const title = document.createElement("div");
			title.className = "hwhx-toast__title";
			title.textContent = options.title;
			content.appendChild(title);
		}
		if (options.text) {
			const text = document.createElement("div");
			text.className = "hwhx-toast__text";
			text.textContent = options.text;
			content.appendChild(text);
		}
		appendToastActions(content, id, options.actions);
		element.appendChild(content);
		if (options.closable !== false) {
			const close = document.createElement("button");
			close.type = "button";
			close.className = "hwhx-icon-button";
			close.textContent = "×";
			close.ariaLabel = options.closeLabel || "Закрыть";
			close.addEventListener("click", () => dismissNativeToast(id, "close"));
			element.appendChild(close);
		}
		return element;
	}
	function appendToastActions(container, toastId, actions) {
		if (!Array.isArray(actions) || actions.length === 0) return;
		const root = document.createElement("div");
		root.className = "hwhx-toast__actions";
		for (const action of actions) {
			if (!action?.id || !action.label) continue;
			const button = document.createElement(action.href ? "a" : "button");
			button.className = "hwhx-button hwhx-button--mini";
			button.textContent = action.label;
			button.dataset.tone = action.tone ?? "secondary";
			if (button instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
				button.href = String(action.href);
				button.target = "_blank";
				button.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
			} else button.type = "button";
			button.addEventListener("click", () => {
				try {
					Promise.resolve(action.onClick?.()).catch((error) => console.error("[hwhx] Ошибка действия уведомления:", error));
				} catch (error) {
					console.error("[hwhx] Ошибка действия уведомления:", error);
				}
				if (action.closeOnClick !== false) dismissNativeToast(toastId, "action");
			});
			root.appendChild(button);
		}
		if (root.childElementCount > 0) container.appendChild(root);
	}
	function trimOverflow() {
		while (entries.size > preferences.stackSize) {
			const oldestId = entries.keys().next().value;
			if (typeof oldestId !== "string") break;
			dismissNativeToast(oldestId, "overflow");
		}
	}

		toastSequence += 1;
		return `hwhx-toast-${Date.now()}-${toastSequence}`;
	}

	/**
	* Проверяет, доступен ли runtime расширения (HWHClasses, HWHFuncs, HWHData).
	* @param {string[]} [requiredKeys=["HWHClasses", "HWHFuncs", "HWHData"]]
	* @returns {boolean}
	*/
	function isHwhRuntimeReady(requiredKeys = [
		"HWHClasses",
		"HWHFuncs",
		"HWHData"
	], readyWhen) {
		const runtimeRoot = globalThis;
		if (!requiredKeys.every((key) => !!runtimeRoot[key])) return false;
		if (!readyWhen) return true;
		try {
			return readyWhen();
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	}
	/**
	* Пытается дождаться инициализации runtime расширения с ретраями через setTimeout.
	* @param {{attempt?: number, maxAttempts?: number, delayMs?: number, requiredKeys?: string[], retry?: Function, readyWhen?: Function, logPrefix?: string, scriptName?: string, showInstallNotice?: boolean}} [options]
	* @returns {boolean}
	*/
	function retryHwhRuntimeInitialization({ attempt = 0, maxAttempts = 120, delayMs = 500, requiredKeys = [
		"HWHClasses",
		"HWHFuncs",
		"HWHData"
	], retry, readyWhen, logPrefix = "[HWH]", scriptName = "", showInstallNotice = true } = {}) {
		const initAttempt = Number(attempt) || 0;
		if (isHwhRuntimeReady(requiredKeys, readyWhen)) return true;
		if (initAttempt < maxAttempts && typeof retry === "function") {
			globalThis.setTimeout(() => retry(initAttempt + 1), delayMs);
			return false;
		}
		console.log(`%c${logPrefix} Объект расширения не найден`, "color: red");
		if (showInstallNotice) showHeroWarsHelperInstallNotice({ scriptName });
		return false;
	}

	function safeAdd(x, y) {
		const lsw = (x & 65535) + (y & 65535);
		return (x >> 16) + (y >> 16) + (lsw >> 16) << 16 | lsw & 65535;
	}
	function bitRotateLeft(num, cnt) {
		return num << cnt | num >>> 32 - cnt;
	}
	function md5cmn(q, a, b, x, s, t) {
		return safeAdd(bitRotateLeft(safeAdd(safeAdd(a, q), safeAdd(x, t)), s), b);
	}
	function md5ff(a, b, c, d, x, s, t) {
		return md5cmn(b & c | ~b & d, a, b, x, s, t);
	}
	function md5gg(a, b, c, d, x, s, t) {
		return md5cmn(b & d | c & ~d, a, b, x, s, t);
	}
	function md5hh(a, b, c, d, x, s, t) {
		return md5cmn(b ^ c ^ d, a, b, x, s, t);
	}
	function md5ii(a, b, c, d, x, s, t) {
		return md5cmn(c ^ (b | ~d), a, b, x, s, t);
	}

	function binl2rstr(input) {
		let output = "";
		for (let i = 0; i < input.length * 32; i += 8) output += String.fromCharCode(input[i >> 5] >>> i % 32 & 255);
		return output;
	}
	function rstr2binl(input) {
		const output = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < input.length * 8; i += 8) output[i >> 5] |= (input.charCodeAt(i / 8) & 255) << i % 32;
		return output;
	}
	function rstr2hex(input) {
		const hexTab = "0123456789abcdef";
		let output = "";
		for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
			const x = input.charCodeAt(i);
			output += hexTab.charAt(x >>> 4 & 15) + hexTab.charAt(x & 15);
		}
		return output;
	}
	function str2rstrUTF8(input) {
		return unescape(encodeURIComponent(input));
	}
	/**
	* Вычисляет hex-строку MD5-хэша для переданной строки.
	*/
	function md5(string) {
		return rstr2hex(binl2rstr(binlMD5(rstr2binl(str2rstrUTF8(string)), string.length * 8)));
	}

	/**

	*/
	function computeGameSignature(headers, data) {
		let signature = `${headers["X-Request-Id"] ?? ""}:${headers["X-Auth-Token"] ?? ""}:${headers["X-Auth-Session-Id"] ?? ""}:${data}:LIBRARY-VERSION=1UNIQUE-SESSION-ID=${headers["X-Env-Unique-Session-Id"] ?? ""}`;
		if (headers["X-Env-Unique-Session-Uuid"]) signature += `UNIQUE-SESSION-UUID=${headers["X-Env-Unique-Session-Uuid"]}`;
		return md5(signature);
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/shared/game/network/game-interceptor.ts
	var session = null;
	var listeners = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
	var installed = false;
	var notified = false;
	/** Наибольший X-Request-Id сессии: свой и игры. Номер не откатывается назад. */
	var highestRequestId = 0;
	/** Метка собственного XHR: его заголовки не являются захватом сессии игры. */
	var OWN_GAME_REQUEST = Symbol.for("hwhx.ownGameRequest");
	/**
	* Заголовки, которые нельзя переносить в чужие запросы: флаг инициализации
	* сессии ставит только первый запрос игры, подпись считается заново для каждого тела.
	*/
	var NON_SESSION_HEADERS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["x-auth-session-init", "x-auth-signature"]);
	function sessionHeaders(headers) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(headers).filter(([name]) => !NON_SESSION_HEADERS.has(name.toLowerCase())));
	}
	function hasAuth(headers) {
		return Boolean(headers?.["X-Auth-Token"] ?? headers?.["x-auth-token"] ?? headers?.["X-Auth-Session-Id"] ?? headers?.["x-auth-session-id"]);
	}
	function trackRequestId(headers) {
		const id = Number(headers?.["X-Request-Id"] ?? headers?.["x-request-id"]);
		if (Number.isFinite(id)) highestRequestId = Math.max(highestRequestId, id);
	}
	/**
	* Готовность — только по живой сессии: перехваченный запрос игры или заголовки HWH (lastHeaders).
	*
	* NXFlashVars.auth_key сессией не является: это предсессионный ключ загрузчика.
	* Раньше по нему объявлялась готовность до первого запроса игры, сервер отвечал
	* «Unknown error», а после этого настоящий захват уже не будил ожидающих.
	* С соседними скриптами ошибка пряталась: они успевали заполнить lastHeaders.
	*/
	function isGameNetworkReady() {
		if (session !== null && Boolean(session.apiUrl) && hasAuth(session.headers)) return true;
		const root = globalThis;
		const lastHeaders = root.lastHeaders;
		const flashVars = root.NXFlashVars;
		const apiUrl = typeof root.apiUrl === "string" && root.apiUrl || (typeof flashVars?.rpc_url === "string" ? flashVars.rpc_url : "");
		if (lastHeaders && hasAuth(lastHeaders) && apiUrl) {
			session = {
				apiUrl,
				headers: sessionHeaders(lastHeaders)
			};
			trackRequestId(lastHeaders);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
	/**
	* Возвращает текущую захваченную сессию или null.
	*/
	function getCapturedGameSession() {
		if (!isGameNetworkReady() || !session) return null;
		const lastHeaders = globalThis.lastHeaders;
		if (lastHeaders && hasAuth(lastHeaders)) {
			session.headers = {
				...session.headers,
				...sessionHeaders(lastHeaders)
			};
			trackRequestId(lastHeaders);
		}
		return {
			apiUrl: session.apiUrl,
			headers: { ...session.headers }
		};
	}
	/**
	* Возвращает следующий request ID сессии. Счётчик монотонный: запрос игры с меньшим
	* номером, пришедший после нашего, не заставит повторно отправить уже использованный id.
	*/
	function allocateNextRequestId() {
		if (!session) throw new Error("Game network session is not ready yet.");
		const lastHeaders = globalThis.lastHeaders;
		trackRequestId(lastHeaders);
		trackRequestId(session.headers);
		const next = Math.max(1, highestRequestId) + 1;
		highestRequestId = next;
		if (lastHeaders) lastHeaders["X-Request-Id"] = next;
		session.headers["X-Request-Id"] = next;
		return next;
	}
	function notifyReady() {
		if (notified || !session || !isGameNetworkReady()) return;
		notified = true;
		for (const listener of listeners) try {
			listener(session.apiUrl, { ...session.headers });
		} catch (error) {
			console.error("[GameNetwork] Ошибка вызова listener:", error);
		}
	}
	/**
	* Регистрирует callback, который вызывается при готовности сессии.
	* Если сессия уже готова, вызывается немедленно.
	*/
	function onGameNetworkReady(listener) {
		if (isGameNetworkReady() && session) try {
			listener(session.apiUrl, { ...session.headers });
		} catch (error) {
			console.error("[GameNetwork] Ошибка в listener готовности:", error);
		}
		listeners.add(listener);
		return () => listeners.delete(listener);
	}
	/**
	* Устанавливает перехватчик XHR/fetch для извлечения API URL и заголовков аутентификации.
	* Безопасен для повторного вызова: перехват монтируется только один раз.
	*/
	function installGameNetworkInterceptor() {
		if (installed || typeof XMLHttpRequest === "undefined") return;
		installed = true;
		const originalOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
		const originalSetRequestHeader = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader;
		const originalSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
		const requestHeadersMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
		const requestUrlMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
		XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function gameNetworkOpen(method, url, ...rest) {
			const urlString = String(url);
			if (isGameApiUrl(urlString) && !this[OWN_GAME_REQUEST]) {
				requestUrlMap.set(this, urlString);
				requestHeadersMap.set(this, {});
			}
			return Reflect.apply(originalOpen, this, [
				method,
				url,
				...rest
			]);
		};
		XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = function gameNetworkSetHeader(name, value) {
			const headers = requestHeadersMap.get(this);
			if (headers) headers[name] = value;
			return Reflect.apply(originalSetRequestHeader, this, [name, value]);
		};
		XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function gameNetworkSend(body) {
			const url = requestUrlMap.get(this);
			const headers = requestHeadersMap.get(this);
			if (url && headers && Object.keys(headers).length > 0) updateCapturedSession(url, headers);
			return Reflect.apply(originalSend, this, [body]);
		};
		if (typeof globalThis.fetch === "function") {
			const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
			globalThis.fetch = Object.assign(function gameNetworkFetch(input, init) {
				try {
					const urlString = typeof input === "string" ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input.url;
					if (isGameApiUrl(urlString) && init?.headers && !Reflect.get(init, OWN_GAME_REQUEST)) {
						const headersRecord = {};
						if (init.headers instanceof Headers) init.headers.forEach((val, key) => {
							headersRecord[key] = val;
						});
						else if (Array.isArray(init.headers)) init.headers.forEach(([k, v]) => {
							headersRecord[k] = v;
						});
						else if (typeof init.headers === "object") Object.assign(headersRecord, init.headers);
						if (Object.keys(headersRecord).length > 0) updateCapturedSession(urlString, headersRecord);
					}
				} catch (error) {
					console.debug("[GameNetwork] Ошибка перехвата fetch:", error);
				}
				return Reflect.apply(originalFetch, this, [input, init]);
			}, originalFetch);
		}
	}
	function isGameApiUrl(url) {
		return url.includes("/api/") || url.includes(".nextersglobal.com/api") || /api\/($|\?)/.test(url);
	}
	function updateCapturedSession(url, headers) {
		if (!hasAuth(headers) && !hasAuth(session?.headers)) return;
		trackRequestId(headers);
		session = {
			apiUrl: url,
			headers: {
				...session?.headers,
				...sessionHeaders(headers)
			}
		};
		notifyReady();
	}

	//#region src/shared/game/network/game-caller.ts
	init_defineProperty();
	var DEFAULT_NETWORK_READY_TIMEOUT_MS = 15e3;
	var DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 3e4;
	var GameCaller = class GameCaller {
		constructor(calls) {
			_defineProperty(this, "calls", []);
			_defineProperty(this, "results", {});
			_defineProperty(this, "sideResults", {});
			if (calls) this.add(calls);
		}
		static setGlobalHook(event, callback) {
			if (event === "onError") this.globalHooks.onError = callback;
			else throw new Error(`Unknown hook event: ${event}`);
		}
		addCall(call) {
			const namedCall = typeof call === "string" ? {
				name: call,
				args: {}
			} : {
				name: call.name,
				args: call.args ?? {}
			};
			this.calls.push(namedCall);
			return this;
		}
		add(calls) {
			if (Array.isArray(calls)) for (const call of calls) this.addCall(call);
			else if (calls) this.addCall(calls);
			return this;
		}
		handleError(error) {
			const errorName = String(error.name ?? "Error");
			const description = String(error.description ?? "Unknown error");
			if (GameCaller.globalHooks.onError) {
				if (GameCaller.globalHooks.onError(error) === false) return;
			}
			if (error.call) throw new Error(`${errorName} in ${error.call.name}: ${description}\nArgs: ${JSON.stringify(error.call.args)}`);
			throw new Error(`Hero Wars API error: ${errorName} - ${description}`);
		}
		async send() {
			if (this.calls.length === 0) throw new Error("No calls to send.");
			await ensureGameNetworkSessionReady();
			const session = getCapturedGameSession();
			if (!session) throw new Error("Game network session is not available.");
			const identToNameMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			const callsWithIdent = this.calls.map((call, index) => {
				const ident = this.calls.length === 1 ? "body" : `group_${index}_body`;
				identToNameMap.set(ident, call.name);
				const callRecord = call;
				const existingContext = callRecord.context && typeof callRecord.context === "object" ? callRecord.context : {};
				return {
					...call,
					ident,
					context: {
						actionTs: Math.floor(performance.now()),
						...existingContext
					}
				};
			});
			const payload = JSON.stringify({ calls: callsWithIdent });
			const requestId = allocateNextRequestId();
			const headersToSend = {
				...session.headers,
				"X-Request-Id": requestId
			};
			headersToSend["X-Auth-Signature"] = computeGameSignature(headersToSend, payload);
			const response = await postGameRpc(session.apiUrl, headersToSend, payload);
			if (response.error) this.handleError(response.error);
			if (!Array.isArray(response.results)) throw new Error("Invalid Hero Wars API response: missing results array.");
			for (const entry of response.results) {
				const name = identToNameMap.get(entry.ident) ?? entry.ident;
				if (!this.results[name]) {
					this.results[name] = [];
					this.sideResults[name] = [];
				}
				this.results[name].push(entry.result.response);
				const side = {};
				for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(entry.result)) if (key !== "response") side[key] = value;
				this.sideResults[name].push(side);
			}
			return this;
		}
		result(name, forceArray) {
			let rawList;
			if (name) rawList = this.results[name] ?? [];
			else rawList = Object.values(this.results).flat();
			if (forceArray) return rawList;
			return rawList.length === 1 ? rawList[0] : rawList;
		}
		sideResult(name, forceArray) {
			let rawList;
			if (name) rawList = this.sideResults[name] ?? [];
			else rawList = Object.values(this.sideResults).flat();
			if (forceArray) return rawList;
			return rawList.length === 1 ? rawList[0] : rawList;
		}
		async execute(name) {
			await this.send();
			return this.result(name);
		}
		clear() {
			this.calls = [];
			this.results = {};
			this.sideResults = {};
			return this;
		}
		isEmpty() {
			return this.calls.length === 0 && Object.keys(this.results).length === 0;
		}
		static async send(calls) {
			return new GameCaller(calls).execute();
		}
	};
	_defineProperty(GameCaller, "globalHooks", { onError: null });
	function ensureGameNetworkSessionReady(timeoutMs = DEFAULT_NETWORK_READY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
		installGameNetworkInterceptor();
		if (isGameNetworkReady()) return Promise.resolve();
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let unsubscribe = null;
			let settled = false;
			const finish = (error) => {
				if (settled) return;
				settled = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				clearInterval(poll);
				unsubscribe?.();
				if (error) reject(error);
				else resolve();
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				finish(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error(`Hero Wars сетевая сессия не готова в течение ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1e3)}с: игра ещё не сделала ни одного запроса к серверу. Дождитесь загрузки города и повторите.`));
			}, timeoutMs);
			const poll = setInterval(() => {
				if (isGameNetworkReady()) finish();
			}, 250);
			unsubscribe = onGameNetworkReady(() => finish());
			if (settled) unsubscribe();
		});
	}
	function postGameRpc(url, headers, body, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
			Reflect.set(xhr, OWN_GAME_REQUEST, true);
			xhr.open("POST", url, true);
			xhr.responseType = "json";
			xhr.timeout = timeoutMs;
			for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(headers)) if (value !== void 0 && value !== null) xhr.setRequestHeader(key, String(value));
			xhr.addEventListener("timeout", () => {
				reject(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error(`RPC запрос к ${url} превысил таймаут ${timeoutMs}ms.`));
			}, { once: true });
			xhr.addEventListener("error", () => {
				reject(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error(`Сетевая ошибка при выполнении RPC к ${url}`));
			}, { once: true });
			xhr.addEventListener("load", () => {
				try {
					const responseData = typeof xhr.response === "string" ? JSON.parse(xhr.response) : xhr.response;
					if (responseData && typeof responseData === "object") resolve(responseData);
					else reject(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error(`Некорректный формат ответа RPC: ${String(xhr.response)}`));
				} catch (err) {
					reject(err);
				}
			}, { once: true });
			xhr.send(body);
		});
	}
	/**
	* Обеспечивает наличие глобального Caller: если внешнего нет (helper.js не запущен),
	* регистрирует наш GameCaller в globalThis.Caller.
	*/
	function ensureHeroWarsCaller(runtimeRoot = globalThis) {
		installGameNetworkInterceptor();
		const existing = runtimeRoot.Caller;
		if (typeof existing === "function" && typeof existing.send === "function") return existing;
		runtimeRoot.Caller = GameCaller;
		return GameCaller;
	}
