	var cachedTranslator = null;
	/**
	* Ищет игровой метод перевода без загрязнения Object.prototype.
	*/
	function resolveGameTranslator(runtimeRoot = globalThis) {
		if (cachedTranslator) return cachedTranslator;
		const cheats = runtimeRoot?.cheats;
		if (typeof cheats?.translate === "function") {
			cachedTranslator = (key) => {
				try {
					return cheats.translate(key);
				} catch {
					return key;
				}
			};
			return cachedTranslator;
		}
		const lang = (((runtimeRoot?.com)?.progrestar)?.common)?.lang;
		const registry = findHeroWarsClassRegistry(runtimeRoot);
		const translateClass = lang?.Translate ?? registry?.["com.progrestar.common.lang.Translate"] ?? registry?.["com.progrestar.common.lang.Translate_"];
		if (typeof translateClass?.translate === "function") {
			cachedTranslator = (key) => {
				try {
					return translateClass.translate(key);
				} catch {
					return key;
				}
			};
			return cachedTranslator;
		}
		return (key) => {
			const lazyTranslate = ((((globalThis?.com)?.progrestar)?.common)?.lang)?.Translate ?? findHeroWarsClassRegistry(runtimeRoot)?.["com.progrestar.common.lang.Translate"] ?? findHeroWarsClassRegistry(runtimeRoot)?.["com.progrestar.common.lang.Translate_"];
			if (typeof lazyTranslate?.translate === "function") {
				cachedTranslator = (k) => {
					try {
						return lazyTranslate.translate(k);
					} catch {
						return k;
					}
				};
				return cachedTranslator(key);
			}
			return key;
		};
	}

	/**
	* Легковесные утилиты создания DOM-элементов для чистого TypeScript UI.
	*/
	function el(tag, attrs, ...children) {
		const element = document.createElement(tag);
		if (attrs) for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
			if (value === null || value === void 0 || value === false) continue;
			if (key.startsWith("on") && typeof value === "function") {
				const eventName = key.slice(2).toLowerCase();
				element.addEventListener(eventName, value);
			} else if (key === "className" || key === "class") element.className = String(value);
			else if (key === "dataset" && typeof value === "object") Object.assign(element.dataset, value);
			else if (key === "style" && typeof value === "object") Object.assign(element.style, value);
			else if (key === "style" && typeof value === "string") element.setAttribute("style", value);
			else if (key === "html") element.innerHTML = String(value);
			else if (key === "text") element.textContent = String(value);
			else element.setAttribute(key, String(value));
		}
		for (const child of children) {
			if (child === null || child === void 0 || child === false) continue;
			if (child instanceof Node) element.appendChild(child);
			else element.appendChild(document.createTextNode(String(child)));
		}
		return element;
	}
	function clearChildren(element) {
		while (element.firstChild) element.removeChild(element.firstChild);
	}

	var injected = false;
	/**
	* Внедряет стили Battle Lab в head страницы один раз.
	*/
	function ensureBattleLabStyles() {
		if (injected || typeof document === "undefined") return;
		if (document.getElementById("hwhbattlelab-v3-style")) {
			injected = true;
			return;
		}
		const style = document.createElement("style");
		style.id = BATTLE_LAB_STYLE_ID;
		style.textContent = BATTLE_LAB_CSS;
		if (document.head) document.head.appendChild(style);
		else window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => document.head.appendChild(style));
		injected = true;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/store.ts
	init_defineProperty();
	var BattleLabStore = class {
		constructor(initialState) {
			_defineProperty(this, "state", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "listeners", /* @__PURE__ */ new Set());
			_defineProperty(this, "keyListeners", /* @__PURE__ */ new Map());
			_defineProperty(this, "pendingChanges", /* @__PURE__ */ new Set());
			_defineProperty(this, "notifyScheduled", false);
			_defineProperty(this, "clockRunning", void 0);
			this.state = initialState;
			this.clockRunning = initialState.runState === "running";
			if (this.clockRunning && !initialState.runStartedAt) initialState.runStartedAt = Date.now();
		}
		getState() {
			return this.state;
		}
		get(key) {
			return this.state[key];
		}
		set(key, value) {
			if (this.state[key] === value) return;
			this.state[key] = value;
			this.scheduleNotification(key);
		}
		notify(key) {
			this.scheduleNotification(key);
		}
		update(patch) {
			let hasChanges = false;
			for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch)) {
				const key = k;
				if (this.state[key] !== v) {
					this.state[key] = v;
					this.pendingChanges.add(key);
					hasChanges = true;
				}
			}
			if (hasChanges) this.triggerScheduled();
		}
		subscribe(listener) {
			this.listeners.add(listener);
			return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
		}
		subscribeKey(key, listener) {
			let set = this.keyListeners.get(key);
			if (!set) {
				set = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
				this.keyListeners.set(key, set);
			}
			set.add(listener);
			return () => {
				set?.delete(listener);
			};
		}
		scheduleNotification(key) {
			this.pendingChanges.add(key);
			this.triggerScheduled();
		}
		triggerScheduled() {
			const running = this.state.runState === "running";
			if (running !== this.clockRunning) {
				const now = Date.now();
				if (running) {
					this.state.runStartedAt = now;
					this.state.runElapsedMs = 0;
				} else if (this.state.runStartedAt !== void 0) this.state.runElapsedMs = Math.max(0, now - this.state.runStartedAt);
				this.clockRunning = running;
				this.pendingChanges.add("runElapsedMs");
			}
			if (this.notifyScheduled) return;
			this.notifyScheduled = true;
			queueMicrotask(() => {
				this.flush();
			});
		}
		flush() {
			this.notifyScheduled = false;
			if (this.pendingChanges.size === 0) return;
			const changedKeys = new Set(this.pendingChanges);
			this.pendingChanges.clear();
			for (const listener of this.listeners) try {
				listener(this.state, changedKeys);
			} catch (error) {
				console.error("[BattleLabStore] Ошибка в listener:", error);
			}
			for (const key of changedKeys) {
				const listeners = this.keyListeners.get(key);
				if (listeners) {
					const val = this.state[key];
					for (const l of listeners) try {
						l(val, this.state);
					} catch (error) {
						console.error(`[BattleLabStore] Ошибка в keyListener [${key}]:`, error);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	};

	init_helpers();
	function createTargetsPanel(store, callbacks) {
		const panel = el("aside", { className: "hwhbl-rail" });
		const titleCount = el("span", { text: "ЦЕЛИ" });
		const header = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-rail-header" }, titleCount, el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-icon-btn",
			title: "Обновить список целей",
			onClick: (e) => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				callbacks.onRefresh();
			}
		}, renderBlIcon("refresh", 14)));
		const listContainer = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-rail-list" });
		panel.appendChild(header);
		panel.appendChild(listContainer);
		function renderList() {
			const state = store.getState();
			const opponents = state.opponentsByMode[state.activeModeId] ?? [];
			const selectedId = state.selectedOpponentId;
			titleCount.textContent = `ЦЕЛИ (${opponents.length})`;
			clearChildren(listContainer);
			if (opponents.length === 0) {
				listContainer.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						padding: "24px 12px",
						textAlign: "center",
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
						fontSize: "12px"
					},
					text: state.runState === "loading" ? "Загрузка целей..." : "Нет доступных целей"
				}));
				return;
			}
			for (const opponent of opponents) {
				const isSelected = opponent.id === selectedId;
				const bestResult = state.bestResults.find((r) => r.opponentId === opponent.id);
				const isWon = bestResult !== void 0 && (bestResult.statistics?.winRate === 1 || bestResult.wins !== null && bestResult.calculationCount > 0 && bestResult.wins === bestResult.calculationCount);
				const firstUnit = opponent.teams?.[0]?.units?.[0];
				const avatar = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-target-avatar" });
				const attachAvatar = (url) => {
					avatar.appendChild(el("img", {
						src: url,
						alt: opponent.name ?? opponent.id
					}));
				};
				if (firstUnit && callbacks.getEntityIcon) {
					const res = callbacks.getEntityIcon(firstUnit.id, firstUnit.type);
					if (typeof res === "string" && res) attachAvatar(res);
					else if (res && typeof res.then === "function") res.then((url) => {
						if (url) attachAvatar(url);
					}).catch(() => {});
				}
				const totalPower = opponent.power ?? opponent.teams?.reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.units?.reduce((uSum, u) => uSum + (Number(u.power) || 0), 0) ?? 0), 0) ?? 0;
				const nameText = opponent.name || `Цель #${opponent.id.slice(0, 6)}`;
				const powerFormatted = totalPower > 0 ? formatCompactNumber(totalPower) : "—";
				const usedCount = opponent.modeId === "asgard" && opponent.usedHeroes ? opponent.usedHeroes.length : null;
				const metaRow = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-target-meta" }, el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-num",
					text: powerFormatted
				}), usedCount !== null ? el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--neutral",
					style: {
						fontSize: "10px",
						padding: "1px 5px"
					},
					text: `${usedCount} исп.`
				}) : false, isWon ? el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-target-win",
					text: "✓ Победа"
				}) : false);
				const info = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-target-info" }, el("div", {
					className: "hwhbl-target-name",
					text: nameText
				}), metaRow);
				const item = el("div", {
					className: `hwhbl-target-item ${isSelected ? "hwhbl-selected" : ""}`,
					onClick: () => callbacks.onSelectOpponent(opponent.id)
				}, avatar, info);
				listContainer.appendChild(item);
			}
		}
		store.subscribe((state, changedKeys) => {
			if (changedKeys.has("opponentsByMode") || changedKeys.has("activeModeId") || changedKeys.has("selectedOpponentId") || changedKeys.has("bestResults") || changedKeys.has("runState")) renderList();
		});
		renderList();
		return panel;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/unit-tooltip.ts
	init_helpers();
	/** Превращает модель и старые строковые callbacks в текст, без HTML и object coercion. */
	function formatBattleLabUnitTooltip(value) {
		if (typeof value === "string") return value.trim() || null;
		const model = asRecord$1(value);
		const legacy = [model.title, model.text].filter((item) => typeof item === "string");
		if (legacy.length) return legacy.join("\n").trim() || null;
		const lines = [];
		const entries = (key) => Array.isArray(model[key]) ? model[key].map(asRecord$1) : [];
		const detail = (item) => {
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(item.detail);
			const label = String(item.label ?? descriptor.label ?? "").trim();
			const metrics = Array.isArray(descriptor.metrics) ? descriptor.metrics.map(asRecord$1).map((metric) => `${metric.label}: ${metric.value}`) : [];
			const description = typeof descriptor.description === "string" ? descriptor.description.trim() : "";
			return [
				label,
				metrics.join(" · "),
				description
			].filter(Boolean).join(" — ");
		};
		const add = (heading, values) => {
			if (values.length) lines.push(`${heading}\n${values.join("\n")}`);
		};
		add("Характеристики", entries("stats").filter((stat) => typeof stat.label === "string" && Number.isFinite(stat.value)).map((stat) => `${stat.label}: ${Number(stat.value).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`));
		for (const [key, heading] of [
			["equipment", "Снаряжение"],
			["runes", "Символы"],
			["skins", "Облики"],
			["artifacts", "Артефакты"],
			["skills", "Навыки"]
		]) add(heading, entries(key).map(detail).filter(Boolean));
		if (model.gift) add("Дар стихий", [detail(asRecord$1(model.gift))].filter(Boolean));
		if (model.patronage) add("Покровительство", [detail({ detail: model.patronage })].filter(Boolean));
		add("Вознесение", entries("ascension").map((rank) => `Ранг ${rank.rank}: ${rank.unlocked}/${rank.total}`));
		if (typeof model.element === "string" && model.element) lines.push(`Стихия: ${model.element}`);
		return lines.join("\n\n") || null;
	}
	/** Удерживает фиксированный tooltip внутри viewport, предпочитая верх карточки. */
	function positionBattleLabTooltip(anchor, tooltip, viewport) {
		const margin = 8;
		const clamp = (value, max) => Math.max(margin, Math.min(value, max - margin));
		const top = anchor.top - tooltip.height - margin;
		return {
			left: clamp(anchor.left + (anchor.width - tooltip.width) / 2, viewport.width - tooltip.width),
			top: clamp(top >= margin ? top : anchor.bottom + margin, viewport.height - tooltip.height)
		};
	}
	var tooltipSequence = 0;
	/** DOM v3 не монтирует Vue tooltip layer: один делегированный слой на открытое окно. */
	function installBattleLabTooltips(root, options = {}) {
		const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
		tooltip.id = `hwhbl-unit-tooltip-${++tooltipSequence}`;
		tooltip.className = "hwhbl-root hwhbl-unit-tooltip";
		tooltip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
		Object.assign(tooltip.style, {
			position: "fixed",
			boxSizing: "border-box",
			zIndex: "100100",
			maxWidth: "min(380px, calc(100vw - 16px))",
			maxHeight: "calc(100vh - 16px)",
			overflow: "hidden",
			whiteSpace: "pre-line",
			overflowWrap: "anywhere",
			padding: "10px 12px",
			borderRadius: "8px",
			background: "var(--hwhbl-bg-dialog, #191b24)",
			color: "var(--hwhbl-text, #eee)",
			border: "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border, #66583f)",
			boxShadow: "0 8px 24px #0008",
			fontSize: "12px",
			fontFamily: "var(--hwhbl-font, system-ui, sans-serif)",
			lineHeight: "1.4",
			pointerEvents: "none",
			display: "none"
		});
		let current = null;
		let oldDescription = null;
		const hide = () => {
			if (current) if (oldDescription === null) current.removeAttribute("aria-describedby");
			else current.setAttribute("aria-describedby", oldDescription);
			current = null;
			tooltip.style.display = "none";
		};
		const show = (event) => {
			if (options.isEnabled?.() === false) {
				hide();
				return;
			}
			const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("[data-hwhx-native-title]") : null;
			if (!target || !root.contains(target)) {
				hide();
				return;
			}
			if (target === current) return;
			hide();
			const text = target.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title")?.trim();
			if (!text) return;
			current = target;
			oldDescription = target.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
			target.setAttribute("aria-describedby", [oldDescription, tooltip.id].filter(Boolean).join(" "));
			tooltip.textContent = text;
			if (!tooltip.isConnected) document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
			tooltip.style.display = "block";
			const position = positionBattleLabTooltip(target.getBoundingClientRect(), tooltip.getBoundingClientRect(), {
				width: window.innerWidth,
				height: window.innerHeight
			});
			tooltip.style.left = `${position.left}px`;
			tooltip.style.top = `${position.top}px`;
		};
		const leave = (event) => {
			const next = event.relatedTarget;
			if (next instanceof Node && current?.contains(next)) return;
			hide();
		};
		const escape = (event) => {
			if (event.key !== "Escape" || !current) return;
			hide();
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopImmediatePropagation();
		};
		root.addEventListener("pointerover", show);
		root.addEventListener("focusin", show);
		root.addEventListener("pointerout", leave);
		root.addEventListener("focusout", leave);
		root.addEventListener("pointerdown", hide);
		root.addEventListener("scroll", hide, true);
		document.addEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
		window.addEventListener("resize", hide);
		return () => {
			hide();
			tooltip.remove();
			root.removeEventListener("pointerover", show);
			root.removeEventListener("focusin", show);
			root.removeEventListener("pointerout", leave);
			root.removeEventListener("focusout", leave);
			root.removeEventListener("pointerdown", hide);
			root.removeEventListener("scroll", hide, true);
			document.removeEventListener("keydown", escape, true);
			window.removeEventListener("resize", hide);
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/views/unit-card.ts
	/** Игровые слои остаются независимыми: уровень и звёздность всегда берём из бойца. */
	function createUnitCard({ unit, getIcon, getRankFrame, getUnitDecoration, getTooltip, showLevel = true, showStars = true, size = 58, isUsed = false, favorPetId, favorPetName }) {
		if (!unit) return el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-unit hwhbl-unit-empty",
			style: {
				width: `${size}px`,
				height: `${size}px`
			},
			text: "+"
		});
		const rank = boundedInteger(unit.color ?? unit.rank, 1, 18, 1);
		const stars = boundedInteger(unit.star ?? unit.stars ?? unit.evolution, 0, 6, 0);
		const level = Number(unit.level);
		const unitKind = unit.type ?? (unit.id >= 6e3 && unit.id < 7e3 ? "pet" : "hero");
		const container = el("div", {
			className: `hwhbl-unit hwhbl-unit--${unitKind} hwhbl-unit--rank-${rank}${isUsed ? " hwhbl-unit--used" : ""}`,
			style: {
				width: `${size}px`,
				height: `${size}px`,
				fontSize: `${size}px`
			},
			"aria-label": `#${unit.id}${Number.isFinite(level) ? `, уровень ${level}` : ""}, звёзд: ${stars}`
		});
		const fallback = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-unit-fallback",
			text: unit.id >= 2e3 && unit.id < 3e3 ? "ОШ" : `${unitKind === "pet" ? "П" : ""}#${unit.id}`
		});
		container.appendChild(fallback);
		if (getIcon) resolveArtwork(getIcon(unit.id, unitKind), (url) => {
			appendArtwork(container, url, "hwhbl-unit-avatar", () => {
				fallback.style.display = "none";
			}, () => {
				fallback.style.display = "flex";
			});
		});
		const levelBadge = showLevel && Number.isFinite(level) && level > 0 ? el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-unit-level",
			text: String(Math.trunc(level))
		}) : null;
		if (levelBadge) container.appendChild(levelBadge);
		const starRow = showStars && stars > 0 ? el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-unit-stars",
			"aria-hidden": "true"
		}) : null;
		if (starRow) {
			starRow.appendChild(el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-unit-stars-fallback",
				text: String(stars)
			}));
			container.appendChild(starRow);
		}
		const attachFrame = (url) => {
			appendArtwork(container, url, "hwhbl-unit-frame", () => {
				container.style.borderColor = "transparent";
			}, () => {
				container.style.borderColor = "";
			});
		};
		if (getUnitDecoration) getUnitDecoration({
			...unit,
			color: rank,
			star: stars
		}, unitKind).then((art) => {
			if (art.background) appendArtwork(container, art.background, "hwhbl-unit-background");
			if (art.frame) attachFrame(art.frame);
			if (art.levelPlate && levelBadge) {
				const plate = appendArtwork(levelBadge, art.levelPlate, "hwhbl-unit-level-plate");
				plate.addEventListener("load", () => {
					levelBadge.className += " hwhbl-unit-level--game";
				});
				plate.addEventListener("error", () => {
					levelBadge.className = "hwhbl-unit-level";
				});
			}
			if (art.stars && starRow) appendArtwork(starRow, art.stars, art.absoluteStar ? "hwhbl-unit-absolute-star" : "hwhbl-unit-star").addEventListener("load", () => {
				starRow.querySelector(".hwhbl-unit-stars-fallback")?.remove();
				if (!art.absoluteStar) for (let index = 1; index < stars; index++) appendArtwork(starRow, art.stars, "hwhbl-unit-star");
			});
		}).catch((error) => console.warn("[Battle Lab] Оформление карточки недоступно.", error));
		else if (getRankFrame) resolveArtwork(getRankFrame(rank, unitKind, unit.id), attachFrame);
		if (favorPetId && favorPetId > 0) {
			const badge = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-unit-patron" });
			if (unitKind !== "hero") badge.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", `Покровитель: ${favorPetName || `питомец #${favorPetId}`}`);
			if (getIcon) resolveArtwork(getIcon(favorPetId, "pet"), (url) => appendArtwork(badge, url, "hwhbl-unit-patron-avatar"));
			container.appendChild(badge);
		}
		const patronSuffix = favorPetId && favorPetId > 0 ? `\nПокровитель: ${favorPetName || `питомец #${favorPetId}`}` : "";
		const tooltip = unitKind !== "hero" && getTooltip ? formatBattleLabUnitTooltip(getTooltip(unit, unitKind)) : null;
		if (unitKind !== "hero") container.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", (tooltip || `#${unit.id}\nУровень: ${Number.isFinite(level) ? level : "—"}\nЗвёзд: ${stars}${isUsed ? "\nУже использован в Асгарде" : ""}`) + patronSuffix);
		return container;
	}
	/** У отсутствующей звёздности нет неявной первой звезды. */
	function boundedInteger(value, min, max, fallback) {
		const number = Number(value);
		return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.trunc(number))) : fallback;
	}
	/** Изображения загружаются независимо; ошибка одного слоя не скрывает остальные. */
	function appendArtwork(target, url, className, onLoad, onError) {
		const image = el("img", {
			className,
			src: url,
			alt: "",
			draggable: "false"
		});
		if (onLoad) image.addEventListener("load", onLoad);
		image.addEventListener("error", () => {
			image.remove();
			onError?.();
		});
		target.appendChild(image);
		return image;
	}
	/** Совместимость с синхронными и ленивыми резолверами старых карточек. */
	function resolveArtwork(value, attach) {
		Promise.resolve(value).then((url) => {
			if (typeof url === "string" && url) attach(url);
		}).catch((error) => console.warn("[Battle Lab] Изображение карточки недоступно.", error));
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/views/unit-picker.ts
	/** Выбор у ячейки открывается в верхнем слое и не меняет прокрутку редактора. */
	function openUnitPicker(options) {
		let { units, selectedIds, disabledIds = [], getIcon, getRankFrame, onSelect, onClose, title = "Выберите героя", allowEmpty = false } = options;
		const overlay = el("div", {
			className: options.inline ? "hwhbl-unit-picker hwhbl-unit-picker-inline" : "hwhbl-root hwhbl-unit-picker hwhbl-overlay hwhbl-visible",
			style: options.inline ? {
				position: "relative",
				width: "100%"
			} : {
				position: "fixed",
				top: "0",
				left: "0",
				width: "100%",
				height: "100%",
				background: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)",
				zIndex: "100020",
				boxSizing: "border-box",
				display: "flex",
				alignItems: "center",
				justifyContent: "center"
			}
		});
		let disposeTooltips = installBattleLabTooltips(overlay, { isEnabled: () => options.isTooltipEnabled?.() !== false });
		let closed = false;
		const close = () => {
			if (closed) return;
			closed = true;
			disposeTooltips();
			document.removeEventListener("keydown", keyHandler, true);
			window.removeEventListener("resize", position);
			window.removeEventListener("scroll", position, true);
			overlay.remove();
		};
		const position = () => {
			if (!options.anchor) return;
			const rect = options.anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
			const width = Math.min(500, window.innerWidth - 24);
			const height = Math.min(360, window.innerHeight - 24);
			const top = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom - 12 >= height ? rect.bottom + 6 : Math.max(12, rect.top - height - 6);
			Object.assign(overlay.style, {
				position: "fixed",
				inset: "auto",
				margin: "0",
				padding: "0",
				border: "none",
				background: "transparent",
				zIndex: "100030",
				left: `${Math.max(12, Math.min(rect.left, window.innerWidth - width - 12))}px`,
				top: `${top}px`,
				width: `${width}px`,
				maxHeight: `${height}px`,
				overflow: "visible"
			});
		};
		if (options.anchor) {
			overlay.setAttribute("popover", "auto");
			position();
			window.addEventListener("resize", position);
			window.addEventListener("scroll", position, true);
			overlay.addEventListener("toggle", (event) => {
				if (event.newState === "closed" && !overlay.matches(":popover-open")) {
					close();
					onClose();
				}
			});
		}
		const keyHandler = (event) => {
			if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopImmediatePropagation();
			close();
			onClose();
		};
		document.addEventListener("keydown", keyHandler, true);
		const dialog = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-dialog",
			role: options.inline && !options.anchor ? "region" : "dialog",
			"aria-modal": options.inline ? void 0 : "true",
			"aria-label": title,
			style: {
				width: options.inline ? "100%" : "min(500px, 100%)",
				height: "auto",
				maxHeight: options.anchor ? "min(360px, calc(100vh - 24px))" : options.inline ? "320px" : "80%",
				display: "flex",
				flexDirection: "column",
				background: "var(--hwhbl-bg-dialog)",
				backdropFilter: "blur(24px)",
				border: "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border)",
				borderRadius: "8px",
				boxShadow: options.inline && !options.anchor ? "none" : "0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
				overflow: "hidden"
			}
		});
		const header = el("div", { style: {
			padding: "12px 16px",
			borderBottom: "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border)",
			display: "flex",
			justifyContent: "space-between",
			alignItems: "center",
			background: "var(--hwhbl-bg-subtle)"
		} });
		const titleEl = el("div", {
			text: title,
			style: {
				fontWeight: "bold",
				fontSize: "14px",
				color: "var(--hwhbl-text)"
			}
		});
		const closeBtn = el("button", {
			text: "✕",
			style: {
				background: "none",
				border: "none",
				color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
				cursor: "pointer",
				fontSize: "16px"
			},
			onClick: () => {
				close();
				onClose();
			}
		});
		header.appendChild(titleEl);
		header.appendChild(closeBtn);
		const grid = el("div", { style: {
			padding: "16px",
			display: "flex",
			flexWrap: "wrap",
			gap: "8px",
			overflowY: "auto",
			alignContent: "flex-start"
		} });
		if (allowEmpty) {
			const emptyCard = el("button", {
				type: "button",
				text: "Снять",
				className: "hwhbl-btn hwhbl-btn--secondary",
				style: {
					width: "60px",
					height: "60px",
					display: "flex",
					alignItems: "center",
					justifyContent: "center",
					border: "1px dashed var(--hwhbl-border)",
					borderRadius: "4px",
					cursor: "pointer",
					background: "var(--hwhbl-bg-subtle)",
					color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
					fontSize: "12px"
				},
				onClick: () => {
					close();
					onSelect(0);
				}
			});
			grid.appendChild(emptyCard);
		}
		const cards = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		/** Переиспользуем карточки, меняя только доступность и текущий выбор. */
		const renderCards = () => {
			const sorted = [...units].sort((a, b) => (b.power ?? 0) - (a.power ?? 0) || a.id - b.id);
			for (const card of cards.values()) card.hidden = true;
			for (const unit of sorted) {
				const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(unit.id);
				const isDisabled = disabledIds.includes(unit.id);
				const key = JSON.stringify([
					unit.id,
					unit.type,
					unit.color,
					unit.rank,
					unit.level,
					unit.star,
					unit.stars,
					unit.evolution
				]);
				let cardWrap = cards.get(key);
				if (!cardWrap) {
					const unitId = unit.id;
					cardWrap = el("button", {
						type: "button",
						"aria-label": `Выбрать #${unit.id}`,
						disabled: isDisabled,
						style: {
							background: "transparent",
							border: "none",
							padding: "0",
							cursor: isDisabled ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
							opacity: isDisabled ? "0.4" : "1",
							position: "relative"
						},
						onClick: () => {
							if (!cardWrap.disabled) {
								close();
								onSelect(unitId);
							}
						}
					});
					const unitCard = createUnitCard({
						unit,
						getIcon,
						getRankFrame,
						getTooltip: options.getUnitTooltip,
						getUnitDecoration: options.getUnitDecoration,
						size: 60
					});
					cardWrap.appendChild(unitCard);
					const unitTooltip = unitCard.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title");
					if (unitTooltip) cardWrap.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", unitTooltip);
					const check = el("div", {
						className: "hwhbl-picker-selected",
						text: "✓",
						style: {
							position: "absolute",
							top: "-4px",
							right: "-4px",
							background: "var(--hwhbl-accent)",
							color: "white",
							width: "20px",
							height: "20px",
							borderRadius: "50%",
							display: "flex",
							alignItems: "center",
							justifyContent: "center",
							fontSize: "12px",
							fontWeight: "bold",
							zIndex: "2"
						}
					});
					cardWrap.appendChild(check);
					cards.set(key, cardWrap);
				}
				cardWrap.hidden = false;
				cardWrap.disabled = isDisabled;
				cardWrap.style.opacity = isDisabled ? "0.4" : "1";
				cardWrap.style.cursor = isDisabled ? "not-allowed" : "pointer";
				cardWrap.querySelector(".hwhbl-picker-selected").style.display = isSelected ? "flex" : "none";
				grid.appendChild(cardWrap);
			}
			if (cards.size > 256) {
				for (const [key, card] of cards) if (card.hidden) {
					card.remove();
					cards.delete(key);
				}
			}
		};
		renderCards();
		dialog.appendChild(header);
		dialog.appendChild(grid);
		overlay.appendChild(dialog);
		overlay.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
			if (e.target === overlay) {
				close();
				onClose();
			}
		});
		return Object.assign(overlay, {
			dispose: close,
			/** Открывает тот же DOM для другого слота, не загружая графику заново. */
			reopen: (next) => {
				close();
				const resolversChanged = options.cacheKey !== next.cacheKey || getIcon !== next.getIcon || getRankFrame !== next.getRankFrame || options.getUnitDecoration !== next.getUnitDecoration || options.getUnitTooltip !== next.getUnitTooltip;
				options = next;
				({units, selectedIds, disabledIds = [], getIcon, getRankFrame, onSelect, onClose, title = "Выберите героя", allowEmpty = false} = next);
				if (resolversChanged) {
					for (const card of cards.values()) card.remove();
					cards.clear();
				}
				titleEl.textContent = title;
				dialog.setAttribute("aria-label", title);
				closed = false;
				disposeTooltips = installBattleLabTooltips(overlay, { isEnabled: () => options.isTooltipEnabled?.() !== false });
				renderCards();
				position();
				document.addEventListener("keydown", keyHandler, true);
				window.addEventListener("resize", position);
				window.addEventListener("scroll", position, true);
			}
		});
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/asgard-team-metrics.ts
	init_team_custom_actions();
	/** Старый результат не показывается во время нового запуска до появления лидера. */
	function readAsgardResultTeams(state, opponentId) {
		if (state.runState === "running") {
			const progress = state.runProgress;
			if (progress?.preview?.opponentId === opponentId) return progress.preview.teams;
			return progress?.variations.find((v) => v.id === state.selectedVariationId)?.teams ?? progress?.variations[0]?.teams ?? [];
		}
		const result = state.bestResults.find((item) => item.modeId === "asgard" && item.opponentId === opponentId);
		return result?.variations?.find((v) => v.id === state.selectedVariationId)?.teams ?? result?.teams ?? [];
	}
	/** Все ручные касты бойца остаются видимыми, включая несколько активаций. */
	function formatAsgardHeroTimings(actions, unitId) {
		const times = (actions ?? []).filter((action) => unitId >= 6e3 ? action.type === "teamCustom" && action.value === 2 : action.type === "cast" && action.unitId === unitId).map((action) => action.time).filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a, b) => a - b);
		return times.length ? times.map((time) => `${Number(time.toFixed(2))} с`).join(" · ") : "Авто";
	}
	/** Переключения формы остаются рядом с пачкой, отдельно от ульты питомца. */
	function formatAsgardTeamControls(actions) {
		return [["Автобой", (actions ?? []).filter((action) => action.type === "auto")], ["Форма Ош", (actions ?? []).filter((action) => action.type === "teamCustom" && action.value === 3)]].map(([label, entries]) => {
			const times = entries.map((action) => `${Number(action.time.toFixed(2))} с`);
			return times.length ? `${label}: ${times.join(" · ")}` : "";
		}).filter(Boolean).join(" | ");
	}
	/** Счётчик обновляется даже если лучший план остаётся автобоем. */
	function formatAsgardTeamProgress(progress) {
		if (!progress) return "";
		return `${progress.completed >= progress.total ? "Расчёты завершены" : progress.phase === "training" || progress.phase === "validation" ? "Проверка выбранного плана" : "Подбор таймингов"} · ${progress.completed} / ${progress.total}`;
	}
	/** Этап относится к конкретной пачке; отправленный урон не выдаётся за ответ сервера. */
	function formatAsgardAttackProgress(progress, now = Date.now(), helperConfirmation = false) {
		const end = progress.finishedAt ?? now;
		const clock = (ms) => {
			const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1e3));
			return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
		};
		const timer = progress.phaseStartedAt == null ? "" : ` · ${clock(end - progress.phaseStartedAt)}`;
		const total = progress.startedAt == null ? "" : ` · всего ${clock(end - progress.startedAt)}`;
		switch (progress.phase) {
			case "waiting": return "Ожидает очереди";
			case "starting": return `Старт боя${timer}${total}`;
			case "improving": return `Улучшение боя · ${progress.completed ?? 0} расчётов${timer}${total}`;
			case "waiting-submit": return `Ожидание завершения боя${timer} · до отправки ${clock(Math.ceil(((progress.submitAt ?? now) - now) / 1e3) * 1e3)}${total}`;
			case "sending": return `${helperConfirmation ? "Ожидает «Ок» в HeroWarsHelper" : "Отправка результата / ожидание ответа"}${timer}${total}`;
			case "done": return `Результат отправлен${total}`;
			case "skipped": return "Пропущена: герои уже использованы";
			case "error": return `Ошибка: ${progress.error ?? "Атака остановлена"}${total}`;
		}
	}
	var INSIGHT_SOURCES = {
		archetype: "мета-архетип босса",
		history: "уже била этого босса",
		screening: "найдена скринингом"
	};
	/** «Почему эта пачка»: источник, вклад таймингов и поправка по реальным боям. */
	function formatAsgardTeamInsight(insight) {
		if (!insight) return "";
		const compact = (value) => value >= 1e9 ? `${(value / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B` : value >= 1e6 ? `${(value / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : Math.round(value).toLocaleString("ru-RU");
		const parts = [`Почему: ${insight.sources.map((source) => INSIGHT_SOURCES[source]).join(", ")}`];
		if (insight.autoDamage !== null && insight.timedDamage !== null) parts.push(`авто ${compact(insight.autoDamage)} → тайминги ${compact(insight.timedDamage)} (×${(insight.timedDamage / Math.max(1, insight.autoDamage)).toFixed(1)})`);
		else if (insight.autoDamage !== null) parts.push(`авто ${compact(insight.autoDamage)}`);
		if (insight.observedDamage !== null) parts.push(`сервер ${compact(insight.observedDamage)}`);
		if (Math.abs(insight.calibration - 1) > .01) parts.push(`поправка прогноза ×${insight.calibration.toFixed(2)}`);
		return parts.join(" · ");
	}
	/** Сверка прогноза плана с уроном сервера: «прогноз 45.6M, факт +3%». */
	function formatAsgardForecastCheck(forecast, server) {
		if (!forecast || forecast <= 0 || server == null || !Number.isFinite(server)) return "";
		const delta = Math.round((server - forecast) / forecast * 100);
		const sign = delta > 0 ? "+" : delta < 0 ? "−" : "±";
		return `прогноз ${forecast >= 1e6 ? `${(forecast / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : Math.round(forecast).toLocaleString("ru-RU")}, факт ${sign}${Math.abs(delta)}%`;
	}
	/** «надёжность 72%»: средний бой в процентах от пика; без данных — пусто. */
	function formatAsgardReliability(reliability) {
		if (reliability == null || !Number.isFinite(reliability) || reliability <= 0) return "";
		return `надёжность ${Math.round(Math.min(1, reliability) * 100)}%`;
	}

	/** Подставляет величину купленного усиления в игровой шаблон без повторного суффикса. */
	function formatAsgardBuffDescription(label, value) {
		return label.includes("%param1%") ? label.split("%param1%").join(String(value)) : `${label}: ${value}`;
	}
	/** Читает личные счётчики рейда; очки гильдии и заработанные очки не являются балансом магазина. */
	function resolveBattleLabAsgardSummary(opponent, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		if (!opponent || opponent.modeId !== "asgard") return null;
		const context = asRecord$1(opponent.context);
		const root = asRecord$1(context.__battleLabRoot);
		const boss = asRecord$1(root.boss ?? context);
		const bossUnit = opponent.teams.flatMap((team) => team.units).find((unit) => unit.type !== "pet") ?? null;
		const state = firstBossState(boss);
		const stateUnit = firstUnitRecord(state);
		const stats = asRecord$1(root.stats);
		const userStats = asRecord$1(root.userStats);
		const currentHp = firstFiniteMetric(boss.currentHp, boss.currentHealth, boss.hp, root.bossHp, root.currentBossHp, stats.bossHp, stats.currentBossHp, state.currentHp, state.hp, stateUnit.currentHp, stateUnit.hp, bossUnit?.hp);
		const maxHp = firstFiniteMetric(boss.maxHp, boss.maxHealth, root.bossMaxHp, stats.bossMaxHp, state.maxHp, asRecord$1(state.state).maxHp, stateUnit.maxHp, asRecord$1(stateUnit.state).maxHp, bossUnit?.maxHp);
		const buffLibrary = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.adventure).buff);
		const buffsById = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const buff of [...normalizeAsgardBuffCollection(stats.clanBuff), ...normalizeAsgardBuffCollection(root.buffs)]) {
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(buffLibrary[String(buff.id)]);
			const localeKey = String(descriptor.localeId ?? descriptor.locale_id ?? "").trim();
			const translated = localeKey ? String(translateGame(localeKey) ?? "").trim() : "";
			const label = (translated && translated !== localeKey ? translated : "") || String(descriptor.label ?? descriptor.name ?? `#${buff.id}`);
			const numericValue = Number(buff.value);
			buffsById.set(buff.id, {
				id: buff.id,
				value: Number.isFinite(numericValue) ? numericValue : String(buff.value),
				label,
				texture: String(descriptor.assetTexture_small ?? descriptor.assetTexture ?? "").trim()
			});
		}
		return {
			bossId: positiveInteger(boss.id ?? opponent.externalId),
			level: nullablePositiveMetric(boss.level ?? bossUnit?.level),
			currentHp,
			maxHp,
			bossUnit,
			damage: firstFiniteMetric(userStats.damage),
			coins: firstFiniteMetric(root.coins),
			attemptsLeft: firstFiniteMetric(root.bossAttempts),
			buffs: [...buffsById.values()]
		};
	}
	function firstBossState(boss) {
		const team = asRecord$1((Array.isArray(boss.teams) ? boss.teams : Object.values(asRecord$1(boss.teams)))[0]);
		return asRecord$1((Array.isArray(team.states) ? team.states : Object.values(asRecord$1(team.states)))[0] ?? team);
	}
	function firstUnitRecord(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value.units ?? value.heroes ?? value);
		return asRecord$1(Object.values(source)[0]);
	}
	function firstFiniteMetric(...values) {
		for (const value of values) {
			if (value === null || value === void 0 || value === "") continue;
			const parsed = Number(value);
			if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0) return parsed;
		}
		return null;
	}
	function nullablePositiveMetric(value) {
		const parsed = finiteNumber$1(value, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
	}

	/** Путь к значку усиления Асгарда в атласе приключений. */
	function asgardBuffTextureReference(texture) {
		return texture.includes(":") ? texture : `js/adventure/adventure_buff_icons${texture.endsWith("_54") ? "_small" : ""}.rsx:${texture}`;
	}
	/** При недоступном ресурсе сохраняет смысл значка; ошибки резолвера не ломают всю карточку. */
	function appendIcon(parent, source, size, fallbackName) {
		const fallback = renderBlIcon(fallbackName, size);
		fallback.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
		parent.appendChild(fallback);
		Promise.resolve(source).then((url) => {
			if (typeof url !== "string" || !url) return;
			const image = el("img", {
				src: url,
				alt: "",
				width: size,
				height: size,
				style: {
					objectFit: "contain",
					display: "block",
					flexShrink: "0"
				},
				onLoad: () => {
					fallback.remove();
					image.hidden = false;
				},
				onError: () => {
					image.remove();
				}
			});
			image.hidden = true;
			parent.insertBefore(image, fallback);
		}).catch((error) => console.warn("[Battle Lab] Значок сводки Асгарда недоступен.", error));
	}

	/** Пока атлас грузится, плитку узнают по первым буквам; картинка заменяет их без мигания. */
	function appendBuffIcon(parent, source, label) {
		const fallback = el("span", {
			className: "hwhbl-buff-tile__fallback",
			text: label.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
			"aria-hidden": "true"
		});
		parent.appendChild(fallback);
		Promise.resolve(source).then((url) => {
			if (typeof url !== "string" || !url) return;
			const image = el("img", {
				src: url,
				alt: "",
				width: 40,
				height: 40,
				onLoad: () => fallback.remove(),
				onError: () => image.remove()
			});
			parent.insertBefore(image, fallback);
		}).catch(() => void 0);
	}
	function renderBadges(badges, getTextureIcon) {
		const row = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-buff-badges" });
		for (const badge of badges) {
			const tile = el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-buff-tile hwhbl-buff-tile--static",
				"data-hwhx-native-title": badge.name,
				"aria-label": `${badge.name} ${badge.count}`
			});
			appendBuffIcon(tile, badge.texture ? getTextureIcon?.(asgardBuffTextureReference(badge.texture)) : null, badge.name);
			tile.appendChild(el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-buff-tile__count hwhbl-num",
				text: badge.count
			}));
			row.appendChild(tile);
		}
		return row;
	}
	/** Уже купленные в игре баффы недели из `clanRaid_getInfo.buffs`. */
	function readBoughtBadges(opponent, library) {
		const descriptors = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(library.adventure).buff);
		return normalizeAsgardBuffCollection(asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot).buffs).map((buff) => {
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(descriptors[String(buff.id)]);
			const effect = String(asRecord$1(descriptor.effect).effect ?? "");
			return {
				name: asgardBuffName(buff.id, effect || `#${buff.id}`),
				texture: String(descriptor.assetTexture_small ?? descriptor.assetTexture ?? ""),
				count: String(buff.value)
			};
		});
	}
	function slotBadges(counts, catalog) {
		return Object.entries(counts).filter(([, count]) => count > 0).map(([slotId, count]) => {
			const buff = catalog.find((item) => item.slotId === slotId);
			return {
				name: buff?.name ?? slotId,
				texture: buff?.texture ?? "",
				count: `×${count}`
			};
		});
	}
	function pickCounts(slots, counts) {
		return Object.fromEntries(slots.map((slot) => [slot, counts[slot] ?? 0]));
	}
	/**
	* Рекомендация автоподбора баффов: что уже куплено, что докупить, кому из
	* пачек каждый бафф помогает или мешает и в каком порядке покупать и бить.
	*/
	function renderAsgardBuffRecommendation(options) {
		const { plan, catalog, getTextureIcon } = options;
		const root = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-asgard-buff-recommendation" });
		const bought = readBoughtBadges(options.opponent, options.library);
		root.appendChild(el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
			text: "Уже куплено:"
		}));
		root.appendChild(bought.length ? renderBadges(bought, getTextureIcon) : el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
			text: "—"
		}));
		if (!plan) return root;
		const extra = slotBadges(plan.counts, catalog);
		root.appendChild(el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
			text: extra.length ? `Докупить (очков: ${plan.coins}, золота: ${plan.gold.toLocaleString("ru-RU")}):` : "Докупать ничего не нужно."
		}));
		if (extra.length) root.appendChild(renderBadges(extra, getTextureIcon));
		for (const effect of plan.teamEffects ?? []) {
			if (!effect.helps.length && !effect.hurts.length) continue;
			const line = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-buff-effect" });
			line.appendChild(el("span", { text: options.teamLabel(effect.unitIds) }));
			for (const [title, slots] of [["помогают", effect.helps], ["мешают", effect.hurts]]) {
				if (!slots.length) continue;
				line.appendChild(el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
					text: title
				}));
				line.appendChild(renderBadges(slotBadges(pickCounts(slots, plan.counts), catalog), getTextureIcon));
			}
			root.appendChild(line);
		}
		const schedule = plan.schedule ?? [];
		if (schedule.length > 1) {
			root.appendChild(el("div", {
				className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
				text: "Порядок:"
			}));
			const list = el("ol", { className: "hwhbl-buff-schedule" });
			for (const step of schedule) {
				const item = el("li");
				if (step.kind === "buy") {
					item.appendChild(el("span", { text: "Купить" }));
					item.appendChild(renderBadges(slotBadges(step.counts, catalog), getTextureIcon));
				} else item.appendChild(el("span", { text: `Атаковать: ${step.teams.map((ids) => options.teamLabel(ids)).join(", ")}` }));
				list.appendChild(item);
			}
			root.appendChild(list);
		}
		root.appendChild(el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
			text: `Проверено наборов: ${plan.tested}${plan.exhaustive === false ? " (поиск в пределах бюджета)" : ""}. Покупку выполняешь в игре.`
		}));
		return root;
	}

		};
		const saveSetup = (newSetup) => {
			const st = store.getState();
			if (st.runState === "running" || st.attackState === "attacking" || st.attackState === "checking") return;
			closePicker();
			const updated = {

		let helperPopup = null;

			const currentOpponent = st.opponentsByMode.asgard?.find((item) => item.id === opponent.id) ?? opponent;
			const unavailableHeroIds = readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(currentOpponent, st.asgardAttackProgress);
			const progress = st.runProgress;
			const { displayed, rowResults } = projectAsgardResultRows(currentSetup, readAsgardResultTeams(st, opponent.id), progress?.kind === "training");
			const attackProgress = st.runState !== "running" && st.asgardAttackProgress?.opponentId === opponent.id ? st.asgardAttackProgress.teams : void 0;
			const ticking = attackProgress?.some((team) => team.phaseStartedAt != null && ![
				"waiting",
				"done",
				"skipped",
				"error"
			].includes(team.phase));
			if (ticking && attackTimer == null) attackTimer = setInterval(() => {
				renderContent(store.getState().planningSetups?.[planningKey] ?? setup);
			}, 1e3);
			else if (!ticking && attackTimer != null) {
				clearInterval(attackTimer);
				attackTimer = void 0;
			}
			const confirmation = markHelperConfirmation(attackProgress, helperPopup);
			helperPopup = confirmation.popup;
			const currentRoster = st.planningRoster;
			const busy = st.runState === "running" || st.attackState === "attacking" || st.attackState === "checking";
			const selection = {
				indices: st.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
					0,
					1,
					2,
					3,
					4
				],
				usedHeroIds: unavailableHeroIds,
				busy
			};
			const key = JSON.stringify([
				displayed,
				busy,
				loadingError,
				unavailableHeroIds,
				st.bestResults.find((item) => item.opponentId === opponent.id)?.asgardBuffPlan
			]);
			if (key === renderedKey && currentRoster === renderedRoster) {
				updateTeamMetrics(content, rowResults, st.runState === "running" ? progress : void 0, displayed.teams, attackProgress, confirmation.active, selection);
				return;
			}
			renderedKey = key;
			renderedRoster = currentRoster;
			closePicker();
			clearChildren(content);
			if (!currentRoster) {
				renderRosterPending(content, loadingError, () => void loadRoster());
				return;
			}
			const editingDisabled = busy;
			content.appendChild(renderBuffsSection(currentSetup, currentOpponent, {
				...options,
				editingDisabled
			}, saveSetup, st.bestResults.find((item) => item.opponentId === opponent.id)?.asgardBuffPlan));
			content.appendChild(renderTeamsSection(displayed, currentRoster, {
				...options,
				openPicker,
				editingDisabled,
				unavailableHeroIds,
				onToggleTeamSelect: options.onToggleTeamSelect ?? ((index) => store.update({ selectedTeamIndices: toggleAsgardTeamIndex(store.getState().selectedTeamIndices, index) })),
				isTooltipEnabled: () => store.getState().settings?.tooltipsEnabled !== false
			}, saveSetup));
			updateTeamMetrics(content, rowResults, st.runState === "running" ? progress : void 0, displayed.teams, attackProgress, confirmation.active, selection);
		};
		const unsubscribe = store.subscribe((st, changedKeys) => {
			if (changedKeys.has("planningRoster") || changedKeys.has("planningSetups") || changedKeys.has("runProgress") || changedKeys.has("bestResults") || changedKeys.has("selectedVariationId") || changedKeys.has("runState") || changedKeys.has("attackState") || changedKeys.has("asgardAttackProgress") || changedKeys.has("selectedTeamIndices") || changedKeys.has("opponentsByMode")) renderContent(st.planningSetups?.[planningKey] ?? setup);
		});
		drawer.appendChild(content);
		drawer.appendChild(pickerHost);
		renderContent(setup);
		/** Подписка создаётся до запроса: синхронный и отложенный ростер обновляют то же окно. */
		async function loadRoster() {
			loadingError = "";
			renderContent(store.getState().planningSetups?.[planningKey] ?? setup);
			try {
				if (!options.loadRoster) throw new Error("Загрузка ростера недоступна");
				await options.loadRoster();
				if (!store.getState().planningRoster) throw new Error("Список героев не получен");
			} catch (error) {
				loadingError = `Не удалось загрузить героев: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`;
				console.error("[Battle Lab] Ошибка загрузки ростера:", error);
			}
			renderContent(store.getState().planningSetups?.[planningKey] ?? setup);
		}
		if (!state.planningRoster) loadRoster();
		return Object.assign(drawer, { dispose: () => {
			disposed = true;
			if (attackTimer != null) clearInterval(attackTimer);
			helperPopup?.removeAttribute("data-hwhbl-attack-confirmation");
			closePicker();
			picker = null;
			unsubscribe();
		} });
	}
	function createSlotEl(unitId, pool, typeLabel, size, usedSet, onSelect, options, favorPetId, favorPetName, displayUnits) {
		const displayUnitId = unitId;
		let unitTooltip = null;
		const slotWrap = el("button", {
			type: "button",
			disabled: options.editingDisabled,
			style: {
				position: "relative",
				width: `${size}px`,
				height: `${size}px`,
				border: displayUnitId ? "none" : "1px dashed var(--hwhbl-border)",
				borderRadius: "4px",
				cursor: "pointer",
				display: "flex",
				alignItems: "center",
				justifyContent: "center",
				fontSize: "12px",
				color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
				padding: "0",
				background: "transparent"
			},
			onClick: () => {
				if (options.editingDisabled) return;
				const pickerOptions = {
					cacheKey: readEditorLibrary(options),
					inline: options.embedded,
					anchor: options.embedded ? slotWrap : void 0,
					units: typeof pool === "function" ? pool() : pool,
					selectedIds: unitId ? [unitId] : [],
					disabledIds: [...Array.from(usedSet).filter((id) => id !== unitId), ...typeLabel === "героя" ? options.unavailableHeroIds ?? [] : []],
					getIcon: options.getIcon,
					getRankFrame: options.getRankFrame,
					getUnitTooltip: options.getUnitTooltip,
					getUnitDecoration: options.getUnitDecoration,
					isTooltipEnabled: options.isTooltipEnabled,
					allowEmpty: true,
					title: `Выберите ${typeLabel}`,
					onSelect,
					onClose: () => {}
				};
				if (options.openPicker) options.openPicker(pickerOptions);
				else document.body.appendChild(openUnitPicker(pickerOptions));
			}
		});
		if (displayUnitId) {
			const unitCard = createUnitCard({
				unit: (displayUnits ?? (typeof pool === "function" ? pool() : pool)).find((u) => u.id === displayUnitId) || {
					id: displayUnitId,
					type: typeLabel === "героя" ? "hero" : "pet",
					color: 1,
					star: 1,
					level: 1
				},
				getIcon: options.getIcon,
				getRankFrame: options.getRankFrame,
				size,
				getTooltip: options.getUnitTooltip,
				getUnitDecoration: options.getUnitDecoration,
				favorPetId,
				favorPetName
			});
			slotWrap.appendChild(unitCard);
			unitTooltip = unitCard.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title");
			const name = options.getEntityLabel?.(displayUnitId, typeLabel === "питомца" ? "pet" : "hero") || `#${displayUnitId}`;
			slotWrap.setAttribute("aria-label", `${name} (нажмите для смены)`);
			if (typeLabel === "питомца") slotWrap.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", name);
		} else {
			slotWrap.textContent = typeLabel === "питомца" ? "Авто" : "+";
			slotWrap.setAttribute("aria-label", typeLabel === "питомца" ? "Автоподбор питомца (нажмите для выбора)" : "Выбрать героя");
		}
		slotWrap.setAttribute("aria-label", slotWrap.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title") || `Выберите ${typeLabel}`);
		if (unitTooltip && typeLabel === "питомца") slotWrap.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", `${slotWrap.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title")}\n\n${unitTooltip}`);
		return slotWrap;
	}
	/**
	* Пачки результата поверх ручных строк. Проекция не записывается в
	* planningSetups: промежуточный лидер не становится ручной пачкой.
	*/
	function projectAsgardResultRows(setup, liveTeams, training) {
		const rowResults = Array(5);
		const displayed = {
			...setup,
			teams: setup.teams.map((team) => [...team]),
			teamPetSelections: [...setup.teamPetSelections],
			favorSelections: [...setup.favorSelections ?? []]
		};
		for (const [index, team] of liveTeams.entries()) {
			const fixedRow = setup.teams.findIndex((ids) => ids.length === 5 && ids.every((id) => team.unitIds.includes(id)));
			const row = fixedRow >= 0 ? fixedRow : training ? -1 : index;
			if (row < 0 || row >= 5) continue;
			const fixed = setup.teams[row] ?? [];
			if (fixed.some((id) => !team.unitIds.includes(id))) continue;
			displayed.teams[row] = [...fixed, ...team.unitIds.filter((id) => !fixed.includes(id))];
			displayed.teamPetSelections[row] = team.teamPetId ?? null;
			displayed.favorSelections[row] = team.favor;
			rowResults[row] = team;
		}
		return {
			displayed,
			rowResults
		};
	}
	/**
	* Старый Helper блокирует endBossBattle своим подтверждением под нашей
	* модалкой: подсвечиваем его, только если урон в окне совпал с отправкой.
	*/
	function markHelperConfirmation(attackProgress, previous) {
		const popup = document.querySelector?.(".PopUp_back") ?? null;
		const sending = attackProgress?.find((team) => team.phase === "sending");
		const popupDamage = popup?.querySelector(".PopUp_msgText")?.textContent?.replace(/\D/g, "");
		const active = Boolean(sending?.damage != null && popupDamage === String(sending.damage));
		if (previous && (!active || previous !== popup)) previous.removeAttribute("data-hwhbl-attack-confirmation");
		if (!active || !popup) return {
			active,
			popup: null
		};
		popup.setAttribute("data-hwhbl-attack-confirmation", "true");
		return {
			active,
			popup
		};
	}
	function renderRosterPending(content, loadingError, retry) {
		content.appendChild(el("div", {
			role: loadingError ? "alert" : "status",
			text: loadingError || "Загрузка героев..."
		}));
		if (loadingError) content.appendChild(el("button", {
			type: "button",
			text: "Повторить загрузку",
			onClick: retry
		}));
	}
	function renderBuffsSection(currentSetup, opponent, options, saveSetup, plan) {
		const buffsSection = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-asgard-buffs" });
		buffsSection.appendChild(el("div", {
			text: "Усиления (Баффы)",
			style: {
				fontWeight: "bold",
				marginBottom: "8px"
			}
		}));
		const selectMode = (mode) => {
			if (mode === currentSetup.asgardBuffMode) return;
			saveSetup({
				asgardBuffMode: mode,
				...mode === "auto" && currentSetup.coinBudget === 0 ? { coinBudget: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot).coins) || 0)) } : {}
			});
		};
		const modes = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-buff-modes",
			role: "radiogroup",
			"aria-label": "Режим усилений Асгарда"
		});
		for (const [mode, text, hint] of [
			[
				"current",
				"Текущие",
				"Только уже купленные в игре усиления"
			],
			[
				"manual",
				"Ручные",
				"Выбрать покупки вручную по значкам"
			],
			[
				"auto",
				"Автоподбор",
				"Подобрать покупки по урону в пределах бюджета"
			]
		]) {
			const active = currentSetup.asgardBuffMode === mode;
			modes.appendChild(el("button", {
				type: "button",
				role: "radio",
				text,
				className: `hwhbl-btn ${active ? "hwhbl-btn--primary" : "hwhbl-btn--secondary"}`,
				"aria-checked": String(active),
				"data-hwhx-native-title": hint,
				disabled: options.editingDisabled,
				onClick: () => selectMode(mode)
			}));
		}
		buffsSection.appendChild(modes);
		if (currentSetup.asgardBuffMode === "auto") {
			const coins = Number(asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabRoot).coins);
			const budget = el("label", { className: "hwhbl-budget-group" });
			budget.appendChild(el("span", { text: "Очков на усиления:" }));
			budget.appendChild(el("input", {
				type: "number",
				min: "0",
				step: "1",
				className: "hwhbl-input-number",
				"aria-label": "Бюджет очков на усиления",
				value: String(currentSetup.coinBudget),
				disabled: options.editingDisabled,
				onChange: (event) => {
					const value = Number(event.target.value);
					if (Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0) saveSetup({ coinBudget: value });
				}
			}));
			buffsSection.appendChild(budget);
			const goldBudget = el("label", { className: "hwhbl-budget-group" });
			goldBudget.appendChild(el("span", { text: "Золота на усиления:" }));
			goldBudget.appendChild(el("input", {
				type: "number",
				min: "0",
				step: "1",
				className: "hwhbl-input-number",
				"aria-label": "Бюджет золота на усиления",
				value: String(currentSetup.goldBudget),
				disabled: options.editingDisabled,
				onChange: (event) => {
					const value = Number(event.target.value);
					if (Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0) saveSetup({ goldBudget: value });
				}
			}));
			buffsSection.appendChild(goldBudget);
			buffsSection.appendChild(el("div", {
				className: "hwhbl-label-hint",
				text: `Доступно: ${Number.isFinite(coins) ? coins : "неизвестно"}. Подбор сравнивает урон на выбранных пачках; покупку выполняешь в игре.`
			}));
			buffsSection.appendChild(renderAsgardBuffRecommendation({
				opponent,
				library: readEditorLibrary(options),
				catalog: readAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, readEditorLibrary(options), options.translate ?? ((key) => key)),
				plan,
				teamLabel: (unitIds) => {
					const row = currentSetup.teams.findIndex((ids) => ids.length === unitIds.length && ids.every((id) => unitIds.includes(id)));
					return row >= 0 ? `пачка ${row + 1}` : unitIds.map((id) => options.getEntityLabel?.(id, "hero") ?? `#${id}`).join(", ");
				},
				getTextureIcon: options.getTextureIcon
			}));
		}
		if (currentSetup.asgardBuffMode === "manual" && options.gameLibrary) {
			const buffs = readAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, readEditorLibrary(options), options.translate || ((k) => k));
			const buffsGrid = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-buff-grid" });
			const setCount = (slotId, count) => saveSetup({ asgardBuffCounts: {
				...currentSetup.asgardBuffCounts,
				[slotId]: count
			} });
			for (const buff of buffs) {
				const count = currentSetup.asgardBuffCounts?.[buff.slotId] ?? 0;
				const label = buff.label || `Усиление ${buff.buffId}`;
				const cost = [buff.coinCost ? `${buff.coinCost} очков` : "", buff.goldCost ? `${buff.goldCost.toLocaleString("ru-RU")} золота` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
				const tooltip = [
					buff.name,
					label.startsWith("#") ? "" : formatAsgardBuffDescription(label, buff.value),
					`Куплено в плане: ${count} из ${buff.remaining}`,
					cost ? `Цена за шт.: ${cost}` : "",
					"Клик — добавить, правый клик — убрать"
				].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
				const tile = el("button", {
					type: "button",
					className: `hwhbl-buff-tile${count > 0 ? " hwhbl-buff-tile--active" : ""}`,
					"aria-label": `${buff.name}: ${count} из ${buff.remaining}`,
					"data-hwhx-native-title": tooltip,
					disabled: options.editingDisabled || buff.remaining <= 0,
					onClick: () => {
						if (count < buff.remaining) setCount(buff.slotId, count + 1);
					},
					onContextmenu: (event) => {
						event.preventDefault();
						if (count > 0) setCount(buff.slotId, count - 1);
					}
				});
				appendBuffIcon(tile, buff.texture ? options.getTextureIcon?.(asgardBuffTextureReference(buff.texture)) : null, label);
				tile.appendChild(el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-buff-tile__count hwhbl-num",
					text: `${count}/${buff.remaining}`
				}));
				const cell = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-buff-cell" });
				cell.appendChild(tile);
				const steps = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-buff-steps" });
				steps.appendChild(el("button", {
					type: "button",
					text: "−",
					className: "hwhbl-btn hwhbl-btn--secondary",
					"aria-label": `Уменьшить: ${label}`,
					disabled: options.editingDisabled || count <= 0,
					onClick: () => {
						if (count > 0) setCount(buff.slotId, count - 1);
					}
				}));
				steps.appendChild(el("button", {
					type: "button",
					text: "+",
					className: "hwhbl-btn hwhbl-btn--secondary",
					"aria-label": `Увеличить: ${label}`,
					disabled: options.editingDisabled || count >= buff.remaining,
					onClick: () => {
						if (count < buff.remaining) setCount(buff.slotId, count + 1);
					}
				}));
				cell.appendChild(steps);
				buffsGrid.appendChild(cell);
			}
			buffsSection.appendChild(buffsGrid);
		}
		return buffsSection;
	}
	function renderTeamRow(teamIndex, currentSetup, currentRoster, usedHeroes, options, saveSetup) {
		const team = currentSetup.teams[teamIndex] || [];
		const teamPet = currentSetup.teamPetSelections[teamIndex];
		const teamRow = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-manual-team-row",
			"aria-label": `Пачка ${teamIndex + 1}`,
			style: {
				display: "flex",
				flexWrap: "wrap",
				alignItems: "flex-start",
				gap: "16px",
				marginBottom: "12px",
				padding: "8px",
				border: "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border)",
				borderRadius: "4px",
				minWidth: "0"
			}
		});
		const slots = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-team-slots",
			style: {
				display: "grid",
				gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(5, 69px) 59.8px",
				gap: "8px",
				flex: "0 1 444.8px",
				maxWidth: "100%",
				overflowX: "auto",
				paddingTop: "4px"
			}
		});
		const meta = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-team-meta",
			style: {
				flex: "1 1 280px",
				minWidth: "0"
			}
		});
		const header = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-team-inline-summary" }, el("label", { className: "hwhbl-team-select-label" }, el("input", {
			type: "checkbox",
			className: "hwhbl-team-checkbox",
			"data-hwhbl-attack-team": String(teamIndex),
			"aria-label": `Использовать пачку ${teamIndex + 1} для тренировки и атаки`,
			onChange: (event) => {
				if (!event.target.disabled) options.onToggleTeamSelect?.(teamIndex);
			}
		}), el("strong", { text: `Пачка ${teamIndex + 1}` })), el("span", {
			"data-hwhbl-team-damage": String(teamIndex),
			text: "Урон: —",
			className: "hwhbl-team-damage",
			"data-hwhx-native-title": "Урон — лучший бой пачки с таймингами, подобранными под seed, как перед отправкой.\nНадёжность — средний бой в процентах от этого пика."
		}));
		meta.appendChild(header);
		meta.appendChild(el("div", {
			"data-hwhbl-team-availability": "",
			className: "hwhbl-team-availability"
		}));
		const timingGrid = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-team-timings",
			"aria-label": "Тайминги умений героев и питомца"
		});
		meta.appendChild(el("div", {
			"data-hwhbl-team-insight": "",
			className: "hwhbl-team-insight"
		}));
		meta.appendChild(el("div", {
			"data-hwhbl-team-progress": "",
			style: {
				fontSize: "11px",
				color: "var(--hwhbl-text-muted)",
				marginBottom: "6px"
			}
		}));
		meta.appendChild(timingGrid);
		teamRow.appendChild(slots);
		teamRow.appendChild(meta);
		for (let slot = 0; slot < 5; slot++) {
			const manualHeroId = team[slot];
			const effectiveHeroId = manualHeroId;
			const manualFavor = effectiveHeroId ? currentSetup.favorSelections?.[teamIndex]?.[effectiveHeroId] : void 0;
			const slotEl = createSlotEl(manualHeroId, currentRoster.heroes, "героя", 69, usedHeroes, (id) => {
				const newTeams = Array.from({ length: Math.max(currentSetup.teams.length, teamIndex + 1) }, (_, index) => [...currentSetup.teams[index] ?? []]);
				if (!newTeams[teamIndex]) newTeams[teamIndex] = [];
				if (id === 0) newTeams[teamIndex].splice(slot, 1);
				else newTeams[teamIndex][Math.min(slot, newTeams[teamIndex].length)] = id;
				const newFavor = (currentSetup.favorSelections ?? []).map((favor) => ({ ...favor }));
				if (manualHeroId && newFavor[teamIndex]) delete newFavor[teamIndex][manualHeroId];
				saveSetup({
					teams: newTeams,
					favorSelections: newFavor
				});
			}, options);
			const heroCell = el("div", {
				className: "hwhbl-manual-hero-cell",
				style: {
					display: "flex",
					flexDirection: "column",
					alignItems: "center",
					gap: "6px"
				}
			});
			heroCell.appendChild(slotEl);
			const usedFavor = new Set(Object.entries(currentSetup.favorSelections?.[teamIndex] ?? {}).filter(([heroId, petId]) => Number(heroId) !== effectiveHeroId && typeof petId === "number").map(([, petId]) => Number(petId)));
			const compatiblePets = () => currentRoster.pets.filter((pet) => {
				const petLibrary = asRecord$1(readEditorLibrary(options).pet);
				return Object.values(asRecord$1(petLibrary[pet.id]).favorHeroes ?? {}).map(Number).includes(effectiveHeroId ?? 0);
			});
			const patronSlot = createSlotEl(typeof manualFavor === "number" ? manualFavor : void 0, compatiblePets, "питомца", 36.8, usedFavor, (id) => {
				if (!effectiveHeroId) return;
				const newTeams = Array.from({ length: Math.max(currentSetup.teams.length, teamIndex + 1) }, (_, index) => [...currentSetup.teams[index] ?? []]);
				if (!newTeams[teamIndex]) newTeams[teamIndex] = [];
				if (!manualHeroId) newTeams[teamIndex].splice(Math.min(slot, newTeams[teamIndex].length), 0, effectiveHeroId);
				const newFavor = [...currentSetup.favorSelections ?? []];
				newFavor[teamIndex] = {
					...newFavor[teamIndex],
					[effectiveHeroId]: id || "auto"
				};
				saveSetup({
					teams: newTeams,
					favorSelections: newFavor
				});
			}, options, void 0, void 0, currentRoster.pets);
			patronSlot.setAttribute("aria-label", `Покровитель героя ${effectiveHeroId ?? slot + 1}`);
			patronSlot.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", effectiveHeroId ? patronSlot.getAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title") || "Выбрать покровителя героя" : "Сначала выбери героя");
			patronSlot.disabled = !effectiveHeroId || Boolean(options.editingDisabled);
			heroCell.appendChild(patronSlot);
			timingGrid.appendChild(el("div", { className: "hwhbl-team-timing" }, el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-team-timing-name",
				text: effectiveHeroId ? options.getEntityLabel?.(effectiveHeroId, "hero") || `Герой #${effectiveHeroId}` : `Место ${slot + 1}`
			}), el("div", {

			})));

		const petSlotEl = createSlotEl(typeof teamPet === "number" ? teamPet : void 0, currentRoster.pets, "питомца", 59.8, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), (id) => {

			});
		}, options);
		const petCell = el("div", {

	/** Урон строки: во время атаки — бой и сервер со сверкой прогноза, иначе прогноз плана. */
	function formatRowDamage(result, attack) {
		const damage = attack ? attack.serverDamage ?? attack.damage : result?.damage;
		const label = !attack ? "Урон" : attack.serverDamage != null ? "Урон сервера" : attack.phase === "done" ? "Отправлено" : "Урон боя";
		const check = attack ? formatAsgardForecastCheck(result?.damage, attack.serverDamage) : formatAsgardReliability(result?.reliability);
		return `${label}: ${damage != null ? damage.toLocaleString("ru-RU") : "—"}${check ? ` (${check})` : ""}`;
	}
	function describeRowAvailability(ids, used) {
		if (used) return "Герои уже использованы — повторная атака недоступна";
		return ids.length === 5 ? "" : "Для атаки нужны 5 героев";
	}
	/** Прогресс обновляет только текст метрик, не пересоздавая карточки и картинки. */
	function updateTeamMetrics(root, results, progress, teams, attacks, helperConfirmation = false, selection) {
		root.querySelectorAll(".hwhbl-manual-team-row").forEach((row, index) => {
			const result = results[index];
			const ids = teams[index] ?? [];
			const used = ids.some((id) => selection?.usedHeroIds.includes(id));
			const available = ids.length === 5 && !used;
			const checkbox = row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-attack-team]");
			if (checkbox) {
				checkbox.checked = available && (selection?.indices.includes(index) ?? true);
				checkbox.disabled = !available || Boolean(selection?.busy);
			}
			const availability = row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-team-availability]");
			if (availability) availability.textContent = describeRowAvailability(ids, used);
			const attack = attacks?.find((current) => current.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => current.unitIds.includes(id)));
			const active = Boolean(attack && [
				"starting",
				"improving",
				"waiting-submit",
				"sending"
			].includes(attack.phase));
			row.setAttribute("data-hwhbl-attack-active", String(active));
			const actions = attack?.actions ?? result?.timings;
			const teamProgress = progress?.teamProgress?.find((current) => current.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => current.unitIds.includes(id)));
			row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-team-progress]").textContent = attack ? formatAsgardAttackProgress(attack, Date.now(), helperConfirmation) : formatAsgardTeamProgress(teamProgress);
			row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-team-damage]").textContent = formatRowDamage(result, attack);
			row.querySelectorAll("[data-hwhbl-timing-unit]").forEach((label) => {
				const id = Number(label.dataset.hwhblTimingUnit);
				label.textContent = (result || attack) && id ? formatAsgardHeroTimings(actions, id) : "—";
			});
			row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-team-auto]").textContent = formatAsgardTeamControls(actions);
			const insight = row.querySelector("[data-hwhbl-team-insight]");
			if (insight) insight.textContent = attack ? "" : formatAsgardTeamInsight(result?.insight);
		});
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/run-eta.ts
	init_defineProperty();
	/** Меньше расчётов — скорость ещё в разгоне воркеров и не годится для прогноза. */
	var MIN_SAMPLE_CALCULATIONS = 20;
	/** Новый замер весит больше старого: потоки и режим могли смениться. */
	var SMOOTHING = .5;
	/**
	* Скорость расчётов по прогрессу запусков. Между запусками скорость помнится,
	* поэтому прогноз доступен ещё до старта следующего подбора.
	*/
	var BattleLabThroughputMeter = class {
		constructor(initialRate = null) {
			_defineProperty(this, "startedAt", null);
			_defineProperty(this, "startedCount", 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "lastCount", 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "lastAt", 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "smoothed", void 0);
			this.smoothed = initialRate;
		}
		/** Расчётов в секунду; null — ещё не мерили. */
		get rate() {
			return this.smoothed;
		}
		observe(completed, running, now = Date.now()) {
			if (!running) {
				this.commit();
				this.startedAt = null;
				return;
			}
			if (this.startedAt === null || completed < this.lastCount) {
				this.startedAt = now;
				this.startedCount = completed;
			}
			this.lastCount = completed;
			this.lastAt = now;
		}
		commit() {
			if (this.startedAt === null) return;
			const done = this.lastCount - this.startedCount;
			const seconds = (this.lastAt - this.startedAt) / 1e3;
			if (done < MIN_SAMPLE_CALCULATIONS || seconds <= 0) return;
			const rate = done / seconds;
			this.smoothed = this.smoothed === null ? rate : this.smoothed * (1 - SMOOTHING) + rate * SMOOTHING;
		}
	};
	/** «≈ 4 мин» для числа расчётов при известной скорости. */
	function formatBattleLabEta(calculations, rate) {
		if (!rate || rate <= 0 || calculations <= 0) return "";
		const seconds = Math.round(calculations / rate);
		if (seconds < 60) return `≈ ${Math.max(1, seconds)} с`;
		const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60);
		if (minutes < 60) return `≈ ${minutes} мин`;
		return `≈ ${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} ч ${minutes % 60} мин`;
	}

	function renderWorkbenchTeamHeader(team, tIdx, totalTeams, isSelected, isBoss, damageScore, onToggleTeamSelect) {
		const teamHeader = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-team-header" });
		const teamDamage = team.damage ?? (totalTeams === 1 ? damageScore : null);
		if (totalTeams > 1) {
			const checkbox = el("input", {
				type: "checkbox",
				className: "hwhbl-team-checkbox",
				checked: isSelected,
				onChange: () => {
					onToggleTeamSelect?.(tIdx);
				}
			});
			const label = el("label", { className: "hwhbl-team-select-label" });
			label.appendChild(checkbox);
			label.appendChild(el("span", { text: `Пачка ${tIdx + 1}` }));
			teamHeader.appendChild(label);
		} else teamHeader.appendChild(el("span", {
			style: {
				fontSize: "11.5px",
				fontWeight: "600",
				color: "var(--hwhbl-text-muted)"
			},
			text: isBoss ? "Рекомендованная пачка" : "Рекомендованная команда"
		}));
		const badgesRow = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-team-badges" });
		if (!isBoss && team.power && team.power > 0) badgesRow.appendChild(el("span", {
			className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--neutral hwhbl-num",
			text: `Сила: ${formatCompactNumber(team.power)}`
		}));
		if (isBoss && teamDamage && teamDamage > 0) badgesRow.appendChild(el("span", {
			className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--win hwhbl-num",
			text: `Урон: ${formatFullNumber(teamDamage)}`
		}));
		teamHeader.appendChild(badgesRow);
		return teamHeader;
	}
