		let renderedEnemyKey = null;
		function updateEnemySection(opponent, modeId) {
			const defenders = opponent?.teams?.[0]?.units ?? [];
			const summary = modeId === "asgard" ? callbacks.getAsgardSummary?.(opponent) : null;
			const unitIds = defenders.map((u) => u.id).join(",");
			const summaryKey = summary ? JSON.stringify([
				summary.level,
				summary.bossUnit?.id,
				summary.damage,
				summary.coins,
				summary.attemptsLeft,
				summary.buffs
			]) : "";
			const currentKey = `${modeId}:${opponent?.id ?? "none"}:${opponent?.power ?? 0}:${unitIds}:${summaryKey}`;
			if (currentKey === renderedEnemyKey) return;
			renderedEnemyKey = currentKey;
			clearChildren(enemyUnitsRow);
			if (opponent && defenders.length > 0) {
				const totalPower = opponent.power ?? defenders.reduce((sum, u) => sum + (Number(u.power) || 0), 0);
				enemyTitle.textContent = opponent.name ? `Соперник: ${opponent.name}` : "Состав противника";
				enemyPower.textContent = totalPower > 0 ? `Мощь: ${formatCompactNumber(totalPower)}` : "";
				enemyPower.style.display = totalPower > 0 ? "inline-flex" : "none";
				if (summary) {
					enemyPower.style.display = "none";
					enemyUnitsRow.appendChild(createAsgardOverview(summary, callbacks));
				} else for (const unit of defenders) enemyUnitsRow.appendChild(createUnitCard({
					unit,
					getIcon: callbacks.getEntityIcon,
					getRankFrame: callbacks.getRankFrame,
					getUnitDecoration: callbacks.getUnitDecoration,
					getTooltip: callbacks.getUnitTooltip
				}));
			} else {
				enemyTitle.textContent = "Выберите цель";
				enemyPower.style.display = "none";
				enemyUnitsRow.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
						fontSize: "12px"
					},
					text: "Цель не выбрана или данные состава отсутствуют."
				}));
			}
		}
		let renderedAsgardKey = null;
		function updateAsgardUsedSection(opponent, modeId, roster) {
			if (modeId !== "asgard") {
				asgardUsedCard.style.display = "none";
				renderedAsgardKey = null;
				return;
			}
			asgardUsedCard.style.display = "flex";
			const usedList = opponent?.usedHeroes ?? opponent?.context?.__battleLabUsedHeroes ?? opponent?.context?.usedHeroes ?? [];
			const currentKey = `${opponent?.id ?? "none"}:${usedList.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",")}`;
			if (currentKey === renderedAsgardKey) return;
			renderedAsgardKey = currentKey;
			clearChildren(asgardUsedUnitsRow);
			asgardUsedBadge.textContent = `Использовано: ${usedList.length}`;
			if (usedList.length === 0) {
				asgardUsedUnitsRow.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)",
						fontSize: "12px",
						padding: "4px 0"
					},
					text: "Нет использованных героев (все герои доступны для боя с боссом)."
				}));
				return;
			}
			const heroesMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			if (roster?.heroes) for (const h of roster.heroes) heroesMap.set(h.id, h);
			for (const id of usedList) {
				const unit = heroesMap.get(id) ?? {
					id,
					type: "hero",
					color: 6,
					star: 6,
					level: 130
				};
				asgardUsedUnitsRow.appendChild(createUnitCard({
					unit,
					getIcon: callbacks.getEntityIcon,
					getRankFrame: callbacks.getRankFrame,
					getUnitDecoration: callbacks.getUnitDecoration,
					getTooltip: callbacks.getUnitTooltip,
					isUsed: true,
					size: 50
				}));
			}
		}
		function updateControlsAndProgress(state, opponent) {
			const currentMax = state.maxCalculations;
			numberInput.value = String(currentMax);
			const previousRate = throughput.rate;
			throughput.observe(state.runProgress?.completed ?? state.calculationCount, state.runState === "running");
			if (throughput.rate !== previousRate) storeThroughput(throughput.rate);
			budgetEta.textContent = formatBattleLabEta(currentMax, throughput.rate);
			threadsInput.value = String(state.settings?.plannerWorkers ?? 4);
			const isRunning = state.runState === "running";
			const busy = isRunning || state.attackState === "attacking" || state.attackState === "checking";
			numberInput.disabled = busy;
			threadsInput.disabled = busy;
			trainingInput.value = String(state.settings.trainingRuns);
			trainingInput.disabled = busy;
			teamCountGroup.style.display = state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? "" : "none";
			teamCountInput.value = String(state.settings.asgardTeamCount);
			teamCountInput.disabled = busy;
			calcBtn.disabled = busy || !opponent;
			const assembledCount = opponent ? selectedAsgardTrainingRows(projectPlanningSetupResult(state.planningSetups?.[`asgard:${opponent.id}:attack`], state.bestResults.find((result) => result.opponentId === opponent.id && (result.direction ?? "attack") === "attack")), state.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			], readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(opponent, state.asgardAttackProgress)).length : 0;
			trainingEta.textContent = formatBattleLabEta(state.settings.trainingRuns * (state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? assembledCount : 1), throughput.rate);
			trainBtn.disabled = busy || !opponent || state.activeModeId === "asgard" && assembledCount === 0;
			calcBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? "Подобрать свободные места" : "Рассчитать");
			trainBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? `Тренировать ${assembledCount} пачек по ${state.settings.trainingRuns} расчётов` : "Тренировка");
			trainingLabel.textContent = state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? "Расчётов на пачку:" : "Расчётов тренировки:";
			calcBtn.textContent = state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? "Подобрать свободные места" : "Рассчитать";
			trainBtn.textContent = state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? `Тренировать (${assembledCount} × ${state.settings.trainingRuns})` : "Тренировка";
			const savedResult = state.bestResults.find((r) => r.opponentId === opponent?.id && (r.direction ?? "attack") === (state.activeModeId === "tournament-of-elements" ? state.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack"));
			const activeVar = savedResult?.variations?.find((v) => v.id === state.selectedVariationId) ?? savedResult?.variations?.[0];
			const activeTeamsCount = activeVar?.teams?.length ?? savedResult?.teams?.length ?? 1;
			let attackDisabled = busy || !opponent || !savedResult;
			if (state.activeModeId === "asgard" && savedResult) {
				const setup = state.planningSetups?.[`asgard:${opponent?.id}:attack`];
				const rows = setup?.teams.filter((ids) => ids.length === 5 && savedResult.teams.some((team) => team.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => team.unitIds.includes(id)))) ?? [];
				const matches = rows.length === savedResult.teams.length && rows.every((ids) => {
					const team = savedResult.teams.find((saved) => saved.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => saved.unitIds.includes(id)));
					const slot = setup.teams.indexOf(ids);
					const pet = setup.teamPetSelections[slot];
					return team && (pet === "auto" || pet === void 0 || (pet ?? 0) === (team.teamPetId ?? 0)) && Object.entries(setup.favorSelections?.[slot] ?? {}).every(([id, selection]) => selection === "auto" || (selection ?? 0) === (team.favor[id] ?? 0));
				});
				attackDisabled || (attackDisabled = !matches);
			}
			let attackLabel = "Атаковать";
			if (state.activeModeId === "asgard" && savedResult && opponent) {
				const teams = activeVar?.teams ?? savedResult.teams;
				const selectedCount = selectAsgardAttackTeams(teams, state.planningSetups?.[`asgard:${opponent.id}:attack`], state.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
					0,
					1,
					2,
					3,
					4
				], readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(opponent, state.asgardAttackProgress)).length;
				attackLabel = `Атаковать (${selectedCount} из ${teams.length})`;
				attackDisabled || (attackDisabled = selectedCount === 0);
			} else if (savedResult && activeTeamsCount > 1) {
				const selectedCount = (state.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
					0,
					1,
					2,
					3,
					4
				]).filter((i) => i < activeTeamsCount).length;
				attackLabel = `Атаковать (${selectedCount} из ${activeTeamsCount})`;
				if (selectedCount === 0) attackDisabled = true;
			}
			attackBtn.disabled = attackDisabled;
			clearChildren(attackBtn);
			attackBtn.appendChild(renderBlIcon("swords", 14));
			attackBtn.appendChild(document.createTextNode(` ${attackLabel}`));
			const asgardImproving = state.activeModeId === "asgard" && state.attackState === "attacking";
			purchaseBtn.style.display = state.asgardPurchasePrompt ? "inline-flex" : "none";
			finishBtn.style.display = isRunning && state.activeModeId === "asgard" && state.runProgress?.kind === "search" ? "inline-flex" : "none";
			stopBtn.style.display = isRunning || asgardImproving ? "inline-flex" : "none";
			stopBtn.lastChild.textContent = state.asgardPurchasePrompt ? "Остановить серию" : asgardImproving ? "Хватит улучшать" : "Стоп";
			if (asgardImproving) stopBtn.setAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title", "Остановить подбор таймингов текущей пачки и отправить лучший найденный бой");
			else stopBtn.removeAttribute("data-hwhx-native-title");
			if (state.errorText) {
				progressWrap.style.display = "flex";
				progressWrap.setAttribute("role", "alert");
				progressBar.style.width = "0%";
				progressText.textContent = `Расчёт не завершён: ${state.errorText}`;
				progressCount.textContent = "Ошибка";
			} else if (state.attackState === "attacking") {
				progressWrap.removeAttribute("role");
				progressWrap.style.display = "flex";
				progressBar.style.width = "100%";
				progressText.textContent = state.attackStatusText || "Атака...";
				if (state.attackCountdownMs !== null && state.attackCountdownMs !== void 0) progressCount.textContent = `${Math.ceil(state.attackCountdownMs / 1e3)}с`;
				else progressCount.textContent = "";
			} else if (isRunning || state.runProgress) {
				progressWrap.removeAttribute("role");
				progressWrap.style.display = "flex";
				const completed = state.runProgress?.completed ?? state.calculationCount;
				const total = state.runProgress?.total ?? state.maxCalculations;
				const pct = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round(completed / total * 100)) : 0;
				progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
				const phase = isRunning ? state.runProgress?.phase : void 0;
				let phaseLabel = state.statusText || "Симуляция...";
				if (phase === "screening") phaseLabel = "Скрининг кандидатов";
				else if (phase === "racing") phaseLabel = "Гонка лучших пачек";
				else if (phase === "timing") phaseLabel = "Подбор автотаймингов";
				else if (phase === "validation") phaseLabel = "Валидация результата";
				else if (phase === "training") phaseLabel = "Тестирование пачки";
				const topVar = state.runProgress?.variations?.[0];
				let leaderInfo = "";
				if (topVar) {
					if (state.activeModeId === "asgard" || state.activeModeId === "invasion" || state.activeModeId === "archdemon") {
						const damage = topVar.scoreMax ?? topVar.scoreMean;
						if (damage > 0) leaderInfo = ` • Лучший: ${formatFullNumber(damage)} урона`;
					} else if (topVar.winRate !== null && Number.isFinite(topVar.winRate)) leaderInfo = ` • Лидер: ${(topVar.winRate * 100).toFixed(0)}% побед`;
				}
				progressText.textContent = `${phaseLabel}${leaderInfo}`;
				progressCount.textContent = `${completed} / ${total} (${pct}%)`;
			} else progressWrap.style.display = "none";
		}
		function updateView() {
			const state = store.getState();
			const opponent = state.opponentsByMode[state.activeModeId]?.find((o) => o.id === state.selectedOpponentId);
			updateEnemySection(opponent, state.activeModeId);
			updateAsgardUsedSection(opponent, state.activeModeId, state.planningRoster);
			updateAsgardEditor(opponent);
			const isAsgard = state.activeModeId === "asgard";
			resultCard.classList.toggle("hwhbl-result-card--inline", isAsgard);
			if (isAsgard) asgardEditorHost.after(resultCard);
			else progressWrap.after(resultCard);
			updateControlsAndProgress(state, opponent);
			renderBestResult(opponent, state.bestResults);
		}
		let editorKey = null;
		let editor = null;
		/** Редактор живёт в рабочей области и сохраняется при обновлении прогресса. */
		function updateAsgardEditor(opponent) {
			const key = opponent?.modeId === "asgard" ? opponent.id : null;
			if (key === editorKey) return;
			editor?.dispose?.();
			editor = null;
			clearChildren(asgardEditorHost);
			editorKey = key;
			if (!key) return;
			editor = createAsgardSetupDrawer(store, {
				embedded: true,
				onClose: () => {},
				loadRoster: callbacks.loadRoster,
				getIcon: callbacks.getEntityIcon,
				getRankFrame: callbacks.getRankFrame,
				getUnitDecoration: callbacks.getUnitDecoration,
				getEntityLabel: callbacks.getEntityLabel,
				getTextureIcon: callbacks.getTextureIcon,
				gameLibrary: callbacks.gameLibrary,
				translate: callbacks.translate,
				onToggleTeamSelect: callbacks.onToggleTeamSelect
			});
			asgardEditorHost.appendChild(editor);
		}
		let renderedTeamSignature = null;
		let currentBossDamageBadge = null;
		let currentWinBadge = null;
		let currentVarTabs = null;
		function renderBestResult(opponent, bestResults) {
			if (!opponent) {
				renderedTeamSignature = "no-opponent";
				clearChildren(resultCard);
				resultCard.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						padding: "32px",
						textAlign: "center",
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)"
					},
					text: "Выберите цель из списка слева для начала подбора состава."
				}));
				return;
			}
			const state = store.getState();
			const savedResult = bestResults.find((r) => r.opponentId === opponent.id && (r.direction ?? "attack") === (state.activeModeId === "tournament-of-elements" ? state.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack"));
			const isRunning = state.runState === "running";
			const liveVariations = state.runProgress?.variations;
			const livePreview = isRunning ? state.runProgress?.preview : void 0;
			let result = livePreview ?? savedResult;
			const isLive = isRunning && Boolean(livePreview || liveVariations && liveVariations.length > 0);
			if (!livePreview && isLive && liveVariations && liveVariations.length > 0) {
				const topVar = liveVariations.find((v) => v.id === state.selectedVariationId) ?? liveVariations[0];
				result = {
					id: "live-preview",
					modeId: state.activeModeId,
					opponentId: opponent.id,
					opponentName: opponent.name,
					createdAt: Date.now(),
					calculationCount: state.runProgress?.completed ?? state.calculationCount,
					score: topVar.scoreMax ?? topVar.scoreMean ?? null,
					wins: topVar.wins,
					teams: topVar.teams.map((team, index) => ({
						...team,
						timings: team.timings ?? (index === topVar.teams.length - 1 ? topVar.actions : [])
					})),
					confidence: topVar.confidenceLow ?? void 0,
					variations: liveVariations,
					timings: topVar.actions
				};
			}
			if (!result) {
				renderedTeamSignature = "no-result";
				clearChildren(resultCard);
				resultCard.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						padding: "28px",
						textAlign: "center",
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)"
					},
					text: isRunning ? "Идёт скрининг кандидатов..." : "План ещё не рассчитан. Нажмите «Рассчитать» для запуска симуляций."
				}));
				return;
			}
			const variation = result.variations?.find((v) => v.id === state.selectedVariationId) ?? result.variations?.[0];
			const activeTeams = variation?.teams ?? result.teams ?? [];
			const isBoss = state.activeModeId === "asgard" || state.activeModeId === "invasion" || state.activeModeId === "archdemon";
			const damageScore = variation?.scoreMax ?? variation?.scoreMean ?? result.score;
			const selectedIndices = state.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			];
			const newTeamSignature = `${state.activeModeId}:${opponent.id}:${variation?.id ?? "0"}:${activeTeams.map((t) => `${(t.unitIds ?? []).join(",")}:${t.teamPetId ?? 0}`).join("|")}:${Boolean(isLive)}:${selectedIndices.join(",")}:${JSON.stringify([
				result.timings,
				state.runProgress?.phase,
				state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? result.elapsedMs : void 0,
				activeTeams.map((team) => [team.timings, team.damage])
			])}`;
			if (newTeamSignature === renderedTeamSignature) {
				if (isBoss && damageScore && damageScore > 0 && currentBossDamageBadge) currentBossDamageBadge.textContent = `${isLive ? "Оценка плана" : "Урон"}: ${formatFullNumber(damageScore)}`;
				else if (currentWinBadge) {
					const resultWinRate = result.statistics?.winRate ?? (result.wins !== null && result.calculationCount > 0 ? result.wins / result.calculationCount : 0);
					const winPct = Math.round((variation?.winRate ?? resultWinRate ?? 0) * 100);
					currentWinBadge.textContent = `${winPct}% Побед`;
				}
				if (currentVarTabs && result.variations && result.variations.length > 1) {
					const buttons = currentVarTabs.querySelectorAll("button");
					result.variations.forEach((v, index) => {
						const btn = buttons[index];
						if (btn) {
							const isActive = v.id === (variation?.id ?? result.variations[0].id);
							const scoreLabel = isBoss && (v.scoreMax || v.scoreMean) ? `${formatFullNumber(v.scoreMax ?? v.scoreMean)} урона` : `${Math.round((v.winRate ?? 0) * 100)}%`;
							btn.className = `hwhbl-pill-btn ${isActive ? "hwhbl-active" : ""}`;
							btn.textContent = `Вариант ${index + 1} (${scoreLabel})`;
						}
					});
				}
				return;
			}
			renderedTeamSignature = newTeamSignature;
			clearChildren(resultCard);
			const header = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-result-header" });
			const metricsRow = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-metrics-row" });
			if (isLive) metricsRow.appendChild(el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--running",
				text: state.runProgress?.phase === "training" || state.runProgress?.phase === "validation" ? "Проверка плана" : "Подбор на лету"
			}));
			if (isBoss && damageScore && damageScore > 0) {
				currentBossDamageBadge = el("span", {
					className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--win hwhbl-num",
					text: `${isLive ? "Оценка плана" : "Урон"}: ${formatFullNumber(damageScore)}`
				});
				currentWinBadge = null;
				metricsRow.appendChild(currentBossDamageBadge);
			} else {
				const resultWinRate = result.statistics?.winRate ?? (result.wins !== null && result.calculationCount > 0 ? result.wins / result.calculationCount : 0);
				const winPct = Math.round((variation?.winRate ?? resultWinRate ?? 0) * 100);
				currentWinBadge = el("span", {
					className: `hwhbl-badge ${winPct === 100 ? "hwhbl-badge--win" : winPct > 50 ? "hwhbl-badge--neutral" : "hwhbl-badge--loss"}`,
					text: `${winPct}% Побед`
				});
				currentBossDamageBadge = null;
				metricsRow.appendChild(currentWinBadge);
			}
			const confidence = variation?.confidenceLow ?? result.confidence;
			if (confidence !== void 0 && confidence > 0) metricsRow.appendChild(el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--neutral hwhbl-num",
				text: `Надёжность: ${Math.round(confidence * 100)}%`
			}));
			if (result.elapsedMs) metricsRow.appendChild(el("span", {
				className: "hwhbl-badge hwhbl-badge--neutral hwhbl-num",
				text: `Время расчёта: ${(result.elapsedMs / 1e3).toFixed(1)}s`
			}));
			header.appendChild(metricsRow);
			if (state.activeModeId !== "asgard" && result.variations && result.variations.length > 1) {
				currentVarTabs = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-budget-group" });
				result.variations.forEach((v, index) => {
					const isActive = v.id === (variation?.id ?? result.variations[0].id);
					const scoreLabel = isBoss && (v.scoreMax || v.scoreMean) ? `${formatFullNumber(v.scoreMax ?? v.scoreMean)} урона` : `${Math.round((v.winRate ?? 0) * 100)}%`;
					const varBtn = el("button", {
						className: `hwhbl-pill-btn ${isActive ? "hwhbl-active" : ""}`,
						text: `Вариант ${index + 1} (${scoreLabel})`,
						onClick: () => callbacks.onSelectVariation(v.id)
					});
					currentVarTabs.appendChild(varBtn);
				});
				header.appendChild(currentVarTabs);
			} else currentVarTabs = null;
			resultCard.appendChild(header);
			const teamsContainer = el("div", { style: {
				display: "flex",
				flexDirection: "column",
				gap: "10px"
			} });
			const isTitan = state.activeModeId === "tournament-of-elements";
			(state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? [] : activeTeams).forEach((team, tIdx) => {
				const isSelected = selectedIndices.includes(tIdx);
				const teamBlock = renderWorkbenchTeamBlock({
					team,
					tIdx,
					totalTeams: activeTeams.length,
					isSelected,
					isBoss,
					damageScore,
					roster: state.planningRoster,
					isTitan,
					callbacks
				});
				teamsContainer.appendChild(teamBlock);
			});
			resultCard.appendChild(teamsContainer);
			const timingGroups = state.activeModeId === "asgard" ? [] : [{
				label: "Тайминги активации умений",
				timings: variation?.actions ?? result.timings ?? []
			}];
			for (const { label, timings } of timingGroups) if (timings.length > 0) {
				const timingSection = el("div", { style: {
					display: "flex",
					flexDirection: "column",
					gap: "6px",
					marginTop: "6px"
				} });
				timingSection.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						fontSize: "12px",
						fontWeight: "600",
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-muted)"
					},
					text: label
				}));
				const table = el("table", { className: "hwhbl-timing-table" });
				const thead = el("thead", null, el("tr", null, el("th", {
					text: "Время",
					style: { width: "70px" }
				}), el("th", { text: "Боец" }), el("th", { text: "Действие" })));
				const tbody = el("tbody");
				for (const action of timings) {
					const timeVal = action.time ?? 0;
					const tr = el("tr", null, el("td", {
						className: "hwhbl-num",
						text: `${Number.isFinite(timeVal) ? Number(timeVal).toFixed(6).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") : "0"}s`
					}), el("td", { text: "unitId" in action && typeof action.unitId === "number" ? callbacks.getEntityLabel ? callbacks.getEntityLabel(action.unitId, "hero") : `ID #${action.unitId}` : "Команда" }), el("td", { text: action.type === "cast" ? "Ультимейт" : action.type === "teamCustom" ? `Командное умение (${action.value})` : "Автобой" }));
					tbody.appendChild(tr);
				}
				table.appendChild(thead);
				table.appendChild(tbody);
				timingSection.appendChild(table);
				resultCard.appendChild(timingSection);
			}
		}
		const unsubscribe = store.subscribe((state, changedKeys) => {
			updateElapsed();
			if (changedKeys.has("selectedOpponentId") || changedKeys.has("activeModeId") || changedKeys.has("bestResults") || changedKeys.has("runState") || changedKeys.has("runProgress") || changedKeys.has("calculationCount") || changedKeys.has("maxCalculations") || changedKeys.has("selectedVariationId") || changedKeys.has("selectedTeamIndices") || changedKeys.has("attackState") || changedKeys.has("asgardAttackProgress") || changedKeys.has("attackStatusText") || changedKeys.has("attackCountdownMs") || changedKeys.has("settings") || changedKeys.has("statusText") || changedKeys.has("errorText") || changedKeys.has("planningRoster") || changedKeys.has("planningSetups") || changedKeys.has("opponentsByMode")) updateView();
		});
		updateView();
		updateElapsed();
		return Object.assign(workbench, {
			footer: commandBar,
			dispose: () => {
				unsubscribe();
				clearInterval(elapsedInterval);
				editor?.dispose?.();
			}
		});
	}
	/** Секундомер не обнуляет часы после суток работы. */
	function formatRunElapsed(elapsedMs) {
		const seconds = Math.floor(Math.max(0, elapsedMs) / 1e3);
		return [
			Math.floor(seconds / 3600),
			Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60,
			seconds % 60
		].map((value) => String(value).padStart(2, "0")).join(":");
	}
	var THROUGHPUT_STORAGE_KEY = "hwhbl-calc-throughput";
	/** Скорость — удобство одного устройства: хранилище может быть недоступно. */
	function readStoredThroughput() {
		try {
			const value = Number(globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(THROUGHPUT_STORAGE_KEY));
			return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
		} catch {
			return null;
		}
	}
	function storeThroughput(rate) {
		if (!rate) return;
		try {
			globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(THROUGHPUT_STORAGE_KEY, String(rate));
		} catch {}
	}

	function createHistoryDrawer(store, callbacks) {

		header.appendChild(title);
		header.appendChild(closeBtn);
		const actionsRow = el("div", { style: {
			display: "flex",
			alignItems: "center",
			justifyContent: "space-between",
			paddingBottom: "8px",
			borderBottom: "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border)"
		} }, el("div", { className: "hwhbl-btn-group" }, el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-pill-btn",
			onClick: callbacks.onExport,
			text: "Экспорт"
		}), el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-pill-btn",
			onClick: callbacks.onImport,
			text: "Импорт"
		})), el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-pill-btn",
			style: { color: "var(--hwhbl-danger)" },
			onClick: callbacks.onClear,
			text: "Очистить"
		}));
		const listContainer = el("div", { style: {
			flex: "1",
			overflowY: "auto",
			display: "flex",
			flexDirection: "column",
			gap: "6px"
		} });
		drawer.appendChild(header);
		drawer.appendChild(actionsRow);
		drawer.appendChild(listContainer);
		function renderHistory() {
			const history = store.getState().history ?? [];
			clearChildren(listContainer);
			if (history.length === 0) {
				listContainer.appendChild(el("div", {
					style: {
						padding: "40px 16px",
						textAlign: "center",
						color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)"
					},
					text: "История симуляций пуста."
				}));
				return;
			}
			const table = el("table", { className: "hwhbl-timing-table" });
			const thead = el("thead", null, el("tr", null, el("th", { text: "Режим" }), el("th", { text: "Итог" }), el("th", { text: "Дата" }), el("th", { text: "Действие" })));
			const tbody = el("tbody");
			for (const entry of history.slice(0, 50)) {
				const isWin = entry.result === "win";
				const dateStr = new Date(entry.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString();
				const replayBtn = callbacks.onReplay ? el("button", {
					className: "hwhbl-pill-btn",
					style: {
						padding: "2px 6px",
						fontSize: "10px"
					},
					onClick: () => callbacks.onReplay(entry.id),
					text: "Повтор"
				}) : false;
				const tr = el("tr", null, el("td", { text: entry.modeId }), el("td", null, el("span", {
					className: `hwhbl-badge ${isWin ? "hwhbl-badge--win" : "hwhbl-badge--loss"}`,
					style: {
						padding: "1px 6px",
						fontSize: "10px"
					},
					text: isWin ? "Победа" : "Поражение"
				})), el("td", {
					className: "hwhbl-num",
					text: dateStr
				}), el("td", null, replayBtn));
				tbody.appendChild(tr);
			}
			table.appendChild(thead);
			table.appendChild(tbody);
			listContainer.appendChild(table);
		}
		store.subscribeKey("history", () => {
			renderHistory();
		});
		renderHistory();
		return drawer;
	}

	function createSettingsDialog(store, callbacks) {
		const drawer = el("div", {

				display: "flex",

			});

					color: "var(--hwhbl-text-subtle)"

			}));

	/** Форматирует доступные браузеру показатели, явно сохраняя область измерения. */
	function formatBattleLabResourceUsage(usage, heapBytes) {
		const cpu = usage?.workers ? `${usage.busyWorkers}/${usage.workers}` : "—";
		if (typeof heapBytes !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(heapBytes) || heapBytes < 0) return `CPU Calc: ${cpu}`;
		return `CPU Calc: ${cpu} · RAM JS вкладки: ${(heapBytes / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(0)} МБ`;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/modal.ts
	init_constants$1();
	var activeOverlay = null;
	var activeCleanup = null;
	function closeBattleLabDialog() {
		if (!activeOverlay) return;
		const overlay = activeOverlay;
		activeOverlay = null;
		activeCleanup?.();
		activeCleanup = null;
		overlay.classList.remove("hwhbl-visible");
		setTimeout(() => {
			overlay.remove();
		}, 220);
	}
	function openBattleLabDialog(options) {
		ensureBattleLabStyles();
		if (activeOverlay) closeBattleLabDialog();
		const fallbackModel = options.props?.model;
		const store = options.store ?? new BattleLabStore(fallbackModel ?? {});
		const overlay = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-root hwhbl-overlay" });
		activeOverlay = overlay;
		const dialog = el("div", {
			className: "hwhbl-dialog",
			role: "dialog",
			ariaModal: "true"
		});
		const header = el("header", { className: "hwhbl-header" });
		const brand = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-brand" }, el("div", { className: "hwhbl-brand-icon" }, renderBlIcon("swords", 16)), el("span", { text: "Battle Lab" }), el("span", {
			className: "hwhbl-brand-version",
			text: "v3"
		}));
		const modeSelect = el("select", {
			className: "hwhbl-mode-select",
			onChange: (e) => {
				options.onSelectMode?.(e.target.value);
			}
		});
		const MODE_NAMES = {
			"guild-war": "Война Гильдий",
			"clash-of-worlds": "Столкновение миров",
			"asgard-minions": "Прислужники Асгарда",
			arena: "Арена",
			"grand-arena": "Гранд Арена",
			asgard: "Асгард",
			adventure: "Приключения",
			"epic-brawl": "Потасовка",
			invasion: "Вторжение",
			archdemon: "Архидемон",
			"dominion-rift": "Разлом Доминиона",
			territory: "Территория",
			lord: "Повелители стихий",
			"tournament-of-elements": "Турнир стихий"
		};
		for (const mode of BATTLE_LAB_MODES) {
			const opt = el("option", {
				value: mode.id,
				text: MODE_NAMES[mode.id] ?? mode.id
			});
			modeSelect.appendChild(opt);
		}
		let isDragging = false;
		let dragStartX = 0;
		let dragStartY = 0;
		let dialogStartX = 0;
		let dialogStartY = 0;
		header.style.cursor = "grab";
		header.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
			if (e.target.closest("button, select, input, a, .hwhbl-mode-selector")) return;
			isDragging = true;
			header.style.cursor = "grabbing";
			dragStartX = e.clientX;
			dragStartY = e.clientY;
			const rect = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
			dialogStartX = rect.left;
			dialogStartY = rect.top;
			dialog.style.position = "fixed";
			dialog.style.left = `${dialogStartX}px`;
			dialog.style.top = `${dialogStartY}px`;
			dialog.style.margin = "0";
			dialog.style.transform = "none";
			const onPointerMove = (moveEvent) => {
				if (!isDragging) return;
				const dx = moveEvent.clientX - dragStartX;
				const dy = moveEvent.clientY - dragStartY;
				const maxX = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - dialog.offsetWidth);
				const maxY = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - dialog.offsetHeight);
				const newX = Math.min(Math.max(0, dialogStartX + dx), maxX);
				const newY = Math.min(Math.max(0, dialogStartY + dy), maxY);
				dialog.style.left = `${newX}px`;
				dialog.style.top = `${newY}px`;
			};
			const onPointerUp = () => {
				isDragging = false;
				header.style.cursor = "grab";
				document.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
				document.removeEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
			};
			document.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
			document.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
		});
		const modeWrap = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-mode-selector" }, modeSelect, el("span", { className: "hwhbl-mode-select-chevron" }, renderBlIcon("chevronDown", 12)));
		const statusDot = el("span", { className: "hwhbl-dot hwhbl-dot--ready" });
		const statusLabel = el("span", { text: "Готов к симуляциям" });
		const statusPill = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-status-pill" }, statusDot, statusLabel);
		const historyBtn = el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-icon-btn",
			title: "Журнал боёв",
			onClick: () => toggleDrawer("history")
		}, renderBlIcon("history", 16));
		const settingsBtn = el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-icon-btn",
			title: "Настройки",
			onClick: () => toggleDrawer("settings")
		}, renderBlIcon("settings", 16));
		const actions = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-header-actions" }, historyBtn, settingsBtn, el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-icon-btn",
			title: "Закрыть окно",
			onClick: closeBattleLabDialog
		}, renderBlIcon("close", 16)));
		const refreshBtn = el("button", {
			className: "hwhbl-icon-btn",
			"data-hwhx-native-title": "Обновить данные Асгарда",
			"aria-label": "Обновить данные Асгарда",
			onClick: () => options.onRefresh?.()
		}, renderBlIcon("refresh", 16));
		actions.prepend(refreshBtn);
		const resourceLabel = el("span", {
			className: "hwhbl-resource-usage",
			"data-hwhx-native-title": "CPU Calc: занятые/готовые воркеры Battle Lab, не процент CPU ОС. RAM: JS-куча всей вкладки, включая игру, без памяти воркеров. Прочерк — измерение недоступно."
		});
		const updateResources = () => {
			const memory = performance.memory;
			resourceLabel.textContent = formatBattleLabResourceUsage(options.getResourceUsage?.(), memory?.usedJSHeapSize);
		};
		updateResources();
		const resourceTimer = setInterval(updateResources, 1e3);
		header.appendChild(brand);
		header.appendChild(modeWrap);
		header.appendChild(statusPill);
		header.appendChild(resourceLabel);
		header.appendChild(actions);
		const body = el("div", { className: "hwhbl-body" });
		const targetsPanel = createTargetsPanel(store, {
			onSelectOpponent: (id) => options.onSelectOpponent?.(id),
			onRefresh: () => options.onRefresh?.(),
			getEntityIcon: options.getEntityIcon
		});
		const updateModeLayout = (mode) => {
			body.classList.toggle("hwhbl-body--asgard", mode === "asgard");
			refreshBtn.hidden = mode !== "asgard";
		};
		const workbenchPanel = createWorkbenchPanel(store, {
			loadRoster: options.loadRoster,
			gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
			translate: options.translate,
			onCalculate: () => options.onCalculate?.(),
			onTrain: () => options.onTrain?.(),
			onAttack: () => options.onAttack?.(),
			onStop: () => options.onStop?.(),
			onFinish: () => options.onFinish?.(),
			onConfirmPurchase: () => options.onConfirmPurchase?.(),
			onMaxCalculationsChange: (v) => options.onMaxCalculationsChange?.(v),
			onTrainingRunsChange: (trainingRuns) => options.onSettingsChange?.({
				...store.getState().settings,
				trainingRuns
			}),
			onTeamCountChange: (asgardTeamCount) => options.onSettingsChange?.({
				...store.getState().settings,
				asgardTeamCount
			}),
			onWorkersChange: (v) => {
				const currentSettings = store.getState().settings;
				options.onSettingsChange?.({
					...currentSettings,
					plannerWorkers: v
				});
			},
			onSelectVariation: (v) => options.onSelectVariation?.(v),
			onToggleTeamSelect: options.onToggleTeamSelect,
			getEntityIcon: options.getEntityIcon,
			getRankFrame: options.getRankFrame,
			getEntityLabel: options.getEntityLabel,
			getUnitTooltip: options.getUnitTooltip,
			getUnitDecoration: options.getUnitDecoration,
			getAsgardSummary: options.getAsgardSummary,
			getTextureIcon: options.getTextureIcon
		});
		body.appendChild(targetsPanel);
		body.appendChild(workbenchPanel);
		let activeDrawer = null;
		let drawerEl = null;
		function toggleDrawer(type) {
			if (activeDrawer === type) {
				drawerEl?.dispose?.();
				drawerEl?.remove();
				drawerEl = null;
				activeDrawer = null;
				historyBtn.classList.remove("hwhbl-icon-btn--active");
				settingsBtn.classList.remove("hwhbl-icon-btn--active");
				return;
			}
			drawerEl?.dispose?.();
			drawerEl?.remove();
			activeDrawer = type;
			historyBtn.classList.toggle("hwhbl-icon-btn--active", type === "history");
			settingsBtn.classList.toggle("hwhbl-icon-btn--active", type === "settings");
			if (type === "history") drawerEl = createHistoryDrawer(store, {
				onClose: () => toggleDrawer("history"),
				onClear: () => options.onClearHistory?.(),
				onReplay: options.onReplayHistory,
				onExport: options.onExportSnapshot,
				onImport: options.onImportSnapshots
			});
			else drawerEl = createSettingsDialog(store, {
				onClose: () => toggleDrawer("settings"),
				onSettingsChange: (s) => options.onSettingsChange?.(s)
			});
			body.appendChild(drawerEl);
		}
		dialog.appendChild(header);
		dialog.appendChild(body);
		dialog.appendChild(workbenchPanel.footer);
		overlay.appendChild(dialog);
		overlay.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
			if (e.target === overlay) closeBattleLabDialog();
		});
		const keyHandler = (e) => {
			if (e.key === "Escape") if (activeDrawer) toggleDrawer(activeDrawer);
			else closeBattleLabDialog();
		};
		document.addEventListener("keydown", keyHandler);
		const visibilityHandler = () => {
			if (document.visibilityState === "visible") store.flush();
		};
		document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibilityHandler);
		const disposeTooltips = installBattleLabTooltips(overlay, { isEnabled: () => store.getState().settings?.tooltipsEnabled !== false });
		activeCleanup = () => {
			clearInterval(resourceTimer);
			unsubscribeHeader();
			disposeTooltips();
			workbenchPanel.dispose();
			drawerEl?.dispose?.();
			document.removeEventListener("keydown", keyHandler);
			document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibilityHandler);
			options.onClose?.();
		};
		const unsubscribeHeader = store.subscribe((state, changedKeys) => {
			if (changedKeys.has("activeModeId")) {
				modeSelect.value = state.activeModeId;
				updateModeLayout(state.activeModeId);
			}
			if (changedKeys.has("runState") || changedKeys.has("statusText")) {
				updateResources();
				const isRunning = state.runState === "running";
				statusDot.className = `hwhbl-dot ${isRunning ? "hwhbl-dot--running" : state.runState === "error" ? "hwhbl-dot--error" : "hwhbl-dot--ready"}`;
				statusLabel.textContent = state.statusText || (isRunning ? "Симуляция..." : "Готов");
			}
		});
		const initialState = store.getState();
		modeSelect.value = initialState.activeModeId;
		updateModeLayout(initialState.activeModeId);
		statusLabel.textContent = initialState.statusText || "Готов к симуляциям";
		document.body.appendChild(overlay);
		requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			overlay.classList.add("hwhbl-visible");
		});
		return overlay;
	}

	var LAUNCHER_ELEMENT_ID = "hwhbattlelab-launcher-btn";
	var launcherElement = null;
	/**
	* Создаёт и монтирует плавающую кнопку запуска Battle Lab в интерфейс игры.
	*/
	function mountStandaloneLauncher(options) {
		ensureBattleLabStyles();
		if (launcherElement && document.body?.contains(launcherElement)) return launcherElement;
		const existing = document.getElementById(LAUNCHER_ELEMENT_ID);
		if (existing) existing.remove();
		const button = el("button", {
			id: LAUNCHER_ELEMENT_ID,
			className: "hwhbl-root hwhbl-launcher",
			title: "Открыть Battle Lab (Лаборатория боёв)",
			onClick: (e) => {
				e.preventDefault();
				e.stopPropagation();
				options.onOpen();
			}
		}, el("div", { className: "hwhbl-launcher-icon" }, renderBlIcon("swords", 16)), el("span", { text: "Battle Lab" }));
		launcherElement = button;
		if (document.body) document.body.appendChild(button);
		else window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => document.body.appendChild(button));
		return button;
	}

	function showBattleLabToast(message, durationMs = 3e3) {
		const toast = document.createElement("div");

		toast.style.background = "rgba(20, 24, 32, 0.92)";
		toast.style.backdropFilter = "blur(12px)";
		toast.style.border = "1px solid var(--hwhbl-border)";
		toast.style.boxShadow = "0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
		toast.textContent = typeof message === "string" ? message : message.title ? `${message.title}: ${message.message ?? message.description ?? message.text ?? ""}` : message.message ?? message.description ?? message.text ?? "";
		document.body.appendChild(toast);
		setTimeout(() => {
			toast.style.opacity = "0";
			toast.style.transition = "opacity 0.25s ease";
			setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
		}, durationMs);
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/ui/battle-notification.ts
	function buildBattleLabBattleNotification(battle, modeLabel, copy) {
		const error = battle.serverError;
		const titleKey = error ? "HWHBL_BATTLE_RESULT" : battle.result === "win" ? "HWHBL_VICTORY" : battle.result === "loss" ? "HWHBL_DEFEAT" : "HWHBL_UNKNOWN_RESULT";
		const opponent = battle.opponentName ?? `#${battle.opponentId}`;
		return {
			id: `hwhbattlelab-battle:${battle.modeId}:${battle.opponentId}:${battle.seed ?? battle.createdAt}`,
			title: copy[titleKey],
			text: `${modeLabel} · ${opponent}${error ? `\n${error}` : ""}`,
			tone: error ? "danger" : battle.result === "win" ? "success" : battle.result === "loss" ? "warning" : "info",
			timeoutMs: error ? 1e4 : 5e3,
			closeLabel: copy.HWHBL_CLOSE
		};
	}

	var heroWarsLocaleCodes = [
		"de",
		"en",
		"es",
		"fr",
		"it",
		"ru",
		"zh-cn",
		"zh-tw",

	var localeAliases = {
		"de-de": "de",
		"en-gb": "en",
		"en-us": "en",
		"es-es": "es",
		"fr-fr": "fr",
		"it-it": "it",
		"ja-jp": "ja",
		"ko-kr": "ko",
		"pt-br": "pt",
		"pt-pt": "pt",
		"ru-ru": "ru",
		"th-th": "th",
		"zh-hans": "zh-cn",
		"zh-hans-cn": "zh-cn",
		"zh-hant": "zh-tw",
		"zh-hant-tw": "zh-tw"
	};
	var knownLocales = new Set(heroWarsLocaleCodes);
	function normalizeHeroWarsLocale(value) {
		const normalized = String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll("_", "-");
		if (!normalized) return;
		if (knownLocales.has(normalized)) return normalized;
		return localeAliases[normalized];
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/shared/i18n.ts
	function resolveCurrentUserscriptId(fallbackId = "") {
		{
			const buildId = String("hwhbattlelab").trim();
			if (buildId) return buildId;
		}
		return String(globalThis.__HWHX_USERSCRIPT_ID__ ?? "").trim() || fallbackId;
	}
	/**
	* Определяет текущий код языка из NXFlashVars, navigator.language или i18nLangData.
	* @param {Object} [i18nLangData]
	* @returns {string}
	*/
	function getCurrentLanguageCode(i18nLangData = void 0) {
		const availableLanguages = Object.keys(i18nLangData ?? {});
		const candidateLanguages = [
			globalThis.NXFlashVars?.interface_lang,
			globalThis.document?.documentElement?.lang,
			...globalThis.navigator?.languages ?? [],
			globalThis.navigator?.language
		];
		for (const candidate of candidateLanguages) {
			const rawLanguage = String(candidate ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
			if (availableLanguages.includes(rawLanguage)) return rawLanguage;
			const normalizedLanguage = normalizeHeroWarsLocale(rawLanguage);
			if (normalizedLanguage && availableLanguages.includes(normalizedLanguage)) return normalizedLanguage;
			const shortLanguage = rawLanguage.split(/[-_]/u)[0] ?? "";
			if (availableLanguages.includes(shortLanguage)) return shortLanguage;
		}
		return availableLanguages.includes("en") ? "en" : availableLanguages[0] ?? "en";
	}
	/**
	* Проверяет, является ли перевод осмысленным: не пуст, не равен ключу и не содержит «undefined».
	* @param {*} text
	* @param {*} key
	* @returns {boolean}
	*/
	function isUsefulTranslation(text, key) {
		const value = String(text ?? "").trim();
		const normalizedKey = String(key ?? "").trim();
		return !!value && value !== normalizedKey && value !== `% ${normalizedKey} %` && value !== `%${normalizedKey}%` && !value.includes("undefined");
	}
	/**
	* Собирает отдельную таблицу перевода userscript-а без мутации общей таблицы
	* HeroWarsHelper. Она нужна виджетам, которые не должны перетирать ключи
	* соседнего userscript-а при обычной загрузке игры.
	*/
	function getScriptTranslations(translationsByLanguage = {}, { scriptId = "" } = {}) {
		return mergeTranslationTables(isCustomBuildEnabled() ? getCustomBuildTranslations(scriptId) : translationsByLanguage, getRuntimeTranslations(scriptId));
	}
	function getRuntimeTranslationRegistry() {
		const root = globalThis;
		return root.__HWHX_RUNTIME_TRANSLATIONS__ ?? (root.__HWHX_RUNTIME_TRANSLATIONS__ = Object.create(null));
	}
	function getRuntimeTranslations(scriptId) {
		const normalizedId = String(scriptId ?? "").trim();
		return normalizedId ? getRuntimeTranslationRegistry()[normalizedId] ?? {} : {};
	}
	function mergeTranslationTables(base, overrides) {
		const languages = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...Object.keys(base), ...Object.keys(overrides)]);
		return Object.fromEntries([...languages].map((language) => [language, {
			...base[language] ?? {},
			...overrides[language] ?? {}
		}]));
	}
	function isCustomBuildEnabled() {
		return false;
	}
	function getCustomBuildTranslations(scriptId) {
		if (!scriptId) return {};
		const payload = globalThis.__HWHX_CUSTOM_BUILDS__?.[scriptId];
		if (!payload || String(payload.scriptId ?? "") !== scriptId || !Array.isArray(payload.locales) || !payload.translations || typeof payload.translations !== "object") return {};
		const selectedLocales = new Set(payload.locales.map((locale) => String(locale ?? "").trim()).filter(Boolean));
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(payload.translations).filter(([locale, dictionary]) => selectedLocales.has(locale) && dictionary !== null && typeof dictionary === "object" && !Array.isArray(dictionary)));
	}
	/**
	* Создаёт функцию перевода с поддержкой game I18N, cheats и встроенных словарей.
	* @param {{I18N?: Function, cheats?: {translate?: Function}, i18nLangData?: Object, defaultLanguage?: string, fallbackLanguage?: string, preferGameI18N?: boolean, forceLanguage?: string}} [options]
	* @returns {(key: string, replacements?: Object) => string}
	*/
	function createTranslator({ I18N, cheats, i18nLangData, defaultLanguage = "en", fallbackLanguage = "en", preferGameI18N = true, forceLanguage = void 0, cacheMissingTranslations = false } = {}) {
		const resolvedTextCache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const language = forceLanguage ?? getCurrentLanguageCode(i18nLangData) ?? defaultLanguage;
		const readDictionary = (key) => String(i18nLangData?.[language]?.[key] ?? i18nLangData?.[fallbackLanguage]?.[key] ?? i18nLangData?.[defaultLanguage]?.[key] ?? "");
		return function translate(key, replacements) {
			const normalizedKey = String(key ?? "");
			const cachedText = resolvedTextCache.get(normalizedKey);
			let text = cachedText ?? "";
			if (cachedText === void 0) {
				if (!preferGameI18N) text = readDictionary(normalizedKey);
				if (!isUsefulTranslation(text, normalizedKey) && typeof I18N === "function") try {
					text = String(I18N(normalizedKey) ?? "");
				} catch {
					text = "";
				}
				if (!isUsefulTranslation(text, normalizedKey) && typeof cheats?.translate === "function") try {
					text = String(cheats.translate(normalizedKey) ?? "");
				} catch {
					text = "";
				}
				if (!isUsefulTranslation(text, normalizedKey)) text = readDictionary(normalizedKey);
				if (!isUsefulTranslation(text, normalizedKey)) text = normalizedKey;
				if (cacheMissingTranslations || text !== normalizedKey) resolvedTextCache.set(normalizedKey, text);
			}
			if (replacements) for (const [placeholder, value] of Object.entries(replacements)) text = String(text).split(`{${placeholder}}`).join(String(value));
			return String(text);
		};
	}

	var ICON_BODY_MARKUP = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
	function getIconNode(name) {
		return ICONS_BY_NAME[String(name ?? "")];
	}
	function buildAttributeMarkup(attributes) {
		let markup = "";
		for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
			if (value === void 0 || value === null || value === false) continue;
			markup += ` ${name}="${escapeHtml(value === true ? name : value)}"`;
		}
		return markup;
	}
	function renderIconNode(node) {
		if (!Array.isArray(node) || node.length < 2) return "";
		const [tagName, attributes = {}, children = []] = node;
		if (typeof tagName !== "string") return "";
		const childMarkup = Array.isArray(children) ? children.map((child) => renderIconNode(child)).join("") : "";
		return `<${tagName}${buildAttributeMarkup(isPlainObject(attributes) ? attributes : {})}>${childMarkup}</${tagName}>`;
	}
	/**
	* Рендерит SVG-иконку по имени из коллекции Lucide.
	*/
	function renderIcon(name, options = {}) {
		const normalizedName = String(name ?? "");
		const iconNode = getIconNode(normalizedName);
		if (!iconNode) return "";
		const size = Math.max(10, Number(options.size) || 16);
		const className = [String(options.className ?? "hwhx-lucide").trim(), options.animated === false ? "" : "hwhx-motion-icon"].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
		const title = String(options.title ?? "").trim();
		const titleMarkup = title ? `<title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title>` : "";
		return `<svg${buildAttributeMarkup({
			xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
			width: size,
			height: size,
			viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
			fill: "none",
			stroke: "currentColor",
			"stroke-width": options.strokeWidth ?? 2,
			"stroke-linecap": "round",
			"stroke-linejoin": "round",
			class: className,
			"data-hwhx-icon": normalizedName,
			...title ? {
				role: "img",
				"aria-label": title
			} : { "aria-hidden": "true" }
		})}>${titleMarkup}${getIconBodyMarkup(normalizedName, iconNode)}</svg>`;
	}
	function getIconBodyMarkup(name, iconNode) {
		const cached = ICON_BODY_MARKUP.get(name);
		if (cached !== void 0) return cached;
		const markup = iconNode.map((node) => renderIconNode(node)).join("");
		ICON_BODY_MARKUP.set(name, markup);
		return markup;
	}
	function renderInlineIcon(name, options = {}) {
		const className = ["hwhx-label-icon", options.className].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
		const title = String(options.title ?? "").trim();
		const tooltipAttribute = title ? ` data-hwhx-native-title="${escapeHtml(title)}"` : "";
		return `<span class="${escapeHtml(className)}"${tooltipAttribute}>${renderIcon(name, { size: options.size ?? 16 })}</span>`;
	}
	function renderIconLabel(name, label, options = {}) {
		return `<span class="${escapeHtml(["hwhx-icon-label", options.className].filter(Boolean).join(" "))}">${renderInlineIcon(name, {
			className: options.iconClassName,
			title: options.title,
			size: options.size ?? 15
		})}<span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span></span>`;
	}

	//#region src/shared/storage/settings-transfer.ts
	var SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE_TYPE = "hwhx:settings-transfer:download-json";
	var SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_BRIDGE_FLAG = "__hwhxSettingsDownloadBridgeInstalled";
	var SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
	var OPAQUE_ORIGIN = "null";
	/**
	* Проверяет, что текущий документ работает внутри iframe.
	*/
	function isNestedWindow() {
		try {
			return globalThis.self !== globalThis.top;
		} catch {
			return true;
		}
	}
	function normalizeOrigin(value) {
		const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
		if (!text || text === OPAQUE_ORIGIN) return "";
		try {
			const origin = new URL(text).origin;
			return origin === OPAQUE_ORIGIN ? "" : origin;
		} catch {
			return "";
		}
	}
	function getCurrentWindowOrigin() {
		return normalizeOrigin(globalThis.location?.origin) || normalizeOrigin(globalThis.location?.href);
	}
	function getAncestorOrigins() {
		const ancestorOrigins = globalThis.location?.ancestorOrigins;
		if (!ancestorOrigins) return [];
		return Array.from({ length: ancestorOrigins.length }, (_, index) => normalizeOrigin(ancestorOrigins[index])).filter(Boolean);
	}
	function getReferrerOrigin() {
		try {
			return normalizeOrigin(document.referrer);
		} catch {
			return "";
		}
	}
	function getTrustedAncestorOrigin() {
		return getAncestorOrigins()[0] || getReferrerOrigin();
	}
	function isTrustedSettingsDownloadOrigin(origin) {
		const normalizedOrigin = normalizeOrigin(origin);
		return !!(normalizedOrigin && [
			getCurrentWindowOrigin(),
			getReferrerOrigin(),
			...getAncestorOrigins()
		].includes(normalizedOrigin));
	}
	function isKnownChildWindow(source) {
		if (!source) return false;
		try {
			for (const frame of document.querySelectorAll("iframe")) if (frame.contentWindow === source) return true;
		} catch {}
		return false;
	}
	/**
	* Нормализует имя скачиваемого JSON, чтобы postMessage не протащил путь.
	*/
	function normalizeDownloadFileName(fileName) {
		const safeName = String(fileName ?? "settings.json").trim().replaceAll(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "_") || "settings.json";
		return safeName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".json") ? safeName : `${safeName}.json`;
	}
	/**
	* Скачивает текстовый файл через временный <a>-элемент.
	*/
	function downloadTextFile(fileName, content, mimeType) {
		const blob = new globalThis.Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
		const url = globalThis.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
		const link = document.createElement("a");
		link.href = url;
		link.download = normalizeDownloadFileName(fileName);
		link.style.display = "none";
		document.body.appendChild(link);
		link.click();
		link.remove();
		globalThis.setTimeout(() => globalThis.URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1e3);
	}
	/**
	* Проверяет, что bridge несет именно JSON, а не произвольный текст.
	*/
	function isSafeSettingsDownloadContent(value) {
		if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0 || value.length > SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH) return false;
		try {
			JSON.parse(value);
			return true;
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	}
	/**
	* Проверяет сообщение bridge-а экспорта настроек.
	*/
	function isSettingsDownloadMessage(value) {
		const message = value;
		return !!message && message.hwhx === "settings-transfer" && message.type === SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE_TYPE && isSafeSettingsDownloadContent(message.content);
	}
	function isTrustedSettingsDownloadEvent(event) {
		if (!isSettingsDownloadMessage(event.data)) return false;
		const source = event.source;
		if (!source || source === globalThis) return false;
		if (isKnownChildWindow(source)) return true;
		return isTrustedSettingsDownloadOrigin(event.origin);
	}
	/**
	* Ставит bridge для скачивания из top-window. В sandboxed iframe браузер режет
	* <a download>, поэтому сам файл должен скачать несандбоксенный родитель.
	*/
	function installSettingsDownloadBridge() {
		if (isNestedWindow()) return;
		const state = globalThis;
		if (state[SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_BRIDGE_FLAG]) return;
		state[SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_BRIDGE_FLAG] = true;
		globalThis.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
			if (isNestedWindow() || !isTrustedSettingsDownloadEvent(event)) return;
			downloadTextFile(event.data.fileName, event.data.content, "application/json;charset=utf-8");
		});
	}
	/**
	* Просит top-window скачать JSON-файл, если текущий документ в iframe.
	*/
	function requestTopWindowJsonDownload(fileName, content) {
		if (!isNestedWindow()) return false;
		const targetOrigin = getTrustedAncestorOrigin();
		if (!targetOrigin) return false;
		try {
			globalThis.top?.postMessage({
				hwhx: "settings-transfer",
				type: SETTINGS_DOWNLOAD_MESSAGE_TYPE,
				fileName,
				content
			}, targetOrigin);
			return true;
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	}
	/**
	* Скачивает JSON-файл напрямую или через top-window bridge для sandboxed iframe.
	*/
	function downloadJsonFile(fileName, value) {
		const content = `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`;
		installSettingsDownloadBridge();
		if (requestTopWindowJsonDownload(fileName, content)) return;
		downloadTextFile(fileName, content, "application/json;charset=utf-8");
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/history.ts

	/** Id бойцов противника по командам — для записей истории без снимка боя. */
	function opponentEnemyIds(opponent) {
		return opponent.teams.map((team) => team.units.map((unit) => Number(unit.id)).filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id)));
	}
	/**
	* `enemyTeams` — состав противника на случай, когда у результата нет снимка
	* (общий план Асгарда): по нему история отличает Оша от Маэстро.
	*/
	function buildCalculatedBattleHistory(bestResult, enemyTeams = []) {
		const snapshotEnemies = extractEnemyTeamIds(bestResult.battleSnapshot);
		return {
			id: `calculation:${bestResult.id}`,
			modeId: bestResult.modeId,
			opponentId: bestResult.opponentId,
			opponentName: bestResult.opponentName,
			createdAt: bestResult.createdAt,
			result: resolveCalculatedResult(bestResult.modeId, bestResult.wins),
			teamResults: bestResult.teamResults ?? [],
			damage: bestResult.damage ?? null,
			stars: bestResult.stars,
			teamIds: bestResult.teams.map((team) => [...team.unitIds, ...team.teamPetId ? [team.teamPetId] : []]),
			teams: bestResult.teams.map((team) => ({
				...team,
				unitIds: [...team.unitIds],
				totemIds: [...team.totemIds ?? []],
				totems: team.totems?.map((totem) => ({ ...totem })),
				favor: { ...team.favor }
			})),
			enemyTeamIds: snapshotEnemies.some((team) => team.length) ? snapshotEnemies : enemyTeams.map((team) => [...team]),
			battleSnapshot: bestResult.battleSnapshot ?? null,
			details: bestResult.details ?? null,
			timings: bestResult.timings,
			calculationCount: bestResult.calculationCount,
			score: bestResult.score,
			source: "battle-lab",
			direction: bestResult.direction ?? "attack",
			platformId: bestResult.platformId,
			replayKind: bestResult.replayKind ?? resolveBattleLabReplayKind(bestResult.modeId),
			battleType: readSnapshotString(bestResult.battleSnapshot, "type"),
			seed: readSnapshotNumber(bestResult.battleSnapshot, "seed")
		};
	}
	function readSnapshotString(snapshot, key) {
		const source = typeof snapshot === "object" && snapshot ? snapshot.battleData ?? snapshot : {};
		return String(source[key] ?? source.battleConfig ?? "");
	}
	function readSnapshotNumber(snapshot, key) {
		const value = Number((typeof snapshot === "object" && snapshot ? snapshot.battleData ?? snapshot : {})[key]);
		return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
	}
	function extractEnemyTeamIds(snapshot) {
		const source = typeof snapshot === "object" && snapshot ? snapshot.battleData ?? snapshot : {};
		if (Array.isArray(source.battles)) return source.battles.flatMap((battle) => extractEnemyTeamIds(battle && typeof battle === "object" ? battle : null));
		const defenders = source && typeof source === "object" ? source.defenders : null;
		return (Array.isArray(defenders) ? defenders : defenders ? [defenders] : []).map((team) => Object.values(team && typeof team === "object" ? team : {}).map((unit) => Number(unit?.id)).filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0));
	}
	function hasManualBattleTiming(actions) {
		return actions.some((action) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0);
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/archdemon-chapters.ts
	init_helpers();
	init_archdemon();
	function expandArchdemonChapters(opponents, library, translate) {
		const invasion = asRecord$1(library.invasion);
		const chapters = asRecord$1(invasion.chapter);
		const bosses = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(invasion.boss).list);
		const profiles = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const raw of Object.values(asRecord$1(invasion.phase))) {
			const phase = asRecord$1(raw);
			for (const [bossId, value] of Object.entries(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(phase.phaseData).boss))) {
				const config = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(value).eventConfig);
				const boss = asRecord$1(bosses[bossId]);
				const chapter = asRecord$1(chapters[String(phase.chapterId)]);
				if (config.type !== "bossGroupRating" || !chapter.id || !boss.team || !boss.level) continue;
				profiles.set(String(chapter.id), {
					chapter,
					bossId,
					config,
					signature: combatSignature(boss, config)
				});
			}
		}
		const sources = opponents.flatMap((opponent) => {
			try {
				const event = resolveArchdemonEvent(opponent, library);
				const profile = profiles.get(event.chapterId);
				return profile ? [{
					opponent,
					event,
					profile
				}] : [];
			} catch {
				return [];
			}
		});
		const result = [];
		const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		for (const source of sources) {
			const key = `${source.opponent.platformId}:${source.event.invasionId}`;
			if (groups.has(key)) continue;
			groups.add(key);
			const compatibleSources = sources.filter((item) => item.opponent.platformId === source.opponent.platformId && item.event.invasionId === source.event.invasionId);
			[...profiles.values()].filter((profile) => String(profile.chapter.invasionId) === source.event.invasionId).sort((a, b) => Number(a.chapter.id) - Number(b.chapter.id)).forEach((target, index) => {
				const reference = compatibleSources.find((item) => item.event.chapterId === String(target.chapter.id)) ?? compatibleSources.find((item) => item.profile.signature === target.signature);
				if (!reference) return;
				const context = structuredClone(reference.opponent.context);
				const battle = asRecord$1(context.battleData ?? context.battle);
				if (!battle.attackers || !battle.defenders) return;
				const alias = `boss_${target.bossId}_${target.chapter.id}`;
				const nativeInvasion = /^invasion_boss_\d+$/.test(String(battle.type));
				const preparedBattle = {
					...battle,
					type: nativeInvasion ? `invasion_boss_${target.bossId}` : battle.type,
					typeId: nativeInvasion ? battle.typeId : String(battle.typeId).startsWith("boss_") ? alias : target.bossId
				};
				context.battle = preparedBattle;
				if (context.battleData) context.battleData = preparedBattle;
				context.type = preparedBattle.type;
				context.typeId = preparedBattle.typeId;
				context.__battleLabStartArgs = {
					id: alias,
					chapterId: target.chapter.id
				};
				context.__battleLabReferenceChapterId = reference.event.chapterId;
				const multiplier = Number(target.config.damageMultiplier) || 1;
				context.__battleLabRatingMultiplier = multiplier;
				const locale = String(asRecord$1(target.chapter.clientData).titleLocale ?? "");
				const label = locale ? translate(locale) : "";
				const fallback = translate("HWHBL_ARCHDEMON_CHAPTER").replace("{number}", String(index + 1));
				result.push({
					...reference.opponent,
					id: `archdemon:${alias}`,
					externalId: alias,
					name: label && label !== locale ? label : fallback,
					detail: translate("HWHBL_ARCHDEMON_POINTS_MULTIPLIER").replace("{multiplier}", String(multiplier)),
					context,
					scenarios: void 0
				});
			});
		}
		return [...result, ...opponents.filter((opponent) => !sources.some((item) => item.opponent === opponent))];
	}

	function buildBattleLabHistoryOpponents(mode, history, library, translate = (key) => key) {
		const sourceModeId = mode.id === "dominion-rift" ? "invasion" : mode.id;
		const latest = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const entry of history) {
			if (!entry.battleSnapshot) continue;
			const archdemon = isArchdemonBattle(entry.battleSnapshot);
			if (mode.id === "archdemon") {
				if (!archdemon || entry.source !== "game") continue;
			} else if (entry.modeId !== sourceModeId || archdemon) continue;
			const externalId = historyExternalId(entry, archdemon);
			const key = `${entry.platformId}:${externalId}`;
			if (!latest.has(key)) latest.set(key, entry);
		}
		const opponents = normalizeBattleLabOpponents(mode, { targets: [...latest.values()].map((entry) => {
			const externalId = historyExternalId(entry, mode.id === "archdemon");
			const snapshot = asRecord$1(entry.battleSnapshot);
			const battle = asRecord$1(snapshot.battleData ?? snapshot.battle ?? snapshot);
			return {
				...snapshot,
				...battle,
				...mode.id === "archdemon" ? { battle } : {},
				id: externalId,
				typeId: battle.typeId ?? externalId,
				name: mode.id === "archdemon" ? "Архидемон" : entry.opponentName,
				platformId: entry.platformId,
				__battleLabHistoryEntryId: entry.id
			};
		}) });
		return mode.id === "archdemon" && library ? expandArchdemonChapters(opponents, library, translate) : opponents;
	}
	function historyExternalId(entry, archdemon) {
		if (archdemon) {
			const snapshot = asRecord$1(entry.battleSnapshot);
			const requestId = asRecord$1(snapshot.__battleLabStartArgs).id;
			const bossId = resolveArchdemonBossId(snapshot);
			if (requestId != null) return String(requestId);
			if (bossId) return bossId;
		}
		return extractExternalId(entry.opponentId, entry.modeId);
	}
	function extractExternalId(opponentId, modeId) {
		const prefix = `${modeId}:`;
		return opponentId.startsWith(prefix) ? opponentId.slice(prefix.length) : opponentId;
	}

	var HEX_DIRECTIONS = [
		[1, 1],
		[0, 1],
		[-1, 0],
		[-1, -1],
		[0, -1],
		[1, 0]
	];
	/**
	* Карта Территории приходит из текущей библиотеки игры в плоском виде
	* `id, q, r`. Переводим её в сетку один раз: дальше маршрутизация не зависит
	* от DOM, локали и визуального масштаба карты.
	*/
	function buildBattleLabTerritoryMap(gameLibrary, mapId) {
		const map = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.tiledMap).list)[mapId]).map);
		const rawCells = Array.isArray(map.cells) ? map.cells : [];
		if (rawCells.length < 3) return null;
		const extra = asRecord$1(map.mapExtraData);
		const castleIds = numberSet(extra.castleLevels);
		const townIds = numberSet(Object.keys(asRecord$1(extra.townLevels)));
		const chestIds = numberSet(extra.chestLevels);
		const cells = {};
		for (let index = 0; index + 2 < rawCells.length; index += 3) {
			const id = finiteNumber$1(rawCells[index], NaN);
			const q = finiteNumber$1(rawCells[index + 1], NaN);
			const r = finiteNumber$1(rawCells[index + 2], NaN);
			if (!Number.isInteger(id) || !Number.isFinite(q) || !Number.isFinite(r)) continue;
			cells[id] = {
				id,
				q,
				r,
				kind: resolveCellKind(id, castleIds, townIds, chestIds)
			};
		}
		if (Object.keys(cells).length === 0) return null;
		return {
			id: mapId,
			cells,
			attackCost: resolveRefillableAmount(extra.attackCost),
			actionCost: resolveRefillableAmount(extra.actionCost),
			visibilityRadius: finiteOrNull(extra.visibilityRadius)
		};
	}
	function getBattleLabTerritoryNeighbors(map, cellId) {
		const cell = map.cells[cellId];
		if (!cell) return [];
		const coordinateIndex = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const candidate of Object.values(map.cells)) coordinateIndex.set(coordinateKey(candidate.q, candidate.r), candidate.id);
		return HEX_DIRECTIONS.map(([dq, dr]) => coordinateIndex.get(coordinateKey(cell.q + dq, cell.r + dr))).filter((id) => id !== void 0);
	}
	function numberSet(values) {
		const source = Array.isArray(values) ? values : Object.keys(asRecord$1(values));
		return new Set(source.map((value) => finiteNumber$1(value, NaN)).filter(Number.isInteger));
	}
	function resolveCellKind(id, castleIds, townIds, chestIds) {
		if (castleIds.has(id)) return "castle";
		if (townIds.has(id)) return "town";
		if (chestIds.has(id)) return "chest";
		return "ordinary";
	}
	function resolveRefillableAmount(value) {
		const refillable = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(value).refillable);
		return Object.values(refillable).map((entry) => finiteNumber$1(entry, NaN)).find(Number.isFinite) ?? null;
	}
	function finiteOrNull(value) {
		const number = finiteNumber$1(value, NaN);
		return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
	}
	function coordinateKey(q, r) {
		return `${q}:${r}`;
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/history-recommendation.ts
	function findBattleLabHistoryMatch(opponent, history, options = {}) {
		const currentSignature = opponentLineupSignature(opponent);
		return history.filter((entry) => isEligible(entry, opponent, options)).map((entry) => ({
			entry,
			exactLineup: currentSignature.length > 0 && currentSignature === historyLineupSignature(entry)
		})).sort((left, right) => Number(right.exactLineup) - Number(left.exactLineup) || right.entry.createdAt - left.entry.createdAt)[0]?.entry;
	}
	function opponentLineupSignature(opponent) {
		return teamSignature(opponent.teams.map((team) => team.units.filter((unit) => unit.type !== "pet").map((unit) => Number(unit.id))));
	}
	function historyLineupSignature(entry) {
		return teamSignature(entry.enemyTeamIds);
	}
	function isEligible(entry, opponent, options) {
		if (entry.modeId !== opponent.modeId || entry.opponentId !== opponent.id) return false;
		if (entry.platformId !== "unknown" && opponent.platformId !== "unknown" && entry.platformId !== opponent.platformId) return false;
		if (options.winsOnly && entry.result !== "win") return false;
		if (options.requireTeams && (entry.teams?.length ?? 0) === 0) return false;
		if (options.direction && (entry.direction ?? "attack") !== options.direction) return false;
		return true;
	}
	function teamSignature(teams) {
		return teams.map((team) => [...new Set(team)].filter((unitId) => Number.isSafeInteger(unitId) && unitId > 0).filter((unitId) => unitId < 6e3 || unitId >= 7e3).sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")).filter(Boolean).join("/");
	}

	function learnBattleTiming(experiences, battle, opponent) {
		const reward = resolveBattleLabReward(battle);
		if (reward === null || battle.teamIds.length === 0 || battle.timings.length === 0) return [...experiences];
		const actions = normalizeActions$1(battle.timings);
		const teamSignature = getBattleLabTeamSignature(battle.teamIds);
		const enemySignature = getBattleLabEnemySignature(opponent, battle.enemyTeams);
		const actionSignature = getBattleLabActionSignature(actions);
		const id = [
			battle.modeId,
			teamSignature,
			enemySignature,
			actionSignature
		].join("|");
		const previous = experiences.find((item) => item.id === id);
		return [{
			id,
			modeId: battle.modeId,
			teamSignature,
			enemySignature,
			actionSignature,
			actions,
			observations: (previous?.observations ?? 0) + 1,
			rewardTotal: (previous?.rewardTotal ?? 0) + reward,
			updatedAt: battle.createdAt
		}, ...experiences.filter((item) => item.id !== id)].sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt - left.updatedAt).slice(0, 250);
	}
	function resolveBattleLabReward(battle) {
		if (battle.modeId === "asgard" && battle.damage != null && battle.damage > 0) return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Math.log10(battle.damage + 1) / 10));
		if (battle.result === "win") return 1;
		if (battle.result === "loss") return 0;
		return null;
	}
	function selectLearnedBattleTiming(experiences, modeId, teamIds, opponent) {
		const teamSignature = getBattleLabTeamSignature(teamIds);
		const enemySignature = getBattleLabEnemySignature(opponent);
		const best = experiences.filter((item) => item.modeId === modeId && item.teamSignature === teamSignature && item.observations > 0).map((item) => {
			const winRate = (item.rewardTotal + 1) / (item.observations + 2);
			const evidence = item.observations / (item.observations + 5);
			return {
				item,
				winRate,
				evidence,
				rank: (item.enemySignature === enemySignature ? 1 : 0) * 2 + winRate * .8 + evidence * .2
			};
		}).sort((left, right) => right.rank - left.rank)[0];
		if (!best) return null;
		return {
			actions: normalizeActions$1(best.item.actions),
			confidence: Math.min(.95, Math.max(.05, best.evidence * .8 + (best.item.enemySignature === enemySignature ? .15 : 0))),
			observations: best.item.observations,
			winRate: best.winRate
		};
	}
	function getBattleLabTeamSignature(teamIds) {
		return teamIds.map((team) => [...new Set(team.map(Number).filter((id) => Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0))].sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")).join("/");
	}
	function getBattleLabEnemySignature(opponent, observedTeams = []) {
		if (observedTeams.length > 0) return `complete:${observedTeams.map((team) => `complete:${team.map((unit) => unit.id).sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}`).join("/")}`;
		if (!opponent) return "unknown";
		return `${opponent.dataQuality}:${opponent.teams.map((team) => `${team.quality}:${team.units.map((unit) => unit.id).sort((left, right) => left - right).join(",")}`).join("/")}`;
	}
	function getBattleLabActionSignature(actions) {
		return normalizeActions$1(actions).map((action) => {
			if (action.type === "cast") return `cast:${action.time}:${action.unitId}`;
			if (action.type === "teamCustom") return `team:${action.time}:${action.value}`;
			return `auto:${action.time}`;
		}).join(",");
	}
	function normalizeActions$1(actions) {
		return actions.map((action) => ({ ...action })).sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time || actionPriority(left) - actionPriority(right));
	}
	function actionPriority(action) {
		if (action.type === "auto") return 0;
		if (action.type === "teamCustom") return 1;
		return 2;
	}

	function hydrateBattleLabOpponent(opponent, history) {
		if (opponent.dataQuality === "complete" || isTitanArenaMode(opponent.modeId)) return opponent;
		const serverAttacks = history.filter((item) => item.source === "game" && (item.direction ?? "attack") === "attack" && item.battleSnapshot !== null);
		const entry = findBattleLabHistoryMatch(opponent, serverAttacks) ?? serverAttacks.find((item) => opponent.modeId === "asgard" && item.modeId === "asgard" && item.battleSnapshot !== null);
		if (!entry?.battleSnapshot) return opponent;
		const battles = extractBattles(entry.battleSnapshot);
		if (battles.length === 0) return opponent;
		const defenders = battles.map((battle) => firstTeam$1(battle.defenders)).filter((team) => Object.keys(team).length > 0);
		if (defenders.length === 0) return opponent;
		const teams = defenders.map((team, index) => normalizeTeam(team, index));
		return {
			...opponent,
			dataQuality: "complete",
			teams,
			power: Math.max(opponent.power, teams.reduce((total, team) => total + team.power, 0)),
			context: {
				...opponent.context,
				...battles[0],
				battle: battles[0],
				battles,
				defenders,
				teams: defenders,
				__battleLabHydratedFromHistory: entry.id
			}
		};
	}
	function extractBattles(value) {
		const source = asPlainRecord(value);
		const nested = Array.isArray(source.battles) ? source.battles : [];
		return (nested.length > 0 ? nested : [source]).map((candidate) => {
			const record = asPlainRecord(candidate);
			return asPlainRecord(record.battleData ?? record.battle ?? record);
		}).filter((battle) => battle.attackers != null || battle.defenders != null);
	}
	function firstTeam$1(value) {
		if (!Array.isArray(value)) return asPlainRecord(value);
		return asPlainRecord(value[0]);
	}
	function normalizeTeam(value, index) {
		const units = Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => normalizeUnit$1(item, key)).filter((unit) => unit !== null);
		return {
			id: `history-team-${index + 1}`,
			units,
			power: units.reduce((total, unit) => total + finiteNumber$1(unit.power), 0),
			quality: "complete"
		};
	}
	function normalizeUnit$1(value, fallbackId) {
		const source = asPlainRecord(value);
		const id = positiveInteger(source.id ?? fallbackId);
		if (!id) return null;
		const type = source.type === "pet" || source.type === "titan" ? source.type : id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3 ? "pet" : "hero";
		return {
			...source,
			id,
			type
		};
	}

	var BattleLabWorkspaceRepository = class {
		constructor(accountId) {
			_defineProperty(this, "accountId", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "storage", new NativeKeyValueStore({
				databaseName: "hwh-battle-lab",

		async load() {

			} catch (error) {

		}

		}

	function normalizeWorkspace(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const settings = normalizeBattleLabSettings(source.settings);
		return cloneForStorage({
			schemaVersion: 6,
			bestResults: normalizeBestResults(source.bestResults).slice(0, 100),
			history: normalizeHistory(source.history).slice(0, settings.historyLimit),
			timingExperiences: normalizeTimingExperiences(source.timingExperiences).slice(0, 250),
			maxCalculations: clampCalculationCount(source.maxCalculations),
			settings,
			planningSetups: normalizePlanningSetups(source.planningSetups)
		});
	}
	function estimateBattleLabWorkspaceBytes(value) {
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakSet();
		const serialized = JSON.stringify(value, (_key, item) => {
			if (typeof item === "bigint") return String(item);
			if (typeof item === "function" || typeof item === "symbol") return void 0;
			if (item === null || typeof item !== "object") return item;
			if (seen.has(item)) return "[Circular]";
			seen.add(item);
			if (item instanceof Map) return Object.fromEntries(item);
			if (item instanceof Set) return [...item];
			if (item instanceof ArrayBuffer) return { byteLength: item.byteLength };
			if (ArrayBuffer.isView(item)) return { byteLength: item.byteLength };
			return item;
		}) ?? "";
		if (typeof TextEncoder === "function") return new TextEncoder().encode(serialized).byteLength;
		return serialized.length * 2;
	}
	function normalizeBestResults(value) {
		return normalizeItems(value).map((source) => ({
			...source,

			confidence: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.confidence, .5))),
			timings: normalizeActions(source.timings),
			timingSource: isTimingSource(source.timingSource) ? source.timingSource : "automatic",
			timingImprovement: nullableMetric(source.timingImprovement),
			simulatedTeamCount: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.simulatedTeamCount)),
			estimatedTeamCount: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.estimatedTeamCount)),
			direction: source.direction === "defense" ? "defense" : "attack",
			statistics: normalizeSimulationStatistics(source.statistics),
			teamResults: normalizeBattleResults(source.teamResults),
			damage: nullableMetric(source.damage),
			battleSnapshot: Object.keys(asRecord$1(source.battleSnapshot)).length > 0 ? cloneForStorage(asRecord$1(source.battleSnapshot)) : null,
			details: normalizeBattleDetails(source.details),
			platformId: normalizePlatformId(source.platformId),
			scenarioResults: normalizeScenarioResults(source.scenarioResults),

	function normalizeBestTeams(value) {
		return normalizeItems(value).map((team) => ({
			...team,
			unitIds: normalizeIds(team.unitIds),
			teamPetId: positiveInteger(team.teamPetId),
			bannerId: positiveInteger(team.bannerId),
			totemIds: normalizeIds(team.totemIds),
			totems: normalizeItems(team.totems).map((totem, index) => {
				const id = positiveInteger(totem.id);
				const element = normalizeTitanElement(totem.element);
				if (!id || !element) return null;
				return {
					id,
					element,
					level: Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(totem.level))),
					star: Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(totem.star))),
					power: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(totem.power)),
					slot: Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(totem.slot, index + 1)))
				};
			}).filter((totem) => totem !== null),
			units: normalizeItems(team.units).map((unit) => unit),
			teamPet: Object.keys(asRecord$1(team.teamPet)).length > 0 ? asRecord$1(team.teamPet) : null,
			banner: Object.keys(asRecord$1(team.banner)).length > 0 ? asRecord$1(team.banner) : null,
			favor: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(team.favor)).map(([heroId, petId]) => [heroId, positiveInteger(petId)]).filter((entry) => entry[1] !== null))
		}));
	}
	function normalizeTimingSearch(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const status = source.status;
		if (status !== "disabled" && status !== "unavailable" && status !== "searching" && status !== "found" && status !== "not-improved" && status !== "rejected") return;
		return {

			candidateCount: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.candidateCount)),
			teamCount: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.teamCount)),
			testedTeamCount: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.testedTeamCount)),
			reason: typeof source.reason === "string" && source.reason.trim() ? source.reason : null
		};
	}
	function normalizeScenarioResults(value) {
