			wins: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.wins)),
			scoreMean: finiteNumber$1(source.scoreMean),
			scoreDeviation: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.scoreDeviation)),
			confidenceLow: nullableMetric(source.confidenceLow),
			buff: nullableMetric(source.buff)
		}));
	}
	function normalizeSimulationStatistics(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		if (Object.keys(source).length === 0) return void 0;
		const succeeded = Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.succeeded));
		const failed = Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.failed));
		const winRate = nullableMetric(source.winRate);
		const explicitUnknown = nullableMetric(source.unknown);
		const unknown = Math.max(0, explicitUnknown ?? 0);
		const binarySamples = Math.max(0, succeeded - unknown);
		const wins = Math.max(0, nullableMetric(source.wins) ?? (winRate === null ? 0 : Math.round(winRate * binarySamples)));
		const losses = Math.max(0, nullableMetric(source.losses) ?? Math.max(0, binarySamples - wins));
		return {
			attempted: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.attempted)),
			succeeded,
			failed,
			wins,
			losses,
			unknown,
			winRate,
			scoreMean: finiteNumber$1(source.scoreMean),
			scoreMax: finiteNumber$1(source.scoreMax, finiteNumber$1(source.scoreMean)),
			scoreDeviation: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.scoreDeviation)),
			confidenceLow: nullableMetric(source.confidenceLow),
			confidenceHigh: nullableMetric(source.confidenceHigh)
		};
	}
	function normalizeHistory(value) {
		return normalizeItems(value).map((source) => {
			const battleId = String(source.battleId ?? "").trim();
			return {
				...source,
				...battleId ? { battleId } : {},
				teamResults: normalizeBattleResults(source.teamResults),
				teamIds: normalizeTeamIdLists(source.teamIds),
				teams: normalizeBestTeams(source.teams),
				enemyTeamIds: normalizeTeamIdLists(source.enemyTeamIds),
				battleSnapshot: Object.keys(asRecord$1(source.battleSnapshot ?? source.enemySnapshot)).length > 0 ? cloneForStorage(asRecord$1(source.battleSnapshot ?? source.enemySnapshot)) : null,
				details: normalizeBattleDetails(source.details),
				timings: normalizeActions(source.timings),
				direction: source.direction === "defense" ? "defense" : "attack",
				score: nullableMetric(source.score),
				platformId: normalizePlatformId(source.platformId),
				replayKind: normalizeReplayKind(source.replayKind, source.modeId),
				battleType: String(source.battleType ?? ""),
				seed: nullableMetric(source.seed)
			};
		});
	}
	function normalizePlatformId(value) {
		switch (value) {
			case "web":
			case "vk":
			case "ok":
			case "facebook":
			case "mygames":
			case "mailru":
			case "unknown": return value;
			default: return detectCurrentBattleLabPlatform();
		}
	}
	function normalizeReplayKind(value, modeId) {
		switch (value) {
			case "arena":
			case "grand-arena":
			case "asgard":
			case "adventure":
			case "ebr":
			case "invasion":
			case "lord":
			case "titan": return value;
			default: return resolveBattleLabReplayKind(String(modeId ?? "arena"));
		}
	}
	function normalizeBattleDetails(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const units = normalizeItems(source.units).map((unit) => {
			const unitId = positiveInteger(unit.unitId);
			if (!unitId) return null;
			const normalizeUnitMetric = (metric) => {
				const number = finiteNumber$1(metric, NaN);
				return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(0, number) : null;
			};
			return {
				unitId,
				side: unit.side === "defenders" ? "defenders" : "attackers",
				teamIndex: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(unit.teamIndex)),
				type: unit.type === "pet" || unit.type === "titan" ? unit.type : "hero",
				level: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.level),
				rank: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.rank),
				evolution: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.evolution),
				power: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.power),
				maxHp: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.maxHp),
				hpLeft: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.hpLeft),
				damageDealt: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.damageDealt),
				damageTaken: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.damageTaken),
				healing: normalizeUnitMetric(unit.healing)
			};
		}).filter((unit) => unit !== null);
		if (units.length === 0 && Object.keys(source).length === 0) return null;
		const duration = finiteNumber$1(source.duration, NaN);
		return {
			duration: Number.isFinite(duration) ? Math.max(0, duration) : null,
			units,
			battleCount: Math.max(1, finiteNumber$1(source.battleCount, 1))
		};
	}
	function normalizeBattleResults(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).map((result) => result === "win" || result === "loss" ? result : "unknown");
	}
	function normalizeTimingExperiences(value) {
		return normalizeItems(value).map((source) => ({
			...source,
			actions: normalizeActions(source.actions),
			observations: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.observations)),
			rewardTotal: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.rewardTotal)),
			updatedAt: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(source.updatedAt))
		}));
	}
	function normalizeActions(value) {
		if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
		return value.map((item) => {
			const action = asRecord$1(item);
			const time = finiteNumber$1(action.time, NaN);
			if (!Number.isFinite(time)) return null;
			if (action.type === "auto") return {
				type: "auto",
				time
			};
			if (action.type === "cast") {
				const unitId = positiveInteger(action.unitId);
				return unitId ? {
					type: "cast",
					unitId,
					time
				} : null;
			}
			if (action.type === "teamCustom") {
				const customValue = finiteNumber$1(action.value, NaN);
				return Number.isFinite(customValue) ? {
					type: "teamCustom",
					value: customValue,
					time
				} : null;
			}
			return null;
		}).filter((action) => action !== null);
	}
	function normalizeIds(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).map(positiveInteger).filter((id) => id !== null);
	}
	function normalizeTeamIdLists(value) {
		return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).filter(Array.isArray).map((team) => normalizeIds(team));
	}
	function isDataQuality(value) {
		return value === "complete" || value === "partial" || value === "hidden";
	}
	function isStrategy(value) {
		return value === "simulation" || value === "hybrid" || value === "estimate";
	}
	function isTimingSource(value) {
		return value === "calculated" || value === "learned" || value === "automatic";
	}
	function nullableMetric(value) {
		const number = Number(value);
		return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
	}
	function normalizeItems(value) {
		return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item) => Object.keys(asRecord$1(item)).length > 0) : [];
	}
	function cloneForStorage(value) {
		return cloneStorageValue(value, /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap());
	}
	function cloneStorageValue(value, seen) {
		if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return value;
		const cached = seen.get(value);
		if (cached !== void 0) return cached;
		if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value.getTime());
		if (value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return value.slice(0);
		if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return value.buffer.slice(value.byteOffset, value.byteOffset + value.byteLength);
		if (Array.isArray(value)) {
			const result = [];
			seen.set(value, result);
			for (const item of value) result.push(cloneStorageValue(item, seen));
			return result;
		}
		if (value instanceof Map) {
			const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			seen.set(value, result);
			for (const [key, item] of value) result.set(cloneStorageValue(key, seen), cloneStorageValue(item, seen));
			return result;
		}
		if (value instanceof Set) {
			const result = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			seen.set(value, result);
			for (const item of value) result.add(cloneStorageValue(item, seen));
			return result;
		}
		const result = {};
		seen.set(value, result);
		for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) {
			if (typeof item === "function" || typeof item === "symbol") continue;
			result[key] = cloneStorageValue(item, seen);
		}
		return result;
	}

	var SERVER_TIMEOUT_MS = 1e4;
	/** Запрос к серверу с лимитом ожидания: режим может быть закрыт, а игра — перезагружаться. */
	function sendBattleLabWithTimeout(caller, calls) {
		let timer;
		const timeout = new Promise((_, reject) => {
			timer = setTimeout(() => reject(/* @__PURE__ */ new Error("Сервер не ответил за 10 сек. Возможно, данный режим сейчас недоступен или игра перезагружается.")), SERVER_TIMEOUT_MS);
		});
		return Promise.race([caller.send(calls), timeout]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
	}
	/**
	* Противники обычного режима из серверного вызова режима. Для арен вместе
	* приходит состояние аккаунта, для приключения есть запасной соло-вызов.
	*/
	async function fetchBattleLabModeOpponents(caller, descriptor) {
		const modeId = descriptor.id;
		const includeArenaState = modeId === "arena" || modeId === "grand-arena";
		const opponentCalls = typeof descriptor.opponentCall === "string" ? [descriptor.opponentCall] : [...descriptor.opponentCall];
		const response = includeArenaState ? await sendBattleLabWithTimeout(caller, [...opponentCalls, "arenaGetAll"]) : await sendBattleLabWithTimeout(caller, descriptor.opponentCall);
		let opponents = normalizeBattleLabOpponents(descriptor, modeId === "epic-brawl" && Array.isArray(response) ? {
			...asRecord$1(response[0]),
			...asRecord$1(response[1]),
			enemy: asRecord$1(response[1]).enemy ?? response[1]
		} : Array.isArray(response) ? response[0] : response);
		if (modeId === "adventure" && opponents.length === 0) try {
			opponents = normalizeBattleLabOpponents(descriptor, await sendBattleLabWithTimeout(caller, "adventureSolo_getInfo")).map((opponent) => ({
				...opponent,
				context: {
					...opponent.context,
					__battleLabAdventureSolo: true
				}
			}));
		} catch {}
		return {
			opponents,
			...includeArenaState && Array.isArray(response) ? { accountState: normalizeBattleLabAccountState(response[1]) } : {}
		};
	}

	/** Подтверждение отправки на сервер; без `confirm` в окружении — отказа нет. */
	function confirmBattleLabAction(enabled, message) {
		return !enabled || typeof globalThis.confirm !== "function" || globalThis.confirm(message);
	}
	/** Статус автопрохода Турнира; null — фаза не меняет текст. */
	function formatTournamentAutomationStatus(progress, translate) {
		const level = progress.level ?? "—";
		if (progress.phase === "defense") return translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_DEFENSE", { level });
		if (progress.phase === "planning") return translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_PLANNING", {
			level,
			opponent: progress.opponent?.name ?? "—"
		});
		if (progress.phase === "attacking") return translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_ATTACKING", {
			level,
			battle: progress.battles + 1
		});
		if (progress.phase === "advancing") return translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_ADVANCING", { level });
		return null;
	}
	/** Статус автопрохода Вторжения. */
	function formatInvasionAutomationStatus(progress) {
		if (progress.phase === "chapter") return `Вторжение · переход к следующей главе · боёв: ${progress.battles}`;
		return `Вторжение · ${progress.action?.boss ? "Архидемон" : `точка ${progress.action?.number ?? "—"}`} · боёв: ${progress.battles}`;
	}

	/** Консольная диагностика: геттеры читают живое состояние, а не снимок на старте. */
	function exposeBattleLabDiagnostics(source) {
		const runtimeRoot = globalThis;
		runtimeRoot.HWHBattleLabDiagnostics = {
			get version() {
				return readBattleLabUserscriptInfo().version;
			},
			get menuRegistered() {
				return source.readMenu() !== null;
			},
			get menuDescriptorRegistered() {
				return source.readMenu()?.descriptorRegistered ?? false;
			},
			get menuMounted() {
				return source.readMenu()?.mounted ?? false;
			},
			get menuPlacement() {
				return source.readMenu()?.placement ?? null;
			},
			get menuMountAttempt() {
				return source.readMenuMountAttempt();
			},
			get runtimeReady() {
				return source.readRuntime().ready;
			},
			get runtimeStarting() {
				return source.readRuntime().starting;
			},
			get lastError() {
				const { error } = source.readRuntime();
				return error ? getErrorMessage(error) : null;
			},
			get territoryCapture() {
				return readBattleLabTerritoryCapture();
			},
			get territoryCaptureHistory() {
				return readBattleLabTerritoryCaptureHistory();
			},
			get territorySnapshot() {
				return readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot();
			},
			get territoryMaps() {
				return [3, 4].map((mapId) => buildBattleLabTerritoryMap(readBattleLabGameLibrary(globalThis.lib), mapId)).filter((map) => map !== null);
			},
			campaignDiagnostic(mode) {
				return readBattleLabCampaignDiagnostic(mode);
			},
			open: source.open
		};
	}
	/** Сообщение о старте показывается тостом и, если есть, прогрессом HWH. */
	function showBootstrapStatus(message) {
		showBattleLabToast(message);
		const funcs = globalThis.HWHFuncs;
		if (typeof funcs?.setProgress !== "function") return;
		try {
			funcs.setProgress(message, 4e3);
		} catch {}
	}
	/** Регистрирует расширение в списке HWH, если хелпер это поддерживает. */
	function registerBattleLabHelperExtension() {
		const scriptInfo = readBattleLabUserscriptInfo();
		const hwhFuncs = globalThis.HWHFuncs;
		if (typeof hwhFuncs?.addExtentionName === "function") hwhFuncs.addExtentionName(scriptInfo.name, scriptInfo.version, scriptInfo.author);
	}

	/** Ростер редактора: тип бойца проставляется явно, знамёна редактор не выбирает. */

		}));
		return {
			heroes: typed(account.heroes, "hero"),
			titans: typed(account.titans, "titan"),
			pets: typed(account.pets, "pet"),

				allowFavorPets: true,
				allowBanner: false
			}
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/asgard-live-options.ts
	init_asgard_buff_planning();
	/**
	* Живое улучшение Асгарда пишет прогресс каждой пачки прямо в модель окна:
	* пачка находится по составу, потому что порядок героев в ответе может отличаться.
	*/
	function createAsgardLiveTimingOptions(model, opponentId, extra) {
		return {
			enabled: true,
			minTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
			maxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
			maxCalculations: 999999,
			pipeline: model.settings.asgardPipelineAttacks,
			...extra,
			onTeamProgress: (progress) => {
				const current = model.asgardAttackProgress;
				if (!current || current.opponentId !== opponentId) return;
				model.asgardAttackProgress = {
					...current,
					teams: current.teams.map((team) => team.unitIds.length === progress.unitIds.length && team.unitIds.every((id) => progress.unitIds.includes(id)) ? {
						...team,
						...progress
					} : team)
				};
			},
			onProgress: ({ completed, bestDamage, remainingMs }) => {
				model.attackCountdownMs = remainingMs ?? null;
				model.attackStatusText = `Асгард · серверный seed ${completed} · максимум ${Math.trunc(bestDamage).toLocaleString("ru-RU")}`;
			}
		};
	}
	/**
	* Пауза атаки серией на шаге «Купить»: модель показывает, что докупить,
	* а серия ждёт подтверждения игрока. Покупка делается в игре, не скриптом.
	*/
	function createAsgardPurchaseGate(model) {
		let pending = null;
		return {
			wait: (counts, names = {}) => new Promise((resolve) => {
				model.asgardPurchasePrompt = counts;
				model.attackStatusText = `Купи в игре: ${Object.entries(counts).map(([slot, count]) => `${names[slot] ?? slot} ×${count}`).join(", ")} — и нажми «Купил, продолжить».`;
				pending = (proceed) => {
					pending = null;
					model.asgardPurchasePrompt = null;
					resolve(proceed);
				};
			}),
			resolve: (proceed) => {
				if (!pending) return false;
				pending(proceed);
				return true;
			}
		};
	}
	/** Подписи слотов магазина баффов для подсказок серии. */
	function asgardBuffSlotNames(opponent, library, translate) {
		return Object.fromEntries(readAsgardPlanningBuffs(opponent, library, translate).map((buff) => [buff.slotId, buff.name]));
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/territory-targets.ts
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* Для автоатаки годятся только подтверждённые противники на соседней клетке.
	* Пустая или неизвестная принадлежность гильдии не становится целью по
	* догадке: `startBattle` на союзника или дальнюю клетку сервер справедливо
	* отвергнет.
	*/
	function buildBattleLabTerritoryAttackTargets(snapshot, maps) {
		if (!snapshot.guildId || snapshot.position === null) return [];
		const map = maps.find((candidate) => candidate.cells[snapshot.position]);
		if (!map) return [];
		const visible = new Set(snapshot.visiblePositions);
		return getBattleLabTerritoryNeighbors(map, snapshot.position).flatMap((position) => {
			if (!visible.has(position)) return [];
			const town = asRecord$1(snapshot.towns[String(position)]);
			const userId = String(town.userId ?? town.ownerId ?? "").trim();
			if (!town.status || !userId || userId === snapshot.userId) return [];
			const user = asRecord$1(snapshot.users[userId]);
			const guildId = readGuildId(user) ?? readGuildId(town);
			if (!guildId || guildId === snapshot.guildId) return [];
			return [{
				position,
				userId,
				guildId,
				name: String(user.name ?? town.userName ?? town.name ?? `Игрок ${userId}`)
			}];
		}).sort((left, right) => left.position - right.position);
	}
	function readGuildId(value) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const nested = asRecord$1(source.clan ?? source.guild ?? source.team);
		const id = String(source.clanId ?? source.guildId ?? source.teamId ?? nested.id ?? "").trim();
		return id && id !== "0" ? id : null;
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/territory-enemy.ts
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* `getEnemyTeams` менял обёртку между версиями клиента, но сами бойцы всегда
	* приходят коллекцией. До расчёта допускаем только полный набор боевых статов:
	* одних id или силы недостаточно, иначе получится фальшивая победа.
	*/
	function summarizeBattleLabTerritoryEnemy(response) {
		const root = asRecord$1(response);
		const team = firstTeam(root.teams ?? root.enemyTeams ?? root.defenders ?? root.defense ?? root.team ?? root.units ?? root);
		const units = Object.entries(asRecord$1(team)).map(([key, value]) => normalizeUnit(value, key)).filter((unit) => unit !== null);
		return {
			units,
			power: Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(team).power, units.reduce((total, unit) => total + finiteNumber$1(unit.power), 0))),
			quality: units.length === 0 ? "hidden" : units.every(hasBattleStats) ? "complete" : "partial"
		};
	}
	function firstTeam(value) {
		if (!Array.isArray(value)) return value;
		if (value.length === 0) return [];
		const first = value[0];
		const record = asRecord$1(first);
		return Array.isArray(first) || !positiveInteger(record.id) && Object.keys(record).length > 0 ? first : value;
	}
	function normalizeUnit(value, fallbackId) {
		const source = asRecord$1(value);
		const id = positiveInteger(source.id ?? fallbackId);
		if (!id) return null;
		const type = source.type === "titan" || id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3 ? "titan" : "hero";
		return {
			...source,
			id,
			type
		};
	}
	function hasBattleStats(unit) {
		const source = asRecord$1(unit);
		const hp = finiteNumber$1(source.hp, NaN);
		const attack = Math.max(finiteNumber$1(source.physicalAttack, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY), finiteNumber$1(source.magicAttack, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY), finiteNumber$1(source.intelligence, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY));
		return Number.isFinite(hp) && hp > 0 && Number.isFinite(attack) && attack >= 0;
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/territory-opponents.ts
	init_platform();
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* В обычный подбор попадают только соседние цели с полной серверной командой.
	* Позиция остаётся в контексте: именно её ждёт `clanDomination_startBattle`,
	* а не id владельца города.
	*/
	function buildBattleLabTerritoryOpponents(snapshot, maps) {
		const map = maps.find((candidate) => snapshot.position !== null && candidate.cells[snapshot.position]);
		const atCastle = snapshot.position !== null && map?.cells[snapshot.position]?.kind === "castle";
		const currentTeam = readTerritoryDefenseTeam(snapshot.defense);
		return buildBattleLabTerritoryAttackTargets(snapshot, maps).flatMap((target) => {
			const enemy = summarizeBattleLabTerritoryEnemy(snapshot.enemyTeams[String(target.position)]);
			if (enemy.quality !== "complete") return [];
			const unitType = enemy.units.every((unit) => unit.type === "titan") ? "titan" : "hero";
			return [{
				id: `territory:${snapshot.eventId}:${target.position}`,
				externalId: String(target.position),
				modeId: "territory",
				name: target.name,
				detail: `Точка #${target.position} · гильдия ${target.guildId}`,
				position: target.position,
				power: enemy.power,
				teams: [{
					id: "team-1",
					units: enemy.units,
					power: enemy.power,
					quality: "complete",
					supports: []
				}],
				dataQuality: "complete",
				platformId: detectCurrentBattleLabPlatform(),
				context: {
					targetId: target.position,
					position: target.position,
					userId: target.userId,
					guildId: target.guildId,
					defenders: toBattleUnitRecord(enemy.units),
					teams: [toBattleUnitRecord(enemy.units)],
					enemyTeamKnowledge: ["complete"],
					__battleLabUnitType: unitType,
					battleUnitType: unitType,
					__battleLabTerritoryEventId: snapshot.eventId,
					__battleLabTerritoryAtCastle: atCastle,
					__battleLabTerritoryCurrentTeam: currentTeam,
					__battleLabTerritoryDefenseState: snapshot.defenseState ?? {}
				}
			}];
		});
	}
	function readTerritoryDefenseTeam(defense) {
		const root = defense && typeof defense === "object" ? defense : {};
		const units = root.units ?? root.heroes ?? root.team ?? defense;
		const unitIds = (Array.isArray(units) ? units : Object.values(units && typeof units === "object" ? units : {})).map((value) => {
			const id = Number((value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {}).id ?? value);
			return Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
		}).filter((id) => id !== null).sort((left, right) => left - right);
		const pet = root.pet ?? root.teamPet;
		const bannerId = Number(root.banner ?? root.bannerId ?? (Array.isArray(root.banners) ? root.banners : [])[0] ?? 0);
		const petId = Number((pet && typeof pet === "object" ? pet.id : pet) ?? 0);
		return {
			unitIds,
			petId: Number.isSafeInteger(petId) && petId > 0 ? petId : null,
			bannerId: Number.isSafeInteger(bannerId) && bannerId > 0 ? bannerId : null,
			favor: root.favor && typeof root.favor === "object" ? { ...root.favor } : {}
		};
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/territory-progress.ts
	/**
	* После `clanDomination_startBattle` нельзя строить следующий маршрут по
	* локальному оптимистичному счётчику. Продолжение разрешено лишь тогда, когда
	* свежий ответ сервера подтвердил фактический расход хода.
	*/
	function hasBattleLabTerritoryActionProgress(beforeActionPoints, afterActionPoints) {
		return Number.isFinite(beforeActionPoints) && typeof afterActionPoints === "number" && Number.isFinite(afterActionPoints) && afterActionPoints < beforeActionPoints;
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/territory-locked-candidate.ts
	init_helpers();
	/**
	* Вне замка ТЗ запрещает менять не только героев, но и поддержки. Калькулятор
	* должен оценивать установленный сервером состав целиком, иначе результат
	* нельзя будет отправить в бой.
	*/
	function readBattleLabTerritoryLockedCandidate(opponent) {
		if (opponent.modeId !== "territory" || opponent.context.__battleLabTerritoryAtCastle === true) return null;
		const team = asRecord$1(opponent.context.__battleLabTerritoryCurrentTeam);
		const heroes = Array.isArray(team.unitIds) ? team.unitIds.map(positiveInteger).filter((id) => id !== null) : [];
		if (heroes.length !== 5 || new Set(heroes).size !== heroes.length) return null;
		const heroIds = new Set(heroes);
		const favor = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(asRecord$1(team.favor)).flatMap(([heroId, petId]) => {
			const hero = positiveInteger(heroId);
			const pet = positiveInteger(petId);
			return hero && pet && heroIds.has(hero) ? [[String(hero), pet]] : [];
		}));
		return {
			type: "hero",
			heroes,
			teamPet: positiveInteger(team.petId) ?? 0,
			favor,
			banner: positiveInteger(team.bannerId) ?? 0,
			approxScore: 0
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/territory-service.ts
	init_helpers();
	init_server_battle_response();
	init_territory_capture();
	var TERRITORY_INFO_CALL = "clanDomination_getInfo";
	var TERRITORY_MAP_CALL = "clanDomination_mapState";
	var TERRITORY_ENEMIES_CALL = "clanDomination_getEnemyTeams";
	/**
	* Запрашивает актуальное состояние Территории у сервера. Журнал и push нужны
	* только как дополнительный контекст: первый снимок берём без боя и без клика
	* по клетке.
	*/
	async function fetchBattleLabTerritorySnapshot(caller) {
		const identity = parseBattleLabServerResponse(await caller.send("userGetInfo"));
		if (identity.error) throw new Error(identity.error);
		const owner = readTerritoryOwner(identity.payload);
		if (!owner.id) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул идентификатор игрока для карты ТЗ.");
		const calls = [{
			name: TERRITORY_INFO_CALL,
			args: {},
			ident: "battleLabTerritoryInfo"
		}, {
			name: TERRITORY_MAP_CALL,
			args: {},
			ident: "battleLabTerritoryMap"
		}];
		const response = await caller.send(calls);
		const { error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(response);
		if (error) throw new Error(error);
		saveBattleLabTerritoryCapture(calls, response, owner);
		return readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot();
	}
	/**
	* Состав над соседней клеткой сервер открывает отдельным запросом. Ошибка
	* означает, что точка успела стать недоступной; это не повод ломать снимок
	* карты или атаковать по устаревшей цели.
	*/
	async function fetchBattleLabTerritoryEnemyTeams(caller, position) {
		const call = {
			name: TERRITORY_ENEMIES_CALL,
			args: { levelId: position },
			ident: "battleLabTerritoryEnemy:" + position
		};
		const response = await caller.send(call);
		saveBattleLabTerritoryCapture([call], response);
		const { payload, error } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(response);
		return error ? null : asRecord$1(payload);
	}
	function readTerritoryOwner(value) {
		const root = asRecord$1(value);
		const guild = asRecord$1(root.clan ?? root.guild ?? root.team);
		const id = String(root.id ?? root.userId ?? root.uid ?? "").trim();
		const guildId = String(root.clanId ?? root.guildId ?? root.teamId ?? guild.id ?? "").trim();
		return {
			id,
			guildId: guildId && guildId !== "0" ? guildId : null
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/tournament-auto-runner.ts
	init_helpers();
	init_opponent_normalizer();
	var DEFAULT_MAX_BATTLES = 100;
	var DEFAULT_MAX_TIER_TRANSITIONS = 12;
	var MAX_STAGNANT_BATTLES = 3;
	var TERMINAL_STATUSES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
		"completed",
		"disabled",
		"finished",
		"closed",
		"peace_time"
	]);
	/**
	* Ведёт Турнир по серверному состоянию, а не по локальному счётчику. После
	* каждого боя и перехода перечитывается статус, поэтому зависший ответ не
	* превращается в бесконечную мясорубку попыток.
	*/
	async function runBattleLabTournamentAutomation({ signal, load, prepareDefense, prepareAttack, attack, advanceTier, maxBattles = DEFAULT_MAX_BATTLES, maxTierTransitions = DEFAULT_MAX_TIER_TRANSITIONS, scope = "all", onProgress }) {
		const battleLimit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBattles));
		const transitionLimit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxTierTransitions));
		const preparedDefenseLevels = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		let battles = 0;
		let completedTiers = 0;
		let stagnantBattles = 0;
		let snapshot = await load();
		const emit = (phase, opponent = null) => {
			onProgress?.({
				phase,
				level: snapshot.state.level,
				battles,
				completedTiers,
				opponent
			});
		};
		emit("loading");
		while (!signal.aborted) {
			if (isTerminalTournamentState(snapshot.state)) {
				emit("done");
				return buildResult(snapshot, battles, completedTiers, false);
			}
			if (isBattleLabTournamentTierComplete(snapshot.state)) {
				if (scope === "current-tier") {
					emit("done");
					return buildResult(snapshot, battles, 1, false);
				}
				if (completedTiers >= transitionLimit) throw new Error(`Автопрохождение остановлено после ${transitionLimit} переходов: сервер не вернул конечное состояние Турнира.`);
				const before = tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot);
				const completedLevel = snapshot.state.level;
				emit("advancing");
				snapshot = await advanceTier(snapshot);
				completedTiers += 1;
				if (tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot) === before && !isFinalCompletedLevel(completedLevel, snapshot.state.maxLevel)) throw new Error("После titanArenaCompleteTier сервер не сменил уровень Турнира.");
				if (tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot) === before && isFinalCompletedLevel(completedLevel, snapshot.state.maxLevel)) {
					emit("done");
					return buildResult(snapshot, battles, completedTiers, false);
				}
				continue;
			}
			if (snapshot.opponents.length === 0) throw new Error("Турнир активен, но сервер не вернул ни одного доступного соперника.");
			const levelKey = String(snapshot.state.level ?? tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot));
			if (snapshot.state.canSetDefense && !preparedDefenseLevels.has(levelKey)) {
				emit("defense");
				await prepareDefense(snapshot);
				if (signal.aborted) break;
				preparedDefenseLevels.add(levelKey);
				snapshot = await load();
				continue;
			}
			if (battles >= battleLimit) throw new Error(`Автопрохождение остановлено после ${battleLimit} боёв: сработал предохранитель от бесконечного цикла.`);
			const opponent = snapshot.opponents[0];
			const before = tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot);
			emit("planning", opponent);
			const result = await prepareAttack(opponent, snapshot);
			if (signal.aborted) break;
			emit("attacking", opponent);
			await attack(opponent, result);
			battles += 1;
			snapshot = await load();
			stagnantBattles = before === tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot) ? stagnantBattles + 1 : 0;
			if (stagnantBattles >= MAX_STAGNANT_BATTLES) throw new Error("Три боя подряд не изменили очки и список соперников. Автопрохождение остановлено, чтобы не сжечь попытки впустую.");
		}
		emit("stopped");
		return buildResult(snapshot, battles, completedTiers, true);
	}
	function isTerminalTournamentState(state) {
		return TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(state.status);
	}
	function tournamentSnapshotFingerprint(snapshot) {
		const opponents = snapshot.opponents.map((opponent) => {
			const score = finiteNumber$1(asRecord$1(opponent.context).attackScore, -1);
			return `${opponent.externalId}:${score}`;
		}).sort().join("|");
		return [
			snapshot.state.level ?? "?",
			snapshot.state.status,
			snapshot.state.completedOpponents,
			snapshot.state.remainingOpponents,
			opponents
		].join(":");
	}
	function isFinalCompletedLevel(level, maxLevel) {
		return level !== null && maxLevel !== null && level >= maxLevel;
	}
	function buildResult(snapshot, battles, completedTiers, stopped) {
		return {
			battles,
			completedTiers,
			stopped,
			state: snapshot.state
		};
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/asgard-training.ts
	init_planning_setup();
	init_optimizer_adapter();
	init_fixed_team_candidates();
	init_asgard_buff_planning();
	init_calc_executor();
	/** Тренирует каждую собранную строку своим бюджетом N, не отдавая весь бюджет первой пачке. */
	async function trainAsgardTeams(options, dependencies = {
		fetchAccountSnapshot,
		trainBattleLabResult,
		hasWorkerPool: () => getBattleLabCalcExecutor() !== null
	}) {
		const startedAt = Date.now();
		const assembled = options.setup.teams.map((ids, slot) => ({
			ids,
			slot
		})).filter((row) => row.ids.length === 5 && (options.selectedTeamIndices === void 0 || options.selectedTeamIndices.includes(row.slot)));
		const total = options.runsPerTeam * assembled.length;
		if (!assembled.length) throw new Error("Собери хотя бы одну пачку из пяти героев перед тренировкой.");
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.runsPerTeam) || options.runsPerTeam < 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(total)) throw new Error("Укажи положительное целое число тренировок; общий счётчик должен помещаться в безопасное целое число.");
		const account = options.accountSnapshot ?? await dependencies.fetchAccountSnapshot(options.caller);
		validateFixedTeams(assembled.map((row) => row.ids), Object.keys(account.heroes).map(Number));
		const supports = planningFixedTeamSupports(options.setup);
		let buffPlan = options.setup.asgardBuffMode === "manual" ? priceAsgardBuffPlan(readAsgardPlanningBuffs(options.opponent, options.gameLibrary, (key) => key), options.setup.asgardBuffCounts) : void 0;
		const mode = resolveBattleMode(options.opponent, account, "attack");
		const teams = assembled.map(({ ids, slot }) => {
			const candidates = generateFixedTeamCandidates({
				account,
				gameLibrary: options.gameLibrary,
				mode
			}, [ids], options.opponent.context, mode, [supports[slot]]).filter((candidate) => candidate.type === "hero");
			const previous = options.bestResult?.teams.find((team) => sameIds(team.unitIds, ids));
			const candidate = candidates.find((option) => previous && option.teamPet === (previous.teamPetId ?? 0) && option.banner === (previous.bannerId ?? 0) && JSON.stringify(Object.entries(option.favor).sort()) === JSON.stringify(Object.entries(previous.favor).sort())) ?? candidates.sort((a, b) => b.approxScore - a.approxScore)[0];
			if (!candidate) throw new Error(`Для пачки ${slot + 1} недоступны выбранные герои или питомцы.`);
			const unchanged = previous && candidate.teamPet === (previous.teamPetId ?? 0) && Object.keys({
				...candidate.favor,
				...previous.favor
			}).every((key) => candidate.favor[key] === previous.favor[key]);
			return {
				unitIds: [...ids],
				teamPetId: candidate.teamPet || null,
				bannerId: candidate.banner || null,
				favor: { ...candidate.favor },
				units: ids.map((id) => account.heroes[id]),
				teamPet: candidate.teamPet ? account.pets[candidate.teamPet] : null,
				timings: unchanged ? previous.timings : [{
					type: "auto",
					time: 0
				}]
			};
		});
		const template = options.bestResult ?? {
			id: `${options.opponent.id}:manual`,
			modeId: "asgard",
			opponentId: options.opponent.id,
			opponentName: options.opponent.name,
			createdAt: Date.now(),
			calculationCount: 0,
			elapsedMs: 0,
			score: 0,
			wins: null,
			stars: null,
			teams,
			dataQuality: options.opponent.dataQuality,
			strategy: "simulation",
			confidence: 0,
			timings: [{
				type: "auto",
				time: 0
			}],
			timingSource: "automatic",
			simulatedTeamCount: 0,
			estimatedTeamCount: 0,
			direction: "attack",
			platformId: options.opponent.platformId
		};
		let buffRunsPerTeam = 0;
		if (options.setup.asgardBuffMode === "auto") {
			const catalog = readAsgardPlanningBuffs(options.opponent, options.gameLibrary, (key) => key);
			if (!catalog.length) throw new Error("В снимке нет доступного магазина усилений Асгарда. Обнови противника.");
			const maxTrials = Math.min(128, Math.floor((options.runsPerTeam - 1) / 3));
			if (maxTrials < 1) throw new Error("Для подбора усилений нужно хотя бы 4 расчёта на пачку.");
			let bestBuffPreview;
			let bestBuffScore = -Infinity;
			buffPlan = (await searchAsgardBuffPlans({
				catalog,
				coinBudget: readAsgardBuffCoinBudget(options.opponent, options.setup.coinBudget),
				goldBudget: options.setup.goldBudget,
				maxTrials,
				bounded: true,
				signal: options.signal,
				evaluate: async (plan) => {
					const trialOne = async (team) => {
						const trial = await dependencies.trainBattleLabResult({
							...options,
							accountSnapshot: account,
							bestResult: {
								...template,
								teams: [team],
								asgardBuffPlan: plan,
								timings: [{
									type: "auto",
									time: 0
								}],
								variations: void 0
							},
							maxCalculations: 3,
							ultraTimingEnabled: false,
							scenarios: [],
							onProgress: void 0,
							onProcess: void 0
						});
						if (trial.calculationCount !== 3) throw new Error("Подбор усилений не завершил контрольные расчёты.");
						return trial;
					};
					const trials = dependencies.hasWorkerPool?.() ? await Promise.all(teams.map(trialOne)) : await teams.reduce(async (done, team) => [...await done, await trialOne(team)], Promise.resolve([]));
					const score = trials.reduce((sum, trial) => sum + (trial.statistics?.scoreMean ?? trial.score), 0);
					const trialTeams = trials.flatMap((trial) => trial.teams);
					buffRunsPerTeam += 3;
					options.onProgress?.(buffRunsPerTeam * teams.length);
					if (score > bestBuffScore) {
						bestBuffScore = score;
						bestBuffPreview = {
							...template,
							asgardBuffPlan: {
								...plan,
								tested: buffRunsPerTeam / 3,
								exhaustive: false
							},
							teams: trialTeams,
							score,
							damage: score,
							calculationCount: buffRunsPerTeam * teams.length,
							elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
							variations: [],
							statistics: void 0,
							scenarioResults: void 0,
							battleSnapshot: void 0,
							details: null,
							confidence: 0
						};
					}
					options.onProcess?.({
						kind: "training",
						phase: "training",
						completed: buffRunsPerTeam * teams.length,
						total,
						variations: [],
						preview: bestBuffPreview ? {
							...bestBuffPreview,
							calculationCount: buffRunsPerTeam * teams.length
						} : void 0,
						teamProgress: teams.map((team) => ({
							unitIds: team.unitIds,
							completed: buffRunsPerTeam,
							total: options.runsPerTeam,
							phase: "training"
						}))
					});
					return {
						score,
						value: null
					};
				}
			})).plan;
		}
		const timingRunsPerTeam = options.runsPerTeam - buffRunsPerTeam;
		const slots = Array(teams.length);
		const previews = teams.map(() => []);
		const counts = teams.map(() => buffRunsPerTeam);
		const phases = teams.map(() => "timing");
		const countTotal = () => counts.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
		const controller = new AbortController();
		const abort = () => controller.abort();
		options.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
		if (options.signal?.aborted) controller.abort();
		let failure;
		try {
			const trainTeam = async (team, index) => {
				if (controller.signal.aborted) {
					if (index > 0) return;
					throw new Error("Тренировка остановлена.");
				}
				try {
					const trained = await dependencies.trainBattleLabResult({
						...options,
						signal: controller.signal,
						accountSnapshot: account,
						bestResult: {
							...template,
							asgardBuffPlan: buffPlan,
							teams: [team],
							timings: team.timings ?? [{
								type: "auto",
								time: 0
							}],
							variations: void 0
						},
						maxCalculations: timingRunsPerTeam,
						onProgress: (count) => {
							counts[index] = Math.max(counts[index], buffRunsPerTeam + count);
							options.onProgress?.(countTotal());
						},
						onProcess: (progress) => {
							const leader = progress.variations.find((variation) => variation.succeeded > 0);
							const currentTeams = leader ? leader.teams.map((current) => ({
								...current,
								timings: leader.actions,
								damage: leader.scoreMax ?? leader.scoreMean,
								reliability: leader.scoreMax && leader.scoreMax > 0 ? leader.scoreMean / leader.scoreMax : null
							})) : [];
							counts[index] = Math.max(counts[index], buffRunsPerTeam + progress.completed);
							phases[index] = progress.phase;
							if (currentTeams.length) previews[index] = currentTeams;
							const previewTeams = previews.flat();
							options.onProcess?.({
								...progress,
								completed: countTotal(),
								total,
								teamProgress: teams.map((current, teamIndex) => ({
									unitIds: current.unitIds,
									completed: counts[teamIndex],
									total: options.runsPerTeam,
									phase: phases[teamIndex]
								})),
								variations: [],
								preview: previewTeams.length ? {
									...template,
									asgardBuffPlan: buffPlan,
									id: `${options.opponent.id}:training:partial`,
									confidence: leader?.confidenceLow ?? 0,
									statistics: void 0,
									scenarioResults: void 0,
									timingSearch: void 0,
									wins: null,
									stars: null,
									teams: previewTeams,
									score: previewTeams.reduce((sum, current) => sum + (current.damage ?? 0), 0),
									calculationCount: countTotal(),
									elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
									variations: [],
									battleSnapshot: void 0,
									details: null
								} : void 0
							});
						}
					});
					slots[index] = trained;
					previews[index] = trained.teams;
					counts[index] = Math.max(counts[index], buffRunsPerTeam + trained.calculationCount);
					options.onProgress?.(countTotal());
				} catch (error) {
					if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
						failure = error;
						controller.abort();
					}
					if (previews[index].length) slots[index] = {
						...template,
						teams: previews[index],
						calculationCount: counts[index],
						score: previews[index].reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.damage ?? 0), 0)
					};
				}
			};
			if (dependencies.hasWorkerPool?.()) await Promise.all(teams.map(trainTeam));
			else for (let index = 0; index < teams.length; index++) await trainTeam(teams[index], index);
		} finally {
			options.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
		}
		if (failure) throw failure;
		const results = slots.filter((result) => Boolean(result));
		if (!results.length) throw new Error("Тренировка остановлена до первого результата.");
		const completed = countTotal();
		const score = results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.score, 0);
		return {
			...results[0],
			id: `${options.opponent.id}:training:${Date.now()}`,
			createdAt: Date.now(),
			teams: results.flatMap((result) => result.teams),
			score,
			damage: score,
			calculationCount: completed,
			elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
			confidence: Math.min(...results.map((result) => result.confidence)),
			simulatedTeamCount: results.length,
			estimatedTeamCount: 0,
			variations: [],
			statistics: void 0,
			scenarioResults: void 0,
			battleSnapshot: void 0,
			details: null,
			teamResults: void 0,
			timingSearch: void 0,
			timingSource: results.some((result) => result.timingSource === "calculated") ? "calculated" : "automatic"
		};
	}
	/** Порядок героев внутри одной команды не меняет её состав. */
	function sameIds(left, right) {
		return left.length === right.length && left.every((id) => right.includes(id));
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/domain/run-result.ts
	/** Заменяет результат только текущей цели и направления; отсутствие нового очищает старый. */
	function replaceBattleLabRunResult(results, opponent, direction, next) {
		const others = results.filter((result) => result.opponentId !== opponent.id || (result.direction ?? "attack") !== direction);
		return next ? [next, ...others] : others;
	}
	/** Сохраняет рассчитанный промежуточный план при остановке без результатов прошлого запуска. */
	function battleLabProgressResult(opponent, direction, progress) {
		if (progress.preview) return progress.preview;
		const leader = progress.variations[0];
		if (!leader || leader.succeeded < 1 || !leader.teams.length) return void 0;
		const teams = leader.teams.map((team, index) => ({
			...team,
			timings: team.timings ?? (index === leader.teams.length - 1 ? leader.actions : [])
		}));
		const score = leader.scoreMax ?? leader.scoreMean;
		return {
			id: `${opponent.id}:partial:${Date.now()}`,
			modeId: opponent.modeId,
			opponentId: opponent.id,
			opponentName: opponent.name,
			platformId: opponent.platformId,
			direction,
			createdAt: Date.now(),
			calculationCount: progress.completed,
			elapsedMs: 0,
			score,
			damage: [
				"asgard",
				"invasion",
				"archdemon",
				"dominion-rift"
			].includes(opponent.modeId) ? score : null,
			wins: leader.wins,
			stars: null,
			teams,
			dataQuality: opponent.dataQuality,
			strategy: "simulation",
			confidence: leader.confidenceLow ?? 0,
			timings: leader.actions,
			timingSource: leader.actions.some((action) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0) ? "calculated" : "automatic",
			simulatedTeamCount: teams.length,
			estimatedTeamCount: 0,
			variations: opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? [] : progress.variations
		};
	}
	function hasTimedTeam(team) {
		return (team.timings ?? []).some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0);
	}
	/**
	* Тренировка Асгарда идёт по выбранным строкам: остальные пачки плана и их
	* тайминги сохраняются. Если тренировка не подтвердила тайминг и откатила
	* пачку на автобой, а у прежнего плана был тайминг с бо́льшим уроном, живое
	* улучшение боя стартует с прежнего — оно всё равно проверит оба на seed сервера.
	*/
	function mergeAsgardTrainingResult(previous, trained) {
		if (trained.modeId !== "asgard" || !previous?.teams.length) return trained;
		const key = (team) => [...team.unitIds].sort((a, b) => a - b).join(",");
		const trainedByKey = new Map(trained.teams.map((team) => [key(team), team]));
		const merged = [...previous.teams.map((old) => {
			const fresh = trainedByKey.get(key(old));
			if (!fresh) return old;
			trainedByKey.delete(key(old));
			if (!hasTimedTeam(fresh) && hasTimedTeam(old) && (old.damage ?? 0) > (fresh.damage ?? 0)) return {
				...fresh,
				timings: old.timings,
				damage: old.damage
			};
			return fresh;
		}), ...trainedByKey.values()];
		const score = merged.reduce((sum, team) => sum + (team.damage ?? 0), 0);
		return {
			...trained,
			teams: merged,
			score,
			damage: score
		};
	}

	//#region src/scripts/hwhbattlelab/runtime/observed-battle-projection.ts
	init_helpers();
	init_snapshot_compression();
	async function projectObservedBattle({ battle, history, opponents, historyLimit = 500 }) {
		let opponent = opponents.find((item) => item.externalId === battle.opponentId);
		if (!opponent && battle.enemyTeams.length > 0) {
			const teams = buildObservedTeams(battle);
			const power = teams.reduce((total, team) => total + team.power, 0);
			opponent = {
				id: `${battle.modeId}:${battle.opponentId}`,
				externalId: battle.opponentId,
				modeId: battle.modeId,
				name: battle.opponentName ?? `#${battle.opponentId}`,
				detail: battle.opponentDetail ?? battle.battleType,
				position: null,
				power,
				teams,
				dataQuality: "complete",
				context: battle.enemyContext,
				platformId: battle.platformId
			};
		} else if (opponent && battle.enemyTeams.length > 0) opponent = {
			...opponent,
			name: battle.opponentName ?? opponent.name,
			detail: battle.opponentDetail ?? opponent.detail,
			dataQuality: "complete",
			teams: buildObservedTeams(battle),
			context: battle.enemyContext,
			platformId: battle.platformId
		};
		const entry = {
			id: battle.battleId ? `${battle.modeId}:battle:${battle.battleId}` : `${battle.modeId}:${battle.opponentId}:${battle.createdAt}`,
			...battle.battleId ? { battleId: battle.battleId } : {},
			modeId: battle.modeId,
			opponentId: opponent?.id ?? `${battle.modeId}:${battle.opponentId}`,
			opponentName: battle.opponentName ?? opponent?.name ?? `#${battle.opponentId}`,
			createdAt: battle.createdAt,
			result: battle.result,
			teamResults: battle.teamResults,
			damage: battle.damage,
			stars: battle.stars,
			teamIds: battle.teamIds,
			teams: buildObservedOwnTeams(battle),
			enemyTeamIds: battle.enemyTeams.map((team) => team.map((unit) => unit.id)),
			battleSnapshot: battle.enemyTeams.length > 0 ? await compressBattleSnapshot(battle.enemyContext) : null,
			details: battle.details,
			timings: battle.timings,
			calculationCount: 0,
			score: battle.damage,
			source: "game",
			direction: "attack",
			platformId: battle.platformId,
			replayKind: battle.replayKind,
			battleType: battle.battleType,
			seed: battle.seed
		};
		return {
			opponent,
			opponents: opponent ? opponents.some((item) => item.id === opponent?.id) ? opponents.map((item) => item.id === opponent?.id ? opponent : item) : [opponent, ...opponents] : [...opponents],
			history: [entry, ...history.filter((item) => item.id !== entry.id)].slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.floor(historyLimit)))
		};
	}
	function buildObservedOwnTeams(battle) {
		const observedTeams = battle.teams ?? [];
		if (observedTeams.length === 0) return void 0;
		return observedTeams.map((units) => {
			const teamPet = units.find((unit) => unit.type === "pet") ?? null;
			const fighters = units.filter((unit) => unit.type !== "pet");
			return {
				unitIds: fighters.map((unit) => unit.id),
				teamPetId: teamPet?.id ?? null,
				bannerId: null,
				favor: {},
				power: units.reduce((total, unit) => total + finiteNumber$1(unit.power), 0),
				units: fighters,
				teamPet
			};
		});
	}
	function buildObservedTeams(battle) {
		return battle.enemyTeams.map((units, index) => ({
			id: `team-${index + 1}`,
			units,
			power: units.reduce((total, unit) => total + finiteNumber$1(unit.power), 0),
			quality: "complete"
		}));
	}

	function createBattleLabUnitTooltipResolver(gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		return (unit, kind = String(asRecord$1(unit).type ?? "hero")) => buildBattleLabUnitTooltip(unit, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame);
	}
	function buildBattleLabUnitTooltip(rawUnit, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const unit = asRecord$1(rawUnit);
		const unitId = positiveId(unit.id);
		const heroDefinition = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.hero)[String(unitId)]);
		const titanDefinition = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.titan)[String(unitId)]);
		const definition = kind === "titan" ? titanDefinition : heroDefinition;
		return {
			stats: buildStats(unit, translateGame),
			equipment: kind === "hero" || kind === "pet" ? buildEquipment(unit, definition, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame) : [],
			runes: kind === "hero" ? buildRunes(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame) : [],
			gift: kind === "hero" ? buildTitanGift(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame) : null,
			skins: kind === "hero" ? buildSkins(unit, unitId, gameLibrary, translateGame) : [],
			ascension: kind === "hero" ? buildAscension(unit, unitId, gameLibrary) : [],
			artifacts: kind === "totem" ? buildTotemArtifact(unit, gameLibrary, translateGame) : buildArtifacts(unit, definition, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame),
			skills: kind === "totem" ? [] : buildSkills(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame),
			element: String(unit.element ?? definition.element ?? "").trim(),
			...kind === "pet" ? { patronage: buildPetPatronage(unitId, gameLibrary, translateGame) } : {}
		};
	}
	/** В выборе покровителя показываем совместимость и виды бонусов из pet-конфига. */
	function buildPetPatronage(petId, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const definition = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.pet)[petId]);
		const stats = [...new Set(values(definition.favorStats).map((rule) => String(asRecord$1(rule).stat ?? "").trim()).filter(Boolean))].map((stat) => translateFirst([`LIB_BATTLESTATDATA_${toTranslationToken(stat)}`], STAT_DEFINITIONS.find(([key]) => key === stat)?.[2] ?? humanize(stat), translateGame));
		const heroes = values(definition.favorHeroes).map(positiveId).filter(Boolean).map((heroId) => entityLibraryLabel(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.hero)[heroId]), `LIB_HERO_NAME_${heroId}`, `#${heroId}`, translateGame));
		if (!stats.length && !heroes.length) return null;
		return createDetail(`pet-patronage:${petId}`, "Питомец-покровитель", "", [...stats.length ? [{
			label: "Усиляет",
			value: stats.join(", ")
		}] : [], ...heroes.length ? [{
			label: "Совместимые герои",
			value: heroes.join(", ")
		}] : []]);
	}
	function buildStats(unit, translateGame) {
		return STAT_DEFINITIONS.flatMap(([key, translationKeys, fallback]) => {
			const value = finiteNumber$1(unit[key], NaN);
			return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? [{
				key,
				label: translateFirst(translationKeys, fallback, translateGame),
				value
			}] : [];
		});
	}
	function buildEquipment(unit, definition, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const rank = Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(unit.color ?? unit.rank ?? unit.tierLevel, 1)));
		const itemIds = values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(definition.color)[String(rank)]).items).map(positiveId).slice(0, 6);
		const itemType = kind === "pet" ? "petGear" : "gear";
		const itemLibrary = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.inventoryItem)[itemType]);
		return itemIds.map((itemId, index) => {
			const item = asRecord$1(itemLibrary[String(itemId)]);
			const label = entityLibraryLabel(item, kind === "pet" ? `LIB_PET_GEAR_NAME_${itemId}` : `LIB_GEAR_NAME_${itemId}`, `#${itemId}`, translateGame);
			const occupied = isOccupiedSlot(collectionValue(unit.slots, index, itemId));
			return {
				slot: index + 1,
				itemId,
				itemType,
				texture: String(item.assetTexture ?? item.iconAssetTexture ?? "").trim(),
				occupied,
				color: Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(item.color))),
				detail: createDetail(`equipment:${itemId}:${index}`, label, entityLibraryDescription(item, translateGame), [{
					label: "Слот",
					value: occupied ? "занят" : "пуст"
				}, ...buildStatMetrics(asRecord$1(item.battleStatData), translateGame)])
			};
		});
	}
	function buildRunes(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const runeRoot = asRecord$1(gameLibrary.rune);
		const levels = values(runeRoot.level).map(asRecord$1);
		return values(definition.runes).flatMap((rawRuneId, index) => {
			const id = positiveId(rawRuneId);
			if (!id) return [];
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(runeRoot.type)[String(id)]);
			const points = Math.max(0, finiteNumber$1(collectionValue(unit.runes, index, id)));
			const level = resolveProgressLevel(levels, points, "enchantValue");
			const previous = finiteNumber$1(levels[level]?.enchantValue);
			const next = finiteNumber$1(levels[level + 1]?.enchantValue, previous);
			const percent = next > previous ? clampRatio((points - previous) / (next - previous)) : 1;
			const stat = String(descriptor.stat ?? "").trim();
			const label = translateFirst(stat ? [`LIB_BATTLESTATDATA_${toTranslationToken(stat)}`] : [], stat ? humanize(stat) : `#${id}`, translateGame);
			const value = finiteNumber$1(values(descriptor.value)[level]);
			return [{
				slot: index + 1,
				id,
				label,
				level,
				percent,
				texture: [
					descriptor.assetTexture,
					descriptor.iconAssetTexture,
					`rune_${id}`,
					`rune_icon_${id}`,
					stat ? `rune_${toSnakeCase(stat)}` : ""
				].filter(Boolean).join("|"),
				detail: createDetail(`rune:${id}`, label, "", [
					{
						label: "Уровень",
						value: String(level)
					},
					{
						label: "Прогресс",
						value: `${Math.round(percent * 100)}%`
					},
					...value > 0 ? [{
						label,
						value: `+${formatPlainNumber(value)}`
					}] : []
				])
			}];
		});
	}
	function buildTitanGift(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const level = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(unit.titanGiftLevel)));
		const definitions = asRecord$1(gameLibrary.titanGift);
		const maxLevel = Math.max(0, ...Object.keys(definitions).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite));
		if (maxLevel <= 0 && level <= 0) return null;
		const levelDefinition = asRecord$1(definitions[String(level)]);
		const mainStat = String(definition.mainStat ?? "").trim();
		const stats = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(levelDefinition.battleStatBonus)[mainStat]).battleStatData);
		return {
			level,
			maxLevel,
			percent: maxLevel > 0 ? clampRatio(level / maxLevel) : 0,
			itemType: "consumable",
			itemId: 24,
			detail: createDetail("titan-gift", "Дар стихий", "", [{
				label: "Уровень",
				value: `${level}/${maxLevel || "—"}`
			}, ...buildStatMetrics(stats, translateGame)])
		};
	}
	function buildSkins(unit, unitId, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const skinStates = asRecord$1(unit.skins);
		const activeId = positiveId(unit.currentSkin ?? unit.skin);
		return values(gameLibrary.skin).map(asRecord$1).filter((skin) => positiveId(skin.heroId) === unitId).flatMap((skin) => {
			const id = positiveId(skin.id);
			if (!id || !(String(id) in skinStates)) return [];
			const level = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(skinStates[String(id)])));
			const levels = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(skin.statData).levels);
			const maxLevel = Math.max(0, ...Object.keys(levels).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite));
			const levelDefinition = asRecord$1(levels[String(Math.min(level, maxLevel))]);
			const label = entityLibraryLabel(skin, String(skin.localeKey ?? `LIB_SKIN_NAME_${id}`), `#${id}`, translateGame);
			const textureName = String(skin.iconAsset ?? skin.iconAssetTexture ?? "").trim();
			return [{
				id,
				label,
				level,
				maxLevel,
				percent: maxLevel > 0 ? clampRatio(level / maxLevel) : 0,
				active: activeId === id,
				texture: qualifyInventoryTexture(gameLibrary, skin.iconAtlas ?? skin.iconAssetAtlas, textureName),
				detail: createDetail(`skin:${id}`, label, entityLibraryDescription(skin, translateGame), [{
					label: "Уровень",
					value: `${level}/${maxLevel || "—"}`
				}, ...buildStatMetrics(asRecord$1(levelDefinition.statBonus), translateGame)])
			}];
		}).sort((left, right) => Number(right.active) - Number(left.active) || left.id - right.id);
	}
	function buildAscension(unit, unitId, gameLibrary) {
		return values(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.heroAscension).id)[String(unitId)]).nodes).map(asRecord$1).flatMap((rankDefinition, index) => {
			const rank = Math.max(1, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(rankDefinition.rank, index + 1)));
			const total = values(rankDefinition.nodes).length;
			if (total === 0) return [];
			const state = collectionValue(unit.ascensions, rank - 1, rank);
			const unlocked = Array.isArray(state) ? state.length : Object.values(asRecord$1(state)).filter((value) => value !== false && value != null).length;
			return [{
				rank,
				unlocked: Math.min(total, unlocked),
				total,
				percent: clampRatio(unlocked / total)
			}];
		});
	}
	function buildArtifacts(unit, definition, kind, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const ids = values(definition.artifacts).map(positiveId).filter(Boolean);
		const descriptors = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(kind === "titan" ? gameLibrary.titanArtifact : gameLibrary.artifact).id);
		return ids.map((id, index) => {
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(descriptors[String(id)]);
			const state = asRecord$1(collectionValue(unit.artifacts, index, id));
			const label = entityLibraryLabel(descriptor, kind === "titan" ? `LIB_TITAN_ARTIFACT_NAME_${id}` : `LIB_ARTIFACT_NAME_${id}`, `#${id}`, translateGame);
			const level = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(state.level ?? state.artifactLevel)));
			const star = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(state.star ?? state.evolution ?? state.stars)));
			return {
				slot: index + 1,
				id,
				label,
				level,
				star,
				texture: String(descriptor.assetTexture ?? descriptor.iconAssetTexture ?? "").trim(),
				detail: createDetail(`artifact:${id}`, label, entityLibraryDescription(descriptor, translateGame), [{
					label: "Уровень",
					value: String(level || "—")
				}, {
					label: "Звёзды",
					value: star > 0 ? `★${star}` : "—"
				}])
			};
		});
	}
	function buildTotemArtifact(unit, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const id = positiveId(unit.id);
		if (!id) return [];
		const descriptor = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.titanArtifact).id)[String(id)]);
		const label = entityLibraryLabel(descriptor, `LIB_TITAN_ARTIFACT_NAME_${id}`, `#${id}`, translateGame);
		const level = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(unit.level)));
		const star = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(unit.star ?? unit.evolution)));
		return [{
			slot: 1,
			id,
			label,
			level,
			star,
			texture: String(descriptor.assetTexture ?? descriptor.iconAssetTexture ?? "").trim(),
			detail: createDetail(`totem:${id}`, label, entityLibraryDescription(descriptor, translateGame), [{
				label: "Уровень",
				value: String(level || "—")
			}, {
				label: "Звёзды",
				value: star > 0 ? `★${star}` : "—"
			}])
		}];
	}
	function buildSkills(unit, definition, gameLibrary, translateGame) {
		const skillLibrary = asRecord$1(gameLibrary.skill);
		return values(definition.skill).flatMap((rawId, index) => {
			const id = positiveId(rawId);
			const descriptor = asRecord$1(skillLibrary[String(id)]);
			const texture = String(descriptor.icon_assetTexture ?? descriptor.iconAssetTexture ?? "").trim();
			if (!id || !texture) return [];
			const rawState = collectionValue(unit.skills, index, id);
			const state = asRecord$1(rawState);
			const label = entityLibraryLabel(descriptor, `LIB_SKILL_NAME_${id}`, `#${id}`, translateGame);
			const level = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(state.level ?? state.value ?? rawState)));
			return [{
				id,
				label,
				level,
				texture,
				detail: createDetail(`skill:${id}`, label, entityLibraryDescription(descriptor, translateGame), [{
					label: "Уровень",
					value: String(level || "—")
				}])
			}];
		});
	}
	function createDetail(id, label, description, metrics) {
		return {
			id,
			label,
			description,
			metrics
		};
	}
	function buildStatMetrics(stats, translateGame) {
		return Object.entries(stats).flatMap(([key, rawValue]) => {
			const value = finiteNumber$1(rawValue, NaN);
			if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value === 0) return [];
			return [{
				label: translateFirst([`LIB_BATTLESTATDATA_${toTranslationToken(key)}`], humanize(key), translateGame),
				value: `${value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatPlainNumber(value)}`
			}];
		});
	}
	function entityLibraryDescription(definition, translateGame) {
		for (const rawValue of [
			definition.localeDescription,
			definition.locale_description,
			definition.locale_id_currentLevel,
			definition.description
		]) {
			const key = String(rawValue ?? "").trim();
			if (!key) continue;
			const translated = String(translateGame(key) ?? "").trim();
			if (translated && translated !== key) return translated;
			if (!/^LIB_|^UI_/u.test(key)) return key;
		}
		return "";
	}
	function qualifyInventoryTexture(gameLibrary, rawAtlasId, textureName) {
		if (!textureName) return "";
		const atlasId = String(rawAtlasId ?? "").trim();
		const descriptor = asRecord$1(asRecord$1(asRecord$1(gameLibrary.asset).inventory)[atlasId]);
		const atlas = String(descriptor.atlas ?? atlasId).trim();
		if (!atlas || /^\d+$/u.test(atlas)) return atlasId === "2" ? `hero_icons_only/hero_icons_only.xml:${textureName}` : textureName;
		return `${atlas.includes("/") ? atlas : atlas === "hero_icons_only.xml" ? `hero_icons_only/${atlas}` : atlas}:${textureName}`;
	}
	var plainNumberFormatter = null;
	function formatPlainNumber(value) {
		plainNumberFormatter ?? (plainNumberFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("ru-RU", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }));
		return plainNumberFormatter.format(value);
	}
	function collectionValue(value, zeroIndex, entityId) {
		if (Array.isArray(value)) return value[zeroIndex];
		const record = asRecord$1(value);
		return record[String(entityId)] ?? record[String(zeroIndex)] ?? record[String(zeroIndex + 1)];
	}
	function values(value) {
		return Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(asRecord$1(value));
	}
	function isOccupiedSlot(value) {
		if (typeof value === "number") return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0;
		if (typeof value === "boolean") return value;
		return Object.keys(asRecord$1(value)).length > 0;
	}
	function resolveProgressLevel(levels, points, thresholdKey) {
		let result = 0;
		for (const level of levels) if (finiteNumber$1(level[thresholdKey]) <= points) result = Math.max(result, Math.floor(finiteNumber$1(level.level)));
		return result;
	}
	function entityLibraryLabel(definition, conventionalKey, fallback, translateGame) {
		const localeKey = String(definition.localeId ?? definition.locale_id ?? conventionalKey).trim();
		const translated = localeKey ? String(translateGame(localeKey) ?? "").trim() : "";
		return (translated && translated !== localeKey ? translated : "") || String(definition.label ?? definition.name ?? fallback);
	}
	function translateFirst(keys, fallback, translateGame) {
		for (const key of keys) {
			const translated = String(translateGame(key) ?? "").trim();
			if (translated && translated !== key) return translated;
		}
		return fallback;
	}
	function positiveId(value) {
		const id = Math.floor(Number(value));
		return Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : 0;
	}
	function clampRatio(value) {
		return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0));
	}
	function toSnakeCase(value) {
		return value.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2").toLowerCase();
	}
	function toTranslationToken(value) {
		return toSnakeCase(value).toUpperCase();
	}
	function humanize(value) {
		const normalized = toSnakeCase(value).replaceAll("_", " ");
		return normalized ? `${normalized[0].toUpperCase()}${normalized.slice(1)}` : value;
	}

	function bitmapDataToCanvas(bitmapData, context) {
		const { classes } = context.runtime;
		const source = callRuntimeMethod(findOwnInstanceOf(findOwnInstanceOf(bitmapData, classes.limeImage, "Lime Image внутри BitmapData"), classes.imageBuffer, "Lime ImageBuffer внутри Image"), requireSemanticMethod(classes.imageBuffer, "get_src"));
		if (!source) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Lime ImageBuffer не вернул источник изображения.");
		const canvas = createCanvas(context, positiveDimension(Reflect.get(bitmapData, "width"), "ширина"), positiveDimension(Reflect.get(bitmapData, "height"), "высота"));
		requireCanvasContext(canvas).drawImage(source, 0, 0);
		return canvas;
	}
	function atlasTextureToCanvas(bitmapData, texture, context) {
		const sourceCanvas = bitmapDataToCanvas(bitmapData, context);
		const region = readTextureRectangle(texture, context.runtime.classes.subTexture, "get_region");
		const frame = readOptionalTextureRectangle(texture, context.runtime.classes.subTexture, "get_frame");
		const rotated = Boolean(callSemanticMethod(texture, context.runtime.classes.subTexture, "get_rotated"));
		const scaleValue = callSemanticMethod(texture, context.runtime.classes.subTexture, "get_scale");
		const scale = Number.isFinite(Number(scaleValue)) && Number(scaleValue) > 0 ? Number(scaleValue) : 1;
		const cropWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(rotated ? region.height : region.width));
		const cropHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(rotated ? region.width : region.height));
		const crop = createCanvas(context, cropWidth, cropHeight);
		const cropContext = requireCanvasContext(crop);
		const sourceX = Math.round(region.x * scale);
		const sourceY = Math.round(region.y * scale);
		const sourceWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(region.width * scale));
		const sourceHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(region.height * scale));
		if (rotated) {
			cropContext.translate(0, cropHeight);
			cropContext.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
			cropContext.drawImage(sourceCanvas, sourceX, sourceY, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, 0, 0, cropHeight, cropWidth);
		} else cropContext.drawImage(sourceCanvas, sourceX, sourceY, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, 0, 0, cropWidth, cropHeight);
		if (!frame || frame.width <= 0 || frame.height <= 0) return crop;
		const output = createCanvas(context, Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.width)), Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.height)));
		requireCanvasContext(output).drawImage(crop, Math.round(-frame.x), Math.round(-frame.y));
		return output;
	}
	function canvasToDataUrl(canvas, options = {}) {
		return canvas.toDataURL(options.type ?? "image/png", options.quality);
	}
	function canvasToBlob(canvas, options = {}) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
				if (blob) resolve(blob);
				else reject(new GameAssetRuntimeError("Canvas не смог создать Blob."));
			}, options.type ?? "image/png", options.quality);
		});
	}
	function readTextureRectangle(texture, Type, semanticName) {
		const rectangle = asRectangle(callSemanticMethod(texture, Type, semanticName));
		if (!rectangle) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Текстура не вернула ${semanticName}.`);
		return rectangle;
	}
	function readOptionalTextureRectangle(texture, Type, semanticName) {
		const methodName = resolveHaxePropertyMethod(Type, semanticName);
		if (!methodName) return null;
		return asRectangle(callRuntimeMethod(texture, methodName));
	}
	function callSemanticMethod(target, Type, semanticName) {
		return callRuntimeMethod(target, requireSemanticMethod(Type, semanticName));
	}
	function requireSemanticMethod(Type, semanticName) {
		const methodName = resolveHaxePropertyMethod(Type, semanticName);
		if (!methodName) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`В Haxe-классе ${Type.j ?? Type.name} не найдено свойство ${semanticName}.`);
		return methodName;
	}
	function asRectangle(value) {
		if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
		const record = value;
		const rectangle = {
			x: Number(record.x),
			y: Number(record.y),
			width: Number(record.width),
			height: Number(record.height)
		};
		return Object.values(rectangle).every(Number.isFinite) ? rectangle : null;
	}
	function createCanvas(context, width, height) {
		const canvas = context.canvasFactory?.() ?? globalThis.document?.createElement("canvas");
		if (!canvas) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Canvas недоступен. Передайте canvasFactory при работе вне браузера.");
		canvas.width = width;
		canvas.height = height;
		return canvas;
	}
	function requireCanvasContext(canvas) {
		const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
		if (!context) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Не удалось получить Canvas 2D context.");
		return context;
	}
	function positiveDimension(value, label) {
		const dimension = Number(value);
		if (!Number.isFinite(dimension) || dimension <= 0) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Некорректная ${label} BitmapData.`);
		return Math.round(dimension);
	}

	function createGameResourceIconAtlasLoader(options = {}) {
		const root = options.runtimeRoot ?? globalThis;
		const fetchResource = options.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
		const createBitmap = options.createImageBitmap ?? globalThis.createImageBitmap;
		const createCanvas = options.canvasFactory ?? (() => document.createElement("canvas"));
		const atlasSourceByKey = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		let indexPromise;
		return { async loadIconAtlas(resourceKey, loadOptions = {}) {
			const key = normalizeKey$1(resourceKey);
			const flashVars = (root.unsafeWindow ?? root).NXFlashVars ?? root.NXFlashVars;
			const indexUrls = flashVars?.index_url;
			const staticUrl = String(flashVars?.static_url ?? "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
			const indexUrl = String(indexUrls?.asset_index ?? "");
			if (!staticUrl || !indexUrl) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("В NXFlashVars нет адресов игровых ресурсов.");
			const request = (url) => fetchResource(url, { signal: loadOptions.signal }).then((response) => {
				if (!response.ok) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Игровой ресурс вернул HTTP ${response.status}.`);
				return response;
			});
			indexPromise ?? (indexPromise = request(indexUrl).then((response) => readIndex(response, indexUrl)).catch((error) => (indexPromise = void 0, Promise.reject(error))));
			const index = await indexPromise;
			const atlasPath = index[key]?.path;
			if (!atlasPath) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Атлас ${key} отсутствует в asset index.`);
			let sourcePromise = atlasSourceByKey.get(key);
			if (!sourcePromise) {
				sourcePromise = loadAtlasSource({
					atlasPath,
					index,
					key,
					request,
					staticUrl
				}).catch((error) => {
					atlasSourceByKey.delete(key);
					throw error;
				});
				atlasSourceByKey.set(key, sourcePromise);
			}
			const source = await sourcePromise;
			const image = await createBitmap(source.imageBlob);
			return new ResourceIconAtlasLease(key, source.frames, image, createCanvas);
		} };
	}
	async function loadAtlasSource({ atlasPath, index, key, request, staticUrl }) {
		const { frames, imagePath } = parseAtlas(await request(`${staticUrl}/assets/${atlasPath}`).then((response) => response.text()));
		const imageKey = normalizeKey$1(key.slice(0, key.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) + imagePath);
		const imageAssetPath = index[imageKey]?.path;
		if (!imageAssetPath) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Изображение ${imageKey} отсутствует в asset index.`);
		return {
			frames,
			imageBlob: await request(`${staticUrl}/assets/${imageAssetPath}`).then((response) => response.blob())
		};
	}
	var ResourceIconAtlasLease = class {
		constructor(resourceKey, frames, image, createCanvas) {
			_defineProperty(this, "resourceKey", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "frames", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "image", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "createCanvas", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "asset", {});
			_defineProperty(this, "released", false);
			this.resourceKey = resourceKey;
			this.frames = frames;
			this.image = image;
			this.createCanvas = createCanvas;
		}
		textureNames() {
			return [...this.frames.keys()];
		}
		texture(name) {
			return this.frames.get(name) ?? null;
		}
		toCanvas(name) {
			const frame = this.frames.get(name);
			if (!frame) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Текстура ${name} отсутствует в ${this.resourceKey}.`);
			const canvas = this.createCanvas();

			canvas.height = frame.height;
			const context = canvas.getContext("2d");

			context.drawImage(this.image, frame.x, frame.y, frame.width, frame.height, 0, 0, frame.width, frame.height);
			return canvas;
		}
		toDataUrl(name, options = {}) {
			return canvasToDataUrl(this.toCanvas(name), options);
		}
		toBlob(name, options = {}) {
			return canvasToBlob(this.toCanvas(name), options);
		}
		release() {
			if (this.released) return;
			this.released = true;
			this.image.close?.();
		}
	};
	async function readIndex(response, url) {
		if (!url.toLowerCase().includes(".gz")) return response.json();
		return new Response(response.body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))).json();
	}
	function parseAtlas(xml) {
		const imagePath = attribute(xml.match(/<TextureAtlas\b([^>]*)>/i)?.[1], "imagePath");
		const frames = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		for (const match of xml.matchAll(/<SubTexture\b([^>]*?)(?:\/>|>)/gi)) {
			const source = match[1];
			const frame = {
				name: attribute(source, "name"),
				x: Number(attribute(source, "x")),
				y: Number(attribute(source, "y")),
				width: Number(attribute(source, "width")),
				height: Number(attribute(source, "height"))
			};
			if (frame.name && frame.width > 0 && frame.height > 0) frames.set(frame.name, frame);
		}
		if (!imagePath || frames.size === 0) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Игровой XML-атлас пуст или повреждён.");
		return {
			frames,
			imagePath
		};
	}
	function attribute(source, name) {
		return source?.match(new RegExp(`${name}\\s*=\\s*["'](.*?)["']`, "i"))?.[1] ?? "";
	}
	function normalizeKey$1(value) {
		return value.trim().replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/^\/+/, "");
	}
