	var GameAssetLoader = class {
		constructor(options = {}) {
			_defineProperty(this, "runtime", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "imageContext", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "defaultTimeoutMs", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "options", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "resourceAtlases", null);
			this.options = options;
			this.runtime = resolveGameAssetRuntime(options);
			this.imageContext = {
				runtime: this.runtime,
				canvasFactory: options.canvasFactory
			};
			this.defaultTimeoutMs = normalizeTimeout(options.defaultTimeoutMs, 15e3);
		}
		async loadRsx(resourceKey, options = {}) {
			const ident = normalizeResourceKey(resourceKey);
			const asset = callRuntimeMethod(this.runtime.rsxStorage, this.runtime.names.rsxGetAsset, [ident]);
			if (!asset || !(asset instanceof this.runtime.classes.rsxAsset)) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`RSX-ресурс ${resourceKey} не найден в игре.`);
			return new RuntimeRsxLease(await this.loadOwnedAsset(asset, options), this.runtime, this.imageContext);
		}
		async loadIconAtlas(resourceKey, options = {}) {
			let asset;
			try {
				asset = this.findIconAtlas(resourceKey);
			} catch (error) {
				if (!(error instanceof GameAssetNotFoundError)) throw error;
				this.resourceAtlases ?? (this.resourceAtlases = createGameResourceIconAtlasLoader({
					runtimeRoot: this.options.runtimeRoot,
					...this.options.canvasFactory ? { canvasFactory: this.options.canvasFactory } : {}
				}));
				return await this.resourceAtlases.loadIconAtlas(resourceKey, options);
			}
			return new RuntimeIconAtlasLease(await this.loadOwnedAsset(asset, options), this.runtime, this.imageContext);
		}
		async loadImage(resourceKey, options = {}) {
			const asset = this.findImage(resourceKey);
			const owned = await this.loadOwnedAsset(asset, options);
			const bitmapData = findOwnInstanceOf(asset, this.runtime.classes.bitmapData, `BitmapData изображения ${resourceKey}`);
			if (!bitmapData) {
				this.releaseOwnedAsset(owned);
				throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`Изображение ${resourceKey} загрузилось без BitmapData.`);
			}
			return new RuntimeImageLease(owned, bitmapData, this.runtime, this.imageContext);
		}
		async loadHero(unitId, skinId = 0, scale = 1, options = {}) {
			if (!Number.isInteger(unitId) || unitId <= 0) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Некорректный id боевой единицы: ${unitId}.`);
			const asset = callRuntimeMethod(this.runtime.heroStorage, this.runtime.names.heroGetAsset, [
				unitId,
				skinId,
				scale
			]);
			if (!asset || !(asset instanceof this.runtime.classes.heroAsset)) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Hero asset для боевой единицы #${unitId} не найден.`);
			return new RuntimeHeroLease(await this.loadOwnedAsset(asset, options), this.runtime);
		}
		async loadUnitIcon(unitId, kind = "hero", options = {}) {
			if (!Number.isInteger(unitId) || unitId <= 0) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Некорректный id: ${unitId}.`);
			const description = readHaxeStringMapValue(findOwnInstanceOf(kind === "banner" ? this.runtime.bannerDescriptionStorage : this.runtime.heroDescriptionStorage, this.runtime.classes.stringMap, `StringMap описаний ${kind}`), String(unitId));
			if (!description || typeof description !== "object") throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Нет описания ${kind} #${unitId}.`);
			const getBigIconAsset = resolveHaxeInstancePropertyMethod(description, "get_bigIconAsset");
			if (!getBigIconAsset) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`У ${kind} #${unitId} нет get_bigIconAsset.`);
			const iconAsset = callRuntimeMethod(description, getBigIconAsset);
			if (!iconAsset || !(iconAsset instanceof this.runtime.classes.imageIconAsset)) throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Нет иконки ${kind} #${unitId}.`);
			const owned = await this.loadOwnedAsset(iconAsset, options);
			try {
				const getImage = resolveHaxePropertyMethod(this.runtime.classes.imageIconAsset, "get_image");
				if (!getImage) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Нет ImageIconAsset.get_image.");
				const imageFile = callRuntimeMethod(iconAsset, getImage);
				const bitmapData = imageFile ? findOwnInstanceOf(imageFile, this.runtime.classes.bitmapData, `BitmapData иконки ${kind} #${unitId}`) : null;
				if (!bitmapData) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError(`У иконки ${kind} #${unitId} нет BitmapData.`);
				return new RuntimeImageLease(owned, bitmapData, this.runtime, this.imageContext);
			} catch (error) {
				this.releaseOwnedAsset(owned);
				throw error;
			}
		}
		findIconAtlas(resourceKey) {
			const expected = normalizeResourceKey(resourceKey).toLowerCase();
			const storages = findOwnInstances(this.runtime.classes.assetStorage, this.runtime.classes.assetTypeStorage);
			for (const storage of storages) {
				const entries = readHaxeMapEntries(storage, this.runtime.names.assetMap, this.runtime.names.haxeMapData);
				for (const [key, value] of entries) {
					if (!(value instanceof this.runtime.classes.iconAtlasAsset)) continue;
					if ([key, ...this.readAtlasNames(value)].some((candidate) => matchesResource(candidate, expected))) return value;
				}
			}
			throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`XML-атлас ${resourceKey} не найден среди зарегистрированных игровых ресурсов.`);
		}
		readAtlasNames(asset) {
			const names = [];
			const assetIdentMethod = resolveHaxePropertyMethod(this.runtime.classes.iconAtlasAsset, "get_assetIdent");
			if (assetIdentMethod) {
				const ident = callRuntimeMethod(asset, assetIdentMethod);
				if (typeof ident === "string") names.push(ident);
			}
			for (const field of [this.runtime.names.atlasXml, this.runtime.names.atlasImage]) {
				const file = readObjectField(asset, field);
				if (!file) continue;
				try {
					const fileName = callRuntimeMethod(file, this.runtime.names.fileGetName);
					if (typeof fileName === "string") names.push(fileName);
				} catch {}
			}
			return names;
		}
		findImage(resourceKey) {
			const normalized = resourceKey.trim().replaceAll("\\", "/");
			for (const candidate of [normalized, normalized.slice(normalized.lastIndexOf("/") + 1)]) {
				const asset = callRuntimeMethod(this.runtime.assetStorage, this.runtime.names.storageGetImage, [candidate]);
				if (asset) return asset;
			}
			throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`Изображение ${resourceKey} не найдено в игре.`);
		}
		loadOwnedAsset(asset, options) {
			const owner = {};
			const priority = Number.isFinite(Number(options.priority)) ? Number(options.priority) : 0;
			const timeoutMs = normalizeTimeout(options.timeoutMs, this.defaultTimeoutMs);
			if (options.signal?.aborted) return Promise.reject(new GameAssetAbortedError("Загрузка ресурса отменена."));
			callRuntimeMethod(asset, this.runtime.names.assetRetain, [owner]);
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				let settled = false;
				let timer = null;
				const finish = (error) => {
					if (settled) return;
					settled = true;
					if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
					options.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
					if (error) {
						this.cancelLoad(callback);
						this.releaseOwnedAsset({
							asset,
							owner
						});
						reject(error);
					} else resolve({
						asset,
						owner
					});
				};
				const callback = () => finish();
				const onAbort = () => finish(new GameAssetAbortedError("Загрузка ресурса отменена."));
				options.signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
				if (timeoutMs > 0) timer = setTimeout(() => finish(new GameAssetTimeoutError(`Игровой ресурс не загрузился за ${timeoutMs} мс.`)), timeoutMs);
				try {
					callRuntimeMethod(this.runtime.assetLoader, this.runtime.names.assetLoaderLoad, [
						asset,
						callback,
						priority
					]);
				} catch (error) {
					finish(new GameAssetRuntimeError("Штатный AssetLoader завершился с ошибкой.", { cause: error }));
				}
			});
		}
		cancelLoad(callback) {
			try {
				callRuntimeMethod(this.runtime.assetLoader, this.runtime.names.assetLoaderCancel, [callback]);
			} catch {}
		}
		releaseOwnedAsset(owned) {
			callRuntimeMethod(owned.asset, this.runtime.names.assetRelease, [owned.owner]);
		}
	};
	var RuntimeAssetLease = class {
		constructor(owned, runtime) {
			_defineProperty(this, "owned", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "runtime", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "isReleased", false);
			this.owned = owned;
			this.runtime = runtime;
		}
		get asset() {
			return this.owned.asset;
		}
		get released() {
			return this.isReleased;
		}
		release() {
			if (this.isReleased) return;
			this.isReleased = true;
			callRuntimeMethod(this.asset, this.runtime.names.assetRelease, [this.owned.owner]);
		}
		assertActive() {
			if (this.isReleased) throw new GameAssetRuntimeError("Ресурс уже освобождён через release().");
		}
	};

	var BinaryReader$1 = class {
		constructor(buffer, littleEndian = false, byteOffset = 0, byteLength = buffer.byteLength - byteOffset) {
			_defineProperty(this, "littleEndian", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "view", void 0);
			_defineProperty(this, "pos", 0);
			this.littleEndian = littleEndian;
			this.view = new DataView(buffer, byteOffset, byteLength);
		}
		get position() {
			return this.pos;
		}
		get size() {
			return this.view.byteLength;
		}
		get hasMore() {
			return this.pos < this.view.byteLength;
		}
		readByte() {
			const v = this.view.getUint8(this.pos);
			this.pos += 1;
			return v;
		}
		readUint16() {
			const v = this.view.getUint16(this.pos, this.littleEndian);
			this.pos += 2;
			return v;
		}
		readInt16() {
			const v = this.view.getInt16(this.pos, this.littleEndian);
			this.pos += 2;
			return v;
		}
		readUint32() {
			const v = this.view.getUint32(this.pos, this.littleEndian);
			this.pos += 4;
			return v;
		}
		readByteArray(length) {
			const bytes = new Uint8Array(this.view.buffer, this.view.byteOffset + this.pos, length);
			this.pos += length;
			return bytes;
		}
		readBoundedString16(checkPrefix = false) {
			let len;
			if (checkPrefix) {
				this.littleEndian = false;
				len = this.readUint16();
				this.littleEndian = true;
				this.pos -= 2;
				const len2 = this.readUint16();
				if (len2 < len) len = len2;
				else this.littleEndian = false;
			} else len = this.readUint16();
			const bytes = this.readByteArray(len);
			return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
		}

	/**
	* Открывает базу данных IndexedDB hw_cache.
	* Возвращает null в средах без IndexedDB (например, тесты или worker).
	*/
	function openGameCacheDb() {
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined") {
				resolve(null);
				return;
			}
			let request;
			try {
				request = indexedDB.open("hw_cache");
			} catch {
				resolve(null);
				return;
			}
			request.addEventListener("upgradeneeded", () => {
				try {
					request.transaction?.abort();
				} catch {}
			});
			request.addEventListener("error", () => resolve(null));
			request.addEventListener("success", () => resolve(request.result));
		});
	}
	/**
	* Читает записи из IndexedDB hw_cache по списку ключей.
	*/
	async function readGameCacheRecords(keys) {
		const db = await openGameCacheDb();
		if (!db) return keys.map(() => null);
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			try {
				const store = db.transaction("cache", "readonly").objectStore("cache");
				const found = Array.from({ length: keys.length }, () => null);
				let left = keys.length;
				if (!left) {
					db.close();
					resolve(found);
					return;
				}
				keys.forEach((key, index) => {
					const get = store.get(key);
					const done = () => {
						left--;
						if (left === 0) {
							db.close();
							resolve(found);
						}
					};
					get.addEventListener("success", () => {
						found[index] = get.result ?? null;
						done();
					});
					get.addEventListener("error", done);
				});
			} catch {
				db.close();
				resolve(keys.map(() => null));
			}
		});
	}
	/**
	* Получает список ключей из IndexedDB hw_cache по строковому префиксу.
	*/
	async function listGameCacheKeys(prefix) {
		const db = await openGameCacheDb();
		if (!db) return [];
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			const keys = [];
			try {
				const range = IDBKeyRange.bound(prefix, prefix + "�");
				const cursorReq = db.transaction("cache", "readonly").objectStore("cache").openKeyCursor(range);
				cursorReq.addEventListener("success", () => {
					const cursor = cursorReq.result;
					if (cursor) {
						keys.push(String(cursor.key));
						cursor.continue();
					} else {
						db.close();
						resolve(keys);
					}
				});
				cursorReq.addEventListener("error", () => {
					db.close();
					resolve(keys);
				});
			} catch {
				db.close();
				resolve(keys);
			}
		});
	}

	* Строит карту исходных путей к их хэшированным именам из игрового индекса AssetStorage.
	*/
	function buildHashedPaths(root = globalThis) {
		const found = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		const win = root;
		const index = ((win.selfGame ?? win)["game.assets.storage.AssetStorage"]?.instance)?.index;
		if (!index || typeof index !== "object") return found;
		const hashedPattern = /^(.+)\.[0-9a-f]{16,}(\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)$/;
		const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		const walk = (node, depth) => {
			if (!node || typeof node !== "object" || seen.has(node) || depth > 6) return;

	/**
	* Читает файл игры: сначала из IndexedDB `hw_cache`, а если нет — по сети с CDN.
	*/
	async function readGameFile(plainPath, root = globalThis) {
		const [record] = await readGameCacheRecords([plainPath]);
		if (record?.data) return record.data instanceof Uint8Array ? record.data : new Uint8Array(record.data);
		const url = await resolveDownloadUrlFor(plainPath, root);
		if (!url) return null;
		try {
			const response = await fetch(url);
			if (!response.ok) return null;
			return new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer());
		} catch (err) {
			console.error(`[game-cache-reader] Ошибка загрузки файла ${plainPath}`, err);
			return null;
		}
	}

					iconDataUrlCache.set(key, dataUrl);
					return dataUrl;
				}
			}
		}
		const [record] = await readGameCacheRecords([`hero_icons/${heroId}.png`]);
		if (record?.data && typeof FileReader !== "undefined") {
			const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve) => {
				const reader = new FileReader();
				reader.addEventListener("load", () => resolve(String(reader.result)));
				reader.addEventListener("error", () => resolve(""));
				reader.readAsDataURL(new Blob([record.data], { type: "image/png" }));
			});
			if (dataUrl) {
				iconDataUrlCache.set(key, dataUrl);
				return dataUrl;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	async function inflateBytes(bytes) {
		if (typeof DecompressionStream !== "undefined") {
			const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate"));
			return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
		}
		return bytes;
	}
	/**
	* Парсит бинарный файл .rsx игрового интерфейса.
	*/
	async function parseRsx(bytes, file = "") {
		const reader = new BinaryReader(bytes, bytes[0] === 4);
		if (reader.str() !== "RE$X") throw new Error("Неверный заголовок файла RSX");
		const asset = {
			file,
			version: reader.u32(),
			images: [],
			frames: [],
			clips: [],
			states: [],
			scale9: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),
			sheets: [],
			byName: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()
		};
		const readState = (r, id) => {
			const clip = r.u16();
			r.u16();
			const name = r.str();
			const blend = r.u8();
			const colorMode = r.u8();
			r.u16();
			let alpha = 1;
			if (colorMode === 1) alpha = r.f32();
			else if (colorMode === 2) r.u32();
			else if (colorMode === 3) r.take(4 * (asset.version < RSX_LONG_COLOR_VERSION ? 8 : 20));
			let matrix = null;
			if (r.u8() === 33) matrix = [
				r.f32(),
				r.f32(),
				r.f32(),
				r.f32(),
				r.f32(),
				r.f32()
			];
			asset.states[id] = {
				clip,
				name: name.startsWith("instance") ? "" : name,
				blend,
				alpha,
				matrix
			};
		};
		const readExtensions = (r) => {
			const types = {};
			const typeCount = r.u16();
			for (let i = 0; i < typeCount; i++) types[r.u16()] = r.str();
			const count = r.u16();
			for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
				const type = types[r.u16()];
				const size = r.u32();
				const end = r.pos + size;
				if (type === "scale9") {
					const n = r.u16();
					for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
						const clip = r.u16();
						asset.scale9.set(clip, {
							x: r.u16(),
							y: r.u16(),
							w: r.u16(),
							h: r.u16()
						});
					}
				}
				r.pos = end;
			}
		};
		const readChunks = async (r, end) => {
			while (r.pos < end) {
				const type = r.u16();
				const length = r.u32();
				const stop = r.pos + length;
				switch (type) {
					case 2: {
						const raw = await inflateBytes(r.take(length));
						const inner = new BinaryReader(raw, r.le);
						await readChunks(inner, raw.length);
						break;
					}
					case 256: {
						const id = r.u16();
						const kind = r.u8();
						const data = new BinaryReader(r.take(length - 3), r.le);
						asset.images[id] = { file: kind === 9 ? data.str() : "" };
						break;
					}
					case 512:
					case 513: {
						const id = r.u16();
						const image = r.u16();
						const rect = {
							x: r.i16(),
							y: r.i16(),
							w: r.i16(),
							h: r.i16()
						};
						const pivotX = asset.version === RSX_FLOAT_PIVOT_VERSION ? Math.trunc(2 * r.f32()) : r.i16();
						const pivotY = asset.version === RSX_FLOAT_PIVOT_VERSION ? Math.trunc(2 * r.f32()) : r.i16();
						const frame = {
							image,
							rect,
							dx: 0,
							dy: 0,
							fullW: rect.w,
							fullH: rect.h,
							ax: 0,
							ay: 0
						};
						if (type === 513) {
							frame.dx = -r.i16();
							frame.dy = -r.i16();
							frame.fullW = r.i16();
							frame.fullH = r.i16();
						}
						frame.ax = (pivotX + rect.w) / 2 + frame.dx;
						frame.ay = (pivotY + rect.h) / 2 + frame.dy;
						asset.frames[id] = frame;
						break;
					}
					case 768: {
						const id = r.u16();
						const className = r.str();
						r.u8();
						const flags = r.u8();
						const n = r.u16();
						if (flags & 1) r.str();
						if (flags & 2) r.str();
						const frames = [];
						for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
							const t = r.u8();
							if (t === 17) frames.push({ piece: r.u16() });
							else if (t === 18 || t === 19) {
								const k = r.u16();
								const states = [];
								for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) states.push(t === 18 ? r.u16() : r.u32());
								frames.push({ states });
							}
						}
						asset.clips[id] = {
							id,
							className,
							frames
						};
						break;
					}
					case 1024:
						readState(r, r.u16());
						break;
					case 4352:
						readState(r, r.u32());
						break;
					case 4096:
						readExtensions(r);
						break;
					default: break;
				}
				r.pos = stop;
			}
		};
		await readChunks(reader, bytes.length - 4);
		for (const clip of asset.clips) if (clip && clip.frames.length && !asset.byName.has(clip.className)) asset.byName.set(clip.className, clip);
		return asset;
	}
	/**
	* Загружает RSX-ресурс и привязанные к нему листы текстур.
	*/
	async function loadRsxAsset(file) {
		const base = file.includes("/") ? file : `js/gui/${file}`;
		const bytes = await readGameFile(`${base}.rsx`);
		if (!bytes) return null;
		const asset = await parseRsx(bytes, file);
		const pattern = new RegExp(`^${base}(\\d+)\\.(png|avif|webp|jpg)$`);
		const sheets = (await listGameFiles(base)).map((path) => pattern.exec(path)).filter((m) => m !== null).sort((a, b) => Number(a[1]) - Number(b[1]));
		asset.sheets = [];
		if (typeof createImageBitmap !== "undefined") for (let i = 0; i < asset.images.length; i++) {
			const match = sheets[i];
			const sheetData = match ? await readGameFile(match[0]) : null;
			asset.sheets[i] = sheetData ? await createImageBitmap(new Blob([sheetData], { type: `image/${match[2]}` })) : null;
		}
		return asset;
	}

	async function loadGameGui(files = ["dialog_basic"]) {

	}
	function findClip(library, name, prefer) {
		const first = prefer ? library.assets.find((a) => a.file === prefer) : null;
		const searchList = first ? [first, ...library.assets] : library.assets;
		for (const asset of searchList) {
			const clip = asset.byName.get(name);
			if (clip) return {
				asset,
				clip
			};
		}
		return null;
	}
	function walk(ctx, asset, clip, matrix, alpha, depth) {
		if (!clip || depth > 16 || ctx.exclude?.includes(clip.className)) return;
		const first = clip.frames.length ? clip.frames[0] : null;
		if (!first) {
			if (/^(text_|marker_)/.test(clip.className)) return;
			const ref = findClip(ctx.library, clip.className, asset.file);
			if (ref && ref.clip !== clip) walk(ctx, ref.asset, ref.clip, matrix, alpha, depth + 1);
			return;
		}
		if (first.piece !== void 0) {
			const frame = asset.frames[first.piece];
			if (frame && alpha > 0) ctx.visit(asset, frame, asset.scale9.get(clip.id), matrix, alpha);
			return;
		}
		for (const id of first.states ?? []) {
			const state = asset.states[id];
			if (!state || depth === 0 && ctx.pick && !ctx.pick(state.name)) continue;
			const child = state.matrix ? mul(matrix, state.matrix) : matrix;
			const targetClip = asset.clips[state.clip];
			if (targetClip) walk(ctx, asset, targetClip, child, alpha * state.alpha, depth + 1);
		}
	}
	function frameBox(frame, m) {
		const xs = [];
		const ys = [];
		const x0 = -frame.ax;
		const y0 = -frame.ay;
		for (const [x, y] of [
			[x0, y0],
			[x0 + frame.fullW, y0],
			[x0, y0 + frame.fullH],
			[x0 + frame.fullW, y0 + frame.fullH]
		]) {
			xs.push(m[0] * x + m[2] * y + m[4]);
			ys.push(m[1] * x + m[3] * y + m[5]);
		}
		return [
			Math.min(...xs),
			Math.min(...ys),
			Math.max(...xs),
			Math.max(...ys)
		];
	}
	function fullFrame(asset, frame) {
		const key = `${asset.file}:${asset.frames.indexOf(frame)}`;
		if (!fullFrames.has(key)) {
			const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
			canvas.width = frame.fullW;
			canvas.height = frame.fullH;
			const sheet = asset.sheets[frame.image];
			if (sheet) {
				const r = frame.rect;
				canvas.getContext("2d")?.drawImage(sheet, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, frame.dx, frame.dy, r.w, r.h);
			}
			fullFrames.set(key, canvas);
		}
		return fullFrames.get(key);
	}
	function drawFrame(g, asset, frame, grid, m, alpha, scale) {
		const sheet = asset.sheets[frame.image];
		if (!sheet) return;
		g.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);
		const r = frame.rect;
		if (!stretched(grid, m, scale)) {
			g.setTransform(m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5]);
			g.drawImage(sheet, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, frame.dx - frame.ax, frame.dy - frame.ay, r.w, r.h);
			return;
		}
		const src = fullFrame(asset, frame);
		const W = frame.fullW * m[0];
		const H = frame.fullH * m[3];
		let left = grid.x * scale;
		let right = (frame.fullW - grid.x - grid.w) * scale;
		let top = grid.y * scale;
		let bottom = (frame.fullH - grid.y - grid.h) * scale;
		if (left + right > W) {
			const k = W / (left + right);
			left *= k;
			right *= k;
		}
		if (top + bottom > H) {
			const k = H / (top + bottom);
			top *= k;
			bottom *= k;
		}
		const sx = [
			0,
			grid.x,
			grid.x + grid.w,
			frame.fullW
		];
		const sy = [
			0,
			grid.y,
			grid.y + grid.h,
			frame.fullH
		];
		const dx = [
			0,
			left,
			W - right,
			W
		];
		const dy = [
			0,
			top,
			H - bottom,
			H
		];
		g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, m[4] - m[0] * frame.ax - m[2] * frame.ay, m[5] - m[1] * frame.ax - m[3] * frame.ay);
		for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
			const sw = sx[i + 1] - sx[i];
			const sh = sy[j + 1] - sy[j];
			const dw = dx[i + 1] - dx[i];
			const dh = dy[j + 1] - dy[j];
			if (sw > 0 && sh > 0 && dw > 0 && dh > 0) g.drawImage(src, sx[i], sy[j], sw, sh, dx[i], dy[j], dw, dh);
		}
	}
	/**
	* Рендерит символ из RSX-библиотеки в DataURL изображение.
	*/
	function renderGui(library, name, opts = {}) {
		if (!library || typeof document === "undefined") return null;
		const key = JSON.stringify([name, opts]);
		if (renderedCache.has(key)) return renderedCache.get(key);
		const hit = findClip(library, name, opts.file ?? null);
		if (!hit) {
			renderedCache.set(key, null);
			return null;
		}
		const { width = 0, height = 0, scale = 1, only = null, hide = null, exclude = null } = opts;
		const pick = only ? (n) => only.includes(n) : hide ? (n) => !hide.includes(n) : null;
		const box = [
			Infinity,
			Infinity,
			-Infinity,
			-Infinity
		];
		const grow = (_asset, frame, _grid, m) => {
			const b = frameBox(frame, m);
			box[0] = Math.min(box[0], b[0]);
			box[1] = Math.min(box[1], b[1]);
			box[2] = Math.max(box[2], b[2]);
			box[3] = Math.max(box[3], b[3]);
		};
		walk({
			library,
			pick,
			exclude,
			visit: grow
		}, hit.asset, hit.clip, IDENTITY, 1, 0);
		if (!(box[0] < box[2] && box[1] < box[3])) {
			renderedCache.set(key, null);
			return null;
		}
		const naturalW = box[2] - box[0];
		const naturalH = box[3] - box[1];
		const kx = width ? width / naturalW : scale;
		const ky = height ? height / naturalH : scale;
		const W = naturalW * kx;
		const H = naturalH * ky;
		const renderScale = 2;
		const cellW = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(W * renderScale));
		const cellH = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(H * renderScale));
		const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
		canvas.width = cellW;
		canvas.height = cellH;
		const g = canvas.getContext("2d");
		if (!g) {
			renderedCache.set(key, null);
			return null;
		}
		const base = [
			kx * renderScale,
			0,
			0,
			ky * renderScale,
			-box[0] * kx * renderScale,
			-box[1] * ky * renderScale
		];
		const visit = (asset, piece, grid, m, alpha) => drawFrame(g, asset, piece, grid, m, alpha, renderScale);
		walk({
			library,
			pick,
			exclude,
			visit
		}, hit.asset, hit.clip, base, 1, 0);
		g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
		g.globalAlpha = 1;
		const result = {
			url: opts.format === "jpeg" ? canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", .85) : canvas.toDataURL("image/png"),
			width: W,
			height: H,
			x: box[0] * kx,
			y: box[1] * ky
		};
		renderedCache.set(key, result);
		return result;
	}

	}

			const normalizedItems = [...new Map(items.map((item) => ({
				itemId: item.itemId,
				itemType: String(item.itemType ?? "").trim(),
				key: getItemIconKey(item.itemType, item.itemId)
			})).filter((item) => item.key).map((item) => [item.key, item])).values()];
			const itemsByBaseType = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
			normalizedItems.forEach((item) => {
				const baseType = getBaseItemType(item.itemType);
				const group = itemsByBaseType.get(baseType) ?? [];
				group.push(item);
				itemsByBaseType.set(baseType, group);
			});
			await Promise.all([...itemsByBaseType].map(async ([baseType, groupedItems]) => {
				const pendingLoad = pendingItemLoads.get(baseType);
				if (pendingLoad) await pendingLoad;
				const currentLoad = loadAtlasRequests(loader, groupedItems.filter(({ key }) => !itemIconCache.has(key)).map(({ itemId, key }) => createIconRequest({
					definition: getItemDefinition(baseType, itemId),
					fallbackId: itemId,
					fallbackType: baseType,
					key,

					resourceDirectory: ITEM_ICON_ATLAS_DIRECTORY
				})).filter((request) => request !== null && missingItemIcons.get(request.key) !== request.signature), itemIconCache, missingItemIcons, onAtlasError);
				pendingItemLoads.set(baseType, currentLoad);
				try {
					await currentLoad;
				} finally {
					if (pendingItemLoads.get(baseType) === currentLoad) pendingItemLoads.delete(baseType);
				}
			}));
			return pickCachedIcons(normalizedItems.map((item) => item.key), itemIconCache);
		}

			loadHeroIcons,
			loadItemIcons
		};

	function getHeroIconKey(heroId) {
		return normalizeEntityId(heroId);
	}
	function getItemIconKey(itemType, itemId) {
		const type = String(itemType ?? "").trim();

	function getGameIconTextureName(value) {
		return parseGameIconTextureReference(value).textureName;
	}
	function getGameIconAtlasName(value) {

	function createIconRequest({ definition, fallbackId, fallbackType, key, resourceDirectory = "", resourceKeys }) {
		const definitionRecord = isPlainObject(definition) ? definition : {};
		const reference = parseGameIconTextureReference(definitionRecord.iconAssetTexture ?? definitionRecord.icon_assetTexture ?? definitionRecord.assetTexture ?? definitionRecord.asset_texture);
		const assetReference = parseGameIconTextureReference(definitionRecord.assetTexture ?? definitionRecord.asset_texture);
		const fallbackNumericId = String(Number(fallbackId) || "");
		const textureNames = [
			reference.textureName,
			assetReference.textureName,
			!reference.textureName && fallbackType && fallbackNumericId ? `${fallbackType}_${fallbackNumericId}` : ""
		].filter(Boolean);
		const resolvedResourceKeys = resolveAtlasResourceKeys(reference.atlasName, resourceKeys, resourceDirectory);
		if (!key || textureNames.length === 0 || resolvedResourceKeys.length === 0) return null;
		return {
			key,
			resourceKeys: resolvedResourceKeys,
			textureNames: [...new Set(textureNames)],
			signature: `${resolvedResourceKeys.join("|")}::${textureNames.join("|")}`
		};
	}
	async function loadAtlasRequests(loader, requests, cache, missingCache, onError) {
		const resourceKeys = [...new Set(requests.flatMap((request) => request.resourceKeys))];
		if (requests.length === 0 || resourceKeys.length === 0) return;
		const unresolved = new Map(requests.map((request) => [request.key, request]));
		const loadedAtlases = await Promise.all(resourceKeys.map(async (resourceKey) => {
			try {
				return {
					atlas: await loadIconResource(loader, resourceKey),
					resourceKey
				};
			} catch (error) {
				onError?.(error, resourceKey);
				return {
					atlas: null,
					resourceKey
				};
			}
		}));
		try {
			for (const { atlas, resourceKey } of loadedAtlases) {
				if (!atlas || unresolved.size === 0) continue;
				const textureByName = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
				const dataUrlByTextureName = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
				atlas.textureNames().forEach((name) => {
					textureByName.set(name.toLowerCase(), name);
					textureByName.set(getGameIconTextureName(name).toLowerCase(), name);
				});
				for (const [key, request] of unresolved) {
					if (!request.resourceKeys.includes(resourceKey)) continue;
					const textureName = request.textureNames.map((candidate) => textureByName.get(getGameIconTextureName(candidate).toLowerCase())).find(Boolean);
					if (!textureName) continue;
					let dataUrl = dataUrlByTextureName.get(textureName);
					if (!dataUrl) {
						dataUrl = atlas.toDataUrl(textureName);
						dataUrlByTextureName.set(textureName, dataUrl);
					}
					cache.set(key, dataUrl);
					unresolved.delete(key);
				}
			}
			if (loadedAtlases.every(({ atlas }) => atlas !== null)) unresolved.forEach((request, key) => missingCache.set(key, request.signature));
		} finally {
			loadedAtlases.forEach(({ atlas }) => atlas?.release());
		}
	}
	async function loadIconResource(loader, resourceKey) {
		if (isRsxResource(resourceKey)) {
			if (!loader.loadRsx) throw new Error(`Загрузчик не умеет читать RSX-ресурс ${resourceKey}.`);
			return loader.loadRsx(resourceKey, { timeoutMs: 4e3 });
		}
		return loader.loadIconAtlas(resourceKey, { timeoutMs: 4e3 });
	}
	function isRsxResource(resourceKey) {
		return resourceKey.trim().split(/[?#]/, 1)[0].toLowerCase().endsWith(".rsx");
	}
	function parseGameIconTextureReference(value) {
		const normalized = String(value ?? "").trim().replaceAll("\\", "/");
		if (!normalized) return {
			atlasName: "",
			textureName: ""
		};
		const separatorIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf(":");
		if (separatorIndex >= 0) return {
			atlasName: normalized.slice(0, separatorIndex).trim(),
			textureName: normalized.slice(separatorIndex + 1).trim()
		};
		const slashIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("/");
		return {
			atlasName: "",
			textureName: normalized.slice(slashIndex + 1).trim()
		};
	}
	function resolveAtlasResourceKeys(atlasName, fallbackResourceKeys, resourceDirectory) {
		if (!atlasName) return [...new Set(fallbackResourceKeys)];
		const normalizedAtlasName = atlasName.replace(/^.*?\/assets\//i, "").replace(/\.([a-f0-9]{16,})\.xml$/i, ".xml").replace(/^\/+/, "");
		const fileName = normalizedAtlasName.slice(normalizedAtlasName.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
		const knownResourceKey = fallbackResourceKeys.find((resourceKey) => resourceKey.slice(resourceKey.lastIndexOf("/") + 1).toLowerCase() === fileName.toLowerCase());
		if (knownResourceKey) {
			if (fileName.toLowerCase() !== "gear_icons_008.xml") return [knownResourceKey];
			return [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...fallbackResourceKeys.filter((candidate) => candidate.toLowerCase().endsWith("_05.xml")), knownResourceKey])];
		}
		if (normalizedAtlasName.includes("/")) return [normalizedAtlasName];
		return [resourceDirectory ? `${resourceDirectory.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/${fileName}` : fileName];
	}
	function getBaseItemType(itemType) {
		if (itemType === "fragmentGear") return "gear";
		if (itemType === "fragmentScroll") return "scroll";
		if (itemType === "gold" || STARMONEY_TYPES.has(itemType)) return "pseudo";
		return itemType;
	}
	function normalizeEntityId(value) {
		const numeric = Number(value);
		return Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric > 0 ? String(Math.trunc(numeric)) : String(value ?? "").trim();
	}
	function pickCachedIcons(keys, cache) {
		return Object.fromEntries([...new Set(keys)].map((key) => [key, cache.get(key)]).filter((entry) => !!entry[1]));
	}

	var CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
	var DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES_PER_SCOPE = 512;
	var DEFAULT_MAX_CHARACTERS_PER_SCOPE = 4e6;
	var MAX_ICON_DATA_URL_LENGTH = 256e3;
	var defaultStorage;
	function createVersionedGameIconCache({ maxCharactersPerScope = DEFAULT_MAX_CHARACTERS_PER_SCOPE, maxEntriesPerScope = DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES_PER_SCOPE, revision, runtimeRoot = globalThis, storage = getDefaultStorage() } = {}) {
		const assetRevision = normalizeRevision(revision ?? (resolveGameAssetRevision(runtimeRoot) || "runtime-fallback"));
		const stateByScope = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		function getScopeState(scope) {
			const normalizedScope = normalizeScope(scope);
			let pending = stateByScope.get(normalizedScope);
			if (!pending) {
				pending = loadScopeState(storage, normalizedScope, assetRevision);
				stateByScope.set(normalizedScope, pending);
			}
			return pending;
		}
		async function read(scope, keys) {
			if (!assetRevision) return {};
			const state = await getScopeState(scope);
			return Object.fromEntries([...new Set(keys.map(normalizeKey).filter(Boolean))].map((key) => [key, state.icons[key]]).filter((entry) => !!entry[1]));
		}
		async function remember(scope, icons) {
			if (!assetRevision) return;
			const normalizedScope = normalizeScope(scope);
			const state = await getScopeState(normalizedScope);
			let changed = false;
			for (const [rawKey, rawDataUrl] of Object.entries(icons)) {
				const key = normalizeKey(rawKey);
				const dataUrl = normalizeIconDataUrl(rawDataUrl);
				if (!key || !dataUrl || state.icons[key] === dataUrl) continue;
				state.icons[key] = dataUrl;
				changed = true;
			}
			if (!changed) return;
			trimIcons(state.icons, maxEntriesPerScope, maxCharactersPerScope);
			state.dirtyVersion += 1;
			await persistScopeState(storage, normalizedScope, assetRevision, state);
		}
		return {
			read,
			remember
		};
	}
	function resolveGameAssetRevision(runtimeRoot = globalThis) {
		const root = asRecordOrNull(runtimeRoot);
		const flashVars = asRecordOrNull((asRecordOrNull(root?.unsafeWindow) ?? root)?.NXFlashVars) ?? asRecordOrNull(root?.NXFlashVars) ?? asRecordOrNull(globalThis.NXFlashVars);
		const indexUrls = asRecordOrNull(flashVars?.index_url);
		return [
			[
				flashVars?.asset_version,
				flashVars?.assets_version,
				flashVars?.client_version,
				flashVars?.static_version,
				flashVars?.version
			].map(normalizeRevision).find(Boolean),
			normalizeRevision(flashVars?.static_url),
			normalizeRevision(indexUrls?.asset_index)
		].filter(Boolean).join("|");
	}
	function getDefaultStorage() {
		return defaultStorage ?? (defaultStorage = new NativeStorage({
			name: "game-icons",
			schemaVersion: CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION
		}));
	}
	async function loadScopeState(storage, scope, revision) {
		let record = null;
		if (revision) try {
			record = normalizeCachedRecord(await storage.read(cacheKey(scope)));
		} catch {
			record = null;
		}
		return {
			dirtyVersion: 0,
			icons: record?.revision === revision ? record.icons : {},
			persistedVersion: 0
		};
	}
	async function persistScopeState(storage, scope, revision, state) {
		if (!state.persisting) state.persisting = (async () => {
			while (state.persistedVersion < state.dirtyVersion) {
				const targetVersion = state.dirtyVersion;
				try {
					await storage.write(cacheKey(scope), {
						icons: { ...state.icons },
						revision
					});
				} catch {
					state.persistedVersion = state.dirtyVersion;
					break;
				}
				state.persistedVersion = targetVersion;
			}
		})().finally(() => {
			state.persisting = void 0;
		});
		await state.persisting;
	}
	function normalizeCachedRecord(value) {
		const record = asRecordOrNull(value);
		const sourceIcons = asRecordOrNull(record?.icons);
		const revision = normalizeRevision(record?.revision);
		if (!sourceIcons || !revision) return null;
		return {
			icons: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sourceIcons).flatMap(([rawKey, rawValue]) => {
				const key = normalizeKey(rawKey);
				const dataUrl = normalizeIconDataUrl(rawValue);
				return key && dataUrl ? [[key, dataUrl]] : [];
			})),
			revision
		};
	}
	function trimIcons(icons, rawMaxEntries, rawMaxCharacters) {
		const maxEntries = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(rawMaxEntries) || 1);
		const maxCharacters = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(rawMaxCharacters) || 1);
		const keys = Object.keys(icons);
		let characterCount = keys.reduce((total, key) => total + key.length + icons[key].length, 0);
		while (keys.length > 1 && (keys.length > maxEntries || characterCount > maxCharacters)) {
			const key = keys.shift();
			if (!key) break;
			characterCount -= key.length + icons[key].length;
			delete icons[key];
		}
	}
	function normalizeIconDataUrl(value) {
		const dataUrl = String(value ?? "").trim();
		return /^data:image\/(?:gif|jpeg|png|webp);base64,/i.test(dataUrl) && dataUrl.length <= MAX_ICON_DATA_URL_LENGTH ? dataUrl : "";
	}
	function normalizeRevision(value) {
		return String(value ?? "").trim().slice(0, 2048);
	}
	function normalizeScope(value) {
		return String(value ?? "").trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9:_-]+/gi, "-").slice(0, 96);
	}
	function normalizeKey(value) {
		return String(value ?? "").trim().slice(0, 160);
	}
	function cacheKey(scope) {
		return `icons:${scope || "default"}`;
	}

	function createOptionalGameEntityIconResolver(gameLibrary, loaderOptions = { runtimeRoot: globalThis }, retryOptions = {}) {

	function createGameEntityIconResolver(gameLibrary, assets, onError, persistentCache) {

	function createLazyOptionalIconResolver(createResolver, reportInitializationError, { maxInitializationAttempts = OPTIONAL_RESOLVER_MAX_INITIALIZATION_ATTEMPTS, retryDelayMs = OPTIONAL_RESOLVER_RETRY_DELAY_MS } = {}) {
		let resolver;
		let pendingInitialization;
		let nextRetryAt = 0;
		let initializationErrorReported = false;
		const normalizedAttempts = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(maxInitializationAttempts) || 1));
		const normalizedRetryDelayMs = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(retryDelayMs) || 0));
		const initializeResolver = () => {
			if (resolver) return Promise.resolve(resolver);
			if (pendingInitialization) return pendingInitialization;
			if (Date.now() < nextRetryAt) return Promise.resolve(null);
			pendingInitialization = (async () => {
				let lastError;
				for (let attempt = 0; attempt < normalizedAttempts; attempt += 1) try {
					resolver = createResolver();
					return resolver;
				} catch (error) {
					lastError = error;
					if (attempt + 1 < normalizedAttempts && normalizedRetryDelayMs > 0) await waitForOptionalResolverRetry(normalizedRetryDelayMs);
				}
				nextRetryAt = Date.now() + normalizedRetryDelayMs;
				if (!initializationErrorReported) {
					initializationErrorReported = true;
					reportInitializationError(lastError);
				}
				return null;
			})().finally(() => {
				pendingInitialization = void 0;
			});
			return pendingInitialization;
		};
		return async (...args) => {
			const activeResolver = await initializeResolver();
			return activeResolver ? activeResolver(...args) : null;
		};
	}
	function waitForOptionalResolverRetry(delayMs) {
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			globalThis.setTimeout(resolve, delayMs);
		});
	}
	function createGameItemIconResolver(catalog, persistentCache) {

			if (current) return current;
			const pending = resolveCachedItemIcon(catalog, itemType, itemId, key, persistentCache).catch(() => null);
			cache.set(key, pending);
			return pending;
		};
	}
	async function resolveCachedItemIcon(catalog, itemType, itemId, key, persistentCache) {
		const cached = persistentCache ? (await persistentCache.read(ITEM_CACHE_SCOPE, [key]))[key] : void 0;
		if (cached) return cached;
		const icon = (await catalog.loadItemIcons([{
			itemType,
			itemId
		}]))[key] ?? null;
		if (icon && persistentCache) persistentCache.remember(ITEM_CACHE_SCOPE, { [key]: icon });
		return icon;
	}
	async function resolveCachedEntityIcon(library, assets, entityId, kind, key, persistentCache) {
		const cached = persistentCache ? (await persistentCache.read(ENTITY_CACHE_SCOPE, [key]))[key] : void 0;
		if (cached) return cached;
		const icon = await resolveEntityIcon(library, assets, entityId, kind);
		if (icon && persistentCache) persistentCache.remember(ENTITY_CACHE_SCOPE, { [key]: icon });
		return icon;
	}
	async function resolveEntityIcon(library, assets, entityId, kind) {
		if (kind === "hero") try {
			const atlasIcon = await getHeroIconFromAtlas(entityId);
			if (atlasIcon) return atlasIcon;
		} catch {}
		const entity = findEntity(library, entityId, kind);
		let nativeError;
		if (kind !== "totem" && kind !== "boss" && kind !== "creep") try {
			const icon = await assets.loadUnitIcon(entityId, kind);
			try {
				return icon.toDataUrl();
			} finally {
				icon.release();
			}
		} catch (error) {
			nativeError = error;
		}
		const candidates = collectTextureCandidates(entity, entityId);
		const descriptor = resolveAssetDescriptor(library, entity, kind, candidates);
		let lease;
		try {
			lease = descriptor.type === "atlas" ? await assets.loadIconAtlas(descriptor.resourceKey) : await assets.loadRsx(descriptor.resourceKey);
		} catch (error) {
			if (kind === "boss" || kind === "creep") try {
				lease = await assets.loadRsx("clan_raid_boss_1_common.rsx");
			} catch {
				try {
					lease = await assets.loadIconAtlas("hero_icons_only");
				} catch {}
			}
			if (!lease) {
				if (kind === "boss" || entityId === 2015 || entityId === 2025) return createBossFallbackIcon(entityId);
				throw nativeError ?? error;
			}
		}
		try {
			const textureName = matchTextureName(lease, candidates, entityId);
			if (textureName) return lease.toDataUrl(textureName);
			if (kind === "boss" || kind === "creep") return createBossFallbackIcon(entityId);
			throw new GameAssetNotFoundError(`В ${descriptor.resourceKey} нет текстуры для ${kind} #${entityId}.`, nativeError ? { cause: nativeError } : void 0);
		} finally {
			lease.release();
		}
	}

	function readLibraryDefinition(gameLibrary, itemType, itemId) {
		const root = asObjectRecord(gameLibrary);
		const rawType = String(itemType ?? "").trim();
		const type = rawType === "fragmentGear" ? "gear" : rawType === "fragmentScroll" ? "scroll" : rawType;
		const targetId = Number(itemId);
		const getData = root.getData;
		let collection;
		if (typeof getData === "function") try {
			collection = Reflect.apply(getData, gameLibrary, [type]);
		} catch {
			collection = void 0;
		}
		const data = asObjectRecord(root.data);
		const inventoryItems = asObjectRecord(data.inventoryItem ?? root.inventoryItem);
		collection ?? (collection = data[type] ?? root[type] ?? inventoryItems[type]);
		if (type === "pseudo" && targetId === 0) {
			const starmoneyDefinition = Object.values(asObjectRecord(collection)).find((definition) => Object.values(asObjectRecord(definition)).some((value) => typeof value === "string" && /(?:star[_-]?money|emerald)/i.test(value)));
			if (starmoneyDefinition) return starmoneyDefinition;
		}
		const findInCandidate = (candidate) => {
			if (Array.isArray(candidate)) return candidate.find((item) => item != null && typeof item === "object" && Number(item.id) === targetId) ?? null;
			if (candidate != null && typeof candidate === "object") {
				const record = candidate;
				const direct = record[String(targetId)];
				if (direct != null && typeof direct === "object") {
					const directId = direct.id;
					if (directId === void 0 || Number(directId) === targetId) return direct;
				}
				return Object.values(record).find((item) => item != null && typeof item === "object" && Number(item.id) === targetId) ?? null;
			}
			return null;
		};
		return findInCandidate(collection) ?? findInCandidate(inventoryItems[type]) ?? {};
	}
	function findEntity(library, entityId, kind) {
		for (const path of COLLECTIONS_BY_KIND[kind]) {
			const collection = readPath$1(library, path);
			const direct = asObjectRecord(asObjectRecord(collection)[String(entityId)]);
			if (Object.keys(direct).length > 0) return direct;
			for (const value of Object.values(asObjectRecord(collection))) {
				const entity = asObjectRecord(value);
				if ([
					entity.id,
					entity.typeId,
					entity.heroId,
					entity.artifactId
				].some((candidate) => Number(candidate) === entityId)) return entity;
			}
		}
		return {};
	}

	function splitAssetTexture(value) {
		const separatorIndex = value.indexOf(":");
		return separatorIndex >= 0 ? [value, value.slice(separatorIndex + 1)] : [value];
	}
	function resolveAssetDescriptor(library, entity, kind, candidates) {
		const qualified = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.includes(":"));
		if (qualified) return {
			type: ASSETS_BY_KIND[kind].type,
			resourceKey: qualified.slice(0, qualified.indexOf(":"))
		};
		const atlasReference = entity.iconAssetAtlas ?? entity.assetAtlas;
		const directAtlas = String(atlasReference ?? "").trim();
		if (directAtlas && !/^\d+$/.test(directAtlas)) return {
			type: "atlas",
			resourceKey: directAtlas
		};
		const atlasId = Number(atlasReference);
		if (Number.isInteger(atlasId) && atlasId > 0) {
			const data = asObjectRecord(library.data);
			const descriptor = asObjectRecord(asObjectRecord(asObjectRecord(library.asset ?? data.asset).inventory)[String(atlasId)]);
			const resourceKey = [
				descriptor.atlas,
				descriptor.asset,
				descriptor.ident,
				descriptor.resource
			].map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim()).find(Boolean);
			if (resourceKey) return {
				type: "atlas",
				resourceKey
			};
		}
		return ASSETS_BY_KIND[kind];
	}
	function matchTextureName(lease, candidates, entityId) {
		const names = lease.textureNames();
		for (const candidate of candidates) {
			const key = candidate.slice(candidate.lastIndexOf(":") + 1).toLowerCase();
			const exact = names.find((name) => name.toLowerCase() === key);
			if (exact) return exact;
		}
		const padded = String(entityId).padStart(4, "0").toLowerCase();
		return names.find((name) => {
			const stem = name.slice(name.lastIndexOf(":") + 1).toLowerCase();
			return stem === padded || stem.startsWith(`${padded}_`);
		}) ?? null;
	}
	function normalizeKind(entityId, kind) {
		if (kind in ASSETS_BY_KIND) return kind;
		if (entityId >= 6e3 && entityId < 7e3) return "pet";
		if (entityId >= 4e3 && entityId < 5e3) return "titan";
		if (entityId >= 2e3 && entityId < 3e3) return "boss";
		return "hero";
	}
	function readPath$1(root, path) {
		let value = root;
		for (const segment of path.split(".")) value = asObjectRecord(value)[segment];
		return value;
	}

	/** Атлас крипов хранится в подпапке и часто только в AVIF, хотя XML указывает PNG. */
	function createBattleLabCreepPortraitResolver() {
		const cache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		return (id) => {
			const existing = cache.get(id);
			if (existing) return existing;
			const pending = readPortrait(id).catch((error) => {
				console.warn("[Battle Lab] Портрет босса недоступен.", id, error);
				return null;
			}).then((url) => {
				if (!url) cache.delete(id);
				return url;
			});
			cache.set(id, pending);
			return pending;
		};
	}
	/** После извлечения маленького портрета освобождает декодированный лист целиком. */
	async function readPortrait(id) {
		const base = "creep_icons/creep_icons";
		const xml = await readGameFile(`${base}.xml`);
		if (!xml) return null;
		const frames = parseTextureAtlasXml(new TextDecoder().decode(xml));
		const frame = frames.get(String(id)) ?? frames.get(String(id).padStart(4, "0"));
		if (!frame) return null;
		for (const extension of [
			"avif",
			"png",
			"webp"
		]) {
			const bytes = await readGameFile(`${base}.${extension}`);
			if (!bytes) continue;
			const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(new Blob([bytes], { type: `image/${extension}` }));
			try {
				const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
				canvas.width = frame.w;
				canvas.height = frame.h;
				const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
				if (!context) return null;
				context.drawImage(bitmap, frame.x, frame.y, frame.w, frame.h, 0, 0, frame.w, frame.h);
				return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
			} finally {
				bitmap.close();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	function resolveBattleLabUnitDecorationTextures(heroColors, unitValue, kind = "hero", entityDefinition = {}) {
		const unit = asObjectRecord(unitValue);
		const colors = asObjectRecord(heroColors);
		const requestedRank = Number(unit.color ?? unit.rank ?? 1);
		let rank = Number.isFinite(requestedRank) ? Math.max(1, Math.trunc(requestedRank)) : 1;
		if (kind === "pet") {
			const availableRanks = Object.keys(colors).map(Number).filter((candidate) => {
				const definition = asObjectRecord(colors[String(candidate)]);
				return Number.isSafeInteger(candidate) && candidate <= rank && Boolean(firstTexture(definition.frameAssetTexture_pet, definition.frameAssetTexture_small_pet));
			});
			rank = Math.max(1, ...availableRanks);
		}
		const definition = asObjectRecord(colors[String(rank)]);
		const requestedStars = Number(unit.star ?? unit.stars ?? 0);
		const starCount = Number.isFinite(requestedStars) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(6, Math.trunc(requestedStars))) : 0;
		const absoluteStar = starCount === 6;
		const heroBackground = firstTexture(definition.backgroundAssetTexture);
		return {
			frame: kind === "hero" ? firstTexture(definition.frameAssetTexture, definition.frameAssetTexture_small) : kind === "pet" ? firstTexture(definition.frameAssetTexture_pet, definition.frameAssetTexture_small_pet) : resolveBattleLabRankFrameTexture(colors, rank, kind, entityDefinition),
			background: kind === "pet" ? heroBackground?.replace(/^bg_hero_/u, "bg_pet_") ?? null : kind === "hero" ? heroBackground : null,
			levelPlate: kind === "hero" || kind === "pet" ? firstTexture(definition.levelBackgroundAssetTexture) : null,
			stars: starCount ? absoluteStar ? "epic_star_icon_small" : "starIcon_small" : null,
			starCount,
			absoluteStar
		};
	}

	async function preloadBattleLabHeroIcons(gameLibrary, resolver, additionalIds = [], concurrency = DEFAULT_ICON_PRELOAD_CONCURRENCY) {
		const heroes = asObjectRecord(asObjectRecord(gameLibrary).hero);
		const libraryEntities = Object.values(heroes).map((value) => asObjectRecord(value)).map((definition) => ({
			id: Number(definition.id),
			kind: normalizePreloadKind(definition.type, Number(definition.id))
		})).filter((entity) => Number.isSafeInteger(entity.id) && entity.id > 0 && (entity.kind === "hero" && entity.id < 4e3 || entity.kind === "titan" && entity.id >= 4e3 && entity.id < 5e3 || entity.kind === "pet" && entity.id >= 6e3 && entity.id < 7e3));
		const additionalEntities = additionalIds.map((value) => typeof value === "number" ? {
			id: value,
			kind: normalizePreloadKind(void 0, value)
		} : {
			id: value.id,
			kind: value.kind
		}).filter((entity) => Number.isSafeInteger(entity.id) && entity.id > 0);
		const queue = [...new Map([...libraryEntities, ...additionalEntities].map((entity) => [`${entity.kind ?? "hero"}:${entity.id}`, entity])).values()];
		await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(queue.length, Math.max(1, Math.floor(concurrency))) }, async () => {
			while (queue.length > 0) {
				const entity = queue.shift();
				if (!entity) continue;
				await resolver(entity.id, entity.kind).catch(() => null);
			}
		}));
	}

	function resolveBattleLabRankFrameTexture(heroColors, rank, kind = "hero", entityDefinition = {}) {

		}

	}
	function createRsxTextureResolver(loader) {
		const cache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
		return (textureName) => {
			const key = textureName.trim();
			if (!key) return Promise.resolve(null);
			const current = cache.get(key);
			if (current) return current;

			cache.set(key, pending);
			return pending;
		};
	}
	async function resolveRsxTexture(loader, textureName) {
		for (const resource of BATTLE_FRAME_RESOURCES) {
			const lease = await loader.loadRsx(resource, { timeoutMs: 4e3 });
			try {
				const normalized = textureName.toLowerCase();
				const match = lease.textureNames().find((candidate) => candidate.toLowerCase() === normalized);
				if (match) return lease.toDataUrl(match);
			} finally {
				lease.release();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
	function firstTexture(...values) {
		for (const value of values) {
			const texture = typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
			if (texture) return texture;
		}
		return null;
	}
	async function resolveBattleLabTexture(loader, textureReference) {
		const references = textureReference.split("|").map((name) => name.trim());
		const requestedNames = references.map(getGameIconTextureName).filter(Boolean).map((name) => name.toLowerCase());
		if (requestedNames.length === 0) return null;
		const preferredResources = references.flatMap((reference) => {
			const resourceKey = normalizeTextureResourceKey(getGameIconAtlasName(reference));
			return resourceKey ? [{
				type: resourceKey.toLowerCase().endsWith(".rsx") ? "rsx" : "atlas",
				key: resourceKey
			}] : [];
		});
		const resources = [...new Map([...preferredResources, ...BATTLE_TEXTURE_RESOURCES].map((resource) => [`${resource.type}:${resource.key}`, resource])).values()];
		for (const resource of resources) {
			const lease = resource.type === "rsx" ? await loader.loadRsx(resource.key, { timeoutMs: 4e3 }).catch(() => null) : await loader.loadIconAtlas(resource.key, { timeoutMs: 4e3 }).catch(() => null);
			if (!lease) continue;
			try {
				const match = lease.textureNames().find((candidate) => requestedNames.includes(getGameIconTextureName(candidate).toLowerCase()));
				if (match) return lease.toDataUrl(match);
			} finally {
				lease.release();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
	function normalizeTextureResourceKey(value) {
		const raw = String(value ?? "").trim().replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/^.*?\/assets\//iu, "").replace(/\.([a-f0-9]{16,})\.(xml|rsx)$/iu, ".$2").replace(/^\/+|\/+$/gu, "");
		if (!raw) return "";
		return /\.(?:xml|rsx)$/iu.test(raw) ? raw : `${raw}.xml`;
	}
	function normalizePreloadKind(value, id) {
		if (value === "hero" || value === "pet" || value === "titan" || value === "banner" || value === "totem") return value;
		if (id >= 7e3 && id < 8e3) return "totem";
		if (id >= 6e3 && id < 7e3) return "pet";
		if (id >= 4e3 && id < 5e3) return "titan";
		if (id > 0 && id < 4e3) return "hero";
	}

				const direct = asRecord$1(collection[String(unitId)]);
				const entity = Object.keys(direct).length > 0 ? direct : Object.values(collection).map(asRecord$1).find((candidate) => [
					candidate.id,
					candidate.typeId,
					candidate.heroId,
					candidate.artifactId
				].some((value) => Number(value) === unitId)) ?? {};
				for (const value of [
					entity.name,
					entity.title,
					entity.localeKey,
					entity.nameLocaleKey,
					entity.titleLocaleKey,
					entity.nameKey,
					entity.titleKey
				]) {
					const label = translateValue(value, translateGame);
					if (label) {
						labelCache.set(cacheKey, label);
						return label;
					}
				}
			}
			for (const prefix of prefixes) {
				const key = `${prefix}${unitId}`;
				const label = translateValue(key, translateGame);
				if (label && label !== key) {
					labelCache.set(cacheKey, label);
					return label;
				}
			}
			const fallback = `#${unitId}`;
			labelCache.set(cacheKey, fallback);
			return fallback;
		};
	}
	function resolveTranslationPrefixes(unitId, kind) {
		if (kind === "banner") return ["LIB_BANNER_NAME_", "LIB_BATTLE_BANNER_NAME_"];
		if (kind === "totem") return [
			"LIB_TITAN_ARTIFACT_NAME_",
			"LIB_TITAN_SPIRIT_NAME_",
			"LIB_TITANSPIRIT_NAME_"
		];
		if (kind === "pet" || unitId >= 6e3 && unitId < 7e3) return ["LIB_PET_NAME_", "LIB_HERO_NAME_"];
		if (kind === "titan") return ["LIB_HERO_NAME_", "LIB_TITAN_NAME_"];
		return [
			"LIB_HERO_NAME_",
			"LIB_TITAN_NAME_",
			"LIB_PET_NAME_"
		];
	}
	function resolveLibraryCollections(kind) {
		if (kind === "banner") return [
			"banner",
			"banners",
			"battleBanner",
			"battleBanners"
		];
		if (kind === "totem") return [
			"titanSpirit",
			"titanSpirits",
			"titanArtifact.id",
			"titanArtifact",
			"artifact.id"
		];
		if (kind === "pet") return [
			"pet",
			"pets",
			"hero"
		];
		if (kind === "titan") return [
			"titan",
			"titans",
			"hero",
			"heroes"
		];
		return [
			"hero",
			"heroes",
			"titan",
			"titans",
			"pet",
			"pets"
		];
	}
	function readPath(root, path) {
		let value = root;
		for (const segment of path.split(".")) value = asRecord$1(value)[segment];
		return value;
	}
	function translateValue(value, translateGame) {
		const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
		if (!text) return "";
		try {
			const translated = String(translateGame(text) ?? "").trim();
			if (translated && translated !== text) return translated;
			return /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(text) ? "" : text;
		} catch {
			return /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(text) ? "" : text;
		}
	}

	function createBattleLabViewResolvers({ translate, translateGame, gameLibrary }) {
		let copyCache = null;
		let modeViewsCache = null;
		let iconResolver = null;
		let frameResolver = null;
		let decorationResolver = null;
		let itemIconResolver = null;
		let textureIconResolver = null;
		let labelResolver = null;
		let tooltipResolver = null;
		let resolvedGameLibrary = null;
		const refreshLibraryResolvers = () => {
			const currentLibrary = typeof gameLibrary === "function" ? gameLibrary() : gameLibrary;
			if (currentLibrary === resolvedGameLibrary) return;
			resolvedGameLibrary = currentLibrary;
			labelResolver = createBattleLabEntityLabelResolver(currentLibrary, translateGame);
			iconResolver = null;
			frameResolver = null;
			decorationResolver = null;
			itemIconResolver = null;
			textureIconResolver = null;
			tooltipResolver = null;
		};
		return {
			getCopy: () => copyCache ?? (copyCache = Object.fromEntries(getBattleLabCopyKeys().map((key) => [key, translate(key)]))),
			getModeViews: () => modeViewsCache ?? (modeViewsCache = BATTLE_LAB_MODES.map((mode) => ({
				id: mode.id,
				label: translate(mode.labelKey),
				shortLabel: translate(mode.shortLabelKey),
				description: translate(mode.descriptionKey),
				icon: mode.icon
			}))),
			getEntityLabel: (entityId, kind) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				labelResolver ?? (labelResolver = createBattleLabEntityLabelResolver({}, translateGame));
				return labelResolver(entityId, kind);
			},
			getEntityIcon: ((entityId, kind) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				iconResolver ?? (iconResolver = createOptionalBattleLabEntityIconResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}));
				return iconResolver(entityId, kind);
			}),
			preloadHeroIcons: async (additionalIds = []) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				iconResolver ?? (iconResolver = createOptionalBattleLabEntityIconResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}));
				await preloadBattleLabHeroIcons(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}, iconResolver, additionalIds);
			},
			getRankFrame: ((rank, kind, entityId) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				frameResolver ?? (frameResolver = createOptionalBattleLabRankFrameResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}));
				return frameResolver(rank, kind, entityId);
			}),
			getUnitDecoration: ((unit, kind) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				decorationResolver ?? (decorationResolver = createOptionalBattleLabUnitDecorationResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}));
				return decorationResolver(unit, kind);
			}),
			getItemIcon: ((itemType, itemId) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				itemIconResolver ?? (itemIconResolver = createOptionalBattleLabItemIconResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}));
				return itemIconResolver(itemType, itemId);
			}),
			getTextureIcon: ((textureReference) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				textureIconResolver ?? (textureIconResolver = createOptionalBattleLabTextureIconResolver());
				return textureIconResolver(textureReference);
			}),
			getUnitTooltip: (unit, kind) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				tooltipResolver ?? (tooltipResolver = createBattleLabUnitTooltipResolver(resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}, translateGame));
				return tooltipResolver(unit, kind);
			},
			getAsgardSummary: (opponent) => {
				refreshLibraryResolvers();
				return resolveBattleLabAsgardSummary(opponent, resolvedGameLibrary ?? {}, translateGame);
			}
		};
	}

	async function replayBattleLabHistory(entry, options = {}) {
		const snapshots = extractReplayBattles(entry.battleSnapshot);
		if (snapshots.length === 0) throw new Error("В записи нет полного снимка, который можно повторить.");
		const calculator = new GameRuntimeBattleCalculator();
		const calculations = [];
		for (const snapshot of snapshots) {
			const mode = resolveReplayMode(entry, snapshot);
			const baseline = await calculator.calculate(withInput(snapshot, new BattleInputBuilder().encode()), mode);
			if (!mode.manualAllowed || !hasManualTiming(entry)) {
				calculations.push(baseline);
				continue;
			}
			const timeline = Array.isArray(baseline.timeline) ? baseline.timeline : [];
			const input = BattleInputBuilder.fromActions(entry.timings, { includeAutoAtStart: !entry.timings.some((action) => action.type === "auto" && action.time === 0) }).encodeWithTimeline(timeline);
			calculations.push(await calculator.calculate(withInput(snapshot, input), mode));
		}
		const replaySnapshot = calculations.length === 1 ? calculationSnapshot(calculations[0]) : { battles: calculations.map(calculationSnapshot) };
		const teamResults = calculations.map((calculation) => {
			const win = asRecord$1(calculation.result ?? calculation.battle?.result).win;
			return win === true ? "win" : win === false ? "loss" : "unknown";
		});
		const preserveOutcome = options.preserveOutcome ?? entry.source === "game";
		return {
			...entry,
			teamResults: preserveOutcome ? entry.teamResults : teamResults,
			result: preserveOutcome ? entry.result : resolveReplayResult(entry.modeId, teamResults),
			details: extractBattleDetails(replaySnapshot),
			battleSnapshot: preserveOutcome ? entry.battleSnapshot : replaySnapshot,
			calculationCount: entry.calculationCount + calculations.length
		};
	}
	function serializeBattleLabSnapshot(entry) {
		return JSON.stringify({
			schemaVersion: 1,
			exportedAt: Date.now(),
			replay: entry
		}, null, 2);
	}
	function parseBattleLabSnapshots(value) {
		const source = JSON.parse(value);
		const record = asRecord$1(source);
		return normalizeWorkspace({ history: Array.isArray(record.history) ? record.history : record.replay ? [record.replay] : Array.isArray(source) ? source : [] }).history.filter((entry) => entry.battleSnapshot !== null);
	}
	function extractReplayBattles(value) {
		const snapshot = asRecord$1(value);
		return (Array.isArray(snapshot.battles) ? snapshot.battles : [snapshot]).map((source) => {
			const record = asRecord$1(source);
			const battle = asRecord$1(record.battleData ?? record.battle ?? record);
			return battle.attackers != null && battle.defenders != null ? structuredClone(battle) : null;
		}).filter((battle) => battle !== null);
	}
	function resolveReplayMode(entry, battle) {
		if (entry.modeId === "archdemon" || isArchdemonBattle(battle)) return {
			...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
			battleConfigIdent: "boss_event",
			manualAllowed: false,
			allowBanner: false
		};
		switch (entry.modeId) {
			case "grand-arena": return BattleModes.HERO_ARENA_AUTO;
			case "asgard": return {
				...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
				battleConfigIdent: "clan_pvp"
			};
			case "adventure": return {
				...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
				battleConfigIdent: "adventure"
			};
			case "epic-brawl": return String(battle.type ?? "").includes("titan") ? {
				...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
				battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl_titan"
			} : {
				...BattleModes.HERO_MANUAL,
				battleConfigIdent: "epic_brawl"
			};
			case "invasion":
			case "dominion-rift": return {
				...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
				battleConfigIdent: "invasion_boss"
			};
			case "lord": return isLegacyLordBoss(entry.modeId, battle.type) ? {
				...BattleModes.BOSS_DAMAGE,
				battleConfigIdent: "boss"
			} : {
				...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
				battleConfigIdent: "titan_arena"
			};
			case "tournament-of-elements": return {
				...BattleModes.TITAN_MANUAL,
				battleConfigIdent: "titan_arena"
			};
			default: return String(battle.type ?? "").includes("titan") ? BattleModes.TITAN_ARENA_AUTO : BattleModes.HERO_ARENA_AUTO;
		}
	}
	function withInput(battle, input) {
		const clone = structuredClone(battle);
		const firstProgress = asRecord$1(Array.isArray(clone.progress) ? clone.progress[0] : null);
		clone.progress = [{
			...firstProgress,
			attackers: {
				...asRecord$1(firstProgress.attackers),
				input
			}
		}];
		return clone;
	}
	function calculationSnapshot(calculation) {
		return {
			battleData: calculation.battleData ?? calculation.battle,
			progress: calculation.progress,
			result: calculation.result,
			battleLogs: calculation.battleLogs,
			battleTime: calculation.battleTime,
			battleTimer: calculation.battleTimer,
			timeline: calculation.timeline
		};
	}
	function hasManualTiming(entry) {
		return entry.timings.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0);
	}
	function resolveReplayResult(modeId, results) {
		if (modeId === "grand-arena") return results.filter((result) => result === "win").length >= 2 ? "win" : results.some((result) => result === "unknown") ? "unknown" : "loss";
		return results[0] ?? "unknown";
	}

	function getSplashTone(color) {
		if (color === "gold") return "gold";
		if (color === "blue") return "blue";
		if (color === "pink" || color === "purple") return "purple";
		return "green";
	}
	/**
	* Создаёт фабрику кнопок меню скрипта (main и other) с динамическими label/title.
	*/
	function createScriptMenuButtonFactory({ actionKey, color = "pink", icon = "", getLabel, getTitle, onClick, buildIconLabel = (_icon, label) => String(label ?? ""), splash = true } = {}) {
		const readLabel = () => typeof getLabel === "function" ? getLabel() : String(getLabel ?? "");
		const readTitle = () => typeof getTitle === "function" ? getTitle() : String(getTitle ?? "");
		const runAction = onClick ? (...args) => {
			if (!splash) return onClick(...args);
			return withRuntimeFeedbackSplash({
				title: String(readLabel()),
				status: String(readTitle()),
				icon: icon || "settings-2",
				tone: getSplashTone(color)
			}, () => onClick(...args));
		} : void 0;
		function createMainButton() {
			return {
				get name() {
					return String(readLabel());
				},
				get title() {
					return String(readTitle());
				},
				color,
				onClick: runAction
			};
		}
		function createOtherButton() {
			return {
				actionKey,
				get msg() {
					return String(buildIconLabel(icon, readLabel()));
				},
				get title() {
					return String(readTitle());
				},
				color,
				result: runAction
			};
		}
		return {
			createMainButton,
			createOtherButton
		};
	}

	init_menu_actions();
	var BATTLE_LAB_MENU_ACTION_KEY = "hwhBattleLabAction";
	var BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY = "hwhBattleLab";
	var BATTLE_LAB_MENU_MARKER_CLASS = "hwhbattlelab-menu-button";
	function createBattleLabMenuRegistration({ helperData, helperClasses, translate, onOpen, splash = true }) {
		const mainMenuButtons = ensureMainMenuButtons(helperData);
		const othersPopupButtons = ensureOtherPopupButtons(helperData);
		const factory = createScriptMenuButtonFactory({
			actionKey: BATTLE_LAB_MENU_ACTION_KEY,
			color: "gold",
			icon: "swords",
			getLabel: () => translate("HWHBL_BUTTON"),
			getTitle: () => translate("HWHBL_BUTTON_TITLE"),
			onClick: onOpen,
			buildIconLabel: (icon, label) => renderIconLabel(icon, label, { className: "hwhx-title-accent" }),
			splash
		});
		let currentPlacement = null;
		return {
			get descriptorRegistered() {
				return Boolean(mainMenuButtons[BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY]);
			},
			get mounted() {
				return isConnected(toMenuElement(mainMenuButtons[BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY]?.button));
			},
			get placement() {
				return currentPlacement;
			},
			sync(rawPlacement) {
				const placement = normalizeMenuActionPlacement(rawPlacement, "main");
				const currentMainButton = mainMenuButtons[BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY];
				const hasCurrentOtherButton = othersPopupButtons.some((button) => button?.actionKey === BATTLE_LAB_MENU_ACTION_KEY);
				if (currentPlacement === placement && (placement === "main" && currentMainButton || placement === "other" && hasCurrentOtherButton)) {
					if (placement === "main") mountMainMenuButtonIfReady(helperClasses, currentMainButton);
					return;
				}
				if (currentMainButton) unmountMainMenuButton(helperClasses, currentMainButton);
				syncScriptMenuActionPlacement({
					HWHData: helperData,
					mainMenuButtons,
					othersPopupButtons,
					placement,
					mainKey: BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY,
					actionKey: BATTLE_LAB_MENU_ACTION_KEY,
					createMainButton: () => markMainButton(factory.createMainButton()),
					createOtherButton: factory.createOtherButton
				});
				currentPlacement = placement;
				if (placement === "main") mountMainMenuButtonIfReady(helperClasses, mainMenuButtons[BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY]);
			},
			refresh() {
				if (currentPlacement !== "main") return true;
				return mountMainMenuButtonIfReady(helperClasses, mainMenuButtons[BATTLE_LAB_MAIN_MENU_KEY]);
			}
		};
	}
	function markMainButton(button) {
		const classes = Array.isArray(button.classes) ? button.classes.filter((value) => typeof value === "string") : [];
		button.classes = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...classes, BATTLE_LAB_MENU_MARKER_CLASS])];
		return button;
	}
	function mountMainMenuButtonIfReady(helperClasses, descriptor) {
		if (!descriptor) return false;
		if (isConnected(toMenuElement(descriptor.button))) return true;
		const menu = resolveScriptMenu(helperClasses);
		if (!menu?.mainMenu || typeof menu.addButton !== "function") return false;
		const existingButton = menu.mainMenu.querySelector?.(`.${BATTLE_LAB_MENU_MARKER_CLASS}`);
		if (existingButton) {
			descriptor.button = existingButton;
			return true;
		}
		const createdButton = toMenuElement(menu.addButton(descriptor));
		if (!createdButton) return false;
		descriptor.button = createdButton;
		createdButton.dataset ?? (createdButton.dataset = {});
		createdButton.dataset.hwhBattleLab = "1";
		return true;
	}
	function unmountMainMenuButton(helperClasses, descriptor) {
		const button = toMenuElement(descriptor.button);
		if (!button) return;
		const row = button.closest?.(".scriptMenu_btnRow");
		if (row && (row.childElementCount ?? 1) <= 1) row.remove?.();
		else button.remove?.();
		const menu = resolveScriptMenu(helperClasses);
		if (Array.isArray(menu?.buttons)) menu.buttons = menu.buttons.filter((candidate) => candidate !== button);
		delete descriptor.button;
	}
	function resolveScriptMenu(helperClasses) {
		if (!helperClasses || typeof helperClasses !== "object") return null;
		const constructor = helperClasses.ScriptMenu;
		if (typeof constructor?.getInst !== "function") return null;
		try {
			return constructor.getInst() ?? null;
		} catch {
			return null;
		}
	}
	function toMenuElement(value) {
		return value && typeof value === "object" ? value : null;
	}
	function isConnected(element) {
		return Boolean(element && element.isConnected !== false);
	}
