	var markRaw = (value) => value;
	var SCRIPT_NAME = "HWH Battle Lab";
	var RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED_KEYS = ["lib"];
	var BOOTSTRAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 120;
	var BOOTSTRAP_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 500;
	var MENU_MOUNT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 240;
	var MENU_MOUNT_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 250;
	var LIVE_TOURNAMENT_TIMING_LIMIT = 8192;
	var battleLabMenuRegistration = null;
	var battleLabMenuMountAttempt = 0;
	var battleLabMenuMountTimer = null;
	var openBattleLabHandler = null;
	var battleLabRuntimeReady = false;
	var battleLabRuntimeStarting = false;
	var battleLabRuntimeError = null;
	function initializeBattleLabExtension(attempt = 0) {
		installGameNetworkInterceptor();
		mountStandaloneLauncher({ onOpen: openBattleLabFromMenu });
		if (globalThis.HWHData) ensureBattleLabMenuRegistration();
		initializeBattleLabRuntime(attempt);
	}
	function ensureBattleLabMenuRegistration() {
		if (battleLabMenuRegistration) return battleLabMenuRegistration;
		const translateMenu = createTranslator({
			i18nLangData: getBattleLabTranslations(),
			preferGameI18N: false,
			fallbackLanguage: "ru",
			cacheMissingTranslations: true
		});
		battleLabMenuRegistration = createBattleLabMenuRegistration({
			helperData: globalThis.HWHData,
			helperClasses: globalThis.HWHClasses,
			translate: translateMenu,
			onOpen: openBattleLabFromMenu,
			splash: false
		});
		battleLabMenuRegistration.sync(DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS.menuPlacement);
		scheduleBattleLabMenuMount();
		exposeBattleLabDiagnostics({
			readMenu: () => battleLabMenuRegistration,
			readMenuMountAttempt: () => battleLabMenuMountAttempt,
			readRuntime: () => ({
				ready: battleLabRuntimeReady,
				starting: battleLabRuntimeStarting,
				error: battleLabRuntimeError
			}),
			open: openBattleLabFromMenu
		});
		return battleLabMenuRegistration;
	}
	function scheduleBattleLabMenuMount(attempt = 0) {
		const registration = battleLabMenuRegistration;
		if (!registration) return;
		battleLabMenuMountAttempt = attempt;
		if (registration.refresh() || attempt >= MENU_MOUNT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) return;
		if (battleLabMenuMountTimer !== null) return;
		battleLabMenuMountTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
			battleLabMenuMountTimer = null;
			scheduleBattleLabMenuMount(attempt + 1);
		}, MENU_MOUNT_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
	}
	async function openBattleLabFromMenu() {
		const currentHandler = readOpenBattleLabHandler();
		if (currentHandler) return currentHandler();
		initializeBattleLabRuntime(0);
		let initializedHandler = readOpenBattleLabHandler();
		if (initializedHandler) return initializedHandler();
		const startTime = Date.now();
		while (!initializedHandler && Date.now() - startTime < 4e3) {
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
			initializeBattleLabRuntime(0);
			initializedHandler = readOpenBattleLabHandler();
		}
		if (initializedHandler) return initializedHandler();
		const error = battleLabRuntimeError;
		const message = error ? `Battle Lab не запустился: ${getErrorMessage$1(error)}` : "Battle Lab ещё ждёт готовности игрового runtime. Повторите через пару секунд.";
		console.error("[Battle Lab]", message, error ?? "");
		showBootstrapStatus(message);
	}
	function readOpenBattleLabHandler() {
		return openBattleLabHandler;
	}
	function initializeBattleLabRuntime(attempt = 0) {
		if (battleLabRuntimeReady || battleLabRuntimeStarting) return;
		if (!retryHwhRuntimeInitialization({
			attempt: Number(attempt) || 0,
			maxAttempts: BOOTSTRAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
			delayMs: BOOTSTRAP_RETRY_DELAY_MS,
			requiredKeys: RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED_KEYS,
			retry: initializeBattleLabRuntime,
			logPrefix: "[Battle Lab:runtime]",
			scriptName: SCRIPT_NAME,
			showInstallNotice: false
		})) return;
		battleLabRuntimeStarting = true;
		try {
			startBattleLabRuntime();
			battleLabRuntimeReady = true;
			battleLabRuntimeError = null;
		} catch (error) {
			battleLabRuntimeError = error;
			console.error("[Battle Lab] Ошибка запуска runtime", error);
		} finally {
			battleLabRuntimeStarting = false;
		}
	}
	function startBattleLabRuntime() {
		const { cheats } = globalThis;
		const lib = createLiveGameLibrary();
		const getGameLibrary = () => readBattleLabGameLibrary(lib);
		const calcWorkers = createBattleLabCalcWorkers(() => model.activeModeId);
		const configureCalcWorkers = (settings) => calcWorkers.configure(settings);
		const caller = ensureHeroWarsCaller(globalThis);
		const repository = new BattleLabWorkspaceRepository(String(globalThis.userId ?? globalThis.NXFlashVars?.user_id ?? "unknown"));
		const tournamentMaxLevel = resolveBattleLabTournamentMaxLevel(getGameLibrary());
		const i18nLangData = getBattleLabTranslations();
		const gameTranslator = resolveGameTranslator(globalThis);
		const translate = createTranslator({
			cheats: { translate: gameTranslator },
			i18nLangData,
			preferGameI18N: false,
			fallbackLanguage: "ru",
			cacheMissingTranslations: true
		});
		const { getCopy, getModeViews, getEntityLabel, getEntityIcon, getRankFrame, getUnitDecoration, getUnitTooltip, getAsgardSummary, getTextureIcon, preloadHeroIcons } = createBattleLabViewResolvers({
			translate,
			translateGame: gameTranslator,
			gameLibrary: getGameLibrary
		});
		const rawModel = {
			activeModeId: "arena",
			selectedOpponentId: "",
			selectedVariationId: null,
			selectedTeamIndices: [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			],
			opponentsByMode: Object.fromEntries(BATTLE_LAB_MODES.map((mode) => [mode.id, []])),
			bestResults: [],
			history: [],
			settings: { ...DEFAULT_BATTLE_LAB_SETTINGS },
			maxCalculations: 500,
			calculationCount: 0,
			runState: "idle",
			statusText: "",
			errorText: "",
			attackState: "idle",
			attackStatusText: "",
			attackCountdownMs: null,
			accountState: {
				arenaPlace: null,
				grandPlace: null,
				arenaPower: 0,
				grandPower: 0,
				battles: 0,
				wins: 0
			},
			tournamentState: {
				level: null,
				maxLevel: tournamentMaxLevel,
				status: "",
				totalOpponents: 0,
				completedOpponents: 0,
				remainingOpponents: 0,
				canSetDefense: false
			},
			tournamentAutoRunning: false,
			invasionEvent: null,
			invasionShop: null,
			invasionShopBalance: {},
			territorySnapshot: readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot(),
			territoryMaps: readBattleLabTerritoryMaps(getGameLibrary()),
			runProgress: null,
			storageBytes: 0
		};
		const store = new BattleLabStore(rawModel);
		const model = new Proxy(rawModel, { set(target, prop, value) {
			const key = prop;
			target[key] = value;
			store.notify(key);
			return true;
		} });
		let workspacePromise = null;
		const campaignController = createBattleLabCampaignController({
			model,
			caller,
			library: getGameLibrary,
			onBattle: recordObservedBattle
		});
		let timingExperiences = [];
		let activeRunController = null;
		let asgardImproveController = null;
		let searchFinishController = null;
		const purchaseGate = createAsgardPurchaseGate(model);
		async function refreshBattleLabTerritoryView() {
			try {
				model.territorySnapshot = await fetchBattleLabTerritorySnapshot(caller);
				model.territoryMaps = readBattleLabTerritoryMaps(getGameLibrary());
				const targets = model.territorySnapshot ? buildBattleLabTerritoryAttackTargets(model.territorySnapshot, model.territoryMaps) : [];
				await Promise.allSettled(targets.map((target) => fetchBattleLabTerritoryEnemyTeams(caller, target.position)));
				model.territorySnapshot = readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot();
			} catch (error) {
				if (model.activeModeId === "territory") model.statusText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.territorySnapshot = readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot();
			}
			model.territoryMaps = readBattleLabTerritoryMaps(getGameLibrary());
		}
		function setModeOpponents(modeId, opponents) {
			model.opponentsByMode = {
				...model.opponentsByMode,
				[modeId]: opponents
			};
			preloadHeroIcons(opponents.flatMap((opponent) => opponent.teams.flatMap((team) => [...team.units.map((unit) => ({
				id: unit.id,
				kind: unit.type
			})), ...(team.supports ?? []).map((support) => ({
				id: support.id,
				kind: support.kind
			}))]))).catch(() => void 0);
		}
		function syncMenuButton(placement) {
			ensureBattleLabMenuRegistration().sync(placement);
			scheduleBattleLabMenuMount();
		}
		async function openBattleLab() {
			await ensureWorkspaceLoaded();
			refreshBattleLabTerritoryView();
			preloadHeroIcons().catch(() => void 0);
			if (model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId].length === 0) refreshOpponents(model.activeModeId);
			calcWorkers.dispatcher?.warmUp().catch(() => void 0);
			openBattleLabModal({
				store,
				onClose: () => {
					if (!activeRunController && model.attackState !== "attacking") calcWorkers.dispatcher?.cleanup();
				},
				onSelectMode: selectMode,
				onSelectOpponent: (opponentId) => {
					model.selectedOpponentId = opponentId;
					model.planningRoster = void 0;
					model.selectedVariationId = null;
					model.selectedTeamIndices = [
						0,
						1,
						2,
						3,
						4
					];
					model.runProgress = null;
				},
				onSelectVariation: (variationId) => {
					model.selectedVariationId = variationId;
				},
				onToggleTeamSelect: (teamIndex) => {
					model.selectedTeamIndices = toggleAsgardTeamIndex(model.selectedTeamIndices, teamIndex);
				},
				onRefresh: () => refreshOpponents(model.activeModeId),
				onCalculate: calculateSelectedOpponent,
				onStop: stopCurrentRun,
				onConfirmPurchase: () => void purchaseGate.resolve(true),
				onFinish: () => {
					searchFinishController?.abort();
					model.statusText = "Собираю план из уже найденного…";
				},
				onTrain: trainSelectedOpponent,
				onAttack: attackSelectedOpponent,
				onMaxCalculationsChange: setMaxCalculations,
				onSettingsChange: (settings) => {
					updateSettings(settings);
				},
				onClearHistory: () => {
					clearHistory();
				},
				onReplayHistory: (entryId) => {
					replayHistoryEntry(entryId);
				},
				onExportSnapshot: (entryId) => {
					if (entryId) exportHistorySnapshot(entryId);
					else exportEngineProfiles();
				},
				onImportSnapshots: (content) => {
					if (content) importHistorySnapshots(content);
				},
				loadRoster: async () => {
					const { fetchAccountSnapshot } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_optimizer_adapter(), optimizer_adapter_exports));
					model.planningRoster = toBattleLabPlanningRoster(await fetchAccountSnapshot(caller));
					model.statusText = "Ростер загружен";
				},
				getEntityLabel,
				getEntityIcon,
				getRankFrame,
				getUnitDecoration,
				getAsgardSummary,
				getTextureIcon,
				getUnitTooltip: (unit, kind) => getUnitTooltip(unit, kind),
				gameLibrary: getGameLibrary,
				getResourceUsage: () => calcWorkers.dispatcher?.resourceUsage,
				translate: (key) => cheats.translate(key)
			});
		}
		async function ensureWorkspaceLoaded() {
			if (workspacePromise) return workspacePromise;
			workspacePromise = repository.load().then((workspace) => {
				model.bestResults = workspace.bestResults;
				model.history = workspace.history;
				model.opponentsByMode = restoreOpponentsFromHistory(workspace.history);
				timingExperiences = workspace.timingExperiences;
				model.maxCalculations = workspace.maxCalculations;
				model.settings = workspace.settings;
				configureBattleLabProfiling(workspace.settings.engineProfiling);
				configureCalcWorkers(workspace.settings);
				model.planningSetups = workspace.planningSetups ?? {};
				model.storageBytes = estimateBattleLabWorkspaceBytes(workspace);
				syncMenuButton(workspace.settings.menuPlacement);
			});
			return workspacePromise;
		}
		async function selectMode(modeId) {
			if (model.runState === "running" || model.tournamentAutoRunning || model.attackState === "attacking") return;
			model.activeModeId = modeId;
			model.planningRoster = void 0;
			const opponents = model.opponentsByMode[modeId];
			model.selectedOpponentId = opponents[0]?.id ?? "";
			model.selectedVariationId = null;
			model.runProgress = null;
			model.errorText = "";
			if (opponents.length === 0 || isBattleLabCampaignMode(modeId) || isTitanArenaMode(modeId)) await refreshOpponents(modeId);
		}
		async function refreshOpponents(modeId) {
			const descriptor = BATTLE_LAB_MODES.find((mode) => mode.id === modeId);
			if (!descriptor) return;
			model.runState = "loading";
			model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_LOADING");
			model.errorText = "";
			try {
				if (modeId === "territory") {
					model.territorySnapshot = await fetchBattleLabTerritorySnapshot(caller);
					model.territoryMaps = readBattleLabTerritoryMaps(getGameLibrary());
					const targets = model.territorySnapshot ? buildBattleLabTerritoryAttackTargets(model.territorySnapshot, model.territoryMaps) : [];
					await Promise.allSettled(targets.map((target) => fetchBattleLabTerritoryEnemyTeams(caller, target.position)));
					model.territorySnapshot = readBattleLabTerritorySnapshot();
					const opponents = model.territorySnapshot ? buildBattleLabTerritoryOpponents(model.territorySnapshot, model.territoryMaps) : [];
					setModeOpponents(modeId, opponents.map((opponent) => ({
						...opponent,
						context: markRaw(opponent.context)
					})));
					model.selectedOpponentId = opponents[0]?.id ?? "";
					model.runState = "done";
					model.statusText = opponents.length ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_READY") : "В ТЗ нет соседней цели с полным серверным составом.";
					return;
				}
				if (isBattleLabCampaignMode(modeId)) {
					await campaignController.refresh(modeId);
					model.runState = "done";
					model.statusText = model.campaign?.snapshot.mapStatus ?? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_DONE");
					return;
				}
				if (isTitanArenaMode(modeId)) {
					applyTournamentStatusResponse(await sendBattleLabWithTimeout(caller, "titanArenaGetStatus"));
					model.runState = "done";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_READY");
					return;
				}
				if (modeId === "invasion" || modeId === "archdemon") {
					model.invasionEvent = await fetchBattleLabInvasionEvent(caller, getGameLibrary());
					syncInvasionOpponents(model.invasionEvent);
					await refreshInvasionShop(model.invasionEvent);
					model.selectedOpponentId = model.opponentsByMode[modeId][0]?.id ?? "";
					model.runState = "done";
					model.statusText = model.invasionEvent.lives === null ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_READY") : `Вторжение: ${model.invasionEvent.lives} жизней, глава ${model.invasionEvent.activeChapterId ?? "—"}, лавка: ${model.invasionShop?.slots.length ?? "—"} карточек.`;
					return;
				}
				if (!descriptor.opponentCall) {
					model.selectedOpponentId = model.opponentsByMode[modeId][0]?.id ?? "";
					model.runState = "done";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_READY");
					return;
				}
				const fetched = await fetchBattleLabModeOpponents(caller, {
					...descriptor,
					opponentCall: descriptor.opponentCall
				});
				if (fetched.accountState) model.accountState = fetched.accountState;
				const { opponents } = fetched;
				setModeOpponents(modeId, opponents.map((opponent) => ({
					...opponent,
					context: markRaw(opponent.context)
				})));
				if (!opponents.some((opponent) => opponent.id === model.selectedOpponentId)) model.selectedOpponentId = opponents[0]?.id ?? "";
				model.runState = "done";
				model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_READY");
			} catch (error) {
				setModeOpponents(modeId, [...EMPTY_OPPONENTS_BY_MODE[modeId]]);
				model.selectedOpponentId = "";
				model.runState = "error";
				model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.statusText = model.errorText;
			}
		}
		async function calculateSelectedOpponent() {
			if (isBattleLabCampaignMode(model.activeModeId)) {
				await campaignController.plan();
				return;
			}
			const selectedOpponent = model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId].find((item) => item.id === model.selectedOpponentId);
			if (!selectedOpponent || model.runState === "running") return;
			const opponent = hydrateBattleLabOpponent(selectedOpponent, model.history);
			const direction = isTitanArenaMode(model.activeModeId) ? model.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack";
			const runController = new AbortController();
			activeRunController = runController;
			try {
				const bestResult = await calculateOpponentPlan(opponent, direction, runController);
				if (!runController.signal.aborted && direction === "attack" && (model.settings.autoTrainAfterSearch || bestResult.modeId !== "asgard" && bestResult.searchStoppedOnPerfectVictory === true)) await trainSelectedOpponent(73);
			} catch (error) {
				if (runController.signal.aborted || searchFinishController?.signal.aborted) {
					model.runState = "done";
					model.errorText = "";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED");
					model.planningSetups = keepStoppedAsgardPlan(model.planningSetups, planningSetupKey(opponent, direction), model.bestResults.find((result) => result.opponentId === opponent.id));
					await persistWorkspace();
				} else {
					model.runState = "error";
					model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
					model.statusText = model.errorText;
				}
			} finally {
				if (activeRunController === runController) activeRunController = null;
			}
		}
		async function calculateOpponentPlan(opponent, direction, runController, setupOverride, archdemonTalismans) {
			model.bestResults = replaceBattleLabRunResult(model.bestResults, opponent, direction);
			model.selectedVariationId = null;
			const previousWinningPlan = findBattleLabHistoryMatch(opponent, model.history, {
				direction,
				requireTeams: true,
				winsOnly: true
			});
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.calculationCount = 0;
			model.runProgress = {
				kind: "search",
				phase: "screening",
				completed: 0,
				total: model.maxCalculations,
				variations: []
			};
			model.errorText = "";
			model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_RUNNING", {
				current: 0,
				total: model.maxCalculations
			});
			const setup = setupOverride ?? normalizePlanningSetup(model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(opponent, direction)]);
			const territoryLockedCandidate = readBattleLabTerritoryLockedCandidate(opponent);
			await persistWorkspace();
			await calcWorkers.dispatcher?.warmUp();
			let bestResult = await optimizeBattleLabPlan({
				caller,
				gameLibrary: getGameLibrary(),
				opponent,
				fixedCandidates: territoryLockedCandidate ? [territoryLockedCandidate] : void 0,
				fixedTeams: territoryLockedCandidate ? [territoryLockedCandidate.heroes] : void 0,
				seedTeams: previousWinningPlan?.teams,
				maxCalculations: model.maxCalculations,
				asgardTeamCount: model.settings.asgardTeamCount,
				plannerWorkers: model.settings.plannerWorkers,
				direction,
				ultraTimingEnabled: direction === "attack" && opponent.modeId !== "archdemon" && model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
				ultraMinTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
				ultraMaxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
				scenarios: planBattleLabScenarios(opponent, direction, model.settings, model.history, (key) => cheats.translate(key)),
				history: model.history,
				signal: runController.signal,
				finishSignal: (searchFinishController = new AbortController()).signal,
				onProgress: (count) => {
					if (count % 10 !== 0 && count !== 1 && count < model.maxCalculations) return;
					model.calculationCount = count;
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_RUNNING", {
						current: count,
						total: model.maxCalculations
					});
				},
				onProcess: (progress) => {
					model.runProgress = progress;
					model.calculationCount = progress.completed;
					const partial = battleLabProgressResult(opponent, direction, progress);
					if (partial) model.bestResults = replaceBattleLabRunResult(model.bestResults, opponent, direction, partial);
				}
			}, setup, archdemonTalismans);
			if (direction === "attack" && !isTitanArenaMode(opponent.modeId) && opponent.modeId !== "archdemon") {
				const learnedTiming = selectLearnedBattleTiming(timingExperiences, bestResult.modeId, bestResult.teams.map((team) => [...team.unitIds, ...team.teamPetId ? [team.teamPetId] : []]), opponent);
				if (learnedTiming && !hasManualBattleTiming(bestResult.timings)) bestResult = {
					...bestResult,
					timings: learnedTiming.actions,
					timingSource: "learned",
					confidence: Math.max(bestResult.confidence, learnedTiming.confidence)
				};
			}
			if (opponent.modeId === "asgard") {
				const key = planningSetupKey(opponent, direction);
				model.planningSetups = {
					...model.planningSetups,
					[key]: fillPlanningSetupSlots(setup, bestResult.teams)
				};
			}
			model.bestResults = [bestResult, ...model.bestResults.filter((result) => result.opponentId !== opponent.id || (result.direction ?? "attack") !== (bestResult.direction ?? "attack"))].slice(0, 100);
			model.selectedVariationId = bestResult.variations?.[0]?.id ?? null;
			model.selectedTeamIndices = [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			];
			model.history = [buildCalculatedBattleHistory(bestResult, opponentEnemyIds(opponent)), ...model.history].slice(0, model.settings.historyLimit);
			model.runState = "done";
			model.statusText = translate(runController.signal.aborted ? "HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED" : "HWHBL_STATUS_DONE");
			await persistWorkspace();
			return bestResult;
		}
		async function trainSelectedOpponent(minimumCalculations = 0) {
			const selected = model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId].find((item) => item.id === model.selectedOpponentId);
			const direction = isTitanArenaMode(model.activeModeId) ? model.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack";
			const storedResult = model.bestResults.find((result) => result.opponentId === selected?.id && (result.direction ?? "attack") === direction);
			const bestResult = resolveSelectedVariation(storedResult);
			const setup = projectPlanningSetupResult(selected && model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(selected, direction)], selected?.modeId === "asgard" ? bestResult : void 0);
			const selectedRows = selected?.modeId === "asgard" ? selectedAsgardTrainingRows(setup, model.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			], readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(selected, model.asgardAttackProgress)) : [];
			const manualSetupReady = !!selected && (selected.modeId === "asgard" ? selectedRows.length > 0 : isPlanningSetupTrainable(setup, selected, model.settings.asgardTeamCount));
			if (!selected || (selected?.modeId === "asgard" ? !manualSetupReady : !bestResult && !manualSetupReady) || model.runState === "running") {
				model.errorText = translate("HWHBL_TRAIN_NO_RESULT");
				return;
			}
			const opponent = hydrateBattleLabOpponent(selected, model.history);
			const runsPerTeam = Math.max(model.settings.trainingRuns, minimumCalculations);
			const trainingCalculations = runsPerTeam * (opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? selectedRows.length : 1);
			if (!Number.isSafeInteger(trainingCalculations)) {
				model.errorText = "Слишком большое общее число расчётов тренировки.";
				return;
			}
			const runController = new AbortController();
			activeRunController = runController;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.calculationCount = 0;
			model.runProgress = {
				kind: "training",
				phase: "training",
				completed: 0,
				total: trainingCalculations,
				variations: []
			};
			model.errorText = "";
			model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_TRAINING", {
				current: 0,
				total: trainingCalculations
			});
			model.bestResults = replaceBattleLabRunResult(model.bestResults, opponent, direction);
			model.selectedVariationId = null;
			try {
				await persistWorkspace();
				const progressCallbacks = {
					onProgress: (count) => {
						model.calculationCount = count;
						model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_TRAINING", {
							current: count,
							total: trainingCalculations
						});
					},
					onProcess: (progress) => {
						model.runProgress = progress;
						model.calculationCount = progress.completed;
						const partial = battleLabProgressResult(opponent, direction, progress);
						if (partial) model.bestResults = replaceBattleLabRunResult(model.bestResults, opponent, direction, partial);
					}
				};
				const scenarios = planBattleLabScenarios(opponent, direction, model.settings, model.history, (key) => cheats.translate(key));
				await calcWorkers.dispatcher?.warmUp();
				const trained = opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? await trainAsgardTeams({
					caller,
					gameLibrary: getGameLibrary(),
					opponent,
					setup,
					bestResult,
					runsPerTeam,
					selectedTeamIndices: selectedRows,
					plannerWorkers: model.settings.plannerWorkers,
					ultraTimingEnabled: model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
					ultraMinTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
					ultraMaxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
					scenarios,
					history: model.history,
					signal: runController.signal,
					...progressCallbacks
				}) : manualSetupReady ? await optimizeBattleLabPlan({
					caller,
					gameLibrary: getGameLibrary(),
					opponent,
					maxCalculations: trainingCalculations,
					asgardTeamCount: model.settings.asgardTeamCount,
					plannerWorkers: model.settings.plannerWorkers,
					direction,
					ultraTimingEnabled: direction === "attack" && opponent.modeId !== "archdemon" && model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
					ultraMinTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
					ultraMaxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
					scenarios,
					history: model.history,
					signal: runController.signal,
					runKind: "training",
					...progressCallbacks
				}, setup) : await trainBattleLabResult({
					caller,
					gameLibrary: getGameLibrary(),
					opponent,
					bestResult,
					maxCalculations: trainingCalculations,
					plannerWorkers: model.settings.plannerWorkers,
					ultraTimingEnabled: direction === "attack" && bestResult.modeId !== "archdemon" && model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
					ultraMinTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
					ultraMaxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
					scenarios,
					history: model.history,
					signal: runController.signal,
					...progressCallbacks
				});
				const mergedResult = {
					...mergeAsgardTrainingResult(storedResult, trained),
					variations: opponent.modeId === "asgard" ? [] : [...trained.variations ?? [], ...(storedResult?.variations ?? []).filter((variation) => variation.id !== model.selectedVariationId)].slice(0, 5)
				};
				model.bestResults = [mergedResult, ...model.bestResults.filter((result) => result.opponentId !== selected.id || (result.direction ?? "attack") !== direction)].slice(0, 100);
				model.selectedVariationId = mergedResult.variations?.[0]?.id ?? null;
				if (opponent.modeId === "asgard") {
					const key = planningSetupKey(selected, direction);
					const trainedByHeroIds = (ids) => trained.teams.find((team) => team.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => team.unitIds.includes(id)));
					model.planningSetups = {
						...model.planningSetups,
						[key]: {
							...setup,
							teamPetSelections: setup.teams.map((ids, index) => {
								const team = trainedByHeroIds(ids);
								return team ? team.teamPetId : setup.teamPetSelections[index];
							}),
							favorSelections: setup.teams.map((ids, index) => trainedByHeroIds(ids)?.favor ?? setup.favorSelections?.[index] ?? {})
						}
					};
					model.runProgress = {
						kind: "training",
						phase: "training",
						completed: trained.calculationCount,
						total: trainingCalculations,
						variations: []
					};
				}
				model.history = [buildCalculatedBattleHistory(mergedResult, opponentEnemyIds(opponent)), ...model.history].slice(0, model.settings.historyLimit);
				model.runState = "done";
				model.statusText = translate(runController.signal.aborted ? "HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED" : "HWHBL_STATUS_TRAINED");
				await persistWorkspace();
			} catch (error) {
				if (runController.signal.aborted) {
					model.runState = "done";
					model.errorText = "";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED");
					await persistWorkspace();
				} else {
					model.runState = "error";
					model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
					model.statusText = model.errorText;
				}
			} finally {
				if (activeRunController === runController) activeRunController = null;
			}
		}
		function stopCurrentRun() {
			if (purchaseGate.resolve(false)) return;
			if (model.attackState === "attacking" && asgardImproveController) {
				asgardImproveController.abort();
				model.attackStatusText = "Улучшение остановлено, отправляю лучший найденный бой…";
				return;
			}
			campaignController.stop();
			if (!activeRunController || activeRunController.signal.aborted) return;
			activeRunController.abort();
			model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPING");
		}
		async function setMaxCalculations(value) {
			model.maxCalculations = clampCalculationCount(value);
			await ensureWorkspaceLoaded();
			await persistWorkspace();
		}
		async function runTerritoryAutomatically() {
			if (model.runState === "running" || model.attackState === "attacking") return;
			if (!confirmBattleLabAction(model.settings.confirmAttack, translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_CONFIRM"))) return;
			const runController = new AbortController();
			activeRunController = runController;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.attackState = "checking";
			model.errorText = "";
			let battles = 0;
			try {
				while (!runController.signal.aborted) {
					await refreshOpponents("territory");
					const snapshot = model.territorySnapshot;
					if (!snapshot || snapshot.actionPoints === null || snapshot.actionPoints <= 0) break;
					const opponent = model.opponentsByMode.territory[0];
					if (!opponent) break;
					model.selectedOpponentId = opponent.id;
					const beforeActionPoints = snapshot.actionPoints;
					const result = await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(opponent, model.history), "attack", runController);
					if (runController.signal.aborted) break;
					await executePlannedBattle("territory", opponent, result);
					battles += 1;
					await refreshOpponents("territory");
					const afterActionPoints = model.territorySnapshot?.actionPoints;
					if (!hasBattleLabTerritoryActionProgress(beforeActionPoints, afterActionPoints)) throw new BattleLabAttackBlockedError("ТЗ не подтвердил расход хода после боя. Автозахват остановлен, чтобы не отправлять повторную атаку.");
				}
				model.runState = "done";
				model.attackState = "done";
				model.statusText = runController.signal.aborted ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED") : `ТЗ: выполнено атак ${battles}.`;
				model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
			} catch (error) {
				if (runController.signal.aborted) {
					model.runState = "done";
					model.attackState = "done";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED");
					model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
				} else {
					model.runState = "error";
					model.attackState = error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError ? "blocked" : "error";
					model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
					model.statusText = model.errorText;
					model.attackStatusText = model.errorText;
				}
			} finally {
				if (activeRunController === runController) activeRunController = null;
			}
		}
		/** Оставляет отмеченные и ещё не отработавшие пачки; null — атаковать нечем. */
		function selectAttackTargetTeams(selected, bestResult) {
			const target = selectBattleLabAttackTarget(model.activeModeId, bestResult, model.planningSetups?.[`asgard:${selected.id}:attack`], model.selectedTeamIndices ?? [
				0,
				1,
				2,
				3,
				4
			], readAsgardAttackUsedHeroes(selected, model.asgardAttackProgress));
			if ("result" in target) return target.result;
			model.attackState = "blocked";
			model.attackStatusText = target.blocked;
			return null;
		}
		async function attackSelectedOpponent() {
			if (isBattleLabCampaignMode(model.activeModeId)) {
				await campaignController.attack(model.selectedOpponentId);
				return;
			}
			const selected = model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId].find((opponent) => opponent.id === model.selectedOpponentId);
			const bestResult = resolveSelectedVariation(model.bestResults.find((result) => result.opponentId === selected?.id && (result.direction ?? "attack") === (isTitanArenaMode(model.activeModeId) ? model.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack")));
			if (!selected || !bestResult) {
				model.attackState = "blocked";
				model.attackStatusText = translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_NO_RESULT");
				return;
			}
			if (!confirmBattleLabAction(model.settings.confirmAttack, translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_CONFIRM"))) return;
			const targetedResult = selectAttackTargetTeams(selected, bestResult);
			if (!targetedResult) return;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = model.activeModeId === "asgard" ? {
				opponentId: selected.id,
				teams: targetedResult.teams.map((team) => ({
					unitIds: [...team.unitIds],
					phase: "waiting"
				}))
			} : null;
			model.attackState = "checking";
			model.attackStatusText = translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_CHECKING");
			model.attackCountdownMs = null;
			try {
				let attackExecutionResult;
				if (model.activeModeId === "epic-brawl" && model.settings.epicBrawlAutoBattle) attackExecutionResult = await executeEpicBrawlSeries(selected, targetedResult);
				else attackExecutionResult = await executePlannedBattle(model.activeModeId, selected, targetedResult);
				await refreshOpponents(model.activeModeId);
				let advancedTier = false;
				if (isTitanArenaMode(model.activeModeId) && (bestResult.direction ?? "attack") === "attack" && isBattleLabTournamentTierComplete(model.tournamentState)) {
					await advanceTournamentTierFromServer();
					advancedTier = true;
				}
				model.attackState = "done";
				const executionRecord = asRecord$1(attackExecutionResult);
				const stoppedReason = executionRecord.stoppedReason;
				const responseCount = Array.isArray(executionRecord.responses) ? executionRecord.responses.length : null;
				if (stoppedReason && typeof stoppedReason === "string") model.attackStatusText = `Атака: ${responseCount ? `выполнено ${responseCount} из ${targetedResult.teams.length}, ` : ""}${stoppedReason}`;
				else model.attackStatusText = advancedTier ? translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_TIER_UPDATED") : responseCount && responseCount > 1 ? `Атака завершена (${responseCount} пачек).` : translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_DONE");
			} catch (error) {
				model.attackState = error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError ? "blocked" : "error";
				model.attackStatusText = error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError ? error.message : `${translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_BLOCKED")}: ${getErrorMessage$1(error)}`;
			} finally {
				model.attackCountdownMs = null;
			}
		}
		async function selectInvasionChapter(chapterId) {
			if (model.activeModeId !== "invasion" || model.runState === "running") return;
			model.runState = "loading";
			model.errorText = "";
			try {
				model.invasionEvent = await selectBattleLabInvasionChapter(caller, chapterId, getGameLibrary());
				syncInvasionOpponents(model.invasionEvent);
				await refreshInvasionShop(model.invasionEvent);
				model.selectedOpponentId = model.opponentsByMode.invasion[0]?.id ?? "";
				model.selectedVariationId = null;
				model.statusText = `Вторжение: выбрана глава ${model.invasionEvent.chapters.find((chapter) => chapter.active)?.number ?? "—"}.`;
				model.runState = "done";
			} catch (error) {
				model.runState = "error";
				model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.statusText = model.errorText;
			}
		}
		async function runInvasionAutomatically() {
			if (model.runState === "running" || model.attackState === "attacking") return;
			if (!confirmBattleLabAction(model.settings.confirmAttack, translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_CONFIRM"))) return;
			const runController = new AbortController();
			activeRunController = runController;
			let selectedTalismanId = null;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.attackState = "checking";
			model.errorText = "";
			try {
				const result = await runBattleLabInvasionAutomation({
					signal: runController.signal,
					load: async () => {
						const snapshot = await fetchBattleLabInvasionEvent(caller, getGameLibrary());
						model.invasionEvent = snapshot;
						syncInvasionOpponents(snapshot);
						return snapshot;
					},
					selectChapter: async (chapter) => {
						selectedTalismanId = null;
						const snapshot = await selectBattleLabInvasionChapter(caller, chapter.id, getGameLibrary());
						model.invasionEvent = snapshot;
						syncInvasionOpponents(snapshot);
						await refreshInvasionShop(snapshot);
						return snapshot;
					},
					selectTalisman: async (snapshot) => {
						const offeredIds = await rollBattleLabInvasionTalismans(caller);
						const opponent = findInvasionActionOpponent(snapshot, true);
						if (!opponent) throw new Error("Сервер не вернул цель Архидемона для выбора талисмана.");
						const setup = {
							...normalizePlanningSetup(model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(opponent, "attack")]),
							archdemonTalisman: "auto"
						};
						const talismanId = (await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(opponent, model.history), "attack", runController, setup, {
							offeredIds,
							includeNoTalisman: false
						})).archdemonTalismanPlan?.talismanId;
						if (!talismanId) throw new Error("Не удалось выбрать талисман из серверного броска.");
						await selectBattleLabInvasionTalisman(caller, talismanId, offeredIds);
						selectedTalismanId = talismanId;
					},
					plan: async (action, snapshot) => {
						let activeSnapshot = model.invasionEvent ?? snapshot;
						let opponent = findInvasionActionOpponent(activeSnapshot, action.boss, action.id);
						if (!opponent) throw new Error("Серверная точка Вторжения исчезла до расчёта.");
						const setup = action.boss && selectedTalismanId ? {
							...normalizePlanningSetup(model.planningSetups?.[planningSetupKey(opponent, "attack")]),
							archdemonTalisman: selectedTalismanId
						} : void 0;
						let plannedResult = await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(opponent, model.history), "attack", runController, setup);
						if (!action.boss && model.settings.invasionAutoShop) {
							const shopUpgrade = await improveInvasionTeamFromShop(plannedResult, activeSnapshot, runController.signal);
							if (shopUpgrade.changed) {
								activeSnapshot = model.invasionEvent ?? activeSnapshot;
								opponent = findInvasionActionOpponent(activeSnapshot, false, action.id);
								if (!opponent) throw new Error("Точка Вторжения исчезла после обновления лавки.");
								plannedResult = await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(opponent, model.history), "attack", runController, setup);
							}
							if (!shopUpgrade.complete) plannedResult = await calculateOpponentPlan(restrictInvasionOpponentToOwnedUnits(opponent, model.invasionEvent ?? activeSnapshot), "attack", runController, setup);
						}
						return plannedResult;
					},
					attack: async (action, plan, snapshot) => {
						const opponent = findInvasionActionOpponent(model.invasionEvent ?? snapshot, action.boss, action.id);
						if (!opponent) throw new Error("Серверная точка Вторжения исчезла перед атакой.");
						await executePlannedBattle(opponent.modeId, opponent, plan);
						model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
						model.runState = "running";
					},
					onProgress: (progress) => {
						model.statusText = formatInvasionAutomationStatus(progress);
					}
				});
				model.runState = "done";
				model.attackState = "done";
				model.statusText = result.stopped ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED") : `Вторжение завершено: боёв ${result.battles}.`;
				model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
			} catch (error) {
				model.runState = runController.signal.aborted ? "done" : "error";
				model.attackState = runController.signal.aborted ? "done" : "error";
				model.statusText = runController.signal.aborted ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED") : getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
			} finally {
				if (activeRunController === runController) activeRunController = null;
			}
		}
		function findInvasionActionOpponent(snapshot, boss, actionId) {
			const modeId = boss ? "archdemon" : "invasion";
			const action = findBattleLabInvasionAction(snapshot, boss, actionId);
			if (!action) return void 0;
			return buildBattleLabInvasionOpponents(snapshot, getGameLibrary(), modeId).find((item) => item.context.__battleLabInvasionActionId === action.id);
		}
		function syncInvasionOpponents(snapshot) {
			const library = getGameLibrary();
			setModeOpponents("invasion", buildBattleLabInvasionOpponents(snapshot, library, "invasion"));
			setModeOpponents("archdemon", buildBattleLabInvasionOpponents(snapshot, library, "archdemon"));
		}
		async function refreshInvasionShop(snapshot) {
			try {
				model.invasionShop = await fetchBattleLabInvasionShop(caller, snapshot, getGameLibrary());
				model.invasionShopBalance = await fetchBattleLabInvasionShopBalance(caller, model.invasionShop);
			} catch {
				model.invasionShop = null;
				model.invasionShopBalance = {};
			}
		}
		/**
		* Лавка усиливает только найденную пачку. Сначала берём детерминированные
		* карточки, затем — если пользователь разрешил — ограниченно обновляем
		* витрину и каждый раз перечитываем её с сервера.
		*/
		async function improveInvasionTeamFromShop(result, snapshot, signal) {
			const unitIds = result.teams.flatMap((team) => team.unitIds);
			if (unitIds.length === 0 || signal.aborted) return {
				changed: false,
				complete: false
			};
			let remainingNeed = buildBattleLabInvasionShopNeed(unitIds, snapshot.fragments);
			if (Object.keys(remainingNeed).length === 0) return {
				changed: false,
				complete: true
			};
			let shop = await fetchBattleLabInvasionShop(caller, snapshot, getGameLibrary());
			const requiredUnitIds = new Set(unitIds.filter((id) => snapshot.availableUnits.includes(id)));
			let changed = false;
			for (let refresh = 0; !signal.aborted; refresh += 1) {
				const balance = await fetchBattleLabInvasionShopBalance(caller, shop);
				const plan = planBattleLabInvasionShopPurchases({
					shop,
					balance,
					neededFragments: remainingNeed
				});
				remainingNeed = plan.remainingNeed;
				if (plan.purchases.length > 0) {
					await buyBattleLabInvasionShopPurchases(caller, shop, plan.purchases);
					changed = true;
				}
				if (plan.pinSlotId) await pinBattleLabInvasionShopSlot(caller, shop.shopId, plan.pinSlotId);
				const ownedUnitIds = new Set(snapshot.availableUnits.filter((id) => Number(snapshot.fragments[String(id)] ?? 0) >= 1));
				for (const purchase of plan.purchases) for (const id of Object.keys(purchase.usefulFragments).map(Number)) ownedUnitIds.add(id);
				const bootstrap = planBattleLabInvasionShopBootstrap({
					shop,
					balance: plan.remainingBalance,
					ownedUnitCount: [...requiredUnitIds].filter((id) => ownedUnitIds.has(id)).length,
					requiredUnitCount: requiredUnitIds.size
				});
				if (bootstrap.purchase) {
					await buyBattleLabInvasionShopPurchases(caller, shop, [bootstrap.purchase]);
					changed = true;
					break;
				}
				if (Object.keys(plan.remainingNeed).length === 0 || !plan.canRefresh || refresh >= model.settings.invasionAutoShopRefreshLimit) break;
				shop = await refreshBattleLabInvasionShop(caller, shop);
			}
			const complete = Object.keys(remainingNeed).length === 0;
			if (!changed || signal.aborted) return {
				changed,
				complete
			};
			const updated = await fetchBattleLabInvasionEvent(caller, getGameLibrary());
			model.invasionEvent = updated;
			syncInvasionOpponents(updated);
			await refreshInvasionShop(updated);
			return {
				changed: true,
				complete: isBattleLabInvasionShopNeedComplete(unitIds, updated.fragments)
			};
		}
		function restrictInvasionOpponentToOwnedUnits(opponent, snapshot) {
			return {
				...opponent,
				context: {
					...opponent.context,
					__battleLabInvasionAllowedUnits: [...snapshot.availableUnits],
					__battleLabInvasionFragments: { ...snapshot.fragments },
					__battleLabInvasionFullRoster: false
				}
			};
		}
		async function executePlannedBattle(modeId, opponent, bestResult) {
			model.attackState = "attacking";
			model.attackStatusText = translate("HWHBL_ATTACK_RUNNING");
			await calcWorkers.dispatcher?.warmUp();
			const direction = bestResult.direction ?? "attack";
			const sequence = modeId === "asgard" ? buildAsgardAttackSequence(bestResult.teams, bestResult.asgardBuffPlan?.schedule) : [];
			if (sequence.length) bestResult = {
				...bestResult,
				teams: sequence.map((step) => step.team)
			};
			return executeBattleLabAttack({
				caller,
				modeId,
				opponent,
				bestResult,
				asgardLiveTiming: modeId === "asgard" ? createAsgardLiveTimingOptions(model, opponent.id, {
					timerDivisor: await readAccountBattleTimerDivisor(caller),
					readSkipSignal: () => {
						asgardImproveController = new AbortController();
						return asgardImproveController.signal;
					},
					purchaseBefore: (ids) => sequence.find((step) => step.team.unitIds.length === ids.length && ids.every((id) => step.team.unitIds.includes(id)))?.buyBefore ?? null,
					waitForPurchase: (counts) => purchaseGate.wait(counts, asgardBuffSlotNames(opponent, getGameLibrary(), translate))
				}) : void 0,
				tournamentLiveTiming: isTitanArenaMode(modeId) && direction === "attack" ? {
					enabled: model.settings.ultraTimingEnabled,
					minTime: model.settings.ultraMinTime,
					maxTime: model.settings.ultraMaxTime,
					maxCalculations: LIVE_TOURNAMENT_TIMING_LIMIT,
					submissionReserveMs: 1e4,
					onProgress: (progress) => {
						model.attackCountdownMs = progress.remainingMs;
						model.attackStatusText = formatBattleLabTournamentStatus(progress, translate);
					}
				} : void 0,
				executor: calcWorkers.dispatcher ?? void 0
			});
		}
		async function advanceTournamentTier() {
			if (model.tournamentAutoRunning || model.runState === "running") return;
			model.attackState = "checking";
			model.attackStatusText = translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_ADVANCING");
			try {
				await advanceTournamentTierFromServer();
				model.attackState = "done";
				model.attackStatusText = translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_TIER_UPDATED");
			} catch (error) {
				model.attackState = error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError ? "blocked" : "error";
				model.attackStatusText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
			}
		}
		async function advanceTournamentTierFromServer() {
			const { statusResponse } = await completeBattleLabTournamentTier(caller);
			return applyTournamentStatusResponse(statusResponse, true);
		}
		async function loadTournamentAutomationSnapshot() {
			return applyTournamentStatusResponse(await caller.send("titanArenaGetStatus"), true);
		}
		function applyTournamentStatusResponse(response, followTier = false) {
			const snapshot = readTitanArenaOpponents(response, tournamentMaxLevel, (key) => cheats.translate(key));
			model.tournamentState = snapshot.state;
			model.bestResults = model.bestResults.filter((result) => {
				if (!isTitanArenaMode(result.modeId)) return true;
				const opponent = snapshot.opponents.find((item) => item.id === result.opponentId);
				return opponent !== void 0 && matchesTitanArenaPlan(result, opponent);
			});
			for (const modeId of ["tournament-of-elements", "lord"]) setModeOpponents(modeId, snapshot.opponentsByMode[modeId].map((opponent) => ({
				...opponent,
				context: markRaw(opponent.context)
			})));
			if (followTier || model.activeModeId === "tournament-of-elements" && snapshot.tierMode === "lord") model.activeModeId = snapshot.tierMode;
			const activeOpponents = model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId];
			if (!activeOpponents.some((opponent) => opponent.id === model.selectedOpponentId)) {
				model.selectedOpponentId = activeOpponents[0]?.id ?? "";
				model.selectedVariationId = null;
			}
			return {
				state: snapshot.state,
				opponents: snapshot.opponents
			};
		}
		async function runTournamentAutomatically(scope = "all") {
			if (model.tournamentAutoRunning || model.runState === "running") return;
			if (!confirmBattleLabAction(model.settings.confirmAttack, translate(scope === "current-tier" ? "HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_TIER_CONFIRM" : "HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_CONFIRM"))) return;
			const runController = new AbortController();
			activeRunController = runController;
			model.tournamentAutoRunning = true;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.attackState = "checking";
			model.errorText = "";
			model.attackCountdownMs = null;
			try {
				const automationResult = await runBattleLabTournamentAutomation({
					scope,
					signal: runController.signal,
					load: loadTournamentAutomationSnapshot,
					prepareDefense: async (snapshot) => {
						model.tournamentRunDirection = "defense";
						const source = snapshot.opponents[0];
						if (!source) throw new Error("На текущем уровне нет соперников для расчёта защиты.");
						model.activeModeId = source.modeId;
						model.selectedOpponentId = source.id;
						model.selectedVariationId = null;
						const defense = await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(source, model.history), "defense", runController);
						if (runController.signal.aborted) return;
						await executePlannedBattle(source.modeId, source, defense);
						model.attackCountdownMs = null;
						model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
						model.runState = "running";
					},
					prepareAttack: async (source) => {
						model.tournamentRunDirection = "attack";
						model.activeModeId = source.modeId;
						model.selectedOpponentId = source.id;
						model.selectedVariationId = null;
						const plannedAttack = await calculateOpponentPlan(hydrateBattleLabOpponent(source, model.history), "attack", runController);
						model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
						model.runState = "running";
						return plannedAttack;
					},
					attack: async (opponent, plannedAttack) => {
						await executePlannedBattle(opponent.modeId, opponent, plannedAttack);
						model.attackCountdownMs = null;
						model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
						model.runState = "running";
					},
					advanceTier: advanceTournamentTierFromServer,
					onProgress: (progress) => {
						model.runState = progress.phase === "done" || progress.phase === "stopped" ? "done" : "running";
						model.statusText = formatTournamentAutomationStatus(progress, translate) ?? model.statusText;
					}
				});
				model.runState = "done";
				model.attackState = "done";
				model.statusText = automationResult.stopped ? translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED") : translate("HWHBL_TOURNAMENT_AUTO_DONE", {
					battles: automationResult.battles,
					tiers: automationResult.completedTiers
				});
				model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
			} catch (error) {
				if (runController.signal.aborted) {
					model.runState = "done";
					model.attackState = "done";
					model.errorText = "";
					model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_STOPPED");
					model.attackStatusText = model.statusText;
				} else {
					model.runState = "error";
					model.attackState = error instanceof BattleLabAttackBlockedError ? "blocked" : "error";
					model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
					model.statusText = model.errorText;
					model.attackStatusText = model.errorText;
				}
			} finally {
				model.tournamentAutoRunning = false;
				model.tournamentRunDirection = void 0;
				model.attackCountdownMs = null;
				if (activeRunController === runController) activeRunController = null;
			}
		}
		async function executeEpicBrawlSeries(initialOpponent, initialResult) {
			let opponent = initialOpponent;
			let result = initialResult;
			const maximumBattles = model.settings.epicBrawlMaxBattles;
			for (let battleIndex = 0; battleIndex < maximumBattles; battleIndex += 1) {
				model.attackStatusText = `Вселенская битва · ${battleIndex + 1}/${maximumBattles}`;
				const win = findBattleExecutionWin(await executeBattleLabAttack({
					caller,
					modeId: "epic-brawl",
					opponent,
					bestResult: result
				}));
				if (win === null || win === false && model.settings.epicBrawlStopOnDefeat) return;
				await refreshOpponents("epic-brawl");
				const nextOpponent = model.opponentsByMode["epic-brawl"][0];
				if (!nextOpponent) return;
				model.selectedOpponentId = nextOpponent.id;
				await calculateSelectedOpponent();
				const nextResult = model.bestResults.find((candidate) => candidate.modeId === "epic-brawl" && candidate.opponentId === nextOpponent.id && (candidate.direction ?? "attack") === "attack");
				if (!nextResult) return;
				opponent = nextOpponent;
				result = nextResult;
			}
		}
		async function updateSettings(settings) {
			model.settings = normalizeBattleLabSettings(settings);
			configureBattleLabProfiling(model.settings.engineProfiling);
			configureCalcWorkers(model.settings);
			model.history = model.history.slice(0, model.settings.historyLimit);
			syncMenuButton(model.settings.menuPlacement);
			await ensureWorkspaceLoaded();
			await persistWorkspace();
		}
		function resolveSelectedVariation(result) {
			if (!result || !model.selectedVariationId) return result;
			const variation = result.variations?.find((candidate) => candidate.id === model.selectedVariationId);
			if (!variation) return result;
			return {
				...result,
				teams: variation.teams,
				timings: variation.actions,
				timingSource: variation.actions.some((action, index) => action.type !== "auto" || action.time > 0 || index > 0) ? "calculated" : "automatic",
				score: result.modeId === "asgard" ? variation.scoreMax ?? variation.scoreMean : variation.scoreMean,
				wins: variation.wins,
				confidence: variation.confidenceLow ?? result.confidence,
				statistics: {
					attempted: variation.attempted,
					succeeded: variation.succeeded,
					failed: variation.failed,
					wins: variation.wins,
					losses: variation.losses,
					unknown: variation.unknown,
					winRate: variation.winRate,
					scoreMean: variation.scoreMean,
					scoreMax: variation.scoreMax ?? variation.scoreMean,
					scoreDeviation: variation.scoreDeviation,
					confidenceLow: variation.confidenceLow,
					confidenceHigh: variation.confidenceHigh
				}
			};
		}
		async function recordObservedBattle(battle) {
			showBattleLabToast(buildBattleLabBattleNotification(battle, getModeViews().find((mode) => mode.id === battle.modeId)?.label ?? battle.modeId, getCopy()));
			if (battle.serverError) return;
			await ensureWorkspaceLoaded();
			const projection = await projectObservedBattle({
				battle,
				history: model.history,
				opponents: model.opponentsByMode[battle.modeId],
				historyLimit: model.settings.historyLimit
			});
			setModeOpponents(battle.modeId, projection.opponents);
			if (battle.modeId === "invasion" && projection.opponent) {
				const riftOpponent = {
					...projection.opponent,
					id: `dominion-rift:${projection.opponent.externalId}`,
					modeId: "dominion-rift",
					name: `${projection.opponent.name} · Буря`
				};
				const current = model.opponentsByMode["dominion-rift"];
				setModeOpponents("dominion-rift", [riftOpponent, ...current.filter((opponent) => opponent.externalId !== riftOpponent.externalId)]);
			}
			model.history = projection.history;
			if (battle.modeId === "archdemon") setModeOpponents("archdemon", restoreOpponentsFromHistory(model.history).archdemon);
			timingExperiences = learnBattleTiming(timingExperiences, battle, projection.opponent);
			await persistWorkspace();
		}
		async function clearHistory() {
			model.history = [];
			model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_HISTORY_CLEARED");
			await persistWorkspace();
		}
		async function replayHistoryEntry(entryId) {
			const entry = model.history.find((item) => item.id === entryId);
			if (!entry) return;
			model.asgardAttackProgress = null;
			model.runState = "running";
			model.errorText = "";
			model.statusText = `${translate("HWHBL_REPLAY")}: ${entry.opponentName}`;
			try {
				const replayed = await replayBattleLabHistory(entry);
				model.history = model.history.map((item) => item.id === entry.id ? replayed : item);
				model.runState = "done";
				model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_STATUS_TRAINED");
				await persistWorkspace();
			} catch (error) {
				model.runState = "error";
				model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.statusText = model.errorText;
			}
		}
		function exportEngineProfiles() {
			const reports = readBattleLabProfiles();
			if (reports.length === 0) {
				model.statusText = translate("HWHBL_ENGINE_PROFILE_EMPTY");
				return;
			}
			downloadJsonFile(`hwh-battle-lab-engine-profiles-${Date.now()}.json`, { reports });
		}
		function exportHistorySnapshot(entryId) {
			const entry = model.history.find((item) => item.id === entryId);
			if (!entry) return;
			const snapshot = JSON.parse(serializeBattleLabSnapshot(entry));
			downloadJsonFile(`hwh-battle-lab-${entry.replayKind}-${entry.createdAt}.json`, snapshot);
		}
		async function importHistorySnapshots(content) {
			try {
				const imported = parseBattleLabSnapshots(content);
				if (imported.length === 0) throw new Error("Файл не содержит полных снимков Battle Lab.");
				const merged = new Map([...imported, ...model.history].map((entry) => [`${entry.platformId}:${entry.id}`, entry]));
				model.history = [...merged.values()].sort((left, right) => right.createdAt - left.createdAt).slice(0, model.settings.historyLimit);
				model.opponentsByMode = restoreOpponentsFromHistory(model.history);
				model.runState = "done";
				model.errorText = "";
				model.statusText = `${translate("HWHBL_IMPORT_SNAPSHOT")}: ${imported.length}`;
				await persistWorkspace();
			} catch (error) {
				model.runState = "error";
				model.errorText = getErrorMessage$1(error);
				model.statusText = model.errorText;
			}
		}
		function restoreOpponentsFromHistory(history) {
			return Object.fromEntries(BATTLE_LAB_MODES.map((mode) => [mode.id, buildBattleLabHistoryOpponents(mode, history, getGameLibrary(), (key) => key.startsWith("HWHBL_") ? translate(key) : cheats.translate(key)).map((opponent) => ({
				...opponent,
				context: markRaw(opponent.context)
			}))]));
		}
		async function persistWorkspace() {
			const workspace = {
				schemaVersion: 6,
				bestResults: model.bestResults,
				history: model.history,
				timingExperiences,
				maxCalculations: model.maxCalculations,
				settings: model.settings,
				planningSetups: model.planningSetups
			};
			await repository.save(workspace);
			model.storageBytes = estimateBattleLabWorkspaceBytes(workspace);
		}
		async function updatePlanningSetup(setup) {
			if (model.runState === "running" || model.tournamentAutoRunning || model.attackState === "attacking") return;
			const opponent = model.opponentsByMode[model.activeModeId].find((item) => item.id === model.selectedOpponentId);
			if (!opponent) return;
			const direction = isTitanArenaMode(model.activeModeId) ? model.settings.tournamentDirection : "attack";
			model.planningSetups = {
				...model.planningSetups,
				[planningSetupKey(opponent, direction)]: normalizePlanningSetup(setup)
			};
			model.bestResults = model.bestResults.filter((result) => result.opponentId !== opponent.id || (result.direction ?? "attack") !== direction);
			model.selectedVariationId = null;
			model.runProgress = null;
			if (model.campaign) model.campaign = {
				...model.campaign,
				plan: []
			};
			await persistWorkspace();
		}
		function findBattleExecutionWin(value) {
			const { result } = parseBattleLabServerResponse(value);
			return result === "win" ? true : result === "loss" ? false : null;
		}
		registerBattleLabHelperExtension();
		observeBattleHistory((battle) => void recordObservedBattle(battle), (key) => gameTranslator(key));
		openBattleLabHandler = openBattleLab;
		syncMenuButton(model.settings.menuPlacement);
		const runtimeRoot = globalThis;
		runtimeRoot.HWHBattleLab = {
			runTerritoryAutomatically,
			selectInvasionChapter,
			runInvasionAutomatically,
			advanceTournamentTier,
			runTournamentAutomatically,
			updatePlanningSetup,
			open: openBattleLab
		};
		ensureWorkspaceLoaded().catch((error) => {
			battleLabRuntimeError = error;
			console.error("[Battle Lab] Локальное состояние не загрузилось", error);
		});
	}
	function readBattleLabTerritoryMaps(library) {
		return [3, 4].map((mapId) => buildBattleLabTerritoryMap(library, mapId)).filter((map) => map !== null);
	}
	//#endregion
	//#region src/entries/hwhbattlelab.user.ts
	initializeBattleLabExtension(0);
	//#endregion
})();
